The minister denies the 120,000 euro figure, says the stickers were added under a previous cabinet and their added value was insufficient, and states they will not be included in future maintenance contracts and existing contracts will be revised unless this costs more.
Therefore, when the still-running maintenance contracts are renewed, it will no longer be included that the stickers must be applied.
Daarom zal bij de vernieuwing van de nog lopende onderhoudscontracten niet meer worden opgenomen dat de stickers moeten worden aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat er veel meer daklozen in Nederland zijn

An MP asked whether the government is aware of reports that homelessness in the Netherlands has risen sharply. The State Secretary answered that the CBS figures are based on registrations for shelter and homeless benefit, not street counts, and pointed to measures on social housing access for status holders.
These figures therefore relate to the number of people who claim shelter and a homeless benefit, and not necessarily the number of people who live on the street.
Deze cijfers hebben dus betrekking op het aantal personen dat een beroep doet op opvang en een daklozenuitkering en niet perse het aantal mensen dat op straat verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat statushouders met voorrang een sociale huurwoning krijgen met lagere huur van een woningcorporatie in Amsterdam

An MP asked the minister whether a Amsterdam housing association (not a recognised social landlord) gives refugee status holders priority and lower rents for social housing, and whether this should be stopped. The minister said the association falls outside his responsibility, that landlords set rents within rules, and that the Huisvestingswet urgency rule for permit holders is being removed by a bill to be sent to parliament this spring.
Because this is not a recognised housing association, the allocation system of this association does not fall under my policy responsibility.
Omdat dit geen toegelaten instelling is valt het toewijzingssysteem van deze vereniging niet onder mijn beleidsverantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat er weer een storing was op de Botlekbrug

An MP asked the minister why a Botlek bridge fault took over seven hours to fix, how often the bridge has failed, and how the builder is held liable for the damage. The minister explained the fault and repair steps, pointed to an independent review to be sent to parliament, and said the contract with the builder covers repairs but not damage from failures.
An independent review has taken place on the faults and their handling on the new Botlek bridge. I will send the results of this review to the House of Representatives at the beginning of March.

Er heeft een onafhankelijke review plaatsgevonden op de storingen en de afhandeling van de storingen op de nieuwe Botlekbrug. De resultaten van deze review zal ik begin maart aan de Tweede Kamer versturen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat NS schikt met omstreden bestuurder en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de schikking met NS-fraudeurs

MPs Madlener, Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the government about reports that NS settled employment contracts with controversial managers linked to irregularities in the Limburg concession tender, and asked for the settlement terms. The Minister of Finance answered that NS's board handles such labour matters under Dutch law, that the state was not involved and the shareholder has no role, so the contents cannot be disclosed by the government.
I therefore cannot inform you about the exact course and content of the agreed settlements, because I do not have that information.
Ik kan u dan ook niet informeren over het exacte verloop en de inhoud van de overeengekomen schikkingen, omdat ik niet over die informatie beschik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht op RTV Oost dat extra geld nodig is voor de N35

An MP asked the minister whether the national government is providing too little funding for the N35 road, which the state owns, and whether it will meet the province of Overijssel. The minister replied that about 600 million euros has been invested, roughly 450 million from national funds, that no further talks are planned unless the province raises a topic with its own financing, and that the N35 receives sufficient attention.
There is no reason for me to initiate an additional conversation with the province of Overijssel on this.
Er is voor mij geen aanleiding om aanvullend hierop een gesprek met de provincie Overijssel te initiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de autofabrikant de automobilist overal volgt

An MP asked the minister whether car manufacturers tracking drivers everywhere infringes privacy, whether drivers should control their data, and whether the government will act. The minister replied that the Data Protection Act applies and the Dutch data protection authority supervises compliance, that drivers should have control and informed consent, and pointed to a privacy reference architecture and further work in the sector and at EU level.
It is up to her to judge whether the Wbp is being complied with.
Het is aan haar om te oordelen of de Wbp wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Helder over het bericht dat de snelheidscamera’s op de A2 goed zijn voor 48 miljoen euro aan boeteopbrengsten

MPs Madlener and Helder asked whether speed cameras on the A2 generating 48 million euro in fines treat motorists as a cash cow, how many minor violations are involved, whether the controls are necessary for road safety, and whether the speed limit will be raised to 130 km/h. The minister replied that the controls aim at compliance with limits, gave the breakdown of fines by excess speed, cited a Rijkswaterstaat analysis showing reduced speeds, and said a decision on raising limits awaits a court ruling and will be communicated this year.
I will inform the House about this still this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier dit jaar nog over.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Madlener over het bericht dat Volkswagen dieselauto’s uit de handel neemt

MP Madlener asked the state secretary whether Volkswagen may also have manipulated emissions software in the Netherlands, whether a Dutch investigation will be launched, whether other brands will be checked, and what sanctions will apply. The state secretary answered that type-approval enforcement lies with the German authority KBA, that the RDW is considering its own investigation into other brands, and that EU rules provide sanctions including withdrawal of type approval.
Enforcement of a vehicle's emissions is the responsibility of the type-approval authority of the country that issued the European type approval for the vehicles concerned.
Handhaving van de emissies van een voertuig is de verantwoordelijkheid van de typegoedkeuringsinstantie van het land dat de Europese typegoedkeuring voor de betreffende voertuigen heeft afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat een automobilist €2500,00 aan onterechte boetes heeft gekregen

An MP asked whether a motorist wrongly received EUR 2,500 in speeding fines from a speed camera, how many such cameras exist, and whether other drivers were affected. The minister said the case involved one vehicle with specific characteristics, that a supplier fix has been implemented on all cameras of this type, and that no further investigation is needed.
There are no known other cases in which an offence was wrongly recorded.
Er zijn geen andere gevallen bekend waarbij ten onrechte een overtreding is geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Benzine is 20 eurocent te duur’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Dutch petrol prices are 20 cents per litre too high and whether the minister will intervene or ask the ACM to investigate. The minister denied the analysis, explained that fuel prices are set in separate markets with lags and local competition, and saw no need to intervene or commission new research, though the ACM monitors the market.
For the reasons given in the answer to question 2, I see no need to intervene or to commission new research into the level of fuel prices.
Om de genoemde redenen in het antwoord op vraag 2 zie ik geen noodzaak om in te grijpen of opnieuw onderzoek uit te laten voeren naar de hoogte van de brandstofprijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Klever over het bericht dat windmolenparken op zee 80% minder energie opleveren

MPs Madlener and Klever asked whether offshore wind farms really produce 80% less energy than claimed, whether subsidy and cost calculations should be revisited, and whether all wind plans should be halted. The minister replied that the wake effect is known and accounted for, that the press report confused installed capacity with output per square kilometre and used a hypothetical scenario unrealistic for the Netherlands, that no new insights change subsidy or costs, and that plans will not be halted.
No, see the answers to questions 2 and 3.
Nee, zie de antwoorden op vraag 2 en 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Spaarhypotheek onnodig duur’

An MP asked the minister whether a report that savings-mortgage (spaarhypotheek) savings credited against the risk surcharge are needlessly costly is accurate, and whether the government would intervene, have the AFM or DNB act, commission an ACM mortgage-market study, or cap early-repayment penalties as in Belgium. The minister answered that including savings can be disadvantageous depending on savings size and tax rate, that AFM will address providers where needed, that ACM monitors competition and will update its studies in 2016, and that Belgian-style penalty caps are not adopted because they would make banks less willing to offer long fixed-rate periods.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) monitors competition in the mortgage market, including the interest rates mortgage lenders charge.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) monitort de concurrentie op de hypotheekmarkt, waarbij onder andere wordt gekeken naar de rentetarieven die hypotheekverstrekkers hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat windturbines de telescoop van Lofar kunnen verstoren

An MP asked whether wind turbines can disturb the Lofar telescope and whether turbines near it should be removed or stopped nationwide. The minister confirmed possible interference, said the interest of Lofar is weighed in the zoning plan and consultation with Astron is ongoing, but refused to halt turbine construction.
In this context I am in consultation with the management of Astron, the operator of Lofar, to limit possible disturbances from wind turbines to an acceptable level.
In dit kader ben ik in overleg met de directie van Astron, de exploitant van Lofar, om mogelijke verstoringen van windturbines tot een acceptabel niveau te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Welvaartsverlies voor verlaging loan-to-value'

An MP asked the housing minister about reports that lowering the loan-to-value limit causes welfare losses, that starters and self-employed face mortgage difficulties, and how many households are underwater. The minister said the government has set a path to phase the LTV limit to 100% by 2018, pointed to banks' information point for flexible workers and restschuld financing, and declined to comment on the Prime Minister's private purchases.
As Minister for Housing and Central Government Real Estate, I do not concern myself with the private affairs of the Prime Minister.
Als Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst ga ik niet over de privé aangelegenheden van de Minister-President.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Leengrens hypotheek moet verder omlaag'

Madlener (PVV) asked the minister whether a further cut in the loan-to-value ratio would hurt the fragile housing market, and how the government views the FSC analysis and banking/homeowner criticism of it. The minister answers that a further LTV cut is not on the table, that the LTV path is already set to phase down to 100% by 2018, and rules out a further cut below 100% this cabinet term.
The cabinet has set out a path for the loan-to-value, under which the maximum loan-to-value will be gradually reduced to 100% by 2018.
Het kabinet heeft een pad voor de loan-to-value uitgestippeld, welke inhoudt dat de maximale loan-to-value stapsgewijs wordt afgebouwd naar 100% in 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de gemeente Rotterdam een milieuzone gaat instellen

Madlener (PVV) asks the state secretary whether he agrees that Rotterdam's environmental zone harms entrepreneurship and accessibility, and asks for costs, benefits, the number of affected vans, and a ban on municipal environmental zones. The state secretary answers that municipalities must weigh and justify such measures themselves, sees no reason to ban them, and gives an estimate of about 1,300 non-compliant delivery vans.
It is up to the municipalities to estimate and demonstrate whether introducing an environmental zone for certain vehicle categories is a (cost-)effective measure.
Het is aan de gemeenten om in te schatten en aan te tonen of het invoeren van een milieuzone voor bepaalde categorieën voertuigen een (kosten)effectieve maatregel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat woningcorporatie Ymere meer koopwoningen dan sociale huurwoningen bouwt

An MP asked the minister whether housing corporation Ymere should be building market-rate owner-occupied homes rather than social rentals, and whether stricter rules are needed. The minister said developing owner-occupied new builds is not a core task of corporations, pointed to the revised Housing Act effective 1 July 2015 that separates core (DAEB) from non-core activities, and gave sector figures on owner-occupied construction.
I do not consider developing new owner-occupied homes to be a core task of a housing corporation.
Het ontwikkelen van nieuwbouwwoningen in het koopsegment reken ik niet tot de kerntaken van een woningcorporatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Overheid heeft windmolen-video gemanipuleerd’

An MP asks whether government information footage showing offshore wind farms off the Dutch coast was manipulated and whether spreading it amounts to improper governance, and whether beach-tent owners should be compensated for tourism losses. The minister denies manipulation, explains the footage was made by an independent bureau using KNMI weather data, says the government informs stakeholders carefully, and points to a parliamentary motion under study on tourism and economic effects.
The commissioned bureau ROM3D is an independent advisory firm specialised in making this kind of simulation.
Het ingeschakelde bureau ROM3D is een zelfstandig adviesbureau, gespecialiseerd in het maken van dit soort simulaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat Ballast Nedam stopt met complexe werkzaamheden

PVV MP Madlener asked the minister whether Ballast Nedam's withdrawal from complex infrastructure work affects the A15 widening and national infrastructure, and whether complex projects can still be awarded to single bidders. The minister answered that the A15 deadline is unaffected, that enough other bidders exist, and that large projects are awarded to consortia.
For completion of the project, Ballast Nedam's decision to partly withdraw from the A15 Maasvlakte-Vaanplein project has no consequences.
Voor de afronding van het project heeft het besluit van Ballast Nedam, om zich deels terug te trekken uit het project A15 Maasvlakte-Vaanplein, geen gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht "Geen compensatie voor korting op AOW-toeslag"

An MP asked why AOW pensioners who objected late or were unaware of the option were not compensated for AOW partner allowance cuts on small pension lump sums, despite the top administrative court ruling against the SVB, and what the government would do. The State Secretary replied that the Central Appeals Tribunal only found the outcome unreasonable in specific cases, that the government is amending the general income decree to fully exempt such lump sums from 1 December 2014, and that already final decisions will not be reopened to avoid precedent.
This concerns a new regulation, so there is no legal inequality with citizens whose decision was taken under different applicable law and which has become legally unassailable.

Het betreft een nieuwe regeling en daarmee is er geen sprake van rechtsongelijkheid ten opzichte van burgers waarvan het besluit onder een ander geldend recht is vastgesteld en waarbij er inmiddels sprake is van een rechtens onaantastbaar besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Pensioenfondsen gaan investeren in windpark’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether pension funds should be investing in a wind farm and in climate policy, and whether the regulator should be asked to intervene. The State Secretary answered that pension funds are primarily responsible for their own investment policy, saw no reason to intervene, and said DNB supervises compliance with the law without reporting on individual funds.
Pension funds are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy and for whether or not to take risk.
Pensioenfondsen zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid en het wel of niet nemen van risico daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘NS-personeel steeds vaker fysiek belaagd’

An MP asked the state secretary what was being done to protect rail staff from physical assault, whether a union survey showed existing measures were insufficient, and whether four proposed measures (more conductors, a railway police force, tougher sentencing, closing ticket gates) would be adopted. The government answered that staff safety is primarily the employer's responsibility, listed existing measures such as the reisverbod and ticket gates, promised to raise the survey with rail company CEOs and unions, and rejected a railway police force and the other proposals while leaving staffing choices to NS.
I will therefore discuss these outcomes in the regular consultation I have with the CEOs of ProRail and NS, and ask them what action they will take in response to this survey.
Ik zal deze uitkomsten dan ook bespreken in het reguliere overleg dat ik heb met de CEO’s van ProRail en NS, en aan hen vragen welke actie zij ondernemen naar aanleiding van deze enquête.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht «Automobilist de klos in de Randstad»

PVV MPs asked whether higher municipal parking tariffs and more section controls on motorways are unfair extra burdens on motorists and whether the government will stop the big cities' plans. The state secretary answered that parking tariffs are a municipal matter, that section controls improve compliance rather than add costs, and that they do little for urban air quality, promising talks with the G7 cities.
Setting the height of parking tariffs is a responsibility of the municipalities and not of the national government.
Het vaststellen van de hoogte van parkeertarieven is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten en niet van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een zwaar gesubsidieerde elektrische auto bijna net zoveel fijnstof produceert als een benzinewagen

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop subsidising electric cars after a report claimed they emit almost as much fine particulate matter as petrol cars, and whether VAT and registration tax should be cut instead. Minister Kamp answered that total particulate emissions including brake and tyre wear are about a third lower for electric cars, that subsidies will be reconsidered in the Autobrief 2.0, and that the 160,000 euro-per-car figure is not recognised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de spitsstrook zou werken als een boetefuik

An MP asked whether the A12 hard-shoulder (spitsstrook) acts as a speed-fine trap, whether it should be permanently opened, and whether speed enforcement on motorways is justified. The minister said the A12 and A4 lanes will be opened permanently, that police data cannot show more speeding when shoulders are open, and that fines aim to improve compliance rather than raise revenue.
As I indicated in the General Consultation with your House on 9 October 2014, the plus lane on the A12 between Woerden and Gouda will be permanently opened by mid-2015.
Zoals ik in het Algemeen Overleg met uw Kamer op 9 oktober 2014 heb aangegeven wordt de plusstrook op de A12 tussen Woerden en Gouda medio 2015 permanent opengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat de NS in Schotland gaat rijden

Two PVV MPs asked whether NS's Scottish rail subsidiary Abellio carries financial risks for the State as shareholder, and whether NS should stop international concessions to focus on domestic rail after the Fyra debacle. The Secretary of State replied that the UK concession model leaves most asset and personnel risk with the authority, that NS needs no capital or guarantees from the shareholder, that the €3.2 billion is a fixed operating payment rather than a price paid by NS, and that NS decides its own foreign concessions within agreed financial frameworks.
I do not share that view. NS has not paid €3.2 billion for the Scottish concession, but receives a fixed amount to cover operating costs.
Ik deel die mening niet. NS heeft geen € 3,2 miljard betaald voor de Schotse concessie, maar ontvangt een vast bedrag ter dekking van de exploitatiekosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat door middel van een WOB-verzoek aan het licht is gekomen dat windmolens worden geplaatst op een gevaarlijke plek

The MP Madlener asks whether the minister plans wind turbines on the Tweede Maasvlakte beach that would displace kitesurfers, whether residents and recreational users have a say, and what extra costs arise. The minister answers that a 2009 convenant covers wind energy in the Rotterdam port, that further study is ongoing with interests of kitesurfers to be considered later, that stakeholders will be involved when preparations start, and that any extra costs fall on the potential market party.
In the planning for the Second Maasvlakte, both wind energy and a beach for extensive recreation were considered.
Bij de planvorming rond de 2 de Maasvlakte is gekeken naar zowel windenergie als aanleg van strand voor extensieve recreatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Madlener over het bericht 'Moldaviërs halen Roemenen in'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure about reports of Dutch transport firms 'flagging out', foreign drivers, lorry parking and the sale of passports and driving licences, and whether borders should be closed to Eastern European workers. The government answered that data on flagged-out firms and job losses is unavailable, that it cannot track non-EU nationality entitlements, that enforcement is being strengthened in cooperation with the ILT and Inspectie SZW, and that closing the labour market is not a realistic option.
It is not known how many Dutch lorry drivers have lost their jobs since the labour market was opened to Romanians, Bulgarians and Poles.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs sinds de openstelling van de arbeidsmarkt voor Roemenen, Bulgaren en Polen hun baan hebben verloren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de provincie Drenthe de gemeente Emmen dwingt windturbines te plaatsen

An MP asked the minister whether the province of Drenthe is coercing the municipality of Emmen into accepting wind turbines, whether the government will support the municipal council against the province, and whether a municipal ban should bind the province and national government. The minister answered that the province acted within its statutory powers, that the national government will not intervene, and that a municipal no-turbine decision is not decisive given provincial and ministerial competences under the Electricity Act.
In my view the province of Drenthe has acted in accordance with its legal authority.
De provincie Drenthe heeft naar mijn mening conform haar wettelijke bevoegdheid gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat er te veel defecten zijn bij trucks

Madlener (PVV) asked the minister about reports of excessive truck defects, the share of unsafe trucks over five years, whether defective trucks should be banned from the road, whether controls should be intensified, and whether postponed maintenance creates unfair competition. The minister acknowledged the reports, gave police inspection figures (2.7% of checked trucks received a driving ban), said no new measures were needed for now, and agreed that postponed maintenance is unfair competition.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en De Graaf over het bericht dat een buschauffeur een persoon in een boerka heeft geweigerd

MPs Madlener and De Graaf asked the government about a report that a bus driver refused a woman wearing a burqa, and whether burqa bans should be pursued given security concerns. The State Secretary answered that the government considers face-covering clothing undesirable where communication is seriously hindered, that a legal ban in education, care, public transport and government buildings is being prepared, and that the driver's refusal was contrary to the carrier's rules, so apologies were offered.
According to the carrier's company rules, the burqa wearer should have been treated in the same way as all other passengers.
Volgens de bedrijfsregels van de vervoerder had de boerka-draagster op dezelfde manier behandeld moeten worden als alle andere reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over Turk veroordeeld wegens 'Allah' in twitternaam

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about a Turkish Twitter user sentenced to fifteen months for using the word 'Allah' in his username, whether this shows Turkey is not Western and should never join the EU, why Turkey receives nearly 1 billion euro in EU pre-accession aid, and when the government will veto accession talks. The minister acknowledges serious rule-of-law and free-expression shortcomings in Turkey, defends accession negotiations as the best lever for reform, notes IPA aid can be adjusted on merit, and declines to halt the talks.
The cabinet is of the view that accession negotiations are the best way to encourage Turkey to reform to European standards.
Het kabinet is van mening dat toetredingsonderhandelingen de beste manier vormen om Turkije aan te sporen te hervormen naar Europese maatstaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht dat leden van het Europees Parlement 200 miljoen euro hebben gedeclareerd

PVV MPs Wilders and Madlener asked whether the cabinet would ensure strict checks on European Parliament members' office-cost declarations and whether Dutch MEPs avoid submitting receipts. The minister replied that office costs are paid as a flat-rate allowance without declarations, that the European Court of Auditors is responsible for public control, and that its audit found the EP's control systems effective.
Public control over these expenditures is the responsibility of the European Court of Auditors.
De publieke controle op deze uitgaven is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Europese Rekenkamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht 'Mogelijk 300 miljoen extra naar Brussel'

PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the cabinet budgets for EU payments beyond the 8 billion euro for next year, why the money goes to Brussels rather than domestic tax relief or elderly care, and whether he will leave the EU. The minister replied that the 2015 EU payments are estimated at 7.2 billion in the 2014 budget, that CBS revisions may affect them but cannot yet be quantified, that details will follow in the Spring Memorandum, referred to the Prinsjesdag budget documents for the rationale, and rejected leaving the EU.
In the Miljoenennota 2015 I will address the changes that occur in budget year 2015.
In de Miljoenennota 2015 zal ik ingaan op de mutaties die zich voordoen in het begrotingsjaar 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Madlener en Wilders over gesjoemel met EU-subsidie voor moskeeën

MPs asked whether Amsterdam and the Interior Ministry obtained EU subsidy for two mosques by misdescribing a building as a multicultural centre, and asked about a mosque construction halt and punishment of those responsible. The minister answered that the mosque part was excluded from subsidy, that the subsidy went to Amsterdam Groot-Oost rather than the ministry, that the OLAF investigation outcome is pending, and rejected a construction halt and a withdrawal of EU involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht "Ook Moldaviër mag zonder visum Nederland in"

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of reports that Moldovan nationals can enter the Netherlands without a visa, and why, given existing crime and nuisance, immigration should continue to be allowed. The minister confirmed awareness, explained that the visa waiver covers short stays only, that long-term immigration remains governed by national law, and pointed to the emergency brake procedure as a safeguard.

Furthermore, the emergency brake procedure that came into force on 9 January, which allows the visa requirement to be temporarily reintroduced in the event of a sudden increase in illegal stay and/or asylum applications, provides an adequate safety net.

Verder biedt de op 9 januari jl. in werking getreden noodremprocedure, die het mogelijk maakt bij een plotselinge toename van illegaliteit en/of asielaanvragen tijdelijk de visumplicht weer in te voeren, een adequaat vangnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'PGGM haalt beleggingen uit Israëlische banken'

MPs Madlener, De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government considers PGGM's divestment from Israeli banks a boycott, how much PGGM invests in Israel and the Palestinian territories, and what the government will do against investor withdrawal and anti-Israel sentiment. The minister answered that PGGM's decision is its own, that PGGM still invests in Israeli companies (over EUR 60 million in several dozen firms), that the government does not track investments and does not intervene in company decisions, and that it is working to deepen economic ties with Israel.
The government does not keep track of PGGM's investments.
Het kabinet houdt de investeringen van PGGM niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Madlener over belastinggeld voor Palestijnse ambtenaren

PVV MPs asked how many Palestinian officials and pensioners funded by EU and Dutch money are former prisoners convicted of terrorism, asked why aid to the Palestinian Authority is rising, and whether it should be halted and reclaimed. The minister said Pegase salary payments exclude sanctioned persons, could not confirm the $50,000 figure, and that the government sees no reason to change the policy.
The cabinet sees no reason to change this policy, as also stated in the Coalition Agreement.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om dit beleid, zoals tevens verwoord in het Regeerakkoord, te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hundreds of thousands from outside EU could head for UK in passport loophole’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that Bulgaria and Romania issue passports to non-EU nationals, enabling them to reach Northern Europe, and about expected Romanian and Bulgarian labour migration. The government replied that nationality law is a member-state competence, that it expects other states to act with due care, that predicting numbers is uncertain, and that the Netherlands has taken measures with municipalities to manage arrivals and tackle abuse.
Nationality legislation is not a competence of the European Union, and each member state therefore has its own legislation determining who is entitled to the nationality in question.
Nationaliteitswetgeving is geen bevoegdheid van de Europese Unie en iedere lidstaat heeft derhalve eigen wetgeving op basis waarvan vastgesteld wordt wie recht heeft op de betreffende nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht dat de Nederlandse economie tuimelt naar 30e plaats

PVV MPs asked whether the reported drop of the Dutch economy to 30th place means the Netherlands would be better off outside the euro, whether lower taxes would boost growth, and whether the government will reverse tax rises and redirect spending. The minister rejects leaving the euro, says the ranking drop is relative and largely driven by emerging economies, and explains that the government lowers household burdens while reducing deficits mainly through spending cuts.
No, I do not share that view.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over Visumvrij reizen door Turken

MPs Madlener and Wilders asked whether Turkish citizens would gain visa-free travel to the EU once a readmission agreement is signed, and whether the government would push to halt negotiations. The Minister replied that visa abolition is not yet on the table, that it depends on strict conditions in an action plan, and that the government sees the readmission agreement as in Dutch interests.
Abolition of the visa requirement is not yet on the agenda.
Afschaffing van de visumplicht is nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over Kroatië en de buitensporig tekortprocedure

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Croatia, as a new EU member, is already in breach of budget rules and whether the government regrets supporting its accession, and whether it would argue for Croatia to leave the EU. The minister answered that the Commission assesses compliance under the European Semester and may propose an excessive deficit procedure, that Croatia met accession requirements, and that parliament also approved accession.
Croatia has met the EU requirements in the accession process.
Kroatië heeft aan de EU-eisen in het toetredingstraject voldaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over de uitspraak van Eurocommissaris Kroes over Verhofstadt als kandidaat-voorzitter van de Europese Commissie

MPs Wilders and Madlener asked the Prime Minister whether the Dutch government supports Guy Verhofstadt as candidate for Commission president, after Commissioner Kroes said the VVD would back him, and asked which liberal has the most EU-right. The government answered that it will decide which candidate to support once the candidates are known, and that this is not yet on the agenda.
The government will decide which candidate for President of the European Commission to support when the candidates are known.
De regering zal een beslissing nemen over welke kandidaat voorzitter van de Europese Commissie te steunen wanneer de kandidaten hiervoor bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Kosten pensioenbeheer fors gestegen’

Madlener (PVV) asks the State Secretary why pension funds' asset management costs rose by 1.5 billion euros in 2012, whether such cost increases can be justified to members, when full cost transparency will be mandated, and what will be done to curb cost growth. The State Secretary answers that the rise is mainly due to higher performance fees linked to higher returns, that voluntary disclosure has improved and Pension 1-2-3 will include costs, that higher costs are justifiable only if matched by returns, and that cost control is primarily the funds' own responsibility, with no new mandatory measures yet.
I do not have information with which I can explain the increased costs of asset management.
Ik beschik niet over informatie waarmee ik de toegenomen kosten van het vermogensbeheer kan verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Kritiek op peperdure EU-campagne’

An MP from the PVV asks the Foreign Minister why EU Parliament election information campaigns cost 6.6 million euro and 41.5 million euro next year, and what the government will do to stop the spending. The minister defends the campaign as informing citizens about the vote, notes the low turnout, and says the government favours a sober EU budget while leaving spending priorities to the European Parliament.
The cabinet favours a sober and efficient EU budget and, as is known, takes a critical stance on the level of administrative spending by the European institutions.
Het kabinet is voorstander van een sobere en efficiënte EU-begroting en neemt zoals bekend een kritische houding aan over de hoogte van de administratieve uitgaven van de Europese instellingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Weduwe buitenland houdt pensioen’

MPs Madlener and De Graaf asked whether the government will appeal a court ruling that the lowering of survivors' benefits for widows moving abroad under the country-of-residence principle is unlawful, and whether it will introduce repair legislation. The minister confirmed an appeal will be lodged, reaffirmed the policy with an estimated €8 million budget impact, and declined to propose repair legislation.
Yes, the Social Insurance Bank will appeal the ruling of the Amsterdam District Court of 22 August.
Ja, de Sociale Verzekeringsbank zal hoger beroep instellen tegen de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam van 22 augustus jl.
Vragen van het lid Madlener (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Europese Unie verbiedt babyfoto op verpakking babyvoeding» (ingezonden 12 juni 2013).

An MP asks whether an EU ban on baby photos on infant formula packaging is correct and why national food matters are regulated by Brussels, questioning what the cabinet will do to stop such EU interference. The minister confirms the rule (extended to follow-on formula by a 2013 regulation, with the ban not covering all baby food), notes Dutch inspections found no such images, and states EU food rules have applied since 1963 for trade and public health, offering no action beyond referring back to that answer.
The ban therefore does not concern all baby food.
Het verbod betreft dus niet alle babyvoeding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, de Roon, Madlener en van Klaveren over de samenwerking tussen de EU en de Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about EU cooperation with the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, including its observer status, its stance on criticism of Islam and whether the EU should end contacts. The minister rejected most premises, affirmed continued support for free expression and religious freedom, and declined to end the observer status.
No. However, the OIC has for some time paid considerable attention to combating religious intolerance.
Nee. Wel heeft de OIC al geruime tijd veel aandacht voor het tegengaan van religieuze intolerantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht: ‘Rutte: werkloze jongeren naar Nederland halen’ van de website van de Telegraaf

Wilders and Madlener asked the Prime Minister whether he is aware of a news report that Rutte wants to bring unemployed youth to the Netherlands, and insulted him with a rhetorical question. The government replied that the report is known and that it will respond in answer to a separate request from the Social Affairs committee.
The cabinet will respond to this news report in reply to the request of the standing committee for Social Affairs and Employment of 9 July.
Het kabinet zal op deze berichtgeving reageren in antwoord op het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid van 9 juli jl.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Madlener over het bericht 'Poll:39% Nederlanders wil uit de EU'

PVV MPs Wilders and Madlener asked whether the government will prepare for Dutch withdrawal from the EU after a poll showing 39% support for leaving, and whether a referendum will be held. The minister replied that the government takes citizens' concerns seriously and will pursue EU reform, that withdrawal is not on the table, and that no referendum is needed.
A departure of the Netherlands from the EU is not on the table as far as the cabinet is concerned.
Een vertrek van Nederland uit de EU is wat het kabinet betreft niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Madlener over de absurde verhoging van de EU-uitgaven aan ontwikkelingshulp

Two PVV MPs asked why EU development spending is rising, including the planned EDF amount for 2014-2020 and Dutch contributions, and whether the government will stop the flow of Dutch money to development aid. The minister confirmed Dutch EU development contributions of about 507 million euro for 2013, explained that the final EDF 2014-2020 envelope was lowered to 30.5 billion euro, and said the Regeerakkoord cuts the ODA budget by 750 million euro per year in 2014-2016 and 1 billion euro from 2017.
The coalition agreement includes a substantial cut target for the development cooperation budget.
In het Regeerakkoord is een forse taakstelling opgenomen met betrekking tot het budget voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Wilders en Madlener over het bericht “Eurozone scheldt mogelijk Griekse schuld kwijt”

MPs Van Dijck, Wilders and Madlener asked the Finance Minister why he suggested in a Greek newspaper that eurozone countries might forgive Greek debt and demanded a public retraction. The minister answered that the Eurogroup will only revisit possible further debt-sustainability measures for Greece at a later date, and that the Netherlands opposes debt forgiveness.
The Netherlands is not in favour of debt forgiveness.
Nederland is geen voorstander van schuldkwijtschelding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Graus over het bericht “EU wil meer concurrentie met haven Rotterdam”

PVV MPs Madlener and Graus asked ministers whether the government would act against EU port-liberalisation proposals that could strengthen competitors of Rotterdam and how much EU money would fund them. The minister said the Port Regulation is still being studied, that TEN-T funds are not linked to the regulation and effects on the second Maasvlakte cannot yet be stated, and that the Netherlands opposes unfair competition and will treat all applications equally.
Via the BNC procedure I will inform you as agreed no later than 14 June 2013.
Via de BNC procedure zal ik u volgens afspraak uiterlijk op 14 juni 2013 informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over de voorschriften met betrekking tot de presentatie van olijfolie in horeca gelegenheden

An MP from the PVV asked the government whether it would implement an EU rule banning olive oil cans in restaurants, and what further EU measures burden Dutch firms. The state secretary said the Netherlands opposed the rule, which the Commission has since withdrawn, and promised a list of EU rules causing unnecessary regulatory burden.
We are pleased that Commissioner Çiolos (Agriculture), after the necessary political pressure and media outcry in the European Union, has decided to withdraw the decision.
Het verheugt ons dat Commissaris Çiolos (Landbouw), na de nodige politieke druk en de ophef in de media in de Europese Unie, heeft besloten om het besluit in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener naar aanleiding van het online artikel van De Telegraaf ‘Kroatië klaar voor Europese Unie’ van 26 maart 2013

An MP (Madlener, PVV) asked the foreign minister whether the cabinet still considers Croatia ready for EU accession despite high unemployment and poor corruption rankings, and whether it would block accession. The minister replied that the cabinet maintains its position, that unemployment and corruption are not accession criteria, and that it will not block accession.
Is this cabinet willing to still block the accession of a thoroughly corrupt, criminal and unemployed country?
Is dit kabinet bereid om de toetreding van een door en door corrupt, crimineel en werkloos land alsnog te blokkeren?
Antwoord vragen Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de helft van de Nederlanders zijn eigen pensioen met zorgen tegemoet ziet

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked why the government spends billions on eurozone rescue funds while Dutch pension entitlements are cut, and whether pension funds should be allowed a fixed 4% discount rate. The State Secretary replied that euro-fund loans are conditional, that pension cuts are needed because funds fall short of legal funding requirements, and that a risk-free rate is required, so 4% is not acceptable.
In my letter of 1 March to your House I explained why pension funds must calculate their obligations using a risk-free interest rate.
In mijn brief van 1 maart jl. aan uw Kamer heb ik toegelicht waarom pensioenfondsen hun verplichtingen met een risicovrije rente moeten berekenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Bontes over het bericht dat Europese superspionnen het recht krijgen om persoonlijke informatie zoals e-mails, websitebezoeken, medische data en politie bestanden in te zien

MPs Madlener and Bontes asked whether reports that EU 'super spies' would gain access to citizens' emails, website visits, medical data and police records are accurate, and whether the EU agency ENISA should be abolished. The minister replied that the report conflates a non-binding cybersecurity strategy with a Commission directive, that ENISA has no operational or investigative powers, and that the government will ensure the existing EU data protection framework is respected.
The report is not correct and, in my view, is not accurate.
Het bericht klopt niet en is mijns inziens niet accuraat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet, Fritsma en Madlener over het bericht “Inwoners EU hebben recht op uitkering”

PVV MPs asked why EU residents may receive social assistance while doubts exist about their residence right and an income requirement applies, and whether all wrongly paid benefits to foreigners will be recovered. The minister answered that residence rights under the EU free movement directive depend on an individual assessment by the IND, that municipalities handle benefit decisions, and that municipalities are responsible for recovery policy.
The implementation of the WWB has been decentralised to the municipalities.
De uitvoering van de WWB is gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Fritsma over het bericht “Veel Zuid-Europeanen naar Nederland”.

MPs Madlener and Fritsma asked the government about a news report on rising numbers of Southern European nationals in the Netherlands and what would be done to control this immigration. The government responded that EU free movement rights apply, that the numbers differ from CBS figures, and that it will keep enforcing income requirements and tackling exploitation while continuing existing initiatives.

As long as citizens from another member state meet the conditions for free movement of persons and thus do not place an unreasonable burden on social provisions in our country, we see no reason to oppose their arrival in the Netherlands and participation in Dutch society.

Zolang burgers uit een andere lidstaat voldoen aan de voorwaarden die gesteld worden aan het vrij verkeer van personen en daarmee dus geen onredelijke belasting vormen voor sociale voorzieningen in ons land, zien wij geen reden om afwijzend te staan tegen hun komst naar Nederland en deelname aan de Nederlandse samenleving.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU 11,2 miljard euro wil om Brusselse gaten te dichten

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked the Finance Minister and Prime Minister whether the government would refuse to pay a proposed 11.2 billion euro EU budget increase and demand the money back. The minister answered only that Question 1 was yes and that Questions 2 to 4 were covered in a separate letter to the House.
For an answer to questions 2 to 4, I refer you to the letter I sent to the House of Representatives simultaneously with the answers to these parliamentary questions.
Voor een antwoord op de vragen 2 t/m 4 verwijs ik u naar de brief die ik hierover gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen naar de Tweede Kamer heb gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over kwalificering van zionisme en islamkritiek als “misdaad tegen de menselijkheid”

MPs De Roon and Madlener asked the Foreign Minister how he judged Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's calls to treat Islamophobia and Zionism as crimes against humanity, whether dialogue with such leaders was worthless, what the government had done about his hostile statements, whether Turkey was therefore an enemy of free speech, and when Turkish EU accession would be abandoned. The minister disassociated the government from Erdogan's remarks, reaffirmed support for Turkey-Israel normalisation and Turkish EU membership perspective subject to conditions, and gave only brief answers to the other questions.
I expressly distance myself from the statement of Prime Minister Erdogan.
Ik neem uitdrukkelijk afstand van de uitspraak van premier Erdoğan.
Antwoord vragen Madlener en Tony Van Dijck over het EU-trendrapport 2013 van de Algemene Rekenkamer

Two MPs (Madlener and Tony van Dijck, PVV) asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the Court of Audit's 2013 EU trend report, including the 3.9% error rate, unverified Greek loans and EFSF funds, member states' resistance to a national declaration, and whether governments should be forced to provide one. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the government opposes the error rate, that EFSF/Greek loans are controlled via conditionality and national budget channels with an audit committee being explored, that no member state refuses accountability, and that he will not link ESM aid to a national declaration.
The cabinet is exploring whether EFSF funds can be placed under the supervision of the ESM audit committee.
Het kabinet verkent of de middelen van het EFSF onder toezicht van het ESM-auditcomité gebracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Madlener over het bericht: ‘EU-controleur in Den Haag’

MPs Wilders, Tony van Dijck and Madlener asked whether the government would send back an EU 'European Semester Officer' stationed in The Hague, object to growing Brussels interference, and station a Dutch controller in Brussels to oversee EU spending. The minister replied that the Commission's Semester role is important for budget oversight, that the officers only facilitate information exchange without changing Commission powers, and that the European Court of Auditors handles EU spending control while Netherlands pushes member-state accountability.
Appointing this officer changes nothing about the powers the Commission has under existing EU regulations.
Het aanstellen van deze functionaris verandert niets aan de bevoegdheden die de Commissie heeft op basis van de bestaande EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over de huisvestingskosten voor EDEO-vertegenwoordigers

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about the high residence costs of EU diplomats in Hong Kong and Moscow, EU diplomat pay and perks, an internal audit showing weak financial management, and whether the Netherlands should run its own diplomacy. The minister confirmed the rent figures, defended market-based selection and cost-benefit weighing, said Dutch pressure for austerity and budget neutrality continues, noted that EU financial rules are overseen by the Commission and the European Court of Auditors, and said he was not aware of misconduct, promising to raise it if found.
The cabinet is not aware of any misconduct. Where that is the case, the cabinet will raise it.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met misstanden. Waar dat wel het geval is, zal het kabinet dat aan de orde stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pechtold, Van Bommel, Madlener, Van der Staaij, Ouwehand en Segers over het rapport “Seventeenth Bi-annual Report: Developments in European Union Procedures  en Practices Relevant

MPs asked the foreign minister about the COSAC report on parliamentary scrutiny of EU documents, including why the Dutch parliament lacks access to Council documents marked EU Restricted and Limité that Austrian MPs can see. The minister answered that both chambers will receive direct access to all Limité documents, that Limité is a distribution code rather than a classification, and that the Dutch parliament is already as well informed as the Austrian and European Parliaments.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Van Vliet over het bericht ‘Oudere mannen vaker werkloos’

Two PVV MPs asked the minister about a report that older men are increasingly unemployed and how this fits with raising the AOW age, the planned easing of dismissal law, the job-continuation bonus, and the bridging scheme for those unable to prepare for the higher AOW age. The minister replied that unemployment among men aged 45-65 remains the lowest of age groups, that dismissal criteria and the selection principle are retained, that the bonus supports working longer, and that bridging scheme contours were sent to parliament with implementation planned for 2013.
On 23 January a letter was sent to the House of Representatives outlining the contours of the bridging scheme.
Op 23 januari jl. is een brief verstuurd aan de Tweede Kamer waarin de contouren van de overbruggingsregeling zijn geschetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over multinationals halen miljoenen uit EU-fonds

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that multinationals received millions from the European Social Fund, and whether EU subsidies are being wasted and how fraud will be prevented. The minister answered that the Commission is investigating the Polish case, that the Court of Auditors' error rates are unacceptably high and the Netherlands will push for better accountability and transparency, and that subsidies are open to all firms so no distortion arises, while refusing to halt EU payments.
The results of the European Commission's investigation must be awaited before the cabinet can make detailed statements about this situation.
De resultaten van het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie moeten worden afgewacht alvorens het kabinet gedetailleerde uitspraken kan doen over deze situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over “Brussel straft Tsjechische corruptie met EU-subsidies mild”

Two PVV MPs asked whether the EU's light correction of about 450 million euros for irregularities in Czech use of EU funds is a token penalty, and whether the government will stop Czech EU subsidies. The minister answered that no fraud in the criminal sense is involved, that the Commission applies the rules in EU law, and that he will not halt subsidies or reclaim the Dutch share.
The cabinet cannot confirm the error rates of up to 100% cited in the media unless it obtains disclosure of the sources cited in the newspaper article in question.
Het kabinet kan de in de media genoemde foutpercentages tot 100% niet bevestigen dan nadat openbaarheid is verkregen over de geciteerde bronnen in het desbetreffende krantenartikel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Britse premier David Cameron zegt Brussel de wacht aan’

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether the cabinet would, like British PM Cameron, stand up against Brussels, restrict social benefits for immigrants, and hold a referendum on the EU's future. The minister answered that the cabinet supports a strong Europe and subsidiarity discussions but not a redefinition of the relationship, supports free movement while seeking to prevent benefit magnets, and opposes a referendum as it favours representative democracy.
The cabinet favours representative democracy and does not intend to hold a referendum on the future of the European Union.
Het kabinet is voorstander van de representatieve democratie en is niet voornemens een referendum te organiseren over de toekomst van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht «5,5% meer loon voor EU-ambtenaren»

An MP asked the minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of a 5.5% salary increase for EU civil servants and whether the government would block it, including the solidarity levy negotiations and the taxation, pensions and privileges of EU staff. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, referred to earlier answers on the solidarity levy, and described the EU pension and tax arrangements and Dutch pressure for modernisation and reduction of EU staff benefits.

In the negotiations on both the new EU Multiannual Financial Framework and the EU civil service regulations, the Netherlands, together with a large group of like-minded countries, is pressing for far-reaching modernisation and reduction of allowances, promotion system and pension system.

In de onderhandelingen van zowel het nieuwe Meerjarig Financieel Kader van de EU als over het EU-ambtenarenstatuut wordt door Nederland, samen met een grote groep gelijkgezinde landen, aangedrongen op vergaande modernisering en versobering van de vergoedingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over Roma

An MP asked the foreign minister about a mayor's warning against Eastern European and Roma migrants, including whether Roma would raise crime and welfare dependence. The government answered that migrant crime is not attributable to labour migrants, that Roma are not registered so no data exist, and that the 2014 opening of the labour market to Bulgarians and Romanians will not be reversed.
Since Roma as such are not registered, no data are known on school dropout and benefit dependence.
Aangezien Roma als zodanig niet worden geregistreerd zijn er géén gegevens bekend over schooluitval en uitkeringsafhankelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over de gevolgen van de forse verhoging van de Franse bieraccijns

PVV MPs asked whether France's proposed sharp increase in the beer excise, which leaves wine excise largely unchanged, would harm Dutch beer exports and whether the government would respond with countermeasures. The minister answered that Dutch beer exports to France are about 5% of total exports, that the measure does not discriminate against foreign brewers, that it is in line with EU law, and that the government sees no reason for countermeasures.
If the measure were to turn out to have a discriminatory effect indirectly, in its implementation, we will consider that.
Indien de maatregel indirect, in de uitwerking, een discriminatoir effect zou blijken te hebben, zullen wij ons daarover beraden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de Commissie voorstelt om Albanië de status van kandidaat-lid te verlenen

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether the European Commission's recommendation to grant Albania EU candidate status is misguided, whether pre-accession aid would be wasted, and whether Albania, described as Islamic and corrupt, should be barred from accession. The minister answered that Albania has had an accession perspective since 1999, that pre-accession aid is unrelated to candidate status, and that accession is possible if all strict conditions are met.
If these countries meet all the strict conditions of the enlargement process, they can eventually accede to the EU.
Indien deze landen voldoen aan alle strenge voorwaarden van het uitbreidingsproces, dan kunnen zij op termijn toetreden tot de EU.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Fritsma over het bericht dat de EU dreigt met herinvoering van de visumplicht voor de Westelijke Balkan

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the EU threatens to reinstate visa requirements for Western Balkan countries, asking about asylum figures, whether Roma asylum flows are undesirable, suspending Schengen expansion, and trends in Roma migration. The government answered that 2012 asylum data per country are unavailable due to the IND's system migration, that abuse of asylum is undesirable but protection must remain available, that Romania and Bulgaria's Schengen accession is not currently on the agenda, and that the registration system cannot generate figures by ethnicity.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de Europese Unie miljarden verspilt volgens de Europese Rekenkamer

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about a report that the EU wasted billions, with an error rate of about 5 billion euro in 2011 according to the European Court of Auditors. The government answered that it is disappointed, will take a critical stance on discharge in the Ecofin Council, and seeks a much leaner EU budget with cuts of at least 100 billion euro.
The cabinet will adopt a very critical attitude when this is dealt with.
Het kabinet zal bij de behandeling hiervan een zeer kritische houding aannemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'EU-commissaris: EU verder uitbreiden’

An MP asked the foreign minister about EU enlargement, including concerns that Western Balkan accession could bring organised crime to the Netherlands and about press freedom in Turkey. The minister replied that enlargement is not an end in itself, that the Western Balkan states must meet strict conditions with rule-of-law chapters opened first and closed last, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom concerns with Turkey.
These chapters are only closed once it can be irrefutably established that these countries have built a positive track record on the said subjects.
Deze hoofdstukken worden pas gesloten nadat onomstotelijk kan worden vastgesteld dat deze landen een positief track record hebben opgebouwd op de genoemde onderwerpen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over bericht 'Grieken krijgen circuit'

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked why Greece is funding a 30 million euro Formula 1 circuit amid its economic crisis and EU bailout, and whether the Netherlands should stop loans to Greece. The State Secretary answered that Greece sets its own investment priorities within the EFSF/IMF programme conditions, monitored by the Troika, and that the Dutch position on Greek loans is unchanged.
It is up to the Greek government to determine its investment priorities within the conditions set under the EFSF and IMF loan programme.

Het is aan de Griekse overheid om haar prioriteiten op het gebied van investeringen vast te stellen binnen de randvoorwaarden die zijn opgesteld in het kader van het leningenprogramma van EFSF en IMF.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked whether government bodies would reconsider moving data and services to US cloud providers, and for overviews of planned migrations and risks. The government says cloud policy already weighs market concentration, plans a sovereign government cloud and a revised policy, but gives no clear halt to US migrations and only partial overviews.
The Ministry of Defence was excluded from that overview because it falls outside the scope of the government-wide cloud policy.
Het Ministerie van Defensie is daarin buiten beschouwing gelaten omdat zij buiten de scope van het Rijksbreed cloudbeleid vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het nieuwsbericht 'Den Helder Airport ziet status ‘nationaal belang’ als enige reddingsboei' van 11 maart 2025 in Regio Noordkop

MP Pierik asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Den Helder Airport's threatened survival, including a claimed 300% rent increase, lack of 'national importance' status, CBS statistics, and whether the government will decide on that status by end 2025. The Minister answered that Den Helder Airport is a civil company rather than a national-importance civil airport, that rent rises follow the integral cost model and indexation, that the national government is not responsible for its operations, and that no decision on that status is planned.
Den Helder Airport (DHA) is not a civil airport but a civil company.
Den Helder Airport (DHA) is geen civiele luchthaven, maar een civiel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Postma over veiligheidswaarschuwingen boven het luchtruim van Oekraïne voor 17 juli 2014 (neerhalen MH17)

MPs Omtzigt and Postma asked why pre-MH17 aviation safety warnings (Eccairs reports on airspace over Ukraine) were never made public, and demanded disclosure of the reports, related documents and the ECAC-DGCA meeting records. The minister refused full publication citing EU confidentiality rules and the Raad van State ruling, but offered to place anonymised versions of the reports and ECAC notes for confidential inspection by the Chamber, and answered most questions by pointing to prior disclosures and existing oversight.
In view of the ruling, I cannot make the said reports available to the Chamber publicly.
Gelet op de uitspraak kan ik de genoemde meldingen niet openbaar aan de Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Beckerman over de sloop van de woonwijk Mrija voor 1000 Oekraïners in Vlaardingen

MPs De Nispen and Beckerman (SP) asked ministers about plans to demolish the Mrija housing estate housing about 1,000 Ukrainians in Vlaardingen for a new wastewater treatment plant, questioning responsibility, the waste of recently built homes, and alternatives. The Minister of Asylum and Migration answered that the wastewater plant is a Delfland water board responsibility, the municipality is responsible for follow-up choices, the Rijk supports relocation and subsidises housing business cases, and she invites the municipality to submit business cases to the NOO.
The Rijk has no direct involvement in carrying out that obligation.
Het Rijk heeft met de uitvoering van die verplichting geen directe betrokkenheid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het artikel van de NOS van 14 mei 2025, waarin wordt vermeld dat er problemen rondom drinkwater kunnen ontstaan omdat het besparen van drinkwater te langzaam zou gaan

Heutink (PVV) asked the minister whether there is a shortage of permits rather than water for new drinking water abstraction points, whether conservation campaigns are wrong, whether environmental groups frustrate permitting through lawsuits, and when law changes will help. The minister said permitting requires several conditions, outlined the Actieprogramma and the Leven met water campaign, noted that appeal and objection rights are a required and important part of the democratic system, and said that decentralised authorities can already speed decisions under current law.
Under the General Administrative Law Act, decisions of the competent authority are open to appeal and objection.
Op grond van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht staan besluiten van het bevoegd gezag open voor beroep en bezwaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de brand op een vrachtschip in de haven van Amsterdam

MPs Bamenga and Rooderkerk (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the cause of a May 2025 ship fire in the Amsterdam port, repeated fires, prevention measures, and health monitoring of residents. The minister answered that the cause is unknown and the matter is a local responsibility, cited general measures on battery waste and prevention by industry, and reported that GGD and the safety region issued advice to residents.
This concerns a local incident, which is handled by the local competent authority.
Het betreft een lokaal incident, dat door het lokaal bevoegd gezag behandeld wordt.
Antwoord vragen van lid De Hoop over het artikel “KLM-piloten: veiligheid staat bij de KLM niet langer op 1”

An MP asked the minister whether she recognises pilots' safety concerns about KLM cargo aircraft maintenance, when the pilots' letter to the aviation regulator ILT was sent and whether it was mentioned in earlier answers. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the ILT received the letter on 4 March and has inspected an aircraft and is analysing incident reports, and said earlier answers did not address individual reports while promising a debate answer after the summer recess.
Following the letter, the ILT aviation authority spoke with the letter's authors.
Naar aanleiding van de brief is de ILT-luchtvaartautoriteit in gesprek gegaan met de schrijvers van de brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Stoffer over onnodige trainingseisen voor vissers Wet bemanning zeeschepen

MPs Pierik and Stoffer asked whether mandatory additional safety training for fishers under the new Wet bemanning zeeschepen is disproportionate and not aligned with practice on fishing vessels, and asked the government to pause implementation. The minister answered that the only change is a five-yearly refresher for basic safety training required by STCW-F, agreed with sector bodies, with a transition period to 2030, and declined to pause the law, which enters into force on 1 July 2025.
The only substantive change in the new Wet bemanning zeeschepen, which enters into force on 1 July 2025, is a five-yearly refresher obligation for this training.
De enige inhoudelijke aanpassing in de nieuwe Wet bemanning zeeschepen, die per 1 juli 2025 in werking treedt, is een 5-jaarlijkse herhalingsverplichting voor deze training.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over PFAS-lozingen Custom Powders

An MP asked the government about PFAS discharges by Custom Powders in Helmond, including the role of oversight, health effects, liability, costs and future prevention. The minister answered that the municipality will commission an independent investigation into its own oversight role, that PFOA effects are recognised but causality is not established, that liability lies with polluters through courts, and that structural measures (VTH reform, Routekaart, industry action agenda) are under way with further information promised before the summer recess.

The municipality of Helmond, as competent authority for the sewage discharges, has therefore announced an independent investigation into the role of the municipality and the environmental service, including licensing, supervision and enforcement.

De gemeente Helmond, als bevoegd gezag voor de rioollozingen, heeft daarom aangekondigd dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek komt naar de rol van de gemeente en de milieudienst, inclusief vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Peter de Groot over probleemgevallen met certificeringen bij de ILT

MPs Buijsse and Peter de Groot asked the minister about inspection and certification delays for inland shipping after the accreditation suspension of the NBKB, including temporary certificates, the independence of new inspection bodies and capacity risks. The minister answered that the ILT outsources certification to accredited bodies, issued 690 temporary certificates, is working with new providers toward agreements once they meet independence requirements, and is working to expand inspection capacity.
The ILT is in close contact with both the inland shipping sector and the recognised classification societies and inspection bodies to keep a finger on the pulse and to intervene if necessary.
De ILT staat in nauw contact met zowel de binnenvaartsector als de erkende klassenbureaus en keuringsinstanties om vinger aan de pols te houden en in te grijpen als dit nodig zou zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Dobbe over de eerdere beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in religieuze context

MPs Becker and Dobbe asked about the effectiveness of border indicators, awareness campaigns, training and follow-up on female genital mutilation risks at Schiphol, and the status of related programmes and research. The government answered that indicators and training are in place, the Marechaussee sees no need for evaluation or stronger controls, campaigns ran with reach figures but no formal evaluation, and a comparative study on preventive protection orders is expected before summer 2025.
Antwoord op de leden Postma en Grinwis over het meerekenen van autonome vlootvernieuwing in de balanced approach-procedure

MPs Postma and Grinwis asked whether autonomous fleet renewal was counted in the reference situation and the noise target of the balanced approach procedure at Schiphol, and whether it was double-counted. The minister confirmed autonomous developments up to November 2024 are in the reference situation, said the 15% first-phase target sits on top of them, and announced a policy change for the remaining 5% so autonomous developments can contribute to it.
In the letter of 7 May to the House, the cabinet announced a policy change for the remaining percentage, so that autonomous developments can contribute to achieving the remainder of the noise target.

1 aan de Kamer heeft het kabinet voor het resterende percentage een beleidswijziging aangekondigd, waardoor de autonome ontwikkelingen wel kunnen bijdragen aan het behalen van het restant van het geluidsdoel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de handhaving van het verbod op varend ontgassen

Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how enforcement of the ban on gassing off at sea is organised, including staffing, equipment, violations, and the availability of degassing installations. Minister Madlener replied that the ILT enforces risk-based using e-noses and drones, has recruited inspectors, recorded four violations resulting in penalty payments, and that capacity is considered sufficient.
The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) enforces the applicable ban.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) handhaaft op het geldende verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht dat de nieuwe Duitse coalitie de vliegtaks gaat verlagen

An MP from FVD asked the government about Germany's coalition plan to cut its aviation tax, the Dutch plan to differentiate its own aviation tax by distance, and the risk of passenger diversion and loss of competitiveness. The minister answered that Germany's choice is a national matter, that the effects of the Dutch measure are still being studied with results expected before the summer recess, and that the government sees no reason to scrap or reverse the Dutch tax increase.
The cabinet sees no reason for this.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de beperkte bereikbaarheid van Zeeland bij stremmingen van de Vlaketunnel (A58)

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of the Vlaketunnel on the A58, the delayed partial reopening, risks to schoolchildren cycling, economic losses, and the adequacy of Zeeland's emergency routes. The minister replied that the closure followed a technical fault, partial reopening came after the morning rush hour due to a more complex fault, an evaluation is pending, and no structural tracking of losses exists for unplanned closures, while committing to ongoing regional cooperation and a future Rijkswaterstaat-led traffic management arrangement.
The evaluation by Rijkswaterstaat and others should reveal why the tunnel tube could not be partially reopened earlier.
Uit de evaluatie van onder andere Rijkswaterstaat moet blijken waarom de tunnelbuis niet eerder gedeeltelijk kon worden opengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over openheid over de besluitvorming ten aanzien van geluidsreductie bij Schiphol

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management to share, under Article 68 of the Constitution, the documents and legal and official advice underlying the Cabinet's 6 May decision on how to fill the remaining noise-reduction target around Schiphol, before the vote on related motions. The minister answered that the documents cannot be made public because of the state's litigation interest, and sent them as confidential documents for members only to inspect.
In view of the state's procedural interest, these documents cannot be made public.
Gelet op het procesbelang van de Nederlandse Staat kunnen deze stukken niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de gevolgen van het niet naleven van Europese milieu- en natuurwetgeving

An MP asked the ministers what EU legal tools besides infringement procedures could force the Netherlands to comply with environmental and nature law, and about related talks with the Commission and other member states. The minister answered that the Commission could theoretically cut EU funds such as CAP money, that talks with the Commission are confidential so details cannot be disclosed, and that compliance is discussed with other states without a central focus on level playing field.
To be able to exchange views openly with the Commission on various issues and possible solutions now and in the future, confidentiality is of great importance.
Om nu en in de toekomst met de Commissie open van gedachten te kunnen wisselen over verschillende vraagstukken en mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen, is vertrouwelijkheid van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over calamiteitenroutes in Zeeland

An SGP MP asked the minister about the closures of the Vlaketunnel (A58) in Zeeland, the lack of two-way emergency routes through the tunnel tube, traffic management, and emergency routes in the MIRT. The minister answered that closures were recorded per year, that two-way traffic in a tunnel tube is not permitted under Dutch tunnel law, that cooperation with the province exists, and that no new connections to the N289 are planned.
Yes, it is important that there are adequate emergency routes and that people can leave Zeeland in case of emergencies.
Ja, het is belangrijk dat er adequate calamiteitenroutes zijn en dat mensen in geval van calamiteiten Zeeland kunnen verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gabriëls over het bericht dat er meer 'zombiebranden' zijn door klimaatverandering

MPs Kröger and Gabriëls asked the government about reports that climate change is causing more 'zombie fires' and what the Netherlands is doing on climate adaptation, drought, water management and spatial planning. The minister replied that such overwintering fires have not been documented in the Netherlands, cited existing funding and planned measures including a new National Climate Adaptation Strategy due in 2026, and gave substantive answers on most questions while declining to provide the strategy draft before year-end.
According to the current planning, the draft NAS will be opened for public consultation at the end of this year.
