Volgens de huidige planning zal de ontwerpNAS eind dit jaar opengesteld worden voor publieke consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Amerikaanse luchtvaart weer naar de rechter als kabinet krimp Schiphol doorzet’

An MP from JA21 asks the minister whether American airline association A4A's letter threatening legal action has been received, whether the government will reconsider its Schiphol capacity reduction given the risk of foreign countermeasures from the US, China and India, and what those countries have signalled. The minister replies that the balanced approach procedure was followed correctly, that A4A's concerns are known and the case has been referred to the administrative court, that contacts with the US, China and India have taken place, and that countermeasures cannot be fully excluded but were weighed in the decision.
A4A submitted a confidential opinion in the procedure for the airport traffic decision (LVB procedure).
A4A heeft een vertrouwelijke zienswijze in de procedure voor het luchthaven verkeerbesluit (LVB-procedure) ingediend
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het artikel ‘Onafhankelijk milieurapport afgezwakt na druk door Schiphol’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Schiphol and the ministry pressured the Commission for Environmental Assessment (mer) into softening its report on the Schiphol emissions rules, and whether the new flight-limit decree meets equivalence criteria. The minister denied undue pressure, said the commission only changed wording on its own authority after normal review of the draft, and maintained that the decree meets the equivalence criteria based on the 2020 MER and annual use forecasts.
No, there is no question of putting the mer commission under pressure.
Nee, er is geen sprake van het onder druk zetten van de commissie voor de mer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht 'KLM registreert vracht-747’s tijdelijk in buitenland voor onderhoud'

MP De Hoop asked whether KLM's temporary registration of cargo 747s in San Marino for maintenance by a non-EASA-approved foreign firm poses safety risks and whether such practices are legal and common. Minister Madlener confirmed the facts, said the registration is permitted under the Chicago Convention with San Marino responsible for airworthiness, and that the ILT checks the aircraft before re-registration in the Netherlands, but did not commit to any new action.
It is not illegal to deregister an aircraft.
Het is niet illegaal om een luchtvaartuig uit te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Koning klaagt erop los: vaak file na loos alarm’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about frequent tunnel closures at the Schiphol tunnel caused by height-detection alarms for trucks, including false positives, traffic impact, and planned improvements. The minister answered in detail, stating the system produces no false positives, giving 2024 alarm counts per tunnel, and outlining signage, technical, and enforcement measures with a report to parliament promised before summer.
The system does not give false-positive alarms.
Het systeem geeft geen fout-positieve meldingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en De Hoop over de scheepsramp voor de kust van Hull

MPs Gabriëls and De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about environmental effects of the Hull tanker collision, its causes, differences in shipping rules, Dutch preventive measures, and whether the Dutch North Sea safety approach needs strengthening. The minister answered that effects and causes are not yet known, pending British investigations, and pointed to existing Dutch routing, monitoring and cooperation measures plus a planned risk-analysis approach.
It is therefore not yet known what the environmental effects of this incident are.
Het is dus nog niet bekend wat de milieueffecten van dit incident zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de economische kansen van verduurzaming op Curaçao

Two D66 MPs asked about a Curaçao solar park, EV charging and electric buses, including a 13.2 million euro financing gap and Dutch funding commitments. The minister says Curaçao is responsible for procurement and financing, that Dutch SDE funds cannot be used directly but grid and storage costs may be eligible, and that a feasibility study and a May visit to Curaçao are planned.
It is up to Curaçao to shape the implementation and financing.
Het is aan Curaçao om de uitvoering en financiering vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Aukje de Vries, Soepboer en Pierik over de gesloten brug bij Uitwellingerga

Four MPs asked the minister why temporary solutions for the closed Uitwellingerga bridge are not feasible, what the impact is on residents and businesses, and whether bridge inspections were adequate. The minister explains that only a temporary fixed bridge deck option is being pursued for August 2025, that the bridge cannot be repaired, that about 1,500 people in surrounding villages are affected, and that inspection procedures are being evaluated.
Rijkswaterstaat regularly evaluates the inspection procedures; the experiences at Uitwellingerga are also being taken into account.
Rijkswaterstaat evalueert de inspectieprocedures regelmatig; ook de ervaringen van Uitwellingerga worden hierin meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostić over “de onbetrouwbaarheid van de inschatting van saneringskosten voor de grond vanTata Steel”

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked the government about the reliability of the estimated remediation costs of up to 12 billion euros for Tata Steel's land, including the assumptions, possible bankruptcy liability and the absence of a parent company guarantee. The minister answered that the underlying analysis is confidential, that remediation costs depend on future land use, that the polluter-pays principle applies, and that a maatwerkafspraak is being pursued to avoid a bankruptcy scenario.
No. Wijers and Blom, supported by BCG, conducted independent research.
Nee. Wijers en Blom hebben, ondersteund door BCG, onafhankelijk onderzoek gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over de files op de A2 Deil Vught

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about congestion on the A2 between Vught and Deil, its economic cost, and whether the project paused for lack of nitrogen space, capacity and funds can be restarted quickly. The Minister acknowledges the problem, says the project remains needed but is paused, that one paused project a year is the ambition, that mitigating measures are the maximum feasible for now, and that no priority ranking can yet be given pending analysis.
In the spring it will also be indicated which of the paused projects will be restarted first.
In het voorjaar wordt ook aangegeven welk van de gepauzeerde projecten als eerste weer wordt opgestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het artikel ‘Brug Uitwellingerga kan niet worden gerepareerd: nieuwe brug pas in 2029 klaar’

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the prolonged closure of the Uitwellingerga bridge, the temporary bridge timeline, the 2029 permanent replacement, the vaarseizoen 2026 options and ferry, and the risk to nearby bridges. The minister answered in detail on timelines and options but with several deferrals to decisions still pending.
The aim is to take a decision on this by May 2025 at the latest.
Beoogd is om hierover uiterlijk in mei 2025 een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Podt over de Kaderrichtlijn Water (KRW)

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the EU Water Framework Directive, including the Commission's finding that the Netherlands will likely miss its 2027 targets, the Tussenevaluatie, nitrogen and manure rules, permit backlogs and legal risks. The minister acknowledged the shortfall and the legal risks, pointed to the impulse programme and forthcoming measures before summer 2025, but gave largely general answers and deferred several points to other ministers and authorities.
Before summer 2025 the House will be informed about this.
Vóór de zomer van 2025 wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over belastingconstructies bij OV-bedrijf Qbuzz

An SP MP asked the government about Qbuzz's interest payments to its Italian state-railway parent, tax avoidance, foreign ownership of regional bus operators and whether Dutch-owned bus operators are preferred. The government declined to discuss individual tax files citing confidentiality, restated the arm's-length principle and existing earnings-stripping rules, and said foreign ownership is not decisive in concession awards.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, individual tax files cannot be discussed.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over verzorgingsplaatsen van de toekomst

MP Vermeer asks the minister about the high costs and unequal chances for SME operators at rest-stop fuel and charging concessions, the temporary policy rule shortening charging permits, fossil fuel phase-out, and trust with SME fuel station owners. The minister replies that permits are allocated by lottery or on request, fuel stations are auctioned under the Benzinewet, a draft bill is in consultation with equal access as a key aim, existing concession terms will be respected, and the sector will be involved in a participation track on the route map.
Equal access for all entrepreneurs is very important.
Gelijke toegang voor alle ondernemers is erg belangrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Olger van Dijk over verdachte Russische schepen in onze wateren

MPs Kahraman and Olger van Dijk asked the ministers about suspicious Russian ships in Dutch waters, the shadow fleet, espionage around North Sea infrastructure and European sales of tankers to Russia. The government describes sanctions listings, IMO and port-state measures, NATO and regional cooperation, and promises a confidential briefing on the legal analysis of additional powers while declining to detail planned measures.

As promised in the NATO Defence Ministerial committee debate of 5 February 2025, you will be informed through a confidential technical briefing about the outcomes of the legal analysis into additional options to intervene in maritime espionage and sabotage activities.

Zoals toegezegd in het commissiedebat NAVO Defensie Ministeriële op 5 februari 2025, zal u middels een vertrouwelijke technische briefing worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van de juridische analyse
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Bamenga over het artikel op de website PITANE.BLUE van 19 januari 2025: ‘OV-NL: doel uitstootvrije bussen in 2030 onder druk door gebrek aan stroom’

MPs Rooderkerk and Bamenga asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about mobility CO2 emissions, whether the 2030 restemissie target is reachable, funding, grid congestion delaying bus electrification, air quality and whether climate targets could be dropped. The State Secretary answered that the government is not on track, will consider alternative measures in spring, has no budget space yet, cites grid-congestion agreements and subsidies, and states it will only deviate from climate targets if alternative policy fails.
Therefore the cabinet is looking this spring at the possibilities for taking alternative measures, as also agreed in the coalition programme.
Daarom kijkt het kabinet dit voorjaar naar de mogelijkheden om alternatieve maatregelen te treffen, zoals ook afgesproken in het regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Oezbeekse trucker staakt bij truckstop in Venlo: “ik vrees voor m’n leven”’

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Infrastructure and Social Affairs how they will protect a striking Uzbek truck driver from employer coercion, ensure full wages, safeguard his residence permit, and act against the Lithuanian firm Baltic Transline and sector-wide abuse. The minister replied that the Labour Inspectorate has investigated and is still examining the case, that cabotage rules were not breached on the cited route, that an implementation study is under way with results expected end 2025, and that EU-level research on third-country drivers is ongoing.
I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het artikel 'Derogatiebedrijven helpen kabinet een handje: 'Nitraatconcentratie daalt naar, op of onder de norm''

An MP asks ministers whether the reported fall in nitrate levels on derogation farms, and the claim that ending the manure derogation will help water quality, are supported by RIVM and Wageningen research and by the European Commission. The ministers answer that the reports were shared with the Commission, that ending the derogation may reduce grassland and shift fertiliser use, and that additional measures such as the 7th and 8th Nitrate Action Programmes are needed.
Yes, these reports have been shared with the European Commission by the Minister of LVVN.
Ja, deze rapporten zijn door de Minister van LVVN met de Europese Commissie gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over de wijze waarop geluidshinder rondom Schiphol wordt gemodelleerd, gevalideerd en gemeten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how aircraft noise around Schiphol is modelled, validated and measured, including whether NOMOS outdoor measurements can capture indoor annoyance. The minister answered that noise exposure is modelled with Doc29 and validated against measurements since 2017 (structurally since 2024), that outdoor measurements are not meant to measure annoyance, and that indoor measuring is impractical, while promising a plan for noise measurement before summer 2025.
Measuring aircraft noise exposure indoors at residents' homes gives no insight into the annoyance those residents experience.
Het binnenshuis meten van de geluidbelasting van vliegverkeer bij omwonenden geeft geen inzicht in de hinder die deze omwonenden dan ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Plas over de actualisatie van de Beleidslijn grote rivieren

Two MPs from SGP and BBB asked the ministers how the update of the Beleidslijn Grote Rivieren would affect farms in flood-overflow areas such as the Kampereilanden, including investment room, stable renewal and manure use. Minister Madlener replies that grounded agricultural firms keep development options under exceptions, that the update is not seen as a significant obstacle to Kampen, that the government will study boundaries for specific areas and that compensation is available under the Omgevingswet.
For agricultural businesses located in the former flow-carrying regime, almost nothing changes.
Voor agrarische bedrijven, die in de voormalige stroomvoerende regime liggen, verandert er nagenoeg niets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Grinwis over de gevolgen van de aangekondigde grenscontroles voor het vrachtverkeer

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister how border checks with Germany and Belgium affect freight traffic, including waiting times, costs, parking capacity and fatal accidents linked to queues. The minister replied that checks are intelligence- and risk-driven with no fixed posts, that waiting times are very limited, that green lanes and exemptions are ruled out, and that cost-sharing talks are ongoing.
Because of the effectiveness of the controls, it is undesirable to publish where the controls will be carried out.
Het is vanwege de doelmatigheid van de controles onwenselijk te publiceren waar de controles worden ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Inspectie rekt regels voor het gedogen van geluidsoverlast bij Schiphol verder op’

An MP asks why Schiphol again exceeds legal noise limits and why the ILT did not sanction the 2023 exceedance, including whether a de facto toleration policy exists. The minister answers that anticipatory enforcement under explicit instruction prevents sanctions for exceedances caused by NNHS runway rules, that the policy will end after the balanced approach procedure (targeted November 2025), and that documents will be published, while declining to predict litigation outcomes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het verder oprekken van de geluidsregels voor Schiphol door de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport

An MP asks whether the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) has repeatedly tolerated Schiphol exceeding statutory noise limits under the anticipatory enforcement policy, whether Schiphol breached the conditions in 2021 to 2023, whether the ILT's enforcement independence was compromised by ministry or Schiphol pressure, and what sanctions and disclosure apply. The minister answers that anticipatory enforcement is a ministerial instruction still in place, that the 2023 exceedance was almost entirely explained by the preferential runway rules so the ILT could not act, that the ILT is independent and the ministry did not pressure it, and that the government aims to end the tolerance situation and restore residents' legal protection.
The ILT, after investigation with Schiphol and LVNL, reached this outcome independently.
De ILT is na onderzoek bij Schiphol en LVNL zelfstandig tot deze uitkomst gekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Boswijk over de berichten 'Hypermoderne Tesla Cybertruck van rapper Kosso rijdt via omweg tóch op de Nederlandse weg' en 'Eerste legale Tesla Cybertruck in België rijdt rond: Ned

MPs Vedder and Boswijk asked whether Tesla Cybertrucks entering the Netherlands via loopholes (Albanian registration, Czech individual approval) pose road safety risks and what the government will do. The minister answered that the vehicle is registered abroad under the Vienna Convention, that the RDW has only a pending individual approval application for another Cybertruck, that enforcement tools exist but no new policy is planned, and that the government will push the European Commission to update individual approval rules.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the RDW remain actively engaged in international forums where vehicle requirements affecting vehicle safety are further developed.

Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de RDW blijven actief in gesprek in internationale gremia waar voertuigeisen, die van invloed zijn op de voertuigveiligheid, verder worden ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de lozing van FrieslandCampina op de Waddenzee

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about FrieslandCampina's discharge of a hazardous cleaning agent into the Wadden Sea, including whether the chemicals' composition, long-term impacts, legal compliance and the permit process are adequately controlled. The minister answered that the provincial authority of Groningen is responsible, that the permit is being actualised with stricter discharge conditions expected this quarter, and that the process follows national and EU rules, while several details (such as the warm-water discharge study) are still pending further research.

The competent authority, in this case the provincial executive of Groningen, is responsible for assessing this indirect discharge, granting it through an environmental permit and updating the discharge conditions in that permit.

Het bevoegd gezag, in dit geval het college van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Groningen (in het vervolg: de provincie of de provincie Groningen), gaat over de beoordeling van deze indirecte lozing
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over Praalwagens

Mp Pierik (BBB) asked the minister whether stricter APK, registration and plating rules for float vehicles at carnival parades are unduly costly for traditional carnival associations, and what alternatives and communication took place. The minister answered that floats fall under existing vehicle categories, that the rules stem from an EU directive, that existing exemptions apply, that no data exists on affected associations, and that communication went through industry bodies rather than directly to all carnival associations.
No data is available on which carnival associations use which type of vehicle in carnival parades.
Er is geen data beschikbaar omtrent welke carnavalsverenigingen welk type voertuig inzetten bij carnavalsoptochten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het bericht 'Zeekoeten onder de parafine aangespoeld aan de kust: 'Zelf gaan ze het niet redden''

MP Kostić asked the ministers about reports that seabirds were dying from paraffin discharged at the coast, the care duty for injured animals, financial support for animal ambulances and wildlife centres, and Dutch and IMO rules on washing tanks and discharging residues. The government answered each question, pointing to existing voluntary arrangements, IMO work expected to conclude in 2026, and Dutch proposals at the IMO, while declining to provide compensation or structural funding for individual rescue organisations.
There is no compensation scheme from central government for individual rescue actions by animal ambulances or wildlife centres.
Er bestaat vanuit het Rijk geen compensatieregeling voor individuele reddingsacties van dierenambulances of wildopvangcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger Van Dijk over het bericht ‘Voertuigen weginspecteurs vaker aangereden'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the tripling of collisions with road inspector vehicles in 2024, the causes, distraction-related measures and safety of inspectors. The minister answered that causes appear largely random and linked to inattention, cited enforcement and camera measures, and committed to reconsidering lane closures if safety measures prove insufficient.
Incidentally, this question has immediately been added to the guidelines for producing the incident report.
Per direct is deze vraag overigens toegevoegd aan de aanwijzingen om te komen tot het feitenrelaas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel “’Kanaalkijkers’ zijn vol bewondering over leegpompen, verdiepen en verbreden van Julianakanaal”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about emission-free earthmoving machines on the Julianakanaal project, the cost and delay of Schoon en Emissieloos Bouwen (SEB), diesel generators, the risk of delay to the dike reinforcement programme (HWBP), and safety risks for residents. The minister answered that the project was urgent so no emission-free equipment requirements were set, that SEB costs are only known at programme level and will be evaluated in 2025, and that nitrogen issues and SEB are considered per project without evidence SEB itself causes delays.
Since the calamity had to be resolved urgently, no estimate was made of the additional costs and extra lead time from using emission-free equipment on the Julianakanaal.

Aangezien de calamiteit met spoed moest worden opgelost, is er geen inschatting gemaakt van de meerkosten en extra doorlooptijd als gevolg van de inzet van emissieloos materieel bij het Julianakanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de balanced approach-procedure Schiphol

MP Kostić asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, Madlener, about the Schiphol balanced approach procedure, including claims that the European Commission warned against the old downsizing plan, the history of the procedure and its noise-reduction targets, and EU law on noise and fundamental rights. The minister answers most questions, denies that the noise target was weakened, explains the phasing and additional fleet renewal rules, and shares documents only under confidential inspection, citing EU correspondence confidentiality.
The starting point is that correspondence with the European Commission is strictly confidential and is not made public during ongoing procedures.
Uitgangspunt is dat correspondentie met de Europese Commissie strikt vertrouwelijk is en niet openbaar wordt gemaakt tijdens lopende procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over de afsluiting voor vrachtverkeer op de A12

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Rijkswaterstaat closed the A12 Velperbroek viaducts to heavy freight, whether similar viaducts exist, and about economic, traffic and planning effects. The minister explained the tand-nok construction defect, that about 100 similar structures exist with 17 prioritised, that heavy traffic is limited to 45 tonnes with enforcement left to police and ILT, and that a support structure is planned for April 2025 with a definitive fix only in the Vernieuwing programme.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have a national picture of the bridges and viaducts managed by provinces and municipalities.
Rijkswaterstaat beschikt niet over een landelijk beeld van de bruggen en viaducten in beheer bij provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Geen zwaar vrachtverkeer meer over viaduct A12 bij Velperbroek’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the weight restriction on heavy freight over the A12 viaducts at Velperbroek, including support structures, enforcement, detour effects, renovation timing and defence transport needs. The minister answered all ten questions in substance, noting Rijkswaterstaat does not enforce itself (police and ILT do), that renovation timing is not yet known, and that the military transport network is being re-evaluated with the Ministry of Defence.
Specific information on military transport routes and corridors cannot be shared publicly due to the confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke informatie over militaire transportroutes en corridors kan i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet publiekelijk gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over Staatssecretaris Jansen en de veiligheid op de werkvloer op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MP Bamenga asks ministers about a letter from 175 civil servants at the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management protesting Staatssecretaris Jansen's remarks about Moroccans, the reported sick leave of advisers, and how ministers will restore a safe working climate and address institutional racism in the civil service. The government answers that it takes the concerns seriously, that talks with staff are ongoing, that a broader integrated anti-discrimination approach and reporting model are planned, and declines to give individual personnel details.
We do not comment on internal individual personnel matters.
Over interne individuele personele aangelegenheden doen wij geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de sterke toename van het aantal overtredingen van de regels over de door vliegtuigen minimaal aan te houden aanvlieghoogte richting Schiphol

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether low-altitude approaches to Schiphol over Sassenheim and nearby municipalities have sharply increased, and whether enforcement by the ILT is adequate. The minister replies that no violations of the approach-altitude rules have been recorded since 2022, that deviations stayed within the allowed 15% limit, and that the ILT's existing sanctioning tools are sufficient.
The LVB also stipulates that LVNL may deviate from those provisions if necessary for the safe and efficient handling of air traffic.
In het LVB is ook vastgelegd dat LVNL van die bepalingen mag afwijken als dat noodzakelijk is in verband met een veilige en doelmatige afwikkeling van het vliegverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over het bericht ‘Rivaal Qatar Airways mag meer vliegen op Schiphol ondanks krimpplan: ’KLM moet kapot’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Qatar Airways may fly more from Schiphol despite a shrinking plan, including slot allocation rules, fair competition in the EU-Qatar air agreement, Qatari crew rest rules, and the Qatargate investigation. The minister answered that slot allocation is the independent slot coordinator's responsibility, that the EU-Qatar agreement contains enforceable fair-competition clauses, that no concrete evidence of safety risk has been found, and that the government will reraise the issue if evidence emerges.
If not, why not? Answer 5: I do not share this view.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 5 Ik deel deze mening niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht 'Een op de drie provincies voor de rechter om drinkwater'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising legal disputes over drinking water, groundwater abstraction and pricing, and how scarce groundwater should be allocated. The minister said the ministry keeps no figures on lawsuits, that groundwater extraction permits are the provinces' responsibility, and that pricing and regulation measures are being prepared, without committing to a new concrete step.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management does not keep data on the number of lawsuits concerning drinking water supply or threats thereof.
Het Ministerie van IenW houdt geen gegevens bij van aantallen rechtszaken met betrekking tot de drinkwatervoorziening of dreigingen daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Boos personeel, duurdere tickets en langere rijen: reiziger dreigt klos te worden van ingreep Schiphol bij beveiliging’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Schiphol's plan to reorganise security and ground-handling contracts, including reducing ground handlers from six to three, and its effects on passengers, prices, staff and foreign ownership. The minister answered that Schiphol is responsible for tendering, that the Marechaussee supervises security, that prices are not expected to rise, and that the ground-handling reduction aims to improve efficiency and working conditions, while answering several questions by pointing to Schiphol's assessments.
Schiphol is legally obliged to have security work carried out by security companies that meet strict requirements.
Schiphol is wettelijk verplicht beveiligingswerkzaamheden uit te laten voeren door beveiligingsbedrijven die aan strikte eisen voldoen.
Antwoord op van het lid Grinwis over het artikel ‘‘Fuck de regels’: hoe spotgoedkope Chinese fatbikes Nederland worden binnengesmokkeld’

MP Grinwis asked the ministers of Infrastructure, Finance and Justice about reports that illegal Chinese fatbikes with throttles and excessive motors are smuggled into the Netherlands, how customs and the ILT control them, and what enforcement measures will follow, including on online sellers and the Ouxi V8 model. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that customs controls are risk-based without separate capacity or success figures for fatbikes, that the ILT and police can seize or fine non-compliant vehicles, and that a consumer awareness campaign is running.
It cannot be said how much capacity Customs deploys on fatbike controls.
Het is daardoor niet te zeggen hoeveel capaciteit de Douane inzet op de controles van fatbikes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het krantenartikel 'Forse verhoging havengelden Schiphol wekt woede in de luchtvaartsector'

An MP asks the minister about a 41% rise in Schiphol airport charges, its fairness to short-haul and Dutch-departing passengers, and whether the government will engage Schiphol. The minister replies that Schiphol sets charges under a legal framework checked by the ACM, that transfer discounts protect the hub, and that the government will report on an airport-tax study in Q2 2025.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is the independent regulator and tests the airport charges against the legal framework, including on reasonableness.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is de onafhankelijke toezichthouder en toetst de luchthavengelden aan het wettelijk kader, op onder andere redelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Extra krimp Schiphol dreigt na nieuwe berekeningen PVV-minister Madlener’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Schiphol flight cap may fall to about 466,000 movements, and how fleet renewal, tariffs, retaliation risks and EU notification were handled. The minister answers that the cabinet chose a phased -15% noise target giving about 478,000 movements from November 2025, that no extra shrinkage occurs, and that the EU Commission has been informed, though some questions are answered only in part or deferred.
The cabinet chooses to fill in the noise target in the first phase at -15%.
Het kabinet kiest daarbij voor een invulling van het geluidsdoel in de eerste fase naar –15%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het met spoed sluiten van de brug Uitwellingerga

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Uitwellingerga bridge had to be closed urgently, whether better monitoring or earlier restrictions could have prevented it, the replacement timeline, and risks of further bridge failures in the region. The minister answered that newer inspections revealed worse condition than assumed, that earlier monitoring would not have prompted closure, that the replacement may be brought forward but is not yet confirmed, and that a temporary bridge is among options under consideration.
It is being examined whether the replacement of this bridge can be brought forward by several years.
Onderzocht wordt of de vernieuwing van deze brug enkele jaren naar voren kan worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bontenbal over het potentiële valmeerproject bij de Haringvlietmonding

MPs Grinwis and Bontenbal asked the government about the proposed Delta21 valmeer (storage reservoir) at the Haringvliet mouth, its energy value, flood safety, ecological impact, strategic autonomy, and whether it should be included in the grid security plan and a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answers that the project has potential value as large-scale electricity storage but faces large uncertainties and ecological drawbacks, and commits to a broader cost-benefit comparison of flexibility options and an update of the energy storage roadmap.

As promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (7 November 2024), the cabinet is willing to map the pros and cons of a valmeer project for the energy system, including a comparison with other flexibility applications.

Zoals is toegezegd tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (7 november 2024) is het kabinet bereid om in kaart te brengen wat de voor- en nadelen zijn van een valmeerproject voor het energiesysteem, inclusief een vergelijking met andere flexibiliteitstoepassingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Peter de Groot over de verdwijnende parkeerplaatsen in binnensteden

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether municipal removal of parking spaces in city centres such as Nijmegen harms car-dependent residents, whether a national overview of car-restrictive municipal measures exists, and whether national parking norms for new housing will be examined. The minister replied that parking and public space decisions are municipal responsibilities, that the ministry has no overview or oversight of parking norms, and that talks with municipalities on parking tariffs will be held.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de veerverbinding met Ameland

An MP asks whether the government will start the MIRT exploration for the Ameland ferry link, which has a 250 million euro risk reserve in the budget and a startdocument with partner names. The minister confirms the start decision was taken on 14 November 2024, after consulting regional administrators, and that the reserve was used for it.

Yes, I am aware of this. On 14 November the House was informed about the start decision and the use of the 250 million euro reserve (incl. VAT) under article 11.04 for the MIRT exploration of Ameland accessibility.

Ja, hier ben ik van op de hoogte. Op 14 november jl. is de Kamer geïnformeerd over de startbeslissing en het aanwenden van de reservering van € 250 mln. incl. btw op artikel 11.04 voor de MIRT verkenning Bereikbaarheid Ameland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Soepboer en Wingelaar naar aanleiding van het bericht “Grote gevolgen gezonken vrachtschip: fabrieken op Chemelot dreigen stil te vallen en directeur Sappi in Maastricht vreest productiest

Two MPs asked the minister about the Julianakanaal closure after a sunken ship, the compensation committee, works progress, bypass route reliability, and business damage. The minister answered that works are on schedule for reopening by end April 2025, that a compensation committee exists but damage from the ship collision falls under the shipowner's liability rather than Rijkswaterstaat compensation.
Basically there is therefore no ground for damages or compensation by Rijkswaterstaat solely as a result of this calamity.
In de basis is er dan ook geen grond voor schadevergoeding of nadeelcompensatie door Rijkswaterstaat enkel als gevolg van deze calamiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht «Gedrag van PVV-bewindslieden zet de verhoudingen op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat onder hoogspanning»

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported tensions with civil servants over their conduct, including a controversial remark on TV and lobbying by Schiphol and KLM. The Minister acknowledged the unease, said talks with the senior civil service had been held, stated that the State Secretary has distanced himself from the remark, and said the relationship is in good order.
From our conversations with the senior civil service we have gained insight into the discomfort that this and earlier events have caused in the department.
Uit onze gesprekken met de ambtelijke top hebben wij inzicht gekregen in het ongemak waartoe een en ander (uit het verleden) heeft geleid in het departement.
Antwoord op van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het bericht dat “stokoude, slecht verzekerde tankers met Russische olie meermaals per dag langs de Nederlandse kust varen”

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked about reports that old, poorly insured tankers carrying Russian oil pass the Dutch coast hundreds of times, raising pollution risk, possible sabotage use, liability, legal options, sanctions effectiveness and oil refining loopholes. The minister replied that the Netherlands cannot block such vessels in international waters and relies on port state control, IMO and IOPC Fund measures, EU sanctions listings and continued work on sanctions evasion, while giving only general answers on future sanctions proposals.
It is not in the interest of the negotiations or the Dutch negotiating position to go further into detail on concrete proposals.
7 Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelingen en de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie om verder in detail te gaan over concrete voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en De Hoop over de hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Bushoff and De Hoop asked about high hospital parking fees, public transport access for low-income patients, parking outsourcing, and the Rover report on hospital accessibility. Minister Agema answered that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, pointed to existing transport and tax schemes, and committed only to forwarding the Rover report to sector bodies.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger Van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Minister van Defensie: Nederlandse wetten ongeschikt voor ‘grijze zone’ tussen oorlog en vrede’

MPs Van Dijk and Six-Dijkstra asked the government about Russian vessels mapping North Sea infrastructure, military transport routes, conscription and reservists, a single cyber contact point, and cybersecurity governance. The government answered that it does not pre-announce responses, outlines Defence's North Sea tasks and the Action Plan, says military route specifics are confidential, notes a voluntary enquiry and more reservists, and describes the NLCS and the planned Cyberweerbaarheidsnetwerk.
Specific information on military transport routes and corridors cannot be shared publicly due to the confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke informatie over militaire transportroutes en corridors kan i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet publiekelijk gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het bericht uit de Telegraaf van 4 oktober jl. 'Boosheid om ophoping waterschapsbelasting: Rekening van €1200 binnen zeven maanden tijd’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a water board's system failure that caused residents to receive multiple large water-tax bills in a short period, and about its effects and oversight. The minister acknowledged the problem, described hardship relief and instalment options, said the issue stemmed from a Waternet-only ICT system, and noted that oversight of water boards lies primarily with the provinces while the water board is expected to resolve it itself.
In the first instance, it is the responsibility of the general board to hold the executive board to account if it believes the tasks are not being carried out properly.
Het behoort in eerste instantie tot de bevoegdheid van het algemeen bestuur om het dagelijks bestuur erop aan te spreken, indien het van mening is dat de taken niet goed worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over maatregelen die contraproductief werken voor het oplossen van de klimaatcrisis

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management about the CO2 impact of opening Lelystad Airport to commercial flights and of possibly reversing zero-emission zones, including whether the climate minister was consulted and what the timeline is. The government said the decision is still pending in 2025, that an updated environmental impact report will assess CO2 emissions and be submitted to parliament, and that the zero-emission zone reduction was estimated at 1 Mton CO2 per year from 2030.

Once there is clarity on a definitive planning of these products, the House will be informed about the decision-making steps. The role of parliament is (also) safeguarded through the pre-submission procedure.
Zodra er zicht is op een definitieve planning van deze producten wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de besluitvormingsstappen. De rol van het parlement is (ook) via de voorhangprocedure geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over het bericht dat laadpalen langs de snelwegen worden verwijderd

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why charging points on motorway service areas are being removed, arguing that a temporary policy rule holds back entrepreneurs and conflicts with the energy transition and EU obligations. The Minister replies that the temporary rule is a bridge to a new policy, that charging points have grown 40% and removals concern only a few contested permits, and that no decision on the new policy or extension has yet been taken.
A decision on the new policy for service areas and on extending the temporary policy rule has not yet been taken.
Een besluit over het nieuwe beleid voor verzorgingsplaatsen en het verlengen van de tijdelijke beleidsregel is nog niet genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over een onvolledige reactie op zorgen van SchipholWatch

MP Kostić asks the minister why her reply to SchipholWatch's August letter on health, liveability and legal protection around Schiphol was incomplete, and requests a full answer before the aviation debate. The minister says the letter will be addressed in a reactienota expected end of October, and that the Chamber will be informed then, without answering the seven points on substance now.
The reactienota is expected to be ready at the end of October, after which the Chamber will be informed.
Naar verwachting is deze reactienota eind oktober gereed, waarna de Kamer wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

Three D66 MPs asked the government about reports of systematic Russian espionage and sabotage preparation in the North Sea, including legal options, coordination, protection measures, AIS switch-offs and oversight. The government answered that the threat is current, cited new protection measures and international cooperation, but declined to share intelligence assessments, case numbers or diplomatic communications.
The cabinet does not make public statements about the knowledge level, methods or sources of the MIVD and AIVD.

Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (MIVD) en de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over krimp van luchtvaart en bescherming van burgers, gezondheid, natuur en klimaat

Rep. Kostić (PvdD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the reversal of Schiphol flight-cap reductions, alleged pressure on civil servants, exclusion of residents and health experts, consistency with court rulings, and climate obligations. The Minister answered at length, defending the revised noise-reduction package, the new flight-movement bandwidth, the consultation process, and planned monitoring, while largely restating the procedural framework.
To follow up on the RBV judgment, the balanced approach procedure (BA) will be continued.
Om opvolging te geven aan het RBV-vonnis wordt de balanced approach-procedure (BA) verder doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´ en De Hoop over het rapport «Groei zonder winst»

Two MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the report 'Groei zonder winst' on Schiphol's growth strategy and Lelystad Airport, and about an ESB article on aviation costs, including whether the social costs of aviation exceed its benefits. The minister rejects the report's conclusions, argues that Schiphol's hub and connectivity are significant economic benefits, and points to a planned distance-based flight tax from 2027 and a decision on Lelystad Airport in 2025.
The government programme provides that the decision on opening Lelystad Airport to commercial civil aviation will take place in 2025.
In het regeerprogramma is opgenomen dat besluitvorming over de opening van Lelystad Airport voor de commerciële burgerluchtvaart in 2025 plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoop over het beperken van de beloofde krimp van Schiphol

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the late delivery of new aircraft could affect Schiphol's noise ceilings, who bears the risk of late delivery, whether KLM or Schiphol can be cut in flights, and what sanctions apply if sector measures fail. The minister answered that agreements with KLM and Schiphol are still being negotiated, that failure could trigger a new balanced approach procedure, that sanctions are an option, and that the effect will be monitored for a year.

As also shared in the letter of 4 September, failing to reach the noise target may in the extreme case mean a new balanced approach procedure must be started to ensure the noise target is still achieved.

Zoals ook in de Kamerbrief van 4 september gedeeld kan het niet halen van het geluidsdoel in het uiterste geval betekenen dat er een nieuwe balanced approach-procedure moet worden gestart om te borgen dat het geluidsdoel alsnog wordt gehaald.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Palmen, Ceder en White n.a.v. Beleidsreactie ACOI-rapport over de openbaarheid van de Bijlmervliegramp-stukken en het feit dat openbaarheid jaren op zich laat wachten door vertra

MPs Jansen, Palmen, Ceder and White asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Bijlmer air disaster archive remains largely closed years after the 2023 motion and why the government is commissioning external studies before acting on the ACOI recommendations. The minister defends the sequencing as driven by scarce expertise and procedure, outlines timelines and planned studies, and says access to the audio material was delayed by equipment and digitisation needs.
The aim is to have the study on recommendation 4 completed in the first quarter of 2025.
Het streven is het onderzoek naar aanbeveling 4 in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Rooderkerk, Podt en Bamenga over het schrappen van het Nationaal Programma Landelijk Gebied (NPLG)

MPs from D66 asked whether the National Programme for the Rural Area (NPLG) remains government policy, what the quantitative effects of scrapping it are on climate, nature, and Water Framework Directive goals, and how alternative measures and the decision-making process were handled. The minister answers that the cabinet is ending the NPLG in favour of an implementation-focused, area-specific approach with contours due by year-end, while stating that the international targets stay in place, and that scrapping was agreed in inter-ministerial consultation and in the Regeerprogramma.
As a cabinet we are taking a different course and ending the NPLG, as the draft had been adopted by the previous caretaker cabinet.
Als kabinet slaan we een andere koers in en stoppen met het NPLG, zoals dat als ontwerp nog door het vorige demissionaire kabinet was vastgesteld.
Antwoord op de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Chinese luchtvaartmaatschappijen stunten met goedkope vliegtickets op de Europese markt omdat zij over Rusland kunnen blijven vliegen.’

D66 MPs asked whether Chinese and other non-EU airlines flying over Russia gain cost advantages over EU carriers, whether this poses a safety risk, and whether the government will restrict such overflights or seek EU or ICAO action. The minister confirmed these airlines use Russian airspace and an unfair advantage is possible, but said EU law does not allow banning them, that non-discriminatory charges are barred under the Chicago Convention, and that ICAO cannot impose such sanctions.
However, it turns out that it is legally not possible to prohibit airlines from countries that may still operate via Russian airspace from conducting flights to and from the European Union (EU).

Het blijkt echter juridisch niet mogelijk om luchtvaartmaatschappijen uit landen die nog wel via het Russisch luchtruim mogen opereren te verbieden om vluchten van en naar de Europese Unie (EU) uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Peter de Groot en Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Brug Uitwellingerga niet meer bediend voor de scheepvaart»

MPs Peter de Groot and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Uitwellingerga bridge no longer being operated for shipping, its maintenance history, expected duration, economic effects and compensation. The minister answered all eleven questions on substance, stating the closure duration is not yet known, that the bridge deteriorated faster than expected, and that a general hardship compensation scheme applies while no separate scheme was opened.
Before the start of the sailing season (April 2025), Rijkswaterstaat will provide more clarity.
Voor de start van het vaarseizoen (april 2025) zal Rijkswaterstaat meer duidelijkheid te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht ''Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is''

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the government's climate policy suffices to meet the 2030 targets in mobility, and about the emission effects of the lower fuel excise, higher motorway speed, delayed zero-emission zones and road pricing. The State Secretary answered that the effects can only be assessed in the Klimaat- en Energieverkenning due 24 October, that additional policy will be considered in spring 2025 if needed, and that the fuel excise cut is not newly analysed.
From this it will become clear whether additional policy is needed to achieve the climate targets for mobility.
Hieruit zal blijken of aanvullend beleid nodig is om de klimaatdoelstellingen voor mobiliteit te behalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de uitspraak dat immigranten honden en katten eten

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether his claim that immigrants eat pets was nuanced, whether it is government policy or whether he distances himself, and asked for answers before the budget debate. The minister rejected the suggestion, said he cannot rule out that some people have eaten pets, stated this is not government policy, and agreed to answer before the budget debate.
The suggestion that is being created is incorrect and I firmly reject it.
De suggestie die wordt gewekt klopt niet en werp ik verre van mij.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel van de NRC 'Hoe PVV’er Barry Madlener in zijn eerste weken als minister van Infrastructuur de voorgenomen krimp van Schiphol terug liet draaien'

An MP asked how the Schiphol flight-cap increase to 475,000–485,000 movements was decided, who was consulted, and how civil servants' integrity and residents' trust are affected. The minister answered that an additional consultation ran in 2024, about ten meetings with sector parties and advisers were held, civil servants advised with noted risks, residents' concerns were acknowledged, and the decision notes were already shared with the Chamber.
The underlying relevant decision notes have, in line with the existing practice, already been shared with the Chamber on 4 September.
De onderliggende relevante beslisnota’s zijn conform de bestaande lijn reeds met de Kamer gedeeld op 4 september jl.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over Het RIVM-onderzoek ter onderbouwing van het Europese PFAS restrictievoorstel en het bericht: Advies aangescherpt: speel niet in zeeschuim, maar strandganger weet van niets

An MP asks the ministers about the RIVM study underpinning the EU PFAS restriction proposal, whether municipalities and environmental services have legal grounds to curb PFAS emissions, revision obligations, the precedent of court rulings, and the late and narrow public advice on PFAS in sea foam. The government answers that the RIVM report is a building block for permit decisions, that existing duties of care and permit revision apply, that a guidance document is coming in autumn, and that the advice is unchanged with clarifications added on the website and app.

However, this report can be used as a building block to substantiate individual decisions on tightening permits or imposing tailor-made requirements to ultimately bring PFAS (and much of F-gas) emissions down to zero.

Wel kan dit rapport als bouwsteen worden gebruikt voor de onderbouwing van individuele besluiten over het aanscherpen van vergunningen of het opleggen van maatwerkvoorschriften om emissies van PFAS (en een groot deel van de F-gassen) uiteindelijk naar nul terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de situatie in Sluiskil.

An MP asks the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat is liable for groundwater flooding in Sluiskil, whether the damage is really due to homes rather than the state, whether residents can be compensated, and whether the damwanden were deep enough. The minister answers that Rijkswaterstaat is not legally liable, that causes are mixed including housing age, that a joint drainage programme with the municipality is planned, and that no new legal basis for compensation is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het onteigenen van grond om een betere waterkwaliteit te bereiken

Pierik (BBB) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about expropriating land to improve water quality, including whether land can be expropriated when the pollution source lies abroad or has no proven link to the land, and about Belgian sewer overflows affecting the Mark. The minister answered that expropriation is legally possible under the Omgevingswet only with a justified reason and urgency, that the government is not a proponent of compulsory expropriation except in extreme necessity, and that transboundary pollution is raised bilaterally and via river commissions.
Expropriation can only take place if there is a justified reason for it.
Onteigenen kan alleen plaatsvinden als hier een gegronde reden voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het maatschappelijk manifest voor schoon en voldoende water voor mens en natuur

MP Kostić asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a civil-society manifesto calling for clean, sufficient and affordable water, and about the government's ability to meet Water Framework Directive goals by 2027, including licensing, costs and the Commission's infringement procedure. The minister said the approach is supported, that the government will reconsider specific manifesto points after the 2025 budget, and that it is unlikely all WFD targets will be met by 2027, while outlining planned licence reviews, a pending law change on indefinite permits, and a future Ctgb framework for pesticide authorisation.
European infringement procedures are strictly confidential.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel “Geen DDA vluchten meer in 2025”

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the end of Dakota flights in 2025 due to the EU lead-fuel ban and general aviation fleet impacts. The minister answered that the ban is EU regulation, no exemption is possible, aviation safety is not affected once certified, and the government awaits the ECHA decision on the request.
This concerns European regulation that applies to all EU member states.
Het betreft hier Europese regelgeving die voor alle EU-lidstaten geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het vernattingsbeleid van de duinstreek van Noord- en Zuid-Holland

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the nature-oriented dune water management policy, which may have caused flooding, should be revised after heavy rainfall, whether residents can be told to waterproof cellars, and why the consultation with the water boards is not brought forward. The minister denied that a national 'vernattingsbeleid' exists, attributed the flooding to an exceptionally wet period, placed responsibility on local and regional water managers and residents, and said no structural measures are yet decided.
However, there is no 'national waterlogging policy' for the dunes and therefore no possibility of revising it.
Er bestaat echter geen «landelijk vernattingsbeleid» voor de duinen en daardoor ook geen mogelijkheid tot herziening ervan.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht «Griekse vliegvakantie eindigt voor Nederlanders in nachtmerrie: «Paniek, huilen, flauwvallen en reanimatie»

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how she views a reported incident in which Dutch passengers were held for a long time in a Greek aircraft cabin after a technical defect, and whether airlines should be obliged to provide acceptable cabin conditions, replacement aircraft, a maximum waiting time, or European rules. The minister acknowledged the situation was unpleasant, said no specific Dutch or EU rule sets a maximum time aboard, and promised talks with airlines and airports and raising the point at a future EU Transport Council.
Several regular conversations are taking place from the ministry with airlines and umbrella organisations.
Er lopen vanuit het ministerie verschillende reguliere gesprekken met luchtvaartmaatschappijen en koepelorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en White over extreem hoge ticketprijzen voor vliegreizen naar Suriname

MPs De Hoop and White asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why flights to Suriname are two to four times pricier than to Aruba and other Caribbean destinations, whether cartel behaviour or extra costs explain this, and how the government will protect a network serving diaspora travellers. The minister replied that airlines set fares commercially, that the competition authority ACM previously found no excessive pricing, that the ministry has no indication of abuse of dominance and little power to intervene under the bilateral agreement, and that it will push for more steering on public interests like network quality in EU rules.
The ministry will work to achieve more steering of public interests, such as network quality, when the relevant EU laws and regulations are revised.
Het ministerie zal zich inzetten voor meer sturing op publieke belangen, zoals netwerkkwaliteit, bij de herziening van de hiervoor relevante EU wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de startdatum van de werkzaamheden aan het Julianakanaal

An MP asked the minister why a second opinion on the Julianakanaal works was commissioned, whether its interim results would be shared, why work starts before final results, and why the extra budget was not communicated earlier. The minister answered that the second opinion covered the chosen method and costs, that final results are now attached with an implementation plan, that the start is justified by interim findings, and that the cost increase arose from failed foil tests in late May and was communicated promptly.
The final results are now available. These results are included as an annex to this letter.
De eindresultaten zijn inmiddels beschikbaar. Deze resultaten zijn als bijlage bij deze brief opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘dat de Nederlandse Kustwacht de sancties tegen Rusland niet uitvoert’

An MP asked whether the Dutch Coast Guard has for over a year refused to enforce new EU sanctions against Russia, whether this undermines the sanctions packages, and what capacity and enforcement steps are planned. The minister denies any refusal, explains that capacity limits led to prioritising packages 1 to 10 and interim arrangements for package 11, and outlines reorganisation, extra analysts and EU-level tools.
There is no question of the Coast Guard refusing.
Er is geen sprake van weigering door de Kustwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´ en Teunissen over dierlijk vet in biobrandstof

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about animal fat used in biofuel, its links to intensive livestock farming, palmoil deforestation and fraud in imported used cooking oil. The state secretary answered that the fat is a low-value waste product, that limits apply and that Dutch oversight by independent certifiers and the Netherlands Emissions Authority is robust, while promising to press the Commission on inspections in Asia.
The Netherlands has a robust system that oversees the supply chain of biofuels.
Nederland staat voor een robuust systeem dat toeziet op de toeleveringsketen van biobrandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Gabriels over het bericht 'Advies aangescherpt: speel niet in zeeschuim, maar strandganger weet van niets'

Two Green Left-PvdA MPs asked why the government quietly clarified its advice to avoid swallowing sea foam, why no warning signs were placed on beaches, and how PFAS contamination will be addressed. The minister answered that the advice was only clarified, not tightened, that signs are reserved for acute dangers, that economic motives played no role, and that the topic will be raised at the October national bathing water consultation.
This will be discussed at the next national bathing water consultation in October.
Dit zal ter sprake komen in het volgende landelijk zwemwateroverleg in oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat zeeschuim onveilig is door vervuiling met PFAS

An SP MP asked the government about news that sea foam is unsafe due to PFAS pollution, including whether beach visitors were informed of tightened advice, what warnings were issued, and whether PFAS production should be halted and damages recovered from polluters. The minister replied that the advice is unchanged apart from clarifying wording, that no warning signs were placed, that producers cannot yet be identified, and that a full production stop is rejected in favour of a broad EU ban.
The advice on PFAS in sea foam is unchanged.
Het advies omtrent PFAS in zeeschuim is ongewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kahraman over de implementatie van de sanctiepakketten tegen Rusland

MPs Omtzigt and Kahraman asked the ministers about the implementation of the EU sanctions packages against Russia, including whether the Coast Guard enforces them, and whether any sanctions go unenforced or incompletely implemented. The minister answered at length that all sanctions are nationally implemented via the Sanctieregeling, that the government aims for strict compliance, that the Coast Guard was agreed to prioritise packages 1 to 10 given limited capacity with alternatives found for later packages, and that implementation is a national matter with no formal notice from the Commission.
The cabinet's starting point is strict compliance with all sanctions, and the cabinet therefore does not share the view that there are measures that are not enforced.
Uitgangspunt van het kabinet is het strikt naleven van alle sancties, en het kabinet deelt dus ook niet het beeld dat er maatregelen zijn die niet gehandhaafd worden.
Antwoord op op de vragen van de leden De Hoop en Chakor over het bericht: 'Schepen varen straks zonder schipper op de Waddenzee: realiteit is dichterbij dan je denkt'

MPs De Hoop and Chakor asked the minister about reports that ships may sail the Wadden Sea without a skipper, including who is responsible, whether unmanned navigation is lawful, liability, and assistance duties. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat is the nautical authority, that a skipper must currently be aboard, that experiments are allowed under a policy rule and an exemption is planned for 1 January 2025, and that liability and safety will be addressed case by case.
The ministry is currently working on this exemption possibility.
Het ministerie werkt momenteel aan deze ontheffingsmogelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de startdatum van de werkzaamheden aan het Julianakanaal

An MP asked the minister whether the planned start of works closing the Julianakanaal on 12 August 2024 complies with a parliamentary motion requiring the Borgharen weir to be fully functional first, and what the status of those works and the protection of canal users is. The minister answers that the weir is restored enough for works to start on 12 August, that alternative routes remain available, and describes the status of works and stakeholder communication.
The Borgharen weir has been restored to such an extent that works on the Julianakanaal can start on 12 August.
De stuw Borgharen is dusdanig hersteld dat op 12 augustus gestart kan worden met de werkzaamheden op het Julianakanaal.
