An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about municipal job postings that let candidates choose between secondment or self-employment, and the risk of bogus self-employment this creates. The minister said the government sees a risk if the same work is done identically by a freelancer and an employee, but no central data exist on how many municipalities comply, and points to existing awareness campaigns, Belastingdienst enforcement and VNG guidance.
The cabinet considers it very important that the national government sets a good example in tackling bogus self-employment
Het kabinet vindt het van groot belang dat de rijksoverheid het goede voorbeeld geeft als het gaat om de aanpak van schijnzelfstandigheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Dijk en Patijn over de Kamerbrief 'Informeren over bouwplaats ID en over inhoudingen op het minimumloon,' d.d. 30 oktober 2025 (kenmerk: 2025-0000214845)

MPs Saris, Dijk and Patijn asked why the minister abandoned the planned phase-out of deductions from the minimum wage for housing, given the migration goal, the Labour Inspectorate's warnings about abuse and the Aanjaagteam recommendations. The minister answered that the 25% cap stays because abolition would currently harm migrant workers more, and pointed to consultation, the Wet Goed Verhuurderschap and planned measures, answering all twelve questions in substance.
The cabinet has therefore decided that employers may for the time being continue to charge up to 25% of the statutory minimum wage for housing costs.
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten dat werkgevers vooralsnog maximaal 25% van het Wettelijk minimumloon in rekening mogen blijven brengen voor huisvestingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn, Saris en Dijk over het besluit de inhoudingsregeling voor huisvesting op het minimumloon van arbeidsmigranten in stand te houden

MPs Patijn, Saris and Dijk asked why Minister Paul decided within two weeks of taking office to keep the wage-deduction scheme for housing from the minimum wage for migrant workers, which the ministry had planned to phase out, and with whom he had discussed it. The minister answered that he made an independent decision based on the ministry's exploratory review, that employer and union bodies were consulted earlier in that review, and that the only later contact was a briefing to the Stichting van de Arbeid under embargo, with the rest of the answers repeating that no other conversations took place.
On 28 August my ministry received a copy of a letter sent by VNO-NCW/MKB-Nederland to members of the House of Representatives.
Op 28 augustus heeft mijn ministerie een kopie ontvangen van een brief die door VNO-NCW/MKB-Nederland is verzonden aan leden van de Tweede Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Patijn over het FNV-rapport “De problemen op Schiphol”

Two MPs (De Hoop and Patijn, GroenLinks-PvdA) asked eight questions about an FNV report on working conditions at Schiphol, including exposure to hazardous substances, workload, staff turnover, and the duty to ensure safe conditions. State Secretary Nobel answered that employers including Schiphol are responsible for safe working conditions, that the Arbeidsinspectie monitors progress, and that the government will raise the issue in regular consultations, while declining to impose specific obligations on Schiphol.
As State Secretary, I cannot impose obligations or measures on specific companies, as you intend in your question.
Als Staatssecretaris kan ik geen verplichtingen of maatregelen opleggen aan specifieke bedrijven, zoals u in uw vraag bedoelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de opbouw van vakantiedagen tijdens ziekte

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a court ruling extending holiday accrual to employees in a dormant employment contract is compatible with EU law, and whether the law will be amended. The minister answered that Dutch law is not contrary to EU law, that the directive concerns work or wage periods, and that no legislative change is planned.
The cabinet does not believe that the provisions on the accrual of holiday in Dutch legislation conflict with European law.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat de bepalingen over de opbouw van vakantie in Nederlandse wetgeving in strijd zijn met Europees recht.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Patijn over het artikel Groot deel bedrijven houdt zich al decennia niet aan wettelijke plicht medezeggenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why about 30 percent of companies legally required to have a works council do not establish one, and why Dutch law lacks public enforcement while Belgium and France have it. The minister confirmed the non-compliance, said enforcement is left to private law and that adding public sanctions is not being considered, while a broader package to improve compliance will be sent to parliament by year-end.
At this moment this is not being considered.
Op dit moment wordt dit niet overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Patijn en Bikkers over borging van de regionale scholingsfondsen

MPs Saris, Patijn and Bikkers asked the Minister of Social Affairs about structural funding for regional training funds such as Twente and Achterhoek, the complexity of the SLIM subsidy scheme, unused SLIM funds, and the status of the Lifelong Development agenda. The minister acknowledged their value, said structural funding is still being explored and that no money is available for it, and promised a letter on the LLO agenda by year-end.
There are no funds available for structural funding, so a bridge to structural funding is not realistic.
Er zijn geen middelen beschikbaar voor structurele borging, waardoor een overbrugging naar structurele borging niet reëel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het uitfaseren van WBS

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the phase-out of the shared vacancy system WBS, without a functional replacement, breaches the statutory cooperation duty between UWV, SVB and municipalities. The minister denied a breach, stating that a data-exchange alternative (VUM) exists, that CRM functions stay in place until a replacement is ready, and that UWV and VNG provide support.
No. The cooperation obligation applies to services to job seekers and employers. It does not oblige UWV to make an IT system available to municipalities.
Nee. De samenwerkingsverplichting geldt voor de dienstverlening aan werkzoekenden en werkgevers. Het verplicht UWV niet om een IT-systeem beschikbaar te stellen aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Patijn over interim-salarissen in de publieke sector

MPs Mohandis and Patijn asked how interim executives in the public sector can combine several assignments to evade the WNT pay cap, and whether the rules should change. The minister says the WNT is not being circumvented, commits to investigating whether the situation recurs and, if so, to proposing an extension of the anti-cumulation rule to interim managers, and explains the enforcement roles of the Tax Authority and supervisory bodies.
Following this case, the Minister of BZK will have it investigated whether the situation described occurs or has occurred more often.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus zal de Minister van BZK laten onderzoeken of de beschreven situatie zich vaker voordoet of heeft voorgedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Patijn en Vijlbrief over de kabinetsreactie op de verkenning wettelijk minimumjeugdloon en het artikel Van Hijum kritisch op aangenomen Kamermotie over minimumjeugdloon

MPs Dassen, Patijn and Vijlbrief asked why the government delays the youth minimum wage increase to 1 January 2027 and rejects the adopted motion's 2026 timing, funding sources and steeper staffel. The minister answers that 2026 is not feasible due to AMvB procedures, that the motion lacks sound funding, and that the chosen staffel (62.5%-75%-87.5%) reflects policy considerations.
The cabinet has decided not to implement the motion at this time.
Het kabinet heeft besloten de motie op dit moment niet uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Haage over de achterstanden van kinderen van Europese arbeidsmigranten en de financiering van scholen

MPs Patijn and Haage ask the government about funding shortfalls for schools with many children of Eastern European labour migrants, whose weighting under the disadvantage-funding model is seen as inadequate, and about reviewing the model. The State Secretary says the CBS is recalibrating the disadvantage indicator, expected to be in use in 2027, and that the funding model is not the solution for family instability caused by economic hardship.
It illustrates the need to periodically recalibrate the indicator used for educational disadvantage.
Het illustreert de noodzaak om de gebruikte indicator voor onderwijsachterstanden periodiek te herijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het bericht dat Online-supermarkten bijval krijgen van ACM

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the ACM's letter on online supermarkets and competition sits well with the collective labour agreement exemption and the AVV framework, and how the pending dispensation request will be handled after a court ruling. The minister replies that the ACM acts independently, that the minister decides the dispensation on its own legal assessment, that the procedure must be followed carefully without prejudging the outcome, and that a broader review of the cao and AVV system will be reported after the summer.
It is important that this process is carefully followed through and I cannot anticipate the outcome.
Het is belangrijk dat dit proces zorgvuldig wordt doorlopen en ik kan niet op de uitkomst vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Westerveld over de voortgang van een passende zorgverlofregeling voor ouders van ernstig zieke kinderen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the ministers about progress on a motion requiring a suitable leave scheme for parents of seriously ill children, and about the lack of paid care leave and financial hardship. The minister says an exploration with stakeholders is underway, results expected this autumn, and acknowledges the difficult situation without committing to specific substance.
This autumn I expect to be able to inform your House further about this exploration.
Dit najaar verwacht ik uw Kamer verder te kunnen informeren over deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Patijn, Bikker en Saris over de vertraging van het UWV-onderzoek naar de beoordeling van post-COVID-patiënten

MPs asked why the UWV study into how post-COVID patients were assessed for WIA benefits was delayed, and what is being done about knowledge gaps among insurance physicians and the duration-capacity standard. The minister acknowledged the delay, said the study is expected to finish in September, outlined a handbook and casuistry being developed with the NVVG, and rejected the view that the problem is structurally underestimated.
I regret that the study has been delayed.
Ik betreur dat het onderzoek vertraging heeft opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het opleggen van een sectoraal uitzendverbod aan de vlees-en pluimveesector

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about progress twelve months after the June 2024 meeting with the meat and poultry sector on stopping malafide temporary employment agencies, and about the planned sectoral temporary-agency ban by AMvB. The minister acknowledges that misconduct persists despite sector measures, that the sector is not improving sufficiently, and that preparing the AMvB will take about twelve months, while keeping it as a backstop.
I will therefore also prepare and work out the AMvB so that the cabinet can intervene.
Ik ga daarom ook de amvb voorbereiden en uitwerken zodat het kabinet kan ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn, Van der Lee en Stultiens over de gevolgen van toenemende robotisering voor werkgelegenheid en belastinginkomsten

Greens-Labour MPs asked whether the government sees Mercedes and BMW testing humanoid robots as a sign of labour market change, whether research and tax-base scenarios on robotisation exist, and whether alternative taxes such as a robot tax should be explored. The minister answered that automation is a continuing structural trend rather than a sudden shift, pointed to labour market reforms and lifelong learning plans, and said uncertainty is large, so the tax system should be robust and simple, citing ongoing box 3 and tax reforms.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Van Kent over de afgesloten cao IKEA met de bedrijfsbond WIM

MPs Patijn and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the IKEA collective agreement with the company union WIM, including strikes by FNV members, a narrow 50.3% vote, and whether the union is independent of the employer and compliant with ILO Convention 98. The minister declined to judge the specific case, stated that the Netherlands is reviewing the independence of unions as part of a broader exploration of the cao system, and said no grounds exist to declare the agreement invalid if legal requirements are met.
I have therefore entered into discussions with social partners and other stakeholders and am including this point in the further elaboration of the exploration.
Daarom ben ik hierover met sociale partners en andere stakeholders in gesprek gegaan en neem ik dit punt mee met de verdere uitwerking van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over plannen van de Europese Commissie om de rechten van gedetacheerde werknemers in te perken in het kader van de 'Single Market Strategy'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU plans to harmonise certificates for posted and temporary-agency work could weaken the Dutch Wtta licensing regime and create loopholes. The minister acknowledged the Single Market Strategy, said it was too early to judge the effects, warned that applying the Wtta to foreign agencies is essential, and committed to raising the issue with the Commission and to a BNC-fiche.
I consider it important that the Wtta can be introduced without delay and that its level of protection is not undermined, in the short or long term.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de Wtta zonder vertraging kan worden ingevoerd en dat het beschermingsniveau daarvan – op de korte of lange termijn – niet ondermijnd wordt.
Antwoord op Vragen van leden Dassen en Patijn over het rapport ‘Verkenning wettelijk minimumjeugdloon’ en de rapportage van onderzoeksbureau Blauw ‘Jongeren en het minimumjeugdloon’

MPs Dassen and Patijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the report on the statutory youth minimum wage and the Blauw interview study with young workers, including its justification, cost, evidence on employment and schooling, and consistency with EU adequacy rules. The minister answered that the cabinet will reconsider the youth minimum wage, reserved funds in the Voorjaarsnota 2025 for raising rates for ages 16 to 20, and will send a cabinet response before the summer recess, with some follow-up data still to be produced.
The cabinet sees reason to substantively reconsider the youth minimum wage.
Het kabinet ziet aanleiding voor inhoudelijke heroverweging van het minimumjeugdloon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de premiestelling en fondsen van werknemersverzekeringen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about how contribution rates and funds for employee insurance schemes are set, how they have developed over time, and whether premiums serve purposes beyond covering costs. The minister explained that UWV sets the Whk premium while the cabinet sets the Aof, Awf and Ufo premiums within the income framework, and provided figures on fund income, expenditure, differentiation and reserves.
UWV sets the height of the Whk premium. The cabinet sets the height of the other three premiums.
Het UWV stelt de hoogte van de Whk-premie vast. Het kabinet stelt de hoogte van de andere drie premies vast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over nieuwe fouten bij het UWV

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about new errors at UWV affecting WIA and Ziektewet benefits, including how and when they were discovered, the amounts and numbers of people affected, and why problems keep surfacing piecemeal. The minister answered that UWV found the indexation errors in late 2024, that the affected people are being analysed with results expected later that month, that the errors also affect the Ziektewet, and that he will report in the next progress letter.
I will inform you about this in the next progress letter on UWV's improvement approach.
Hierover zal ik u informeren in de volgende voortgangsbrief over de verbeteraanpak van UWV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de opbouw van de reservering van 1,2 miljard voor arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkeringen

MP Patijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the basis for a reported 1.2 billion euro reservation for disability benefit (WIA) errors, the scope of affected beneficiaries, and related correction operations. The minister said she does not recognise the 1.2 billion figure, cannot pre-empt spring budget decisions, and promised to inform parliament in April on UWV's review of benefit errors, with 43,000 cases to be individually checked.
I will inform your House about the outcome of that review in April, with the ambition of doing so before the parliamentary debate on the WIA problems on 16 April.
Over het resultaat van dat onderzoek informeer ik uw Kamer in april, waarbij het mijn ambitie is om dat te doen voor het Kamerdebat WIA-problematiek van 16 april.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Patijn over een winterstop bij Transavia op kosten van UWV

MPs De Hoop and Patijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Transavia's 46-6 flexible contracts, under which cabin crew receive no pay for six winter weeks and may claim WW unemployment benefit at UWV's expense, including whether this amounts to fossil subsidy, state aid, misuse, and how it can be curbed. The minister answered that the arrangement is legal and open to any employer, that KLM as shareholder is responsible for labour terms, and that the planned Meer zekerheid flexwerkers bill will ban zero-hour on-call contracts from 2027, which would end this construction; the answers are partly evasive on Transavia-specific data.
I have no information about Transavia's workforce.
Ik heb geen informatie over het personeelsbestand van Transavia.
Op verzoek van het lid Patijn zijn de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht ‘Ombudsman onderzoekt perikelen pgb’ ingetrokken

MP Patijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that many care providers received no PGB payments from the SVB in January due to administrative problems, the Ombudsman's finding that these issues were not quickly resolved, and the effect of proposed SVB budget cuts. The questions were withdrawn at the MP's request, so no government answers were given.
At the request of MP Patijn (GroenLinks-PvdA), the written questions to the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the report 'Ombudsman investigates PGB troubles' have been withdrawn.

Op verzoek van het lid Patijn (GroenLinks-PvdA) zijn de schriftelijke vragen aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Ombudsman onderzoekt perikelen pgb» zijn ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over bezuinigingen op de uitvoering van de sociale zekerheid

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the exact scope and distribution of the 22% budget cut on social security implementation agencies, including an extra 34 million cut via the education deal and whether UWV's recovery operation will be affected. The Minister replies that the allocation is still under discussion and will be communicated with the spring memorandum, though the cut is explicitly linked to the Hoofdlijnenakkoord's promise to spare implementation.
The Chamber will be informed about this with the spring memorandum.
Bij voorjaarsnota wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de handhaving van schijnzelfstandigheid

An MP asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers how enforcement against sham self-employment (schijnzelfstandigheid) will differ in 2024, 2025 and 2026, and why fines are waived for 2025 even in cases of bad faith or evident sham self-employment. The state secretary explains the lifting of the enforcement moratorium, the no-fines rule for 2025 (following a motion), continued enforcement via audits and visits, and the extension of model contracts to end-2029.
Following the Flach-Aartsen motion, no administrative fines will be imposed for 2025.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Flach-Aartsen 5 worden over 2025 geen bestuurlijke boetes opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de extra bezuinigingen op SZW als gevolg van de 'onderwijsdeal'

Patijn (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the extra 34 million euro cut to the SZW budget from the education deal, how it will be filled, how much falls on UWV, SVB and the Labour Inspectorate and whether FTE will be lost, and how this fits the coalition pledge to protect implementing bodies. Minister Van Hijum confirmed the cut, said the allocation is not yet decided and will be communicated around the spring memorandum, and noted that the implementing bodies were included in the basis for the cut while promising to weigh the importance of implementation.
As soon as a decision has been made on the allocation, the House will be informed as quickly as possible, probably with the spring memorandum.
Zodra besloten is over de invulling wordt de kamer zo snel mogelijk hierover geïnformeerd, waarschijnlijk bij voorjaarsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over overwerktoeslag voor deeltijdwerkers

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about two EU Court of Justice rulings (2023 Lufthansa, 2024 Kuratorium) that treat overtime pay differences between part-time and full-time workers as potentially discriminatory, and whether this changes the Helmig doctrine, WW premium differentiation and Dutch law (art. 7:648 BW). The minister answered that the rulings clarify existing law, that objective justification must be assessed case by case with a high bar, that WW premiums are unaffected, and that no legislative change is needed.
Once there is more clarity on that, I will inform your House.
Zodra daar meer duidelijkheid is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Ceder en Patijn over het bericht 'Crisis UWV nog groter, ook missers bij mogelijk duizenden jonggehandicapten: 'Kommer en kwel''

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the ministry knew earlier of problems at UWV affecting Wajong disability benefit assessments, and whether it would commission independent research, extend the Court of Audit request, and address WW and Ziektewet. The minister answered that Wajong quality measurements were discontinued from 2020 so quality cannot be verified, promised further investigations, a letter on remedies, and a check on WW and Ziektewet, but declined to commit to an Algemene Rekenkamer investigation until ongoing studies finish.
Unfortunately, quality measurements were scaled down from 2020 onward, and it is now insufficiently clear how the quality of Wajong assessments stands, because it is not traceable.
Helaas zijn de kwaliteitsmetingen vanaf 2020 afgeschaald en is het nu onvoldoende duidelijk hoe het is gesteld met de kwaliteit van de Wajong-beoordelingen, omdat dit niet navolgbaar is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de uitspraak van de CRvB dat er sprake is van discriminatie vanwege handicap bij de berekening van het dagloon van de WIA, waarbij de loonloze tijdvakken in de WIA wel meegeteld

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs how the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling on WIA daily wage calculation for unpaid periods, which it found discriminatory on grounds of disability, will be implemented, including who is affected, the financial impact, and UWV's capacity to correct past benefits. The minister answers that a plan to revise existing WIA benefits is being drafted with UWV, that the government will inform parliament later this year, and that the budget impact will be dealt with in the spring 2025 budget decision.
I aim to inform your House about this later this year.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer later dit jaar hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het bericht 'Al 18 jaar gaat UWV de fout in: massale controle van zeker 53.000 dossiers wacht op groen licht'

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that UWV had made errors in WIA daily wage indexation for 18 years, requiring review of about 53,000 files, and when the problem was known and what was done. The Minister confirmed awareness since August 2023, explained the cause, estimated 2,500-3,000 files needing correction, and described a pilot starting by October 2024 and fuller correction in 2025.
UWV intends to start a pilot of the remediation action by October 2024 at the latest, for the indexation moments of 1 January 2020 and 1 January 2014, to test the intended approach.
UWV is voornemens om uiterlijk in oktober 2024 te starten met een pilot van de herstelactie voor het indexatiemoment 1 januari 2020 en 1 januari 2014 om de beoogde werkwijze te testen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het inburgeringsexamen in het buitenland

An MP asks the State Secretary about the pre-departure civic integration exam abroad, including its effectiveness, its compatibility with international anti-discrimination treaties, and plans if courts rule against it. The government reports exam volumes, evaluation findings, that it appealed the Haarlem court ruling to the Council of State, and that it will decide on consequences only after that ruling.
I do not want to anticipate the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitspraak van de Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op van de leden Bushoff en Patijn over het bericht ‘Erkenning van longcovid voor WIA-uitkering gaat vaak mis: “Beoordeling bij driekwart van de patiënten onvoldoende”

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked whether incorrectly prepared long-COVID WIA disability assessments by UWV, reported as unsound in about 75% of a preliminary sample, are acceptable and what remedies exist. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the sample is not representative, announced a follow-up study by UWV expected by year-end, and outlined training and capacity measures, while not committing to reopening decisions.
Because the preliminary study is not a representative sample, UWV is starting a follow-up study.
Omdat het vooronderzoek geen representatieve steekproef betreft, start UWV een vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het moratorium om te handhaven op schijnzelfstandigheid

The MP asks how the state secretary's statement that amending labour law is a condition for lifting the enforcement moratorium on sham self-employment fits with earlier government positions on a three-track approach, and what delaying the labour-law amendment would mean for lifting the moratorium. The state secretary answers that enforcement proceeds in parallel tracks, that a clearer legal framework supports compliance, and that the government still intends to lift the moratorium on 1 January 2025 after impact assessments.
The cabinet has the ambition to fully lift the enforcement moratorium on 1 January 2025.
Het kabinet heeft de ambitie om het handhavingsmoratorium op 1 januari 2025 volledig op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Van Oostenbruggen over "regeling Tegemoetkoming Stoffengerelateerde Beroepsziekten (TSB)"

MPs Patijn and Van Oostenbruggen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about low uptake, high rejection rates and the evidentiary standard in the occupational disease compensation scheme (TSB), including patient involvement, diagnostics costs and the 'voorshands aannemelijk' test. The Minister acknowledges shortcomings, promises a patient advisory group, further improvement plans and a progress letter in the second half of 2024, while defending the evidentiary threshold and the non-liability nature of the scheme.
That is why I will set up a sounding board group that will also play a role in drafting new protocols that applications must meet.
Daarom ga ik een klankbordgroep instellen die ook een rol zal krijgen bij de opstelling van nieuwe protocollen waar aanvragen aan moeten voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over ‘schijnzelfstandigheid bij YoungOnes’

The MP asks how the planned permit regime for temporary labour will prevent false self-employment at YoungOnes, and what the Tax Authority has done after a letter flagging possible employer status. The minister answers that the Labour Inspectorate will focus on exposing such constructions and enforce against them, while the Tax Authority cannot comment on individual taxpayers and describes its general enforcement options, including a moratorium-based warning procedure.
The Labour Inspectorate will therefore, in its supervision and enforcement activities under the Temporary Agency Work Permit Act, pay attention to recognising and exposing sham constructions.

De Arbeidsinspectie zal daarom in haar toezichts- en handhavingsactiviteiten in het kader van de Wet toelating terbeschikkingstelling van arbeidskrachten aandacht hebben voor het onderkennen en blootleggen van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over AKW+

MP Patijn asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the AKW+ supplementary child benefit after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that excludes partners whose income is from benefits rather than current work, questioning fairness, the eligibility rules and simplification. The Minister acknowledges the impact and inconsistency between partners and single parents, and announces an exploratory review of the scheme's future, including its purpose, eligibility and possible simplification, without committing to specific legal changes now.
In response to your questions and because of the phasing out of the IACK, my ministry will carry out an exploration of the future viability of this allowance.
Naar aanleiding van uw vragen en vanwege de uitfasering van de IACK, zal mijn ministerie een verkenning uitvoeren naar de toekomstbestendigheid van deze tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op van het lid Patijn over de ontwikkeling van de AIQ

MP Patijn asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the decline of the labour income share (AIQ), its causes, historical trends, the SER's earlier 80% target, and policy options to raise it. The minister confirms the CEP 2024 lowered the forecast, attributes this mainly to productivity and terms-of-trade effects and wage revisions, and says wage recovery should continue while noting limited direct policy levers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over ‘onterecht niet verkregen ontslagvergoedingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that flex workers rarely receive transition payments (transitievergoedingen) to which they are entitled, and about monitoring and deadlines. The minister said employers must pay unless an exception applies, that the Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans will be evaluated in 2025 including payment compliance, and that the ministry cannot intervene in individual cases but workers can claim via information tools and the kantonrechter.
The evaluation will specifically examine awareness of the right to a transition payment, compliance with the obligation to pay it, its use, and whether it can be claimed.

Bij de evaluatie wordt specifiek aandacht besteed aan de bekendheid met (het recht op) de transitievergoeding, de naleving van de verplichting om een transitievergoeding te betalen, het gebruik van de transitievergoeding en de opeisbaarheid.
Antwoord op van het lid Patijn over het bericht “Duizenden truckers werken onder schrijnende omstandigheden: ‘Ik voel me als een hond aan de lijn’”

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about an academic article criticising the government's plan for homeless EU citizens, including its treatment of residence rights and the three-group categorisation. The state secretary largely rejected the critique, defended the plan as a clarification of EU-citizen rights, and committed to a rights tool and pilot projects while declining to seek an independent advisory opinion.

To achieve this, it was decided in consultation with municipalities to develop a practical rights tool to help municipalities better assess entitlements to shelter (under the Wmo 2015) of individual EU citizens.

Om dit te bewerkstelligen is in overleg met gemeenten besloten om een praktische rechtentool te ontwikkelen waarmee gemeenten beter in staat zouden moeten zijn om rechten op opvang (in het kader van de Wmo 2015) van individuele EU-burgers te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Kat en Van der Laan over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken

D66 MPs asked how young people can be protected from influencers who lure them into scams around match-fixing sports betting, including crypto flows, gambling-addiction protection, advertising oversight and cross-border enforcement. The minister answered that prevention campaigns, platform obligations and existing regulators (Ksa, ACM, AFM, Commissariaat voor de Media) cover the issue, and promised a campaign, a ministry review of labelling edited ads and a werkagenda by year-end.
As previously promised, the House will receive the work agenda by the end of this year, setting out ongoing and future activities on addiction prevention.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt de Kamer eind dit jaar de werkagenda waarin lopende en toekomstige activiteiten op het gebied van verslavingspreventie een plek krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Paulusma over het bericht '4 op de 10 mensen met laag inkomen verwachten problemen met betalen van zorgverzekering

MPs Kat and Paulusma asked the government about reports that many low-income people expect trouble paying health insurance premiums, rising premiums, unused healthcare allowance, and access to municipal collective health insurance. The minister acknowledged the concerns, gave premium and take-up figures, and listed existing and planned measures, without committing to new structural steps beyond monitoring and ongoing policy.
I will keep a close eye on the situation.
Ik blijf vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat, Sneller en Van Weyenberg over het piramidespel van IM Academy en Finfluencers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Finance and Economic Affairs about the IM Academy pyramid scheme, its recruitment of young people, and the regulation of finfluencers. The government said the supervisors (Ksa, ACM, AFM) are responsible, explained existing rules and enforcement tools, and said it sees no need for major new rules beyond pressing for stronger European investor protection.
The supervisory authorities are independent in their supervision and make no statements about ongoing or possible future investigations.
De toezichthouders zijn onafhankelijk in hun toezicht en doen geen mededelingen over lopende of eventueel te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over "berichten omtrent maandelijks beslag op bijstand in strijd met de wet"

An MP asked the minister about a court ruling that monthly garnishment of social assistance by a municipality breached the subsistence protection, and about extra enforcement costs and municipal practice. The minister agreed to urge municipalities to pay holiday allowance monthly when garnishing, to favour annual payment where possible, and to consider support with VNG, but declined to compensate costs in general.
I will, together with the VNG, call on municipalities to take this into account in implementation.
Ik zal in samenwerking met de VNG gemeenten oproepen om hiermee rekening te houden in de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Onderzoek in Drents-Groningse Veenkoloniën wijst uit: veel meer geld en aandacht nodig om kinderen uit armoede te loodsen'

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about a study finding that intergenerational poverty in the Veenkoloniën needs much more money and attention, and about recommendations for national, local and regional actors. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to existing programmes, the minimum wage increase, the wealth-taxation measures and the Aanpak Geldzorgen, but gave no new commitments beyond ongoing and planned measures.
The cabinet is considering, together with the VNG and Divosa, how the findings of the study, including the preconditions, can be brought to the attention of municipalities and local organisations.
Het kabinet beziet samen met de VNG en Divosa hoe de uitkomsten van het onderzoek inclusief de randvoorwaarden onder de aandacht van gemeenten en lokale organisaties gebracht kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Raemakers over het artikel 'Het gebrek aan zorg voor psychiatrische patiënten met een verslaving drijft ouders tot wanhoop: ‘Wij zijn gevangen in de zorg voor hem’

D66 MPs Kat and Raemakers asked the state secretary and minister about a newspaper report on people with psychiatric problems and addiction who fall between care providers, lose housing and end up in severe cases. The government acknowledges the problem, points to existing dual-diagnosis standards, the Integraal zorgakkoord and regional escalation models, says care providers do not record referrals, and promises to pass the Querido pilot to municipalities and to inform itself via the national addiction rapporteur.
Care providers do not keep data on referrals to other care providers, so there is no national picture of how large this group is.
Zorginstanties houden geen gegevens bij over het doorverwijzen naar andere zorginstanties, dus er is geen landelijk beeld hoe groot deze groep is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het onderzoek ‘Betalingsregelingen bij uitvoeringsorganisaties van het Rijk’

An MP from D66 asked the minister how Dutch government implementation bodies (CJIB, CAK, Belastingdienst) can avoid pushing citizens into financial trouble, ensure minimum subsistence in custom payment arrangements, and improve transparency about them, following an Algemene Rekenkamer report. The minister acknowledged the shortcomings, promised communication and work-instruction changes, explored a uniform subsistence norm and legislative options, and cited ongoing collaborative initiatives, though some answers note privacy constraints and ongoing reviews.

Yes, I find it worrying that government organisations still insufficiently think along with people with debt concerns about tailored payment arrangements and insufficiently observe the subsistence minimum.
Ja, ik vind het zorgelijk dat overheidsorganisaties nog onvoldoende meedenken met mensen met geldzorgen over betalingsregelingen op maat en daarbij het bestaansminimum onvoldoende in acht nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Weyenberg over het niet kunnen openen van een betaalrekening door kwetsbare mensen

MPs Kat and Van Weyenberg asked whether vulnerable people, including young victims of money mules, can open a payment account and why banks demand debt counselling or guardianship first. The Minister of Finance explains the Basic Bank Account Convenant and the EU directive, says the requirements are for banks to judge case by case, and promises to discuss improved communication and tailored treatment with banks.
Yes, I will discuss this with banks and will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Ja, ik zal hierover met banken in gesprek gaan en zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Sneller over het bericht 'Een witbrood stelen om de kinderen te laten eten: de oneindige spiraal van schulden en criminaliteit'

MPs Kat and Sneller asked about a press report linking debt to recidivism, the share of prisoners with debts and access to debt assistance, CJIB debt-relief rules, and judges' knowledge of defendants' finances. The minister acknowledges the debt-crime link and describes existing debt-support routes and reclassering initiatives, but gives no current figures on prisoners receiving debt help and says a fuller answer on the probation thesis' recommendations will follow by end 2023.
There is no recent data available on the total percentage of detainees who struggle with debts.
Er zijn geen recente gegevens bekend over het totale percentage gedetineerden dat kampt met schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Sneller en Kat over het bericht 'Gokbedrijven probeerden ondanks verbod via wk-pools nieuwe klanten te lokken'

MPs Romke de Jong, Sneller and Kat asked the government about reports that gambling firms, including state holding Nederlandse Loterij, advertised via World Cup pools despite a ban, and about the state's oversight as shareholder. The government answered that it was unaware of the World Cup pool ads, that the Gaming Authority fined Nederlandse Loterij for advertising aimed at young adults, that it has voiced concerns to the holdings, and that it is evaluating the shareholding while declining to disclose the number of young players.
This information is not known to me or to my colleague the Minister for Legal Protection because it concerns confidential business information.
Deze informatie is bij mij of mijn collega de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet bekend omdat dit vertrouwelijke bedrijfsinformatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Mensen met schulden merken niets van hogere lonen en uitkeringen'

An MP asked the ministers whether debt-relief recipients benefit from the higher minimum wage through an adjusted beslagvrije voet, and about fee indexation for bewindvoerders. The government answered that recalculation happens during 2023 on request or annually, promised a proactive joint approach with the enforcement chain, and explained that trustee fees are not indexed in 2023 due to the formula's reference year.
We are urgently taking steps to ensure that financially vulnerable people quickly feel the effects of the minimum wage increase in their wallets.
Wij zetten met urgentie stappen om te bewerkstelligen dat financieel kwetsbare mensen de gevolgen van de stijging van het wettelijk minimumloon snel merken in hun portemonnee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Boulakjar en Kat over het bericht 'BKR wil hypotheken registreren en gegevens delen met belwinkels en postorderbedrijven'

MPs from D66 asked the Finance Minister, on behalf of other ministers, about BKR's plan to register mortgages and share data with phone-shop and mail-order firms, including its legal basis, public oversight, proportionality and privacy. The minister answered that no positive mortgage registration is planned for now, that a bill will be consulted on in early 2023 to give credit registration a statutory basis and ministerial powers, and that the government is in talks with BKR.
In the bill, credit registration becomes a statutory task, with corresponding powers for the Minister of Finance.
In het wetsvoorstel wordt kredietregistratie een wettelijke taak, met overeenkomstige bevoegdheden voor de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Gemeenten willen stekker uit Kredietbank in Assen trekken'

MPs asked the minister about possible closure of the Gemeenschappelijke Kredietbank (GKB) in Assen, including risks to debt-relief continuity, costs, and availability of loans. The minister answered that municipalities would re-tender debt assistance and keep loan products available, noting no other Kredietbanken are known to be in deficit.
The municipalities concerned would, in case of dissolution of the KBG, carry out a new tender for their debt assistance and the provision of debt-restructuring loans.
De betreffende gemeenten zullen in het geval van opheffing van de KBG een nieuwe aanbesteding doen voor hun schuldhulpverlening en de verstrekking van saneringskredieten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Paulusma en Kat over het bericht dat steeds meer mensen kiezen voor een hoog risico bij hun zorgverzekering

MPs Paulusma and Kat asked the minister about reports that more people choose high voluntary deductibles in health insurance, the risks this poses, the government's role in matching policies to needs, insurers' product range, and installment payment of the mandatory deductible. The minister sees no trend yet, relies on insurers, comparison sites and a government information campaign, points to NZa plans to tighten rules on near-identical policies, and says no further steps are needed on installment payment since insurers already offer it.
I think it is too early to speak of a "trend" and therefore I am also not in discussion with other departments about it.
Ik vind het te vroeg om te spreken over een «trend» en ben daarom ook niet in gesprek met andere departementen hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Voedselbank Almere kan drukte bijna niet aan'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about reports that the Almere food bank cannot cope with rising demand, including whether local organisations and municipalities have enough resources, whether working people above the poverty line are affected, and how ESF+ funds are being spent. The minister answered that rising energy prices and inflation have increased demand, pointed to new national measures, a 35 million euro allocation to municipalities in 2022 and 200 million euro for debt and poverty in 2022-2024, and said the ESF+ funds for food aid have not yet been spent and will be allocated via an open call.
Question 9: Can you give insight into how the European Social Fund (ESF+) funds made available for support to food banks have been spent?
Vraag 9 Kunt u inzicht geven in hoe de Europees Sociaal Fonds (ESF+-)gelden die beschikbaar zijn gekomen voor steun aan de voedselbanken zijn besteed?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Boucke over het artikel 'Energieleveranciers laten bewoners met betaalproblemen massaal stikken: Schuldhulpverleners luiden noodklok'

MPs Kat and Boucke asked whether energy suppliers refuse payment arrangements for customers with payment problems, risking disconnection and derailing debt relief, and what the government will do. Minister Schouten answered that suppliers sometimes refuse arrangements, that amended disconnection rules from 26 October 2022 require suppliers to make extra efforts to reach customers and offer reasonable arrangements, and that a temporary emergency fund and a planned court-imposed payment arrangement bill are in preparation.

If a debt counsellor's proposal receives no response, the debt counsellor can point to the energy supplier's obligation to make extra efforts to reach customers and offer a reasonable and appropriate payment arrangement.

Indien er niet wordt gereageerd op een voorstel van een schuldhulpverlener, kan de schuldhulpverlener wijzen op de verplichting die de energieleverancier heeft om een extra inspanning te leveren om contact te krijgen met de klanten en om een redelijke en passende betalingsregeling aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat ver 'het artikel Jamal Oulel zet met zijn fintech Socialdebt incassobureaus buitenspel'

An MP asked the minister whether the Socialdebt fintech, which takes over young people's debts without fees, could be scaled up and supported alongside the national guarantee fund and innovative financing. The minister said early intervention is promising but the pilot is too new to judge effectiveness, so scaling will wait for evaluation, with no regulatory barriers identified.
I will continue to stay in close contact with Socialdebt and the municipality of Rotterdam to be able to establish this.
Ik blijf hiertoe nauw contact houden met Socialdebt en de gemeente Rotterdam om dit te kunnen vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Toezichthouder onderzoekt meldingen torenhoge kosten schuldhulp'

An MP from D66 asked the minister about reports of commercial debt mediation that circumvents the statutory ban, including via lawyers, trustees and curators, and about enforcement and complaint routes. The minister acknowledged the problem, announced stronger administrative enforcement, a complaints desk, stricter requirements for trustees and clearer rules, while stating that data on circumvention is not kept and that the ban's exceptions for regulated professions remain supervised by their own bodies.
We do not have statistics on circumventing the ban on debt mediation.
We beschikken niet over statistieken over het omzeilen van het verbod op schuldbemiddeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht 'Kantonrechter ontslaat Langhenkel als bewindvoerder'

MP Kat asked the ministers about the dismissal of bewindvoerder Langhenkel and related oversight failures, including court actions, complaint and fraud statistics, and quality-control outcomes. The government answered that it regrets the situation, that six liability claims arose (three settled, three judgments), and that many data points are not held by the judiciary, with a promised follow-up on stricter standards and court oversight.
In how many cases since 2019 has the client or successor bewindvoerder objected to the final account of the (ex officio) dismissed bewindvoerder?
In hoeveel gevallen vanaf 2019 tot heden heeft de cliënt of opvolgend bewindvoerder bezwaar gemaakt tegen de eindafrekening en -verantwoording van de (ambtshalve) ontslagen bewindvoerder?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Kat  over het bericht ‘Weer minder mensen in de wettelijke schuldsanering’ van het CBS

MPs Ceder and Kat asked the government why the number of people admitted to the statutory debt restructuring regime (Wsnp) keeps falling and whether the entry threshold is too high, and whether it will consult municipalities and others. The minister answers that admission criteria are applied too strictly, points to a pending bill to loosen them, and says advice will be sought from practitioners, with a letter to parliament planned for September 2022.
It is not intended that people who would benefit from a Wsnp procedure remain in a municipal debt assistance procedure if it is clear that this offers no solution to their debt problem.

Het is niet de bedoeling dat mensen, die gebaat zijn bij een Wsnp-traject, in een gemeentelijk schuldhulpverleningstraject blijven indien duidelijk is dat dit geen oplossing biedt voor de schuldenproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Ginneken over het artikel 'Zo werd Myrthe Reuver de dupe van haar data: ‘Ze geloven in eerste instantie het systeem’'

MPs Kat and Van Ginneken asked the ministers about a newspaper report on credit assessments by credit-information bureaus based on general data, possibly including incorrect data from former residents, and about notification, objection, retention periods and BKR registrations. The government answered that such assessments on general data are undesirable, that incorrect data processing is unlawful, that GDPR rights apply, that the Dutch industry code sets an 8-year retention, and that the BKR retention period of five years is retained while a draft law on credit registration is prepared.
Processing incorrect personal data to arrive at the score is therefore unlawful.
Het verwerken van foutieve persoonsgegevens om tot de score te komen is dan ook onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Sneller over het artikel 'Rechters maken schulden van de zwakkeren juist erger'

MPs Kat and Sneller asked whether courts handle around 5,000 default debt collection judgments weekly, why debtors fail to appear, and what has been done with the Raad voor de rechtspraak's recommendations on debt cases. The minister says default judgments have fallen below that level, outlines reforms such as a planned legal basis for courts to impose payment arrangements, a debt officer pilot, lower court fees and a shorter good-faith test, and commits to further letters on cost stacking and experiments.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kat over het artikel ‘Bewindvoerder steelt 160.000 euro van cliënten’

An MP asked the government about a court-appointed administrator (bewindvoerder) who embezzled client funds, including how many similar cases exist, how supervision and complaints worked, and how client recovery and quality rules are being tightened. The minister answered that three similar cases are known since 2019, that the administrator was suspended and dismissed promptly by the Limburg court once signals arose, and outlined existing supervision, criminal complaints, client damage recovery and ongoing reform of quality requirements.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Romke de Jong over het bericht 'Aantal startende ondernemers 'nog steeds erg hoog''

MPs Kat and Romke de Jong asked how persons under debt restructuring, debt administration or guardianship can register as entrepreneurs at the Chamber of Commerce without consent, and how the Chamber checks this. The minister answers that unauthorised registration is not intended, that the Chamber checks authority and records only in doubtful cases, that no statistics are kept, and that the Chamber will update its information for vulnerable groups.
Such data are not kept, neither for the debt restructuring procedure nor for protective administration or guardianship.
Dergelijke gegevens worden niet bijgehouden, noch voor de schuldsaneringsprocedure, noch voor het beschermingsbewind of de curatele.
Antwoord op van het lid Kat over het artikel ‘Ik ben drie jaar van mijn leven verloren’

An MP asks the Minister for Poverty Policy about reports that PLANgroep, a debt-relief provider contracted by municipalities, delayed help and mishandled cases, and about how municipalities can oversee and correct contractors. The minister says municipalities hold the information and oversight tools, that the quality framework is adequate, and that municipalities must handle the problems with PLANgroep.
The municipalities that engaged PLANgroep for debt relief know how many people have been affected. The national government has no information on this.
De gemeenten die PLANgroep hebben ingeschakeld voor schuldhulpverlening weten hoeveel mensen zijn getroffen. De rijksoverheid heeft hierover geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat en Podt over het artikel 'Zorgwekkende’ cijfers uit achterstandswijken: ‘Schrok van armoede onder de Syriërs’'

Two MPs asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about reports that Syrian status holders face high poverty and debt yet rarely use debt relief, and about DUO loan forgiveness, debt rescheduling and support measures. The Minister answered that loans are forgiven if integration obligations are met, partial forgiveness applies in case of late completion, debt restructuring loans are available, and that the government will work with municipalities on earlier debt support and a debt-policy programme due in 2022.
It is difficult to answer this question because we do not have specific information about it.
Het is lastig een antwoord te geven op deze vraag, omdat wij hier geen specifieke informatie over hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Paulusma over het bericht 'Dure betalingsregeling van Infomedics maakt de tandarts onbetaalbaar'

MPs Kat and Paulusma asked whether dental-clinic payment arrangements run by billing firm Infomedics, which charge patients service fees, are acceptable, and whether such fees should be banned. The minister said such fees should be avoided, that a ban is not under consideration, and that the sector and Infomedics will be consulted on practical solutions.
The cabinet has set itself the goal of preventing collection costs as much as possible and acting quickly on early payment arrears.
Het kabinet heeft wel als doel gesteld om incassokosten zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen en snel te acteren bij beginnende betalingsachterstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over de tv uitzending Radar ‘De rol van de gerechtsdeurwaarder’

An MP asked the government about a Radar broadcast on a bailiff collecting disputed debts for a dubious company, and about bailiff oversight, dispute handling, complaint statistics and legal protection. The minister condemned any improper pressure, declined to judge the individual case, pointed to existing supervision by the BFT and the Kamer voor gerechtsdeurwaarders, and noted pending incasso quality legislation.
I cannot make statements about an individual case.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Geregistreerde Schuld Regeling ontvangen'

An MP (D66) asked about a proposal for a registered debt scheme run by bailiffs to reduce repeated attachment costs borne by debtors, and about related risks, legal changes and foreign models such as Belgium's IOS procedure. The minister acknowledges the cost problem, points to a planned bill on coordinating third-party garnishment and a further deepening exercise, but declines a substantive assessment of fraud and legal-protection risks and says the Belgian model is not to be introduced.
I refrain from a substantive response and assessment of the risks of fraud and negative legal protection for the debtor because I do not yet want to anticipate the aforementioned deepening exercise.

Ik onthoud mij van een inhoudelijke reactie en beoordeling van de risico's op fraude en negatieve rechtsbescherming van de schuldenaar omdat ik nog niet vooruit wil lopen op de hiervoor genoemde verdiepingsslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Door schuldhulpverlener kampen Arnhemmers met nieuwe schulden: ‘Dit moet binnen een week zijn opgelost’’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that Arnhem residents accumulated new debts through a municipal debt-assistance contractor (PLANgroep), and about quality standards, procurement, oversight and risks of outsourcing debt help to commercial parties. The State Secretary acknowledged the errors, said municipalities remain responsible for quality under the Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening, pointed to the NVVK quality framework and procurement rules, and said complaints go to the municipality.
The municipal executive and the municipal council are responsible for quality assurance.
Het college van burgemeester en wethouders en de gemeenteraad zijn verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteitsborging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Elke maand 1.050 euro voor thuisloze jongeren: het werkt'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about a Eindhoven project giving homeless youths a monthly allowance and whether such experiments and a basic income-type approach would be scaled up. The State Secretary said the project overlaps with national income policy, will seek independent legal advice from the Landsadvocaat, and declined to compile an overview of such experiments while pointing to existing pilots and the ZonMw programme.
I will therefore call in the Landsadvocaat for independent legal advice.
Ik zal daarom de Landsadvocaat inschakelen voor onafhankelijk juridisch advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het aanvragen van loonkostenvoordelen door werkgevers

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries about how employers apply for wage-cost subsidies for hiring people with work disabilities, including whether the correction deadline is clear and whether a legal succession changes entitlement. The government answered that guidance is published in several places, that corrections are possible until 1 May of the following year, and that the subsidy right does not pass to a successor company in a takeover or legal merger.
I am of the view that the conditions and the process are sufficiently clear because sufficient communication has taken place about them.
Ik ben van mening dat de voorwaarden en het proces voldoende duidelijk zijn omdat hierover voldoende wordt gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over "de hoogte van het Bbz-krediet"

An MP asked the government about usage and repayment rates of the Bbz business loan, how its 8% interest rate was set, and whether it should be reconsidered as market conditions changed. The State Secretary said repayment data are unavailable, maintained that 8% is market-conform and aligned with high-risk business credit, and said the rate would only be revisited if market rates change.
Unfortunately, I do not have the requested data.
Ik beschik helaas niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Hoe juist werken tot armoede leidt: ‘Het probleem is dat toeslagen, loon en uitkering niet op elkaar zijn afgestemd’'

D66 MPs Kat and Van Weyenberg asked about a newspaper report that mismatched payment cycles (four-weekly wages versus monthly benefits and allowances) cause hardship, asking how common this is, how payroll and benefit rules work, and whether uniform payment rules or holiday-pay changes would help. The minister answers that the problem is recognised, explains the rules and offsetting practices in detail, says data on liquidity problems are unavailable, and notes that the answers will feed into a follow-up study of the UWV report.
It is not known how many people experience liquidity problems in connection with receiving wages every four weeks.
Niet bekend is hoeveel personen in verband met de ontvangst van salaris per vier weken liquiditeitsproblemen ondervinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Romke de Jong en Kat over de Tozo

MPs from D66 asked why the Tozo loan carries 2% interest while the Bbz credit carries 8%, and whether the gap is defensible for entrepreneurs. The minister answered that the Tozo is a temporary crisis scheme pegged to Qredits' rate, the Bbz is a structural last-resort scheme with market-rate interest, and he is not willing to lower the Bbz rate because a lower non-market rate would constitute state aid.
I attach importance to a market-conform interest rate being applied to interest-bearing loans under the regular Bbz.
Ik hecht eraan dat er in het kader van het reguliere Bbz een marktconforme rente wordt gehanteerd voor rentedragende leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht "Meldpunt toegang tot schuldhulpverlening voor ZZP’ers"

An MP asked the minister about the Nationale ombudsman's complaints point for self-employed people (ZZP'ers) denied debt assistance, and about support for municipalities, communication, and preparation if steun measures end. The minister replied that municipalities are responsible, cites guides, subsidies, campaigns and Belastingdienst's changed approach, but gives no figures and cannot guarantee non-refusal in every case.
This is a responsibility of municipalities. The Ministry of SZW has no data on this.
Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten. Het Ministerie van SZW heeft hier geen gegevens over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Kabinet: Voedselaanbod voor de voedselbanken op peil houden’

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about expected growth in food bank demand, how it relates to ESF funding, and the social impact model for food production. The minister said demand growth is not yet clearly measured but a 7% rise was seen in 2020, that 3% of ESF+ funds will go to food aid with details still being negotiated, and that gemeenten are responsible for minima support.
On average VBNL saw a growth of 7% in 2020, with strong regional differences.
Gemiddeld zag VBNL een groei van 7% in 2020, met hierin sterke regionale verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst opnieuw in de fout is gegaan met toeslagen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance about erroneous Belastingdienst benefit recalculation letters sent to 224 recipients after faulty processing of IND residence-status data, covering the scale, amounts, fix, prevention, and financial impact. The State Secretary answers in detail, acknowledging a design error at Toeslagen, describing the correction, the 1,127 wrongful decisions worth about 2.4 million euro, measures such as a right to comment before large reclaims, and that all affected persons have been contacted.
This went badly wrong. I have already apologised to those affected.
Het is hier erg misgegaan. Ik heb de betrokkenen inmiddels hiervoor excuses gemaakt.

m: Amendement van het lid Wijen-Nass over het verhogen van de strafbedreiging

Amendment to a criminal bill doubling the maximum penalty for equipping vehicles with hidden compartments to obstruct investigation, from one to two years and from two to four years for habitual offenders.
In the first paragraph, 'one year' is replaced by 'two years'.
In het eerste lid wordt «een jaar» vervangen door «twee jaar».
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen c.s. over meldingen van poortwachters aan de FIU op verzoek anonimiseren
Motion asking that gatekeepers' reports to the FIU can be anonymised in a criminal file at the request of the reporter, provided the report to the FIU itself is not anonymous.

The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, that local authorities and existing prevention programmes handle these issues, and that a school safety bill and a planned increase in maximum penalties are underway, without committing to new structural funding.
The use of AI or deepfakes is not automatically a form of digital subversion; for that, AI would have to be used by criminals as a means to disrupt society in order to commit criminal acts.

Het gebruik van AI of deepfakes is niet automatisch een vorm van digitale ondermijning, hiervoor moet AI als middel worden gebruikt door criminelen om de samenleving te ontwrichten om criminele handelingen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over de randweg Abdissenbosch

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the long-delayed Abdissenbosch ring road, its cross-border link to Germany, and whether Dutch environmental rules cause the delay. The minister replied that road construction is a provincial responsibility (Limburg), declined substantive comment on the project status, and said nature (nitrogen) rules apply equally across the EU under the Habitats Directive.
Provincial and municipal roads fall under the responsibility of the provinces.
Provinciale en gemeentelijke wegen vallen onder verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse politie presenteert uitvinding tegen discriminatie: ‘de paal bepaalt’’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Amsterdam police's random selection pole, a tool meant to prevent ethnic profiling in stop-and-search actions, and whether it would undermine police expertise and effectiveness and be rolled out nationally without parliamentary consent. The minister answered that the pole is a supporting tool for random checks, that the basis of professional checking remains the police guidance, that it does not affect investigation, that it has so far been used only by the Amsterdam unit, and that local authorities set the conditions, without committing to a parliamentary approval or abolition.
It is up to the mayor, in consultation with the public prosecution service and the police, to set the conditions for random checks and frisk actions.
Het is aan de burgemeester in samenspraak met het OM en de politie om de voorwaarden te bepalen van aselectieve controle- en fouilleeracties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het besluit van het CBR om de theorie-examens in Maastricht per juli 2025 te verplaatsen naar Roermond

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the CBR's decision to move Maastricht theory exams to Roermond, which the MP said increases travel time and reduces public transport access, is consistent with government policy on spreading national government jobs and equal access. The minister answered that the move improves accessibility for most of Limburg, that CBR is an independent agency the ministers cannot direct, and declined to ask CBR to reconsider.

Independent administrative bodies (zbo's) are organisations of the central government that carry out public tasks independently, but do not fall directly under a ministry and therefore have greater distance from political leadership.

Zelfstandige bestuursorganen (zbo's) zijn organisaties van de Rijksoverheid die zelfstandig publieke taken uitvoeren, maar niet direct onder een ministerie vallen en daardoor een grotere afstand tot de politieke leiding hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Vermeer, Pierik, Van Zanten, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Wijen-Nass, Oostenbrink en Joseph over optredens van de haatprediker Bob Vylan in Nederland

MPs from BBB asked whether a Bob Vylan concert in Paradiso calling for violence against Zionists and whether such performances should be allowed, and asked about criminal liability, entry bans and municipal responsibility. The minister said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to comment on individual cases, and noted that municipal mayors decide on events and that entry refusal is possible under Schengen rules but depends on available information.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to investigate exactly what was said. The police investigation into this is still ongoing.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te onderzoeken wat er precies is gezegd. Het politieonderzoek hiernaar loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Moordenaar krijgt na jaren cel en tbs baan in zorgkliniek: ’Hoe kan zo iemand werken met kwetsbare personen?’

An MP asked how a person with a serious violent past could obtain a VOG for a care job, and whether that is responsible given contact with vulnerable clients. The Secretary of State said VOG decisions weigh risk case by case, gave the general criteria, defended the use of experience experts in care, and did not discuss the individual case for privacy reasons.
Because of the protection of the personal privacy of those involved, I cannot go into individual cases.
Vanwege de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van betrokkenen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht 'Pijnlijk: Terwijl homoacceptatie vrijwel overal groeit, daalt die in ‘gaycapital’ Amsterdam

An MP asked the Justice Minister and Education State Secretary about falling acceptance of homosexuality among youth in Amsterdam, the gap for youth with migrant backgrounds, prosecution and sentencing for discrimination, and whether the government would act on Amsterdam neighbourhoods and prosecution guidelines. The government said the research is ongoing, Amsterdam is responsible for local action, prosecution guidelines and sentencing policy are already adequate, and the questions could not be answered in time.
There is no overview available of prosecution demands and sentences in cases involving discrimination and/or violence where sexual orientation plays a role.
Er is geen overzicht voorhanden van strafeisen en vonnissen waarbij sprake is van discriminatie en/of geweld waar geaardheid een rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht 'Door nieuwe verhuurregels komen studenten nóg moeilijker aan een kamer'

An MP asked the minister about reports of a sharp fall in student rooms and the effect of the Wet betaalbare huur and the WWSO revision on rental supply. The minister answered that the national stock fell about 4%, that a full evaluation is planned for 2027, and that new measures such as temporary student contracts and hospitaverhuur are in preparation.
The Landelijke Monitor Studentenhuisvesting published on 4 September estimates the total supply at 322,400 housing units.
In de Landelijke Monitor Studentenhuisvesting die op 4 september is gepubliceerd, wordt het totale aanbod geschat op 322.400 wooneenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over ‘Hoogkarspel Zuid krijgt vorm: geen rijkssteun, wel plannen voor supermarkt en levendig buurtcentrum’

An MP asked the housing minister why Hoogkarspel Zuid was not selected for national funding for large-scale housing, whether the selection criteria changed after the application, and what this means for smaller municipalities. The minister denied any change in criteria, said the selection was based on existing deal data and open sources without contacting municipalities, and pointed to a package of schemes open to all municipalities, including a single-municipality application rule.
There has been no change to the assessment framework.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een wijziging van het beoordelingskader.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht 'gemeente vs. echtpaar Bos in Bruinisse: 'Onwerkelijk hoe ons leven zo verdwijnt''

MP Wijen-Nass asked the Minister of Housing about a couple in Bruinisse facing heavy penalties and strict enforcement for permanently living in a holiday home, and whether municipalities should be more lenient pending new rules. The Minister said she cannot judge individual cases, has urged municipalities to show restraint, and expects new regulation allowing legalisation under conditions to take effect in 2026.
I assume that most municipalities heed my call to be restrained in enforcement.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het grootste deel van de gemeenten gehoor geeft aan mijn oproep om terughoudend te zijn met handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘XR kondigt aanvallen met boterzuur aan, gemeente Eindhoven laat het begaan; geeft ondernemers tips over ventilatie en EHBO’

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the government will act against Extinction Rebellion's announced use of butyric acid in Eindhoven, whether it qualifies as terrorism or a criminal organisation, and why local authorities are not intervening. The minister condemned the tactic, said the mayor decides on protest conditions, and said prosecution and banning a group are matters for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts.
It is not for the cabinet but for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether a specific case constitutes a terrorist offence or a criminal organisation.
Het is niet aan het kabinet maar aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er in bepaald geval sprake is van een terroristisch misdrijf of een criminele organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over de situatie in de middenhuur

An MP from BBB asks the Minister for Housing about the very high demand for mid-rent homes (10,000 applications for 200 units), the investment climate for mid-rent construction, the effects of the Affordable Rent Act on unit size, and whether local authority demands are discouraging building. The Minister acknowledges the shortage, points to fiscal and rent-regulation measures, promises to inform parliament on a joint study with the Finance State Secretary later this year, and says local authorities will not impose stricter technical requirements, with exploitation demands to be addressed under the STOER programme.
I will inform parliament later this year about the outcomes of this study.
Wij zullen uw Kamer later dit jaar informeren over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Huurders eisen nu echt actie tegen schimmel in huis’

An MP asks the minister about mould in rental homes, the failure of housing associations to take responsibility, and whether current law protects tenants' health. The minister replies that the National Performance Agreements and local agreements address mould, that the existing rules are sufficient, and that landlords carry primary responsibility.
I am of the view that the current laws and regulations are sufficient.
Ik ben van mening dat de huidige wet- en regelgeving voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wijnen-Nas en Zanten over de column ‘Afgeslacht om die achterlijke reden: Eer’

MPs Van Zanten and Wijnen-Nas asked the government about a Telegraaf column on honour killings and what it would do about the attitudes behind them and whether citizenship could be revoked for honour-motivated crimes. The state secretary condemned the worldview, described prevention and repression measures, and said revoking Dutch nationality is only possible within European Convention limits, with the government studying whether other serious crimes could be added.
Revoking Dutch nationality is only possible for persons who hold another nationality besides Dutch.
Intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit is alleen mogelijk bij personen die naast de Nederlandse nog een andere nationaliteit hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het vertrek van rijksdiensten uit Roermond

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the loss of central government jobs in Roermond, whether compensation is warranted, whether Roermond will be prioritised under the 'Elke Regio Telt' policy, and whether an action plan will be drawn up for a fairer spread of government jobs. The Minister answered that the decline was largely due to a one-off relocation, that structural compensation is not desirable, that concrete outcomes take time and that a ministry-level exploration with Roermond will take place without committing to specific relocations.
I do not consider structural compensation desirable or workable.
Ik acht een structurele compensatie niet wenselijk en niet werkbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Nieuwe trend bij online pesten: ‘Het is ongelooflijk triest gedrag’’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether consistent online bullying harms victims' mental health, whether bullying will be included in the planned criminalisation of psychological violence, and whether schools can refer bullies to Halt.
