The government agreed bullying is harmful, said existing criminal law covers some forms, said consultations on the psychological violence bill are ongoing with details due before summer 2025, and explained Halt referral is possible via police/prosecution or municipal preventive interventions.
Your House will be informed before summer 2025 about the outlines of this bill.
Uw Kamer wordt voor de zomer 2025 geïnformeerd over de contouren van dit wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Fundamentele koerswijziging OM: Dieven en oplichters zo min mogelijk voor de strafrechter’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's shift to handling theft and fraud cases below six years' imprisonment via penal orders rather than court, and whether the policy conflicts with the community-service ban and legislative intent. The minister defended the expanded use of penal orders as a way to shorten case times, said the OM's policy stays within legal limits, and noted monitoring, a WODC study and a Procurator-General follow-up study are underway.
The OM has informed me that, partly in light of the questions raised, ample time is being taken for careful monitoring of the current expansion and preparation of possible future expansions.

Het OM heeft mij geïnformeerd dat, mede gelet op de ontstane vragen, ruim de tijd wordt genomen voor een zorgvuldige monitoring van de huidige uitbreiding en voorbereiding van mogelijke toekomstige uitbreidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Kamerlid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Jongeren verlaten sociale advocatuur om vergoedingen’

MP Wijen-Nass asks the State Secretary about reports that young lawyers are leaving social legal aid over fees, raising concerns about aging practitioners, shrinking numbers and regional shortages threatening legal certainty. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, points to past measures and promises further steps, research on regional supply, and a joint vision with the bar and legal aid bodies.
I have asked the Knowledge Centre to conduct further research into the development of the supply of social lawyers, differentiating among other things by legal field and region.
Ik heb het Kenniscentrum gevraagd nader onderzoek te doen naar de ontwikkeling van het aanbod van sociaal advocaten en daarbij onder meer te differentiëren naar rechtsgebied en regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over politie inzet tijdens NAVO Top in Den Haag tussen 24-26 juni

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Justice and Security how public order elsewhere in the Netherlands would be guaranteed during the NATO summit, and about event cancellations, sponsor contract losses and liability. The minister answered that police and Defence will support each other, that local authorities decide on events based on available police capacity, and that local parties will consult on solutions.
I trust that they will jointly reach a solution that does justice to all interests as far as possible.
Ik vertrouw erop dat zij in gezamenlijkheid tot een oplossing komen waarin zo veel mogelijk aan alle belangen recht wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Wijen-Nass over het artikel 'Weer meer wethouders gestopt in 2024, roep om uitbreiding van colleges'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about news reports of more aldermen leaving office in 2024 and calls to expand city executives, including workload relief, legal changes, financial support and support programmes. The minister answered that 157 aldermen left in 2024, gave the numbers for small and medium municipalities, said a letter on the attractiveness of the office will come before the summer recess, and noted that changing the legal cap on aldermen requires amending the Municipalities Act.
From my ministry we offer financial support for this.
Vanuit mijn ministerie bieden we hiervoor financiële ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ’Huurprijzen in de vrije sector stijgen verder, maar niet overal’

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about media reports that the Wet betaalbare huur is reducing rental supply and that landlords are selling rental homes, and asked when an early evaluation could be brought forward. The Minister answered that signals are monitored, the Kadaster figures show no growing trend in sell-offs, it is too early to judge proportionality, and the full evaluation follows within three years, with a weighing planned in Q1 2025.
The first full evaluation of the law, looking at its effects on the rental market as a whole, follows within three years of the law entering into force.
De eerste volledige evaluatie van de wet, waarbij ik in het geheel kijk naar de effecten daarvan op de huurmarkt, volgt binnen drie jaar na inwerkingtreding van de wet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over de productiecapaciteit van munitie en defensiematerieel

MP Wijen-Nass asked whether the government would take a strategic stake in defence start-ups and whether it would contact the German economics minister to produce shortfall munitions in German industry. The State Secretary replied that a stake remains an option under the economic security instrument, with a letter promised in Q1 2025, and that Defence already discusses production scaling with Germany, which decides on its own industrial capacity.
Your House will be informed in Q1 2025 about how Defence and the Ministry of Economic Affairs will further strengthen the strategic position of the defence industry in the long term.
Uw Kamer wordt in Q1 2025 geïnformeerd over hoe Defensie en Economische Zaken (EZ) de strategische positie van de defensie-industrie verder gaan versterken op de lange termijn.

m: Motie van het lid Wuite over het aanstellen van een jongerenvertegenwoordiger Caribische Zaken
Asks the government to talk with the Nationale Jeugdraad about how a youth representative for Caribbean affairs could be appointed and to report to the House in Q1 2024.
requests the government to enter into discussion with the National Youth Council on how a youth representative for Caribbean Affairs can be appointed
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te gaan met de Nationale Jeugdraad over de wijze waarop een jongerenvertegenwoordiger Caribische Zaken kan worden aangesteld
Motie van het lid Wuite over in gesprek treden over gefaseerde en gedeeltelijke kwijtschelding van de coronaleningen
Asks the government to open talks in one or two years with the Caribbean countries about phased, partial forgiveness of corona loans if reforms show results.
requests the government to enter into talks with the Caribbean countries in one or two years about phased and partial forgiveness of the corona loans
verzoekt de regering om over een of twee jaar met de Caribische landen in gesprek te treden over gefaseerde en gedeeltelijke kwijtschelding van de coronaleningen
Motie van het lid Wuite over een overzicht van welke Nederlandse regelgeving van toepassing is op de drie bijzondere gemeenten
Asks the government to produce by year end an overview of which Dutch rules apply to the three Caribbean special municipalities and actively inform citizens about it.
requests the government to produce by the end of the year an overview of which Dutch regulations apply to the three special municipalities
verzoekt de regering voor het einde van het jaar een overzicht te maken van welke Nederlandse regelgeving van toepassing is op de drie bijzondere gemeenten
Motie van het lid Wuite over een haalbaarheidsstudie naar de mogelijkheid van een regionale ontwikkelingsmaatschappij in het Caribische deel van het Koninkrijk
Asks the government to commission a feasibility study into a regional development company for the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, possibly funded by repayment of corona loans.
requests the government to carry out a feasibility study into establishing a regional development company in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom
verzoekt de regering een haalbaarheidsstudie uit te voeren naar de mogelijkheid om een regionale ontwikkelingsmaatschappij in het Caribische deel van het Koninkrijk op te richten
Motie van het lid Wuite over het uitwerken van financiële scenario's, waaronder het mogelijk invoeren van het sociaal minimum per 1 januari 2024
Asks the government to prepare financial scenarios, including a possible social minimum from 1 January 2024, and to inform the House before the budget debate.
requests the government to work out financial scenarios pending the final report of the Commission on the social minimum for the Caribbean Netherlands
verzoekt de regering in afwachting van het eindrapport van de Commissie sociaal minimum Caribisch Nederland financiële scenario's uit te werken
Motie van het lid Wuite over het organiseren van een Koninkrijksconferentie in 2023
Asks the government to organise a Kingdom conference in 2023 on the Statute and the future of the Kingdom, including human rights and the rule of law.
calls on the government to organise a Kingdom conference in 2023
roept de regering op om in 2023 een Koninkrijksconferentie te organiseren
Motie van het lid Wuite over het toevoegen van een beleidsartikel klimaatadaptatie en -mitigatie in het begrotingshoofdstuk Koninkrijksrelaties
Motion asking the government to add a policy article on climate adaptation and mitigation to the Kingdom Relations budget chapter.
requests the government to add the policy article on climate adaptation and mitigation to the Kingdom Relations budget chapter
verzoekt de regering om in het begrotingshoofdstuk Koninkrijksrelaties het beleidsartikel klimaatadaptatie en -mitigatie toe te voegen
Motie van het lid Wuite over 2% van het geld uit het Europees Herstelfonds besteden aan cultuur
Asks that 2% of the Netherlands' Recovery Fund money go to the cultural and creative sector.
states that 2% of the money the Netherlands receives under the European Recovery Fund should go to the cultural and creative sector
spreekt uit 2% van het geld dat Nederland toekomt in het kader van het Europees Herstelfonds toe te kennen aan de culturele en creatieve sector
Motie van het lid Wuite over een fieldlab herstelexperiment voor de culturele sector
Asks the government to include a fieldlab recovery experiment for the cultural sector in the recovery plan and to inform the House before the Spring Memorandum 2022.
requests the government to include the idea behind the fieldlab recovery experiment in the recovery plan
verzoekt de regering de gedachte achter het fieldlabherstelexperiment op te nemen in het herstelplan
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het bericht 'Toegankelijkheid musea onder druk door achterblijvendeoverheidssubsidies'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about reports that museums face financial pressure from rising costs and lagging government subsidies, risking admission prices and accessibility. The State Secretary acknowledged uneven financial strain, said admission pricing is up to the museums, and pointed to existing support measures while stating that funding responsibility is shared with local and provincial governments.
As independent institutions, it is up to the museums themselves to set the admission price for entrance tickets.
Als zelfstandige instellingen is het aan de musea zelf om de toegangsprijs te bepalen voor entreetickets.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het bericht 'Eilandsraad Sint Eustatius voelt zich gechanteerd door Den Haag'

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the Sint Eustatius island council felt blackmailed by The Hague over the transition to phase 2.0, including the process, transparency, ministry errors and a critical island council motion. The State Secretary answered that the process was transparent and that the council agreed to adopt the outstanding ordinances to allow the appointment of two deputies, while acknowledging some timing shortcomings and promising better aligned expectations.
I am of the view that the course of the transition process has been transparent.
Ik ben van mening dat het verloop van het transitieproces transparant is geweest.

m: Motie van het lid Wingelaar over een landelijk kennis- en ondersteuningsplatform voor inbesteding door provincies
Asks the government, together with provinces and transport regions, to set up a national knowledge and support platform for provinces considering in-house award of transport concessions.
requests the government, together with provinces and transport regions, to set up a national knowledge and support platform that provinces can use for in-house award
verzoekt de regering om samen met provincies en vervoersregio's een landelijk kennis- en ondersteuningsplatform op te zetten waar provincies bij inbesteding gebruik van kunnen maken
Motie van het lid Wingelaar over de Kamer informeren na het besluit over specifieke uitkeringen en voor het daadwerkelijk overhevelen naar het Gemeentefonds
Asks the government to fully and promptly inform the House after the decision on specific grants and before they are actually transferred to the municipal fund.
requests the government, after the decision on the specific grants but before actually transferring them to the municipal fund, to inform the House fully and as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering na het besluit over de specifieke uitkeringen, maar voor het daadwerkelijk overhevelen naar het Gemeentefonds, de Kamer volledig en zo spoedig mogelijk te informeren
Motie van het lid Wingelaar over borgen dat kortingen door het niet omzetten van specifieke uitkeringen geen negatieve gevolgen hebben voor de financiële positie van decentrale overheden
Asks the government to ensure that budget cuts from not converting specific grants do not harm the financial position of subnational governments.
requests the government to ensure that cuts from not converting specific grants have no negative consequences for the financial position of decentralised governments
verzoekt de regering te borgen dat kortingen door het niet omzetten van specifieke uitkeringen geen negatieve gevolgen hebben voor de financiële positie van decentrale overheden
Motie van het lid Aukje de Vries c.s. over gemeenten de mogelijkheid geven te werken met een stelpost onderuitputting
Asks the government to let municipalities use a budget reserve for expected underspending, agreed with provinces as financial supervisors.

requests the government to give municipalities the option to work with a budget item for underspending and to make agreements about this with the provinces as financial supervisors of municipal finances

verzoekt de regering om gemeenten de mogelijkheid te geven om te werken met een stelpost onderuitputting en daarover afspraken te maken met de provincies als financieel toezichthouders op de gemeentefinanciën
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Wingelaar ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het schrappen van de verstrekkingsverplichting
Removes the proposed duty for competent authorities to send the Minister copies of decisions departing from the circular materials plan.
With this amendment the proposed duty to provide copies is removed from the bill.
Met dit amendement wordt de voorgestelde verstrekkingsverplichting uit het wetsvoorstel geschrapt.
Amendement van het lid Wingelaar over het schrappen van de verstrekkingsverplichting
Removes the proposed obligation for local administrative bodies to send the Minister of Infrastructure a copy of decisions deviating from the circular materials plan.
With this amendment the proposed obligation to provide copies from the bill is deleted.
Met dit amendement wordt de voorgestelde verstrekkingsverplichting uit het wetsvoorstel geschrapt.
Amendement van het lid Wingelaar over een evaluatie van de verstrekkingsverplichting binnen drie jaar
Requires the minister to report to the States General within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the new information-provision obligation in the Environmental Management Act.
sends to the States General within three years of the entry into force of this act a report on the effectiveness and effects
zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten
Motie van het lid Wingelaar over de Kamer informeren over de wijze waarop haar informatiepositie bij de beoordeling van de financiële situatie van decentrale overheden verbeterd kan worden
Asks the government to reflect on the ROB advice on an annual monitor of municipal and provincial finances and to inform the House how its information position will be strengthened.
requests the government, after publication of the ROB advice, to reflect on the findings and inform the House on how the House's information position will be strengthened

verzoekt de regering om, na publicatie van het advies van de ROB, te reflecteren op de bevindingen en de Kamer te informeren over de wijze waarop de informatiepositie van de Kamer versterkt zal worden
Motie van het lid Stoffer c.s. over het heroverwegen van beleidsmatige prikkels die reparatie en hergebruik van elektrische en elektronische apparatuur ontmoedigen
Asks the government to reconsider policy incentives that discourage repair and reuse of electrical equipment and to inform the House before year end.
requests the government to reconsider the mentioned policy incentives that discourage repair and reuse of discarded electrical and electronic equipment
verzoekt de regering de genoemde beleidsmatige prikkels die reparatie en hergebruik van afgedankte elektrische en elektronische apparatuur ontmoedigen te heroverwegen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Wingelaar en Saris over het gebruik en de bescherming van Nedersaksisch en Limburgs als streektalen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior why Low Saxon and Limburgish are protected under Part II rather than Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, and what the state has done to support them. The minister answered that Part II already provides adequate protection through convenants with regional governments, that Part III's adoption requires further analysis, and that the convenant with Low Saxon is under evaluation.
Whether extension to Part III is appropriate requires further analysis of feasibility and resources and will proceed in consultation with the regional governments concerned.
Of uitbreiding naar deel III passend is, vraagt een nadere analyse van uitvoerbaarheid en middelen en gaat in samenspraak met de betrokken regionale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over de sluiting van fabriek Fibrant op Chemelot

Wingelaar asked the government about the planned closure of Fibrant's caprolactam plants at Chemelot, the subsidies Fibrant received, effects on the cluster, and past closures. The minister responded that the decision is not yet final, that the government is in close contact with the company and province and is pursuing a plan for the cluster, and that it cannot yet say whether subsidies would be reclaimed.
At this moment, however, it is premature to speak of a definitive decision.
Het is op dit moment echter te voorbarig om te spreken over een definitief besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Wingelaar over het artikel ‘geen noodbrug blijkt op infoavond over renovatie brug Urmond’

MPs Van Dijk and Wingelaar asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Urmond bridge renovation: the delay since around 2017-2018, the lack of a social impact analysis, the shift in project scope without informing residents, and the budget discrepancy (EUR 8.8m vs 15-20m, only EUR 350,000 for nuisance measures). The minister acknowledged communication shortcomings and that the bridge will be fully closed, but attributed the delay and scope change to deteriorating technical condition and defended the budget as phase-specific, while leaving alternatives like a temporary bridge to the municipality of Stein.
No official social impact analysis (MIA) was prepared for the closure of the Urmond bridge.
Er is geen officiële maatschappelijke impactanalyse (MIA) opgesteld voor de afsluiting van brug Urmond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Wingelaar over Rijkswaterstaat sluit brug Urmond anderhalf jaar volledig af, maar gemeente Stein verzet zich: Niet akkoord met samenloop verbreding A2

MPs Olger van Dijk and Wingelaar ask why Rijkswaterstaat fully closes the Urmond bridge for 18 months despite objections from Stein and residents, and how local participation and the A2 timing were handled. The minister answers that worsened inspection results make a partial closure unsafe, that residents were consulted in earlier phases, that a klankbordgroep and alternatives like bus and bike options are being explored, but that no formal impact analysis was made and no reconsideration meeting with the municipality will be held.
No official societal impact analysis (MIA) has been prepared for the closure of the Urmond bridge.
Er is geen officiële maatschappelijke impactanalyse (MIA) opgesteld voor de afsluiting van brug Urmond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over het Eindrapport Plastic Tafel

An MP asks whether the Plastic Table package reaches the 30% circular plastics goal for 2030, and about investment losses, bank confidence, the binding nature of measures, and industry 'game changers'. The government answers that the 30% figure is now an aspiration rather than a norm, that most measures are voluntary and effects uncertain, and that it is studying which proposals to legislate, while promising to report back on Prinsjesdag.
No overview is available of the number of investments, patents and capacity in chemical recycling and bio-based plastics production.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van het aantal investeringen, patenten en capaciteit van chemische recycling en biogebaseerde productie van plastics.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over de invulling van de 10%-korting bij het niet overhevelen specifieke uitkeringen en de bescherming van de financiële positie van medeoverheden

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the 10% budget cut kept in place when a specific grant is not transferred respects the motion requiring no negative effects on municipalities' and provinces' finances, and how lower performance requirements are verified. The minister replied that the cut is applied via a framework (alternative funding, lower performance requirements or agreements on efficiency), that it should not burden subnational governments, and that departments will inform parliament in autumn 2025 without a commitment before Prinsjesdag.

In my letter of 21 May 2025 I indicated that the above is in line with the motion by MP Wingelaar, since the described route is aimed at preventing negative consequences for the financial position of subnational governments.

In mijn brief van 21 mei 2025 heb ik aangegeven dat het bovenstaande in lijn is met de motie van het lid Wingelaar 6 , aangezien de beschreven route immers gericht is op het voorkomen van negatieve gevolgen voor de financiële positie van medeoverheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over gebrekkige handhaving van milieuregels in Noord- en Midden-Limburg

An MP asked the state secretary why Northern and Central Limburg lacks a full environmental enforcement service (omgevingsdienst) and whether the region will meet robustness criteria in time. The state secretary agreed this is undesirable, said responsibility lies with the municipalities and provinces as owners, and noted the region is not expected to be robust by 1 April 2026, with IenW monitoring and supporting the process.
The Ministry of IenW supports the steps the province is taking within the framework of IBT; this has also been stated in official contact between officials and the province of Limburg.
Het Ministerie van IenW ondersteunt de stappen die de provincie zet in het kader van IBT, dit is in ambtelijk contact tussen ambtenaren met de provincie Limburg ook benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wingelaar en Gabriëls over strengere regels voor het gebruik van Beaumix

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports on Beaumix, a secondary building material, and calls for stricter rules, following RIVM and Court of Audit warnings. The State Secretary replied that the findings will be incorporated into the ongoing review of soil regulation, that Beaumix may continue to be used under current quality standards if applied correctly, that lab results from Stein may be considered if representative, and that Parliament will be informed in summer 2025.
Should research show that these quality requirements need to be tightened, I will of course take that into account in implementing the aforementioned motion.
Mocht uit onderzoek blijken dat deze kwaliteitseisen moeten worden aangescherpt, dan zal ik dat vanzelfsprekend meewegen in de uitvoering van bovengenoemde motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wingelaar, Van Vroonhoven en Omtzigt over het artikel 'Rechter wijst meer dan ?500.000 toe aan gedupeerde vader in toeslagenaffaire'

Three NSC MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling awarding over 500,000 euros to a victim of the childcare benefits scandal, and about the handling of supplementary damages claims, appeals, lawsuits and payouts. The State Secretary answered in detail with figures on claims, decisions, appeals, pending cases and penalty payments, while noting the Van Dam advisory commission's findings are still awaited and the ruling is under study.
The cabinet has made agreements with municipalities, OTB and IPW for referring parents for urgent assistance.
Het kabinet heeft afspraken gemaakt met gemeenten, OTB en IPW voor het aandragen van ouders voor urgentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over het artikel 'Kankerverwekkend gas lekte weg bij Sabic’?

An MP asks the state secretary about reports of a butadiene leak at Sabic in Chemelot and whether the government's reassurances on health impacts and cumulative risks are credible. The state secretary answers that incidents were reported and handled by the province and regional environmental service, that limits were not exceeded, and that RIVM will run an exploratory health study expected next year.
The reporting system worked well in this case.
Het systeem van melden heeft in deze casus goed gewerkt.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Kostić, Wingelaar, Koekkoek, Gabriëls, Bamenga en Van Kent over het RTL Nieuws onderzoek 'Meer ziekmakende stoffen in de lucht bij 125 bedrijven door heel Nederland’

Six MPs asked the state secretary about an RTL Nieuws investigation showing rising emissions of hazardous substances (including PAK) at many industrial firms, and about the effectiveness of the ZZS minimisation duty, reporting errors at Tata Steel and the role of competent authorities. The state secretary answered that enforcement and assessment of emissions data is primarily the responsibility of competent authorities such as the provinces and environmental services, pointed to the Impulsprogramma Chemische Stoffen and the Actieagenda, promised to consult competent authorities and to ask RIVM and the Expertgroep for a reassessment, and declined to act on several requests because they fall under other bodies.
The competent authority may use all means available to it, including filing a criminal complaint; I do not interfere further in this.
Het bevoegde gezag kan gebruik maken van alle middelen die hen ter beschikking staan, waaronder het doen van aangifte, ik meng mij hier verder niet in.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Soepboer en Wingelaar naar aanleiding van het bericht “Grote gevolgen gezonken vrachtschip: fabrieken op Chemelot dreigen stil te vallen en directeur Sappi in Maastricht vreest productiest

Two MPs asked the minister about the Julianakanaal closure after a sunken ship, the compensation committee, works progress, bypass route reliability, and business damage. The minister answered that works are on schedule for reopening by end April 2025, that a compensation committee exists but damage from the ship collision falls under the shipowner's liability rather than Rijkswaterstaat compensation.
Basically there is therefore no ground for damages or compensation by Rijkswaterstaat solely as a result of this calamity.
In de basis is er dan ook geen grond voor schadevergoeding of nadeelcompensatie door Rijkswaterstaat enkel als gevolg van deze calamiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar  over het bericht uit de Telegraaf van 4 oktober jl. 'Boosheid om ophoping waterschapsbelasting: Rekening van €1200 binnen zeven maanden tijd’

An MP asked the Minister about a water board (Amstel, Gooi en Vecht) sending multiple overdue tax bills after ICT failures, and about provincial oversight, hardship, and citizens' rights. The minister answered that the provinces, not the ministry, supervise water boards, that the board offers instalments, relaxed waiver rules and restrained enforcement, and that the ministry has no authority to intervene because the issue does not concern sound water management.
Provincial executives are responsible for carrying out supervision of the water board and therefore for how they communicate with the board about it.
Gedeputeerde staten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het toezicht op het waterschap en hiermee ook voor de wijze waarop zij hierover communiceert met het waterschap.

m: Amendement van het lid Van der Wal over €100.000 extra voor de ondersteuning van het Veteranen Platform
Shifts 100,000 euro within the defence budget article to support the Veterans Platform.
With this amendment 100,000 euro is made available additionally for supporting the Veterans Platform
Met dit amendement wordt € 100.000 extra beschikbaar gesteld voor de ondersteuning van het Veteranen Platform
Motie van het lid Van der Wal over inventariseren hoeveel objecten er nu in depots van de Nederlandse musea liggen en uitwerken hoe musea die kunst extern en internationaal kunnen aanbieden
Asks the government to inventory how many objects lie in Dutch museum depots and to work out how museums can lend stored art domestically and abroad.
requests the government to inventory how many objects are currently in the depots of Dutch museums
verzoekt de regering te inventariseren hoeveel objecten er op dit moment in depots van de Nederlandse musea liggen
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het gebruik van de mobiele schaapskooi ter bescherming van schapen

An MP asked the ministers about a mobile sheep shelter as a wolf-protection measure and whether it can help meet the legal duty to protect livestock from predators. The minister confirmed the duty, said a policy rule for the open standard is being drafted with broad stakeholder involvement, and noted that provinces run subsidy schemes, while declining to provide data on how many farmers currently take adequate measures.
Currently I am working on a policy rule for filling in the open norm on protection of animals not kept in a building.
Momenteel werk ik aan een beleidsregel voor de invulling van de open norm over bescherming van dieren die niet in een gebouw worden gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Chakor over de gaswinning boven Schiermonnikoog

MPs Bushoff and Chakor asked why the N05-A gas extraction permit above Schiermonnikoog was granted despite earlier refusal, why ONE-Dyas may proceed while appeals are pending, and about compensation, German permits and fossil-fuel planning. The minister answered that the permits were repaired after court rulings on nitrogen and harbour porpoise, that interim relief lifted the suspension so production can proceed pending appeal, and that the project is justified by supply security and lower emissions.
On 18 April 2024 the Hague District Court ruled that the environmental permit for the platform was insufficiently substantiated on two aspects and annulled the permit on those two points.
Op 18 april 2024 heeft de Rechtbank Den Haag geoordeeld dat de omgevingsvergunning voor het platform op twee aspecten onvoldoende onderbouwd is en heeft de vergunning op deze twee punten vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de aangenomen Europese Natuurherstelwet

An MP from D66 asked the minister how the EU Nature Restoration Regulation affects Dutch nature, food security, permitting, and the funding for the countryside, and when the national restoration plan will be presented. The state secretary answered that the regulation can help nature over time, that the government will implement it without national add-ons, that the cabinet is still working out the policy and funding, and that the national restoration plan will be drafted with a deadline of 1 September 2026.
The cabinet is currently further elaborating the coalition agreement into a government programme. I will inform the House later about my plans.
Momenteel is het kabinet het Hoofdlijnenakkoord verder aan het uitwerken tot een regeerprogramma. Ik informeer de Kamer later over mijn plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht dat in Nederland tussen 2013-2022 de oppervlakte van natuur- en bosgebieden met bijna 2,5 procent is afgenomen

An MP asked the minister how nature area fell by 15,800 hectares between 2013 and 2022 despite the Natuurnetwerk target, and about related biodiversity and Natuurpact questions. The minister replied that Statistics Netherlands found data inconsistencies so the figures cannot yet be relied on, that the NNN area in fact grew, and that the government will push provinces to meet the 80,000 hectare target while withholding the detailed answers until corrected data are available.
It is therefore not possible to draw conclusions from the report. As soon as the CBS has formulated a consistent time series, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Het is dus niet mogelijk om conclusies te ontlenen aan het bericht. Zodra het CBS een consistente tijdsreeks heeft geformuleerd, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het krantenartikel ‘Meer sleepnetvisserij in Nederlandse natuurgebieden dan in zes andere landen bij elkaar’

An MP asked the ministers about a report showing heavy bottom-trawling in Dutch Natura 2000 marine sites and its impact on seabed biodiversity. The ministers confirmed the trawling hours roughly but could not verify the Dutch share or the comparison with other countries, and pointed to EU exclusive competence and the slow Article 11 procedure while committing to work toward 15% seabed protection by 2030.
For sea fisheries (so outside the 3-mile zone), the European Union has exclusive competence to take measures, to the exclusion of the member states.
Voor de zeevisserij (dus buiten de 3 mijlszone) geldt dat de Europese Unie exclusief (dus met uitsluiting van de lidstaten) bevoegd is om maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Bamenga over het bericht Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels

Two D66 MPs asked the nitrogen minister whether Schiphol's permit, built on buying out farms, breached additionality rules and PAS case law, and whether it could be revised before court rulings. The minister says she applied the same additionality test as for other external netting and that the permit is under appeal, so she cannot comment on substance.
Given the ongoing appeal procedure, I cannot make substantive statements on this.
Gelet op de lopende beroepsprocedure kan ik hierover geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Grinwis en Bromet over het bericht ‘Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels’

MPs Vedder, Grinwis and Bromet asked whether the minister relaxed nitrogen rules for Schiphol against advice from senior officials, and why PAS-melders are treated differently. The minister denies overriding advice, says the same extern salderen policy was applied to private parties, acknowledges the Raad van State ruling now requires additionality checks, and commits to broadening the PAS-melder legalisation approach.
No, that is not the case. I want to emphasise that no exception was made when issuing the definitive nature permit for Schiphol.
Nee, dat is niet het geval. Ik wil benadrukken geen enkele uitzondering te hebben gemaakt bij afgifte van de definitieve natuurvergunning voor Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Bromet, Vedder en Holman over het rondetafelgesprek Wolf van 4 april 2024

MPs from four parties asked the ministers about LIFE and Regional Development Fund subsidy options for wolf coexistence measures raised at a round-table meeting, and whether these had been examined. The minister replied that LIFE and EFRO funding are possible in principle but no concrete study was done, provinces are responsible, and she will raise the options with the provinces and set up a long-term coexistence vision.
I will bring these options to the attention of the provinces.
Ik zaldeze mogelijkheden onder de aandacht brengen bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en De Hoop over drie recente vonnissen met betrekking tot de handhavingsprocedures van Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport en Rotterdam-The Hague Airport

MPs Bromet and De Hoop asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about three court rulings that found the refusal of enforcement requests against Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport and Rotterdam The Hague Airport inadequately reasoned, and about external nitrogen offsetting, the PAS legalisation programme and general national nitrogen measures. The Minister answered that she will reconsider the objection decisions taking the court's reasoning into account, will not appeal, is tightening external offsetting rules and broadening PAS-melder options, but declined to give a full list of affected projects and did not commit to new enforcement against other permits.
The court ruled that my decision not to impose appropriate measures was insufficiently reasoned.
De rechtbank heeft geoordeeld dat ik mijn besluit om geen passende maatregelen op te leggen onvoldoende heb gemotiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over het Akkoord voor de Noordzee

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about Greenpeace leaving the North Sea Consultation, gas extraction acceleration versus the Paris Agreement, and delays in closing parts of the North Sea to bottom trawling. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the government stays within Paris-aligned targets, that accelerated extraction only shifts production forward in time, and that the 2023 trawling closure target was missed but will be pursued via an EU procedure with a proposal by end 2024.
I have told the NZO that our aim is to submit the joint recommendation (to reach 13.7%) to the European Commission by the end of 2024.
Ik heb aan het NZO aangegeven dat onze inzet is om de gezamenlijke aanbeveling (om te komen tot 13,7%) uiterlijk eind 2024 bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Van der Plas over het artikel 'Toekomst van Gorsselse melkveehouders onzeker, want in het bos staan eiken in plaats van iepen'

MPs Pierik and Van der Plas asked the minister about a Trouw article on Gorssel dairy farmers facing uncertainty because the Eester Loo forest was reclassified as beech-oak rather than elm-ash, and about the wijzigingsbesluit that added protected habitat types. The minister answered at length on the process, the reclassification, its effects on nitrogen permits, legal certainty and support measures, while stating that existing permits are not affected and that little room exists to ease the rules.
I do not see those possibilities, because the Netherlands is already sailing very close to the wind in this area.
Die mogelijkheden zie ik niet, omdat Nederland op dit vlak al scherp aan de wind zeilt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Teunissen over het artikel 'Nederland vormt belangrijke spil in illegale handel bedreigde diersoorten'

MPs Eerdmans and Teunissen asked the ministers how the government responds to a SPOTS/IUCN/Bears in Mind/ELI report that the Netherlands is a hub for illegal trade in endangered species used in traditional Chinese medicine, and what enforcement steps follow. The government answered that one suspect has been arrested by the NVWA investigation service, that enforcement is ongoing, that budgets and capacity are constrained but not quantified, and that it will pursue EU and international coordination while declining to give operational details of ongoing investigations.
In the interest of the investigation, the NVWA-IOD does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
In het belang van de opsporing doet de NVWA-IOD geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de Nationale Databank Flora en Fauna

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked the minister about access to the Nationale Databank Flora en Fauna (NDFF), its costs, data control, and alleged overstatement of nitrogen-sensitive habitat on the Veluwe. The minister answered that open access is being prepared but legal anchoring means full opening is delayed to 2025, while disputing the claimed mapping discrepancies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels’

MPs Hertzberger and Olger van Dijk asked the government why Schiphol's nitrogen permit allowed external netting without an additionality requirement, why 500,000 flights were permitted despite advice pointing to 440,000, and about nearby habitat overload. The Minister of Nature and Nitrogen answered that the permit followed a technical assessment and that the reference situations and external netting were applied as before, with limited nitrogen increases, while partly deferring to other responsibilities and procedures.
I was advised by officials to make the decision, as I did in September 2023.
Mij is ambtelijk geadviseerd om het besluit te nemen, zoals ik dat in september 2023 genomen heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de onlangs openbaar gemaakte Woo-documenten “stikstofadvies Remkes” deel I-II-III

Two MPs from BBB asked the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen, on behalf of the Minister of Agriculture, about the released Woo documents on the Remkes nitrogen advice, covering the MOB letter, bank and supply-chain steering, buffer strips, socio-economic impact methodology, and permit revocation. The government answered that the MOB letter is public, that the Remkes report took its own line, that the Landbouwakkoord failed so the concept commitments are not binding and no instruments to secure supply-chain contributions have yet been developed, and that provinces are not obliged to use the socio-economic impact method or specific instruments.
The agreement did not come about and therefore the draft agreements are not binding.
Het akkoord is er niet gekomen 7 en daarmee zijn de conceptafspraken niet bindend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over het aanpassen van antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen over de landelijke vrijstellingslijst en het toch niet uitvoeren van een aangenomen motie, vlak na gesprekken met de jagers

An MP asks why the minister's answers to written questions on the national exemption list were changed after lobby groups from the hunting sector met ministry officials, and why a motion to remove threatened species from the list has not been implemented. The minister admits a wrong version was sent by mistake, says the revised answers reflect the need for more consultation with provinces, and commits to preparing withdrawal of the exemptions for rabbit, wood pigeon and jay, with a report to parliament in June.
Implementing the motion is, however, more complex than foreseen in advance.
Het uitvoeren van de motie is echter complexer dan vooraf voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het artikel ‘Overijssel voorlopig niet van stikstofslot: boeren en projecten langer in onzekerheid?’

An MP asked the minister about stalled permitting in Overijssel and the PAS-melders awaiting legalisation under the nitrogen policy, including how many have been legalised and when the piekbelasting scheme will deliver results. The minister answered that external netting is only very limitedly allowed, that 2488 legalisation requests exist with most still pending, and that no precise timeline or deposition reduction can yet be given, while promising a broader action plan.
It is still too early in the implementation process to give a picture of the potential nitrogen deposition reduction of the peak-load approach.
Het is nog te vroeg in het uitvoeringsproces om een beeld te geven van de potentiële stikstofdepositiereductie van de aanpak piekbelasting.
Antwoord op antwoorden op de vragen van het lid Pierik over de relatie tussen stikstofemissie en stikstofdepositie

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen how nitrogen emissions from wild animals relate to deposition in Natura 2000 areas, and whether their impact is included in calculations and nature-target analyses. The minister answered that wild animal emissions are estimated at about 1.5% of Dutch ammonia emissions and under 1% of deposition, so no specific policy measures are planned, while acknowledging data gaps and noting that dog-related effects are a local management matter.
The contribution of wild animals is thus about 1.5% of total emissions at 1.9 kilotons.
De bijdrage van wilde dieren is met 1,9 kiloton dus ongeveer 1,5% op het totaal aan emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel “Wadplaten verdrinken, schelpen leggen het loodje: opwarming bedreigt Waddennatuur''

An MP from D66 asks the Ministers of Nature and Nitrogen and of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government's Wadden Sea policy squares with research showing climate change is salinising the Wadden Sea, drowning tidal flats and threatening its ecosystem, and how this bears on gas drilling permits near Ternaard. The ministers answer that climate pressure is acknowledged, point to the Beleidskader Natuur Waddenzee and a range of short- and long-term measures, and say a separate permit decision on the drilling will take into account the advisory assessment.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate is currently conducting a study into the sediment-supplying capacity of the Vlie storage basin.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat heeft op dit moment een studie lopen naar het sediment leverend vermogen in de komberging Vlie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Bromet en Bushoff over het rapport ‘De Europees- en Internationaalrechtelijke status van de Waddenzee’

Opposition MPs Chakor, Bromet and Bushoff asked the government about the Waddenacademie report on the European and international legal status of the Wadden Sea, including whether the Ternaard gas extraction permit was tested against World Heritage obligations and the fragmentation of Wadden Sea governance. The Minister replied that the report is still being studied, that the permit is assessed under the Nature Conservation Act with only indirect World Heritage considerations, and that the landsadvocaat's advice cannot be shared because it could harm the state's litigation position.
I cannot share this advice with you now, because it could harm the position of the state in any future legal proceedings.
Dit advies kan ik nu niet met u delen, omdat dit de positie van de staat in een eventueel proces zou kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over olievervuiling op Bonaire

An MP from the SP asked the cabinet about oil pollution on the coast of Bonaire, including the environmental damage, the source (possibly the abandoned tanker Gulfstream), and whether the owner can be held liable. The government answered that the impact on nature appears limited for now, the long-term damage is not yet known, the situation is said to be under control, and liability is still being examined because the ship's owner has not been identified.
It is being examined whether there are possibilities to recover the damage.
Er wordt bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om schade te kunnen verhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het artikel 'Foei, edelherten en wilde zwijnen piesen stikstof'

An MP asks the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about claims that wild animals such as deer and wild boar produce significant nitrogen emissions, and whether waterfowl undermine water quality and Natura 2000 goals. The minister answers that wild animal ammonia is about 1.5 percent of Dutch emissions, with limited impact on nitrogen policy, water quality designations and habitat goals, and promises no change to the vulnerable-area designations for now.
It therefore has a very limited impact on the objectives of nitrogen policy and the conservation of Natura 2000 areas.
Het heeft daarmee een zeer beperkte impact op de doelstellingen van het stikstofbeleid en het behoud van Natura 2000-gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het toepassen van een rekenkundige ondergrens in AERIUS Calculator

MP Hertzberger asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen why a 25 km calculation cut-off was adopted in AERIUS Calculator instead of a minimum deposition threshold, how much deposition it shifts, what compensating measures would be needed, and whether the IPO round-table records and the interbestuurlijke verkenning can be shared. The minister answered that the 25 km limit applies to all sources on modelling grounds, that a legally defensible lower threshold still requires further research with results expected mid-2024, and committed to sharing the verkenning results and the round-table minutes.
I will inform your House as soon as the results are available.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren zodra de resultaten beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Varkensboer die voor miljoenen is uitgekocht, wil op andere plek uitbreiden'

The MP Paternotte asked the minister whether a bought-out pig farmer may expand on another, family-owned site and whether the national buyout schemes can prevent this, including the ban on restarting elsewhere and the unused permit space. The minister answered that the ban only covers new locations, that the subsidy can be used for expansion on an existing permitted site, that the schemes are not designed around other sites of the same company, and that extra budget is needed to honour all applications.
I will inform your House more fully in the short term.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn nader informeren.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over een advies door een kinderverpleegkundige aan het SKGZ

An MP asked the minister about a children's nurse's assessment for a case of intensive child care, the applicable rules on indication and usual care under the Zorgverzekeringswet, and whether annual re-indication should be abolished. The minister replied that indication must meet V&VN standards with an extra training requirement, that usual-care rules allow contextual judgement, that professional autonomy and the pgb framework apply, that a toolbox is in preparation, and that the motion-Sazias question will be addressed in a later letter.
It is not for me to give a judgement on the quality of indications or re-assessments in specific situations.
Het is niet aan mij om in specifieke situaties een oordeel te geven over de kwaliteit van indicatiestellingen of herbeoordelingen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aanschaf van beademingsapparatuur die niet bruikbaar is op de intensive care

Two SP MPs asked whether part of the first 100 ventilators from Philips, and planned Demcon machines, are unsuitable for ICU use, and asked about expert advice, serial numbers, distribution lists and disposables. The minister answered only by referring to a COVID-19 update letter, providing no substance on the questions themselves.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the ministers of Medical Care and Economic Affairs and Climate about the purchase of ventilation equipment unusable in intensive care (2020Z06022) have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de ministers voor Medische Zorg en van Economische Zaken en Klimaat over de aanschaf van beademingsapparatuur die niet bruikbaar is op de intensive care ( 2020Z06022 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Van den Berg over de webinar ‘Schouwen door PA en VS: Welbeschouwd een goed idee?!’

MPs Regterschot and Van den Berg asked whether physician assistants and verpleegkundig specialisten could be authorised to perform natural-death inspections (lijkschouw) to relieve doctors, and whether the Wlb should be amended. The minister answered that taakherschikking is not opposed if quality can be shown, that research via ZonMw and a further exploration this autumn will be undertaken, and that the need for a Wlb amendment will be considered.
Before taking the step to prepare the necessary amendment of article 3 of the Wlb, thorough research must first be done into the possibilities for task redistribution.

Alvorens de stap te zetten tot voorbereiding van de benodigde wetswijziging van artikel 3 van de Wlb, zal daarom eerst gedegen onderzoek moeten worden gedaan naar de mogelijkheden tot taakherschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Voetbaltv daagt privacywaakhond AP voor de rechter om uitblijven besluit’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the Dutch privacy regulator AP taking VoetbalTV to court over its failure to issue a decision, and about inconsistent GDPR enforcement across EU states. The minister answered that the AP acts independently, that consistency is pursued via the EDPB, that a decision is now before the court so the AP cannot comment on its content, and that the matter will be raised with the AP after the summer recess.
Under Article 52 of the GDPR, each supervisory authority acts with complete independence in performing its tasks and exercising its powers under the regulation.

Op grond van artikel 52 van de AVG treedt elke toezichthoudende autoriteit volledig onafhankelijk op bij de uitvoering van de taken en de uitoefening van de bevoegdheden die haar overeenkomstig deze verordening zijn toegewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘AED-netwerk is uitgebreid, maar nog niet dekkend’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about AED coverage, noting that only about 22,000 AEDs are registered with the HartslagNU call system despite many more existing in the Netherlands, and asked what actions would expand registration and training of civilian responders. The minister replied that many AEDs are indoors or poorly accessible, that coverage improved in 2020, that municipalities are responsible for AED policy, and that HartslagNU aims to grow its responder network, without committing to new concrete government measures.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for AED policy.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beleid rond AED’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het advies van de Gezondheidsraad betreffende de gezondheidsrisico’s van landbouwgif en de kabinetsreactie hierop

An MP asks the government to confirm that the Health Council advises intensifying existing pesticide sustainability plans, to explain the gap with past targets, and to adopt stricter EU approval criteria and spray-free zones. The minister responds that the Toekomstvisie 2030 implementation programme will intensify efforts with annual monitoring, that targets from Gezonde Groei remain in force, and that spray-free zones lack the required scientific basis.
This is provided for in the implementation programme accompanying the Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030, which I will send to your House in September.
Hierin voorziet het uitvoeringsprogramma bij de «Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030», dat ik uw Kamer in september zal doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over gebrek aan vergoeding van taperingstrips door CZ bij suïcidaliteit

MP Van Gerven asked why insurer CZ refuses to reimburse compounded tapering strips for a patient who became suicidal during a protocolled antidepressant taper, and whether such patients are entitled to tailored care. The minister declined to judge the individual case, said reimbursement depends on rational pharmacotherapy criteria applied first by insurers, and noted that insurers' pharmacists work under accountable medical advisers and that insurers will reimburse taper medication case by case.
It is not for me to assess an individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om een individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de goedkeuring van Remdesivir in Europa

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the European approval of remdesivir, including weak mortality benefit, side-effect data, researcher ties to Gilead, pricing and profits during the pandemic. The minister answered that EMA and CBG assessed efficacy and safety, that a conditional marketing authorisation was granted, that the price should be reasonable but market pricing is not for the minister to judge, and that the company's stock value is not a matter for government.

It is the task of the European Medicines Agency (EMA) and the Dutch College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) to carry out an independent, substantive assessment of a medicine's efficacy and safety before it may be placed on the European or Dutch market.

Het is de taak van de European Medicines Agency (EMA) en het Nederlandse College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) om een onafhankelijke, inhoudelijke beoordeling van de werkzaamheid en veiligheid van een geneesmiddel te doen alvorens een geneesmiddel op de Europese, dan wel Nederlandse markt mag worden gebracht.
Àntwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Groot alarm bij de bloedbank: alweer een zak vol zwarte deeltjes’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of black particles in donated plasma at Sanquin and the manufacturer Haemonetics, including why the 2011 incidents and later foreign warnings led to no further action. The minister answered that the IGJ was informed in 2011, the defective centrifuge bowls were recalled, the Dutch equipment was judged lower risk, and the IGJ is now in talks with Sanquin and Haemonetics and has requested the confidential report.
The IGJ has asked Haemonetics additional questions and requested the report.
De IGJ heeft bij Haemonetics aanvullende vragen gesteld en het rapport opgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over de berichten ‘Thialf verder in de problemen nu tekort oploopt tot 1 miljoen euro’ en ‘Wie betaalt de medailles van Sven en Sjinkie’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the financial continuity of the Thialf skating venue, a shortfall of about 1 million euro, and the funding of top sport infrastructure. The minister acknowledged the deficit and referred to a pending Mulier Institute study, existing NOC*NSF/CTO funding for ice rental, and a recovery plan being prepared, without committing to new funds.
I think it is too early to make any commitments on that at this moment.
Ik vind het te vroeg om daar op dit moment al toezeggingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Gemeentepolis verdwijnt langzaam. Wat is er aan de hand?’

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care why municipal health insurance packages for low-income residents are disappearing, whether the government will advocate for them, whether it will research the effects of their loss, and why it did not respond to Heerde's letter. The minister replies that the municipal package is one instrument among others, that insurers and municipalities are primarily responsible for collective arrangements, that two studies will be sent to parliament in autumn, and that the government did respond to Heerde in January 2020.
I expect to be able to send both studies to your House this autumn.
Beide onderzoeken verwacht ik dit najaar naar uw Kamer te kunnen sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de reactie van het kabinet op het 'Draaiboek triage op basis van niet medische overwegingen voor IC-opname ten tijde van fase 3 in de COVID-19 pandemie'

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the cabinet why the Minister for Medical Care signed the June 2020 letter on the triage draft for ICU admission in COVID-19 phase 3, whether it is an ethical matter, how the draft was prepared, and what the cabinet's role and alternatives are. The government answered that medical care falls under the Medical Care minister, that the cabinet rejects age-only selection as discriminatory and favours first come, first served, and that it will await a broad societal dialogue before deciding whether to confirm the draft or use regulation.
I am awaiting the broad societal discussion now, but if necessary the general prohibition of discrimination will be clarified in legislation or regulations.
Ik wacht de brede maatschappelijke discussie nu af, maar zo nodig zal in wet- of regelgeving het algemene discriminatieverbod worden verduidelijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de financiering voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek voor vaccinontwikkeling

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked why COVID-19 vaccine research funding through ZonMw starts late, whether the budget is too small, who assesses proposals, and whether private vaccine development could inflate prices or deny supply to the Netherlands. Minister De Jonge answered that funding was raised to 40 million euro for the ZonMw programme and 67.5 million euro overall, that assessment follows published procedures, and that he does not share concerns about price inflation or supply refusal.
The RIVM delivered this scan in the first week of May.
Het RIVM heeft deze scan de eerste week van mei opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'ZN weigert coronaschade ziekenhuizen volledig te compenseren'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that health insurers refuse to fully compensate hospitals for COVID-19 damage, and about their earlier pledge to cover all costs. The minister replied that insurers and hospital associations agreed a compensation scheme neutralising COVID-19 effects on hospital revenue and costs, including a hardship clause, but that the total amounts and damage are not yet known, and declined further state financial support.
It is not yet known what amount is involved in the scheme and how large the COVID-19 damage to hospitals is.
Het is nog niet bekend welk bedrag er met de regeling gemoeid is en hoe groot de coronaschade is voor ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over onduidelijkheid rond de voorraad aan mondkapjes

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Medical Care about a study showing faulty face masks in care homes, whether supplies are sufficient across care settings, how masks are distributed, the handling of MP Marijnissen's motion on professional discretion, mask quality standards and domestic production. The Minister answers that supply is sufficient for current demand with a reserve stock, that the LCH distributes equipment, that the RIVM guidelines were loosened for professionals, and that EU-level quality standards are being pursued.
I am in favour of good-quality face masks with a good level of protection.
Ik ben een voorstander van kwalitatief goede mondkapjes met een goed beschermingsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het niet vergoeden van explantatie van borstimplantaten

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister for Medical Care why insurers refuse to reimburse breast implant explantation for patients with systemic complaints, despite supporting medical opinions, and why patients must pursue lengthy appeals. The Minister replied that insurers assess reimbursement case by case under the Zorgverzekeringswet, that disputes can go to the SKGZ, and that he will press insurers to discuss with the Zorginstituut when explantation counts as insured care.
It is primarily the task of health insurers to determine which care may be counted as insured care.
Het is primair de taak van zorgverzekeraars om te bepalen welke zorg tot verzekerde zorg gerekend mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Patiënten de dupe van medicijnwisseling'

MPs Van Gerven (SP) and Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Medical Care about patients harmed by forced drug switching, the CBG list of drugs not to be switched, the cost savings from switching, the stalled agreement with parties, drug shortages, purchasing by insurers, and national procurement. The minister answered that switching is handled case by case, a CBG list is coming this year, savings are substantial, shortages are a global problem addressed by a five-month stock and temporary measures, and no conclusion on centralised purchasing has been reached.
I have asked the College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) to draw up a list of medicines that should preferably not be switched.
Ik heb het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) gevraagd een lijst op te stellen van geneesmiddelen die bij voorkeur niet gewisseld zouden mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Fysiotherapeuten maken zich druk over tekortschietende corona-compensatie: “Dit is een vitaal beroep”’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about physiotherapists' concerns over the COVID-19 continuity contribution from health insurers, including its conditions, reduced reimbursement for catch-up care, data disclosure and the possibility of insurers refusing payment. The minister replied that the scheme is a necessary, separate arrangement agreed with insurers, that catch-up care is paid at a lower rate to avoid double payment, and that insurers must be accountable but may be asked for disclosure only proportionately.
The conditions that health insurers attach to the support they provide must be verifiable.
De voorwaarden die zorgverzekeraars stellen aan de steun die zij bieden, moeten controleerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de onzekerheid bij fysiotherapeuten als gevolg van de continuiteitsbijdrage

Ploumen asked the Minister about legal uncertainty among physiotherapists over the ZN continuity contribution, the lower reimbursement rate for catch-up care, and whether physiotherapists would turn to the NOW scheme instead. The Minister defended the scheme as avoiding double payment, said he is unaware of physiotherapists shifting to NOW, and stated he is in ongoing talks with insurers.
I am in continuous discussion with the health insurers about the continuity contribution, the restart of regular care and catch-up care.
Antwoord 7 Ik ben doorlopend in gesprek met de zorgverzekeraars over de continuiteïtsbijdrage, het opstarten van de reguliere zorg en de inhaalzorg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet en Renkema over de berichten ‘Verpleeghuizen wilden al vroeg testen maar werden geweigerd’, 'Protocol voor contactonderzoek kent twee grote zwakke plekken' en ’Inval-minis

Greens MPs asked the health minister about nursing homes being denied COVID-19 testing, the contact-tracing protocol, staffing needs, and the procurement of protective equipment through the national LCH consortium. The minister answered most questions with figures and explanations, while declining to give some data (such as the Germany, Belgium and France mask purchase figures) and deferring on the one-by-one timing request.
No, I do not have this overview at the moment.
Nee, dit overzicht heb ik op dit moment niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Ploumen en Ellemeet over de Inclusieve Vaccin Alliantie

Three MPs asked the Minister of Health how the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance relates to the COVID-19 pool and ACT, whether it undermines global access, and how prices and pharmaceutical deals would be controlled. The minister answered that the initiatives are complementary, that the Alliance includes solidarity with low- and middle-income countries, and that price and supply agreements are being pursued, but gave no firm commitments on joining the pool or conditioning public funding.
I believe several paths must be pursued to make a safe and effective COVID-19 vaccine available as quickly as possible.
Ik ben van mening dat er verschillende paden bewandeld moeten worden om zo snel mogelijk een veilig en effectief vaccin tegen COVID-19 beschikbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het jaarverslag van Witte Kruis over 2018

The MP asks whether the legal structure of Witte Kruis (ambulance service) is clear, why its equity of 13.1 million euro is not reinvested, what the 'other reserves' are, and whether money parked there could benefit the foreign owner Transdev. The minister explains the ownership chain, states that RAVs must hold sufficient equity under the Tijdelijke wet ambulancezorg, that the supervisory board must ensure no funds are withdrawn, that Transdev is the shareholder, and that no profit has been distributed since 2007; the answer to the final question on timing is that it could not be met.
The supervisory board must ensure this happens and that no funds are withdrawn from equity, which could jeopardise the continuity of ambulance care.

De Raad van Commissarissen dient erop toe te zien dat dit gebeurt en dat er geen gelden aan het eigen vermogen worden onttrokken, waardoor de continuïteit van de ambulancezorg in het geding kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het weer opschalen van de reguliere ziekenhuiszorg

MP Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the slow restart of regular hospital care after COVID-19, including waiting lists, digital care, staff involvement, hospital finances and early warning of financial risk. The minister answered that hospitals bear primary responsibility, the NZa coordinates regionally, digitalisation and finance arrangements are being developed, and a plan for IC capacity is forthcoming.
It is primarily the responsibility of healthcare providers themselves to restart care and to use the possibilities for their own organisation.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf om de zorg weer op te starten en de mogelijkheden daartoe voor de eigen organisatie te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht dat Amsterdam streeft naar nul nieuwe hiv-infecties in 2026

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Medical Care about Amsterdam's goal of zero new HIV infections by 2026, PrEP subsidy capacity and waiting lists, and whether a national plan is needed. The minister welcomed Amsterdam's ambition but said zero new infections is not achievable in the short term, rejected a dedicated national plan and expansion of the PrEP scheme for now, and pointed to a pilot evaluation and annual report later.
I do not intend to expand the scheme.
Ik heb niet het voornemen de regeling uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat producent coronamedicijn Sanquin mogelijk in de problemen komt

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that Sanquin's plasma products subsidiary SPP may be in trouble, its role in COVID-19 treatment, its finances, state ownership, and possible foreign partners. The minister replies that SPP is not in trouble but seeks a strategic partner, that the state will not take a majority stake, and that Dutch supply of plasma medicines must be guaranteed whatever the outcome.
I am examining what is needed for this, including the role of SPP in it.
Ik onderzoek wat hiervoor nodig is, inclusief de rol van SPP hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de financiële problemen bij Sanquin

An MP asked the minister about Sanquin's financial problems, their effect on COVID-19 plasma research, and the consequences of a possible partnership or takeover of Sanquin Plasma Products by a foreign party. The minister answered that the Stichting Sanquin is not in financial trouble, that research is not delayed, and that Sanquin's statutory tasks would be preserved under any new partner subject to ministerial approval.
The Ministry of VWS has regular contact with the Stichting Sanquin and SPP.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft regelmatig contact met de Stichting Sanquin en SPP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het artikel ‘Helpt ventileren tegen corona? Nederland negeert Duits advies frisse lucht’

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Health Minister about a newspaper article on ventilation against COVID-19, requesting OMT advice, Dutch research on aerogenic transmission, current infection and hospital figures, IFR, the PIENTER study and an evaluation of PCR tests. The minister mostly provided requested figures and referred to RIVM publications and a technical briefing, while declining to answer the question on the unidentified evaluation report as unclear.
For the answers to these questions, I refer you to the letter to the House of 24 June 2020 and its annex: the OMT advice.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen, verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief van 24 juni 2020 en de bijlage van de Kamerbrief: het OMT-advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Van der Staaij over de financiering van ziekenhuizen en over het bericht ‘NVZ: ‘VWS laat ziekenhuizen en verzekeraars vrij worstelen over geld’

MPs Ellemeet and Van der Staaij asked about a 47% fall in hospital care revenue during COVID-19, whether hospitals should be fully compensated, whether all hospitals are protected from bankruptcy, and whether the financing system should change. Minister Van Rijn answered that insurers' continuity payments and cost reimbursement are in place, the NZa supervises insurers, a Contourennota on the system is postponed to autumn, and the regime for larger providers is still being worked out.
With the continuity contribution and extra-cost scheme there is compensation, so hospitals need not get into financial difficulties because of the coronavirus crisis.
Met de continuïteitsbijdrage en meerkostenregeling is er sprake van compensatie, waardoor ziekenhuizen niet vanwege de coronacrisis in financiële problemen hoeven te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over overwerk in relatie tot toeslagen

Two SP MPs asked whether the government will protect care and other essential workers from losing childcare, rent and healthcare allowances because of overtime during the coronavirus crisis, and whether it will give certainty about having to repay allowances. The government answered that it cannot identify overtime effects on household income, that allowances must follow actual income, and that it will focus on communication and individual arrangements rather than a special scheme, apologising for the delay.

The cabinet will now primarily focus on communication to point citizens to the importance of reporting expected changes in household income for 2020 to the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances as soon as possible.

Het kabinet zal nu primair inzetten op communicatie om burgers te wijzen op het belang om verwachte wijzigingen in het huishoudinkomen van 2020 zo snel mogelijk door te geven aan de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over bezoekverboden aan niet-coronapatienten in Limburgse ziekenhuizen

An MP asked whether hospitals in Limburg still maintain visitor bans for non-COVID patients and what the guidelines are. The minister replied that since 2 June no Limburg hospital has a full ban, that hospitals set their own visiting arrangements (one visitor per day at the named hospitals), and that there are no specific national guidelines on visits.
There are no specific guidelines regarding hospital visits for (non-)COVID patients.
Er zijn geen specifieke richtlijnen met betrekking tot ziekenhuisbezoek aan (niet-)coronapatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de productie van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen in Nederland

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister about domestic production of personal protective equipment, including which producers exist, certification capacity for masks in the Netherlands, and whether small firms are treated equally to large ones in procurement via the LCH. The Minister answered that no full registry exists, listed selected contracts and certifying bodies, said the government will not set up its own notified body, and that firms bear the risk of failed certification.
A general overview of all manufacturers of protective equipment in the Netherlands cannot be given, because this is not registered.
Een algemeen overzicht van alle fabrikanten van beschermingsmiddelen in Nederland is niet te geven, omdat dit niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aankoop van vijf miljoen afgekeurde mondkapjes

Two SP MPs asked the Minister why around five million government-purchased face masks were rejected as unfit for care, what their type, financial impact and recovery prospects are, and what happens to them. The Minister said the LCH procurement consortium checks quality at three stages, withholds payment on rejected goods and has no recall insurance, and that the risk to the ministry cannot yet be quantified and rejected masks are being checked for other uses.
The LCH generally pays part of the purchase price in advance, but for part of the purchases no financial obligation was entered into in advance.
Het LCH betaalt, in de regel, vooraf een gedeelte van de koopsom aan, maar voor een deel van de aankopen is vooraf geen financiële verplichting aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het invoeren van een draagplicht voor niet-functionele mondmaskers in het openbaar vervoer

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked how a mandatory face-covering rule in public transport would be enforced, and questioned why non-medical masks need no CE marking or minimum quality standards and why masks are not provided free of charge.
