Minister Bruins answered that enforcement runs through existing transport supervisors without checking mask type, that NEN is drafting recommendations for non-medical masks, and that people are responsible for buying their own masks, with VAT lowered to 0%.
People themselves are responsible for purchasing a face mask.
Mensen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het aanschaffen van een mondkapje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over de zwendel met mondmaskers

An MP asked the health minister about reports of chaos and fraud in face-mask purchasing, the quality of masks supplied via the national consortium (LCH), and what happens to rejected masks. The minister answered that quality checks and inspectorate oversight are in place, stock levels are sufficient, and rejected masks are being returned or reassessed, though details are limited.

Oversight by the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority, the Labour Inspectorate, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate and the Fiscal Intelligence and Investigation Service is therefore very important.

Toezicht door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA), Inspectie SZW (iSZW), Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) en het Fiscale inlichtingen- en opsporingsdienst (FIOD) is daarom erg belangrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Bergkamp over de kwaliteit van mondkapjes in verpleeghuizen

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether nursing homes still face shortages of protective equipment and whether the quality of masks bought outside the national LCH channel can be assured, and who is responsible for quality. The minister answered that shortages of face masks have eased, that the LCH has sufficient stock, and that manufacturers and care institutions are responsible for quality, with institutions able to have masks tested and to report quality concerns to the inspectorates.
The LCH indicates that there is sufficient stock to meet current demand for face masks, including for nursing homes.
Het LCH geeft aan dat er voldoende voorraad is om aan de huidige vraag naar mondmaskers te voldoen, ook voor verpleeghuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Niemand wees Marjolein door’ en vergoeding fysiotherapie bij coronapatiënten die niet in het ziekenhuis zijn opgenomen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report that COVID-19 patients not hospitalised cannot get physiotherapy under the chronic-condition indication, and about how multidisciplinary rehabilitation should be funded. The minister confirmed that non-hospitalised patients must pay for physiotherapy themselves unless covered by supplementary insurance, said the Zorginstituut and NZa are advising on the benefit and funding, and promised to inform parliament after the summer recess.
In early May I asked the Zorginstituut Nederland to advise me promptly on measures regarding the entitlement to paramedical care.
Ik heb begin mei het Zorginstituut Nederland gevraagd om mij op korte termijn te adviseren over maatregelen ten aanzien van de aanspraak voor paramedische zorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat fabrikanten van bekkenbodemmatjes aanwezig zijn in de operatiekamers

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that manufacturers' product specialists attend operations involving pelvic floor mesh, including whether patients must consent and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The minister said such presence can support safe care, that patients should be informed though formal consent is not required under the WGBO, and that the IGJ sees no need for a separate investigation.
I am not aware of how often manufacturers are specifically present at the placement of pelvic floor mesh.
Het is mij niet bekend hoe vaak fabrikanten specifiek bij de plaatsing van bekkenbodemmatjes aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Bekende sporters vragen regering om steun voor meer beweging: Sport is essentieel.'

MP Kerstens asked the minister whether the government will act on a call by well-known athletes for more sport and exercise, including structural cooperation and concrete plans with the signatories. The minister replied that sport is important, pointed to the National Sport and Prevention Agreements and local sports accords, offered a meeting with the initiators, and cited a EUR 110 million support package for sports clubs.
Together with State Secretary Blokhuis, I held a conversation with the initiators on 2 June.
Samen met Staatssecretaris Blokhuis heb ik op 2 juni jl een gesprek gevoerd met de initiatiefnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de voorgenomen aanwijzing omtrent de beschikbaarheidbijdrage voor postmortale orgaanuitname bij donoren

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister for Medical Care what is meant by using the current project subsidy as a guideline for the NZa's supplement to the availability fee for post-mortem organ retrieval, and what this means for continuity in staffing and funding from 1 January 2021. The Minister explained that the subsidy amount will be used to set the supplement, that the NZa will re-calibrate the availability fee in its 2021 cost study, and that continuity of staffing and funding is secured.
In 2021 the NZa will again carry out a cost study to recalibrate the level of the availability fee, in which this new item will also be included.
In 2021 zal de NZa 2021 weer een kostenonderzoek uitvoeren om de hoogte van de beschikbaarheidsbijdrage opnieuw te herijken, waarbij ook deze nieuwe post zal worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Geen goedkeuring: zorgverzekeraar betaalt noodhospitaal niet'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether an insurer's refusal to pay for a COVID-19 emergency hospital in Limburg (Maastricht UMC+) and the financing of extra capacity in Rotterdam was justified, and who should pay the roughly 4.5 million euro bill. The Minister had sympathy for the proactive preparation, said no formal reimbursement request had yet been filed, and deferred the financing question to ongoing regional talks rather than resolving it.
I am awaiting the further outcomes of these discussions.
Ik wacht de verdere uitkomsten van deze gesprekken af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de fusieperikelen tussen het streekziekenhuis SKB en het Slingeland ziekenhuis

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the stalled merger between Slingeland and SKB hospitals, including the lack of consultation, transparency, and whether a single hospital was planned. The Minister said the region must keep talking, that Santiz and Menzis have no plan for one hospital, and that the planned regional group has not started; on the joint works council, the Minister said it is for Santiz to decide.
It is for Santiz to establish a works council.
Het is aan het Santiz om een ondernemingsraad (OR) in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten ‘Regio wil hulp minister bij ziekenhuissoap’ en ‘Nieuwe aflevering in ziekenhuissoap: vertrouwen opgezegd in Raad van Toezicht’

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked the minister about the crisis at Santiz hospitals in the Achterhoek, including the withdrawal of confidence by the medical staff, the proposed fusion, and the delayed Slingeland hospital rebuild. The minister said the situation is undesirable, that IGJ placed Santiz under intensified supervision, that a defusion study is being commissioned, and that an independent explorer has been appointed to restart the regional group.
Also, as of 15 May 2020, the IGJ has placed Santiz under intensified supervision.
Ook heeft de IGJ per 15 mei 2020 Santiz onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘SKB blaast fusie met Slingeland af’

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the minister about reports that the SKB hospital in Winterswijk called off its merger with Slingeland (Santiz), including the reasons, the IGJ's role, the new Doetinchem building, and the regional care plan. The minister answered that no final defusion decision has been taken, that a mediator will be appointed to restore stability and start a regional dialogue, that the IGJ has placed Santiz under heightened supervision, and that he has no role in the building plans or in the decision on defusion.
It is up to the Santiz board of directors to give clarity on how they have concretely given and will give shape to the new building. I have no role in this.
Het is aan de raad van bestuur van Santiz om duidelijkheid te geven over hoe zij concreet invulling hebben gegeven en gaan geven aan de nieuwbouw. Ik heb hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over continuïteit en kwaliteit van de ziekenhuiszorg in de regio

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the continuity and quality of hospital care in the Achterhoek region amid conflict between two hospitals, including calls for a ministerial regional role and a regional vision. The Minister answered by appointing a facilitator, noting IGJ supervision of Santiz, and saying the regional process should lead to a shared vision within the current system.
I have informed the House of Representatives about this in a letter of 27 May 2020.
Ik heb de Tweede Kamer hierover geïnformeerd via een brief op 27 mei 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de briefing inzake het testbeleid en de persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the health and medical care ministers about the procurement of personal protective equipment, the shortage claims, and the reasons no additional suppliers were added during COVID-19. Minister Van Rijn answered that the LCH buys from over fifty suppliers, that RIVM guidelines are risk-based rather than shortage-based, and that the LCH is working to expand procurement and transport, but gave no precise delivery dates.
I have instructed the LCH to procure as much protective equipment for healthcare as possible.
Ik heb het LCH opdracht gegeven om maximaal beschermingsmiddelen voor de zorg in te kopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het geneesmiddelenbeleid tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asks the health minister whether postponing the tightening of drug price rules (Wgp) costs the health budget about 150 million euros, whether drug shortages during the coronavirus crisis justify this, whether the minister will enforce stockholding duties, and how preferential purchasing by insurers and a reported amoxicillin shortage are handled. The minister defends the postponement as a general measure for supply continuity, says maximum prices can be lifted for specific shortage drugs, reports that shortage monitoring is in place, and declines to share detailed purchase and stock data about insurers and the amoxicillin batch.
The Shortage and Defect Reporting Point has, as I understand it, received no signals of reduced stock at marketing authorisation holders before 1 April 2020.
Het Meldpunt Geneesmiddelentekorten en -defecten (Meldpunt tekorten) heeft naar ik begrijp geen signalen ontvangen van verminderde voorraad bij handelsvergunninghouders voorafgaand aan 1 april 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het pleidooi voor separate COVID-19Ziekenhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care to respond to a proposal by intensivist Girbes for dedicated COVID-19 hospitals and whether the OMT and government had discussed it. The minister agreed the care system needs reorganising and described four lines of action, leaving the regional concentration of COVID-19 care to regional structures, and stated the proposal was not discussed in the OMT and that hospital federations generally oppose separate COVID-19 hospitals.
The proposal to set up separate hospitals for COVID-19 patients was not discussed in the OMT.
Het pleidooi om aparte ziekenhuizen in te richten voor COVID-19 patiënten is niet besproken in het OMT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het voorkomen van extra kosten voor mensen wier zorg is uitgesteld vanwege de coronacrisis

MP Hijink asked whether patients whose care was postponed by the COVID-19 crisis should be charged the deductible only for the first DBC, to avoid paying twice, and whether the deductible could be abolished. The Minister explained that patients pay only for care actually received, that it is not necessary to exempt follow-up DBCs, and that the NZa advice on follow-up DBCs is expected around summer; abolishing the deductible is not being investigated.
As I indicated above, people only pay deductible for care they have actually received.
Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven betalen mensen alleen eigen risico voor zorg die zij daadwerkelijk hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Westerveld over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor de sportsector

MPs Diertens and Westerveld asked about COVID-19 impacts on sports: whether clubs with payroll staff can use the NOW wage subsidy, whether clubs and event organisers get financial support, municipal compensation and SPUK extension, and how elite athletes without A-status can access aid. The minister answered that the €120 million package and NOW/TOGS/Tozo schemes apply under conditions, that municipalities receive €90 million compensation, that the SPUK will be evaluated before a decision, and that some athletes without KvK registration fall outside existing schemes.
As I have promised the House, the SPUK is currently being evaluated. Based on this, I will in due course take a decision on the continuation of the SPUK.
Zoals ik de Kamer heb toegezegd, wordt de SPUK momenteel geëvalueerd. Op basis hiervan zal ik te zijner tijd een besluit nemen over de voortzetting van de SPUK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Ontslag dreigt voor ruim 50% fysiotherapeuten’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why the compensation scheme for paramedical care (including physiotherapists) was delayed, what percentage of lost revenue would be compensated, whether non-contracted providers can participate, how non-insured costs are handled, and whether the minister will take responsibility rather than leaving finances to insurers. The minister answered that insurers' continuity-contribution scheme opens to providers from 15 May, based on normal insured revenue, that non-contracted providers must sign a payment agreement, that Rijksregelingen apply only to uninsured revenue after insurer support, and that the answers were late due to the COVID workload.
Are you willing, if necessary, to not leave the financial care to health insurers but to take your responsibility as Minister?
Bent u bereid om, als dat nodig blijkt, de financiële zorg niet aan zorgverzekeraars over te laten maar als Minister uw verantwoordelijkheid te pakken?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Van Gerven over het rapport over de financialisering van big pharma (nieuwe versie)

Two SP MPs asked the minister for Medical Care about an SOMO report on the financialisation of big pharma, including shareholder payouts, debt-financed buybacks, the role of public money in COVID-19 vaccine development, and access conditions. The minister answered that transparency on R&D costs and pricing is important, that the government negotiates hard on prices and will remain transparent on public vaccine investments, and that it will insist on broad access, but did not accept the characterisation of the business model as unacceptable or unsustainable.
I will remain transparent about the Dutch government's investment strategy and within European cooperation.
Ik zal transparant blijven over de investeringsstrategie van de Nederlandse overheid en in Europees samenwerkingsverband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de financiële gevolgen en regelingen voor sportverenigingen

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Health and Social Affairs why sports clubs using central payroll service bureaus cannot apply for the NOW wage subsidy, whether they should be excluded, and whether rules and accountant requirements should be changed for clubs with non-calendar fiscal years. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the bureau is the formal employer and that changing the system is not feasible given speed and volume, pointing instead to a EUR 120 million sports support package and promising only that accountant-certificate thresholds are being examined.
Currently it is being examined below which threshold an accountant's statement is not required.
Momenteel wordt bezien onder welke grens een accountantsverklaring niet is vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de gevolgen van nieuwe Europese wetgeving voor de beschikbaarheid van  medische hulpmiddelen en medische hulpmiddelen voor invitro diagnostiek

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about shortages from the EU Medical Devices Regulation and the in-vitro diagnostics regulation, including whether in-house tests should be restricted and whether the rules should be paused. The minister answered that the MDR postponement was due to the Covid crisis rather than shortage signals, that the IVDR applies from May 2022 with an in-house exemption conditional on no equivalent market product, and that no change to EU legislation is currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to advocate changing the legislation in Europe.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om aanpassing in wetgeving in Europa te bepleiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Sazias over hoge parkeerkosten bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Ploumen and Sazias asked whether hospital staff working extra hours during the coronavirus crisis should be exempted from paid parking costs, since public transport is limited. The Minister agreed in principle and said the hospital umbrella organisations NVZ and NFU report that most hospitals have waived or sharply reduced parking fees during the crisis, possibly in consultation with municipalities.
I have contacted the umbrella organisations of hospitals, the NVZ and NFU.
Ik heb contact gezocht met de koepelorganisaties van ziekenhuizen, de NVZ en NFU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Test op antistoffen, dat is nu essentieel’ en ‘onderzoek relatie corona en vuile lucht’.

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper op-ed on antibody testing and the mechanics of immunity after a mild COVID-19 infection, a proposal to test a representative sample, and a possible link between air pollution and COVID-19 severity. The minister answered that research on antibodies and immunity is still ongoing, that an expert task force will advise on testing strategy, that the Pienter-Covid study already tests a broader population sample, and referred the air pollution question to earlier answers.
The task force will among other things assess whether and for which persons it is desirable for an antibody test to be deployed on a large scale.
De taskforce zal onder andere beoordelen of en voor welke personen het wenselijk is dat een test op antistoffen op grote schaal ingezet gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat een slechte luchtkwaliteit de overlevingskans voor mensen met het COVID-19 virus verslechtert

An MP asked the government whether air pollution worsens survival odds for COVID-19 patients, citing SARS and Italian data, and whether a causal link was established and would be investigated in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that the cited ecological studies do not prove causation, that the RIVM considers the hypotheses plausible but unproven, and that research is being explored through international networks and the veehouderij programme, with the Chamber to be informed.
Your House will be informed about which research will be carried out within the MCC framework.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over welk onderzoek er in MCC verband uitgevoerd zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de ‘veronderstelde toegang’ tot elektronische patiëntendossiers

An MP asked whether the temporary 'corona opt-in' opened the GP records of about eight million people to any UZI-holding care worker, whether this is compatible with consent rules, and related questions on encryption, the Landelijk Schakelpunt operator and whether the measure will be reversed. The minister answered that access requires patient consent on the spot, that the measure is temporary until at most 1 June 2020, and that the LSP operator is bound to Dutch law, while declining to say how many people have opted out.
I do not know how many people currently have an opt-out registered and cannot and may not know, because this is part of the individual GPs' registrations and privacy-sensitive information.

Ik weet niet hoeveel mensen in de huidige situatie een opt-out hebben geregistreerd en kan en mag dat ook niet weten want dit is onderdeel van de registraties van de afzonderlijke huisartsen en privacygevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het delen van corona-patenten door farmaceuten

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about concerns over affordable access to future COVID-19 medicines and vaccines, whether Costa Rica's call for a WHO patent pool should be endorsed, and the pharmaceutical industry's stance on global access. The minister acknowledged the concerns and the need for solidarity, said patent pools can strengthen follow-on innovation and the government will publicly support a global COVID-19 pool at the WHO assembly, and said industry has an important role and the government will raise this with it.
the government will, before and during the WHO's annual assembly, show leadership and explicitly speak out in favour of such a global COVID-19 pool and actively support the WHO in this.
zal de regering voorafgaand, en tijdens, de jaarlijkse vergadering van de WHO leiderschap tonen en zich expliciet uitspreken voor zo’n wereldwijde COVID-19 pool en de WHO hierbij actief steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat (onder meer) het Franciscus Gasthuis in Rotterdam 'doordendert' met het invoeren van functiedifferentiatie

MP Kerstens asked the minister about reports that Franciscus Gasthuis in Rotterdam was pressing ahead with nursing function differentiation, and whether the earlier withdrawn BIG-II bill had caused distrust among nurses. The minister said the talks on function differentiation are for employers and employees to conduct, that the hospital consulted its nursing advisory and works councils, and that he would not urge hospitals to halt the process.
As previously indicated, the discussion on function differentiation is between representatives of employers and employees. The government has no direct role in this.
Zoals eerder aangegeven loopt het gesprek over functiedifferentiatie tussen vertegenwoordigers van werkgevers en werknemers. De overheid heeft hier geen directe rol in
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Costa Rica de WHO oproept een internationale pool op te richten voor intellectueel eigendom inzake COVID-19

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister of Medical Care about Costa Rica's call for the WHO to create a global patent pool for COVID-19 technologies and whether public funding for COVID-19 vaccines or medicines should require the resulting IP to be placed in such a pool. The minister supports information sharing and FAIR principles and says the government will back a global COVID-19 pool, but says mandatory pooling of patents from publicly funded research is not clearly desirable because private investment must be able to recover costs, while the government will fund only therapies available on acceptable terms.

As requested on 8 April in the amended motion by MP Ellemeet et al. on establishing a global COVID-19 pool, the government will show leadership before and during the WHO's annual meeting and explicitly advocate for such a global COVID-19 pool and actively support the WHO in this.

Zoals 8 april jongstleden in de gewijzigde motie van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over het opzetten van een wereldwijde COVID-19 pool (t.v.v. motie 25 295, nr. 224 ) is gevraagd, zal de regering voorafgaand, en tijdens, de jaarlijkse vergadering van de WHO leiderschap tonen en zich expliciet uitspreken voor zo'n wereldwijde COVID-19 pool en de WHO hierbij actief steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de financiering van zorgkosten tijdens de coronapandemie

An SP MP asked whether insurers would cover all extra COVID-19 care costs so patients pay nothing extra, how hospital budget caps and transport are handled for COVID and non-deferrable care, and how patients with budget policies are protected when transferred. The minister answered that patients will not be charged extra COVID costs, hospitals' extra costs will be reimbursed, transport covered under the Zvw, and budget-policy holders receive the same access as others.
Charging patients for extra costs resulting from the COVID-19 outbreak is indeed not an issue.
Extra kosten als gevolg van de uitbraak van COVID-19 in rekening brengen bij patiënten is inderdaad niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over uitstel van de Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen

Two SP MPs asked why the Minister postponed the Medicines Prices Act sharpening by six months, why the 150 million euro cost falls on premium payers, how COVID-related drug price controls are lifted, and why compulsory licensing was not used. The Minister answered that the postponement gives market parties financial room to build stocks, that the cost is about 150 million euro, that maximum prices may be lifted for COVID drugs if shortages threaten, and that compulsory licences would not address supply shortages.
I did call on parties to act responsibly with the extra financial room I am giving them.
Ik heb partijen wel opgeroepen verantwoordelijk om te gaan met de extra financiële armslag die ik hen hiermee bied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Nederland faalde zelf bij aanschaf foute mondkapjes’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government checked the certification of the Chinese supplier of 1.3 million face masks, of which about 600,000 failed quality requirements, and what is being done to prevent such failures. The answer merely refers to a letter on the general COVID-19 situation, without addressing the specific questions.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to Minister van Rijn (Medical Care) have been answered by means of a letter on the COVID-19 update on the state of affairs.
De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan Minister van Rijn (Medische Zorg) ( 2020Z06930 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het testbeleid in zorginstellingen

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister of Health about healthcare workers with mild symptoms who cannot get tested, the division of testing responsibilities between employers, GP and GGD, and what workers should do when referred back and forth. The minister's answer refers to a separate letter on the state of affairs (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277) rather than answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MP Hijink (SP) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) and Minister van Rijn (Medical Care) have been answered by letter <COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs>.

De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Hijink (SP) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) en Minister van Rijn (Medische Zorg) ( 2020Z07031 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vagen van het lid Jansen over tekorten van medische hulpmiddelen in de langdurige zorg

An MP asked the health minister about shortages of protective equipment and medical supplies in long-term care during the COVID-19 crisis, including gloves, aprons, masks and disinfectants, and whether staff were working unprotected. The minister answered by referring to a general COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than answering each question directly.
The written questions from MP Jansen (PVV) to the Minister for Medical Care have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Jansen (PVV) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘VWS bezig met reddingsplan zorg: Niemand failliet’

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports of a rescue plan so that care providers do not go bankrupt during the COVID-19 crisis, including whether non-contracted providers qualify, whether the anti-assignment rule is lifted, and whether municipalities will be obliged and compensated to pay providers. The minister replied that insurers have set up a continuity contribution scheme open to all providers, that the cessation ban will not be lifted, and that the government will monitor municipalities and compensate them for extra costs.
With contracted care providers, insured persons always have the guarantee that the bill is reimbursed via the health insurer.
Bij gecontracteerde zorgaanbieders hebben verzekerden altijd de garantie dat de rekening via de zorgverzekeraar vergoed wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het gereedstellen van het Bronovo ziekenhuis

MP Ploumen asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the closed Bronovo hospital in The Hague could be made ready to receive patients and COVID-19 patients, what care it could offer, whether its location is suitable compared with Ahoy, and whether the minister will act quickly. The minister referred to the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219) as his answer, without addressing the questions on substance in this document.
The written questions from MP Ploumen (PvdA) to the Minister for Medical Care (2020Z06114) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ploumen (PvdA) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06114 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de effecten van de coronacrisis op kraamverzorgenden

An MP asked whether midwifery assistants (kraamverzorgenden) who have close contact with clients lack protective equipment and testing, whether they are included in the regional acute care consultation, and when equipment and testing will be made available. The minister answered by referring to the COVID-19 update letter to parliament, a cross-reference rather than a substantive answer.
The written questions from MP Ploumen (PvdA) to the Minister for Medical Care (2020Z06227) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 219).
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ploumen (PvdA) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06227 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219 ).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de brandbrief van fysiotherapeuten over een effectief noodplan voor fysiotherapiepraktijken dat per direct voorziet in financiële ondersteuning

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister for Medical Care nine questions about letters and press statements from physiotherapists and dental professionals warning of bankruptcy, asking why they are excluded from existing COVID-19 support and when compensation will be clear. The answers were not given in this document; the minister referred to the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219) instead.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister for Medical Care (2020Z06224) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 219).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06224 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het uitbreiden van de testcapaciteit (ingezonden 7 april 2020).

Two SP MPs asked the minister about unused laboratory testing capacity, how far testing could be scaled up using companies, scientists and biotech parks, whether vendor lock-in limits testing, and whether the government would use military coordination, compulsory licences or relax procurement rules. The reply is a Kamerbrief reference stating the written questions were answered in a separate COVID-19 update letter, without substantive answers in this document.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister for Medical Care have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06299 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over de discrepantie tussen de berichtgeving over bestellingen en leveringen van beschermingsmiddelen en de tekorten die nog steeds worden ervaren door zorgmedewerkers

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health ministers about the gap between reports of protective equipment orders and deliveries and continuing shortages for care workers, referencing an adopted motion and the state of affairs letter, and asked whether supplies are adequate across hospitals, nursing homes, GP practices, home care, and disability/youth/mental health settings. The government answered by referring to its COVID-19 state of affairs letter of the same date rather than answering the questions separately.

The written questions from MPs Wilders and Agema (both PVV) to the Ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Medical Care (2020Z06296) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema (beiden PVV) aan de Ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06296 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het bericht 'Onrust bij thuiszorg, wijkverpleging, gehandicaptenzorg en ouderen zorg bij gebrek aan bescherming en beperkt testen personeel'

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the ministers, following press reports, about shortages of protective equipment and limited testing for staff in home care, district nursing, disability care and elderly care, including how the ministry's purchasing collective, alternative supplies, industry contributions, domestic production, expanded testing and a passed motion would be handled. The answer is a referral: the questions were answered in the broader COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than individually.

The written questions from members Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the Ministers for Medical Care and of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z06304) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de Ministers voor Medische Zorg en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z06304 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de open brief aan de Raad van Bestuur van Treant voor het behoud van acute zorg in het Bethesda Ziekenhuis in Hoogeveen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether she would support reconsidering the closure of the emergency department at Bethesda Hospital in Hoogeveen, especially during the COVID-19 crisis, and urged the hospital board to pause irreversible steps. The Minister replied that the regional care plan was agreed earlier, that the transition was even accelerated to 30 March for crisis preparedness, and that reconsideration is not appropriate, while promising to monitor developments.
Reconsidering the decision to close the emergency department of Bethesda Hospital is therefore not on the table.
Een heroverweging van het besluit om de SEH van het Bethesda Ziekenhuis te sluiten is dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Overleg over mogelijk tekort aan medicijnen’

An MP asked the health minister about a possible shortage of medicines during the coronavirus crisis, including industry concerns, EU coordination and cross-border export restrictions. The minister pointed to a new coordination body, EU-level monitoring with the EMA, and confirmed Dutch compliance with EU green lanes for goods, mostly referring to earlier letters without new commitments.
For a full explanation of the concrete and possible steps I have in mind for the coming period, I refer you to my letter on this subject.
Ik verwijs voor de uitgebreide toelichting op de concrete en mogelijke stappen die ik in de aankomende periode voor ogen heb graag naar mijn brief over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht dat het RIVM het sombere scenario uit ziet komen

Labour MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that RIVM now expects the gloomier COVID-19 scenario, and why its ICU length-of-stay and capacity assumptions differ from the 25 March briefing. The minister's reply refers to a separate written answer on the current state of affairs (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) rather than answering the questions directly.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 200)
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200 )
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht «De eerste 100 extra beademingsapparaten van Philips zijn binnen: «mooi nieuws»

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the use of Defence, veterinarians, private clinics and other parties for ventilator supply during COVID-19, including counts of available and deployed ventilators, and whether answers could be given before the plenary debate. The answers were not given in this document; the minister referred to a letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) instead.
have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 200)
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200 )
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

PvdA MPs asked the health ministers how far the Netherlands follows WHO advice on testing for COVID-19, whether test kits, staff, laboratory capacity and protective equipment are sufficient, and how ICU capacity, public information and distancing rules are handled. The minister answered that testing is targeted due to global shortages under a national guideline with a taskforce, that protective equipment is distributed under a central procurement and regional distribution structure, and that information is clear and updated, while largely restating existing policy and referring to a separate Kamerbrief for ICU capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Kuik over de begeleiding van functiebeperkte studenten die te kort schiet

MPs Van der Molen and Kuik asked the ministers about the 2017 annual report on students with disabilities, uneven support across institutions, the inspectorate's role, and implementation of the UN disability convention. The minister replied that institutions are broadly adequate, that an Inspectorate study is underway with results expected spring 2018, and that a motion-based action plan is being worked out.
Furthermore, I can inform you that the inspectorate is currently conducting a study into the accessibility of higher education for students with a disability.
Verder kan ik u berichten dat de inspectie momenteel een onderzoek uitvoert naar de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor studenten met een functiebeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht in de NRC dat de zorg aan kwetsbare gezinnen onder druk staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether municipalities may buy youth protection and probation care below cost, whether a realistic tariff will be ensured, and how continuity of care for about 420 families will be guaranteed after a tariff dispute. The government answered that municipalities bear responsibility under the decentralised system, that a cost-price study with VNG is planned for April 2018, and that continuity in the Zuid-Holland Zuid region has been arranged, while referring many detailed questions to municipalities or lacking the data.
It is up to municipalities and institutions themselves to conduct research into the cost price where necessary.
Het is dan ook aan gemeenten en instellingen zelf om zo nodig onderzoek te doen naar de kostprijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht 'Hoge blootstelling pesticide geeft geboorteafwijking'

An SP MP asked the government whether it would respond to Californian findings linking pesticide exposure to birth defects, whether comparable pesticides are used in the Dutch sector, whether Dutch data are missing, and whether health risks including birth defects are covered by the RIVM exposure study. The minister referred all five questions to a separate letter on the status of research into pesticide effects on residents, giving no substantive answers.
I refer you to my answer to question 2.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over opnieuw honderden ontslagen in de zorg

An SP MP asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that care workers at Zorgspectrum Het Zand are being dismissed despite staff shortages, and asked for investigation of the causes and intervention with social partners. The minister declined to judge the organisation's specific decision, citing financial difficulties, and pointed to the Arbeidsmarktagenda 2023 commitments to job security and a EUR 347 million support package.
It is not for me to judge the specific circumstances of the case and the choice made by the organisation concerned.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de specifieke omstandigheden van het geval en de keuze die daarin door de betreffende organisatie wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over fraude bij zorgaanbieder Job Lanceer

The MP Marijnissen asked the state secretary about serious care failures and suspected pgb fraud at care provider Job Lanceer, and why the Inspectorate kept approving care and did not coordinate with other bodies. The minister calls the reports serious, says the municipality of Tiel has moved clients to other providers, explains the Inspectorate's supervision history and cooperation arrangements, and sees no reason for further measures.
In view of the above answers, I currently see no reason to take measures.
Gelet op bovenstaande antwoorden zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding tot het nemen van maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over alarmerende berichten dat mensen met een beperking ’s nachts enkel in de gaten gehouden worden door camera’s

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that people with disabilities are monitored only by cameras at night, questioning the safety, IGZ oversight, staffing norms, dignity and whether camera monitoring is a restrictive measure. The minister answered that camera monitoring can complement care if conditions are met, that the IGZ checks restrictive measures and proportionality, but that no binding staffing norm or new national rules are planned.
I therefore see no reason to take measures to replace camera monitoring with care workers.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om maatregelen te treffen om de inzet van cameratoezicht te vervangen door zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de gemeente Eindhoven met het criterium ‘schoon huis’ wil gaan werken, terwijl jurisprudentie aangeeft dat dit niet mag

An MP asks whether Eindhoven's plan to use a 'clean house' performance criterion for home help, and a court ruling against a similar criterion, is lawful and how the government will respond. The minister answers that the approach fits the Central Council for Appeal ruling if the agreed steps are recorded in the municipality's decision, that the municipality must still ensure the service is financially feasible for residents, and that no action is needed.
Legal certainty is guaranteed because the support plan forms part of the decision.
De rechtszekerheid is gewaarborgd doordat het ondersteuningsplan onderdeel is van de beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat bendes het gemak ontdekt hebben van fraude met persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

An SP MP asked the minister about press reports that criminal gangs exploit the personal budget (pgb) for care fraud, the scale of the fraud, and what is being done to reduce it, including the NZa recommendations. The minister acknowledges the problem, gives fraud figures as a lower bound, lists existing and planned measures such as the Wtza bill, a planned legal study on data sharing and a fraud warning register, and says he will inform parliament on the pending report.
I will inform your House of the results of this study.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over jongeren met psychische problemen die soms wel 40 weken moeten wachten op hulp

MP Kooiman asked whether the government shared alarm that youth with psychological problems in the Utrecht region sometimes wait up to 40 weeks for care, why waiting times vary so widely, and what is being done about the low share of providers publishing waiting times. Minister De Jonge acknowledged the long waits and the low publication rate, pointed to regional agreements on transparent waiting-time reporting from 2018, and said gemeenten and providers must make every effort to provide timely care, but did not commit to a broader national investigation.
I also find that percentage too low.
Ik vind dat percentage ook te laag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de toegang tot de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz)

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about waiting lists and access to the Wlz long-term care act for young adults with intellectual disabilities and psychiatric problems, including the CIZ's evidentiary requirement of onset before age 18 and the exclusion of psychiatric grounds from the Wlz. The State Secretary answers that the CIZ assesses each case individually, that other domains (Wmo, Zvw, Jeugdwet) can provide care, and that the question of opening the Wlz to psychiatric disorders is left to the incoming cabinet.
The CIZ weighs each application for access to the Wlz individually, uses various documents and applies a nationally applicable assessment framework.
Het CIZ weegt elke aanvraag voor toegang tot de Wlz individueel, maakt daarbij gebruik van verschillende documenten en hanteert een landelijk geldend afwegingskader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de achterblijvende resultaten van het Deltaplan Dementie n.a.v. het artikel op Zorgvisie d.d. 21 september 2017

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that the Deltaplan Dementie has produced few concrete results, including the shelving of the national dementia register and care portal and disputes over research funding. The State Secretary replied that results take time, pointed to ongoing care and awareness programmes, explained that the register and portal were reshaped rather than abandoned, and said research funding is balanced across themes although demand exceeds available money.
Yes, I am in regular contact with the board of the Deltaplan Dementie.
Ja, ik heb regelmatig contact met het bestuur van het Deltaplan Dementie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Opinie: Maak Nederland nou eindelijk eens toegankelijk voor gehandicapten’

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary for Health about the implementation of the UN disability rights convention, public transport accessibility, local inclusion agendas and toilet access for people with bowel, stomach and kidney conditions. The state secretary described the five-track implementation plan, pointed to existing public transport accessibility rules and municipal Wmo duties, and said no central data exist on local inclusion agendas or toilet accessibility.
Your House will receive, as I promised in the debate, a progress report on the approach before the end of this calendar year.
Uw Kamer ontvangt, zoals ik in het debat heb toegezegd, voor het einde van dit kalenderjaar een voortgangsbericht over de aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Het nieuwe product van kinderbeschermers is intimidatie’

An MP asked the government whether 'drang' (pressure within voluntary child-protection support) is used as a product, whether it lowers coerced measures, how often it is applied, and whether organisations profit from it. The Minister answered that drang is a professional attitude within voluntary support, that no national figures exist, that only a judge may order out-of-home placement, and that the Jeugdwet interim evaluation may examine its use.
Yes, I share this view and this is also legally arranged. A child judge decides on a coerced out-of-home placement.
Ja, deze mening deel ik en dit is wettelijk ook zo geregeld. Een kinderrechter beslist over een gedwongen uithuisplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘NIVEL: Informatie Wmo voor familie verstandelijk gehandicapten ontoereikend’

An MP asked the state secretary about a NIVEL report finding that families of people with intellectual disabilities are often unaware of independent client support under the Wmo, and whether awareness campaigns for informal carers could include it. The secretary confirmed low awareness (25% in a client survey), pointed to a Koplopers project with 14 municipalities and a Movisie review of good practices, and promised to raise the signal in work with VNG and Mezzo with a report before the Christmas recess 2017.
I will ask Movisie to identify good examples among the Koplopers regarding independent client support for informal carers, discuss them with Mezzo among others, and disseminate these examples.

Ik zal Movisie vragen om goede voorbeelden te identificeren bij de Koplopers met betrekking tot onafhankelijke cliëntondersteuning voor mantelzorgers, deze onder andere te bespreken met Mezzo en deze voorbeelden te verspreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Kwaliteit van zorg in Nederland loopt gevaar’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Health about a Rathenau Institute report warning that care quality is at risk because policy and practice lack research support, and about unclear responsibility for knowledge in municipal care policy. The State Secretary rejected any trend break in care quality, said the ministry has taken full responsibility for knowledge infrastructure, and committed to working with municipalities on a better knowledge agenda, without a concrete new step.
The department therefore has taken and continues to take its responsibility in full.
Het departement nam en neemt dus ten volle zijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de wachttijden voor een plaats in een verpleeghuis toenemen

An MP asked the state secretary whether rising waiting times for nursing home places are caused by acute placements, whether people avoid Wlz applications because of higher co-payments, and what will be done. The secretary replied that most applicants get an offer within six weeks and waiting figures are stable, and that a study requested by a motion will examine whether people delay Wlz applications for financial reasons.
During the thirty-member debate on acute care on 13 September, MP Ellemeet submitted a motion asking the government to investigate this.
Tijdens het dertigledendebat over acute zorg van 13 september jl. heeft mevrouw Ellemeet een motie ingediend, waarin zij de regering verzoekt om hier onderzoek naar te doen

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het signaal dat de doorlooptijd voor het verkrijgen van een rolstoel in meerdere gemeenten te lang is en de kwaliteit van de rolstoel

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked when the promised analysis of the Ieder(in) signal report and recent NZN/Ieder(in) complaints, prepared with the VNG, would be ready, and whether it would cover wheelchair quality, innovative solutions such as personal budgets, and long repair waits. The State Secretary answered that the analysis is planned for spring next year, will include quality and repair-wait signals, and that he cannot yet commit to a improvement plan or its measures.
The plan is to have the analysis completed by next spring.
De planning is om komend voorjaar de analyse gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Bergkamp over vennootschapsbelasting in de jeugdhulpverlening

MPs Raemakers and Bergkamp asked whether youth care organisations fall under corporate tax and which care sectors are exempt, after a 2017 article raised confusion. The state secretaries answered that youth care providers are generally now taxable since the 2015 funding change, but may qualify for the care-institution exemption if they meet its three conditions, as other care sectors can.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een vertrekkend bestuurder een zorginstelling vier ton kost

An MP asked the state secretary about a Scheidsgerecht Gezondheidszorg ruling awarding a departing executive EUR 400,000, questioning its appropriateness given the organisation's losses and supervision, and whether legal options exist to prevent such payments. The secretary confirmed the ruling, said the Raad van Toezicht is responsible for a careful dismissal process, noted the ruling is binding and that the amount reflects salary, severance and costs under the WNT norms.
The ruling of the Scheidsgerecht Gezondheidszorg is binding.
De uitspraak van het Scheidsgerecht Gezondheidszorg is bindend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorginstellingen verontrustend vaak verlies leiden

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that care institutions often make losses, including bankruptcies of home-care organisations due to low tariffs, staffing costs, use of the extra funds for minimum staffing in nursing homes, and whether banks charge higher interest to institutions missing a profit norm. The state secretary said he has no overview of bankruptcies, pointed to municipal duties and the price regulation AMvB, explained the cost rise was a relative decline due to incidental factors, said EUR 275 million is available for staffing with inspection levers via care offices, and said banks weigh strategy more than short-term results.
I have no overview of home-care organisations that went bankrupt in 2015 and 2016 (due to low tariffs).
Ik heb geen overzicht van thuiszorgorganisaties die in 2015 en 2016 failliet zijn gegaan (door te lage tarieven).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht dat stervende patiënten overgeplaatst worden om het sterftecijfer laag te houden

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether hospitals moving dying patients to keep mortality rates low, as reported in a column, is shocking and whether the Inspectorate will act. The minister replied that the column contains no concrete evidence of substandard care, that hospital mortality ratios need nuance, and that she sees no reason for further action or sanctions.
Concrete indications of substandard care for dying patients cannot be derived from the article.
Concrete aanwijzingen voor tekortschietende zorg bij stervende patiënten zijn aan het artikel niet te ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat er te weinig verpleging is voor mensen die thuis willen sterven

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that patients wanting to die at home cannot get district nursing, and that hospitals and hospices had to keep patients or admit them, including a budget-cap issue raised by Buurtzorg's director. The State Secretary said he regrets the problems, pointed to available funding and the NZa's oversight of insurers' duty of care, and cited workforce measures and training expansion, without committing to a specific new measure.
Following the reports, the NZa is contacting RTL Nieuws, V&VN and Buurtzorg to investigate this signal further.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving neemt de NZa contact op met RTL-nieuws, V&VN en Buurtzorg om dit signaal verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Te weinig verpleging voor mensen die thuis willen sterven: 'Dieptepunt in zorg'’

MPs Bergkamp and Van der Staaij asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that terminally ill patients cannot get home palliative nursing care and are kept in or cannot leave hospitals or hospices. The State Secretary acknowledged 17 reported cases, attributed them mainly to staff shortages and budget ceilings, pointed to NZa oversight and planned roundtables, and promised further monitoring of palliative care while stating he sees no evidence of underfunding by insurers.
I am willing to conduct further research into the bottlenecks in palliative care along three tracks.
Ik ben bereid om langs drie sporen verder onderzoek te doen naar de knelpunten in de palliatieve zorg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "pensioen en zware beroepen".

SP MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs whether the rising pension age is unattainable for heavy-work occupations and why incapacity inflow among metal workers has doubled, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that social partners are primarily responsible for sustainable employability, pointed to prevention and retraining initiatives and ESF support, said a separate heavy-occupations scheme proved unworkable, and attributed the rise in WIA inflow mainly to former unemployed people falling sick after the 2014 crisis.
Social partners are primarily responsible for working longer.
Sociale partners zijn primair aan zet bij langer doorwerken van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over onnodige regeldruk voor kleine evenementen en festivals

The MP asks the government about excessive regulatory burden for small events and festivals, citing an Actal advisory report, and asks whether it will harmonise local rules, shift regulation toward small events, improve municipal service and simplify volunteer allowances and permits. The minister answers that municipal autonomy is important, points to a new national Besluit brandveilig gebruik that will replace many local rules from 1 January 2018, rejects several proposals as unnecessary, and says recommendations to municipalities are for them to adopt, with VNG playing a facilitating role.
At the outset, municipal policy freedom is of great importance in order to do justice to local circumstances and needs and to provide local tailor-made solutions.
Voorop staat dat de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten van groot belang is om daarmee recht te doen aan de plaatselijke omstandigheden en behoeften en om te voorzien in lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de misstanden en de winsten in de zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a young man who took legal action over poor care from Woonzorgnet, Woonzorgnet's profits and executive pay, whistleblower signals of abuse, and the profit ban in care. The State Secretary said the situation is undesirable, pointed to supervisory roles of the IGZ, internal supervisors, purchasers and the WNT, explained the profit-ban rules and noted one enforcement case currently under legal review.
I find that an undesirable situation. Complaints must be open for discussion and resolved as well as possible in consultation between the care provider and the client (representatives).
Ik vind dat een onwenselijke situatie. Klachten moeten bespreekbaar zijn en zo goed mogelijk in overleg tussen zorgaanbieder en cliënt(vertegenwoordigers) worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de problemen bij Haagse Wijk- en Woonzorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about worker protests and planned dismissals at Haagse Wijk- en Woonzorg, including the board's refusal to engage, the former board chair's severance pay, and whether the health and labour inspectorates would investigate. The State Secretary said the situation is being handled through the Arbeidsmarktagenda and mediation with FNV, that the IGZ sees no reason to intervene for now but will monitor, and that the labour inspectorate is not involved.
The Labour Inspectorate indicates it is not involved and therefore has no findings on this matter.
De Inspectie SZW geeft aan niet betrokken te zijn en heeft hierover derhalve geen bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat de Vereniging Gehandicaptenzorg Nederland de noodklok luidt over de zorg van meervoudig ernstig  gehandicapten

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the care standard for people with severe multiple disabilities is met, why financing changes prevent providers from covering losses, and whether the meerzorg budget is sufficient for 2017 and 2018. The State Secretary answers that quality standards and inspection apply, that the sector is financially healthy on average, that meerzorg is part of regional contracting space without a separate budget, and that the Wlz framework was raised by 200 million euros.
The Wlz-wide cost price study carried out by the NZa in the second half of 2017 will provide information on the adequacy of tariffs for care to clients with severe multiple disabilities.

Het Wlz-brede kostprijsonderzoek dat door de NZa wordt uitgevoerd in de tweede helft van 2017 zal informatie opleveren over de toereikendheid van de tarieven voor zorg aan cliënten met ernstige meervoudige beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de uitgifte van een invalidenparkeerkaart voor zorginstellingen gefinancierd door een persoonsgebonden budget

MP Bergkamp asked about the status of changes needed so care institutions funded by a personal budget (PGB) can obtain a disabled parking card, and about interim options. The government answered that it is coordinating with the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment on a single comprehensive regulatory amendment to be presented in autumn, and that competent authorities can grant exemptions under article 87 RVV 1990 in the meantime.
The Minister of IenM therefore aims to present you with one comprehensive amendment of the relevant regulations in the autumn.
De Minister van IenM streeft er daarom naar u in het najaar één omvattende wijziging van de relevante regelgeving voor te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht aangaande de gedwongen verhuizing van een cliënt van een Fokuszorg naar een zelfstandige woning om de benodigde 24-uurszorg te krijgen

An MP asked the State Secretary about a client with severe disability who was forced to move from a Fokus care home to an independent dwelling to obtain 24-hour care, and about the timeline for housing, whether this is systemic, and inter-municipal cooperation. The State Secretary acknowledged the case, said persoonlijke assistentie should start without waiting for relocation, and committed to evaluating the scheme and to further analysis of rolstoel delivery problems with the VNG.

In situations where no other suitable dwelling has yet been found and the client still lives in the ADL home, the client's safety should take priority and an application for personal assistance need not wait until a move has taken place.

In situaties waarin nog geen andere geschikte woning is gevonden en de cliënt nog woonachtig is in de ADL-woning behoort de veiligheid van de cliënt voorop te staan en hoeft een aanvraag voor persoonlijke assistentie niet te wachten tot een verhuizing heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over ondersteuning thuis voor mensen met dementie

An MP asked how home support for people with dementia is organised, which bodies oversee municipal Wmo support, and what was done on her motion to spread effective methods via the VNG. The minister says casemanagement and home nursing cover complex needs, that the NZa has no Wmo oversight role, and lists actions on waiting lists and casemanagement.
The municipality appoints a Wmo supervisor under article 6.1 of the Wmo 2015.
De gemeente wijst een Wmo-toezichthouder aan op basis van artikel 6.1 van de Wmo 2015.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het signaal dat de doorlooptijd voor het verkrijgen van een rolstoel in meerdere gemeenten te lang is en de kwaliteit van de rolstoel ook bij aanpassingen en reparaties regelm

An MP asked the state secretary whether long waiting times and poor quality for wheelchairs in several municipalities are a long-standing problem and whether an analysis and improvement plan with the VNG will follow. The state secretary replied that a signal report from Ieder(in) was only recently received, that an analysis with the VNG of it and recent complaints will be made and reported to parliament, and described the Nationaal Keurmerk Hulpmiddelen and contractual oversight by municipalities.
I have agreed with the VNG to further analyse both the report and recent complaints received by the NZN and Ieder(in).
Ik heb met de VNG afgesproken zowel het rapport als recente meldingen die bij het NZN en Ieder(in) zijn ontvangen nader te analyseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over au pairs in de zorg

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about Dutch care providers using Eastern European 'au pairs' (live-in care workers) for home care, including whether the Inspectorate monitors such providers, whether this complies with the working time and collective agreement rules, and whether these constructions should be banned. The State Secretary replies that the Inspectorate applies risk-based supervision and will visit if signals warrant it, that 24-hour on-call presence is permitted under the Working Time Act with rest rules, that he cannot judge collective agreement compliance, and that language skills and fair competition must be safeguarded without announcing a ban.
I do not have figures on the number of Eastern European 'au pairs', where 'au pair' in this case means a live-in Eastern European care worker.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal Oost-Europese «au pairs», waarbij onder «au pair» in dit geval wordt verstaan een inwonende Oost-Europese zorgverlener.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Marijnissen over de impact van de Groningse versterkingsopgave voor de zorg

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Economic Affairs how the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation affects care institutions, including guarantees of support, who bears costs, resident relocation and compensation, and whether gas extraction should be reduced further. The government answered that a joint programme with the NCG, care providers, insurers and local authorities is being prepared, that NAM pays for safety reinforcement while costs of future-proofing fall to care providers and insurers, and that the production ceiling is reduced by 10% from October 2017 with a broader gas phase-out to be considered in transition paths.
Further details on the implementation of the reinforcement operation will follow once the steering group has completed the programme.
Verdere details over de uitvoering van de versterkingsopgave volgen als de stuurgroep het programma gereed heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Beckerman over het bericht dat er een sterke groei is van het aantal gezinnen dat bij de noodopvang belandde

MPs Kooiman and Beckerman (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of the Interior about a sharp rise in families ending up in emergency shelter in 2016, its causes, and possible structural fixes. The government answered that it is improving monitoring, that data on homeless families are incomplete, that debt rules are not a legal barrier to renting, and that it supports a Amsterdam-style approach while leaving most solutions to municipalities.
I do not know whether, and if so how often, this happens with homeless families.
Het is mij niet bekend of en zo ja, hoe vaak dit gebeurt bij dakloze gezinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de ontbrekende stukken uit het verslag van het Directeuren Overleg Alcohol (DOA)

An MP asked why the Auditdienst Rijk report on the missing second page of a 2008 Directeuren Overleg Alcohol minutes did not report former members' recollections, why the search stopped after finding an earlier version, and for the search file. The state secretary answered that there was no special reason, that recollections varied and were limited, that the search covered departmental drives without finding a second page, and that an anonymised file will be sent with a broader Wob request pending.
Yes, that can be done. Because of the large amount of documents to anonymise, this takes some time.
Ja, dat kan. Door de grote hoeveelheid te anonimiseren stukken vraagt dat enige tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bizarre bericht 'In de zorg is gevoel belangrijker dan taalkennis'

PVV MPs asked whether it is acceptable that 37,000 care workers were dismissed while recruitment of refugees and status holders is pushed, and whether language and VOG (certificate of conduct) standards are being lowered. The State Secretary replied that care quality standards apply equally to all, that language requirements remain in law (Wkkgz, BIG), that a VOG can be requested for status holders, and that no standards change for new recruits.
The standards and requirements that care workers must meet are the same for everyone in the Netherlands.
De gestelde normen en eisen waaraan medewerkers in de zorg moeten voldoen zijn in Nederland voor iedereen hetzelfde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de misstanden bij zorginstelling Careyn

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about serious problems at care provider Careyn, covering care quality, working conditions, finances, the board's pay and the IGZ's earlier blacklisting, and whether the government intervened. The State Secretary answers that the board is responsible, that the NZa sees no short-term continuity threat, that the IGZ's judgment on quality is awaited in October, and that the IGZ issued an order and several measures were taken.
On the quality of care at Careyn, I am awaiting the IGZ's judgment, which will come with its findings in October.
Over de kwaliteit van zorg bij Careyn wacht ik het oordeel van de IGZ af die in oktober met haar bevindingen komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen Careyn bijna kopje-onder gaan

MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked whether a Careyn internal guide for IGZ inspection visits, the use of unqualified holiday staff, and the size of the organisation endanger oversight and resident safety. The State Secretary answered that IGZ is not being hindered, inspections are unannounced, the guide is only facilitating, and an organisational break-up is not an IGZ power but a matter for the board if quality is at stake.
The IGZ must of course never be hindered in carrying out its tasks.
De IGZ mag vanzelfsprekend nooit in de uitvoering van haar taken belemmerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht 'bezuiniging ouderenzorg nutteloos'

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked whether journalistic calculations showing that cuts to elderly care achieved nothing are correct, why earlier objections were dismissed, and whether the government will restore care cuts for older people. The Secretary of State rejected the calculations as incorrect, argued that the cuts were needed to bend spending growth and shifted responsibilities to insurers and municipalities, and said the government has invested in nursing home quality without committing to reverse the cuts.
The conclusion that the cuts to elderly care were useless is incorrect.
De conclusie dat de bezuinigingen op de ouderenzorg nutteloos zijn geweest is incorrect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over recente berichtgeving rondom zelfmoorden van jongeren

MP Raemakers asked the State Secretary of Health about recent youth suicides in Heerlen, Venlo and Deelen and possible failures of youth care, including suicide figures, inspection reports and prevention roles. The State Secretary gave CBS figures, explained the mandatory calamity-reporting system and inspection follow-up, described suicide prevention funding and programmes, and said current communication with municipalities is adequate.
Providers of youth care, youth protection and Veilig Thuis are legally obliged to report calamities to the inspectorates.
Aanbieders van jeugdhulp, jeugdbescherming en Veilig Thuis zijn wettelijk verplicht calamiteiten te melden bij de inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Inspectie Jeugdzorg geen onderzoek doet naar zelfdoding

An SP MP asked the state secretary why the Inspectie Jeugdzorg is not investigating the suicide of a youth in Venlo previously involved in youth care, and why Venlo, unlike Heerlen, did not report it. The secretary answered that no youth care was active in the past year so there was no inspection reason, that the municipality is investigating itself, and that reporting is voluntary for municipalities but obligatory for providers.

The municipality of Venlo will first conduct its own investigation. This will be monitored, and during and after completion TSD, in consultation with the municipality, will consider whether and what further action is needed.

De gemeente Venlo gaat nu eerst zelf onderzoek doen. Dit wordt gevolgd en tijdens en na afronding van het onderzoek zal door TSD in afstemming met de gemeente worden bekeken of en wat er nog extra nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht 'Tekort aan handjes: zorg smeekt ontslagen werknemers terug te keren'

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether the government's care reforms caused unnecessary job losses, why refugees and migrants are being recruited into care, why some nursing programmes still have admission stops, and when staff will stop being used as pawns. The state secretary answered that reforms caused job losses but measures were taken to manage them, that recruitment plans and a 72 million euro boost aim to address shortages, and that care quality remains guaranteed.
The cabinet has in recent years carried out necessary reforms, because the demands we place on the organisation of care changed and care grew faster than society could afford.

Antwoord 2 De afgelopen jaren heeft het kabinet noodzakelijke hervormingen doorgevoerd, omdat de eisen die we stellen aan de organisatie van de zorg veranderden en de zorg harder groeide dan we als maatschappij aan konden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over de signalen dat gemeenten geen alfahulpen meer mogen inzetten

MP Hermans asked the state secretary about signals that municipalities may no longer deploy or broker alfahulpen (home help via the Regeling dienstverlening aan huis), and about the legal interpretation under the Wmo 2015 following Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings. The state secretary answered that no municipal signals of difficulty had reached him, maintained that such arrangements fall outside the Wmo 2015 so that clients can use alfahulpen mainly via a pgb, and said he will not take additional measures beyond following municipalities in adjusting policy.
I do not intend to take additional measures, except to follow municipalities in adjusting current policy where necessary.
Ik ben niet voornemens aanvullende maatregelen te treffen, behoudens het volgen van gemeenten in het waar nodig aanpassen van het huidige beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Bergkamp over de financiering van bijzondere woonvormen.

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior and Health ministers about financing options for collective self-build and supported living projects, including mortgage terms, municipal support, land acquisition and loan-to-value rules. The minister answered that details are largely unknown or case-specific, pointed to municipal subsidies and a Expertteam Eigenbouw review, and described no binding obligations for the executive.
I do not have an overview of how often this happens, which types of projects are involved, or what conditions are attached to such financing.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van hoe vaak dit gebeurt, om welke type projecten het gaat, en welke voorwaarden aan een dergelijke financiering gesteld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Aantal nieuwe pleegouders blijft ondanks hogere vraag afnemen'

An MP asked the state secretary about the reported decline in new foster carers despite higher demand, the reasons foster carers stop, financial support, and whether the campaign will be intensified. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to the Actieplan Pleegzorg with research into why carers stop, a campaign running to 2018, support projects, and evaluations due in early 2018, while placing the 3,000 annual departures in context.
I share your concerns about the decline in the number of foster families.
Ik deel uw zorgen over de daling van het aantal pleeggezinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over vrouwen in blijf-van-mijn-lijfhuizen die verstrikt raken in bureaucratische regelgeving

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the state secretary whether women fleeing domestic violence get stuck in bureaucratic rules, such as signing forms, needing a partner's consent for children's help, the briefadres, the kostendelersnorm, urgentie and independent client support. The state secretary responded that he is grateful for the Ombudsman's report and will prepare a policy response with relevant parties, to be sent in the GIA progress report, without answering the specific questions on substance.
The report of the National Ombudsman provides important starting points for further improvement.
Het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman biedt belangrijke aanknopingspunten voor verdere verbetering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht 'Waarnemers: maak stembiljet verkiezingen gebruiksvriendelijker'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about an OSCE report criticising the Dutch ballot for the March 2017 elections, including accessibility for voters with disabilities, poll worker training, assistance inside voting booths, and larger print or party logos.
