The Minister answered that assistance inside booths is restricted by the Electoral Act and the UN convention reservation, that a ballot-experiment bill was rejected but may be reintroduced, and that only about a quarter-threshold of accessibility criteria is unmet, with no polling station fully compliant.
I will ask the municipalities to pay more explicit attention to this rule next time when training their staff.
Ik zal de gemeenten vragen om daarbij de volgende keer nadrukkelijker aandacht te besteden aan deze regel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over klachten inzake de uitvoering van de zogenoemde Backpay-regeling

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the implementation of the Backpay scheme for former Dutch East Indies civil servants and KNIL soldiers, including delays, rejections, the 15 August 2015 cut-off date and calls for re-assessment. The state secretary answered that 574 payments of 25,000 euros had been made, that decisions took on average 26 to 42 days, that rejections followed from the scheme's criteria, that appeals are possible under the General Administrative Law Act, and that the scheme is considered successful.
When new information comes to light, the SVB is generously willing to reconsider the judgement.
Wanneer er nieuwe informatie bovenkomt, is SVB ruimhartig bereid om opnieuw het oordeel te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Kooiman over de schadelijke gevolgen van de HeatStick voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Kooiman asked the State Secretary about claims that the IQOS HeatStick is less harmful, its cancer-causing substances, its missing graphic warnings and its regulatory status abroad. The State Secretary said the product is still discouraged, that independent studies were short-term and did not assess long-term harm, and that RIVM research on the product is expected in autumn 2017 before deciding on notification to the European Commission.
I have asked the RIVM to conduct research into the IQOS and the HeatStick.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd onderzoek te doen naar de IQOS en de HeatStick.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de misstanden bij de Thomashuizen

MP Marijnissen asks the State Secretary about reported poor care, neglect, abuse and misuse of personal budget (pgb) funds at Thomashuizen, and about the franchise model used by De Drie Notenboomen. The State Secretary answers that the inspectorate has ordered investigations, a sexual abuse report has gone to the Public Prosecution Service, two franchisees were replaced, and an action plan and inspectorate review are forthcoming, while placing primary responsibility for quality on the operators and the umbrella organisation.
Following the signals, the inspectorate, in line with standard procedure, instructed De Drie Notenboomen and these Thomashuizen to investigate the signals further and report back to the inspectorate.

Naar aanleiding van de signalen heeft de inspectie, in lijn met de standaard werkwijze, de Drie Notenboomen en deze Thomashuizen de opdracht gegeven om nader onderzoek te doen naar de signalen en hierover te rapporteren aan de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de gedwongen verhuizing van ouderen bij zorginstelling Aafje

An MP asked the State Secretary whether it is acceptable that Aafje forces 35 very elderly residents at Boekenrode to move, after it stops 24-hour care and a restaurant there, and what will be done to prevent this. The State Secretary answered that residents were consulted, 25 chose to move and 4 stay, that care entitlements remain, and that the IGZ has issued an instruction to Aafje, with no national registry of such closures kept.
No national list is kept of nursing home locations that close or receive another purpose, whether or not with care.
Er wordt geen landelijke lijst bijgehouden van locaties van verzorgingshuizen die sluiten of een andere bestemming krijgen, al dan niet met zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorgketens voor kwetsbare ouderen aan alle kanten kraken

An MP asks why care chains for frail elderly people are still failing, whether the closure of nursing homes was wrong, and how many elderly people are not in the right place. The minister answers that regional work is ongoing, that the government does not register such cases nationally, and that short-stay residential care was moved into the Zvw from 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Opa Penning overlijdt door inschattingsfout'

The PVV MP Agema asked why improvement points after an earlier death in a care facility were not implemented in time for Mr Penning, whether the IGZ failed in its oversight, and whether staffing shortages contributed. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ followed its usual procedure, found the measures adequate after inspections, saw no reason to investigate the IGZ, and that staffing was not a factor.
I see no reason at this time to investigate the IGZ's conduct in this case.
Ik zie nu geen aanleiding om het handelen van de IGZ in deze casus te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet toelaten van geneesmiddel Orkambi tot het basispakket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why Orkambi was not added to the basic insurance package, given its high cost per patient and the treatment of cystic fibrosis patients. The minister answered that the Health Care Institute advised against unconditional reimbursement because of unfavourable cost-effectiveness and crowding-out of other care, that she considers the price unacceptable and wants pharmaceutical companies to be more transparent, and that negotiations with Vertex continue.
I do not make substantive statements about the negotiation.
Ik doe geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over de onderhandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat veel meer kinderen residentieel geplaatst worden, in plaats van in een (pleeg)gezin

MP Kooiman asked the State Secretary why CBS figures show youth care with residential placement rising from about 33,000 in 2015 to over 36,000 in 2016, alongside falling foster care and rising 'other residential placement', and what will be done to reverse this. The State Secretary answered that 2016 is too early to draw conclusions about the Jeugdwet, that the causes are unclear and require further research (due autumn 2017), and that the outcomes will feed into the Actieplan Pleegzorg if a link is found.
It is still too early to draw conclusions from the 2016 CBS figures, the second year of the Jeugdwet, about the success of the Jeugdwet.
Het is nog te vroeg om uit de CBS-cijfers 2016 – het tweede jaar van de Jeugdwet – conclusies te trekken over het slagen van de Jeugdwet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het al dan niet verplicht aanbesteden in de zorg

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Health and the Minister of the Interior whether public tendering of care in the social domain is mandatory, given conflicting reports, and what will be done to clarify it. The government answered that tendering is not always required, depends on whether the arrangement is a procurement or a subsidy, and that a working group and PIANOo support center have been set up to clarify the rules for municipalities.
Public tendering in the social domain is not by definition and in all cases mandatory.
Een openbare aanbesteding in het sociale domein is niet per definitie en in alle gevallen verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het voortbestaan van de Kindertelefoon

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary how the continuity of the Kindertelefoon, AKJ and Sensoor would be secured, what agreements were made with municipalities, and why the interim VNG funding arrangement could not be made structural. The state secretary answered that responsibility for these services will move to central government from 2018 via a deduction from the municipal fund, since municipal payments to third parties from the fund are not in line with the Financiële-verhoudingswet, and that a legislative route will be pursued as quickly as possible.
I will arrange this by law as quickly as possible.
Ik zal dit zo snel als mogelijk wettelijk regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over de decentralisatie van de Kindertelefoon, AKJ en Sensoor

MPs Marijnissen and Kooiman asked the state secretary about the VNG's decision to stop centrally financing the Kindertelefoon, AKJ and Sensoor, and how continuity and bureaucracy concerns square with earlier motions and commitments. The state secretary answered that the government will take over responsibility for these services from 2018 via a fund deduction from the municipal fund and legislation, citing insufficient guarantees and the burden of the existing arrangement.
I will regulate this by law as soon as possible.
Ik zal dit zo snel als mogelijk wettelijk regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het voortbestaan van de Kindertelefoon

An MP asked the state secretary about the future of the Kindertelefoon and AKJ after the transitional funding from 388 municipalities expires, and whether their tasks should be organised nationally. The state secretary agreed the services should be national, concluded the state will take responsibility from 2018 through a fund withdrawal from the municipal fund, and promised to legislate as soon as possible.
Therefore in 2018 I will ensure the continuity of the Kindertelefoon, AKJ and Sensoor.
Daarom zal ik in 2018 zorg dragen voor continuïteit van de Kindertelefoon, AKJ en Sensoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het contracteren van de Kindertelefoon

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary why only 29 municipalities had contracted the Kindertelefoon, Luisterend Oor and Vertrouwenswerk Jeugd by mid-May, why these were not financed like other national services, and why the government acted only just before the 1 June deadline. The state secretary answered that the uncertainty and administrative burden of the municipal model are too great, so responsibility will move to the national government, with a withdrawal from the municipal fund in the September 2017 circular, and that the 2018 guarantee by the VNG board is welcomed.
I will arrange this by law as quickly as possible.
Ik zal dit zo snel als mogelijk wettelijk regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Helder over twijfels bij het overlijden van een jongen in een instelling

MPs Agema and Helder asked about the death of a boy in an institution, the discontinued NODO procedure for investigating child deaths, its funding and responsibility, and 20 reported suspicious deaths submitted by relatives. The government answered that NODO was ended in 2014 after evaluation, replaced by the NODOK scheme focused on parents' grief, that in this case a non-natural death was established, and that further investigation would follow regular criminal procedures, without giving case details for privacy reasons.
Regarding further investigation in this specific situation, we cannot make any statements, in view of the privacy of the next of kin.
Over nader onderzoek in deze specifieke situatie kunnen wij, in het kader van de privacy van de nabestaanden, geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over de overseksualisering van kinderen

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked about the Council of Europe's concern over the sexualisation of children, the role of media and advertising regulation, and whether sanctions via the Advertising Code Committee are adequate. The state secretary answered that existing youth-protection rules, education on sexuality, and self-regulation (RCC, NICAM) are sufficient for now, that a Dutch monitoring study is pending, and that OCW will raise modernisation of youth-protection rules with RCC and NICAM.
In contacts with the Advertising Code Committee (RCC) and the Netherlands Institute for the Classification of Audiovisual Media (NICAM), the Ministry of OCW will raise this matter.
In de contacten met de Reclame Code Commissie (RCC) en het Nederlands Instituut voor de Classificatie van Audiovisuele Media (NICAM) zal het Ministerie van OCW dit ter sprake brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de constructie van De Wit thuiszorgorganisatie

MPs Marijnissen and Van Kent asked about thuiszorgorganisatie De Wit employing 'zorg-au pairs' from Eastern Europe under Wlz care, inspection history, language requirements, pay and oversight. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate issued an aanwijzing after repeated non-compliance, that foreign care workers are allowed if qualified, that a WTZi reform bill is in preparation, and that topfunctionaris pay is not publicly disclosed because the organisation lacks a WTZi licence.
It is up to the institution itself whether and how it wants to be transparent about the pay of its top officials.
Het is aan de instelling zelf of en hoe zij transparant wil zijn over bezoldigingen van haar topfunctionarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de kosten voor koosjere maaltijden in zorgcentra

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether kosher meal provision at care centres such as Etrog in Amersfoort is under financial pressure because costs are not covered in the tariffs, and whether the government will ensure such religious meal provision remains possible. The State Secretary replied that meals are part of the integrated Wlz tariff for accommodation, that there are no specific funding rules for religious meals, and that providers have freedom to allocate funds, while agreeing that food can be part of a care centre's identity.
There are no specific funding rules for the reimbursement of meal provision according to religious practices.
Er zijn geen specifieke bekostigingsregels voor de vergoeding van maaltijdverstrekking volgens religieuze gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over klachten over betalingsachterstanden van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) aan schrijf- en gebarentolken

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about UWV payment delays to sign-language and written-language interpreters, including unpaid invoices, VAT burdens, and poor reachability. The state secretary answered that about 1,730 invoices were paid late due to capacity problems and internal miscommunication, that all arrears have now been cleared, and that UWV will discuss service improvements with interpreter organisations and report to parliament after the summer.
UWV will keep the Ministry of SZW informed of the outcomes. On that basis, your House will be informed after the summer about improvement measures that follow from them.
Het UWV zal het Ministerie van SZW op de hoogte houden van de uitkomsten. Op basis hiervan zal uw Kamer na de zomer worden geïnformeerd over verbetermaatregelen die hieruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht “Bezetting ambulances in steden in de knel”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary for Health about reports that ambulance staffing shortages in Utrecht, Rotterdam and The Hague threaten continuity of care, and whether each ambulance crew should include a permanent employee. The government answered that providers and insurers are responsible for continuity, that AZN reports sufficient staff in all regions, and it outlined training funding and an experiment with the Bachelor Medisch Hulpverlener, without committing to structural changes to employment rules.
It is the responsibility of the care provider to deliver good care and to safeguard continuity in doing so.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder om goede zorg te leveren en daarbij de continuïteit te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Diertens en Van Meenen over de oproep om een gezonde voedselomgeving te bevorderen

MPs De Groot, Diertens and Van Meenen asked about a call by food scientists to make healthy eating the easy choice, including reported plans by Dunkin' Donuts to open outlets in schools and hospitals. The state secretary said the government supports a healthy food environment, works with schools, municipalities and food partners through existing programmes, and has no known plans for fast-food outlets in schools or hospitals.
As far as is known, there is currently no question of Dunkin' Donuts or any other fast-food chain opening outlets in schools and hospitals.
Antwoord 3, 4 Voor zover bekend is er momenteel geen sprake van een eventuele vestiging van Dunkin» Donuts of een (andere) fastfoodketen in scholen en ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over invallen bij thuiskwekers

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether reported police raids on home cannabis growers were proportionate, how raid and eviction decisions are made, and whether medical use and personal circumstances such as a child with autism are weighed. The Minister answered that the reported accounts were partly incorrect, that such decisions are local discretionary assessments under the Damocles policy and Article 4:84 Awb, and that no central guideline weighs medical use or personal circumstances.
There is no central guideline for weighing whether and how personal circumstances factor into decisions on police raids and evictions at cannabis plantations.
Er is geen centrale richtlijn voor de weging of en hoe persoonlijke omstandigheden meewegen in besluiten bij invallen en ontruimingen van wietplantages door de politie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat gehandicapten een verklaring van een (onafhankelijk) arts nodig hebben om in attractiepark De Efteling gebruik te kunnen maken van de voorzieningen voor mensen

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that De Efteling required doctors' certificates from visitors with disabilities to use accessibility facilities, and whether this fits the UN disability convention. The state secretary answered that Efteling has since dropped the certificate requirement after consulting disabled people, that the sector association is considering a common guideline, and that only independent doctors may issue such certificates under KNMG rules.
Inquiries with Efteling show that, after talking with people with disabilities, it has now adjusted its policy.
Uit navraag bij de Efteling blijkt dat zij, na een gesprek met mensen met een beperking, haar beleid inmiddels heeft aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Menzis keurmerken voor wijkverpleging verplicht heeft gesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary about insurer Menzis requiring Kiwa quality marks for home-care staff, the threat of withheld payments, and whether such requirements are acceptable. The government answered that insurers may set quality conditions, that the Kiwa mark is a practical tool for self-employed carers, and that Menzis has improved its communication and contacted the affected carers.
An health insurer is free to set (quality) requirements for care providers as long as the content and scope of the entitlement are not restricted and the insurer fulfils its duty of care.
Een zorgverzekeraar is vrij om (kwaliteits)eisen te stellen aan zorgaanbieders zolang de inhoud en de omvang van de aanspraak hiermee niet wordt beperkt en de zorgverzekeraar zijn zorgplicht nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Peters over onterechte verdenkingen van kindermishandeling

CDA MPs Keijzer and Peters asked the state secretary about research suggesting that child-abuse screening questionnaires used by doctors lead to mostly unfounded suspicions, and about the training, procedures and data retention affecting wrongly accused parents. The state secretary disputes that the research shows over 90% unfounded suspicions, says screening is only an alert tool, promises to explore having Veilig Thuis itself initiate destruction of files when suspicions are refuted, and notes that training is left to field parties without a separate budget.
Together with the Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis I consider it desirable that Veilig Thuis, when the suspicion has been refuted, itself takes the initiative to destroy the file.
Samen met het Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis vind ik het wenselijk dat Veilig Thuis, als het vermoeden is weerlegd, zélf het initiatief neemt tot vernietiging van het dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het nog niet toegezonden actieplan pleegzorg

MP Raemakers asks why the promised action plan on foster care has not yet been sent to parliament, when it can be expected, and which parties were consulted. The Secretary of State says he expects to send the plan before 1 June 2017, that it addresses motions on tariffs, foster parents' legal position and dropout, and lists the consulted parties.
I expect to be able to present the Action Plan Foster Care to your House before 1 June 2017.
Ik verwacht het Actieplan Pleegzorg vóór 1 juni 2017 aan uw Kamer te kunnen aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de aanhoudende problemen in de jeugdzorg

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about the continuing problems in youth care, including the Transition Authority's warning about institutional survival and payment practices. The State Secretary answered that the TAJ term was extended, the transition cost subsidy was prolonged, and that the government will pursue standardisation, an escalation ladder and a bill to enforce compliance, though it largely leaves payment arrangements to municipalities and providers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat mensen met een beperking niet terecht kunnen in een zorginstelling

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health why young people with intellectual disabilities and severe behavioural problems cannot find care places, how care insurers' duty of care fits with waiting lists of up to 143 people, and whether the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) should have intervened earlier. The State Secretary called the situation undesirable, said care insurers are working on a contact and mediation action plan with results reported in May, acknowledged a rough estimate of about 500 hard-to-place youths without fully verifying it, and promised to inform parliament soon.
I will inform the House this spring about the results, as well as about the structural improvement measures.
Ik informeer uw Kamer nog dit voorjaar over de resultaten, evenals over de structurele verbetermaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het kwaliteitskader “Verpleeghuiszorg, samen leren en verbeteren”

Member Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary about the nursing home quality framework, including whether it is deliberately vague, staffing minimums for intensive care, night and weekend cover, the role of the Inspectorate, and consultation and evidence behind it. The State Secretary defended the framework as setting clear minimum norms, said the Inspectorate adapted its framework, and explained staffing is context-dependent with the sector to develop local norms.
The Care Institute has included the nursing home care quality framework as a quality standard in its register.
Het Zorginstituut heeft het kwaliteitskader verpleeghuiszorg opgenomen als kwaliteitsstandaard in haar register.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten in Zuid-Holland korten op het pgb

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the State Secretary about reports that municipalities in South Holland cut personal budgets (pgb) for parents of seriously ill children. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Youth Act, that the ministry has checked their approach, that the region has committed to better motivation of decisions, and that a further study of pgb trends will follow.
Municipalities are responsible for the implementation of the Youth Act.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de Jeugdwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de zorgkantoor niet weten wie zorg nodig heeft

An MP asks whether care offices (zorgkantoren) really do not know who needs long-term care and how many people, acute or otherwise, are waiting, and how this split between active and non-active waiters can be justified. The State Secretary responds that care offices actively mediate active waiters, that non-active waiters depend on signals from clients or providers, and that five concrete measures, including intensified NZa supervision, have been announced with an action plan report due this spring.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of the action plan, including structural improvement measures, this spring.
Ik informeer uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het actieplan, inclusief structurele verbetermaatregelen, dit voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de harde kritiek op de overgehevelde jeugdzorg

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about harsh criticism of the decentralised youth care, including deteriorating care, rising crisis placements, regional procurement withdrawals and whether decentralisation has failed. The State Secretary rejected claims of deteriorating care, pointed to regional cooperation efforts, a pending Hospers report on crisis placements, a planned bill to enforce standard arrangements, and said a first evaluation would come in early 2018.
The bill amending the Youth Act and the Social Support Act 2015 to reduce implementation burdens, which makes this possible, goes into consultation in May 2017.

Het wetsvoorstel «wijziging van de Jeugdwet en de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 in verband met het verminderen van de uitvoeringslasten» dat dit mogelijk maakt, gaat in mei 2017 in consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de tolkenvoorziening

An MP asked the state secretary about decentralising sign-language interpreter provision, including municipal expertise, client choice and quality. The government answered that the Berengroep and UWV will handle assessments centrally, client choice is balanced against practical limits, and it will inform parliament further after its letter of 8 March 2017.
The current funding method for the sign-language interpreter provision via the VNG will no longer be possible from 1 January 2018.
De huidige financieringswijze voor de doventolkvoorziening via de VNG is per 1 januari 2018 niet meer mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de pilot wijkverpleging nu al verliesgevend is

An MP asks whether the Utrecht home-nursing pilot, reported as already loss-making, is leading to more hours from non-contracted providers and risks to patients, and whether the pilot should be halted. The State Secretary says there are no signals that care quality is at risk, that Zilveren Kruis (the insurer) is compensating preferred providers and considering checks on non-contracted providers, and that the pilot is a contractual matter for the insurer and providers, monitored by Zilveren Kruis and the NZa.
The pilots concern contractual arrangements between Zilveren Kruis and the providers.
De pilots betreffen contractafspraken tussen Zilveren Kruis en de aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over subsidieverlening aan organisaties voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik in de kerk

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about the resignation of KLOKK's supervisory board, the salary and spending of KLOKK's director, the handling of sub-funding to MCU, and the continuation of grant support. The government replied that the board resigned on its own choice over a disrupted relationship with the executive board, that the director's pay is set by the supervisory board, that remaining improvement points are being followed up, and that the grant will not be renewed after 2017 and disbursement was paused.
However, it is for the Supervisory Board, in its role as employer of the director, to set the director's employment conditions.
Het is evenwel aan de Raad van Toezicht, in de rol van werkgever van de directeur, om de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de directeur vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de sluiting van de verzorgingshuizen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the closure of St. Clara nursing home in Gorinchem, its residents' relocation, the building's sale proceeds, and cuts to nursing-home places under the shift from institutional to home care. The State Secretary answered that the building was outdated, residents are being offered alternatives in consultation with the care office and client council, and that closures are not tracked centrally, with the government stating care offices must buy enough places.
No national list is kept of nursing homes that are closing or plan to close in 2017.
Er wordt landelijk geen lijst bijgehouden van verzorgingshuizen die sluiten of in 2017 voornemens zijn te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorginstelling Charim versnaperingen aan haar bewoners schrapt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that care provider Charim cut residents' small extras such as coffee and biscuits, and about whether directors who left received severance pay and whether intimidation persists. The State Secretary replied that the coffee and biscuit were not abolished but adjusted in consultation with the client council, that IGZ sees no need for direct intervention, and that severance details must be disclosed under WNT transparency rules in the annual report.
The cup of coffee and the biscuit with the coffee for residents at the Mirtehof and Amandelhof locations have not been abolished.
Het kopje koffie en het koekje bij de koffie aan de bewoners van de locaties Mirtehof en Amandelhof zijn niet afgeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over rolstoeltoegankelijkheid van treinen

Mr Van Helvert (CDA) asked the state secretaries about the wheelchair accessibility of trains after a TV report, including the number of stations without assistance, the risk of worsening access before 2024/2030, and whether timelines can be shortened. The state secretary rejected the report's conclusion as too one-sided, cited planned extra assistance stations and new accessible trains, and said the timelines are already near what is feasible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er opnieuw patiëntenstops zijn in de wijkverpleging

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports of renewed patient-intake stops in community nursing, the 20% budget cut, staff shortages, families being relied upon, and workforce issues. The State Secretary replies that the budget is sufficient, that insurers bear the duty of care supervised by the NZa, and that a sector-wide process to improve procurement for 2018 is underway, while committing to a monitor report and continued monitoring.
I expect the NZa monitor on the 2017 community nursing contracting process at the end of March, which will give a clearer picture of the agreements made between insurers and providers.
Ik verwacht eind maart de monitor van de NZa over het contracteerproces wijkverpleging 2017 waaruit een duidelijker beeld komt van de gemaakte afspraken tussen zorgverzekeraars en aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over de mogelijkheid voor (pleeg)kinderen om het inkomen van ouders bij een aanvullende beurs buiten beschouwing te laten

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked how DUO assesses requests to disregard parental income for supplementary student grants in cases of severed contact or serious conflict, including what documentation is required and whether requiring students to describe private conflicts is acceptable. The minister answered that DUO needs a range of evidence depending on the situation, that students may need to provide personal statements, that DUO can depart from professional statements, and that decisions follow the legal framework and internal work instructions.
The framework on which DUO bases a decision consists of the legal framework, made up of statutes and regulations and their explanatory notes.
Het afwegingskader op basis waarvan DUO een beslissing neemt wordt gevormd door het wettelijk kader, bestaande uit de wet- en regelgeving en de daarbij behorende toelichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de arbeidsvoorwaarden in wijkteams hard achteruit gaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that employment conditions of social neighbourhood team staff are deteriorating, including loss of permanent contracts and pay cuts after reorganisations. The State Secretary answered that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that existing employment protections and employer obligations apply, and that the ministry has no data and sees no reason for further investigation or intervention.
I do not have figures on how many people working in social neighbourhood teams have seen their employment conditions worsen due to organisational changes.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over hoeveel mensen die werkzaam zijn in sociale wijkteams er bij organisatieveranderingen in arbeidsvoorwaarden op achteruit zijn gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitzending van Kassa inzake onveilige sleutelkluisjes

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about unsafe key lockboxes used with elderly home care, raised by a Kassa broadcast, and about actions taken since 2014, cooperation with stakeholders, public information, safe alternatives, a Putten subsidy and the government's duty to help the elderly live safely. The state secretary said such lockboxes are undesirable, pointed to an ongoing cross-ministerial track with sector parties and CCV research into alternatives, said the product concerned was removed from the Politie Keurmerk list, and stressed shared responsibility of clients, professionals, municipalities and insurers.
Under the responsibility of the Minister of Security and Justice, a track was started in 2016 to promote safe access to homes of vulnerable groups.
Onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie is in 2016 een traject ingezet om veilige toegang voor woningen van kwetsbare groepen te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Hoogland over de toegankelijkheid van treinen en treinstations

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretaries about worsened train accessibility for wheelchair users at Zevenbergen and Lage Zwaluwe stations and related planning. The government acknowledged the problem, explained that new SLT-to-other-rolling-stock deployment and platform-height timelines cause it, and committed to further accessibility measures and travel information.
ProRail's programme to bring all platforms to the correct height runs until 2030.
Het programma van Prorail om alle perrons op de goede hoogte te brengen loopt tot 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over jong ouderschap

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary how municipalities can better use decentralisation to support young parents, avoid new silos, handle the region-binding rule for shelters, address housing access, administrative burdens, preventive funding, education support and consultations with FIOM and Siriz. The state secretary answered that municipalities are implementing the transition locally and are supported via guidance and monitoring, that no national data exists on homeless teen mothers and a study is planned, and promised to report back in May and after the Voorjaarsnota.
These figures are not registered in a way that allows a national overview to be generated.
Deze cijfers worden niet geregistreerd op een wijze waarmee landelijk overzicht kan worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een zorgbestuurder de verpleeghuisnorm van Hugo Borst niet realistisch vindt

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health whether a care executive's claim that the 2-staff-to-8-residents nursing home norm is unrealistic is correct, along with questions on staffing costs, labour market shortages, managers in care, governance conflicts at Fundis/Alliade, and whether the minister distances herself from the manifesto. The State Secretary disputes or declines to verify the executive's figures, defends the Zorginstituut's decision not to adopt a generic numeric staffing norm, promises an analysis of financial effects by end February 2017, and says he sees no problem with the governance issues beyond the boards' own responsibility.
I have no insight into how exactly the calculation in question was arrived at.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de wijze waarop de betreffende berekening precies tot stand is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bergkamp over het aanvragen van een invalidenparkeerkaart door zorginstellingen die niet onder de Wet Toelating Zorginstellingen (WTZi) vallen

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Health about care institutions not covered by the WTZi being denied disabled parking permits, and whether an exception should be created. The state secretary said the permit rules sit with the Infrastructure ministry and that he wants no distinction by funding route and will examine with that ministry whether the regulation can be amended.
I will examine together with Infrastructure and Environment whether the regulations can be adjusted on this point.
Ik zal samen met Infrastructuur en Milieu bezien of de regelgeving op dit punt kan worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er te weinig aandacht is voor mannen die door vrouwen worden mishandeld en misbruikt

An MP asked the government about the lack of attention and data on men who are abused or assaulted by women, including prevalence, shelter, and prevention. The state secretary answered that a prevalence study is due end-2017, that men-specific shelter exists in 40 places, and promised to highlight male victims in an existing public campaign.
The study is expected to be completed at the end of 2017.
Het onderzoek wordt naar verwachting eind 2017 afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat De Zonnebloem fors moet bezuinigen op zorgvakanties voor gehandicapten en minder valige ouderen wegens teruglopende donaties

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about reports that De Zonnebloem must cut holiday places for disabled people and frail elderly due to falling donations, and whether the ministry could cover the 4 million euro shortfall. The state secretary said De Zonnebloem is an independent organisation that decides how to spend its donations, that it is cutting most of its holiday offer, and that the ministry will not fund the shortfall from its budget because that would make volunteer organisations too dependent on government subsidies.
De Zonnebloem is an independent organisation that makes its own decisions about how donations and gifts are spent.
De Zonnebloem is een zelfstandige organisatie die zelf besluiten neemt over de besteding van giften en donaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht: “Medewerkers van verpleeghuis De Bleerinck in Emmen slaan alarm. Constant het gevoel dat ik tekortschiet”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that staffing and care hours at nursing home De Bleerinck were cut, raising concerns about safe care, unpaid breaks, and budget cuts. The secretary said the care board is primarily responsible, the Inspectorate will monitor the situation, and the claim of major long-term care budget cuts is incorrect, citing spending figures.
When the Inspectorate is of the view that there is insufficient, or insufficiently qualified, staff available, the IGZ will intervene.
Wanneer de Inspectie van mening is dat er onvoldoende, of onvoldoende gekwalificeerd personeel beschikbaar is, zal de IGZ ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het kwaliteitskader van de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming

An MP asked about changes to the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming's 2016 quality framework, including whether obligatory safeguards for parents were removed. The State Secretary denied that reporting rules were reduced, explained removed or changed provisions as giving professionals discretion, and said the Child Protection Council's client council was consulted.
It is not correct that the changes have led to a reduction in the rules to which a report must comply.
Het is niet juist dat de wijzigingen hebben geleid tot inkorting van de regels waaraan een rapportage moet voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat 1 op de 3 mensen ontevreden is over de zorg en ondersteuning

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the government accepts responsibility for the roughly one million people reporting unmet care needs after the 2015 reforms, citing a SCP report. The State Secretary answered that the SCP data do not show care being withheld, that the number receiving help stayed stable, that unmet need does not equal requested help, and that existing legal safeguards suffice, committing to no new action.
This does not appear from the SCP research 'Care and support in the Netherlands: key figures 2015'.
Dit blijkt niet uit het onderzoek «Zorg en ondersteuning in Nederland: kerncijfers 2015» van het SCP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een hoogbejaard echtpaar na 70 jaar, door hun zorgsituatie, tegen hun wil in, gedwongen niet meer samenwoont

An MP asked whether an elderly couple separated after 70 years by care needs, and whether previous government promises that couples would not be separated still hold. The state secretary said partner admission under the Wlz is legally possible, that the care office must mediate, that the couple had been offered it but did not take it up at the time, and that a solution is being worked on.
Following the 2014 parliamentary debate on this subject, I undertook to discuss with care offices how clients can be better informed about their rights and options regarding partner admission.

Naar aanleiding van het debat met de Kamer over dit onderwerp in 2014 heb ik toegezegd dat ik met zorgkantoren zal bespreken op welke wijze cliënten beter kunnen worden geïnformeerd over hun rechten en mogelijkheden ten aanzien van de partneropname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de wonderlijke herindicatie van Maartje

An SP MP asks the State Secretary why a client with an intellectual disability was refused Wlz care at reassessment, why the CIZ relied on a 1999 school test, and what support she will receive. The State Secretary declines to discuss the individual case because an objection is pending, explains the general rules and transition arrangements, and provides figures on negative Wlz decisions after temporary LVG/SGLVG profiles.
While this objection is pending, I cannot go into this individual case in more detail.
Hangende dit bezwaar kan ik niet nader in gaan op deze individuele zaak
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat scholen geen vertrouwen meer hebben in Veilig Thuis

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that schools have lost trust in Veilig Thuis, citing 40% of primary schools reporting no feedback on their notifications, and asked about registration systems, data and measures to raise reporting. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the VNG programme 'Veilig Thuis – de basis op orde', the Beweging tegen Kindermishandeling, a protocol to improve statistics, and the meldcode revision, but gave no school-specific data and declined to create a single linked registration system.
No figures can be given on the number of advice requests and notifications from (primary) education.
Er zijn geen cijfers te geven over het aantal adviezen en meldingen vanuit het (basis)onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Volp over het bericht dat Basisscholen weinig vertrouwen hebben in meldpunt Kindermishandeling

MPs Ypma and Volp asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that primary schools have little trust in the child abuse reporting line Veilig Thuis, including long waiting times and weak feedback after reports. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the VNG improvement programme and the Beweging tegen Kindermishandeling, and promised continued monitoring and better communication to schools via progress reports.
That is why the VNG programme is working on structural solutions, both at the entry point and in passing cases on to help and in cooperation with the local field.
Daarom wordt er in het VNG-programma gewerkt aan structurele oplossingen, zowel aan de poort als bij het doorzetten naar hulp en samenwerking met het lokale veld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat pleegkinderen na hun 18e verjaardag vaak in de knel komen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that foster children often struggle after turning 18, including whether municipalities may stop youth care without a conversation and how responsibility is shared between municipalities. The State Secretary answers that the Youth Act allows care to continue until age 23, that municipalities must hold timely conversations, and that a national work agenda, a Action Plan on foster care and a coordination point for complex cases are being developed.

It is up to municipalities, in consultation with foster parents, foster children, the foster care provider and possibly the family guardian, to assess what is necessary and desirable for the 18-year-old.
Het is aan gemeenten om in overleg met pleegouders, pleegkinderen, de pleegzorgaanbieder en eventueel de gezinsvoogd tot een beoordeling te komen wat nodig en wenselijk is voor de 18-jarige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de voortdurende zorgelijke situatie bij Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid

An MP asked the government about continuing problems at Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid, including police reports not being handled properly and waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that inspectorates have kept the organisation under intensified supervision since April 2016, that waiting lists have fallen markedly since August 2016, and that the regional municipalities have taken steps, though the organisation is not yet fully in order.
The inspectorates are following developments at Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid within the framework of intensified supervision.
De inspecties volgen de ontwikkelingen bij Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid in het kader van het verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Dik-Faber over vastgoed in de zorg

MPs Keijzer and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary about vacant care property, waiting lists and the ending of the care infrastructure subsidy. The State Secretary answered that the NZa sees no continuity risk for elderly care, that property decisions lie with providers, and that a successor regulation will be developed.
I want to work towards a national regulation with regional involvement that will replace the care infrastructure subsidy scheme.
Ik wil toewerken naar een landelijke regeling met regionale betrokkenheid, die de subsidieregeling zorginfrastructuur zal vervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over een wijziging in het beleid van Fokus

An MP asked the state secretary whether Fokus's tightened limits on household help, applied from short notice, leave clients insufficient time to arrange replacement help, and whether the government will act to prevent such abrupt changes. The state secretary replied that Fokus says it has not tightened its framework but applies existing criteria, gives clients notice and time when help falls under municipal domain, and that no measures are considered necessary.
I therefore see no need to take measures.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om maatregelen te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het nog steeds niet op een juiste wijze uitvoering geven aan de Wmo 2015 door gemeenten in vervolg op de uitspraken van de Centrale Raad van Beroep op 18 mei jl.

An MP asked whether the municipality of Katwijk is implementing the Wmo 2015 correctly after Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings, and whether other municipalities' household-help schemes comply. The State Secretary says Katwijk has not sufficiently complied with his urgent request, so he is starting the formal instruction procedure under Wmo 2015 (art. 2.6.8), while declining to name a firm deadline for the rest of the questions.

With this response, the municipality of Katwijk has not sufficiently complied with my earlier urgent request to adjust the ordinance, policy rules and implementation of the policy as soon as possible and bring them into line with the Wmo 2015.

Met deze reactie geeft de gemeente Katwijk onvoldoende gehoor aan mijn eerdere, dringende, oproep om op de kortst mogelijke termijn de verordening, de beleidsregels en de uitvoering van het beleid aan te passen en in lijn te brengen met de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat duizenden gehandicapten niet naar de dagbesteding kunnen omdat zorginstellingen onvoldoende geld krijgen

MP Leijten (SP) asks why thousands of disabled people cannot attend day care because institutions lack funds for transport, and whether cuts since 2013 halved the transport budget and led to lost day care, charging for transport, and reduced quality. The State Secretary answers that the NZa found no threat to care duty or minimum quality, that institutions can reallocate within their budgets, that no further research is needed, and that the broader Wlz tariff review will only conclude by 2019.
It is up to institutions to make funds available for this within the total available budget.
Het is aan instellingen om binnen het totale beschikbare budget daarvoor middelen vrij te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de budgetten en bureaucratie in de jeugdzorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about municipal youth care budget shortfalls, rising intake, administrative burden and private practitioners withdrawing from youth care. The state secretary was cautious about shortfall reports, denied a clear rise in youth care use, pointed to ongoing data work and the Jeugdwet's choice rules, and promised to report back on administrative-burden measures in early 2017.
I followed the reporting by NOS and Binnenlands Bestuur with interest.
Ik heb de berichtgeving van de NOS en Binnenlands Bestuur met interesse gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe zorgverzekering voor ouderen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about a new VGZ insurance product for older people developed with the Nationaal Ouderenfonds and ANBO, including subsidies, commissions, advisers' fees, solidarity concerns and transparency of intermediary payments. The minister answered that it is a collective arrangement on existing policies rather than a new insurer, that the organisations receive no commission from VGZ, and that transparency of intermediary remuneration should improve.
I have no insight into the subsidies these older-persons organisations receive from other governments.
Ik heb geen zicht op de subsidies die deze ouderenorganisaties van andere overheden ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over de uitzending van De Monitor van 27 november 2016 betreffende zorgverlener Monte Christo

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a PGB care provider, Monte Christo, encouraged youths to commit fraud to obtain higher assessments, and about complaints, oversight and enforcement. The State Secretary answered that providers must not encourage fraud, described existing controls and an ongoing IGZ supervision track and zorgkantoor investigation, but declined to publish the fraud investigation results.

Health insurers and care offices never make the results of (fraud) investigations public, both because of the privacy of those involved and to prevent sensitive information about fraudsters' methods from becoming public.

Zorgverzekeraars en zorgkantoren maken de resultaten van (fraude)onderzoeken nooit openbaar, zowel vanwege de privacy van de betrokkenen als om te voorkomen dat gevoelige informatie over de werkwijze van fraudeurs naar buiten komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over nieuwe schandalen bij Philadelphia

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a young woman with an intellectual disability who was reportedly subjected to coercive care and confinement at Philadelphia without a court authorisation, along with indication upcoding, a visitation restriction on her stepfather, and calls for independent investigations. The State Secretary said the IGZ had handled a 2014 complaint and closed it in 2015, that Philadelphia has commissioned an external investigation which the IGZ will assess, and that he cannot comment on the specific case until then.
Only once the facts are on the table and the IGZ has assessed Philadelphia's investigation report can I give a substantive response to what happened.
Pas als de feiten boven tafel zijn en de IGZ het onderzoeksrapport van Philadelphia heeft beoordeeld, kan ik een inhoudelijke reactie geven op het gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over misstanden met mentorschap in de zorg

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister about a case in which care provider Philadelphia requested a mentorship for a resident without her family's knowledge, and about how often such requests occur and whether they are monitored. The government answered that an independent external investigation is underway, that the court must hear the person and relatives before appointing a mentor, and that complaints about mentorship have not been referred to the inspectorate, while promising an evaluation of the 2014 law.
Only once all the facts are known and the IGZ has assessed the investigation report can I give a substantive response to Philadelphia's conduct.
Pas als alle feiten boven tafel zijn en de IGZ het onderzoeksrapport heeft beoordeeld, kan ik een inhoudelijke reactie geven op het handelen van Philadelphia.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Advocaat cliënten met pgb-schuld: ‘Instellingen komen wel héél makkelijk weg met misbruik’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that institutions escape easily from PGB (personal budget) fraud, its scale, police and prosecution capacity, and protection of good-faith budget holders. The state secretary cited fraud figures, said capacity is adequate, agreed with care offices on handling pre-December 2015 cases, and promised a mandatory third-party clause in care contracts to allow direct action against fraudulent providers.
To meet the request of your House, I intend to make a third-party clause mandatory for the care agreements that budget holders conclude with care providers.
Om aan het verzoek van uw Kamer tegemoet te komen wil ik een derdenbeding verplicht stellen voor de zorgovereenkomsten die budgethouders sluiten met zorgaanbieders.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht van Actiz dat de Inspectie niet altijd de goede vragen stelt als het gaat om de kwaliteit in verpleeghuizen en dat de IGZ hierop via een reactie in de media stelt dat

An MP asked the state secretary about a media dispute between Actiz and the Inspectorate (IGZ) over who set quality indicators for nursing homes, and whether the government should take the lead. The government answered that the sector, including Actiz, IGZ and client organisations jointly set the safety indicators under an administrative agreement, and that the Care Institute has stepped in to develop a quality framework.
Within this process the IGZ has explicitly taken on the executing role.
Binnen dit proces heeft de IGZ nadrukkelijk de uitvoerende rol op zich genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Fokke over afgelaste operaties in de Zuyderland-ziekenhuizen in Geleen en Heerlen

MPs Volp and Fokke asked the minister whether cancelled operations at Zuyderland hospitals in Geleen and Heerlen, caused by full wards and a norovirus outbreak, could be prevented and how patients could be moved to appropriate care. The minister confirmed the five cancelled operations, said operations resumed the next day, pointed to the insurer's duty of care and NZa oversight, and promised a quickscan of the emergency care chain with results before the Christmas recess.
I am having a quickscan carried out of the emergency care chain in our country because there are signals that more is going on than an incident.
Ik laat een quickscan uitvoeren ten aanzien van de spoedeisende keten in ons land omdat er signalen zijn dat er meer aan de hand is dan een incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht “Soa-sjoemelaars liegen voor gratis test”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that young people lie to obtain free STI tests, rising STI rates, and whether the cap on the ASG scheme and the EUR 150 co-payment create barriers. The state secretary said the scheme serves as a safety net, that triage is in place to prevent misuse, that STI rates rose across age groups, and that the cap was meant to improve efficiency; no new measures were announced.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over zorgorganisaties die steeds meer betalen aan accountants

Two SP MPs asked why healthcare organisations spent rising sums on accountants, with the big four firms taking most of it, and whether the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet caused extra bureaucracy. The state secretary answered that accountancy control is necessary, that costs fell on average, that the rise is due to more contracting parties under the new laws, and that standardisation tools and possible further regulation are being pursued.
I do not have the figures on the accountancy costs of these mental health providers and therefore cannot confirm whether this expectation is correct.
Ik beschik niet over de cijfers van de accountantskosten van deze ggz-aanbieders en kan dus niet staven of deze verwachting wel of niet terecht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel 'Maximaal 3 plassen in verpleeghuis Careyn'

An MP from 50PLUS asks the state secretary for health about a report that residents of nursing home Careyn may only use the toilet three times a day, and whether this is an isolated incident given the IGZ has placed Careyn on its blacklist and sent an intervention team. The secretary calls it an incident that the provider must handle, says the IGZ maintains intensive supervision and support, but gives no specific new action on this case.
The IGZ advice to deploy an intervention team means there is considerable problematic situation at Careyn.
Het advies van de IGZ om een interventieteam in te zetten betekent dat er sprake is van een aanzienlijke problematiek bij Careyn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de indicaties voor zware verpleeghuiszorg zijn gehalveerd

The MP asks whether the halving of severe nursing home care indications in 2015 reflects tighter eligibility or under-indication, and about the tariffs and zorgzwaartepakketten. The State Secretary answers that unique-client figures for VV7-VV10 have stabilised rather than fallen, that the CIZ applies statutory criteria without steering, and that he is examining whether the VV10 profile should continue to be indicated by the CIZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Indicaties voor zware verpleeghuiszorg halveren’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the CIZ's sharp drop in severe nursing-home care indications, and misleading information on its website, mean care recipients get too-low indications and care providers lose funding. The State Secretary replied that the indication process is careful, that the number of unique entitled clients has stayed stable at about 17,000 to 20,000, that no CIZ quota was set, and that objections remain possible.
I have taken note of this and have consulted with the CIZ.
Ik heb hiervan kennis genomen en ik ben met het CIZ in overleg getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het artikel "Wethouder Fles en CDA Noordwijk nemen elkaar de maat"

A CDA MP asks the State Secretary whether the Noordwijk case shows that 'self-reliance' is used inconsistently under the Wmo, whether municipalities must act to prevent harm from closing a building without consulting partners, and whether the municipality wrongly treats prevention and early signalling as outside the Wmo. The State Secretary answers that municipalities may assess self-reliance within the law, that a legal definition is undesirable, that the municipality does provide support and prevention, and that the council has the power to ask questions.
Municipalities can assess the degree of self-reliance of residents.
Gemeenten kunnen de mate van zelfredzaamheid van inwoners beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorgcentrum Huis in de Duinen onder verscherpt toezicht is gesteld

An MP asked why the inspectorate had not placed care centre Huis in de Duinen under heightened supervision earlier despite repeated shortfalls, and whether ministers had allowed a danger to residents to persist. The State Secretary answered that the inspectorate found improvement efforts in January 2016 but stagnation in August 2016 led to heightened supervision from 12 October 2016, and that board appointment decisions rest primarily with supervisory boards.

On the basis of these findings the inspectorate has insufficient confidence in lasting improvement at Huis in de Duinen and therefore placed it under heightened supervision for six months from 12 October 2016.

De inspectie heeft op basis van deze bevindingen onvoldoende vertrouwen in duurzame verbetering van Huis in de Duinen en heeft Huis in de Duinen daarom met ingang van 12 oktober 2016 voor een periode van zes maanden onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over misstanden in de pleegzorg

MP Ypma asks the state secretary about a Haarlem case in which a foster child was placed in another care form and foster payments stopped while the foster parents still provided care, and asks whether foster contracts are formally ended during temporary admissions and how carers will be compensated. The state secretary answers that foster contracts need not be terminated during a temporary admission with prospect of return, that the Regeling Jeugdwet allows reduced but still cost-based payment up to the basic amount, and that the issue will be included in an action plan and evaluation for foster carers.
I will include this point in the foster care action plan and the resulting evaluation of measures to improve the position of foster parents.
Ik zal dit punt meenemen in het actieplan pleegzorg en daaruit voortvloeiend de evaluatie van de maatregelen ter verbetering van de positie van pleegouders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er namens de Stichting Rookpreventie Jeugd aangifte is gedaan tegen vier tabaksfabrikanten die actief zijn in Nederland

An SP MP asked the government to respond to a report that criminal complaints were filed against four tobacco manufacturers, and about laser-perforated filters and TNCO measurement gaps versus real consumer exposure. The State Secretary said the Openbaar Ministerie assesses the complaint, the NVWA is the competent supervisor and will keep enforcing the ISO method until a new one is adopted, and he will raise validated methods at EU level.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to assess the complaint.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om de aangifte te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Asante over Mantelzorgende studenten

Two MPs asked the state secretary and education minister about carer students' stress, dropout and support by institutions and municipalities. The government answered that support is case-by-case via study advisers and hardship funds, pointed to municipal duties under the Wmo 2015, and described a flexible-study experiment, without committing to new national programmes.
In a letter to the aldermen I will ask for attention to this.
In een brief aan de wethouders zal ik hier aandacht voor vragen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de toezegging die is gedaan met betrekking tot het onderzoek van de Auditdienst Rijk naar de notulen van het Directeuren Overleg Alcohol tijdens het Algemeen overleg Omgang me

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the progress and delay of the Auditdienst Rijk investigation into the 2008 minutes of the Directeuren Overleg Alcohol, promised during a 2016 committee debate on government information handling. The State Secretary answered that the digital archives are being searched, a final search is ongoing, results will be handed to the audit service, and the Chamber will be informed, aiming for January.
Once the Auditdienst Rijk has completed its work, I will inform your Chamber of the steps taken in this process and the results it has produced.
Zodra de Auditdienst Rijk haar werkzaamheden heeft afgerond zal ik uw Kamer informeren over stappen die in dit proces zijn gezet en de resultaten die dit heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Zorg voor oudere patiënt onder druk’ in De Medisch Specialist

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that elderly patients cannot safely return home after hospital care, and about proposals to extend out-of-hours admissions and alleged fraud pressure. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the eerstelijns verblijf and the Praktijkteam, said he rejects fraud, and said a regional best-practice list is being developed without committing to a new binding step.
The Praktijkteam "zorg op de juiste plek" has been active for some time to support parties in tackling bottlenecks at local level.
Het Praktijkteam «zorg op de juiste plek» is al geruime tijd op pad om partijen te ondersteunen om knelpunten op lokaal niveau aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorg in de regio Arnhem in de knel dreigt te komen

An SP MP asks whether it is acceptable that three youth-care providers in the Arnhem region may withdraw from a tender, possibly leaving families without their trusted helpers, and what the state will do to prevent underpayment and stalled procurement. The State Secretary answers that the procurement is not yet concluded, that municipalities must ensure adequate provision and continuity under the Jeugdwet, that the Transition Authority can mediate if needed, and that the region will not halt the tender but will seek clarification from the non-bidding parties.
At this moment the tender procedure in the Arnhem region has not yet been concluded and it is not appropriate for me to make statements about it.
Op dit moment is de aanbestedingsprocedure in de regio Arnhem nog niet afgerond en past het mij niet om hierover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een stichting in Emmen fraude heeft gepleegd met persoonsgebonden budgetten (pgb’s) van gedetineerden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that a foundation in Emmen defrauded personal care budgets (pgb) of prisoners, asking how such fraud was possible, when it occurred relative to the trekkingsrecht, and how the money would be recovered. The government answered that a criminal investigation by the Inspectie SZW and the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and declined to comment on the case, but said it would pursue asset confiscation and support victims if fraud is proven.
Pending this investigation, I cannot make any statements about this case.
Hangende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitspraken doen over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de ouderenzorg verstopt raakt

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that elderly care is becoming blocked, including the shrinking growth room for long-term care budgets since 2010 and waiting lists for nursing home places. The state secretary answered that the decline is overstated because personal budgets were added and extra funds were provided, that the 2.4% growth room aligns with CPB projections, and that the cabinet will set growth room for 2018–2021.
This picture is not correct for a number of reasons.
Dit beeld is om een aantal redenen niet terecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over Heineken biertegoed

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health whether Heineken's app-based beer credit promotion, sold alongside supermarket alcohol purchases, breaches the Drank- en Horecawet or advertising codes and should be countered. The State Secretary replies that the promotion does not breach the Act, that advertising compliance falls to the self-regulatory code bodies, that the government cannot yet judge whether it increases drinking, and that the Trimbos Institute will develop an alcohol-reduction app.
There are no provisions in the Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) that prohibit this Heineken action.
Er zijn geen bepalingen in de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) die deze actie van Heineken verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Gideonsbende voor de verpleeghuiszorg

MP Leijten asked how the 'Gideonsbende' advisory group of care practitioners was formed, who its members are, whether they are linked to Inspectorate measures, whether its discussions are secret and whether members are paid. The State Secretary answered that members were selected through contacts in the field, listed 21 members, noted one member's organisation had an Inspectorate instruction, stated discussions are not secret but no minutes are kept, and that members receive no compensation.
No minutes are made of the meetings, because none of the members indicated they wanted them.
Van de bijeenkomsten worden geen verslagen gemaakt, omdat geen van de leden heeft aangegeven daarop prijs te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de open brief aan mevrouw De Jong-Verspeek van BrabantZorg

An MP asked the state secretary whether he contacted the BrabantZorg representative named in an open letter before answering earlier questions, why he did not investigate further, and whether he would ask the NZa to examine the provider and check how often critical relatives are dismissed as mentors. The secretary said the matter is primarily between the complainant and the provider, pointed to legal safeguards and IGZ oversight, said mentors are appointed and dismissed by the court rather than the institution, and declined to order an NZa investigation or further research.
I see no reason to instruct the NZa to conduct further investigation into the working methods of this institution.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de NZa opdracht te geven om nader onderzoek te doen naar de werkwijze van deze instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het geld voor jeugd-ggz in Almere op is

MP Kooiman asked the state secretary how he responds to Almere's letter restricting youth mental health access due to budget shortfalls, whether this reflects broader budget and waiting-list problems, and whether he will verify that children are not left without care. The state secretary replied that the Youth Act obliges municipalities to provide care beyond acute cases, that he contacted the alderman, that the municipal council passed a motion reversing the intake stop, and that he will monitor implementation and report on waiting-time norms in a letter before 14 November.
The mere fact that the municipal budget for youth care threatens to be exceeded does not detract from municipalities' obligation to provide youth care.
Het enkele feit dat het gemeentelijk budget voor jeugdhulp overschreden dreigt te worden doet niet af aan de jeugdhulpplicht van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over wachtlijsten en geldtekort bij jeugdzorg

Member Klein asks the State Secretary about youth care waiting lists, the share of psychologists with waits over four weeks, and whether Almere may temporarily halt part of specialist youth care due to budget shortfalls. The State Secretary says waiting times are being discussed with municipalities and branches, with a progress letter promised, and refers the Almere question to an earlier answer to a related question.
In the progress letter on youth care that I will send to the House before 14 November, I will inform you further about the outcomes of the consultations held.
In de voortgangsbrief Jeugd die ik voor 14 november aan Uw Kamer zal toesturen, zal ik u nader informeren over de uitkomsten van het gevoerde overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Leijten over het bericht dat er meer mensen onder de brug slapen

MPs Bashir and Leijten asked the government about reports of more people sleeping under a bridge in Rotterdam, rising homelessness, and the causes and policy response. The state secretary answered that causes of homelessness are diverse, that responsibility for shelter capacity lies mainly with municipalities, and listed measures such as housing reforms, a Platform31 experiment and a quality framework, without giving a full account of why earlier policy failed.
Responsibility for shelter capacity and for the flow from shelters into housing therefore lies at these levels (municipal and regional).
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de capaciteit in opvangcentra en de doorstroom vanuit de centra naar huisvesting ligt dan ook op deze niveaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bureaucratie waar mantelzorgers mee te maken hebben

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the administrative burden on informal carers, including the estimated 900 million euro cost, a mother's 65-page PGB accountability demands, and whether the government had foreseen the burden. The state secretary acknowledges the burden, points to a regulatory-reduction programme, a commissioned study on reform-related administrative costs, and a planned web portal, but denies a link to cost-cutting and defers details on the individual case.
Once this study is completed, your House will receive the study including a policy response.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond, ontvangt uw Kamer dit onderzoek inclusief een beleidsreactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter met betrekking tot de jeugdhulpaanbesteding in de gemeenten Alphen aan den Rijn en Kaag en Braassem

An MP asked the state secretary how the court ruling on the youth care tender in Alphen aan den Rijn and Kaag en Braassem is being followed up, whether other regions must redo similar tenders, and whether online auction-site tendering should be banned. The state secretary replied that the municipalities are appealing, that existing providers continue meanwhile, that the ruling concerns risk allocation and scope rather than the tender method, and that no other changes to policy follow.
If the appeal ruling is that a re-tender must nonetheless take place, the court's ruling will be taken into account when carrying out that re-tender.
Mocht de uitspraak in hoger beroep zijn dat alsnog moet worden overgegaan tot heraanbesteding, dan wordt bij de uitvoering van deze heraanbesteding de uitspraak van de rechter in acht genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Mei Li Vos over de ontoegankelijkheid van nieuwe postbussen van Post.nl voor mensen met een beperking

MPs Volp and Mei Li Vos asked why PostNL's new parcel and letter lockers in Almere are inaccessible to people with disabilities, whether Arbo rules conflict with the UN disability convention, and whether PostNL will make accessibility agreements. The State Secretary replied that the lockers are a pilot, that lowered letter boxes are kept on request, that PostNL will consult Ieder(in), and that existing postal rules already cover vulnerable groups so no additional agreements are needed.
I therefore see no reason for additional agreements.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding voor aanvullende afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Nijboer over hulp bij pinnen voor mensen met een beperking

MPs Volp and Nijboer asked whether ING's new security policy, which requires a companion when a customer with a disability withdraws cash, conflicts with the Dutch disability equality law and the UN Convention. The State Secretary answered that banks set their own security rules, that the Wgbh/cz obliges providers to make effective adjustments with the College voor de Rechten van de Mens judging specific cases, and that the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer will discuss accessibility.
The College voor de Rechten van de Mens can investigate whether there is prohibited discrimination and whether article 2 has been violated.
Het College voor de Rechten van de Mens kan onderzoeken of er sprake is van verboden onderscheid en of er in strijd met artikel 2 is gehandeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het (her)indiceren, binnen de Wmo, via de computer

An MP asked whether municipalities may assess and re-assess Wmo care needs via computer instead of face-to-face 'kitchen table' interviews, and whether the minister considers this consistent with tailored care. The minister answered that clients may in some cases use a digital procedure but are not obliged to, that municipalities must still meet Wmo 2015 requirements, and that he has no overview of how many municipalities use computers for this and sees no reason to investigate.
I have no insight into the number of municipalities that use the computer to carry out the investigation set out in article 2.3.2 Wmo 2015.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal gemeenten dat de computer inzet bij het uitvoeren van het in 2.3.2 Wmo 2015 opgenomen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over problematiek rondom onveilige scootmobiels

An MP asked the State Secretaries about accidents with three-wheeled mobility scooters, whether councils wrongly issue them instead of safer five-wheeled models, and how scooters are checked for safety. The government answered that causes are multifactorial, a SWOV study is ongoing with results expected end 2017, and that scooters are not type-approved for road use, with councils responsible for individual suitability.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over Wurg- en zwijgcontracten in de jeugdzorg

MP Kooiman asked whether the minister will investigate how many municipalities use gag and strangle clauses in youth care contracts and whether clients can effectively opt out, and how the minister will address privacy problems. The minister answered that municipal councils oversee municipal privacy compliance, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises, no investigation into scale or opt-out is planned, and the issue will be placed on the agenda of the next consultation with municipalities and providers.
It is up to the municipal council to supervise the conduct of the municipal executive board.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om toe te zien op het handelen van het college van B&W.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de ramingen ontwikkeling verpleeghuizen 2016-2021

MP Bergkamp asked the State Secretary for Health about the projected development of nursing home places for 2016–2021, the sources and parties behind the projection, and timing of answers before a debate.
