The State Secretary answered that the projection is a technical estimate based on 2015 realisations, CPB wage and price indices, and assumed demographic growth, does not yet include extra 2016 funds, and that actual growth may differ or be higher.
The realisation of growth in the number of places may therefore differ from what the technical projection indicates.
De realisatie van de groei in het aantal plekken kan dus anders verlopen dan de technische raming aangeeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Bouwmeester over zeggenschap van bewoners, patiënten en cliënten over hun zorg

MPs Bouwmeester and Volp asked why residents of care home Thebe cannot sleep under their own bedding when the board will not pay for washing it, and whether the sector's leadership and the Taskforce Waardigheid en Trots should act for those with low incomes. Minister Schippers answered that the Zorginstituut now specifies that the care institution is responsible for washing bedlinen, including residents' own, with the cliëntenraad's agreement, and pointed to the Landelijke Commissie van Vertrouwenslieden and a planned amendment to strengthen client councils' rights.
The institution is responsible for washing the flat linen.
De instelling is verantwoordelijk voor het wassen van het platgoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de noodopvang voor ouderen een gat in de markt is

Leijten (SP) asked whether emergency short-stay care for elderly people, introduced by Amsta, reflects closing nursing homes and lighter care being pushed out of institutions, and what the government will do so elderly people get care when needed. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the short-stay first-line care is a welcome addition, will fall under the Zvw from 2017, that no extra capacity is created, and that the budget was raised by 29.5 million euros.
The moving out of institutions of the lighter care packages mainly concerns people who previously lived permanently in an institution with a relatively light care need.
Het extramuraliseren van de lichtere zorgzwaartepakketten heeft vooral betrekking op mensen die voorheen permanent in een instelling verbleven met een relatief lichte zorgvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat vanwege geldgebrek autistische kinderen op de wachtlijst komen

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether autistic children are being placed on waiting lists because of budget shortfalls at a youth mental health provider, and about cut-off dates, waiting-list data, and guarantees against children falling through the gap. The secretary replied that municipalities bear the duty of care and procurement responsibility, that national waiting-list data cannot be provided, and that he will report on waiting-time agreements with VNG and providers in the November progress letter.
In this case it is up to the municipality of Dordrecht to make agreements with providers on the care offer for children who need youth care directly.
Het is in dit geval aan de gemeente Dordrecht om afspraken te maken met aanbieders over het hulpaanbod voor kinderen die direct jeugdhulp nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat in veel gemeenten het geld voor de jeugdpsychiatrie al op is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether youth psychiatry funding in many municipalities had run out, creating waiting lists, and how the government as system responsible would address budget ceilings and related issues. The State Secretary replied that youth care budgets are unearmarked municipal funds, that waiting-list cases are being checked individually and so far not linked to budget shortfalls, that talks with the VNG on referring children are under way, and that municipalities' budget outcomes vary for many reasons.
I am in talks with the VNG and sector bodies about the agreements they will make on this and will inform you of the outcomes before the budget consultation.
Ik ben met de VNG en branches in gesprek over de afspraken die zij hierover gaan maken en zal u voor het begrotingsoverleg informeren over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de uitzending van Argos waaruit blijkt dat Bureau Jeugdzorg Noord-Brabant niet aan waarheidsvinding doet

Member Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary about a Argos broadcast claiming Bureau Jeugdzorg Noord-Brabant does not establish the truth in custody disputes, and what steps would be taken, including forensic investigation and reviewing the family guardian's role. The State Secretary replied that the statutory duty to state facts fully applies, the bureau rectified its regional director's statement, existing complaint and disciplinary routes exist, and no further action or forensic expansion is planned, while a separate advisory process on forensic research is underway.
Certified institutions are obliged to state the relevant facts fully and truthfully in reports or petitions (article 3.3 of the Youth Act).
Gecertificeerde instellingen zijn verplicht in rapportages of verzoekschriften de van belang zijnde feiten volledig en naar waarheid aan te voeren (artikel 3.3 van de Jeugdwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de ruim driekwart van gemeenten dat de fout in is gegaan met de huishoudelijke verzorging

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government views research showing that 77% of municipalities may be violating the Wmo 2015 after CRvB rulings on domestic care, and what supervisory steps it has taken. The State Secretary answered that he contacted three municipalities party to the case and ten others, has formally written to four, that a national network of social-domain directors will support municipalities, and that municipalities themselves are responsible for aligning their policy with the law.
I do not have a national overview of the state of affairs at municipalities.
Ik beschik niet over een landelijk overzicht van de stand van zaken bij gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht dat bierreclames op televisie het drankgedrag van tieners beïnvloedt

An MP asked the state secretary whether beer advertising on television influences teenagers' drinking, and whether a French-style advertising ban and alcohol sponsorship should be reconsidered. The state secretary said the findings will be weighed in the upcoming evaluation of the Drank- en Horecawet, pointed to existing TV advertising time limits and the STIVA code, and said current rules allow the sponsorship.

I will therefore take the findings of the cost-benefit analysis (MKBA), including the outcomes of the analysis of the effects of restricting advertising measures, into account in the evaluation of the Drink and Catering Act taking place this year.

Ik neem de bevindingen van de Maatschappelijke Kosten en Baten analyse (MKBA), inclusief de uitkomsten van de analyse van de effecten van het beperken van reclame maatregelen dan ook mee in de evaluatie van de Drank – en Horecawet die dit jaar plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen de uitvraag over kwaliteit van zorg door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) boycotten

An MP asks the State Secretary about nursing homes boycotting the IGZ quality data request, the so-called black list, the consequences for non-delivery, the new quality framework and staffing norms. The State Secretary rejects the boycott as unacceptable, says the IGZ can demand information and take steps, and promises the updated list and quality framework by year-end.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een bewoner van zorginstelling Cordaan

MP Leijten asked the state secretary about the IGZ report on the 2014 death of a 19-year-old resident of Cordaan from choking, including why the report is not public, why it took two years, and whether the executive board should face consequences. The state secretary said the report found care shortcomings but is withheld pending consideration of interests, the criminal investigation blocks judgement on avoidability, the IGZ sees no grounds for stronger enforcement, and Cordaan has committed to improvements.
This report is not public. Before I can send information from the report to the House, the IGZ is obliged to weigh the interests of those involved in the matter.
Dit rapport is niet openbaar. Voordat ik informatie uit het rapport naar Uw Kamer kan sturen is de IGZ gehouden de belangen van de bij de aangelegenheid betrokkenen te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Het kabinet verrekent zich met toestroom Wlz’

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether the government would respond to a report by Bureau HHM showing possible shifts into the Wlz long-term care scheme, with 5% more older clients and 13% more disabled clients, and whether this implies extra budget. The state secretary answered that the figures are theoretical maximum shifts, that actual uptake is being monitored by CBS, that the NZa advises on budget adequacy, and that no extra budget is needed based on this report.
Within that perspective the research mapped what the maximum shifts are in theory.
Het onderzoek heeft binnen dat perspectief in kaart gebracht wat theoretisch gezien de maximale verschuivingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat aanbieders van wijkverpleging nu al op budgetplafonds stuiten

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that home-care providers are already hitting budget ceilings, raising concerns about care continuity, waiting lists, job losses and bankruptcies. The state secretary said there is more budget in 2016, that insurers must ensure access to care and offer alternatives when ceilings are reached, and that regional consultations were being arranged, while declining to provide provider-level figures on cliënten stops, layoffs or bankruptcies.
I have no insight into the number of client stops or the number of institutions where waiting lists threaten to arise.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal cliëntenstops dan wel het aantal instellingen waar wachtlijsten dreigen te ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over de rapportage ‘Onderzoek naar goed bestuur binnen de Zorggroep Alliade te Heerenveen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the IGZ/NZa report finding an appearance of conflict of interest at Zorggroep Alliade, including its board, supervisory board, the Freya/Support & Co structures, and whether market-conformity could be verified. The State Secretary answered that such conflicts are unacceptable, that the board and supervisory board should have acted earlier, that the directors resigned, and that the IGZ, NZa and Openbaar Ministerie continue monitoring, promising further inspection action.
If in the IGZ's judgement Alliade falls short in this, the IGZ will take further measures.
Indien naar oordeel van de IGZ Alliade hierin tekort schiet, dan zal de IGZ nadere maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de onderzoeken naar belangenverstrengelingen bij zorginstelling Alliade

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about inspection findings on conflicts of interest at care provider Alliade, where directors also owned subcontracting companies, and about the appearance of conflict, the market conformity of payments, and whether rules should change. The State Secretary says the appearance of conflict is unacceptable, notes the directors have resigned, says the regulators will examine the matter further and address conflicts of interest in governance oversight, but states that no data exist on other providers and declines to give the subcontractor financial figures.
I have therefore asked the IGZ to explicitly put the theme of conflicts of interest on the agenda in its oversight of good governance.
Ik heb de IGZ daarom gevraagd om het thema belangenverstrengeling expliciet te agenderen in hun toezicht op goed bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Ouderen zitten aantal keren zonder maaltijd'

An MP asked whether a warm meal is basic care under the Wlz and why elderly residents at a care facility were going without warm meals, despite high fees. The State Secretary replied that the case concerns Zvw home-care with an additional meal service by Wielborgh, not Wlz care, that the disruption came from a switch to volunteers, and that extra staff have since been arranged.
Contrary to what the article suggests, this does not concern Wlz care but Zvw care with additional services provided by home-care provider de Wielborgh.
Anders dan het artikel suggereert, gaat het hier niet om Wlz-zorg, maar Zvw-zorg met aanvullende dienstverlening door thuiszorgaanbieder de Wielborgh.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over wurg- en zwijgcontracten in de jeugdzorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about gag and strangling clauses in youth care contracts that force independent providers to hand over confidential client data and impose penalties for breaching secrecy. The state secretary answered that contracts may not violate the law, that a ministerial regulation now clarifies privacy rules for data sharing, and that courts can review such clauses, but declined to make model contracts mandatory or to track how many municipalities use similar clauses.
What is certainly not possible is that municipalities include conditions that violate laws and regulations, or require a provider to violate them.
Wat zeker niet kan, is dat gemeenten voorwaarden opnemen die wet- en regelgeving overtreden, of die van een aanbieder verlangen dat ze deze overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat geen Valysvervoer wordt toegekend

An MP asks why a woman referred by Valys to a municipality for Wmo transport was sent back to Valys without an indication, how often this happens, and whether the municipality will intervene. The state secretary says the referral back is not logical, notes Valys access can be obtained without a Wmo indication, promises a fifth eligibility condition by 1 October 2016 and a broader study of Valys access.
On the specific case, the municipality of Hollands Kroon could not go into it from a privacy point of view.
Op de specifieke casus kon de gemeente Hollands Kroon vanuit het oogpunt van privacy niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Curator: ‘Wmo klopt gewoon niet’

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about a curator's claim that the Wmo does not work, the bankruptcies of Thuiszorg Noord-Holland and Stichting ZorgBedrijf, care-worker pay, and tariffs. The state secretary answered that the curator explained his views, that continuity of care and working conditions were secured through takeovers, that causes await the bankruptcy report, and that he has no overview of other home-care bankruptcies; he referred to a draft decree on a realistic price and to earlier agreements with unions and VNG.
For the answer to your question about the precise reasons for the bankruptcy, the bankruptcy report must be awaited.
Voor het antwoord op uw vraag naar de precieze redenen van het faillissement moet het faillissementsverslag worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over lange wachttijden voor een plek in een verpleeghuis

An MP asked the state secretary about rising waiting times for nursing home places, including a May 2016 jump in actively waiting people and whether the reassessment of care indications played a role. The secretary answered that monthly figures fluctuate, the May rise appears one-off, insurer differences are small, and promised to report on the client-motivation study in October and on measures after that.
I will inform your House shortly about the outcomes of the study and also indicate which measures will be taken on that basis.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en tevens aangeven welke maatregelen op basis daarvan worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat tientallen ouderen die in een huis van Florence wonen verplicht moeten verhuizen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about reports that dozens of elderly residents of a Florence care home must move, including sixteen forced to relocate, and about related job losses and care-allocation choices. The state secretary replied that the move reflects a shift towards care at home and that the relocations are a matter for the care provider and the zorgkantoor, with the IGZ monitoring quality and safety rather than placement decisions.
It is up to the care provider to make decisions in this regard and up to the IGZ to supervise them.
Het is aan de zorgaanbieder om daarin beslissingen te nemen en aan de IGZ om daarop toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht “Gemeenten verhullen optie extra huishoudelijke hulp”

An MP asks whether municipalities are holding back the extra Huishoudelijke Hulp Toelage funds for domestic help and why, and whether the government will ensure the money is used for its intended purposes. The State Secretary says the conditions were loosened in December 2015, municipalities decide how to spend the money within the aims, monitoring shows gains but realisation lagging, and he has no signals of misuse.
I have no signals that municipalities are not using this money for the agreed purposes.
Ik heb geen signalen dat gemeenten dit geld niet voor de afgesproken doelen inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat ouderen of instanties kinderen opzadelen met enorme pgb-schulden

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that children are left with large personal budget (pgb) debts incurred by parents or institutions while they were minors, and whether this breaches children's rights and whether the system should change. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem as undesirable, said he is discussing a solution with care offices and the NZa, and said that since 2015 pgb applications are examined more strictly, though he saw no reason to change application rules and could not yet give numbers of affected children.
That is why I am in discussion with the care offices and the NZa to find a solution for this AWBZ case.
Daarom ben ik met zorgkantoren en de NZa in gesprek om te komen tot een oplossing voor deze AWBZ-casuistiek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er een wachtlijst bestaat voor assistentiehonden voor mensen met een psychische stoornis en over het bericht dat assistentiehonden nog steeds niet overal toega

MPs asked the Defence and Health ministers about waiting lists for assistance dogs for veterans with PTSD and about hotels refusing access to assistance dogs despite legal duties. The ministers said waiting lists are undesirable but left them to the sector, pointed to pending independent research funded by Defence, and promised to consult Koninklijke Horeca Nederland and to raise awareness.
It is undesirable that hotels wrongly refuse assistance dogs.
Het is onwenselijk dat hotels assistentiehonden ten onrechte weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de continuïteit van zorg in gedrang komt door krappe budgetten wijkverpleging

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that budget ceilings for district nursing threaten continuity of care, including expected waiting lists and service stops, and whether the 600 million euro cut is responsible. The state secretary answered that insurers have a duty of care and must contract additional care, that existing clients keep their right to continue treatment, that regional consultations will be set up, and that the 2015 overrun of 37.7 million euro is limited, with 180 million euro more available in 2016.
I have already agreed with health insurers and care providers to hold regular regional consultations between care purchasers and providers starting in September.
Ik heb ook al met zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders afgesproken om vanaf september regionaal periodieke overleggen te beleggen tussen zorginkopers en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het mogelijke faillissement van thuiszorgorganisatie Solace ATC Thuiszorg

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Solace ATC, its debts, municipal cuts to care hours, transfer of clients and staff, and possible director liability. The State Secretary answered that the bankruptcy curator is responsible for investigating causes, has selected Tzorg as successor provider, and that such questions fall to the curator and courts, so he will not start his own investigation.
It is for the judge to assess whether the board members and supervisors involved are held personally liable for the bankruptcy.
Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de betrokken bestuurders en toezichthouders persoonlijk aansprakelijk gesteld worden voor het faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars aanbieders van wijkverpleging straffen

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Health whether insurers clawing back 51 million euros from home-care providers that exceeded their 2015 volume caps is appropriate, given claimed savings and a budget underspend, and about resulting care continuity risks. The State Secretary replies that use of the macro-budget instrument is his decision and was not applied for 2015, that revenue clawback is a private contractual matter between insurer and provider, and that he has no data on affected clients, closures or layoffs.
That is a private-law matter between the health insurer and the care provider.
Dat is een privaatrechtelijke kwestie tussen zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Zorgverzekeraars claimen 50 miljoen bij aanbieders wijkverpleging en het bericht van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland dat zorgverzekeraars verbaasd zi

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked about reports that health insurers claim 50 million from home-care providers for exceeding revenue caps, and about insurers' duty of care for insured persons. The State Secretary answered that such contractual revenue caps and clawbacks are a matter between insurers and providers, that insurers' statutory duty of care remains intact, and described the dispute-resolution route and the numbers of additional contracts and care hours.
This concerns a component of a contractual agreement between an individual care provider and an individual health insurer, of which I am not a party.
Dit betreft een onderdeel van een contractuele overeenkomst tussen een individuele zorgaanbieder en een individuele zorgverzekeraar waarin ik geen partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars verbaasd zijn over de reactie van Actiz over de wijkverpleging

An MP asks the State Secretary about insurers' reaction to Actiz on home nursing funding, questioning the shift of wijkverpleging to insurers, the 600 million euro budget cut, and the risk to patients. The State Secretary defends the transfer to the Zvw, reports a 37.7 million euro overrun for 2015 with no overrun yet in 2016, notes extra funds for 2016, and refers to the dispute-resolution body and a separate answer for the gambling question.
I still stand behind the transfer of wijkverpleging to the Zvw.
Ik sta nog steeds achter de overheveling van de wijkverpleging naar de Zvw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de budgetten van wijkverpleging nu al uitgeput zijn

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports that home-nursing (wijkverpleging) budgets were already exhausted, including claims that insurers were deliberately limiting contracting and clawing back funds. The state secretary said there were no indications the national budget was insufficient, pointed to extra funding and insurers' duty of care, and referred contracting disputes to negotiation and the new dispute body.
I have no insight into data at the level of individual care providers.
Ik heb geen inzicht in gegevens op het niveau van zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over De brandbrief van Actiz over de wijkverpleging

An MP asked the state secretary about Actiz's warning that home-care providers face serious pressure from insurers' contracting, with fears of client stops and financial failures. The state secretary responded that insurers must meet their duty of care, budgets are adequate, and regional consultations will be organised, while rejecting most concerns.
I have agreed with health insurers and care providers that from September they will hold periodic regional consultations between care purchasers and care providers.
Ik heb met zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders afgesproken dat zij vanaf september regionaal periodieke overleggen beleggen tussen zorginkopers en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over mogelijk etnisch profileren van ondernemers

An MP asks several ministers whether inspection and licensing bodies may be ethnically profiling entrepreneurs through risk models, large joint enforcement teams and the 'slecht levensgedrag' licence criterion. The minister answers that ethnicity is not a selection variable, that the government opposes profiling and points to existing measures, but declines to provide lists, case-level quickscans or a fundamental investigation, pointing to municipal responsibility.
No, a list of fined companies alone cannot support any conclusion about how companies are selected.
Nee, uit alleen een overzicht van beboete bedrijven valt geen conclusie te trekken over de selectie van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het aftreden van de voltallige Adviesraad Sociaal Domein van de gemeente Katwijk

An MP asked the State Secretary about the resignation of the entire Katwijk social domain advisory council over the municipality's Wmo implementation, including whether the municipality complied with Central Raad van Beroep rulings and whether it used individual assessments. The State Secretary answered that Katwijk had partly corrected its ordinance, that the remaining fee-discount scheme does not fit the Wmo 2015, and that he has written to the municipal executive requesting a response on bringing policy into line.

I have therefore, in accordance with the rules of inter-governmental supervision, requested in writing that the Katwijk executive inform me promptly of how the municipality will bring its policy and implementation in line with the Wmo 2015.

Ik heb het college van B en W van de gemeente Katwijk daarom, conform de spelregels van het interbestuurlijk toezicht, schriftelijk verzocht mij op korte termijn te informeren over de wijze waarop de gemeente beleid en uitvoering in lijn brengt met de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Karabulut over het bericht dat de vrouwenopvang onveilig is

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about reports that women's shelters are unsafe, with reports of fear cultures, volunteer and flex staffing, bureaucracy, debt, high contributions and weak housing pathways. The State Secretary answered that no further signals of a fear culture were received, that the matters are largely for municipalities and ongoing projects, and promised continued monitoring and talks with the Federatie Opvang.
This concerns a limited number of anonymous sources.
Het gaat hier om een beperkt aantal anonieme bronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat gemeenten de juridische grenzen van de WMO opzoeken

An MP asks the state secretary about municipalities seeking legal limits to avoid complying with a Central Appeals Tribunal ruling on domestic help under the WMO, and about VNG guidance on not restoring cut hours. The secretary rejects non-compliance, says he can intervene under article 2.6.8 if municipalities deviate structurally, and asks municipalities to review their policy with VNG support, while denying the cuts should be reversed.

When I find that a municipality deviates more than incidentally from the legal framework, as partly defined by the CRvB, and the municipal council does not take its responsibility, I have the option to use the powers under article 2.6.8 of the Wmo 2015.

Op het moment dat ik constateer dat een gemeente meer dan incidenteel afwijkt van de wettelijke kaders, zoals mede ingevuld door de CRvB, en de gemeenteraad haar verantwoordelijkheid niet neemt, heb ik de mogelijkheid om van de bevoegdheden in het kader van artikel 2.6.8 van de Wmo 2015 gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat er angst is voor het overlijden van bewoners van verpleeghuis Westhoff

An MP asks the state secretary for health about reports that a care home's board plans to relocate residents, and that staff and relatives fear residents may not survive the move, plus the board's claims about staff shortages and policy. The answers say the board is responsible for hiring and has enough budget, the relocation is unrelated to funding shortages, and the minister is willing to meet the board chair.
Inquiries with Florence indicate that the board sees itself responsible for hiring enough higher-educated staff and that Florence has sufficient budget for this.
Navraag bij Florence leert dat de bestuurder zich verantwoordelijk weet voor het aannemen van voldoende hoger opgeleid personeel en dat Florence hiervoor voldoende budget heeft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet kunnen krijgen van een persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) via de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) bij een persoonlijk faillissement van één van de ouders

Two SP MPs asked why a 14-year-old's personal budget (pgb) was refused and whether the SVB-managed scheme and the care office meet their duty of care when a parent is bankrupt, and whether the rule is still needed and how many similar cases exist. The State Secretary says a suitable solution was found with the mother, that the rule on bankruptcy stays as a safeguard, that the NZa supervises the care office, and that no broader investigation is needed.
The care office, given the specific circumstances and from the standpoint of its duty of care, has now reached a solution that, as I understand it, is suitable for all parties.
Het zorgkantoor is, gelet op de specifieke omstandigheden en vanuit het oogpunt van de zorgplicht, inmiddels met een, naar ik heb vernomen, voor alle partijen passende oplossing gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Leijten over de VNG-pilot blurring

MPs Voordewind and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Health about the VNG pilot on alcohol blurring, which they say breaches the Drank- en Horecawet, including in supermarkets and in light of a poll showing 75% opposition. The State Secretary answered that a court found Nieuwegein acted unlawfully, that municipalities must enforce rather than tolerate violations, that he raised the issue with the VNG, and that he will weigh the poll and supermarket participation in the ongoing evaluation of the law.
Municipalities must enforce violations of the Drink and Catering Act rather than tolerate them.
Gemeenten dienen overtredingen van de Drank- en Horecawet te handhaven en niet te gedogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de open brief van een mevrouw over haar tante die mogelijk door BrabantZorg kaalgeplukt wordt

An MP asked the state secretary whether care provider BrabantZorg was wrongly debiting a resident's account for voluntary contributions and hairdressing, and what would be done about it, including whether a sample investigation would be carried out. The state secretary said the matter falls to the inspectorate, the NZa and the courts' appointed guardians, saw no need for a new investigation, and considered existing enforcement powers sufficient.
It is the task of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) to supervise this.
Het is de taak van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) om daarop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Velpse zorginstelling Boriz fraudeerde; zorggeld ging in eigen zak in plaats van naar cliënten’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that a care provider, Boriz, defrauded personal budget funds, including how budget holders are protected, possible sanctions such as professional bans, signals of similar fraud elsewhere, and the status of a promised fraud warning register. The State Secretary answered that fraud will be tackled firmly, outlined civil and criminal remedies and governance instruments, pointed to enforcement partners for signals, and promised further reporting on the register this autumn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over fraude bij zorgorganisatie Boriz

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about suspected fraud at care organisation Boriz, its profits, whether it continues as subcontractor of Pluryn, and whether former owners can set up new care organisations. The state secretary said he awaits Menzis's fraud investigation, which he will not publish, declined to give a timeline, said excessive profits do not belong in care and that enforcement bodies are acting, and noted insurers must screen providers' integrity.
Health insurers and care offices never make fraud investigation reports public, both out of privacy interests and to prevent sensitive information about fraudsters' methods from becoming public.

Zorgverzekeraars en zorgkantoren maken de rapporten van fraudeonderzoeken nooit openbaar, zowel vanuit het belang van privacy als om te voorkomen dat gevoelige informatie over de werkwijze van fraudeurs naar buiten komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel "Negen op de tien ouderen zien zorgverleners te kort"

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Health about a Nationaal Ouderenfonds finding that home-care workers increasingly neglect their signalling duty for loneliness, malnutrition and dementia, and who bears responsibility. The State Secretary agreed signalling is important, called it a shared responsibility of care providers, the social domain and the client's environment, and welcomed the Fund's initiative to propose improvements.
An agreement has been made with the Ouderenfonds that they will send me a proposal for this.
Met het Ouderenfonds is de afspraak gemaakt dat zij mij hiervoor een voorstel doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het onderzoek naar het mijden van zorg vanwege eigen bijdragen Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) flink vertraagd is

Two SP MPs asked why the CBS study on whether people avoid Wmo care because of co-payments was delayed and whether the research will answer that question. The Staatssecretaris explained the delay (data not yet ready for tables, final results expected November 2016), said supplementary qualitative research on avoidance has been commissioned, and declined to suspend co-payments before the results are in.
Additional research has been commissioned into undesired avoidance of care and co-payments.
Er is aanvullend onderzoek uitgezet naar ongewenste zorgmijding en eigen bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Onderzoek gevolgen eigen bijdragen Wmo flink vertraagd”

An MP from the CDA asks why the CBS study into the effects of higher Wmo co-payments is delayed again and whether care avoidance is included. The State Secretary answers that the data were not ready for preliminary results before summer, final tables are expected in November 2016, and care avoidance falls outside the CBS study, to be covered by complementary qualitative research.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over het bericht dat miljoenen euro’s in zakken van zorgdirecteuren verdwijnen

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked the government about reports that millions of euros of public care funds flow to care directors as dividends, and how this is permitted and controlled. The State Secretary answered that the WTZi bans profit distribution in institutional care but allows it in some outpatient care, that internal supervisors, insurers and municipalities oversee this, and that existing rules are sufficient, while promising to fight abuse via the governance code and inspections.
In the first instance, it is up to the supervisory body of the care provider concerned to assess whether paying out dividends is in the interest of the provider's continuity and patient care.

Het is in eerste instantie aan het toezichthoudend orgaan van de betreffende zorgaanbieder om te beoordelen of het uitkeren van dividend in het belang is van de continuïteit van de aanbieder en de zorgverlening aan patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat miljoenen euro's zorggeld verdwijnen in de zakken van directeuren

The SP MP Leijten asks the State Secretary how small care providers can make very high profits, why a third of recognised care businesses do not file full annual accounts, how profit-taking in care can be stopped, and whether a licensing requirement or a ban on care-sector BV structures should be introduced. The State Secretary responds that profit distribution is restricted for intramural care under the WTZi, that the IGZ is investigating specific cases, that supervisory boards and purchasers bear primary responsibility, that partial reporting for a substantial share of providers is allowed under the rules, and that existing licensing already applies, while declining to ban the BV structure.
The IGZ investigations into these matters are currently ongoing and I cannot anticipate their content or outcomes.
De onderzoeken van de IGZ hiernaar lopen op dit moment en ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de inhoud en de uitkomsten ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over rookruimtes in de horeca

An ChristenUnie MP asks the state secretary for health about smoking rooms in hospitality venues, whether they undermine the smoking ban and unfair competition, whether municipalities can help enforce the Tobacco Act, and whether smoke-free playgrounds will be promoted. The state secretary answers that smoking rooms are incompatible with a smoke-free society, that rising numbers are not necessarily a sign of failed policy, that NVWA enforces the ban in cooperation with municipalities while deferring a decision on municipal enforcement until the Drank- en Horecawet evaluation, and that he supports smoke-free playgrounds and local tobacco control.
I am monitoring the consequences of my policy, and that includes the presence of smoking rooms.
Ik houd de gevolgen van mijn beleid in de gaten en zo ook de aanwezigheid van rookruimtes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht "Een beetje hulp totdat het te laat is"

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary about a news report on youth care, whether acute out-of-home placements have risen since municipalities took over youth care, and whether children face dangerous waiting times for specialist help. The secretary says no data yet shows a rise, a study will be published in October 2016, he agrees children must get the right help, and promises to discuss waiting times with municipalities and sector bodies, reporting in the autumn progress letter.
I have committed to further discuss the state of affairs regarding waiting times and the necessary improvements with municipalities and the sector organisations.
Ik heb toegezegd dat ik met gemeenten en de brancheorganisaties de stand van zaken rondom de wachttijden en de verbeteringen die er nodig zijn verder zal bespreken

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de berichten “Antilliaanse verzekeraar leeg getrokken”, “Balletje-balletje op de Antillen met reserves van verzekeraar Ennia” en “Spin in het Antilliaanse web

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked the Finance and Interior Ministers about press reports on insurer Ennia on Curaçao, supervision by the Dutch and local central banks, and Dutch liability for failing Caribbean financial institutions. The ministers answered that prudential supervision of Ennia lies with the Curaçao central bank, that DNB's powers over BES branches are limited, that DNB's 2015 report is confidential so details cannot be given, and that the Dutch state is not guarantor for Caribbean financial institutions.

Because of, among other things, DNB's duty of confidentiality, which aims to limit possible harmful consequences for the institution concerned, and because of my systemic responsibility as Minister, under which in principle I do not receive information on individual supervised institutions from DNB, it is not possible for me to answer the questions about the content of the report and about any earlier warnings and actions.

Vanwege onder meer deze geheimhoudingsplicht van DNB – die als doel heeft om eventuele schadelijke gevolgen voor de betrokken instelling te beperken – en vanwege mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid als Minister – waarbij geldt dat ik in principe geen informatie over individuele onder toezicht staande instellingen van DNB ontvang – is het voor mij niet mogelijk om de vragen over de inhoud van het rapport en over eventuele eerdere waarschuwingen en acties te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Philadelphia 30.000 euro per maand betaalt voor de beveiliging van kasteel Beverweert

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that care provider Philadelphia pays 30,000 euro per month for security at Kasteel Beverweert, and whether this is paid from care funds, what the full cost history is, and why the estate has not been sold. The State Secretary answered that Philadelphia itself is responsible for its spending, that security costs about 50,000 euro per month, that the castle still carries 4.5 million euro on the books, and that no realistic buyer has been found, while providing only partial cost data.
For how that care and support is organised, Philadelphia – like every other care provider – is itself responsible.
Voor de wijze waarop die zorg en ondersteuning wordt georganiseerd, is Philadelphia – net als iedere andere zorgaanbieder – zelf verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Wijkverpleging noodgedwongen soms ook poetshulp”

Krol (50PLUS) asked the state secretary about a report that district nurses sometimes do cleaning work and that many carers are overburdened. The state secretary said nurses should not do routine household work but may incidentally do small tasks, pointed to respite care and municipal responsibility for carers, and said capacity should be used effectively.
I am aware that carers are often heavily burdened and that overburdening must be prevented as much as possible.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat mantelzorgers vaak zwaar belast worden en dat overbelasting zo veel mogelijk moet worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over jong ouderschap naar aanleiding van het congres Jong en Ouder

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the state secretary about support, housing, funding fragmentation and care for young parents, including teen pregnancies in closed youth care. The state secretary largely pointed to municipal responsibility, existing initiatives and the taskforce, promising follow-up letters on national procurement and a study on the demand side.
Municipalities precisely have the opportunity to look, using funds from different sources, at how integrated tailored support can best be delivered.
Gemeenten hebben juist de mogelijkheid om met middelen die uit verschillende bronnen komen te kijken op welke wijze integraal het beste maatwerk kan worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de contracten van bestuurders

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether board members of Amstelring, a care provider under intensified inspection, with a 111% employment factor comply with the WNT pay cap and whether this is acceptable. The state secretary answered that no WNT breach occurred since actual pay stays under the maximum, that the accountant checks the hours arrangement, and that CIBG monitors compliance and will enforce where needed.
In this case there is no violation of the WNT.
Er is in dit geval geen sprake van overtreding van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanhoudende financiële problemen voor jeugdzorginstellingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about persistent payment delays and financial problems for youth care institutions, including the eligibility criteria for transition-cost subsidy, the size of the payment problem, and administrative burden. The State Secretary largely defended the existing escalation ladder and subsidy criteria, said no reliable data exist on administrative burden, and promised to report on standardisation by September.
No figures are available that offer solid insight into a decrease or increase in administrative burden and regulatory pressure since decentralisation.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar die een solide inzicht bieden in een daling of stijging van administratieve lasten en regeldruk sinds de decentralisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de top van de slecht presterende verpleeghuizen meer verdient dan de norm

An MP asks the state secretary for health about reports that top executives at poorly performing nursing homes earn more than the Balkenende norm, whether high pay is justified, and what action will be taken. The secretary says the WNT sets maximum pay, supervisory boards must set a fitting pay within those limits, and the CIBG will enforce the WNT if violations occur.
The CIBG supervises the WNT. If there is a violation, the CIBG will take enforcement action.
Het CIBG ziet toe op de WNT. Indien er sprake is van en overtreding, zal het CIBG handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht "Top slechte verpleeghuizen verdient meer dan de norm"

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why directors of poorly rated nursing homes earn above the Balkenende norm, and how this fits with claims that high pay attracts the best managers. The State Secretary replied that supervisory boards must set appropriate pay within the WNT limits, that transitional rules apply, and that he supports self-reflection and accreditation for care governors.
Within the limits set by the WNT, it is up to the internal supervisors to determine what an appropriate remuneration is for the director(s) concerned.
Binnen de grenzen die de WNT stelt, is het aan de interne toezichthouders om te bepalen wat een passende beloning voor de betrokken bestuurder(s) is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over ongekend hoge declaraties van een zorginstelling

An MP asked the state secretary whether a care provider's billing for a terminal patient's home care, which the family calculated at very high hourly rates, was justified. The government replied that the family misread five-minute billing units as minutes, that the rates are within the contractual and NZa maximum tariffs, and that the billings are considered justified.

Based on the data supplied for assessing this case by the health insurer, the Netherlands Care Authority (NZa) and the care institution itself, it can be concluded that the institution's billing behaviour is justified.

Op basis van de gegevens die voor beoordeling van deze casus zijn aangeleverd door de zorgverzekeraar, Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de zorginstelling zelf, kan worden geconcludeerd dat het declaratiegedrag van de zorginstelling gerechtvaardigd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over zaken die te maken hebben met huiselijk geweld

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about domestic violence: whether Veilig Thuis quality covers households without children, which inspectorate supervises shelters and Veilig Thuis, PTSD expertise and treatment capacity, whether victims of stalking can adopt a new identity, the sharing of victims' addresses with suspects, police expertise on psychological abuse, and scheduling. The government answered that the inspectorates' scope covers all victims, that municipalities are responsible for oversight of Veilig Thuis, that existing care and a standard on trauma are relied on, that a new identity is not possible while an analysis of victim data use is ongoing, and that address restrictions and domicile choice protect victims in most cases.
Municipalities are therefore responsible for the oversight of the VT organisations.
Gemeenten zijn dus verantwoordelijk voor de controle van de VT-organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het aantal slachtoffers van sextortion dat explosief groeit

MP Bergkamp asked whether the rapid growth in sextortion victims is concerning, how victims can be supported, how stigma can be addressed, how criminal organisations can be tackled, and which criminal provisions apply. The government answered that the Help Wanted figures do not show explosive growth, outlined victim support measures, awareness and education programmes, Interpol-coordinated enforcement, and the existing legal options, while stating it will examine making sextortion with a sexual motive a sexual offence.
The Public Prosecution Service does not specifically register cases involving coercion or extortion with a sexual motive.
Het Openbaar Ministerie registreert niet specifiek op gevallen waarbij sprake is van dwang of afpersing met een seksueel motief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming 130 tijdelijke mensen aanneemt

MP Kooiman asked the Justice and Health ministers about long waiting times at the Child Protection Board (Raad voor de Kinderbescherming) and the temporary hiring of 130 staff, including whether waiting times will be reduced, what the effects are on the wider child protection chain, and whether extra funds will follow. The minister answered that the hiring is a temporary response to unexpected rising intake, that waiting times may rise further before easing by year-end, that the chain will be monitored and funding adjusted if the rise persists, and that other chain organisations are the responsibility of municipalities.
We see no need to take other measures in anticipation of this.
Wij zien geen noodzaak om vooruitlopend hierop andere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat relatie- en concurrentiebeding voor vrije zorgkeuze gaat

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a court ruling letting a care provider's non-compete and non-relocation clauses override young adults' free choice of care, along with related questions on child welfare, management pay and a profit-distribution holding structure. The State Secretary regretted the impact on clients, said the court's ruling must be respected, argued choice of care remains important, said the inspectorate is investigating the profit ban and the pay regulator will examine management pay, and deferred to contracting bodies to protect clients.

The CIBG will, as the responsible supervisory body under the Public and Semi-Public Sector Senior Officials (Remuneration) Act, launch an investigation into the remuneration of De Karmel's management.

Het CIBG zal, als de verantwoordelijke toezichthouder op grond van de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke – en semi-publieke sector, een onderzoek instellen naar de bezoldiging van het management van De Karmel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bv-boom van zorgnetwerkorganisatie Fundis Holding

An MP asks the state secretary about healthcare network Fundis Holding's structure of 22 BVs, including its restructuring into BVs, financial oversight, WTZi licensing, profit distribution, dual board roles, and governance. The state secretary answers that the structure is the organisation's own choice, financial reporting is published, one BV has licensing, dividends stay within the foundation, and dual roles are said not to exist, while calling dual roles incompatible with the governance code.
Fundis has informed me that every legal entity within its organisation publishes its own annual report and financial statements.
Fundis heeft mij laten weten dat elke rechtspersoon binnen haar organisatie een eigen jaarverslag en jaarrekening uitbrengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Pantein 170 banen schrapt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about Pantein's plan to cut 170 jobs to save 10 million euros, asking about its finances, care quality, and salary guarantees for remaining staff. The State Secretary answered that Pantein is responsible for its own management and personnel policy in consultation with the works council, that the IGJ is already examining care quality, and that no ministerial investigation is warranted.
Pantein is itself responsible for its business operations and, in consultation with the works council, for its personnel policy.
Pantein is zelf verantwoordelijk voor haar bedrijfsvoering en – in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad – voor haar personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over meer vraag naar euthanasie als er onvoldoende palliatieve zorg geboden wordt

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether inadequate palliative care drives demand for euthanasia, citing SCEN doctors who feel powerless when palliative care falls short and an extrapolated estimate of 160 to 800 cases a year. The State Secretary acknowledged the SCEN doctors' frustration, said he has no hard data on palliative care quality, and promised a progress letter and improvement measures such as the National Palliative Care Programme.
I do not have hard figures on the quality of the palliative care provided.
Ik heb geen harde cijfers over de kwaliteit van de ingezette palliatieve zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de mantelzorgers financiële problemen heeft

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the government how it views reports that over half of informal carers face financial problems, why carers were not informed about changes in care, and what concrete measures will be taken. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for supporting carers under the Wmo 2015, that the cited Nibud study should be qualified, and that no concrete measures were announced beyond pointing to municipal responsibility.
It is up to municipalities to translate this responsibility into policy and implementation.
Het is aan gemeenten om deze verantwoordelijkheid door te vertalen in beleid en uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over een gemeente die geen nieuwe zorginstelling binnen zijn grenzen wil

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked whether the municipality of Aa en Hunze's refusal to host a 24-place assisted-living facility over budget concerns, and the risk of shifting clients between municipalities, is acceptable. The State Secretary says regional need is already met, explains that cost exposure depends on the care actually provided and contracts, and points to a regional plan and a 2020 objective funding model rather than new cross-municipal payment arrangements.
For the distribution of funds for sheltered housing there is currently a historical distribution.
Voor de verdeling van de middelen behorend bij beschermd wonen is momenteel sprake van een historische verdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het hoge ziekteverzuim in de zorg

An SP MP asks the government why sickness absence in health and welfare care is higher than the national average, why it is high in care homes and social services, whether burnout follows from understaffing, and what measures will reduce it, including the staffing norm for long-term care demanded by the Leijten motion. The state secretary answers that absence has long been higher in this sector and reflects demanding work, that the 2016 Q1 figures are not clearly higher than 2015, that a staffing guideline is being developed and due by 1 October, and that existing programmes and sector campaigns address sustainable employability.
I see this as a good opportunity to raise the prevention of work stress and sickness absence in care on the agenda.
Ik zie dat als een goede gelegenheid om het tegengaan van werkstress en ziekteverzuim in de zorg aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de burger niet zo zelfredzaam is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that citizens are not as self-reliant as the policy assumes, and whether care recipients can rely on their networks and on government support. The State Secretary answered that most people are self-reliant, that the Wmo is for those who cannot manage alone, that the policy will not be changed, and that the research underlying the reports is still ongoing.
I therefore see no reason to adjust my policy.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding om mijn beleid aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Leijten over de handelswijze van bestuurders bij Alliade Zorggroep

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the state secretary about conflict of interest at Alliade Zorggroep, where two directors earned money through subcontracting companies, and whether the supervisory board, accountants, IGZ and NZa failed in their oversight. The state secretary answered that IGZ and NZa investigated, found no unlawful use of care funds, and that Alliade has committed to measures such as tighter internal rules and disclosure, with the IGZ to monitor compliance.
I share with IGZ and NZa that any appearance of conflict of interest must be avoided and I agree with their judgment that Alliade must remedy this.
Ik deel met IGZ en NZa dat iedere schijn van belangenverstrengeling moet worden vermeden en deel hun oordeel dat Alliade dit moet herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de rechterlijke uitspraken over Schakenbosch

MPs Bergkamp and Kooiman asked the state secretary about court rulings that minors stayed without a valid legal basis at the Schakenbosch closed youth facility, and why the government did not intervene earlier. The state secretary confirmed knowledge of the rulings since November 2015, said coercive care requires a legal basis, and reported that the Inspectorate is assessing all closed youth institutions, with a final report and consequences promised within weeks.

My starting point is that coercive care requires a legal basis, whether it takes place in a closed youth care institution under the Youth Act or involves compulsory mental health or disability care under the Bopz Act.

Mijn uitgangspunt is dat gedwongen zorg een juridische grondslag behoeft, of deze nu op grond van de Jeugdwet in een instelling voor gesloten jeugdhulp plaatsvindt of dat het gedwongen geestelijke gezondheidszorg of gehandicaptenzorg betreft op grond van de Wet bopz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht dat 38 kinderen onwettig in een gesloten inrichting zitten

MP Ypma asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that 38 children were held unlawfully in closed youth care facilities, including questions on coercive measures, lack of legal representation and the child's best interest. The State Secretary said the Inspectorate is still investigating, that the facilities differ in practice, and promised to send the final report with consequences to parliament within weeks.
As discussed in the committee meeting of 30 June 2016, I expect to receive the Inspectorate's final report within a few weeks.
Zoals besproken in het AO van 30 juni 2016, verwacht ik eindrapport van de Inspectie binnen enkele weken te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kerstens over het verkrijgen van raadsinformatie via een Wob- verzoek (Wet openbaarheid van bestuur)

Members Leijten and Kerstens asked why two parties in Oude IJsselstreek must file a Wob request to obtain information on contracts for home-visit (keukentafel) assessments, and whether bonus-malus arrangements tied to outcomes are acceptable and used elsewhere. The state secretary said council information rights under the Gemeentewet are broader than Wob, rejected bonus-malus arrangements as inconsistent with the Wmo 2015, and reported that no other municipalities are known to use them.
That accountability and information duty is broader than the disclosure duty arising from the Wob, because the Wob regulates citizens' right to government information.

Die verantwoordings- en informatieplicht is breder dan de openbaarmakingsplicht die uit de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob) voortvloeit, omdat de Wob het recht van burgers op overheidsinformatie regelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de huishoudelijke verzorging steeds meer plaatsvindt in het zwarte circuit

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the Wmo 2015 causes fewer care indications, pushing more care into the black market, and about PGGM survey findings on undeclared work and job prospects of home-care workers. The State Secretary answered that municipalities must assess support needs, that the Regeling dienstverlening aan huis offers a legal alternative, that undeclared work is not the government's preferred solution, and that no signals of municipalities forcing undeclared care were known.
There is no insight into the number of alfa-helpers without a contract. No figures are available on this.
Op het aantal alfahulpen dat geen contract meer heeft bestaat geen zicht. Hierover zijn geen cijfers voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over huishoudelijke hulpen die vaker zwart werken

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether domestic helpers increasingly work informally and why the RDaH scheme has little uptake and weaker legal protection for short-hours workers. The minister said informal work is not known, described an information campaign on RDaH, defended the scheme's differentiated rules, and noted municipal use of the Huishoudelijke Hulptoelage.
Whether there is undeclared work involved is not known to us.
Of hierbij sprake is van zwart werk, is ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat Zeeuwse gemeenten medische gegevens van kinderen eisen

An MP asks whether Zeeland municipalities demanding children's medical data before funding treatment violates the temporary ministerial regulation and privacy law. The State Secretary says the regulation limits shared data to diagnosis groups with an opt-out, that the municipal board is responsible for privacy compliance, and that the data protection authority supervises, with only one complaint known and a final regulation being prepared.
The municipal board of mayor and aldermen is primarily responsible for ensuring the municipality complies with the legal requirements on information security and privacy protection.

Het college van burgemeester en wethouders is primair verantwoordelijk om ervoor te zorgen dat de gemeente voldoet aan de wettelijke vereisten ten aanzien van informatiebeveiliging en privacybescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Ontslag voor 250 huishoudelijke hulpen Zorggroep’

MP Keijzer asked the State Secretary about the planned dismissal of 250 domestic helpers at Zorggroep Oude en Nieuwe Land and whether the hourly rates paid by three municipalities allow a sound business and meet municipal duties under the Wmo 2015. The State Secretary answered that the municipalities' policy does not comply with Wmo 2015 rules after recent court rulings, that temporary and structural arrangements are being prepared, and that the rates meet the Code and sufficient budget exists.
The three municipal executives acknowledge this and will propose to their councils in the short term to adjust the local Wmo policy for cleaning support.
De drie colleges van burgemeester en wethouders erkennen dit feit en stellen op korte termijn de gemeenteraden voor het lokale Wmo-beleid voor schoonmaakondersteuning te aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over alfahulpen in de thuiszorg

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the state secretary about alfahulpen in home care, including the Oude IJsselstreek municipality's reaction, whether the promised legislation would come, and workers' insurance and income. Van Rijn answered that the municipality is reconsidering its plans, that the quoted remark was inaccurate, that gemeenten should inform citizens about labour-law aspects, and described the voluntary insurance options under the Regeling dienstverlening aan huis.
I consulted the municipality and this turns out to be an incorrect quotation.
Ik heb de gemeente geconsulteerd en dit blijkt een onjuist citaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een groot ziekenhuis over een paar jaar achterhaald is

MP Leijten asked the minister on what research she based her claim that large hospitals will be obsolete within a few years, and how this fits with ongoing hospital mergers and emergency-room closures. The minister answered that hospital care must reorganise toward networks and home-based treatment, that she does not consider hospitals unnecessary, and that the Nza and ACM review mergers while market oversight is being strengthened.
I informed your House about this in more detail by letter on 6 June.
Ik heb uw Kamer daar op 6 juni per brief nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Vermue en Ypma over het bericht dat Zeeuwse gemeenten medische gegevens van kinderen eisen

MPs Oosenbrug, Vermue and Ypma asked whether Zeeland municipalities demanding children's medical data to decide on reimbursement of care complies with privacy law and the Youth Act, and whether municipal officials are qualified and trained to handle it. The state secretary says only one complaint is known, no diagnosis information was requested, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that privacy safeguards and a definitive ministerial regulation are being developed, while leaving municipal oversight largely to local bodies.

I do not have a picture of whether, and if so how many, municipalities since the Youth Act took effect have asked for medical data of youth care clients to assess whether medical costs can be reimbursed.

Ik heb niet in beeld of, en zo ja, hoeveel gemeenten sinds de inwerkingtreding van de Jeugdwet medische gegevens van jeugdhulpcliënten vragen voor de beoordeling of medische kosten vergoed kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat familieleden van dementerenden acuut te hulp moeten schieten in een verpleeghuis omdat er geen personeel is

An MP asked the state secretary whether families of dementia patients being pressed into service at a nursing home lacking staff contradicts the Waardigheid en Trots programme, and questioned the funding of long-term care and a planned cut. The state secretary answered that family may not be structurally used for professional care, that the case was an exceptional force-majeure situation, and that the extra 500 million euro cut has been withdrawn.
That can, however, never go so far that family members are structurally deployed for professional care tasks.
Dat kan echter nooit zover gaan dat familieleden structureel worden ingezet voor professionele zorgtaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de schandalen bij Carint Reggelandgroep

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about severance-like payments and 'adviseur' constructions at Carint Reggeland Groep, including a former board chair paid for eight months after leaving and large exit premiums. The State Secretary called such circumvention of the WNT pay rules objectionable, left the assessment to the CIBG supervisor, and pointed to a forthcoming Evaluatiewet WNT to tighten the rules.
Circumventing those rules I consider objectionable. Whether circumvention occurred in this case will be determined by the WNT supervisor for care, the CIBG, after investigation.
Het omzeilen van die regels acht ik laakbaar. Of in deze casus sprake is van omzeiling zal de toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorg, het CIBG, na onderzoek bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het onder verscherpt toezicht stellen van Veilig Thuis Drenthe

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about the placement of Veilig Thuis Drenthe under enhanced supervision, waiting lists, safety of children and families, and whether the budget should be increased. The State Secretary answers that the inspectorates are monitoring, that municipalities are responsible, that the national programme is working on waiting lists, and that the budget depends on local visions, while promising a further progress report.
Municipalities are responsible for Veilig Thuis. The Inspectorates supervise the Veilig Thuis organisations.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor Veilig Thuis. De Inspecties houden toezicht op de Veilig Thuis organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorginstellingen miljoenen euro's kwijt zijn aan bureaucratie

An SP MP asked the state secretary why youth care providers keep reporting millions of euros in extra bureaucratic costs since the transition, and what he would do if the reform takes too long. The secretary acknowledged administrative burden is too high, pointed to reduced product codes, uniform benchmark reports and a possible future power to set rules if municipalities and providers do not act.
I am considering setting further rules if providers and municipalities do not themselves take their responsibility.
Ik overweeg nadere regels te stellen als aanbieders en gemeenten niet zelf hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over opsporingscapaciteit voor pgb-fraude

An MP asked the State Secretary whether enough investigative capacity exists against personal budget (pgb) fraud, and for an overview of the bodies involved, their FTE and cooperation. The government describes a chain approach from indication to enforcement, outlines the roles of the Inspectie SZW, OM, police, NZa and others, reports added capacity of 18 and 3 FTE, and states it has no information on capacity deployed by other parties and will report fraud-signal statistics later.
There is no information available about the capacity other parties deploy in the context of tackling pgb fraud.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over de capaciteit die andere partijen in het kader van de aanpak van pgb-fraude inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de stand van zaken in de jeugdhulp

An MP from the SP asks the state secretary about the Rotterdam child-protection failure, the use of unqualified student helpers, a looming crisis-shelter admission freeze, the link between the youth-care transition, budget cuts and weak neighbourhood teams, and waiting-list monitoring. The secretary answers that the inspections' findings are being followed, that qualified staff must be used under the Jeugdwet, that waiting-list data cannot be collected uniformly in a decentralised system and that a study and Treek waiting norms will follow.
It is up to municipalities to purchase sufficient provision and the municipal council to supervise this.
Het is aan gemeenten om voldoende aanbod in te kopen en de gemeenteraad om hierop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het faillissement van zorgorganisatie Diafaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of care organisation Diafaan, including its causes, the transfer of staff and clients, the treatment of workers' pay, planned rules against wage dumping, and whether bankruptcy and bestuurder conduct should be investigated. The State Secretary answered that the curator is handling the process, care continuity was preserved, some staff saw worse terms, a general administrative measure on wage competition is being prepared, and the curator will decide on further steps after investigating the bestuurders' conduct.
On both matters I keep myself informed through the curator of Diafaan.
Over beide zaken laat ik mij op de hoogte houden door de curator van Diafaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Gebrekkig ict-systeem apothekers vormt risico’

An MP asked the minister about reports that outdated ICT and fax-based communication between pharmacists, doctors and hospitals create medication-safety risks, and what is being done about electronic data exchange and patient access to medication records. The minister answered that electronic exchange is incomplete (mainly outside primary care), listed ongoing measures such as revising the medication transfer guideline, an information standard and the pending client-rights bill, and said patients' electronic access rights will be strengthened.
I am of the view that electronic data exchange contributes to the quality of care.
Ik ben van mening dat elektronische gegevensuitwisseling bijdraagt aan de kwaliteit van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht Jumbo haalt sigaretten uit het zicht

An MP asks the state secretary for health about Jumbo's frosted-glass doors hiding tobacco, whether the 'tabak' lettering breaches advertising rules, whether it undermines evidence on display bans, and whether a covenant on display bans will be concluded by 1 July. The secretary welcomes Jumbo's initiative, says the NVWA is investigating the complaint, and expects supermarkets to conclude a covenant by 1 July, with the frosted glass acceptable if colours and outlines are not visible.
I am awaiting the NVWA's investigation into the complaint.
Ik wacht het onderzoek van de NVWA naar de klacht af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Kwart zorgbestuurders boven Balkenendenorm’

An MP asked the state secretary for health why a quarter of elderly-care executives earn above the Balkenende norm, why one former director received a severance payment far above the WNT maximum despite supervision by the Inspectorate, and whether a faster reduction should be enforced. The state secretary replied that the higher pay falls under transitional law based on the ECHR, that the CIBG enforces the WNT where violations occur, that institutions should weigh the specific circumstances within the limits, and declined to introduce emergency legislation, referring to the answer on question 5.
However, as soon as there is a violation of the WNT, the supervisory body in care, the CIBG, enforces it.
Zodra er echter sprake is van een overtreding van de WNT treedt de toezichthouder in de zorg, het CIBG, handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de uitgave over E-health

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the cost and purpose of a government publication on e-health, including its reach, a quote calling privacy a hurdle, the phrase 'privacy mafia', and possible sponsorship by Philips and Focus Cura. Minister Schippers answered that the publication cost 97,500 euro, that it was a legitimate government communication, that privacy rules remain binding, and that the company contributions were limited to photos and not sponsorship.
The publication was produced without financial contributions from third parties. There is no form of sponsorship.
De uitgave is zonder financiële bijdragen van derden tot stand gekomen. Er is geen sprake van enige vorm van sponsoring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en De Graaf over de brief van het Haagse college van B&W over de huisvesting van asielzoekers in een vleugel van verpleeghuis De Lozerhof

MPs Agema and De Graaf asked about housing asylum seekers in a wing of nursing home De Lozerhof, including expected work by residents, staffing impacts and who is responsible for care quality and safety. The Secretary of State said the arrangement is voluntary-work oriented with careful consultation, that the nursing home itself is responsible for care quality, and that the Inspectorate is following up on previously identified shortcomings.
Care institutions are themselves responsible for the quality and safety of the care provided and for the staff and volunteers in their institution.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geleverde zorg en voor het personeel en vrijwilligers in hun instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Wijkverpleegkundigen helpen steeds vaker met huishoudelijke taken”

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked whether district nurses increasingly perform household tasks, what hourly rates apply, and whether gemeenten and insurers coordinate home care sufficiently. The state secretary said district nurses should not normally do household work, saw no link to volume and tariff cuts, and agreed to raise the issue with the VNG, while declining to collect data on how often it happens.
I do not have figures on this. Requesting them would lead to additional administrative burdens for district nurses.
Ik heb hier geen cijfers over. Het uitvragen hiervan zal leiden tot extra administratieve lasten voor wijkverpleegkundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht dat het aantal hulpvragen wegens huiselijk geweld fors stijgt

MP Volp asked the state secretary about reports of a sharp rise in calls about domestic violence and how to make Veilig Thuis better known as the reporting point. The state secretary said the rise is a positive sign that reluctance is falling, pointed to campaigns and a quality improvement programme, and referred the question on problems at Veilig Thuis regions to a progress letter to be sent later.

In the progress report on violence in dependency relationships (GIA), to be sent to your House in time for the planned committee meeting of 15 September 2016, I will address the efforts of municipalities and central government to get the VT organisations back in order.

In de voortgangsrapportage geweld in afhankelijkheidsrelaties (GIA) die tijdig voor het geplande Algemeen Overleg (AO) van 15 september 2016 aanstaande naar uw Kamer zal worden gezonden, zal ik ingaan op de inspanningen van gemeenten en Rijk om de VT-organisaties verder op orde te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de bezuinigingen op projectgezinnen

An MP asks the state secretary whether cuts to project families in youth care conflict with the Youth Act and what happens to children placed there, and whether pleegouders deserve support. The secretary answers that suitable care stays central, that project families are professional care rather than foster parents, and that the provider Horizon is seeking alternatives and possibly continuity, with TAJ available for mediation.
Horizon indicated in its intended decision to the project parents that it will look for suitable help for the children together with them.
Horizon heeft in haar voorgenomen besluit aan de projectouders aangegeven dat er met hen wordt gezocht naar passende hulp voor de kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Ypma over gezinshuizen in Gouda

MPs Voordewind and Ypma asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about Horizon Jeugdzorg's plan to end the 'projectgezinnen' care form in Gouda, its effect on children's care continuity, and whether municipalities should be consulted.
