The State Secretary answered that Horizon will seek suitable alternatives per child, that the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd can mediate, that he sees no reason to talk to Gouda directly, and that VNG will help inventory whether the problem is broader.
I am not familiar with the individual specific casuistry of the children who are placed in the project families.
Ik ken de individuele specifieke casuïstiek van de kinderen die in de projectgezinnen worden opgevangen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Ik wil naar huis, naar mijn gezin’

MP Leijten asks the state secretary for health how the government views a ventilator-dependent patient and an ALS patient who want to live at home with their families rather than in institutional care, and whether the 'doelmatig' cost criterion and the motion on not forcing people to live where they do not want to are respected. The state secretary says home care is possible with conditions and extra care options, that the care office found a solution and the ALS patient is now at home, and that the government cannot force people to live where they do not want to, while leaving legal aid to the patient's family.
That the woman feels she is being held against her will is not a desirable situation.
Dat mevrouw het gevoel heeft dat ze tegen haar wil wordt vastgehouden, is geen wenselijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat artsen dronken patiënten zat zijn en strengere regels eisen

An SGP MP asked the state secretary for Health about reports that emergency doctors are fed up with drunk patients and demand stricter rules, including enforcement of alcohol-serving bans, prosecution of aggressive patients, mandatory aftercare, and alcohol sales and advertising limits. The state secretary replied that the issue will be taken into account in the ongoing evaluation of the Drank- en Horecawet, that hospitals can join criminal proceedings or claim damages, that a direct liability route for offenders is being prepared with Justice, and that the ZonMw study on alcohol measures will inform the policy response.
During the meeting they indicated, among other things, that VWS takes the NVSHA's signal very seriously and is including it in the ongoing evaluation of the Drink and Catering Act (DHW).
Zij hebben tijdens het gesprek onder andere aangegeven dat VWS het signaal van de NVSHA heel serieus neemt en meeneemt in de evaluatie van de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) die momenteel plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Keijzer over het bericht ‘Subsidie voor een werkster ook al verdien je genoeg’

MPs Potters and Keijzer asked whether it is undesirable that municipalities using ministry HHT funds offer subsidised household help to all residents, not only those with a Wmo indication, and whether the arrangement conflicts with HHT conditions. The state secretary replied that municipalities are free to design the HHT, that it does not replace Wmo help, that he sees no reason for further investigation, consultation or a data request, and that the spending is accountable to the municipal councils.
I therefore see no reason to consult with the municipalities of the Gooi and Vechtstreek region and the VNG on the spending of the HHT funds.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden voor overleg over de besteding van de HHT middelen met de gemeenten van de regio Gooi en Vechtstreek en de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de CIZ (Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg) - beleidsregels indicatiestelling Wlz 2016 (Wet langdurige zorg) in relatie tot kinderen

An MP asked the state secretary about the CIZ eligibility rules for children under five seeking Wlz long-term care, including when constant care is considered ordinary parental care and how decisions are made. The state secretary replied that the 2016 rules changed only in examples, that under-five children can qualify for Wlz mainly if severely multiple disabled, and gave application figures for the first four months of 2016.
Yes, I am aware of the content of the 2016 Wlz indication policy rules.
Ja, ik ben op de hoogte van de inhoud van de beleidsregels indicatiestelling Wlz voor het jaar 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen enorm moeten bijbetalen voor zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that couples caring for a family member under the Wmo 2015 are left with very little after personal contributions, and whether the rules and tax on partner-provided PGB care are fair. The State Secretary defended the contribution rules as income-based, said the municipalities and households have been in talks, explained that partner-caregivers may be worse off only in certain cases, and promised additional qualitative research on care avoidance and PGB cases with partner-caregivers.

I do not have this insight. However, during the committee debate of 10 March on the Wmo 2015 personal contributions, I committed to commissioning additional qualitative research into care avoidance, personal contributions and tailored support under the Wmo 2015.

Ik beschik niet over dit inzicht. Tijdens het AO van 10 maart jl. over de eigen bijdragen Wmo 2015, heb ik echter toegezegd om aanvullend kwalitatief onderzoek uit te laten voeren naar zorgmijding, eigen bijdragen en maatwerk op grond van de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeente Oude IJsselstreek alfahulpen blijft inzetten, terwijl dit ontraden is door de staatssecretaris

An SP MP asked the state secretary how Oude IJsselstreek can deploy alfahulpen (domestic helpers) despite his advice against it, why the arrangement is banned in general provisions but allowed under individual care, and whether the rules create room for abuse. The state secretary answered that municipalities must follow current rules and can only be advised, that the proposal limits the scheme to personal budgets, and that a general administrative order will be sent soon.
Until the bill banning the use of alfahulpen in general provisions takes effect, municipalities cannot be forced to end the use of alfahulpen in the general provision.

Totdat het wetsvoorstel waarin het inzetten van alfahulpen in de algemene voorzieningen verboden wordt van kracht is, kunnen gemeenten niet gedwongen worden het inzetten van alfahulpen in de algemene voorziening te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het miljoenenoverschot bij gemeenten op het zorgbudget

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that many municipalities underspent their social domain care budgets, questioning how this fits with unmet care needs, whether the funds should be earmarked, and whether municipal tendering harms care recipients. The state secretary answered that the 2015 figures are too early to draw conclusions, that underspending may be reserved for future costs, that earmarking was deliberately not adopted, that no evidence shows municipalities harming care users, and promised a proposal on responsible market conduct and a qualitative study on care avoidance.
At the time, the decision not to earmark was deliberately made.
Destijds is bewust gekozen voor het niet oormerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Vermue over de inzet van drugshonden in scholen

MPs Volp and Vermue asked whether deploying drug-sniffing dogs in schools, as planned by the municipality of Steenwijkerland, is undesirable, and how many schools use them. The state secretary answered that drug prevention is a municipal matter, that schools may use private firms for checks if their safety plan with works council approval allows it, and that no registration of drug-dog use in schools exists.
There is no registration of or research into the deployment of drug dogs in schools.
Er bestaat geen registratie van of onderzoek naar de inzet van drugshonden op scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over rookruimtes in de horeca

An MP asked the State Secretary about the rise of smoking rooms in cafés and discotheques and whether to restrict them. The State Secretary answered that smoking rooms are an accepted instrument within the smoke-free hospitality rule, that their enforcement norm is sufficient, and that new rules will await the effects of other measures.

Now that the smoking ban applies across the full hospitality sector and I am taking many other measures to discourage smoking, I first want to await their effects before setting new rules for smoking rooms.

Nu in de volledige horeca het rookverbod is ingevoerd en ik tal van andere maatregelen neem om het roken te ontmoedigen, wil ik eerst de effecten daarvan afwachten alvorens nieuwe regels voor rookruimtes vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over de uitgaven wijkverpleging 2015 en de inkoop wijkverpleging 2016

MPs Bruins Slot and Keijzer (CDA) asked the State Secretary about 2015 spending overruns, 2016 volume and tariff cuts, shortages of community nurses, the new 'Beloning op maat' payment, administrative burden, and coverage of on-call services. The State Secretary answered that the 2015 overrun of EUR 37.7 million is modest, that contracting is a shared responsibility of insurers and providers, and listed measures on staffing, innovation and administrative burden, with a monitor from the NZa promised, but gave no data on specific care volumes.

I have no figures on the volumes of specific care forms such as intensive child care and palliative care, because these care forms are declared under the regular nursing and care services and insurers and providers keep no separate registration.

Ik heb geen cijfers over de volumes van specifieke zorgvormen zoals intensieve kindzorg en pallatieve zorg omdat deze zorgvormen worden gedeclareerd onder de reguliere prestaties verpleging en verzorging en er geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden door verzekeraars en aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rol van de aanjager die de zorg binnen gemeenten op peil moet houden

MP Leijten asks what the directeur-generaal Langdurige Zorg, appointed as 'aanjager' for care continuity in municipalities, actually does after the TSN Thuiszorg bankruptcy, including contact channels, dealings with workers and clients, action on wage dumping, and prevention of further bankruptcies. The state secretary answers that the ministry coordinated stakeholders, a handreiking with VNG was produced, a call-round was held, and most care continuity was maintained, while declining to act on wage dumping as a matter of local competence and referring to measures for workers losing jobs.
The solutions chosen by municipal executives and councils and agreed with providers fall within local decision-making authority as laid down in law.
De oplossingen die colleges en gemeenteraden hebben gekozen en zijn overeengekomen met aanbieders behoren tot de lokale beslissingsbevoegdheid zoals die in de wet is neergelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Nieuwe drug vervangt de zware XTC-pil'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about health risks of the new drug 4-FA (XTC-light), its long-term effects, prevention, and whether it will be banned under the Opium Act. The State Secretary answered that long-term risks are unknown, the drug is monitored, prevention runs through regular channels, and no ban is planned for now based on the 2015 CAM quick scan and WHO advice.
The CAM will examine this year whether there is reason to update the quick scan.
Het CAM zal dit jaar bekijken of er aanleiding is de quick scan te actualiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders over het bericht dat een 74-jarige verlamde poliopatiënt al 60 jaar afhankelijk is van een buisje voor ademen en praten, dat al 20 jaar niet meer gemaakt wordt en deze nu

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether the government would act, including sending an official to China, after a 74-year-old polio patient faced losing his decades-old latex breathing tube that is no longer manufactured. The minister answered that over a thousand tracheostomy tubes exist, that medical devices must meet EU CE rules, and that the supplier Teleflex, with the German manufacturer, is restarting production of the old tube with delivery expected within weeks.
Even before the media coverage, Teleflex was busy working with the manufacturer to find a solution.
Al voor de berichtgeving in de media was Teleflex druk doende om in overleg met de fabrikant voor een oplossing te zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Volp over het bericht “Zorgen over toename seksueel misbruik op scholen”

MPs Ypma and Volp asked about reports of rising sexual abuse and intimidation in schools, the Inspectorate's handling of such reports, school codes of conduct, and sex education. The government answered that the report figures are not a sustained upward trend, pointed to the Wet veiligheid op school and the duty to report to police, and said the Inspectorate's thematic study on sexuality education will be sent to parliament this summer.
The inspectorate has no data on the number of reports of sexual intimidation made to the police or in how many cases the police started an investigation.
De inspectie heeft geen gegevens van het aantal meldingen van seksuele intimidatie bij de politie of in hoeveel gevallen de politie een onderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over het bericht dat de GGD Hart voor Brabant de screening van spraak- en taalontwikkeling van 5-jarigen stop zet

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked whether the GGD Hart voor Brabant stopping logopedic screening of 5-year-olds weakens early detection of speech and language disorders, and what the government will do. The state secretary replied that the GGD has reorganised rather than abandoned the task, that youth health care (JGZ) is responsible under municipal law, and that no intervention or new investigation is planned.
I see no reason to call the GGD Hart voor Brabant and the associated municipalities to order.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de GGD Hart voor Brabant en de bijbehorende gemeenten tot de orde te roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de jeugdzorgorganisaties op het randje van faillissement staan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that youth care organisations are near bankruptcy, asking for liquidity data, the role of late municipal payments, and whether the right to youth care should be reinstated. The State Secretary said the survey response was 36%, that about 40% of respondents reported at least 10% payment arrears from municipalities, and that the TAJ was asked to advise on liquidity support, with a progress report promised for spring.
This report is based on a survey by the Branches Specialised Care for Youth (BGZJ).
Dit bericht is gebaseerd op een enquête van de Branches Gespecialiseerde Zorg voor Jeugd (BGZJ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Jan Slagter over zijn verpleeghuis ‘Ben Oude Nijhuis’

MP Leijten asks the State Secretary for Health about a proposed small-scale nursing home for dementia patients with low incomes, whether the government supports it, why housing corporations show no interest in investing, and what the government did in advisory-team consultations on small-scale housing. The State Secretary says he supports such initiatives, which already exist and are funded, declines to judge the specific initiative's plans, points to local responsibility of corporations and municipalities, and reports the consultations covered the advisory team's findings.
Whether in Mr. Slagter's case there were sound plans I cannot and will not assess. That is for the care office, the financier or a housing corporation with which cooperation is sought.

Of in het geval van dhr. Slagter ook sprake was van degelijke plannen kan en wil ik niet beoordelen. Dit is aan het zorgkantoor, de financier of een woningcorporatie waarmee samenwerking wordt gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er opnieuw angst en intimidatie heersen bij Zorggroep Charim

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports of renewed fear and intimidation at care group Charim, the 2014 reorganisation, departing managers, and possible silence contracts. The government answered that an independent report found social insecurity at many Charim locations, that the IGZ is monitoring the organisation and will act if care quality is at risk, and that it has no reports of silence contracts.
The IGZ has in recent years maintained almost continuous supervision of Charim, partly because of reported incidents and calamities.
De IGZ houdt de laatste jaren vrijwel continu toezicht op Charim, onder andere vanwege gemelde incidenten en calamiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het megalomane project van Daelzicht

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about Daelzicht's abandoned theme-park project, its spending of over 1 million euros on planning, possible liability of board members, the myOwn care robot, staff complaints and the supervisory role of the Raad van Toezicht and the IGZ. The state secretary answered that the decisions rest with the institution and its supervisory board, that the IGZ monitors care quality without signs of risk so far, that board liability requires judicial findings, and that an independent investigation is not considered necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voortdurende crisis bij Daelzicht

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the ongoing crisis at care organisation Daelzicht, including the management team's loss of confidence in the Board, alleged intimidation by the Board, and whether oversight should be tightened. The State Secretary answered that the dispute is primarily between the Supervisory Board, the Board and the works council, that the Board will step down on 1 June 2016 with an interim board member appointed, and that the Inspectorate for Healthcare sees no current grounds for enforcement but is monitoring developments closely.
The Healthcare Inspectorate oversees that the quality and safety of the care provided by Daelzicht is in order.
De Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg ziet erop toe dat de kwaliteit en de veiligheid van de zorg die door Dealzicht wordt geleverd op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de zorgverlening in bijna alle gemeenten onvoldoende is

MP Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary how to respond to reports that clients rate most municipalities poorly for providing necessary care and aids, and that many clients feel limited and cannot get the best-fitting help due to unavailability or cost. The state secretary replies that client experience is important, that municipalities must improve, that a qualitative study on care avoidance, co-payments and tailored support under the Wmo 2015 is underway, and that the Wmo transition was managed in a controlled way.
In the debate of 10 March with your House, I committed, in addition to the quantitative CBS research, to a qualitative study into care avoidance, co-payments and tailored support under the Wmo 2015.

In het debat van 10 maart jl. met uw Kamer heb ik- in aanvulling op het kwantitatieve onderzoek van CBS – een kwalitatief onderzoek toegezegd naar zorgmijding, eigen bijdragen en maatwerk op grond van de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat artsen die kinderen antidepressiva voorschrijven vaak niet de geldende richtlijn volgen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that doctors often do not follow the guideline when prescribing antidepressants to children and young people, including the choice of fluoxetine dose and a shift to citalopram. The State Secretary said there is no structural data on guideline adherence, noted that deviation is permitted with justification, cited supply limits on fluoxetine doses, and committed to discussing the issue with the professional associations.
There is no integral insight into the extent to which doctors prescribe antidepressants to young people in line with the guideline, because no structural data or information on this is available.
Er is geen integraal inzicht in de mate waarin artsen antidepressiva bij jeugdigen richtlijnconform voorschrijven, omdat hiervan geen structurele data of gegevens beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Vriendin die Fokus woning uit moet’

Leijten (SP) asks the state secretary for health how a Fokus client who must leave her home after years is affected by a 2015 court ruling, and whether Fokus should be barred from unilaterally terminating care or housing. The secretary replies that the court ruled Fokus was right given serious health risks, advises the client to seek a new care and housing solution with Fokus and the housing corporation, and maintains opposition to the motion as the link between housing and care is central to the Fokus concept.
I maintain my position that the motion mentioned in question 4 should be advised against, because the link between housing and care is an important part of the Fokus concept.
Ik blijf bij mijn standpunt dat de in vraag 4 genoemde motie moet worden ontraden, omdat de koppeling tussen wonen en zorg een belangrijk onderdeel is van het Fokus-concept.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over mogelijke bedreigingen van heterogene woon- en werkgemeenschappen in de verstandelijk gehandicaptenzorg

The MP asks whether the decentralisations and the loss of zorgzwaartepakketten 1 and 2 threaten heterogeneous residential and work communities in disability care, and whether such combinations still exist. The Secretary of State reports no signals of a bottleneck, notes one institution's concern about its unique character, sees no reason for an investigation, and says heterogeneous housing with both Wlz and Wmo/Zvw clients exists nationwide.
I have received no signals that there are bottlenecks regarding the continuity of residential and work communities in disability care where clients live with different levels of care intensity.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen dat er knelpunten zijn rond het voortbestaan van woon- en werkgemeenschappen in de gehandicaptenzorg waar cliënten wonen met verschillende niveaus van zorgzwaarte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Menzis trekt na jaar boetekleed aan. Cliënt met klacht over pgb-fraude niet serieus genomen’

An MP asks the State Secretary why health insurer Menzis allegedly failed to take a PGB fraud complaint seriously, and whether it considers itself responsible for fraud prevention. The State Secretary replies that Menzis did act on fraud signals (accelerated home visits and material checks at Boriz BV), that the complaint was handled through the complaints procedure and declared unfounded, and that the wider investigation is still ongoing.
There is no question of Menzis refusing to investigate possible PGB fraud.
Er is geen sprake van een weigering van Menzis om mogelijke pgb-fraude te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorginstelling Huis in de Duinen te Zandvoort uit het dal zou zijn

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health about the Inspectorate's (IGZ) findings that more than half of the care criteria at Huis in de Duinen in Zandvoort were still not met, questioning the Inspectorate's oversight, staffing, whistleblowing, sick leave and past political influence. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ has an intensive supervision trajectory with improvements noted, no current signs staff fear reporting, the whistleblower scheme remains in force but was unused, and the IGZ will take further measures if quality falls short again.
Should the IGZ again find that the quality of care is not yet secured, the IGZ will take further measures.
Mocht de IGZ opnieuw constateren dat de kwaliteit van zorg nog niet geborgd is, dan zal de IGZ nadere maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de berichten ‘Rechtszaken dreigen rond deal Buurtzorg en Enschede als eerste gedaagd in TSN-zaak’

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports of legal threats over the deal between municipalities and Buurtzorg after the bankruptcy of TSN Thuiszorg, including claims of forbidden state aid, unequal access to innovation funds, and forced contracting. The answers say that all providers can apply for innovation funds under published criteria, that no concrete cases of procurement or state-aid violations are known, that municipalities retain choice of provider within their contracts, and that the answers are provided before a planned debate.
Regarding the takeover of TSN Thuiszorg's activities by other providers, I am not aware of any examples of violations of the Procurement Act 2012 or of prohibited state aid.

In relatie tot de opvolging van de activiteiten van TSN Thuiszorg door andere aanbieders zijn mij geen voorbeelden van het overtreden van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 of het toekennen van verboden staatssteun bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten inzake ouders die zich door scholen onder druk gezet voelen om hun kind te medicaliseren tegen ADHD

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries whether schools pressure parents to medicate children for ADHD without diagnosis, and whether funding cuts, class sizes, waiting lists and costs drive medicalisation. The government answers that schools cannot prescribe medication, that a plan of action against medicalisation is underway with expert meetings planned for autumn 2016, that prescriptions fell in 2015, and that several questions are for further research or the next progress report.
Schools cannot prescribe medication; this is reserved for care professionals.
Scholen kunnen geen medicatie voorschrijven, dit is voorbehouden aan zorgprofessionals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het artikel ‘Minder uren, meer zelf doen en meer alfahulpen’

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health about a municipality's preference for 'alfahulpen' (publicly funded assistants in home care) and the continued use of this arrangement despite the planned ban. The State Secretary answered that the arrangement is undesirable, that the municipality has been advised against continuing it, that a bill banning alfahulpen in the general provision is forthcoming, and that municipalities are responsible for continuity of care.
The number of municipalities providing home support with the help of alfahulpen is not registered nationally.
Het aantal gemeenten dat thuisondersteuning verleent met behulp van alfahulpen wordt landelijk niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeente Oude IJsselstreek alfahulpen wil inzetten voor huishoudelijke verzorging

The MP Leijten asks whether the Oude IJsselstreek municipality's use of alfahulpen (informal low-paid helpers) for home care conflicts with the government's announced ban and with Wmo 2015 principles of individual tailoring and free choice. The State Secretary calls the municipality's policy undesirable, says he has advised it to stop, confirms a bill banning alfahulpen in general provisions from 1 January 2017 will be sent to parliament, but declines to produce national data on how many municipalities use such constructions.
I therefore consider the municipality's policy undesirable. I have advised the municipality not to continue the policy.
Ik vind het beleid van de gemeente dan ook onwenselijk. De gemeente is door mij ontraden het beleid voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Voordewind, Leijten en Van der Staaij over het supermarktkartel tegen leeftijdsverificatiesystemen voor de verkoop van alcohol en tabak

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a court ruling against the CBL's campaign and code on age verification for alcohol and tobacco sales, and whether the sector is living up to its duty to keep sales from minors. The State Secretary declined to comment on the ruling pending appeal, said the government expects the law to be followed, and will report to parliament on the tobacco display-ban convenant by 1 July 2016 if no agreement is reached.
Since this is a court ruling against which the parties will appeal, I cannot go into the content of this ruling or the conduct of any of the parties in this lawsuit.
Aangezien het een uitspraak van een rechtbank betreft waartegen partijen in hoger beroep zullen gaan, kan ik niet ingaan op de inhoud van deze uitspraak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over de belemmeringen voor personen met een visuele beperking om als raadslid te kunnen functioneren

MPs Oosenbrug, Van Dijk and Fokke asked whether visually impaired councillors are forced to resign because of inadequate support, and what support exists and whether digital democracy is accessible. The Minister says the government is reviewing barriers via a stakeholder inventory and the Dijkstal law evaluation, notes existing financial support for structural impairments, and says digitalisation can help while accessibility is an ongoing process.
The Ministry of the Interior does not keep track of how many political office holders have a visual or other impairment or have had to resign for that reason.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt niet bij hoeveel politieke ambtsdragers een visuele of andersoortige beperking hebben dan wel om die reden hebben moeten aftreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de Taskforce Naleving Leeftijdsgrens Tabak

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the Taskforce Naleving Leeftijdsgrens Tabak, an industry-funded tobacco age-compliance taskforce, including VWS's role, information sharing, FCTC Article 5.3 concerns, and the NIX18 campaign's stakeholders. The State Secretary answered that VWS is not involved in the taskforce's activities, that contacts fall under FCTC Article 5.3 for technical implementation reasons with documents published, and that an independent Bureau Nuchter study will report by summer.
The Ministry of VWS is in no way involved in the activities of this Taskforce.
Het Ministerie van VWS is op geen enkele wijze betrokken bij de activiteiten van deze Taskforce.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Straus inzake scholen die ouders onder druk zetten om hun kind ADHD-medicatie te geven

Two VVD MPs asked whether schools pressure parents to medicate children with ADHD medication or be transferred to special education, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary says schools may not give medical advice, must meet their duty of care under the Passend Onderwijs law, and that no inspection investigation was opened due to few complaints, while a joint action plan on ADHD care is being pursued.
Parents may not be forced by schools to give medication to their child.
Ouders mogen door scholen niet gedwongen worden om medicatie aan hun kind te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Veldhoven over het gegeven dat de Rijksoverheid samenwerkt met de tabaksfirma Japan Tobacco International (JTI)

MPs Dijkstra and Van Veldhoven asked whether government co-operation with tobacco company JTI, via the Green Deal Schone Stranden on cigarette litter, complies with FCTC article 5.3. The state secretary answered that continuing the Green Deal in its current form is no longer acceptable and that the government will explore continuing it without the tobacco industry as a party.
I am of the opinion that continuing the GDSS in its current form is no longer acceptable in light of the current interpretation of article 5.3 of the WHO Framework Convention.
Ik ben van mening dat voortzetting van de GDSS in de huidige vorm niet meer acceptabel is gelet op de huidige invulling van artikel 5.3 WHO-kaderverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht Martha Flora start in Haarlem met Zorgbalans

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about the opening of Martha Flora's luxury care homes in Haarlem, the relocation of former residents of Parkzicht, and the role of insurer CZ's investment arm. The secretary said residents keep their legal right to care, that the high private costs are a matter of personal choice and that CZ's participation is acceptable as long as it is transparent, but did not provide investor return figures.
Private parties investing in (clustered) housing are not obliged to make their returns public.
Private partijen die investeren in (geclusterde) woningen zijn niet gehouden om hun rendementen publiek te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Tanamal over thuiszorgtaken voor mantelzorgers

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that a home-care organisation expects family members, including those living far away, to carry out personal care tasks such as fetching medication and helping clients in bed, and whether it uses a standard task list for relatives. The secretary agreed that tasks cannot simply be shifted to informal carers, that care must be tailored per client, and that a standard list does not fit the Wmo 2015, but said he has no national picture of how many organisations use such lists and will raise the issue with the VNG and industry bodies.
I do not have a national picture of how many home-care organisations use such a standard list.
Ik heb geen landelijk beeld van hoeveel thuiszorgorganisaties een dergelijke standaardlijst hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Leijten over de rectificatie van Kamervragen betreffende de werkwijze van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

Opposition MP Leijten asked why it took so long to discover that the IGZ had wrongly answered two earlier sets of parliamentary questions about a deceased care-dependent woman, and how families are treated by the inspectorate. State Secretary Van Rijn acknowledged the error, said it did not change the final IGZ verdict, and defended IGZ's family involvement while refusing to make medical files available to relatives beyond patient consent and Wob rules.
It was not previously known to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) that the answer was incorrect.
Het was bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) niet eerder bekend dat de beantwoording onjuist was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Belhaj over het bericht dat getraumatiseerde veteranen op straat dreigen te belanden

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary for health and the defence minister about reports that traumatised veterans may end up on the street after funding problems at the Compound in Assen, and whether national government should take a role given its supra-regional function. The state secretary said funding is secured for 2016, that the municipality and the Compound are seeking a multi-year solution, that no national role is foreseen under current responsibilities, and that no further central involvement is planned.

Under the current allocation of responsibilities agreed between central government and municipalities, the national government has no role regarding an additional national arrangement for care and support for the facilities the Compound in Assen provides to veterans.

In de huidige structuur van verantwoordelijkheden die zijn afgesproken tussen het Rijk en gemeenten is geen rol weggelegd voor het Rijk ten aanzien van een aanvullend landelijk arrangement voor zorg en ondersteuning voor de voorzieningen die de Compound in Assen aan veteranen biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Neppérus over het bericht dat ZZP-ers niet langer meer in de zorg kunnen werken

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Neppérus asked whether the Tax Authority's rejection of a freelancer's model contract in care, and an alleged conflict with the Wkkgz, would stop self-employed care workers from working in care after the VAR expires. The government denied any conflict, said the Wkkgz does not hinder self-employed work in care and that no legal amendment is needed, while noting that false self-employment must be prevented.
The Wkkgz does not form an obstacle to working as a self-employed person in care.
De Wkkgz vormt geen belemmering om als zzp’er in de zorg werkzaam te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het faillissement van Freecare

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of Freecare, a care-services foundation, including unpaid staff wages, the continuity of care for clients, and whether a proposed civil bans on board members could prevent repeat directors from setting up care organisations. The State Secretary answered that the municipality of Heerhugowaard had terminated the contract but guaranteed continuity for six clients, that he lacked sufficient facts to judge the directors, and that the proposed civil bestuursverbod applies only under strict criteria for the court to assess.
I have too little factual information to be able to pass judgement on that.
Ik beschik over te weinig feitelijke informatie om een oordeel daarover te kunnen uitspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat er geen plek in een verpleeghuis is voor de nazorg voor een hoogbejaarde mevrouw van 102 jaar oud die nog zelfstandig woont

An MP asked why a frail 102-year-old woman was discharged from hospital without a nursing home place and without contact with family, and questioned the cuts to care homes. The Secretary of State said care content is for the Inspectorate (IGZ) to judge, pointed to hospital-to-community handover improvements, and defended the shift toward home care while citing extra funding for short-stay places.
On care content, it is not for me to judge whether the care providers and hospital involved in this case acted correctly.
Zorginhoudelijk is het niet aan mij om te beoordelen of er in deze casus juist is gehandeld door de zorgverleners en het ziekenhuis die betrokken zijn geweest bij de zorg aan de mevrouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg, Leijten en Dik-Faber over de tariefverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag en de gevolgen hiervan voor vrijwilligerswerk

MPs from CDA, SP and ChristenUnie asked the government to explain the 38% fee increase for the Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and its impact on volunteer organisations, and to reconcile it with earlier statements. The state secretary attributed the increase mainly to cost-recovery of Justis integrity products, said 7.5% covers the free VOG scheme, declined to commission an impact study on volunteer organisations, and said no consultation with VWS took place.
I am not willing to conduct research into the consequences of the fee increase for volunteers and their organisations.
Ik ben niet bereid onderzoek te verrichten naar de gevolgen van de tariefverhoging op het effect voor vrijwilligers en hun organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de bezetting van de gemeentehuizen van Hollands Kroon en Bronckhorst door actievoerende thuiszorgmedewerkers die strijden voor hun baan

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the occupation of municipal offices by care workers protesting the TSN bankruptcy was a good action, and why the Bronckhorst and Hollands Kroon mayors evicted them, and what the government thought of municipalities leaving workers uncertain. The state secretary answered that demonstration is a right, that mayors decide on order and consequences, that he will not judge the mayors' decisions, and that continuity of care and decent employment conditions were secured.
It is up to the mayor to set rules and restrictions to maintain public order and safety.
Het is aan de burgemeester om ter handhaving van de openbare orde en veiligheid voorschriften en beperkingen te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Toename aantal alcoholintoxicaties in 2015’

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about a reported 27% rise in alcohol poisonings among minors in 2015, whether the trend is expected to fall, the causes, and whether municipal enforcement of the age limit is failing. The State Secretary called the figures worrying, said the cause remains uncertain, pointed to a positive overall trend, and said the Drank- en Horecawet is under evaluation with the enforcement findings due in autumn and a government response in early 2017.
Incidentally, I am currently evaluating the Alcohol and Catering Act (DHW).
Overigens evalueer ik op dit moment de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het stijgende aantal jonge comazuipers

An MP asked the state secretary for health about the rising number of young people admitted to hospital for alcohol coma, the reasons for it, and the status of municipal prevention and enforcement plans, horeca mixed-format pilots, parental responsibility and school involvement. The state secretary called the figures worrying, noted that fewer young people drink but heavy binge drinkers remain, said the Drank- en Horecawet evaluation and municipal plan study would follow later in 2016, and emphasised parental responsibility without announcing sanctions on parents beyond existing court practice.
At this moment I am evaluating the Drank- en Horecawet (DHW).
Op dit moment evalueer ik de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over een toename van het aantal comazuipers

An MP asks the state secretary about a reported rise in alcohol intoxications among minors, the government's response to NSCK figures, and measures on alcohol policy, a municipal pilot expanding outlets, and enforcement funding. The state secretary calls the trend worrying, points to ongoing ZonMw research and the DHW evaluation, and says enforcement funding is left to municipalities.
I will therefore certainly discuss this with municipalities in the context of the evaluation, in which this theme will be explicitly addressed.
Ik zal dan ook zeker met gemeenten in gesprek gaan in het kader van de evaluatie, waarin dit thema nadrukkelijk aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de forse toename van het aantal comazuipers

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the sharp rise in hospital admissions of underage youths for alcohol intoxication and what measures would reverse the trend. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, said youth drinking is declining but binge drinking among heavier-drinking older teens remains high, promised action after the summer Peilstation study, and said enforcement of the age limit will be addressed in the DHW evaluation.
I assume you mean better enforcement of the age limit by municipalities.
Ik ga er van uit dat u hierbij doelt op betere handhaving van de leeftijdsgrens door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over horeca-mengvormen die strijdig zijn met de wet

An MP asked the state secretary whether municipal experiments with horeca mixed-format businesses (such as drinks in shops) breach the Drank- en Horecawet, whether he has contacted Amsterdam, which municipalities participate, and whether he will use his powers of substitution or suspension and annulment. The state secretary says he has contacted Amsterdam, that the VNG holds the list of participating municipalities and should share it, that experiments must stay within the law, and that he will raise the theme in the upcoming evaluation of the Act.
I am aware of the trial with horeca mixed-format businesses in Amsterdam.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de proef met horeca-mengvormen in Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over bijzonder bijkomende kosten voor kinderen onder voogdij en residentiële instellingen

An SP MP asks the State Secretaries whether municipalities are refusing to pay special additional costs for children under guardianship or in residential care, whether this reflects procurement pressure and the costs dispute the Children's Ombudsman reported, and whether financial barriers prevent parental contact. The Minister replies that no concrete signals of municipal refusal are known, that a factsheet with the VNG and Jeugdzorg Nederland will clarify the scheme, that special assistance is not the right route, that travel costs can be reimbursed, and that parental contributions were abolished, but commits to no new structural measures beyond the factsheet.
I am not aware of any concrete signals that municipalities would no longer be willing to pay for special costs.
Er zijn mij geen concrete signalen bekend dat gemeenten niet meer bereid zouden zijn om te betalen voor bijzondere kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat 8 kinderen uit hun zorgvoorziening gezet dreigen te worden

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport to respond to reports that eight children might have to leave a care farm, and to intervene to prevent the closure or to keep it open. The secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for individual cases, that a solution was found with the current provider through in-kind care contracting, and that no national intervention is planned.
It is the task of municipalities to ensure an appropriate solution is provided in individual cases.
Het is de taak van gemeenten om in individuele casussen te zorgen dat er een passende oplossing wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Zorgen om lang wachten op pgb’ (persoonsgebonden budget)

An SP MP asked the state secretary about long waiting times for a personal budget (pgb) for a foster parent's child, and about the timing of mandatory consent conversations and waiting times generally. The state secretary acknowledged the delay was too long, said the pgb has now been granted, promised to discuss shortening processing times with care offices, and declined to provide some requested overviews because the information is held by the NZa or not yet available.
The care office concerned acknowledges that it took too long.
Het betreffende zorgkantoor erkent dat het te lang heeft geduurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat er veel meer daklozen in Nederland zijn

An MP asked whether the government is aware of reports that homelessness in the Netherlands has risen sharply. The State Secretary answered that the CBS figures are based on registrations for shelter and homeless benefit, not street counts, and pointed to measures on social housing access for status holders.
These figures therefore relate to the number of people who claim shelter and a homeless benefit, and not necessarily the number of people who live on the street.
Deze cijfers hebben dus betrekking op het aantal personen dat een beroep doet op opvang en een daklozenuitkering en niet perse het aantal mensen dat op straat verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de TV-commercial van Sire: ‘XTC-facts’

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Sire TV commercial on XTC ('XTC-facts') that appears to normalise testing-before-use would discourage youth drug use, and whether the government should use shock imagery instead. The state secretary replied that Sire is an independent foundation so the government is not responsible for the spot, that such campaigns may stimulate interest, so the government does not use mass-media drug prevention, and that the cost is unknown.
SIRE has no ties with the government or other organisations, so the government is not responsible for this video.
SIRE heeft geen banden met de overheid of andere organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over gedragstherapieën voor Gilles de la Tourette voor jeugd

An MP asked the state secretary about reduced access to behavioural therapy for children with Tourette's after the Youth Act 2015, citing European guidelines favouring therapy over medication and possible over-medication. The state secretary said there were no signals of reduced availability, that municipalities purchase care regionally and supra-regionally without tracking availability, and that the professional decides treatment, with no research on medication trends planned.
In doing so, the availability per region or municipality is not tracked.
Daarbij wordt de beschikbaarheid per regio of gemeente niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het ‘Rapport van het inspectiebezoek aan Martha Flora in Gouda op 28 september 2015’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about the IGZ inspection report on Martha Flora Gouda, which found care risks and unmet norms, and about the cost and oversight of the care homes. The state secretary said the provider must submit an improvement plan by 7 April 2016, the IGZ sees no reason for intensified supervision yet, the IGZ will be asked to attach the plan to its final judgment, and pricing and business model questions are for the provider or clients.
I will ask the IGZ to attach the results report (anonymised where necessary given privacy requirements) as an annex to its final judgment.
Ik zal de IGZ verzoeken om het resultaatverslag (waar nodig gelet op privacy-eisen geanonimiseerd) als bijlage bij haar eindoordeel te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Drugs- en wapensmokkel Woenselse Poort kinderlijk eenvoudig’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about a broadcast showing easy drug and weapon smuggling into the Woenselse Poort forensic psychiatric clinic, including the effectiveness of security measures after a firearm-related suicide and whether inspection oversight is ongoing. The State Secretary answered in detail: no firearm was found in five years, security measures were described, internal and Inspectorate investigations are underway, and the outcome is expected within weeks.
The police are currently investigating the origin of the weapon.
Door de politie wordt momenteel onderzoek gedaan naar de herkomst van het wapen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Bruins Slot, Bergkamp, Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over een verzekeraar die wijkverpleegkundigen passeert met nieuw pgb-beleid

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about insurer CZ's new policy limiting which home-care nurses may assess persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) eligibility, designating preferred organisations per region, and whether this restricts budget-holders' choice. The State Secretary answered that CZ's approach is within the agreed rules, budget-holders remain free to choose other providers with reduced reimbursement, the insurer has at least two providers per region, and an AMvB will be sent to parliament with a letter on the motion.
Control lies in all cases with the PGB holder.
De regie ligt in alle gevallen bij de pgb-houder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Otwin van Dijk over de levering van cannabisolie aan patiënten buiten Nederland

MPs Volp and Otwin van Dijk asked the Minister of Health about a The Hague pharmacy supplying THC-free cannabis oil to young patients and patients abroad, the research on cannabidiol for epilepsy, the legal risks for families travelling with it, and how many pharmacies supply it and who reimburses it. The Minister confirmed awareness, pointed to published research and the BMC's support for research, blamed foreign national policy for the travel problem, and said she has no view on insurers' reimbursement policy.
I have no insight into insurers' reimbursement policy for cannabis oil.
Ik heb geen zicht op het vergoedingsbeleid van zorgverzekeraars op cannabisolie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de explosieve groei van het aantal comazuipers

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about the sharp rise in youth alcohol-related hospital admissions (comazuipers), including its causes, the role of social sources of alcohol, and enforcement in bars. The state secretary acknowledged the trend, cited national figures showing a 19% rise in youth alcohol admissions, said the cause is unclear, and pointed to evaluation of the Drank- en Horecawet and planned enforcement measures if compliance does not improve.
I am currently also considering whether and how the harmful effects of alcohol use could be included in the campaign.
Ik bekijk op het moment ook of en op welke manier schadelijke gevolgen van alcoholgebruik een plaats zouden kunnen krijgen in de campagne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Wolbert over voeding in de zorg

MPs Dik-Faber and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about nutrition in care: medical training, malnutrition screening, transmural guidelines, cancer screening advice, prevention funding and food concepts in hospitals. The Minister answered that professional bodies and guideline makers should lead on curriculum and guidelines, pointed to existing initiatives, and promised letters on prevention and a Kwaliteitsinstituut request.
I will ask the Kwaliteitsinstituut to promote attention to nutrition in the relevant guidelines.
Daarnaast zal ik het Kwaliteitsinstituut vragen om te bevorderen dat in de relevante richtlijnen aandacht is voor voeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over overgangsproblemen tussen zorgdomeinen

MP Bergkamp asked about clients losing care when CIZ reclassified their indication from Wlz to other domains (Wmo, Zvw), including low-IQ referrals, lack of care continuity and CIZ conduct. The Staatssecretaris answered that transition rules were adjusted in July 2015, denied receiving signals of care gaps, and pointed to implementation tables and helpdesks, promising to report back on cooperation with VNG and ZN by end of Q1 2016.
The CIZ must always act carefully. I have no signals that clients are missing care due to careless conduct.
Het CIZ dient altijd zorgvuldig te handelen. Ik heb geen signalen dat cliënten zorg mislopen door onzorgvuldig handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over een nieuw megalomaan project in de zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Health about a proposed large recreation-style park by care organisation Daelzicht, questioning its use of care funds, governance, and the parallels with Philadelphia and Meavita. The State Secretary answered that Daelzicht has decided to abandon the plan, and largely declined to assess the governance and investment questions, referring to that decision.
Daelzicht has decided to stop the plan for Belevingspark Heel and has stated that it considers peace within the organisation and its surroundings important.
Daelzicht heeft besloten te stoppen met het plan voor Belevingspark Heel en heeft meegedeeld de rust binnen de organisatie en in de omgeving belangrijk te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over toeslagen voor gezinnen bij meerderjarige, thuiswonende pleegkinderen en over tegemoetkomingen pleegzorg voor gezinnen net over de grens

An MP asked whether adult foster children living at home lose allowances and whether Dutch foster parents living just across the border lose foster care payments. The state secretary replied that adult foster children can count as partners for benefit purposes, that foster payments under the Youth Act depend on residence in the Netherlands, and that cross-border foster parents should turn to foreign authorities.
I am not aware how many Dutch foster families living across the border no longer have a right to a foster allowance.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse pleeggezinnen die over de grens wonen geen recht (meer) hebben op pleegvergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over minder plek voor rolstoelgebruikers in bussen in Arnhem

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Kerstens asked why newly purchased Arnhem trolleybuses offer less space for large electric wheelchairs despite accessible stops, and whether EU rules were responsible. The state secretary answered that the bus operator is testing a new layout with wheelchair users, that the EU vehicle rules apply but the EU accessibility act is not yet law, and that no further European review is currently planned.

Given the efforts of the transport company and the concession holder to reach a solution, I currently see no reason to review with my colleague of infrastructure and environment the European guidelines on safety in public transport.

Gelet op de inspanningen van het vervoerbedrijf en de concessiehouder teneinde tot een oplossing te komen, heb ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om met mijn collega van infrastructuur en milieu de richtlijnen uit Europa te bekijken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat steeds meer jongeren antidepressiva krijgen voorgeschreven

MP Bergkamp asked the state secretary about reports that more young people are prescribed antidepressants, including whether this reflects over-prescription, whether waiting lists in youth mental health care drive it, and what will be done. The state secretary said prescribing should follow guidelines, that professional bodies are updating advice, that data cannot show causes, and that research on youth depression will be funded, while stating waiting-list links cannot be confirmed.
I consider it important that the treating physician weighs medical necessity against the patient's interest in treatment.
Ik vind het van belang dat bij de behandeling van een patiënt door de behandelaar een goede afweging gemaakt wordt tussen de medische noodzaak en het belang van de patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Siderius over het bericht dat de werkgelegenheid in welzijn, jeugdzorg en kinderopvang fors afneemt

MPs Kooiman and Siderius asked the ministers about a projected fall in employment in youth care, welfare and childcare, its effects on care quality, waiting lists, costs of unemployment benefits and support for affected workers. The government answered that the outlook is uncertain, that waiting lists cannot be tracked nationally because municipalities organise access differently, that childcare employment is expected to recover, and that sector plans and extra funding support retraining.
It is not possible to establish nationally in a uniform way the size of the waiting lists because municipalities have organised access to youth care differently.
Het is niet mogelijk om landelijk op eenduidige wijze vast te stellen wat de omvang van de wachtlijsten is omdat gemeenten de toegang tot de jeugdhulp verschillend georganiseerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht dat meisjes het slecht doen na opname in een gesloten jeugdinstelling

MP Ypma asked the state secretary about a report that girls perform poorly after placement in a closed youth institution, and about aftercare, youth teams and funding. The state secretary agreed aftercare should support full social functioning, said municipalities hold the responsibility and are acting, and offered to report on the decentralised youth system later in spring.
I have meanwhile drawn attention to this with the VNG and the youth care provider associations, who recognise its importance.
Ik heb hiervoor inmiddels aandacht gevraagd bij de VNG en de brancheorganisaties van jeugdhulpaanbieders, die het belang hiervan onderkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het proefschrift Troubled girls, troubled futures

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to a dissertation finding serious shortcomings in the effectiveness of closed youth placement for adolescent girls, including multi-problem families, early detection, aggression diagnostics and continuity after age 18. The state secretary acknowledges the picture, points to effectiveness monitoring, professional guidelines, ZonMw research and municipal efforts, but gives largely general answers without committing to specific new measures.
I facilitate this scientific discussion in, among other things, the research programme Effective work in the youth sector.
Ik faciliteer deze wetenschappelijke discussie in onder meer het onderzoeksprogramma Effectief werken in de jeugdsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Accountants worstelen met administratieve chaos bij gemeenten en zorginstellingen”

MP Keijzer asked about reports that accountants struggle with administrative chaos at municipalities and care providers, and what instruments exist to verify the lawfulness of Wmo and Jeugdwet spending in the transition year 2015. The Secretary says instruments such as the model rechtmatigheid protocol were developed and promoted, while refusing to loosen audit requirements because that would require changing the audit decree and reduce transparency to the council.

Because such a change would undermine the desired transparency towards the municipal council, ignore the differing starting positions of municipalities and is also legally and operationally complex, the Minister of BZK, in line with current cabinet policy, has not proposed any changes.

Omdat een dergelijke wijziging afbreuk doet aan de gewenste transparantie naar de gemeenteraad, de verschillende uitgangsposities van gemeenten miskent en bovendien juridisch en uitvoeringstechnisch complex is heeft de Minister van BZK, in lijn met het vigerende kabinetsbeleid, geen wijzigingen voorgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de website ‘woman on web’

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether Women on Web, a Dutch-hosted online abortion-information and medication service, offering free abortions to women with Zika may be unlawful and harmful, and when more will be known about Zika's link to microcephaly and Guillain-Barré. The minister answered that Dutch law only permits abortion in licensed facilities and bars internet prescribing without a doctor-patient relationship, that the IGZ has asked follow-up questions, and that scientific conclusions on Zika will take weeks to months.
The IGZ has asked Women on Web additional questions about the working method of this online community following the reports.
De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van de berichtgevingen Women on Web aanvullende vragen gesteld over de werkwijze van deze online gemeenschap
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Otwin van Dijk over het vonnis van de rechtbank Amsterdam in de zaak van de HIV-patiënt die zijn eigen hennep moet telen

MPs Volp and Van Dijk asked the minister about a court ruling acquitting an HIV patient who grew his own cannabis for medical reasons, and about access to medicinal cannabis, its varieties, reimbursement and research. The minister declined to comment on the ruling, argued the current pharmacy supply is largely sufficient, rejected rules for home cultivation or group cultivation, and listed ongoing research and reimbursement practices.
Developing (policy) rules for exceptional situations is not an option in my view.
Het ontwikkelen van (beleids)regels voor uitzonderingssituaties vind ik geen optie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Jadnanansing over het rapport 'PR onderzoek Safer Internet Day'

MPs Volp and Jadnanansing asked the State Secretary of Health about a PR study on Safer Internet Day showing young people's views on sexting and online sexual conduct, and what should be done in education. The State Secretary replied that sexual resilience education is already mandated in schools, listed existing programmes covering sexting, and said stigmatising victims is undesirable, referring criminal-law questions to the Justice Minister.
Since December 2012 the core curriculum components on sexuality and sexual diversity have been introduced, meaning schools are obliged to devote attention to them.
Sinds december 2012 zijn de kerndoelonderdelen seksualiteit en seksuele diversiteit ingevoerd, wat betekent dat scholen verplicht zijn hier aandacht aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Bergkamp over de vondst van MDMA-resten van XTC-productie in maïsplanten

MPs Koşer Kaya and Bergkamp asked about MDMA residues from ecstasy production found in maize plants on a Someren farm, including risks, NVWA oversight, police cooperation and whether regulation of the market would reduce risk. The state secretary replied that the detected levels pose no health risk, outlined the division of responsibilities between police, municipality and NVWA, and rejected market regulation from a public health perspective.
If the situation gives cause for it, as also happened in this specific case, the NVWA is called in.
Als de situatie daar aanleiding voor geeft, zoals ook in dit specifieke geval is gebeurd, wordt de NVWA ingeschakeld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht dat een onderzoek van het SCP en de Universiteit Utrecht aantoont dat het kabinetsbeleid aangaande zorg contrair is aan de voorkeur van de meerderheid van de Nederlan

An MP asks whether a study showing the cabinet's care policy diverges from majority public preferences means those views obstruct policy, and whether the policy should change. The state secretary replies that citizens' views on care are diverse, that parents are not obliged to use formal childcare, and that the government does not see public opinion as obstructing its care policy, pointing to ongoing mantelzorg measures and an SER advisory request due in September 2016.
The cabinet does not believe that parents' views on childcare stand in the way of cabinet policy.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat de opvattingen van ouders rondom kinderopvang het kabinetsbeleid in de weg zit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht dat ‘Eritrese meisjes moeten wegblijven uit deze kerk’ en ‘Twintig Eritrese vluchtelingen uit Oranje zwanger na bezoeken aan Rotterdamse kerk?’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bergkamp asked about reports that Eritrean girls should stay away from a Rotterdam church after about twenty Eritrean asylum seekers became pregnant, and what COA and Nidos did with warning signals. The government answered that COA received unverified signals, took precautionary measures such as banning unaccompanied minors from visiting the church, reported to police, and that police and prosecutors found no criminal suspicion so far, while withholding details of individual pregnancies under medical confidentiality.

The National Prosecutor's Office will explore the possibilities to examine the signals of possible abuses within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands at national level and in a multidisciplinary manner.

Het Landelijk Parket van het OM zal de mogelijkheden verkennen om de signalen van mogelijke misstanden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland op landelijk niveau en op multidisciplinaire wijze nader te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de schending van privacy door gemeenten in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the state secretary why he has not answered earlier questions on how many municipalities have unlawfully requested personal data or breached confidentiality in youth care since 2015, and whether he tracks this and trusts councils to supervise privacy. The state secretary said he does not track these numbers, that supervision is local and by the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and that he sees no need for extra measures beyond existing programmes.
I do not keep data on that.
Ik houd daar geen gegevens van bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over een dreigend tekort van menskracht bij de GGD door de toestroom van vluchtelingen

MPs Wolbert and Kuiken asked whether the influx of refugees will cause a staff shortage at the GGD public health services and what the government will do to prevent it. The Secretary of State said the staffing impact is hard to predict, that municipalities are responsible for adequate GGD capacity, and that a working group with the VNG was set up to address the issues.
As a result, it cannot be stated in advance whether a staff shortage will arise at the GGDs.
Daardoor is het op voorhand niet aan te geven of er zich een tekort aan menskracht bij GGD'en gaat voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over wachttijd voor een vervangende rolstoel

A CDA MP asked the state secretary about a seven-month wait for a replacement wheelchair, the duty of municipalities to ensure timely supply, whether VWS will agree concrete arrangements with the VNG, and the number of wheelchair suppliers and mergers. The secretary said the Wmo 2015 contains timeliness safeguards, the responsible municipal social service apologised and resolved the case, municipalities hold the responsibility for procurement and oversight, and no VNG agreement is currently planned.
I currently see no reason to consult with the VNG on how municipalities provide assistive devices under the Wmo 2015, or to make concrete arrangements with municipalities on this.

Ik heb op dit moment geen aanleiding om over de wijze waarop gemeenten hulpmiddelen in het kader van de Wmo 2015 verstrekken in overleg met de VNG te gaan en of daarover concrete afspraken te maken met gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat een bisschop misbruik volgens het Vaticaan niet per se hoeft te melden

An MP asked ministers whether a Vatican document saying new bishops need not always report child abuse allegations was acceptable, and whether they would seek clarification from the Dutch bishops' conference. The minister called the statement incorrect and unwise, explained it stemmed from a misunderstanding in a training course that will be corrected, and declined a meeting because the Dutch bishops confirmed that reporting to the prosecutor is required.
Accusations of child abuse must be reported and a police report must be filed.
Beschuldigingen van kindermisbruik moeten gemeld worden en er moet aangifte van worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over lekenhulp bij de Inspectie Jeugdzorg

An MP asked whether laypeople with lived experience of youth care (children, young people, parents) could be involved as lay inspectors in Inspectie Jeugdzorg oversight, and whether a pilot could be made possible. The Secretary of State answered that the inspectorates already involve clients and experts through various sources, that one experiential expert has joined sexual-misconduct oversight visits, and that the Inspectie Jeugdzorg will follow the Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg's experience with lay inspectors and weigh whether to apply it.

The Inspectie Jeugdzorg closely follows the Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg's experience with the use of lay inspectors and weighs on that basis to what extent it can apply this in its own oversight.

De Inspectie Jeugdzorg volgt de ervaringen van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg met de inzet van lekeninspecteurs nauwgezet en weegt op basis van die ervaringen af in hoeverre zij dit zelf kan toepassen in haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over grote prijsverschillen voor zorg tussen gemeenten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that people cannot pay Wmo co-payments and forgo care, and about large price differences between municipalities. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said co-payments must not exceed municipal cost prices, pointed to municipalities' duty to provide individual case-based tailoring, and said data on people ending care is not collected but a CBS study is underway.
Neither I nor the municipalities register whether clients drop out of or forgo support.
Door mij noch gemeenten wordt geregistreerd of cliënten afhaken of afzien van ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de top van TSN Thuiszorg zich achter de schermen ontdaan heeft van aansprakelijkheid bij faillissement

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that TSN Thuiszorg's parent company ADG secretly shed liability for a bankruptcy, shifting risks to staff and creditors, including a renamed entity and withdrawn guarantee. The State Secretary largely confirmed the facts from commercial register documents, said he cannot judge intent or legal compliance (a matter for the courts), called such conduct morally reprehensible if intended, and pointed to existing law and corporate responsibility.
I do not know what the intention of the parent company ADG dienstengroep SE was
Ik weet niet wat de bedoeling van het moederbedrijf ADG dienstengroep SE is geweest
Antwoord op vragen van lid Agema over het bericht dat nabestaanden het Haagse verzorgingshuis Florence aanklagen: ‘Mijn moeder wilde niet dood’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that relatives are suing a The Hague care home over poor care, whether the Inspectorate will investigate, and whether basic residents' rights should be codified in law. The secretary said the Inspectorate has taken up a first citizen report and cannot comment on findings while the investigation is ongoing, and argued that residents' rights are already set out in the Besluit langdurige zorg.
Following the report, the Inspectorate will investigate whether the care given to the woman concerned at the Loosduinse Hof care centre was of responsible quality.
De inspectie gaat naar aanleiding van de melding onderzoeken of de zorg aan de desbetreffende mevrouw in woon-zorgcentrum Loosduinse Hof van verantwoorde kwaliteit was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Inzet ID-scanners bij leeftijdscontrole tabak in strijd met Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens’

SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health whether using ID scanners for tobacco age checks breaches the Dutch data protection act, and what the government will do about it and about poor compliance with the age limit. The State Secretary replied that the Data Protection Authority says such scanners are not automatically unlawful, depending on the data scanned and how they are used, that retailers must follow the law but the government will not prescribe a system, and that the DPA alone decides enforcement priorities, while the NVWA has intensified supervision and he will report on compliance mid-year.
Under the EU privacy directive and the Dutch Data Protection Act (Wbp), the Data Protection Authority is the independent supervisor of the Wbp.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is krachtens de EU-privacyrichtlijn en de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) de onafhankelijke toezichthouder op de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanhoudende ellende met de keukentafelgesprekken

The SP MP Leijten asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether municipalities are misusing the Wmo 2015 in home-care assessments (keukentafelgesprekken), including fraud, conflicts of interest and withheld independent client support, and whether the government will intervene. The state secretary rejects the picture of systematic deception, says improvements are needed, points to training, independent client support rights and letters to aldermen, and sees no need for generic measures or further investigation now.
If I receive signals that a municipality is not carrying out the prescribed assessment in accordance with the requirements, other than in isolated cases, I will address that municipality.

Indien ik signalen ontvang dat een gemeente het voorgeschreven onderzoek, anders dan in incidentele gevallen, niet overeenkomstig de daaraan gestelde eisen uitvoert, spreek ik deze gemeente daarop aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de spelregels Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) van de ouderenbond ANBO

An MP asked whether the government shares the ANBO's view that its 'Spelregels WMO 2015' on access to Wmo services fit the call for a national quality standard, and whether it will bring these rules to municipalities' attention. The Secretary of State said the rules are a valuable operationalisation of existing quality standards, and that the VNG will involve them in a training programme for municipal Wmo conversation staff.
Yes, this spring a training programme from the VNG academy for municipalities will start, aimed at professionalising Wmo conversation staff.
Ja, dit voorjaar start een opleidingsaanbod vanuit de VNG academie voor gemeenten gericht op de professionalisering van de gespreksvoerders Wmo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat een financiële stop dreigt voor de jeugd ggz

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that youth mental health institutions face large repayment demands from insurers because agreements are reinterpreted after the fact, and whether children will suffer. The State Secretary says the NZa has been asked to amend the rules retroactively and in consultation with parties, and that municipalities have a duty to provide alternative youth care if an institution fails.

She has therefore decided to ask the NZa to amend the relevant rules (on direct time with the main treating professional and residential services) with retroactive effect and in consultation with the parties.

Zij heeft daarom besloten de NZa te vragen om de betreffende regels (rond de directe tijd van de hoofdbehandelaar en verblijfsprestaties) met terugwerkende kracht en in afstemming met partijen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat jeugd-GGZ instellingen wellicht miljoenen euro’s terug moeten betalen

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports that youth mental health institutions may have to repay millions of euros over disputed billing rules, and whether the situation could threaten providers and clients. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said the NZa would be asked to clarify and retroactively adjust the rules so insurers and providers can reach fair agreements, and stated that the ministry has not assessed bankruptcy risks.
She has therefore decided to ask the NZa to adjust the relevant rules (on direct time of the main practitioner and residential performances) with retroactive effect and in consultation with parties.

Zij heeft daarom besloten de NZa te vragen om de betreffende regels (rond de directe tijd van de hoofdbehandelaar en verblijfsprestaties) met terugwerkende kracht en in afstemming met partijen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Verzorgingshuis zet Erik op straat'

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how many people had been evicted from care homes after their care indication was lowered, and whether this was desirable.
