The state secretary replied that policy aims for appropriate care, that the care office must offer a suitable alternative when a client's preferred institution is unavailable, and referred back to that answer for the second question.
How many people have been put out on the street since your policy was introduced after their indication was lowered?
Hoeveel mensen zijn er sinds uw beleid is ingevoerd op straat gezet nadat hun indicatie was verlaagd?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de grote onzekerheid voor thuiszorgmedewerkers en cliënten na thuiszorgwissel in Amstelveen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about job and care insecurity for home-care workers and clients after Amstelveen's home-care tender, including transfer conditions, a 20% bonus for reduced care hours, and whether intervention is planned. The state secretary answered that the municipality set conditions requiring client-carer continuity and the cao VVT, that the bonus compensates providers for lost hours, and declined to intervene, deferring to the municipal council.
No. The municipal council is actively involved in the subject of domestic help.
Nee. De gemeenteraad is actief betrokken bij het onderwerp hulp bij het huishouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over gesjoemel met keukentafelgesprekken

An MP asks the State Secretary about a care coordinator reporting that keukentafelgesprekken (kitchen-table assessments) are shortened for commercial reasons, and whether a 30-minute cap and unreplaced sick staff amount to fraud. The State Secretary says assessments must be tailored and that municipalities bear primary responsibility, will address municipalities showing systematic non-compliance, and will hold providers to contractual replacement duties, without announcing a new national measure.
If I receive signals that a municipality is not carrying out the prescribed assessment in accordance with the requirements, other than in isolated cases, I will address that municipality.

Indien ik signalen ontvang dat een gemeente het voorgeschreven onderzoek, anders dan in incidentele gevallen, niet overeenkomstig de daaraan gestelde eisen uitvoert, spreek ik deze gemeente daarop aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het interview met de directeur van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank

An MP asked the state secretaries about SVB director Nicoly Vermeulen's remarks on 'framing' and problems with paying pgb carers, the delayed compensation scheme, monthly mutations and the SVB's organisational culture. The government answered that the problems span the whole chain, that the damage was estimated at 6 to 9 percent of payments, that a chain-wide improvement plan is being developed, and that the director's appointment was ended.
In accordance with the motion, the House will be informed in the first quarter of 2016 about the concretely elaborated plan.
Conform de motie zal de Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2016 over het concreet uitgewerkte plan worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over de “ADHD-epidemie”

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked about the reported fourfold rise in ADHD medication over ten years, the risk of over-medicalisation of children, and whether psychiatrists' concerns and calls for more diagnostics were being addressed. The state secretary acknowledged the rise as worrying, pointed to the Health Council report and a 'Plan van Aanpak Gepaste Zorg' with concrete actions and a session on diagnostic pressure, but gave no independent analysis of the causes.
This strong increase in the use of medication for ADHD in recent years is worrying, although the Health Council found no clear explanation for the increase in its advice.

Deze forse stijging in het gebruik van medicatie bij ADHD de afgelopen jaren is zorgelijk, alhoewel de Gezondheidsraad in haar advies geen duidelijke verklaring heeft gevonden voor de toename in het gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de stand van zaken omtrent het Onderzoeksrapport Vrouwenopvang locatie IJmond

MPs Volp and Kooiman asked the state secretary about the Haanstra report on women's shelter location IJmond, including criticism of its independence and whether further research is needed. The state secretary said the Haarlem alderman is responsible for oversight and has ordered a follow-up investigation, and proposed an expert meeting via VNG and FO to examine whether the shelter model matches client needs.
The alderman of Haarlem must supervise the quality of facilities in his (central) municipality and account for this to the municipal council.
De wethouder van Haarlem moet toezicht houden op de (kwaliteit van) voorzieningen in zijn (centrum)gemeente en daarover verantwoording afleggen in de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over het bericht Amsterdam wil versneld duizend extra huizen voor daklozen

An MP asked the state secretary about Amsterdam's plan to accelerate 1,000 extra homes for homeless people, the current homeless numbers, what other municipalities are doing, and the latest intergovernmental consultation on long-term independent living. The state secretary answered that the latest national data are from 2013 (about 16,900 homeless in 39 municipalities), that a quick scan and further data are coming, that municipalities and housing corporations are responsible for local housing agreements, and that a follow-up study on exit flows from shelters is being arranged.
There is no national data on homelessness available for 2014 and 2015.
Er zijn geen landelijke gegevens over dak- en thuisloosheid beschikbaar voor 2014 en 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over bewindvoerders die bedreigd worden door zorgverleners op jacht naar pgb’s

MP Potters asked the State Secretary about reports that bewindvoerders are threatened by care providers seeking personal budgets (pgb) and about fraud with pgbs, including inadequate administration at care offices and the CIZ assessing clients remotely. The State Secretary condemned threats and fraud, pointed to existing and planned anti-fraud measures (trekkingsrecht, liability rules, a warning register) and said criminal enforcement will be strengthened.
I believe every euro intended for care must also be spent on care.
Ik vind dat iedere euro die bestemd is voor de zorg daar ook aan moet worden besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over de onderhandelingen van zeven Westfriese gemeenten over de thuiszorg

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether thuiszorg provider Zorgkompas made national agreements not to take over TSN Thuiszorg staff in a bankruptcy, whether this amounts to a cartel, and how staff rights and conditions would be protected, including via municipal contracts and compensation. The state secretary replied that no national agreements exist, that providers set their own personnel policy within the law, that talks on a possible takeover are ongoing, and that he refers to earlier letters on fair employment conditions and the 2015 care agreement, without committing to new measures such as compensation.

Based on the information Zorgkompas provided to me, I can inform you that Zorgkompas has made no national agreements about whether or not to take on TSN Thuiszorg staff after a bankruptcy of TSN Thuiszorg.

Op grond van de door Zorgkompas aan mij verstrekte informatie kan ik u melden dat Zorgkompas geen landelijke afspraken heeft gemaakt over het al dan niet in dienst treden van medewerkers van TSN Thuiszorg na een faillissement van TSN Thuiszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de quickscan 'Werkwijze Veilig Thuis' van Defence for Children

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Defence for Children quickscan finding that Veilig Thuis's model protocol and triage tool give insufficient safeguards, that the advice function is unclear, that regional handling differs, that responsibility is shifted to professionals, that workload is too high and that national steering is lacking. The State Secretary agrees the working method needs sharpening and promises measures in the VGR GIA report and a joint project with VNG and VenJ, but sees no need for separate research.
I therefore see no reason to commission further research into the findings of this quickscan.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek te laten doen naar de bevindingen van deze quickscan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Veilig Thuis tekort schiet in haar taken

An MP asked whether Veilig Thuis (domestic violence reporting centres) falls short in its tasks, including long waiting lists that may include high-priority cases and whether acute cases get contact, and what is being done. The state secretary acknowledged inspection signals, said municipalities added funds and organisations are preparing improvement plans, and stated that not all centres meet legal requirements and that some high-priority cases are on waiting lists.
I expect the final inspection report at the end of February 2016. As soon as I have received this report, I will send it to you within the usual timeframes.
Het eindrapport van de inspecties verwacht ik eind februari 2016. Zodra ik dit rapport heb ontvangen, zal ik het binnen de gebruikelijke termijnen aan u sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de telefonische bereikbaarheid van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) over problemen met het persoonsgebonden budget (PGB)

An MP asked the State Secretary why the SVB's phone number for persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) problems was not displayed prominently on its website, and about call volumes and waiting times. The State Secretary acknowledged the website had been reorganised, added the phone number to all answers and contact pages, and reported that telephone accessibility was in order apart from one morning with higher call volume.
Meanwhile, on 8 January the SVB added the phone number to every question and answer on the contact page.
Inmiddels heeft de SVB op 8 januari jl. het telefoonnummer opgenomen bij elke vraag en antwoord op de contact-pagina
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de vermeende angstcultuur bij Zorggroep Charim

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an alleged culture of fear at care group Charim, including whether earlier improvement points had been implemented and what independent research and external support would follow. The State Secretary condemned any culture of fear, said Charim is primarily responsible for its own improvement, described the prior report's themes and an independent study expected in April 2016, and pointed to available support programmes.
Yes. I am of the view that no organisation may have a culture of fear.
Ja. Ik ben van mening dat in geen enkele organisatie sprake mag zijn van een angstcultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het pgb-systeem van de SVB failliet is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the SVB's personal budget (pgb) payment system is bankrupt, whether it is too complex and costly, and how the cost overruns and administrative burden of the trekkingsrecht system will be handled. The State Secretary denies the system is bankrupt, says most payments are now made within 10 working days, promises an improvement plan and talks with municipalities, but declines to commit to moving pgb administration to municipalities and gives no breakdown of the cost of the system.

I would like to use the experiences of the aldermen concerned in the further development and improvement of the pgb chain, but I do not consider it in the interest of the budget holder to implement a far-reaching change to the pgb chain now and for a number of specific municipalities.

Ik wil de ervaringen van de betreffende wethouders graag benutten bij de doorontwikkeling en verbeteren van de pgb-keten, maar ik acht het niet in het belang van de budgethouder om nu en voor een aantal specifieke gemeenten een omvangrijke wijziging van de pgb-keten door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bergkamp over de continuïteit van hospicezorg

MPs Bergkamp and Van der Staaij asked the government about waiting lists and funding gaps at Hospice Dignitas, insurers' expenditure caps for 2016, and whether insurers meet their care duty when contracting little with regional hospices. The State Secretary answered that waiting times are undesirable, that insurers are expected to contract sufficiently and reorganise contracting, that local shortages occur but are not structural, and that the NZa transparency rule and a dispute body are being developed.
Health insurers have a duty of care; they must provide insured persons with good-quality care that is within their reach and delivered in a timely manner.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben zorgplicht, zij moeten verzekerden voorzien van kwalitatief goede zorg die binnen hun bereik is af te nemen en tijdig wordt geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Minder ziekenhuisopnames door casemanager palliatieve zorg'

MPs asked the state secretary for Health about a study finding that palliative case managers reduce hospital admissions, and about funding, reach beyond cancer patients and follow-up on a motion. The state secretary said the model adds value, that the Health Insurance Act allows such roles to be funded through nursing care, and that palliative care is being broadened beyond cancer, though no new obligation is created.
I am currently examining how I can implement the adopted motion submitted by member Bruins Slot et al.
Ik ben momenteel aan het onderzoeken hoe ik uitvoering kan geven aan de aangenomen motie van het lid Bruins Slot c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Transitie doet administratieve lasten met 30 procent groeien’

SP MPs asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about reports that the social domain transition raised administrative burdens by 30 percent, and whether municipal policy freedom and fragmented approaches cause this. The state secretary acknowledged the burden problems and pointed to joint action with municipalities and providers, including an action agenda and a joint implementation organisation, while declining to provide data on external hiring costs and saying there is no representative research on the burden increase.
I do not have representative research on the administrative burden resulting from the transition.
Ik beschik niet over een representatief onderzoek over de administratieve lasten als gevolg van de transitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over jongeren die gemakkelijk onbeperkt kunnen drinken op oudejaarsavond

An MP asked the state secretary whether all-you-can-drink New Year's Eve offers by bars endanger young people, whether municipalities should act, and whether the Drink and Hospitality Act should be tightened, including a Finnish-style ban on volume discounts. The state secretary acknowledged the risks, pointed to existing municipal enforcement powers and to the evaluation of the Act, but said there was no clear breach of the rules, promised only to raise the issue with entrepreneurs and monitor plans, and gave no figures on youth alcohol incidents.
Municipalities have a supervisory and enforcement task regarding the supply of alcohol to minors and to persons who are intoxicated.
Gemeenten hebben een toezichthoudende en handhavende taak waar het gaat om de verstrekking aan minderjarigen en mensen die in staat van dronkenschap verkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘De kindermaag gamet lekker mee’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health how the government responds to research showing that advergames promoting snacks increase children's snacking, and whether the government will ban such disguised marketing. The State Secretary says he takes the findings seriously, relies on the industry's self-regulatory codes, sees no need for legislation yet, and will commission research on compliance and discuss the issue with the food industry.
At present I am having research carried out into the food industry's compliance on social media, the internet and games, among other things.
Momenteel laat ik wel onderzoek doen naar de naleving van de voedingsindustrie op onder andere social media, internet en games.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Oudere staat er alleen voor’

MP Agema (PVV) asked whether the safety of elderly people is endangered by their staying independent longer and whether they are left alone, citing a newspaper report. The Secretary of State answered that the trend toward independent living raises quality of life though it brings risks, and that the long-term care reform, district nursing, and the Wmo 2015 aim to support people at home with institutional care as a fallback.
The long-term care reform is precisely aimed at enabling people to stay at home longer.
De hervorming langdurige zorg is er juist op gericht om het mogelijk te maken dat mensen langer thuis kunnen blijven wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over indicatieproblemen bij terminale thuiszorg

MPs Wolbert and Bouwmeester asked why terminally ill patients in care institutions sometimes cannot die at home because of indication problems with the Wlz and ZZP profiles, and who is responsible for timely solutions. The State Secretary called this undesirable, said the CIZ can now issue palliative terminal care indications for home deaths, and clarified that care offices and providers share responsibility for timely follow-up care.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Yücel over het voornemen van het waterschap Delfland de kwijtschelding van de afvalwaterzuiveringsheffing in twee stappen geheel af te schaffen

MPs Jacobi and Yücel asked whether the Delfland water board's plan to phase out remission (kwijtschelding) of the wastewater treatment levy would hurt low-income households and whether national government should intervene. Minister Plasterk answered that water boards are autonomous in remission policy, that consultations with the Unie van Waterschappen took place, and that social minimum safety nets such as bijstand and municipal compensation exist, with no national intervention planned.

At the same time it was established that the individual water boards are themselves responsible for their own remission policy and account for it to the general board of the water board, which is democratically elected.

Tegelijkertijd is vastgesteld dat de individuele waterschappen zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor hun eigen kwijtscheldingsbeleid en dat zij hierover verantwoording afleggen aan het algemeen bestuur van het waterschap.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat een beveiligingsbedrijf zorgtaken en behandeling in het kader van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning en jeugdzorg wil gaan leveren

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about reports that security company G4S would provide Wmo and youth care tasks in Hollandse Kroon, including its qualifications, staffing, use of remote care and transition impact on clients. The state secretary replied that the municipality had ended the tender talks with G4S, that it would not explain its reasons citing the Aanbestedingswet, and that continuity of care and legal safeguards would be ensured through the procurement process.
Referring to the Aanbestedingswet and the handling of talks between G4S Zorg en Welzijn and the municipality, the municipality makes no statements about the reasons for ending the talks.

De gemeente doet onder verwijzing naar het gestelde in de Aanbestedingswet en de afwikkeling van gesprekken tussen G4S Zorg en Welzijn en de gemeente, geen uitspraken over de beweegredenen voor het beëindigen van de gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over het bericht dat toezichthouders van Patyna het eigen salaris fors verhogen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether it is acceptable that supervisory board members of Patyna raised their own pay while home-care staff are asked to give up salary, and asked for an overview of similar cases and for the quality criteria for supervisors. The state secretary answered that pay limits are set by the WNT and that setting a fitting fee is for the supervisors themselves, that Patyna has since reversed the increase and will review pay with its works and client councils, that data for 2015 are not yet available, and that an accreditation track for supervisors is being discussed with the NVTZ.
Within the limits set by the law, in particular the WNT, it is up to the supervisors to determine what constitutes an appropriate remuneration.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet, in het bijzonder de WNT, stelt is het aan de toezichthouders om te bepalen wat een passende beloning is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de VNG een pilot ‘reguleren mengvormen winkel/horeca’ start

An MP asked whether the VNG pilot allowing shop-catering hybrids, which would tolerate breaches of specific Drank- en Horecawet articles, is lawful and whether the state would act against it. The state secretary said the law leaves no room for such tolerance, that he expects the VNG to adjust the pilot, sent a letter to the VNG, and will address participating municipalities if experiments go beyond legal limits.
I then stated that the Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) leaves no room for the pilot in which prohibitions under the DHW are tolerated.
Ik heb toen gemeld dat de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) geen ruimte biedt voor de pilot waarbij verboden uit de DHW worden gedoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht VNG-pilot toch in strijd met Drank- en Horecawet

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health whether a VNG municipal pilot allowing mixing of bar and retail alcohol sales violates the Drank- en Horecawet, and how the government would act. The State Secretary confirmed the pilot cannot tolerate violations of the law, said he expects the VNG pilot to stay within legal frameworks, and said he would address participating municipalities if not.
Pilots are only possible within the legal frameworks.
Pilots zijn alleen mogelijk binnen de wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over het bericht dat gestreste mantelzorgers vaak hun geduld verliezen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that strained informal carers often lose patience and sometimes act roughly, and about how overburdened carers and care recipients can be protected, how municipalities support carers, and how carers can be informed about respite care and leave rights. The government answered that it takes overburdening seriously, will set up pilots on escalating informal care with municipalities before summer, and will rely on existing municipal duties and programmes while promising a further letter and awaiting an SER advice on combining work and care.
Soon I will send you a further progress letter on informal care, in which I will among other things go into the SCP report in more detail.
Binnenkort stuur ik u opnieuw een voortgangsbrief informele zorg, waarin ik onder andere meer uitgebreid in zal gaan op het rapport van het SCP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Inspectie verzwijgt misstanden. Rapport over grove fouten Helders verzorgingshuis geheimgehouden’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the health inspectorate IGZ concealed serious failures at care home De Golfstroom, why its calamity report was not published, and whether it would send the report to parliament. The State Secretary denied concealment, pointed to published inspection reports, said the calamity report is withheld to protect individual privacy under the open government act, and gave no commitment to send it.
On 17 February 2015 and 7 November 2015 the inspectorate actively published the reports it drew up following its inspection of the quality of care.

De inspectie heeft op 17 februari 2015 en op 7 november 2015 de door haar opgestelde rapporten naar aanleiding van het inspectieonderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de zorgverlening actief openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht van het SCP “Een op de drie Nederlanders geeft informele hulp”

MP Voortman asked whether the government will have the SCP repeat its 2014 informal care study for 2015 to assess the effects of the Wmo 2015 and Youth Act on carers, and about gender differences in paid work among carers. The state secretary answered that key parts will be repeated in 2016 within the long-term care reform evaluation, and described existing policy measures and studies on combining work and care, with a promised letter to parliament after a 2016 meeting.
Important parts of the study will be repeated by the SCP in 2016 as part of the evaluation of the long-term care reform.
Belangrijke onderdelen van het onderzoek zullen door het SCP in 2016 herhaald worden als onderdeel van de evaluatie van de hervorming langdurige zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de stelling ‘Een patiënt heeft het recht zelf te beslissen waar hij/zij de laatste levensfase wil verblijven’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a case where a terminally ill man could not die at a hospice or at home due to an indication problem with the CIZ, and about how often this occurs. The State Secretary answered that such cases are rare, that the Wlz indication rules were clarified so CIZ can issue the palliative terminal care profile for people who want to die at home, and that CIZ staff were reminded of the rules.

The policy rules have now been clarified, so there should be no misunderstanding about the possibility that the CIZ can issue an indication decision for the protected living profile with intensive palliative terminal care for people who want to die at home.

De beleidsregels zijn inmiddels verduidelijkt, zodat er geen misverstanden hoeven te ontstaan over de mogelijkheid dat het CIZ bij mensen die thuis willen overlijden een indicatiebesluit voor het zorgprofiel beschermd wonen met intensieve palliatief terminale zorg kan afgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Monasch over het bericht “Salaris bobo's Friese thuiszorg verdubbeld”

MPs asked the government about reports that supervisory board pay at home-care organisation Patyna had doubled and whether this complies with the Wet Normering Topinkomens. The minister answered that the board pay was reversed, stays at prior levels, falls within WNT limits as far as applicable, and that setting pay and consulting staff are the organisation's own responsibility.
Within the limits set by law, in particular the WNT, it is for the institution and the top official to determine what constitutes appropriate remuneration.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet, in het bijzonder de WNT, stelt is het aan de instelling en de topfunctionaris om te bepalen wat een passende beloning is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over inzake de berichtgeving op de website van het Centraal Administratiekantoor (CAK) over de eigen bijdrage van het Modulair Pakket Thuis (MPT) en de informatie die gebruikers van he

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Health about the CAK's communication on the switch from four-weekly to monthly co-payment for the Modulair Pakket Thuis, the delayed first bill, and whether a payment-arrangement option should be sent by letter. The State Secretary explained the delay as a one-off effect of aligning the system with the iWlz, and said the payment option will be mentioned in a flyer sent with the decision in late February or early March.
The CAK has indeed already stated on its website that it is possible to pay the first invoice in instalments.
Het CAK heeft inderdaad op de website al vermeld dat het mogelijk is om de eerste factuur gespreid te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over het maatwerkprofiel en de meerzorgregeling

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked why the progress report on long-term care discusses the meerzorgregeling but not the development of a maatwerkprofiel, what the difference is between the two, and how care for children with severe multiple disabilities can support their development. The Staatssecretaris answered that maatwerk is being examined through an advisory request to ZIN and NZa with results expected in 2016, that existing profiles already allow development-oriented care, and that children with multiple disabilities can receive developmental care within their zorgplan, with supplementary care where profiles are insufficient.
It is my intention that at a later stage the joint advice of the NZa and ZIN will also contribute to this discussion.
Het is mijn bedoeling dat op een later moment ook het gezamenlijke advies van de NZa en ZIN een bijdrage levert aan deze discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over een stagetekort voor nieuwe verpleegkundigen

MP Wolbert asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Education whether a shortage of internship places is blocking growth in nursing training, and what hogescholen and the government will do about it. The government answered that internship places have grown faster than student numbers, that regional initiatives under the Zorgpact are underway, and that it will keep stimulating them without announcing a new concrete measure.
That is why it is good that initiatives are being developed at regional level.
Daarom is het goed dat op regionaal niveau initiatieven tot stand komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het bericht dat in Enschede een zorggroep een loonoffer vraagt van duizend personeelsleden

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about care group Manna in Enschede requesting a voluntary wage sacrifice from about a thousand staff to cover a 2015 deficit, and how this relates to a court ruling that financial problems may not be shifted onto employees. The state secretary called the request remarkable but said institutions set their own personnel policy within legal and collective agreement frameworks, that the cases differ, and that no information is held on other organisations; he pointed to a new joint approach with unions and VNG for long-term care.
However, institutions determine their own vision, conduct and personnel policy.
Instellingen bepalen echter hun eigen visie, handelen en personeelbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het Van der Staaij over de overgang van een verzilverd ZZP naar terminale zorg thuis

An MP asked whether the Wilhelmina Hospital Assen had repeatedly been unable to arrange home or hospice deaths for patients already receiving Wlz care, and whether the Zvw/Wlz divide should be changed. The state secretary confirmed the cases, said the CIZ issued an indicatie the same day and the guidance was clarified, but refused to convert existing Wlz indications into Zvw home-care indications.
I have incorporated the clarification into the existing information card on Palliative Terminal Care (PTZ).
Ik heb de verduidelijking verwerkt in de bestaande informatiekaart Palliatief Terminale Zorg (PTZ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over minderjarige meisjes in de kelder van een belwinkel

MP Van der Burg asked about minors found repeatedly in the basement of a phone shop, police and youth care contact, whether the youth institutions and Inspectie Jeugdzorg had acted, and the risk assessment and protective measures used. The government answered that police arrested the owner twice and closed the shop, that the investigation's planning cannot be shared, and that the institution used its available tools and the Inspectorate saw no reason for further investigation.
Regarding the planning and any results of the investigation, I cannot inform you further in the interest of the investigation in this case.
Over de planning en eventuele resultaten van het onderzoek, kan ik u in het belang van het onderzoek in deze zaak niet nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over herindicatie van cliënten met een persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) voor wijkverpleging

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked why insurers use differing forms when re-assessing personal-budget (pgb) clients receiving community nursing and what can reduce the administrative burden. The Secretary of State answered that insurers are adopting a uniform application form from 1 January 2016, developed with nursing bodies, and that ministry, insurers and providers will screen forms for necessity while monitoring progress.
I will keep a close eye on this.
Ik zal dit in de gaten blijven houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het bericht “Brabant Zorg sluit geen contract af met DSW en Menzis voor wijkverpleging in 2016”

MPs Bruins Slot and Keijzer asked about BrabantZorg not contracting DSW and Menzis for district nursing in 2016, the price and budget figures, and how insured people are protected. The Secretary of State says the zorgplicht ensures insured people keep access to care, reports preliminary 2015 spending figures that may exceed the budget by about €50 million, and says the MBI would only be considered after definitive figures and analysis of causes.
Before the MBI is applied, several steps will be carried out.
Voordat het MBI wordt ingezet zullen er verschillende stappen worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over verslaving aan sociale media

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about social media addiction among youth, based on a CBS survey reporting that one in six young people calls themselves addicted. The government answered that addiction care sees few such cases, that no further research or action is needed for now, and that schools and parents should teach healthy media use in cooperation with the education ministry.
Given the low demand for help among young people, I see no reason for now to take action.
Gezien de geringe hulpvraag van jongeren zie ik vooralsnog geen reden actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Gapend gat tussen ziekenhuis en thuis’

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports of a gap between hospital and home care, including whether elderly patients stay in hospital too long and whether the funding ceiling for first-line stays is too low. The state secretary said he added EUR 20 million to the 2015 subsidy ceiling, denied a structural flaw in the system, described a new practical support team, and said the funding timing was coincidental.
No, no data on this is kept nationally.
Nee, hier worden landelijk geen gegevens over bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over over mogelijke problemen (her)indicaties jeugdhulp en informatievoorziening rondom de zorgaanvraag

An MP asked the state secretary about re-assessments of youth care under the transition to the Jeugdwet, the timeliness of information to young people and parents, waiting lists, and a monitor report on access problems. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for timely information, that central data on re-assessments is not collected, and pointed to a fact sheet, VNG communication, cooperation with GPs, and knowledge programmes for municipalities.
I am not aware of how many young people whose current AWBZ and/or Youth Act assessment must be re-assessed by municipalities in 2015, because this information is not collected centrally.

Het is mij niet bekend van welk aantal jeugdigen de lopende indicatie uit de AWBZ en/of Wet op de jeugdzorg in 2015 door gemeenten (her)beoordeeld dient te worden omdat deze informatie niet centraal wordt verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Hoogland over de aanvraag van een OV-begeleiderskaart

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Hoogland asked why applying for an OV-begeleiderskaart requires a five-page questionnaire and an IQ test on top of a CIZ indication, and whether these burdens could be dropped when a valid CIZ indication exists. The State Secretary agreed partly: a CIZ indication suffices as proof in one specific case (IQ test no longer required for those with an AWBZ/Wlz 24-hour care indication), reviews of the questionnaire are planned for early next year, but data exchange with CIZ is not straightforwardly permitted under privacy law.

I also want to explore with the indication body for the OV-begeleiderskaart whether the questionnaire can be made more concrete regarding required evidence, so that one piece of evidence per criterion suffices.

Ik wil daarnaast met de indicatiesteller voor de OV-begeleiderskaart bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om de vragenlijst op het punt van de benodigde bewijsstukken zodanig te concretiseren dat er met één bewijsstuk per criterium volstaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de schending van privacy door gemeenten in de jeugdzorg

Voortman (GreenLeft) asked the State Secretaries whether municipalities breach privacy in youth care by sharing medical files via post or unsecured email and letting non-medical officials view children's medical records. The government answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for compliance, that the Cbp supervises, and that only necessary data may be shared, but it gave no concrete sanctions and largely pointed to existing guidance and responsibilities of councils and the Cbp.
The municipal executive is primarily responsible for ensuring the municipality complies with the legal and agreed requirements on information security and privacy protection.

Het college van B&W is primair verantwoordelijk om er voor te zorgen dat de gemeente voldoet aan de (wettelijke en in de gemeente afgesproken) vereisten ten aanzien van informatiebeveiliging en privacybescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over een wijziging van het procesreglement Civiel Jeugdrecht

CDA MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether the change to the Civil Youth Law procedure rules, which stops non-guardian parents from relying on their rights as interested parties, could be reversed by a judge and how many parents are affected. The Minister answered that the judge decides who is an interested party, that no body records how many parents are affected, and that the Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht is advising, with a report expected in spring 2016.
We have asked the Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht to advise on the concept of interested party within the meaning of article 798(1) Rv in cases concerning supervision orders.
Wij hebben de Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht verzocht om te adviseren over het begrip belanghebbende in de zin van artikel 798 lid 1 Rv in zaken betreffende de ondertoezichtstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat slachtoffers van loverboys op kosten van de belastingbetaler geholpen kunnen worden in Turkije

The MP Kooiman asks the State Secretary about a private youth care provider in Turkey (Turkijezorg) that reportedly treats Dutch children with psychological problems and loverboy victims at public expense, raising questions about inspection, quality standards, contracting by municipalities, and registration. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for youth care, that the Youth Inspectorate cannot supervise providers operating outside municipal responsibility, that no children are currently being treated, and that domestic care is preferred, while leaving some questions unknown.
These quality requirements cannot be checked or enforced by a Dutch inspectorate in another country.
Deze kwaliteitseisen kunnen niet door een Nederlandse inspectie in een ander land worden gecontroleerd of afgedwongen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman de bezuinigingen op de thuiszorg in Enschede onderzoekt

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that the National Ombudsman was investigating Enschede's home-care cuts, whether many clients never had a kitchen-table assessment, the number of Wmo complaints received, and whether 'clean and liveable home' is an acceptable standard. The secretary replied that no regular Ombudsman investigation exists yet (an internal municipal review is ongoing and Ombudsman staff will hold a surgery in January 2016), that Enschede conducted assessments and handled 170 objections, that the Ombudsman received 242 Wmo complaints across 111 municipalities, and that municipalities may keep the 'clean and liveable' terminology.
Based on the information the Ombudsman receives during this surgery, he will assess whether to carry out an investigation.
Op basis van de informatie die de No tijdens dit spreekuur krijgt, zal hij beoordelen of hij een onderzoek gaat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over misstanden in de vrouwenopvang in Heemskerk

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about alleged abuses (exploitation, hygiene, intimidation, prostitution) at a women's shelter in Heemskerk, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should investigate and whether the problems extend to other regions. The State Secretary answered that the responsible alderman and the operator are handling the signals, the Inspectorate had no role since the signals did not concern working conditions, the operator being the commissioner of the inquiry does not per se undermine independence, and the ministry passed on signals it received while the responsible municipalities supervise the shelters.
It is not directly for me to judge whether the alleged abuses have been sufficiently investigated in this way.
Het is niet direct aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de vraag of de vermeende misstanden op deze wijze voldoende onderzocht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat thuiszorgorganisatie TSN loonsverlaging moet terugdraaien voor 4300 thuiszorgmedewerkers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health whether a court ruling ordering TSN home care to reverse pay cuts for 4,300 workers shows that legal action should not be needed to secure decent wages, and what the government will do to prevent repeated litigation and restore basic home-care tariffs. The State Secretary said statutory guarantees function in practice, avoiding court is preferable, and an AMvB under WMO article 2.6.6 is being prepared to ensure careful procurement and reasonable tariffs, though he declined to comment on the ruling's implications for other providers beyond the specific case.
To that end, following the agreed joint approach with FNV, CNV and ActiZ, I intend to prepare an AMvB under article 2.6.6 of the WMO.
Daartoe heb ik naar aanleiding van de afgesproken gezamenlijke aanpak met FNV, CNV en ActiZ ben ik voornemens een AMvB op artikel 2.6.6 van de WMO voor te bereiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de stand van zaken bij Fokuswonen

An MP asked the state secretary about Fokus Wonen's 2014 and expected 2015 deficits, its compliance with subsidy rules and IGZ requirements, the future of ADL clustered housing, the budget increase for the Wlz subsidy, criteria for extra funds, and court rulings on linking tenancy and care contracts. The state secretary explained the deficits and stated that Fokus meets its obligations, that a multi-year budget increase applies to all ADL projects, and that case law on linking housing and care contracts is limited and depends on circumstances, though the answers were sent late.
Incidentally, the business operations of Fokus and the choices it makes are the primary responsibility of the board member(s) concerned.
Overigens is de bedrijfsvoering van Fokus en de keuzen die men daartoe maakt de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van de betrokken bestuurder(s).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over geweigerde terminale thuiszorg aan 23 mensen die thuis wilden sterven

MP Agema asks why the Secretary of State addressed the refusal of terminal home care for 23 people wishing to die at home only by a phone call with one hospital, and why he does not act to break the funding impasse in community nursing. The Secretary replies that he contacted the hospital and insurer, that the problem was incidental, that insurer CZ made new working agreements, and that he stressed regional agreements and promised a letter on specialist community nursing before year-end.

As I promised in the committee debate of 10 November, following a motion by MP Bergkamp, I will inform the House before the end of the year about the state of affairs regarding procurement of specialised community nursing functions.

Zoals ik heb toegezegd in het voortgezet algemeen overleg van 10 november jl., naar aanleiding van een motie van het Kamerlid Bergkamp 3 , informeer ik de Tweede Kamer nog voor het eind van het jaar over de stand van zaken rond de inkoop van de gespecialiseerde functies van de wijkverpleging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over informele zorg en persoonsgebonden budgetten

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary for Health about municipalities' room to refuse personal budgets (pgb) for informal care, the 10-hour rule, exclusion of day care and treatment, the 'usual care' criterion, and whether the minister will consult the VNG given many appeals by Per Saldo. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have policy freedom but cannot categorically exclude pgb use for informal care, that blanket exclusions do not fit the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet, and that he will consult the VNG on the appeal outcomes.
Categorically excluding the first 10 hours per week of informal support or informal youth care from a pgb is, in my view, not compatible with the principles of the Wmo 2015 and the Jeugdwet

Het categoraal uitsluiten van de eerste 10 uur per week van informele ondersteuning of informele jeugdhulp middels een pgb verhoudt zich daarom in mijn ogen niet tot de uitgangspunten van de Wmo 2015 en de Jeugdwet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de derde voortgangsrapportage hervorming langdurige zorg (HLZ) d.d. 3 november 2015

An MP asked the state secretary whether care for people with mild intellectual disabilities under 18 and the shift of ZZP VG3/VG4 care to municipalities under the Wmo had changed, and how many people need temporary protected housing, while questioning the sharp fall in CIZ indications. The secretary denied any policy change, said Wlz eligibility criteria differ from the former AWBZ, that municipalities are responsible for temporary needs, and that an external study on the target group and budget will follow.
Analysis of data has shown that it is not possible to obtain clarity in the short term on the size of the target group per municipality and the budget involved in support.
Uit analyse van data is gebleken dat het niet mogelijk is om op korte termijn duidelijkheid te krijgen over de omvang van de doelgroep per gemeente en het met de ondersteuning gemoeide budget.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Volp over de Verwijsindex Risicojongeren

MPs Ypma and Volp asked the State Secretary about a study finding the Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (VIR) rarely identifies new at-risk children and is poorly known, costly and experienced as intrusive. The State Secretary disputed the generalisability of the four-municipality study, pointed to a national evaluation, stated the VIR aims to match signals rather than find new cases, and acknowledged privacy concerns while stressing child safety.
The national picture of how the VIR works is drawn by the evaluation of the VIR that I presented to the House this year as an annex to the progress report.
Het landelijk beeld over de werking van de VIR wordt geschetst door de evaluatie van de VIR die ik de Kamer dit jaar heb aangeboden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het aandacht vragen voor gendercide tijdens het staatsbezoek aan China

An SGP MP asked whether the government would raise gendercide (sex-selective killing of girls and abortion) during the state visit to China, and how. The minister replied that the issue was raised in human rights consultations, with the health state secretary and in the embassy, and that China says sex disclosure is legally banned and campaigns against gendercide.
Combating violence against girls and women, including unborn girls, is one of the Netherlands' policy priorities.
Het tegengaan van geweld tegen meisjes en vrouwen, met inbegrip van ongeboren meisjes, is één van de beleidsprioriteiten van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat aangerande vrouwen vinden dat hulp politie tekort schiet

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether police response to sexual assault victims is too slow, including delays before contact by the sex crimes unit, the practice of not talking to suspects when no case is opened, and referral to sexual violence centres. The minister explains the 7-day target for the informative conversation, the criteria for talking to suspects, and that temporary funding will support a nationwide network of sexual violence centres.
The informative conversation is held within 7 days unless this is not possible for the reporter.
Het informatief gesprek wordt binnen 7 dagen gevoerd tenzij dit voor melder niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de procedure herindeling Wajong

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about the UWV procedure for reassessing young disabled people (Wajong), including people with a day-care indication and those who no longer meet Wsw minimum criteria, and whether they could go straight to Wajong without a new procedure. The government answered that people with an AWBZ day-care indication are presumed to have no work capacity and are not invited, that no data exist on those unknown to UWV because no legal basis for data exchange with CIZ exists, and that no one had been invited in the first two quarters of 2015.
On your question whether I have insight into the size of the group of Wajong recipients with a day-care indication of whom UWV is unaware, I must answer that no data on this are known.
Op uw vraag of ik inzicht heb in de omvang van de groep Wajongers met een indicatie dagbesteding zonder dat UWV hiervan op de hoogte is, moet ik u antwoorden dat hierover geen gegevens bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeente Den Haag Wmo-indicaties stelt via een digitaal rekenprogramma

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether Den Haag's use of a digital calculation program to assess Wmo care needs, instead of personal interviews, complies with the law, covering privacy, access, costs, staffing and whether the minister will intervene. The State Secretary answered that the digital procedure for simple requests does not fully meet Wmo 2015 requirements, that Den Haag is adjusting it by early 2016, and that he sees no reason to intervene since use of a supporting program is not in itself unlawful.
It is up to municipalities to make these choices.
Het is aan gemeenten om hier keuzes in te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bruins Slot en Dik-Faber over de financiering van geestelijke begeleiding bij palliatieve zorg in de thuissituatie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bruins-Slot and Dik-Faber asked why spiritual care for terminally ill patients at home is not reimbursed under the Zvw and whether insurers are meeting their duty of care. The Secretary of State answered that spiritual guidance on religion and spirituality is not insured care, that palliative care by nurses and GPs is covered, and that Agora will be asked to inventory improvements with stakeholders.

I am not aware of any signals that health insurers are not purchasing and reimbursing the support for coping with illness and treatment, as described by the professional groups themselves within the limits of care that GPs and nurses normally provide, and are therefore failing their duty of care.

Mij zijn geen signalen bekend dat zorgverzekeraars de begeleiding bij de verwerking en het omgaan met ziekte en behandeling, zoals door de beroepsgroepen zelf beschreven binnen de grenzen van zorg zoals huisartsen en verpleegkundigen die plegen te bieden, niet inkopen en vergoeden en dus hun zorgplicht niet nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over intensieve kindzorg

Ms Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary of Health about the status and implementation of the Medical Child Care System report, the roles of coordinators, care-coordinator and nursing indication, the division between Zvw, Wlz and Jeugdwet, school-based medical tasks, and whether insurers buy enough intensive child care. The State Secretary answered that implementation is underway with a subsidy of about 460,000 euros, that the care coordinator should relieve parents without taking over, that the ministry monitors signals via meeting platforms and complaint points, and that it will talk to municipalities and insurers about clarity on care boundaries.
I will talk with municipalities, health insurers and interest organisations to make good arrangements so that this is prevented in the future.
Ik ga met gemeenten, zorgverzekeraars en belangenorganisaties in gesprek om hier goede afspraken over te maken, zodat dit in de toekomst wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het herindiceren van cliënten met een persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) op basis van de Zorgverzekeringswet

MP Otwin van Dijk asked the state secretary about Menzis giving clients with a personal budget (pgb) under the Zorgverzekeringswet only about three weeks to submit a new application, and whether that deadline was reasonable and why clients were informed so late. The state secretary said Menzis has adjusted its communication, allowing extensions for force majeure, and that he will keep asking insurers for good communication, while not judging whether short deadlines are generally adequate.
I find it unfortunate to hear that this happened, and I do not think it is right that a pgb should be stopped if an insured person cannot meet the set deadline for legitimate reasons.
Ik vind het vervelend om te horen dat dat gebeurd is en ik vind het niet juist dat een pgb zou worden stopgezet, als een verzekerde om legitieme redenen niet aan de gestelde termijn kan voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht dat jeugdzorg belang van het kind uit het oog verliest

An MP asked the state secretary whether youth care has lost sight of the child's interest and how parents can seek redress when they receive inadequate care. The secretary acknowledged the concerns, said municipalities must not take over professionals' roles, and pointed parents to municipal complaint routes and the Children's Ombudsman, promising to discuss follow-up with the VNG.
I have asked the Children's Ombudsman to report to me the examples where access to and quality of youth care are not going well, so that I get a picture of the nature and extent of the problems.

Ik heb de Kinderombudsman gevraagd om de voorbeelden waarin het met de toegang en kwaliteit van de jeugdhulp niet goed gaat, aan mij te melden, zodat ik een beeld krijg van de aard en omvang van de problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over signalen dat Zorgverzekeringsindicaties uit gemeentelijke budgetten worden betaald

An MP asked whether the SVB pays provider invoices based only on the contract without checking the indication, so that municipal budgets pay for care that should be covered under the Zvw. The Secretary of State answered that municipalities check content against the indication, that an emergency fallback in early 2015 granted automatic approval to contracts not yet reviewed, and that a correction procedure has been developed with partners.
Under privacy legislation, the SVB does not have access to care indications.
Uit hoofde van privacywetgeving beschikt de SVB niet over zorgindicaties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Volp en Servaes over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de United Nations General Assembly Special Session (UNGASS) on the World Drug Problem die in 2016 zal plaatsvinden

Four MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch policy for the 2016 UN drugs special session had changed, whether the Netherlands should back regulated cannabis cultivation, and how death penalty cases for drug offences would be handled. The government answered that the Dutch position has not changed, that it opposes regulated cannabis cultivation and mayors' calls for it, and that it works to end the death penalty for drug offences while noting three Dutch nationals face such sentences.
Regulation/legalisation of cannabis cultivation is not cabinet policy, so it is not appropriate for the Netherlands to take the leading role the questioners propose at the UNGASS.
Regulering/legalisering van de hennepteelt is geen kabinetsbeleid en het ligt daarom niet voor de hand bij de UNGASS een door de vragenstellers beoogde voortrekkersrol op dit vlak te vervullen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Keijzer over het openbaar maken van het oordeel van de Chief Information Officer van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport én het openbaar maken van de verslagen

MPs Bergkamp and Keijzer asked why the CIO assessment of the SVB's ICT system and the minutes of the PGB Trekkingsrecht steering group have not been made public, and why a Wob request was answered late. The state secretary replied that the CIO assessment and steering group minutes were made available to parliament confidentially, that officials' and external participants' views are not published, and that the Wob deadline was exceeded due to processing delays.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het opnieuw sluiten van verzorgingshuizen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why an 88-year-old resident and other elderly people must move because the Olde Heem care home is closing, whether this is acceptable, and whether the government will intervene to keep four homes open. State Secretary Van Rijn replied that closures through renovation and new building are normal, stressed intensive consultation with residents and relatives, declined to intervene because responsibility lies with the care group, corporations and municipalities, and said no national register of closures exists, citing care trends toward staying at home.
No national list is kept of care homes that close.
Er wordt landelijk geen lijst bijgehouden van verzorgingshuizen die sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het Berckmoes-Duindam over het artikel ‘Amsterdamse Kinderombudsman signaleert problemen bij uithuisplaatsingen’

The MP asked the state secretary about children separated from parents in care due to shortages of family shelter places, the numbers involved, and municipal measures to prevent family homelessness. The state secretary said such separation is not centrally registered, that municipalities are responsible for alternatives, and pointed to existing municipal practices and a forthcoming Trimbos study without committing to new measures.
It is not known how many children are separated from their parents due to a shortage of family shelter places, because this data is not centrally registered.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel kinderen worden gescheiden van hun ouders door een tekort aan opvangplaatsen voor gezinnen, omdat dit gegeven niet centraal wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Kooiman betreffende de problemen die kinderen ondervinden met het volgen van onderwijs na een plaatsing in een residentiële jeugdzorgvoorziening

MPs Siderius and Kooiman asked why pupils placed in residential youth care often cannot return to their home school, whether schools tied to nationally operating care institutions bear the school duty of care, and how onderwijs and care placements can be better aligned. The State Secretary says the receiving school has the duty of care, outlines transition rules and a Variawet exemption for short stays, rejects per-place funding, and promises a separate letter on education outside school premises.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over jonge ouder te weinig toegerust

An MP asked whether the government would revisit the 2010 family note and act on proposals to better prepare young parents, including a mandatory parenthood pledge. The state secretary replied that no new family note is needed, that municipalities now hold preventive and youth-care responsibilities under the Jeugdwet, and that parents cannot be obliged to use such services.
At this moment there is no reason to draft a new family note.
Op dit moment is er geen aanleiding om een nieuwe gezinsnota op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de grote problemen in de (specialistische) jeugdpsychiatrie

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about problems in specialist youth psychiatry after the transfer of youth care to municipalities, covering costs, free choice of doctor, continuity at age 18, administration burden, unpaid invoices, waiting times in neighbourhood teams, privacy and access for children from less affluent families. The government answers that the transfer rules allow free choice via contracts or personal budgets, that municipalities are responsible for local problems, and that it will monitor and research them further.
It is a municipal responsibility to solve local problems in matching demand and supply.
Het is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid om lokale problemen in de aansluiting van vraag en aanbod op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over patiëntenstops in de thuiszorg

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about patient intake stops in home care (wijkverpleging) where providers lack funding, asking why the government's promise that no one should be deprived of care is being broken and how the stops will be lifted. The state secretary answered that the insurers' duty of care is decisive, that insurers will contract additional care where needed, and that no additional budget is automatically provided, while stating the aim that no one is deprived of care.
Health insurers, however, have a duty of care for their insured persons.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben echter zorgplicht voor hun verzekerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat slachtoffers van loverboys niet de noodzakelijke hulp krijgen

An SP MP asked whether loverboy victims in the Rotterdam region are not getting the specialist help they need, after Fier Fryslân reported falling referrals. The Secretary of State answered that financial arrangements under the Jeugdwet and Wmo 2015 designate specialist providers, that causes of the fall are unclear and under review with Rotterdam and the VNG, and that a quality framework and further talks with the VNG are planned.
To clarify what is going on, both the municipality of Rotterdam and Fier Fryslân are looking into this matter.
Om helder te krijgen wat er aan de hand is buigen zowel gemeente Rotterdam als Fier Fryslân zich over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Vijfsterren verpleeghuis in Bavel’

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether a five-star nursing home in Bavel, where a place costs about EUR 8,000 per month and mainly pgb holders will live, amounts to two-tier care that undermines regular care and access for those without money. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the Wlz guarantees equal rights to care, that clients may pay for extra services themselves, that providers need no Wtzi licence for Wlz care to pgb holders, and that the zorgkantoor is responsible for matching clients; he saw no tiering or capacity shortage and deferred housing shortages to corporations and municipalities.
The Wlz establishes an equal right to responsible and good-quality care for everyone who is entitled to Wlz care.
In de Wlz is een gelijk recht op verantwoorde en kwalitatief goede zorg vastgelegd voor iedereen die op de Wlz is aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Volp en Bergkamp over het bericht dat personeel monddood wordt gemaakt in de vrouwenopvang

MPs Kooiman, Volp and Bergkamp asked whether staff at a women's shelter in Heemskerk were being silenced, whether the shelter was unsafe for staff and clients, and whether fewer and lower-qualified staff now work there. The State Secretary replied that responsibility lies with the municipality of Haarlem and the operator, that a 2014 Labour Inspectorate visit found no violations, and that a GGD emergency inspection, an improvement plan and an independent investigation are underway, with results promised for November.
The personnel policy of the Heemskerk women's shelter is primarily a matter for the employer and the municipality of Haarlem.
Het personeelsbeleid van de vrouwenopvang Heemskerk is primair een zaak van de werkgever en de gemeente Haarlem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over roken in tuinen en balkons

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary whether people should be free to smoke in their own gardens and balconies, and how to respond to Clean Air Nederland's call for neighbour-smoke lawsuits and its ANBI status. The state secretary answered that there is no smoking ban in private homes and legislation is not the right answer, that neighbours should talk things through, that the ANBI status question is for the Tax Administration, and that whether to pursue a test case is for the organisation itself.
There is however no ban on smoking in the home environment, and I am of the view that legislation is also not the right answer.
Er geldt echter geen verbod op roken in de thuisomgeving en ik ben van mening dat wetgeving ook niet het juiste antwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorg zorgboerderij Hoge Aard in Molenschot ongemoeid laat

MPs Bergkamp and Kooiman asked the State Secretary about media reports that youth care authorities left care farm Hoge Aard in Molenschot alone despite allegations of poor care and mistreatment of residents. The State Secretary said he was seriously concerned, that the inspectorates have conducted several supervisory activities since 2014, that they will continue the investigation jointly and inform the House of the results, and referred the remaining questions to a separate letter to the House.
The IGZ and IJZ will jointly continue the investigation.
De IGZ en IJZ zullen gezamenlijk het onderzoek voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over zorginstellingen die weigeren inzage te geven in het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why care institutions refuse to disclose board members' expense claims and whether the minister will oblige them by law to make declarations transparent. The minister regrets the lack of transparency, says governance is the sector's own responsibility, and points to the upcoming revision of the sector-wide governance code and a survey of expense rules at university medical centres.
Good governance and the associated integrity policy are the responsibility of care providers themselves.
Goed bestuur en het daarbij behorende integriteitsbeleid is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Nispen over het bericht dat het aantal rechtszaken over zorg fors is gestegen

MPs Van Gerven and Van Nispen asked why lawsuits over municipal Wmo care decisions keep rising, whether the government will intervene, and whether higher court fees and cuts to legal aid endanger citizens' access to justice. The Secretary of State answered that the rise partly stems from the new Wmo 2015 and that municipalities should improve careful implementation, with the government able to use supervisory powers only in cases of structural non-compliance, while declining to register social costs and promising a decision on legal aid after a commission report.
It is up to municipalities to learn from these rulings where necessary and improve policy implementation.
Het is aan gemeenten om – waar nog nodig – lering te trekken uit deze uitspraken en de beleidsuitvoering te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de rigide manier waarop CZ haar inkoopeisen hanteert

An MP asked the state secretary about insurer CZ refusing contracts to care providers whose statutes deviate even slightly from the Zorgbrede Governance Code, and whether this fits with court rulings, procedural fairness and deregulation. The secretary broadly supports using the code in contracting, says CZ's policy has been adjusted after talks with sector bodies, and will consult the Wlz insurers on standardising application of the code, while declining to judge what counts as minor errors.
I will therefore consult with the Wlz executing bodies/care offices to arrive at a standardised application of the ZGC within purchasing policy.
Ik zal daarom met de Wlz-uitvoerders/zorgkantoren in overleg treden om te komen tot een gestandaardiseerde toepassing van de ZGC binnen het inkoopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over bemiddelingsbureaus in de zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the rates and services of intermediary agencies in care, the scope of the planned study, whether agency staff acting as representatives of budget holders is undesirable, and whether contracts can be bought out without penalty. The State Secretary said the study is being tendered and has priority, that agency representatives may fail the 'gewaarborgde hulp' standard, that a 'black list' is being explored, and that contract matters are civil and outside government involvement.
The study was promised to the House of Representatives and has priority for me.
Het onderzoek is toegezegd aan de Tweede Kamer en heeft prioriteit voor mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Ypma over onveilige uitwisseling van gegevens tussen gemeenten en behandelaars in de jeugd-ggz

MPs Oosenbrug and Ypma asked whether youth mental health providers exchange sensitive client data with municipalities over unsecured channels, and how the government monitors and enforces information security in the social domain. The Secretary of State acknowledged that not all providers use secure channels yet, pointed to legal duties, the BIG security baseline, and supervision by municipal councils, the Cbp and the Inspectorates, and gave a partial overview without committing to new concrete steps beyond a progress report in spring.
We do not have a complete view of the varied message traffic between providers and municipalities.
Wij hebben geen volledig zicht op het veelzijdig berichtenverkeer tussen aanbieders en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Potters over het controleren van zorgdeclaraties door bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Potters asked whether fraud with personal budgets (PGB) remains possible because court-appointed administrators do not check care declarations, and who is responsible for care quality when administrators lack the expertise. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said administrators are responsible only for finances and administration, and promised work with Per Saldo and care offices on what safeguards 'gewaarborgde hulp' requires, to be addressed in a forthcoming PGB policy agenda.
With Per Saldo and care offices I am working out which safeguards are needed for guaranteed assistance.
Met Per Saldo en zorgkantoren werk ik uit welke waarborgen nodig zijn voor gewaarborgde hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘aantal vechtscheidingen groeit explosief’

An MP asked whether the government will act on reports that high-conflict divorces are rising sharply, including calls for mandatory mediation, appointment of special guardians (bijzondere curatoren), municipal responsibility under the Jeugdwet, and family group plans. The government answered that it monitors the trend but finds mandatory mediation ineffective in all cases, promised ongoing work on special guardians, municipal pilots and mediation legislation, and said the Jeugdwet choices are for municipalities.
I therefore do not consider it effective to make mediation mandatory.
Ik acht het daarom niet effectief om mediation verplicht te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over kindermishandeling

An MP asked the government about forensic pediatric examinations in child abuse cases, the expertise and budget of the NFI versus the FPKM, and why the NFI became the single point of contact for acute and complex cases. The minister answered that the NFI is the preferred supplier for the justice chain, that it expanded its child forensic team, and that private institutes can be used for peak demand or counter-expertise, while denying any termination of cooperation with the FPKM.
The NFI is the preferred supplier for the police and the public prosecution service in the criminal justice chain.
Het NFI is voor de politie en het OM de preferred supplier in de strafrechtketen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat gemeenten in Gelderland 1,1 miljoen euro willen investeren in een ondersteuningsbureau dat de inkoop van jeugdzorg en uitvoering van de Wet maats

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about seven Gelderland municipalities investing 1.1 million euro in a regional procurement support bureau for youth care and Wmo, questioning overhead costs and whether residents get the care they need. The state secretary replied that the investment is about 1% of the 108 million euro budget, that municipalities are responsible for organising execution, and that statutory safeguards and supervisory powers exist, though no national data on transaction costs are available.
The way municipalities organise the implementation of the Wmo 2015 and the Youth Act is the responsibility of the municipalities.
De wijze waarop gemeenten de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015 en de Jeugdwet organiseren, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er een aanmeldstop is bij een jeugd-GGZ praktijk

An MP asked the state secretaries about a reported intake stop at a youth mental health practice in Den Bosch, allegedly caused by budget cuts, and what would be done for affected children and whether other municipalities face similar stops. The government replied that the 20% cut claim is incorrect (3% macro cut for 2015), that municipalities are responsible for providing youth care and for dealing with budget exhaustion, that Den Bosch is in talks with the provider, and that national monitoring does not separately track such stops, while declining to answer before the scheduled debate.
It is up to municipalities to ensure that all children who need youth care receive it.
Het is aan gemeenten om ervoor te zorgen dat alle kinderen die jeugdhulp nodig hebben, deze krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat te veel uitgaven aan pgb-gelden (persoonsgebonden budget) ten koste gaat van intramurale zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary whether a reported overrun on personal budget (pgb) funding is causing cuts to institutional care, and why Achmea Zorgkantoren reported a shortfall while the government expected no pgb shortages. The State Secretary answered that regional shortfalls are expected to be resolved by reallocating funds among care offices, that the NZa will issue an updated advice in October, and that the national budget is sufficient, while answering several figure-based questions only partly.
I have therefore asked the care offices to actively consult with each other on reallocating the available funds.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren daarom gevraagd om actief met elkaar in overleg te gaan over de herverdeling van de beschikbare middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat de pgb-chaos (persoonsgebonden budget) ten koste gaat van verpleeghuizen

An MP asked whether reports that the personal budget (pgb) boom is forcing care institutions for disabled and dementia patients to cut budgets are accurate, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said the cuts are premature, expects sufficient national funds, asked care offices to redistribute, and will send an updated NZa advice to parliament in October.
I have therefore asked the care offices to actively consult with each other on redistributing the available funds.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren daarom gevraagd om actief met elkaar in overleg te gaan over de herverdeling van de beschikbare middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘PGB-chaos gaat ten koste van verpleeghuizen’

MP Potters asked the State Secretary whether PGB (personal budget) growth is causing cuts to institutional care budgets, with consequences for vulnerable clients, and whether a different financing system could prevent this. The State Secretary disputed that cuts are established, said sufficient national funds exist for care offices to redistribute, and said the financing system question would be addressed in a forthcoming agenda.
I expect that nationally sufficient funds are available so that care offices can solve shortfalls themselves through mutual redistribution.
Ik verwacht dat er landelijk gezien voldoende middelen beschikbaar zijn zodat zorgkantoren via een onderlinge herverdeling tekorten zelf kunnen oplossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het toenemend aantal patiëntenstops in de wijkverpleging

An MP asks the State Secretary about rising patient-intake stops in home nursing care, including Vierstroom's stop, whether insurer CZ meets its duty of care, and whether the budget suffices. The State Secretary says the Vierstroom stop has been lifted, insurers must ensure care under their duty of care, and the 2016 budget rises by 180 million euro, while declining to identify other providers at risk.
These signals do not go so far that I have insight into which providers these are.
Deze signalen gaan niet zover dat ik inzicht heb in welke aanbieders dit zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Jacobi en Ypma over het bericht van kindermishandeling in een tehuis voor jongeren met het Prader-Willi syndroom

Three PvdA MPs asked about reports of systematic abuse of residents at a Prader-Willi youth home under enhanced Inspectorate supervision, and whether the home should be closed. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ found no evidence of abuse in its visits, that a prosecution was dropped for insufficient evidence, and that the home remains under monitoring with a follow-up inspection pending.
The Northern Netherlands district public prosecution service opened a criminal investigation following complaints by former staff about abuse.
Het arrondissementsparket Noord-Nederland heeft een strafrechtelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar aanleiding van aangiftes door oud-medewerkers over mishandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Van Wijngaarden over "de beveiliging van SUWInet"

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Van Wijngaarden asked about security of SUWInet, which holds sensitive personal data, including whether burgomasters should be alerted, how citizens can check and restrict access, and whether debt collectors can access it. The State Secretary acknowledged risks identified in a privacy impact assessment, outlined an escalation protocol and audit duties for municipalities, and rejected direct SUWInet access for debt collectors while promising letters to municipalities and a progress update in October.
