The escalation protocol, which I will send to you this autumn, contains a number of steps, with disconnecting an organisation from SUWInet as the ultimum remedium.
Het escalatieprotocol, dat ik u dit najaar toestuur, omvat een aantal stappen met als ultimum remedium het afsluiten van een organisatie van het SUWInet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over de gevolgen van een wijziging van een procesreglement van de rechtbanken

MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether a 2015 change to the Civil Youth Law procedural regulation, based on a Supreme Court ruling, removed parents without custody from the status of interested party in child supervision and placement cases, along with their rights to information, file access and participation, and what support they would receive. The minister confirmed the change, said the removal of automatic party status is a consequence of the ruling, that no data on the group exist, that parents should not be blamed and the consequences will be examined, and that no extra measures are planned because information provision is considered adequate.
That a parent without custody is no longer (by default) regarded as an interested party therefore means that the abovementioned rights lapse.
Dat een ouder zonder gezag niet langer (standaard) als belanghebbende wordt aangemerkt betekent dus dat de hierboven genoemde rechten vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de zorgelijke berichten over de zorg van “hulporganisatie” stichting Stoploverboys.nu

An SP MP asked whether the private foundation Stoploverboys.nu, which provides shelter and care to young loverboy victims with possibly unqualified staff, is acceptable and what oversight exists. The government answered that the foundation is not a legally recognised youth care provider, so the Inspectie Jeugdzorg has no supervisory power over it, and that the municipality has no subsidy relation with it, while a draft law on youth residences would bring such facilities under municipal supervision.
As we indicated above, the Inspectie Jeugdzorg currently cannot take any steps against private care providers such as the foundation Stoploverboys.nu.
Zoals wij hierboven reeds aangaven kan de Inspectie Jeugdzorg op dit moment geen stappen ondernemen tegen particuliere zorgaanbieders, zoals de stichting Stoploverboys.nu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over winkeliers die straks alcohol mogen gaan schenken

The MP asked whether shops and hospitality businesses may be allowed to sell and serve alcohol in experiments, and how this affects youth protection and enforcement of the minimum age. The State Secretary answered that the Alcohol and Hospitality Act prohibits such mixing of functions, that no experiment provision exists, and that the evaluation of the Act will address enforcement and decentralisation of supervision.
I have not given permission to start a pilot in which the Alcohol and Hospitality Act is violated.
Ik heb geen toestemming gegeven om een pilot te starten waarbij de Drank en Horecawet overtreden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat oud-cliënten van Boriz BV onder druk worden gezet om hun klachten in te trekken

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked about reports that Boriz BV pressured former clients to withdraw complaints, whether housing tied to care is acceptable, what happens to clients' rights, and whether the board structure complies with the WNT pay law. The State Secretary condemned such pressure, pointed to a Menzis investigation, said clients can switch care providers, and asked the CIBG to investigate the missing WNT reporting in Boriz's 2014 accounts.
I have asked the CIBG, as the responsible supervisory body, to carry out further investigation.
Ik heb het CIBG, als verantwoordelijk toezichthouder, verzocht nader onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er opnieuw sprake is van ondermaatse zorg in De Kleine Johannes

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports of substandard care at De Kleine Johannes, questioning whether the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) monitored critically enough, why it did not follow up an Amerpoort investigation, and whether staff intimidation and budget cuts were involved. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ monitored closely, found the quality of care sufficient in 2014 and good in 2015, is following the organisation's improvement plan, and sees no reason for further measures.
The IGZ continues to actively monitor the implementation of the necessary improvement measures, both through risk-based supervision and through its supervision of reports.
De IGZ blijft actief toezien op de realisatie van de noodzakelijke verbetermaatregelen, zowel vanuit het risicogestuurde toezicht als vanuit haar toezicht op meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht dat bewoners in blijf-van-mijn-lijfhuizen tot prostitutie worden aangezet

An MP asked whether residents of women's shelters in Alkmaar and Heemskerk were encouraged into prostitution, whether crimes occurred, and whether other shelters face similar problems. The state secretary replied that Blijf Groep found no indication of prostitution being arranged, no complaint was filed, and no other shelters are known to be affected, while declining to add new measures and promising only a note to parliament.
Blijf Groep states that it had no indication whatsoever of prostitution being arranged or prevented at the mentioned locations.
Blijf Groep geeft aan dat zij overigens geen enkele aanwijzing had voor het laten plegen of voorkómen van prostitutie in de genoemde locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Karabulut over misstanden in de vrouwenopvang

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about reported abuses and poor living conditions in a women's shelter in Heemskerk, including hygiene problems, prostitution, intimidation, financial hardship and weak guidance, and asked for independent inquiry and permanent control. The State Secretary said a GGD emergency inspection found inadequate cleaning, Haarlem did not declare the location unfit, an improvement plan and an independent inquiry by J. Haanstra (results expected November) were launched, and that toezicht and shelter quality are the responsibility of centrumgemeenten, so no separate national investigation was ordered.
Before the results of this investigation are available, expected in November of this year, I refrain from giving a substantive judgment on this matter.
Voordat de resultaten van dit onderzoek beschikbaar zijn, naar verwachting in november van dit jaar, onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijk oordeel over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Leijten over bemiddelingsbureaus in de zorg

An SP MP asked the health ministers about intermediary agencies in care that charge high fees to self-employed care workers, including non-compete clauses and fines. The state secretary answered that fees are a matter for agreements between parties, that he will commission research into agency fees and services in care, and that agencies without added value should be reduced.
I therefore intend to have research carried out into the fees that intermediary agencies charge self-employed workers in care and the services the agencies provide.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de fees die bemiddelingsbureaus voor zzp'ers in de zorg hanteren en de diensten die de bemiddelingsbureaus leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Inval pgb-kantoor in Appingedam’

An MP asked the state secretary about a raid on a personal-budget (pgb) office in Appingedam, whether perpetrators rather than clients should be punished, how client care is guaranteed, whether a professional ban can be imposed, and whether this fraud occurs elsewhere. The state secretary said care offices visited beneficiaries, arranged alternative care, will not pursue good-faith budget holders for repayment, and pointed to criminal and civil routes, existing court powers for a professional ban, and a planned central fraud reporting point.
Pending the central reporting point, I will promote discussions between municipalities and care offices on sharing information about fraud signals.
Vooruitlopend op het centraal meldpunt zal ik bevorderen dat gemeenten en zorgkantoren met elkaar in gesprek gaan over het delen van informatie over fraudesignalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de opnamestop in de thuiszorgtak van Stichting Zorgcentra Rivierenland

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about an intake stop at Stichting Zorgcentra Rivierenland's home-care branch, the adequacy of contracted district nursing, and whether a macro-budget ceiling and possible use of the MBI instrument undermine care provision. The state secretary said he regrets intake stops, put responsibility on insurers under their duty of care, pointed to available extra budget, and promised to share the care-cost monitor once data are stable.
In the letter of 29 June I indicated that I do not have data indicating waiting lists or intake stops.
In de brief van 29 juni jl. heb ik aangegeven niet over gegevens te beschikken die duiden op wachtlijsten of opnamestops.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over extreem magere modellen in de mode-industrie

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about the EenVandaag/Viva poll on banning extremely thin models, whether the fashion industry should avoid them, and the status of promised talks with the fashion sector, and about the effects of bans in Spain, Italy, Israel and France. The State Secretary agreed that such models can have undesirable effects, said talks with the fashion world were ongoing with results to be shared possibly before the 14 October committee meeting, and said foreign effects were still unknown and changes would take a long time.
This is still ongoing and I will inform you of the outcomes as soon as they are known.
Dit loopt nog en ik zal u over de uitkomsten informeren zodra deze bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Agema en Wilders over het artikel 'Ouderen op zwart zaad'

PVV MPs asked the government to respond to an article on elderly people's poor finances, calling the situation a disgrace and accusing the government of undermining elderly care, the state pension and pensions. The minister replied that elderly purchasing power has declined due to pension fund problems and budget measures, that low incomes were protected, that long-term care was reformed, and that purchasing power will be reviewed annually with measures in the budget if needed.
Each year the integrated purchasing power picture, including that of the elderly, is weighed for the coming year and the cabinet takes measures where necessary, within the available budgetary room.
Jaarlijks wordt het integrale koopkrachtbeeld, waaronder die van ouderen, voor het komende jaar gewogen en treft het kabinet zo nodig, binnen de beschikbare budgettaire ruimte, maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat er een opnamestop is voor dagbesteding en jeugd-ggz

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about reports of an admission stop for day care and youth mental health care, including at farm-based care providers in Leeuwarden. The secretary answered that no admission stop applies to Leeuwarden's municipalities, that a single provider (Bezinn) imposed one unilaterally, that municipalities are responsible for securing youth care and handling waiting lists, and that the wait-list figures are not separately monitored.
Waiting-time information is not a separate part of the national monitoring of youth care use.
Wachttijdinformatie maakt niet apart deel uit van de landelijke monitoring van het jeugdhulpgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid van de Oranjezaal voor slechtzienden en slechthorenden

An MP asked why the Oranjezaal visit lacks special provisions for visually and hearing-impaired visitors, why sign-language interpreters need their own ticket and guide dogs were initially barred, how comparable museums handle this, and whether separate tours could be organised. The minister replied that companions get free tickets, professional guides and written materials are provided, guide dogs are now allowed, and that the government will lead by example under the UN disability convention.
Following these parliamentary questions, guide dogs are permitted despite the vulnerability of the room and limited physical space.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen zijn, ondanks de kwetsbaarheid van de zaal in combinatie met de beperkte fysieke ruimte, hulphonden toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over dehumanisering in zorginstellingen

MP Leijten asks the State Secretary about the use of camera surveillance and remote monitoring centres replacing care staff in nursing homes, and whether this dehumanises residents, plus questions on financial trade-offs, staffing and sticker-based care practices. The State Secretary replies that technology such as camera supervision can improve care and autonomy if introduced in consultation with residents and staff, that no national overview of experiments exists, that costs depend on local circumstances, and that the choice belongs to individual organisations and their supervisory boards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Potters over de opvang van geradicaliseerde meisjes en jongens in jeugdzorginstellingen

Two VVD MPs asked how many minors have been intercepted or returned from Syria or Iraq, where radicalised youths are housed, and whether separate deradicalisation facilities exist. The government answered that about 35 Dutch jihadists have returned, that radicalised youths can be placed in regular youth care without separate facilities, and that a new exit facility with tailored trajectories will open in September 2015, with more detail promised in the next progress report.
On individual cases or further breakdown, the cabinet makes no statements.
Over individuele gevallen of verdere uitsplitsing doet het kabinet geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat jeugdzorg niet toegerust is op Syriëgangers

Two D66 MPs asked whether youth care institutions are equipped to treat young people who attempted to travel to Syria, including the role of closed youth care, parents, foster care and monitoring. The State Secretary answered that treatment is still being developed case by case, that closed placement may be needed to prevent departure, that an Exit facility and a family support point are being set up, and that no known radicalised minors travelled to the Middle East after closed placement.
In the first place it is up to municipalities together with youth care institutions to give content to this.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan gemeenten samen met de jeugdhulpinstellingen hier inhoud aan te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het verzoek aan gemeenten om de pgb-herindicaties (persoonsgebonden budgetten) voor 1 oktober a.s. af te ronden, en aan te leveren bij de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked why municipalities were asked to deliver revised PGB re-assessment decisions to the SVB by 1 October 2015, whether this deadline was brought forward and whether it risks careless or erroneous re-assessments. The State Secretary answers that no deadline was advanced, that the request aimed at planning for the budget holder and SVB steps, that municipalities can extend budgets to 1 May 2016 if they need more time, and that the chain director will actively monitor progress.
There is no question of deadlines being brought forward.
Er is geen sprake van het vervroegen van deadlines.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat daklozen overleven in bossen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government views reports that homeless people, after losing housing due to debt or benefit cuts, are living in forests outside regular shelter, and what the scale of the problem is. The State Secretary said the problem is recognised in some cities, that municipalities are responsible for prevention and tailored support, and that the Trimbos Institute has been asked to study the scale, while stating that homelessness should not be accepted.
Nationwide data on underlying problems when people register for a shelter are not available because this is not (always) recorded.
Landelijke gegevens over achterliggende problematiek bij aanmelding voor een opvangvoorziening zijn niet beschikbaar omdat dit niet (altijd) wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten de eigen bijdrage als melkkoe gebruiken

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that municipalities have raised co-payments for social care so sharply that people are giving up support, and whether charges above municipal cost prices are unlawful. The State Secretary says the loss of the 33% discount and the absence of national tariffs explain the rises, admits charges above cost price breach the Wmo 2015, and promises to alert municipalities, VNG and CAK, but declines to publish per-municipality co-payment data or to annul municipal ordinances.
This is not in line with the law and the municipalities concerned must adjust this.
Dit is niet in overeenstemming met de wet en de gemeenten die het hier betreft, dienen dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gebruiken eigen bijdrage als melkkoe’

An MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities charge co-payments under the Wmo that exceed their costs to providers, and whether they should be curbed. The state secretary said such charges above actual costs are not permitted under Wmo 2015, that the government does not know how widespread the practice is, and that he will alert municipalities and the VNG but sees no direct role in raising co-payments within legal limits.
I will actively point out to municipalities, the VNG and the CAK that no cost prices may be passed on that exceed the actual costs.
Ik zal gemeenten, de VNG en het CAK er actief op wijzen dat geen kostprijzen mogen worden doorgegeven die hoger liggen dan de feitelijke kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat Amsterdam geen specifieke opvang heeft voor dementerende, dwalende ouderen terwijl deze wel vaker worden aangetroffen

MP Bergkamp asked the State Secretary about reports that Amsterdam lacks specific emergency care for disoriented elderly people with dementia, whether emergency places in nursing homes are sufficient, how often such people end up in police cells, and whether a national database of available places should be created. The State Secretary acknowledged the signal as serious, noted there is no national data on emergency place availability, pointed to regional improvement efforts by SIGRA, and declined a national database in favour of regional routing arrangements.
As far as I am aware, there is no national data on the availability of emergency places and on occupancy rates.
Voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen landelijke gegevens over de beschikbaarheid van spoedplekken en over de bezettingsgraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Bewoners aanleunwoning flink gedupeerd door sluiting verzorgingshuizen”

An MP from 50PLUS asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government views reports that residents of care-home annexes lose services after nursing homes close, and whether the state should ensure enough facilities for elderly people living independently. The state secretary responds that responsibility for support now lies with municipalities, housing corporations and care providers under the Wmo 2015, that the government is promoting independent living through an advisory team, and that municipal councils or local supervisors can address shortcomings.

If municipalities do not carry out this task sufficiently, it is first of all up to the local municipal council to discuss this with the relevant municipal executive, or up to the local supervisor to establish it.

Als gemeenten deze taak onvoldoende uitvoeren, is het in eerste instantie aan de lokale gemeenteraad om hierover met het betreffende college van B&W in gesprek te treden of aan de lokale toezichthouder om dit te constateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het kunnen meenemen van pgb naar het buitenland

An SP MP asks the state secretary about unclear rules on how long a pgb (personal budget) can be used abroad, and about a health insurer that reportedly stopped a budget holder's pgb after a stay abroad and reinstated it only if the objection was withdrawn. The secretary explains the 13-week limit, says the budget holder could appeal on grounds of misled trust, denies any coercion by the insurer, and declines to comment on the pending court case because the insurer has appealed.
As long as the case is before the court, I cannot go into substance on this question.
Zolang de zaak onder de rechter is kan ik niet inhoudelijk op deze vraag ingaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport van het Trimbos-instituut waaruit zou blijken dat kinderen door voorlichting op het gebied van alcohol en drugs juist nieuwsgieriger naar alcohol en drugs worden

The MP asks the State Secretary to explain a Trimbos-institute finding that drug and alcohol education makes children more curious about substances, and how the government squares this with its own earlier letter. The State Secretary cites a 2011/2012 Radboud University evaluation showing some unfavourable attitude effects of primary-school prevention, and says primary-school education is now given only on request, with a shift toward parents and secondary-school prevention.
This emerges from the study the Radboud University conducted in school year 2011/2012 on De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen (DGSG) in primary education.
Dit blijkt uit het onderzoek dat de Radboud Universiteit in schooljaar 2011/2012 uitvoerde naar De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen (DGSG) in het basisonderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de snelste Hiv-aanpak ooit

An MP asked the state secretary about a new rapid HIV-detection approach, its extension beyond Amsterdam, access for people outside Amsterdam, and costs. The secretary replied that it is a pilot (H-team in Amsterdam, possibly Rotterdam), that current guidelines remain in force, and that results must be awaited before any expansion or cost decisions.
For now, this is a pilot project.
Vooralsnog gaat het hier om een pilot project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karalabut over het bericht dat ouderen afzien van zorg vanwege geldgebrek

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the ministers of health and social affairs about reports that elderly people forgo care due to money problems, including questions on rising out-of-pocket costs, dental care, municipal co-payments, and income losses for pensioners. The minister answered that no evidence shows growing numbers forgoing Wmo or Wlz care because of co-payments, that a study on care avoidance will be sent to parliament before the budget debate, and that income measures will be weighed in the August decision-making.
Research into the nature and extent of care avoidance is currently being carried out.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzoek verricht naar de aard en omvang van zorgmijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het objectieve verdeelmodel voor de decentralisatie uitkering Maatschappelijk Opvang

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether the objective allocation model for the maatschappelijke opvang grant should be revised and the redistribution postponed, as requested by the Federatie Opvang. The State Secretary answered that, based on the Raad voor de Financiële Verhoudingen advice, he sees no reason for a new revision now, while offering a broader discussion with the VNG.

In view of the advice of the Raad voor de Financiële Verhoudingen on AWBZ funds for women's shelters and maatschappelijke opvang of December 2014, I currently see no reason for a new recalibration or redistribution.

Gelet op het advies van de Raad voor de Financiële Verhoudingen (Rfv) betreffende de AWBZ middelen voor vrouwenopvang en maatschappelijke opvang van december 2014 zie ik nu geen aanleiding tot een nieuwe herijking of herverdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over knelpunten rond het persoonlijk assistentiebudget in de (Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz)

An MP asks how the Wlz personal assistance budget accounts for partners living together, overlapping care, assistant training and whether the budget may be used by clients without independent housing. The Secretary of State says partner-cohabiting budgets are set lower on purpose, individual case-by-case flexibility is being explored with care offices, and the scheme will be evaluated after two years.
After I receive the response of the care offices on this point, I will consider on that basis whether the necessary tailoring can indeed be provided.
Nadat ik de reactie van de zorgkantoren op dit punt heb ontvangen, zal ik mede op basis daarvan bezien of het benodigde maatwerk inderdaad geleverd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over het project ‘Samen Oud’ in Groningen en Drenthe

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked the State Secretary about the 'Samen Oud' project in Groningen and Drenthe, which faces discontinuation by insurer Achmea, and about whether insurers use the experiment article and Van Dijk's amendment to require municipal-insurer cooperation. The State Secretary said the project is not being stopped, that the communication problem with Achmea is resolved, and that insurers may take different approaches, with ongoing trajectories on innovation; the final question was not answered.
As stated in my answer to question 4, there is no question of stopping the 'Samen Oud' project.
Zoals gezegd in mijn antwoord op vraag 4, is er geen sprake van het stopzetten van het project «Samen Oud».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de verslechterde sfeer in de zorginstelling ‘s Heeren Loo in Noordwijk

An MP asked the state secretary whether mixing severely disabled residents with mildly disabled residents with behavioural problems at ’s Heeren Loo Noordwijk harmed the original residents, and whether patient rights are adequately guaranteed under the Wlz. The state secretary acknowledged the mixing caused problems, said the composition has changed and the situation stabilised, placed composition responsibility with the provider, and pointed to existing quality rules and a pending Wkkgz bill.
It is the care provider's own responsibility to compose the client population on a residence, and equip staff, so that residents can feel safe and live pleasantly there.

Het is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een zorgaanbieder de cliëntenpopulatie op een woning zodanig samen te stellen, en het personeel zodanig toe te rusten, dat de bewoners zich daar veilig kunnen voelen en prettig kunnen wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgbehoevende kinderen van het kastje naar de muur gestuurd worden

SP MPs asked the state secretary about reports that disabled children were being shunted from the CIZ to municipalities and denied Wlz care and day treatment. The secretary answered that five of eight Wlz applications were rejected on the access criteria, one was transferred to a municipality under the Jeugdwet, two remain under review, and he will work with VNG and the CIZ on clearer boundaries.
Only the CIZ is authorised to assess access to the Wlz, which guarantees an objective, expert and uniform indication process.
Uitsluitend het CIZ is bevoegd om de toegang tot de Wlz te beoordelen, waardoor een objectieve, deskundige en uniforme indicatiestelling is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over seksueel misbruik bij boeddhisten in Nederland

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Bergkamp asked the ministers about alleged sexual abuse by Buddhist monks and teachers in the Netherlands, including prevention, reporting, victim support and prosecution limits. The government said it cannot establish misconduct from police and prosecutor information but cannot rule it out, pointed to free certificates of conduct for volunteers, a 'safe church' toolkit, awareness campaigns and victim support services, and noted that statutes of limitation no longer apply to serious sexual offences against children.
Based on information from the Public Prosecution Service and the police, I cannot establish whether Buddhist monks and/or teachers have committed sexual abuse.
Op basis van de informatie van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de politie kan ik niet vaststellen of boeddhistische monniken en/of leraren zich schuldig hebben gemaakt aan seksueel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de ellende in de Wmo

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about municipal failures in applying the Wmo 2015 home-care rules, including Delfzijl, Tiel, the objection-committee advice being ignored, and provider changes in Bergen, Uitgeest, Castricum and Heiloo. The State Secretary said municipal councils are primarily responsible, that courts' rulings are being followed, that he monitors municipalities and will intervene only in structural non-compliance, and saw no reason for a nationwide study.

Only when facts show a municipality deviates from the law more than incidentally and the municipal council fails to take its responsibility, do I have the option, under conditions, to use the powers under Article 2.6.8 of the Wmo 2015 and the Revitalisation of Generic Supervision Act.

Pas als uit de feiten blijkt dat een gemeente meer dan incidenteel afwijkt van de wet en de gemeenteraad haar verantwoordelijkheid daarin niet neemt, heb ik onder voorwaarden de mogelijkheid om van de bevoegdheden in het kader van artikel 2.6.8 van de Wmo 2015 en de Wet revitalisering generiek toezicht gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over onmenselijk beleid door de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015(Wmo 2015)

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about municipalities cutting or refusing home help under the Wmo 2015, including a terminally ill man in Waalwijk, and asked whether the government would intervene and why rulings keep being needed. The state secretary answered that municipal councils are primarily responsible for overseeing municipal implementation, that the government will only intervene in cases of systematic non-compliance, that individual assessments are required, and that he has already written to aldermen and will keep monitoring.

Only when facts show a municipality deviates from the law more than incidentally and the municipal council fails to take its responsibility, do I have the option, under conditions, to use the powers under Article 2.6.8 of the Wmo 2015 and the generic supervision revitalisation act.

Pas als uit de feiten blijkt dat een gemeente meer dan incidenteel afwijkt van de wet en de gemeenteraad haar verantwoordelijkheid daarin niet neemt, heb ik onder voorwaarden de mogelijkheid om van de bevoegdheden in het kader van artikel 2.6.8 van de Wmo 2015 en de Wet revitalisering generiek toezicht gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de problemen met de Wmo in Berkelland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about Berkelland municipality cutting home help for a 96-year-old man, the large number of objections filed, and who pays for handling them. The state secretary replied that municipalities must provide tailored support under the Wmo 2015, that Berkelland is contacting affected residents and reviewing cases, and that handling objections is a municipal cost, not a national review matter.
Berkelland municipality held a conversation with all residents who previously received level 1 home help in the first half of 2015.
De gemeente Berkelland heeft met alle inwoners die in het verleden de voorziening huishoudelijke hulp niveau 1 kregen in de eerste helft van 2015 een gesprek gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de politieke controle op grote hervormingen in de zorg faalt

Leijten (SP) asks how the government views reports that municipal councillors are too poorly informed to control the three major decentralisations in care, and what will be done about it. Minister Plasterk replies that colleges of mayor and aldermen are responsible for informing councils, points to the Wgr and guidance for councillors, and says the Rob advice on democratic legitimacy is pending, with more measures possibly to follow.
It is the responsibility of each college of mayor and aldermen to inform its own municipal council in such a way that it can properly carry out its control task.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van ieder college van burgemeesters en wethouders om de eigen gemeenteraad zodanig te informeren dat zij hun controletaak goed kunnen uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘dat het budget voor 2015 bij een deel van de instellingen jeugdzorg al op is’

An MP asked whether youth care budgets for 2015 were exhausted at some providers, leaving children unable to be treated, and whether continuity of care is guaranteed. The state secretary answered that some municipalities have reached agreed budget ceilings, that continuity is safeguarded under transitional law, and that no national monitoring tracks children whose treatment cannot be completed, while committing to a joint work agenda on administrative burden.
The national monitoring of youth care use does not track how many young people who started a treatment in 2014 cannot complete it in 2015.
In de landelijke monitoring van het jeugdhulpgebruik wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel jeugdigen hun behandeltraject dat in 2014 is gestart, in 2015 niet kunnen afmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over dat gehandicapten en mensen met een uitkering ingezet worden voor thuiszorg

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked whether the municipality of Kaag en Braassem replacing thuiszorg staff with disabled people and benefit recipients, and whether this displaces regular work and breaches Participatiewet rules. The state secretary answered that the programme pairs experienced home helps with trainees for activation purposes, denies that dismissals or displacement occur, and sees no reason for further inquiry or intervention.
From the available information it can be concluded that there is no question of job displacement.
Uit de beschikbare informatie kan worden geconcludeerd dat er geen sprake is van werkverdringing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Fikse rekening voor lopen naar station’

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that a severely epileptic user of the Valys transport service was billed for not ordering a taxi to the station, and whether such cases are common. The state secretary answered that the report was based on a misunderstanding: the client used a Valys rail pass for regular public transport without Valys taxi links, was billed only for the trips actually made, and that no further action is needed.
These examples are not known to the executor of Valys.
Deze voorbeelden zijn niet bekend bij de uitvoerder van Valys.
Antwoord op vragen van het llid Agema over het bericht: 'Achmea: rust of slaapt u tijdens de sterffase, dan geen professionals aan uw bed'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether insurer Achmea's policy of not paying for professional presence at the bedside of dying patients who are resting or sleeping was acceptable, and called for it to be reversed. The State Secretary replied that Zilveren Kruis (an Achmea insurer) has no hour cap on terminal care, that the professional decides what care is needed, and that the current domain-based arrangement for terminal care is appropriate, so no reversal is needed.
Enquiries with Zilveren Kruis show there is no tightening of the policy.
Navraag bij Zilveren Kruis leert dat er geen sprake is van aanscherping van het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het niet volledig vergoeden van palliatieve zorg

SP MPs asked whether insurer Achmea/Zilveren Kruis may refuse to reimburse professional presence during rest or sleep in the dying phase and whether guidance and aftercare for relatives falls under home-nursing coverage. The State Secretary says the insurer has clarified that all palliative terminal care, including rest-time presence and aftercare for relatives, is covered and declarable, and that the insurer has a duty of care without a cap on hours.
Enquiries with Zilveren Kruis show that the above statement is a misinterpretation of the home-nursing purchasing policy.
Navraag bij Zilveren Kruis leert dat bovengenoemde uitspraak een verkeerde interpretatie van het inkoopbeleid wijkverpleging is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Tabakslobby toch weer bij Van Rijn aan tafel’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary about a reported June 2015 meeting with tobacco retailers shortly before a debate on tobacco policy, including whether minutes were kept, the scope of contacts with the tobacco lobby, and whether such contacts should be minimised and recorded. The State Secretary answered that a meeting on 17 June 2015 with alcohol and tobacco sellers addressed youth age-check compliance and that no minutes were made, but the outcome was reported to Parliament; he stated that the ministry had no official meetings with the tobacco industry in the past year and that contacts are kept restrained and transparent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat één derde van de medewerkers in de gehandicaptenzorg zich onveilig voelt

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a third of disability-care staff feel unsafe, rising violence reports, pressure to stay silent, understaffing, and training and support after incidents. The State Secretary answered that the government disapproves of silence, supports the Veilig Werken in de Zorg action plan, places primary responsibility for staffing and safety on managers and social partners, and will inform parliament on lessons learned.
I will shortly inform your House about the lessons learned in addressing the causes of aggression in care across 27 institutions participating in the programme.
Ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort informeren over de geleerde lessen met de aanpak van veroorzakers van agressie in de zorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht van de VNG over de herbeoordeling van overgangscliënten AWBZ/Wmo

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the VNG's warning that re-assessing AWBZ transition clients under the Wmo is a major task, likely to take longer than planned, reflects real problems and what the consequences are for clients and funding. The State Secretary answered that the VNG could not substantiate the warning with a national overview, that no requests for postponement were received, and that a timetable for pgb cases and a step-by-step plan for trekkingsrechten will be discussed on 3 September, with the Chamber to be informed.
I will inform the Chamber of the results of this consultation.
Ik zal de Kamer op de hoogte brengen van de resultaten van dit overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Regio Gooi en Vechtstreek de huishoudelijke hulp toelage verkeerd inzet

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether the Gooi en Vechtstreek region may keep home-help grant money outside home care so that the work falls under the cleaning sector cao, and whether this breaches the conditions for the grant. The state secretary answered that the regional plan is still being worked out with stakeholders, that the ministry approved the application, that cao compliance is primarily a matter for social partners, and that it sees no reason to think municipalities are not respecting the grant conditions.
Compliance with and enforcement of collective labour agreements is a civil-law matter and the primary responsibility of the social partners.
Naleving en handhaving van cao’s is een civielrechtelijke aangelegenheid en de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Otwin van Dijk over de zware belasting van de mantelzorger

MPs Keijzer and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about the heavy burden on informal carers caused by overlapping laws and bureaucracy, citing a case broadcast on De Wachtkamer. The State Secretary said the 'one family, one plan' principle is built into the new system, that signals are discussed with stakeholders and obstacles will be removed where needed, and pointed to a pilot for an integrated PGB and the experiment clause in the Wlz.
When obstacles in laws and regulations are experienced, I am willing to look at them and remove them where necessary.
Wanneer er belemmeringen in wet- en regelgeving worden ervaren, ben ik bereid daarnaar te kijken en deze waar nodig weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vrijwilligersnetwerken die zingevingsvragen van ouderen oppakken

An MP asked the state secretary about volunteer networks offering meaning-of-life support to older people, the link between loneliness and a 'completed life', and the cost-saving findings of a Verwey-Jonker study. The state secretary said the government values such initiatives, is funding loneliness programmes and extra support for volunteers, and will bring the study to the attention of partners.
As part of implementing the loneliness programme, I will again bring the report to the attention of Coalitie Erbij and the VNG.
In het kader van de uitvoering van het programma aanpak eenzaamheid zal ik het rapport bij Coalitie Erbij en de VNG nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Tanamal over het bericht dat mantelzorgers steeds moeilijker op vakantie kunnen

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that carers find it harder to arrange respite cover for holidays, including Mezzo's reported doubling of calls, stricter municipal and insurer requirements, and fewer respite places. The State Secretary acknowledged the signals, said municipalities have policy discretion, noted the Wlz respite entitlement of 104 days and the removal of the WTZi requirement, and promised follow-up with Mezzo and the VNG without committing to new rules.
I have agreed with Mezzo that they will inform me of concrete cases so that I can consider whether concrete action is needed.
Ik heb met Mezzo afgesproken dat zij mij op de hoogte brengen van concrete casussen, zodat ik kan bezien of daar concrete actie nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat slachtoffers van geweld te lang moeten wachten op hulp in Gelderland

MPs Kooiman asked the State Secretaries about reports that victims of domestic violence in Gelderland face long waits before Veilig Thuis reports are handled, and about the rise in reports nationwide. The government answers that Gelderland Zuid has added temporary staff and that municipalities are responsible for addressing delays, with no extra budget planned and a review of the situation expected by end of year.
It is undesirable that victims of domestic violence have to wait too long before the Veilig Thuis organisation takes up the report.
Het is onwenselijk dat slachtoffers van geweld in huiselijke kring te lang moeten wachten voordat de Veilig Thuis-organisatie (VT-organisatie) de melding in behandeling neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de artikelen “ANBO: Het gaat mis met de thuiszorg”, en “Thuiszorg wordt zorgenkind”

Krol (50PLUS) asks the state secretary about reports that many municipalities cut or abolish domestic help under the Wmo 2015 without the required individual investigation, and about the VNG's view that kitchen-table interviews are not feasible everywhere. The state secretary replies that individual assessment is legally required, that citizens can object and appeal, that municipal councils must supervise their executive, and that he sees no reason yet to use his supervisory powers.
Reducing or ending (an existing, ongoing) domestic help provision is only possible when it has been preceded by a carefully prepared individual assessment.

Het versoberen of beëindigen van (een bestaande, doorlopende voorziening van) huishoudelijke hulp is slechts mogelijk wanneer dat vooraf is gegaan door een zorgvuldig voorbereide individuele afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over PGB’s onder de Zorgverzekeringswet

MP Otwin van Dijk asked whether insurer Univé Zorgzaam deducted 10% administrative costs from personal budgets (PGB), whether maximum tariffs apply, and what happens to unspent PGB money. The Secretary of State answered that the 10% cut was a choice to meet a budget reduction for personal care, not an administrative fee, that insurers set tariffs within NZa maximums and inform policyholders, and that unspent budgets stay with insurers.
It is the responsibility of health insurers to determine the level of tariffs for reimbursing non-contracted care.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgverzekeraars om de hoogte van de tarieven voor de vergoeding van niet-gecontracteerde zorg te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over de mogelijkheid van het tijdelijk opschorten van het Persoonsgebonden Budget (PGB) tijdens revalidatie

MP Otwin van Dijk asked whether a PGB under the Wlz is stopped during temporary rehabilitation in a clinic, causing extra administrative burden, and whether it could be suspended instead of ended. The State Secretary replied that Article 5.20 Rlz ends a PGB after two months of institutional stay, but Article 5.7 allows a PGB to be re-granted without full reapplication, and he will clarify this with care offices.
To prevent unnecessary administrative burden, the second paragraph of Article 5.7 suspends all conditions that normally apply to a PGB application.
Om onnodige administratieve lasten te voorkomen stelt het tweede lid van artikel 5.7 vervolgens alle voorwaarden die normaal van toepassing zijn op een pgb-aanvraag buiten werking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel 'Senioren: het systeem zélf mishandelt ons!'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how to assess a study finding that elderly people feel hurt by society's institutions and seen as a burden, and about related issues such as bureaucracy, lack of information and the definition of elder abuse. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the SCP report on elder abuse, referred to ongoing information efforts and the Action Plan, and committed to follow-up research and to involving older people more actively in policy.

Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport van het Trimbos Instituut waaruit zou blijken dat kinderen door voorlichting op het gebied van alcohol en drugs juist nieuwsgieriger naar alcohol en drugs word

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether a Trimbos Institute report showed that alcohol and drug education makes children more curious about using them, and whether the Haarlemmermeer municipality's decision to stop primary-school education on these topics was positive. The State Secretary answered that Trimbos advises against such education in primary schools because it may make pupils more positive toward substances or more curious, cites prior studies showing no effect of primary-school education, and says secondary-school education remains important and drug education needs tailoring.
I informed you about the adjustments to De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen in spring 2013.
Over de aanpassingen binnen De Gezonde school en Genotmiddelen heb ik u in het voorjaar van 2013 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de uitvoering van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (WMO) door gemeenten

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about municipalities cutting domestic care under the Wmo 2015, including a case where a council ignored its objections committee, and about whether residents get personal plans and fixed-hours or fixed-rate care. The State Secretary replies that the law is clear, that municipalities are responsible for implementation and councils must supervise them, that no national overview exists, and that he sees no need for further measures.

The municipal executive is responsible for proper implementation of the law and the frameworks set by the municipal council; the council is primarily responsible for assessing that implementation and correcting it where needed.

Het gemeentebestuur heeft de verantwoordelijkheid voor een goede uitvoering van de wet en de door de gemeenteraad vastgestelde kaders, het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om het bestuur op die uitvoering te beoordelen en waar nodig bij te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol naar aanleiding van de vele berichten van uitstel beantwoording schriftelijke vragen

An MP asked why the health ministry postponed answers to 35 written parliamentary questions in July 2015 and whether it would try to answer faster. The minister confirmed the delays, linked them to holiday schedules, said answers would come before the new parliamentary year, and promised faster answers only for urgent questions.
This is related to the holidays of the ministers and the holiday staffing at the department.
Dit hangt samen met de vakantie van de bewindslieden en de vakantiebezetting op het departement.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de gevolgen van de onlangs ingevoerde aanpassing van de Opiumwet (nieuw art. 11a) voor Nederlandse ondernemers in de hennepzaadindustrie en in d

MPs from D66 asked whether the new article 11a of the Opiumwet could criminalise sales of hemp seed, whether that conflicts with legality, the economic size of the hemp seed industry, and whether seized seeds would be grown by police. The minister answered that hemp seed is excluded from the Opiumwet prohibitions but that sales can fall under article 11a when intended for illegal cultivation, that legal fibre hemp cultivation remains permitted under Green Deals, and that the claim of police growing cannabis is untrue, with seeds only undergoing DNA testing.
Yes, I know this report, but it does not match the facts.
Ja, ik ken dit bericht, maar het stemt niet overeen met de feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Keijzer over het bericht dat het kabinet lak heeft aan het medisch beroepsgeheim in de jeugdzorg

MPs Bergkamp and Keijzer asked whether the 25 June 2015 agreement on a temporary ministerial regulation for youth care billing, which lets invoices carry personal and diagnostic data, respects medical confidentiality and was a proper procedural route given a pending bill. The state secretary replied that the temporary regulation, approved by the Dutch Data Protection Authority under conditions, rests on the Youth Act and will be replaced by the Veegwet, and that the regulation will take effect as soon as possible.
The Cbp has indicated it can agree to this temporary ministerial regulation under conditions, and we will honour these conditions.
Het Cbp heeft onder voorwaarden aangegeven te kunnen instemmen met deze tijdelijke ministeriële regeling en deze voorwaarden zullen door ons worden gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het kabinet lak heeft aan het medisch beroepsgeheim in de jeugdzorg

Member Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary whether the cabinet plans to require youth care providers to put patients' medical data on invoices to municipalities, arguing this bypasses Parliament, lacks a statutory basis and undermines medical confidentiality despite a Data Protection Authority warning. The State Secretary replied that a temporary ministerial regulation under Article 7.3.11(5) of the Youth Act is needed for payment continuity, that the Data Protection Authority has conditionally agreed, and that municipalities need limited data to lawfully spend public funds.
Immediate entry into force of the temporary regulation is necessary to prevent youth care providers from falling into payment inability.
Directe inwerkingtreding van de tijdelijke regeling is noodzakelijk, om te voorkomen dat jeugdhulpaanbieders in betalingsonmacht komen te verkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Pia Dijkstra over de hoge bedragen pgb-geld die verhaald worden op kwetsbare cliënten omdat hun zorgverleners hun zaken niet op orde hadden

MPs Leijten and Dijkstra asked why clients of the care provider Fundament, dragers in zorg must repay large PGB sums misspent by their providers, whether repayment can be dropped, whether a criminal complaint was filed, and about inspection and conflict-of-interest rules for court-appointed administrators. The Secretary of State says repayment claims are suspended, a joint framework with insurers is being drafted, legal conflict rules apply to administrators, and a law change will be discussed with the NZa in autumn.
The repayment claims in this case have been suspended.
De terugvorderingen in onderhavige casus zijn opgeschort.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de 10-jarige Sem niet bij de gemeente Stadskanaal en niet bij het Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg (CIZ) in aanmerking komt voor een indicatie voor zorg en onders

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked why 10-year-old Sem, who has epilepsy and autism, could not obtain care indication from either his municipality or the CIZ, and how many people fall into such gaps. The State Secretary admits the municipality should have taken over responsibility earlier, says it will now do so retroactively, and promises information sessions, but refuses to confirm any general figures or a systemic link between the Wmo and Wlz and offers only partial data.
It took too long before it became clear that the municipality is responsible under the Youth Act for Sem's care.
Het heeft te lang geduurd voordat duidelijk is geworden dat de gemeente op grond van de Jeugdwet verantwoordelijk is voor de zorg voor Sem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘dat de drie BAR-gemeenten af willen van verzekeraar CZ’

MPs Leijten asked whether the government would act on reports that three municipalities want to drop insurer CZ as partner for long-term care and whether gemeenten can choose another insurer. The State Secretary answered that the reported wish is not recognised from recent talks, that a regional secretary programme and ongoing talks are in place, and that the preferred insurer is designated by market share, so municipalities cannot choose; the prestatie wijkgericht werken is kept in 2016 to encourage agreements.
In that sense municipalities have no option to choose a particular health insurer; they will have to cooperate with it.
Gemeenten hebben in die zin geen mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een bepaalde zorgverzekeraar, zij zullen daarmee moeten samenwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Albert de Vries over een afgewezen zorgindicatie en de bezwaarprocedure bij het Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg (CIZ)

MPs Van Dijk and De Vries asked about a rejected care indication for an MS patient in Walcheren, the patient's forced double move, the CIZ's failure to involve family, and the 21-week objection period. The State Secretary said the objection was reconsidered and access granted, that moving patients back and forth is undesirable, that the 21-week period is statutory with a 10.5-week actual duration here, and committed to asking the CIZ to review objection processing times.
I will ask the CIZ to examine the processing time of objection procedures further and to inform you about this in a next progress report HLZ.
Ik zal het CIZ vragen de doorlooptijd van bezwaarprocedures nader te bezien en u ter gelegenheid van een volgende voortgangsrapportage HLZ daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat een derde van de jongeren zich nog onvoldoende veilig voelt in jeugdzorginstellingen

MPs Rebel and Ypma asked the state secretary about a report finding that a third of young people in youth care institutions feel insufficiently safe, and about sexual misconduct, online bullying and the role of youth participation. The secretary answered that most youths feel safe, that institutions can act on the report's tips, that sexuality is not yet routinely discussed and reported misconduct is rising, and that further steps will be taken through existing channels.
I do not infer from the report of the Youth Taskforce that sexuality is hardly or never discussed within youth care institutions, but that being able to discuss sexuality is not yet commonplace.

Ik leid uit het rapport van de Jongerentaskforce niet af, dat binnen jeugdzorginstellingen niet of nauwelijks over seksualiteit wordt gepraat, maar wel dat het bespreekbaar zijn van seksualiteit nog geen gemeengoed is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Duitsers willen ons luxe dementiehuis’

The SP MP Leijten asked the state secretary for health whether a luxury German-run dementia home (Martha Flora), charging residents an extra EUR 3,750 per month on top of public funding, is acceptable and whether it creates a two-tier system of dementia care. The state secretary answered that quality dementia care must be accessible regardless of wealth and that the extra fee is not affordable for many, but largely referred back to earlier answers and gave no concrete new action.
Regardless of how many people want or can pay extra for extras, my starting point remains that high-quality dementia care must be accessible to everyone, regardless of the size of their wallet.

Ongeacht de vraag hoeveel mensen extra willen of kunnen betalen voor extra’s is en blijft voor mij het uitgangspunt dat kwalitatief goede dementiezorg voor een ieder toegankelijk moet zijn, ongeacht de grootte van de portemonnee.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Leijten over het bericht dat veel gemeenten geen woningaanpassingen verstrekken

An SP MP asked the state secretary about municipalities refusing or limiting home adaptations under the Wmo 2015, including the Alphen aan den Rijn stairlift case and the advice to move house. The state secretary said the Alphen regulation conflicted with the Wmo, the municipality committed to amend it, and that he has no national overview and will intervene only if a municipality persists.
If I receive signals that a municipality's policy on home adaptations does not comply with the principles of the law, I will also ask the municipality for an explanation.
Mochten mij signalen bereiken dat het beleid van een gemeente ten aanzien van woningaanpassingen zich niet verhoudt met de uitgangspunten van de wet, dan zal ook ik de gemeente om uitleg vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Betalingsachterstand zet zorgaanbieders klem'

The MP asks about reports that municipalities are late paying care providers, threatening their liquidity and continuity of care, and whether municipalities are shutting out providers as too expensive. The State Secretary answers that municipalities and providers must resolve payment issues locally, points to a joint information agenda and digital infrastructure, and denies recognizing providers being kept out for cost reasons.
I will monitor progress on the actions named therein.
Ik zal toezien op de voortgang van de daarin benoemde acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het gebruik van de SDQ vragenlijst door de GGD

An MP asks the state secretary whether the SDQ questionnaire given by municipal health services (GGD) to parents of five-year-olds is reliable, whether it risks medicalising children, and how results, rights and data retention are handled. The state secretary answers that the SDQ is a validated aid that only informs conversation with parents, that parents may decline and have access to their data, that outcome counts are not nationally available, and that records are kept for 15 years.
No, this information is not available nationally.
Nee, deze informatie is niet landelijk beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het weigeren van een blindengeleidehond door de Hema

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Hema store in Amsterdam refused entry to a person with a guide dog, whether guide dogs must always be admitted, and what law and awareness efforts apply. The secretary confirmed the refusal, said Hema apologised and that its house rules allow guide dogs, and said extending the equal-treatment law to goods and services will make refusal largely unlawful.
As part of the bill implementing the UN convention, the field of goods and services will be brought within the scope of the Equal Treatment Act on Grounds of Disability or Chronic Illness.
In het kader van het wetsvoorstel tot uitvoering van het VN-verdrag wordt het terrein van goederen en diensten onder de reikwijdte van de Wgbh/cz gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Dik-Faber over maatwerkprofielen en herindicering in de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz) voor ernstig meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Dik-Faber asked about CIZ requests for extensive, short-deadline information from families of severely multiple-disabled children being reassessed for the Wlz, and about timing of tailored care profiles and the extra-care scheme. The state secretary said CIZ will ask only targeted questions, plans to extend the transitional period by one year and consider a four-week deadline, but gave no firm date for tailored profiles and did not answer the last question in time.
I am consulting with the CIZ and the parties involved about this. A period of four weeks seems reasonable.
Ik ben hierover in overleg met het CIZ en betrokken partijen. Een periode van vier weken lijkt redelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorg een strop dreigt te worden voor Friese gemeenten

MP Kooiman asks whether youth care costs threaten to leave Frisian municipalities short of funds, what the consequences are for children and families, and whether shortfalls and waiting lists are being monitored. The State Secretary answers that municipalities hold the youth care duty since 2015, that Leeuwarden reports possible shortfalls for some Frisian municipalities but no signs the duty is not being met, and that waiting-time data are not part of national monitoring, with oversight left to municipal councils.
It is up to the municipal council to assess whether the municipal executive's conduct is correct.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om te beoordelen of de handelwijze van het gemeentebestuur juist is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Zorgverlener start kort geding tegen Svb vanwege pgb-problematiek’

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a care provider's kort geding against the SVB over PGB payment problems, including personal liability of budget holders for lost wages, cost orders, refusal to commit to 30-day payment, and repeated overpayments with weekend follow-up calls. The state secretary declined substantive comment because the case is before the court and the SVB is appealing, but noted a compensation scheme is being developed and explained the duplicate payments as an error with spoedbetalingen and apologised.
Because this case is still before the court, it is not appropriate for me to give a substantive response at this time.
Omdat deze zaak nog onder de rechter is past het mij niet om daar op dit moment een inhoudelijke reactie op te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Helvert over jeugdzorg voor gezinnen die in het buitenland wonen, maar werken en/of schoolgaan in Nederland

MPs Keijzer and Van Helvert asked how youth care applies to families living abroad but working or schooling in the Netherlands, and whether the Jeugdwet decentralisation removed their access to youth mental health care. The state secretary answered that the residence principle of the Jeugdwet excludes these children, that EU social security coordination covers only insured care, and that a transitional arrangement runs for a maximum of one year.
I will check with the VNG whether there are specific bottlenecks in implementing the transitional arrangement.
Ik zal met de VNG wel nagaan of er bij de uitvoering van het overgangsrecht specifieke knelpunten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Zilveren Kruis Achmea het eigen risico van mensen verrekent met het PGB-wijkverpleging (Persoonsgebonden Budget)

An MP asked the minister whether Zilveren Kruis Achmea may offset PGB (personal budget) payments for district nursing against outstanding eigen risico debts, and whether this should stop. The minister answered that insurers may offset payments against due claims under the Civil Code, that no misuse or fraud occurs because the eigen risico is not paid from PGB funds, and that four insurers apply such offsetting.
No, there is no misuse (or even fraud), since the eigen risico is not paid from PGB funds.
Neen, er is geen sprake van verkeerd besteden (of zelfs fraude), aangezien het eigen risico niet wordt betaald uit pgb-gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en De Graaf over het reclamespotje van Stichting Moslimpleegkind

PVV MPs asked whether the government would stop a recruitment ad by Stichting Moslimpleegkind that implies white parents are poor foster carers and promotes Islam. The state secretary replied that foster placements are carefully screened and that the Jeugdwet requires considering a child's religious and cultural background, and that diversification campaigns exist, but declined to judge the interpretation of the ad and did not commit to stopping it.
Furthermore, it is not for me to judge the interpretation of a commercial by Stichting Moslimpleegkind.
Verder is het niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over de interpretatie van een reclamespotje van de Stichting Moslimpleegkind.
Antwoord op vragen van het Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Zorgwekkende vragen naar gedrag kinderen’

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether the GGD's use of the SDQ questionnaire for parents is national policy, whether non-response has consequences, and what follow-up occurs and whether answers enter children's files. Staatssecretaris Van Rijn answered that questionnaires are advisory tools under professional guidelines, filling them in is voluntary with no consequences, and only findings prompting follow-up enter the electronic child file.
Not filling in the questionnaire has no consequences.
Het niet invullen van de vragenlijst heeft geen gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over de aanpak van huiselijk geweld in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether the government would adopt preventive, family-centred approaches to domestic violence in Caribbean Netherlands instead of a mainly justice-based response, and whether they would fund and roll out a pilot run by the Bonaire youth and family centre. The government answered that an integrated approach covering prevention, care and justice is needed, pointed to existing measures and funding, and said it would support a Bonaire Eigen Kracht pilot and share results if successful, without committing to a rollout.
If the conference proves successful, the results will be shared with the other islands.
Mocht de conferentie een succes blijken te zijn, dan zullen de resultaten gedeeld worden met de andere eilanden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het artikel “Ik wil niet dood, ik wil alleen hulp”

An MP asks the minister about a newspaper article describing a person seeking mental health help who cannot get adequate care, including bridging care gaps and who is responsible for it. The minister acknowledges the concern, explains the professional and legal framework for treatment, waiting-time norms and the division of responsibilities between municipalities, insurers and the Wlz, but does not commit to a new concrete action.
The signal in the article that cuts are being made in mental health care I do not recognise.
Het signaal in het artikel dat wordt bezuinigd in de GGZ herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een bewoner van zorglocatie Het Hietveld en het onderzoek van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) daarnaar

An MP asks the state secretary why the inspectorate delegated the investigation into a resident's death at Het Hietveld to the provider, whether the family or the provider reported the incident first, and how the provider treated staff after a court case. The secretary answers that the inspectorate follows its standard delegation practice, that the investigation is ongoing so details and reports are withheld, and that the inspectorate found the provider's first analysis insufficient and ordered a deeper one.
Since the investigation has not been completed, I cannot provide further information on this at this time.
Aangezien het onderzoek niet is afgerond, kan ik hierover op dit moment geen nadere informatie verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over lange wachtlijsten voor hiv-test

An MP asked the state secretary about long waiting lists for HIV testing at GGD Amsterdam and whether the supplementary sexual health scheme is adequate and efficiently allocated. The secretary answered that high-risk clients still receive timely consultations, that GGDs are in transition to better triage, and that the scheme's evaluation is planned for 2018.
It is still too early to say whether the waiting times are temporary in nature or not.
Het is nog te vroeg om aan te geven of de wachttijden tijdelijk van aard zijn of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de drastische wijziging van het zorginkoopbeleid in de Wet langdurige zorg

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the reported drastic change in care purchasing rules under the Long-term Care Act (Wlz), including quality-based purchasing, regional tariffs, contracts with providers under intensified supervision, and risks of overlap with the Health Care Inspectorate. The State Secretary replies that the shift is toward dialogue-based, quality-focused purchasing, that the inspectorate and insurers have distinct responsibilities, and that no measures will be taken against purchasing below NZa maximum tariffs.
I will inform you in the progress reports on Dignity and Pride about the state of affairs.
Ik zal u in de voortgangsrapportages over Waardigheid en Trots informeren over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de betalingsproblemen in de jeugdzorg

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Health about payment problems in youth care caused by mismatched software between municipalities and providers, longer waiting times, and providers leaving youth mental health care. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to a joint work agenda by VNG and provider organisations, stated that municipalities remain responsible for ensuring care and for payments, and referred struggling providers to the Transitieautoriteit Jeugd.

The primary responsibility for a proper setup of administrations at municipalities and care providers, and for making the right process agreements, lies with individual municipalities and individual care providers.

De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor een goede inrichting van de administraties bij gemeen ten en zorgaanbieders en het maken van de goede procesafspraken daarover ligt uiteraard bij individuele gemeenten en individuele zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over Nederland als grootproducent van neppeuken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the health effects of counterfeit cigarettes, the controls on imported raw tobacco and transit through Dutch ports, and whether counterfeit production should be fought. The State Secretary answered that illegal cigarettes increase accessibility, that current data do not show a rise in domestic production, and that enforcement lies with Customs and the FIOD, with some international cooperation.
Health (VWS) has no task in combating counterfeit cigarettes. This is reserved for Customs and the FIOD.
VWS heeft geen taak op de bestrijding van namaaksigaretten. Dit is voorbehouden aan de Douane en FIOD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Smaling over het bericht ‘TTIP tast gezondheid EU aan’

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether TTIP would lower import tariffs on unhealthy US products, raising health costs and inequality, and whether the government's red lines on food safety hold. The minister replied that EU food safety standards remain fully in force, that tariffs are not linked to healthiness, that no list of affected products exists, and that the WRR food policy report is answered separately.
Such a list does not exist and is also not necessary.
Een dergelijk lijst is er niet en is ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de gevolgen van de wijziging van financiering voor de soa-poli Amsterdam

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the consequences of a funding ceiling for the Amsterdam GGD sexual health clinic, including fewer free STI tests for risk groups, long HIV testing waits, and risks of avoidance behaviour. The State Secretary replied that triage and efficiency measures are intended to free capacity, that GGDs and GPs remain available, and that the scheme will be evaluated in 2018 rather than earlier.
It is still too early to say whether the changes and the available amount are sufficient. That is why the evaluation has been scheduled for 2018.
Het is nog te vroeg om te zeggen of de wijzigingen en het beschikbare bedrag voldoende zijn. Daarom is de evaluatie in 2018 ingepland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over het bericht dat in Frankrijk wetgeving van kracht wordt die het aanmoedigen van anorexia strafbaar stelt

SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands could ban and prosecute pro-anorexia websites, as France was doing, and what the effects of the current pop-up warning approach are. The state secretary answered that encouraging self-starvation is not a crime under current law, that a ban would not be effective, that he will talk with providers and clinicians about updating the pop-up system, and that a treatment standard for eating disorders is in preparation.
The French initiative prompted me to examine whether a ban on pro-ana content would be desirable and legally possible in the Netherlands.
Het Franse initiatief is voor mij aanleiding geweest om te bezien of een verbod van pro-ana uitingen ook in Nederland wenselijk en juridisch mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het voornemen van het kabinet om de verheerlijking van anorexia te verbieden

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether the government would investigate a ban on pro-ana content after France, and why it had not pursued such measures earlier. The government answered that existing law does not criminalise encouraging extreme dieting, that a ban would not be effective, and that it will instead update the pop-up warning system with providers and engage the fashion sector.
Banning and criminalising these expressions sends the wrong signal to these people and does not encourage them to seek help.
Het verbieden en strafbaar stellen van deze uitingen is een verkeerd signaal naar deze personen en bevordert niet dat zij hulp gaan zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over leerlinggewichten

An MP asked how DUO's country education information is used to set student weights, whether foreign parents' education is fairly assessed, and whether tightened weight rules and controls are reliable and reduce weighted pupil numbers. The government answered that SBB benchmarks foreign systems against Dutch levels, that the weighting criteria were not tightened but error corrections reduce weights, and that the weight is only a correction factor in the youth care allocation model.
I point out that the scheme or the standards in the scheme have not been tightened.
Ik wijs erop dat de regeling of de normen in de regeling niet zijn aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over geweldsfilmpjes bij jongeren

Two MPs from D66 asked the state secretaries how to explain the reported trend of youths filming and sharing violent videos, how many youths are involved, and what measures exist to stop it. The government answered that it has no figures because filming violence is not a separate offence, that prosecution is possible where the filmers can be treated as accomplices or instigators, and that anti-bullying policy, school safety rules from August 2015 and online information campaigns are the main responses.
I do not have figures, because filming an assault or public violence is not an independent criminal offence.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers, omdat het filmen van een mishandeling of openlijke geweldpleging geen zelfstandig strafbaar feit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de gemeentelijke plannen om wietteelt te reguleren en andere vragen ten aanzien van het Nederlands drugsbeleid

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about seizure and import figures for drugs, electricity theft by cannabis growers, coffeeshop turnover, drug harm rankings, illegal distilleries, public support for regulated cannabis cultivation, and a Groningen court ruling on home growers. The minister answered that most figures are not kept or are unavailable because the trade is illegal or the tax data cannot be broken down, gave harm rankings from RIVM and European research, and declined to comment on the pending appeal.
The import of soft and hard drugs concerns an illegal market that operates in secret. No overviews of this are available.
De import van soft- en harddrugs betreft een illegale markt, die zich in het verborgene afspeelt. Hiervan zijn geen overzichten beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de inzet van casemanagers binnen de zorg

MP Bergkamp asked the State Secretary for Health about case managers in care, prompted by a press case of citizens lost between new long-term care rules, and about the motion asking the government to explore the role of case manager. The State Secretary acknowledged signals of citizens being bounced between providers, pointed to the Ieder(in)/Per Saldo help line and independent client support, and said a plan on structural funding of mentorship and case management would be discussed with stakeholders and reported in autumn.
I am currently working on a plan on the structural financing of mentorship.
Ik ben op dit moment bezig met een plan over de structurele financiering van mentorschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitzending van TijdvoorMeldpunt bij omroep MAX

MP Krol asked the State Secretary for Health about a broadcast on fall accidents among elderly people living at home, including calls for a nationwide safety adviser and a uniform home-adaptation subsidy regardless of municipality.
