The State Secretary answered that fall prevention is primarily a local matter, pointed to existing national support tools and Wmo 2015 obligations, rejected a nationwide safety adviser and a uniform subsidy, and promised continued monitoring.
I therefore do not want to impose a national blueprint by making a safety adviser available to everyone.
Ik wil daarom geen landelijke blauwdruk opleggen door een veiligheidsadviseur voor iedereen beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Toename overgewicht in achterstandswijken’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about a WHO projection of rising overweight in Europe, the influence of marketing and self-regulation by the food industry, and widening socio-economic gaps in obesity. The state secretary answered that overweight is a complex shared problem, pointed to the Akkoord with industry, the Vinkje logo and the Gezond in de stad and JOGG programmes, and said existing policy is already intensified and locally focused.
The WHO estimates for 2030 for the Netherlands were however based on only three data points.
De schattingen die de WHO voor 2030 heeft gedaan zijn voor Nederland echter gedaan op basis van slechts drie datapunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een 100-jarige mevrouw die gemangeld wordt door het zorgstelsel

An SP MP asks the state secretary how a terminally ill 100-year-old woman's palliative care indication could be cut from 24-hour care to 2 hours a day, and whether the transition to the new care system left people without clear responsibility. The state secretary replies that re-indication by the nurse was appropriate given her improved condition, that people needing 24-hour care remain under the Wlz, that the professional is responsible for coordinating care, and that no exact data on re-indication outcomes is available.
I have no insight into how many people with a PTZ indication have been re-indicated and which re-indication these people have received.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel mensen met een PTZ indicatie zijn geherindiceerd en welke herindicatie deze mensen hebben gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de preventie- en handhavingplannen voor de Drank- en Horecawet

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the many municipalities lacking or having incomplete alcohol prevention and enforcement plans under the Drank- en Horecawet, and what powers the government has to compel them. The State Secretary acknowledged disappointing quality, said he will talk with municipalities, send a letter and commission a congress, but did not identify any binding powers to force compliance.
I will soon be talking with a number of municipal administrators about the results of this study
Ik ga binnenkort in gesprek met een aantal bestuurders van gemeenten over de resultaten van dit onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over verwaarloosde kinderen op school

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretaries of health and education whether they knew of reports that hundreds of children arrive at school hungry and neglected, and what is being done about it. The government answers that municipalities and Veilig Thuis are responsible for responding, that schools should report signals, and that it is promoting integrated cooperation between schools and neighbourhood teams.
Municipalities also have an important role in tackling poverty, one of the possible underlying causes.
Gemeenten hebben ook een belangrijke rol bij het tegengaan van armoedeproblematiek, één van de mogelijk achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitzending van het programma Kassa waarin de ANBO een Hulpfonds Woningaanpassingen heeft gelanceerd

Krol (50PLUS) asks the State Secretary about a Kassa broadcast in which ANBO launched a housing-adaptation fund, citing surveys showing strict municipal criteria and low budgets. The State Secretary says the Wmo 2015 legal framework and appeal rights are sufficient, so a fund is unnecessary, that variation between municipalities is intended, and that concrete cases of non-compliance will be discussed with those involved.
If I have concrete examples of situations where municipalities do not comply with the law, I will discuss this with those involved.
Indien ik concrete voorbeelden heb van situaties waarbij gemeenten zich niet aan de wet houden, ga ik daarover met betrokkenen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘verwaarloosde kinderen op basisscholen’

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the state secretaries about a report that around 1,100 children arrive at school daily without basic necessities, and that many schools feed and clothe pupils themselves, asking about detection, referral to youth care and Veilig Thuis, and coordination with the VNG and PO-Raad. The government acknowledges the problem, points to municipal responsibility, the poverty-fighting funds and the verbindingsagenda, and says it will discuss the issue with partners without committing to new legal or institutional change.
Municipalities, as stated, have the means to provide the necessary support.
Gemeenten hebben zoals gezegd mogelijkheden om de benodigde ondersteuning te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten “Gewonden bij brand seniorenflats Wijchen” en “Seniorenflats moeten een stuk veiliger”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the government about fire safety in senior housing complexes after press reports of fires and deaths among elderly residents, and whether building rules, drills, inspections and resident education should be tightened. The minister answered that the government is studying how to better protect elderly residents from fire with stakeholders, with results due in autumn 2015, while stating that drills and inspections are largely a matter for residents, owners and municipalities.
It is up to each municipality individually to intensify inspections at senior housing complexes if desired.
Het is aan iedere gemeente afzonderlijk om controles bij seniorencomplexen desgewenst te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de aanhoudende onzekerheid voor kinderen met een meervoudige beperking en de intensieve zorg in de klas

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Education and of Health about persistent uncertainty for children with multiple disabilities who need intensive care in class, including funding of medical care at school, whether Wlz-funded care should be earmarked, and the reported letters from schools to parents. The government replied that funding and care rights are adequate, that earmarking is neither necessary nor desirable, that a national application procedure and a joint working agenda are being pursued, and that it will keep monitoring implementation.
As State Secretary Van Rijn indicated in the general consultation on 25 March, earmarking part of the Wlz indication for possible participation in education is neither necessary nor desirable.

Zoals de Staatssecretaris Van Rijn in het algemeen overleg op 25 maart heeft aangegeven, is het oormerken van een deel van de Wlz-indicatie voor een mogelijke deelname aan onderwijs niet nodig en niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over de toekomst van leerlingen die het praktijkonderwijs succesvol hebben doorlopen

MPs Siderius and Karabulut (SP) asked about the prospects of praktijkonderwijs (practical education) leavers, including barriers from language and maths requirements, the Participatiewet, sheltered work and dagbesteding, and whether the government will monitor and support school-leavers. The State Secretary answers that most leavers find work or continue training, that municipalities are now responsible for support, and that additional measures and monitoring are planned, without accepting parliamentary demands for extended follow-up or compensation for reduced ESF funds.
The cabinet does not expect a negative effect of the Participatiewet on the successful outflow of praktijkonderwijs pupils.
Het kabinet verwacht geen negatief effect van de Participatiewet op de succesvolle uitstroom van leerlingen uit het pro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de pgb-betaling door de Sociale-Verzekeringsbank (SVB)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a 75-year-old PGB budget holder who was reportedly turned away at an SVB office, backlogs in unopened mail and email, kort geding cases against the SVB, and payment disruptions when carers are ill or budgets are transferred. The State Secretary denied anyone is turned away, acknowledged an email backlog being cleared, cited one lost kort geding for the SVB, and said structural fixes for sick-carer registration are being developed.
According to the SVB, no one who presents themselves in person is turned away.
Er wordt volgens de SVB niemand die zich fysiek meldt, weggestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over contra-expertise (Eerste deelrapportage, tweede deelrapportage en eindverslag) opgesteld door M&I/Partners met betrekking tot het uitvoeren van het trekkingsrecht door de Socia

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Health about a contra-expertise by M&I/Partners on the SVB's implementation of the trekkingsrecht (payment-entitlement system) for personal budgets, probing the evidence base, ICT robustness, architecture, costs and fraud-fighting rationale. The State Secretary answered that the report found the current system functioning technically, that further stabilisation and a verbeterplan will follow, and that some information (such as source code) cannot be published for security reasons.
On the basis of the Roadmap Implementation drawn up by the SVB, I issued the assignment at the time.
Op basis van de door de SVB opgestelde Roadmap Invoering heb ik destijds de opdracht verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Fritsma over het bericht ‘Grote onrust in verzorgingshuis Zuidoost over opvang illegalen’

PVV MPs asked why a care home in Zuidoost houses rejected asylum seekers while elderly people with care indications ZZP 1-3 are no longer admitted, and whether such people should be removed. The state secretary replied that vacant care home rooms are being repurposed in the trend toward aging at home, that he sees no reason to change the Wet langdurige zorg for ZZP 1-3, and that deportation is unrelated to his policy.
I see no connection between my policy in the field of long-term care and the action you suggest.
Ik zie geen relatie tussen mijn beleid op het terrein van de langdurige zorg en de door u gesuggereerde actie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over het bericht ‘Stichting wil betere hulp aan daklozen Amersfoort bieden’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a news report on a foundation wanting better help for homeless people in Amersfoort, including the share and flow of 'new homeless', the priority of fast move-out from shelters, and person-tailored guidance. The State Secretary says data on underlying problems are not registered everywhere, points to housing corporations' role and the Wmo 2015 duty of individual investigation, and leaves implementation to municipalities.
No. The underlying problems of people using the social shelter are not registered everywhere.
Nee. De achterliggende problematiek van personen die gebruik maken van de maatschappelijke opvang wordt niet overal geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Mijn bloeddruk schiet omhoog’

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary whether it is responsible to house vulnerable elderly residents in a care centre alongside young people with justice-system contact, and how their safety, including against elder abuse, will be protected. The state secretary replies that the plan, developed by Careyn and Socius for four flats for young people in re-integration, has voluntary support from residents and the client council, with careful selection and intensive supervision, and that a closure of the centre would be a separate matter for individual residents.
The elderly residents and the client council are closely involved in Careyn's plan.
De ouderen en de cliëntenraad zijn nauw betrokken bij het plan van Careyn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de autistische Rebecca, die graag naar school wil, maar al 18 maanden thuis zit

An MP asked the state secretaries about a 15-year-old autistic girl kept at home for 18 months, the lack of a joined-up school and youth-care system, and related waiting lists and gaps in responsibility. The government says a suitable school placement has recently been found, cites privacy limits on details, and points to municipal responsibility and existing cooperation support without committing to new national measures.
I cannot go into all the details of this matter, because this concerns privacy-sensitive information.
Ik kan niet op alle details van deze kwestie ingaan, omdat dit privacygevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht “Wonen in aanleunwoning is riskant bij calamiteiten”

An MP asked the state secretary about fire safety risks for elderly residents of aanleunwoningen (sheltered flats) compared with verzorgingshuizen, and whether research would be done. The government answered that the ministries are investigating how to better protect elderly people against fire, to report to parliament later in 2015, and explained that the Bouwbesluit requires only smoke detectors in aanleunwoningen while verzorgingshuizen need a full fire alarm system.
In the course of 2015, your House will be further informed about the results of this.
In de loop van 2015 wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de resultaten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Gemeente ondermijnt thuiszorg’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary about a report claiming municipal home-care tariffs fell sharply and home-help budgets were cut, raising questions on access, subsidy adequacy, sham contracts and worker conditions. The state secretary disputed several claims, argued that the Wmo 2015 obliges municipalities to provide individually tailored support, and promised further discussions and a separate letter.
At national level, from the CAK administration, there is only insight into individual provisions granted for which a personal contribution is owed, and the number of persons concerned.

Op landelijk niveau bestaat, vanuit de administratie van het CAK, alleen inzicht in de toegekende individuele voorzieningen waarvoor een eigen bijdrage verschuldigd is en het aantal personen dat dit betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de progressieve spierziekte ALS

An MP asked the government about municipal knowledge of ALS, support and equipment for patients, Wmo procedure delays, carer support and leave, and podiatry coverage. The minister answered that municipalities bear responsibility under the Wmo 2015 for tailored support, that patient organisations and the VNG should disseminate ALS knowledge and parties will consult on guidance, and that carer leave rules are being extended from 1 July.
Under the Wmo 2015, municipalities have the responsibility to provide appropriate support to people who are dependent on it.
Gemeenten hebben op grond van de Wmo 2015 de verantwoordelijkheid mensen, die hier op aangewezen zijn, passende ondersteuning te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van het Keijzer over het bericht “Mantelzorgers melden zich vaker ziek op werk”

The MP asked the state secretary about reports that informal carers are taking more sick leave, cuts to day activities and home help, and what the government will do to relieve carers. The state secretary answered that the Wmo 2015 strengthens the carer's position, that municipalities must assess carers' capacity, and that a leave-regulation campaign and projects with employers are underway, while stating that continuity of support must not be compromised and that municipal cuts are for municipalities to decide individually.

I trust that parties will take their (statutory) responsibility and shape it in such a way that the continuity of support for the target group, elderly and/or people with dementia, is not jeopardised.

Ik ga er vanuit dat partijen hun (wettelijke) verantwoordelijkheid nemen en hier op een zodanige wijze invulling ingeven dat de continuïteit van de ondersteuning voor de desbetreffende doelgroep, ouderen en/of mensen met dementie, niet in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de berichten dat mantelzorgers overbelast raken

An MP asks whether working carers overburdened by combining paid work with caregiving face health risks and what barriers and remedies exist. The minister answers that intensive caregiving raises reported health complaints and sick leave, cites prevention campaigns, expanded leave rights from July 2015, and an upcoming SER advisory request and awareness campaign.
Government policy is therefore aimed at preventing people from becoming exhausted and overburdened by combining work and care and subsequently possibly stopping work.
Het kabinetsbeleid is er dan ook op gericht te voorkomen dat mensen door de combinatie van werk en zorg oververmoeid en overbelast raken en vervolgens mogelijk stoppen met werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het taboe op seks in de ouderenzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary whether sexuality is still a taboo in elderly care and disability care, and whether a sexual service provider could be used for clients. The state secretary acknowledged the importance of intimacy and sexuality, said he would raise it with the sector and professional bodies, and saw no need to extend this to disability care or to endorse sexual service provision beyond leaving it to client-caregiver agreements.
At the General Consultation on quality policy for nursing home care of 18 March 2015 I indicated that I intend to discuss this topic with the field and the professional organisations.
In het Algemeen Overleg Kwaliteitsbeleid verpleeghuiszorg van 18 maart 2015 heb ik aangegeven dat ik voornemens ben dit onderwerp te bespreken met het werkveld en de beroepsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de indicatiestelling door professionals

An SP MP asked the state secretary about municipalities cutting home-care hours via indication renewals without proper investigation, the use of care professionals and provision-based consultants, and wijkverpleging indication targets. The secretary said the Bergen op Zoom/Steenbergen/Woensdrecht municipalities now issue appealable decisions, that no national investigation is planned into mandating or provision-based consultants, and that professionals' conduct is governed by existing law and standards.

As a result, the municipalities of Bergen op Zoom, Steenbergen and Woensdrecht decided to send clients, following the provider's assessment with the client of what is needed, a decision open to objection and appeal.

Naar aanleiding hiervan hebben de gemeenten Bergen op Zoom, Steenbergen en Woensdrecht besloten om aan cliënten, in aansluiting op de beoordeling die de aanbieder samen met de cliënt maakt van wat er in de betreffende situatie nodig is om het resultaat een «schoon huis» te bereiken, een beschikking te sturen die open staat voor bezwaar en beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “ Mensen verdwalen in de nieuwe zorgregels”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that people get lost between care counters under the new long-term care, Wmo and health insurance rules, including the role of MEE client support, the Wmo 2015 melding-before-application procedure, a missing urgent procedure when insurers refuse care, and the complexity for people with mild intellectual disabilities. The State Secretary acknowledged that responsibility boundaries are not always clear in practice, pointed to ongoing guidance, client support and a self-test for municipalities, said existing complaint and dispute routes suffice without a special urgent procedure, and promised to respond to a SCP report in spring.
I find this situation undesirable. There is therefore ongoing attention to improving this situation.
Ik vind deze situatie onwenselijk. Er is daarom doorlopend aandacht voor verbetering van deze situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat vrijwilligers ingezet worden in gezinnen die een maatregel opgelegd hebben gekregen van de kinderrechter

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether volunteers deployed in families under a court-ordered child protection measure is responsible, whether they can replace professionals and be effective, and whether child safety is guaranteed. The state secretary replied that the youth-care law and quality framework allow municipalities to use volunteers as a supplement under the lead of the child protection worker, that the matter is a decentralised responsibility, and that the existing legal safeguards suffice.
I do not intend to intervene in this decentralised responsibility. The aforementioned legal safeguards are sufficient.
Ik ben niet voornemens in deze decentrale verantwoordelijkheid te treden. De eerdergenoemde wettelijke waarborgen volstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over VGP hogere aantallen drankslachtoffers bij latere cafésluitingen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a study finding more alcohol-related ambulance calls after Amsterdam cafés were allowed to close an hour later, and about whether such extensions are a national trend, whether additional research is needed, and how municipal licensing balances health harm. The State Secretary acknowledged the study, said causes are unclear, deemed additional research unnecessary given Amsterdam's new monitored approach, and committed to raising the topic with the VNG and mayors.
I will therefore put this point on the agenda in the next conversation with the VNG and in my contacts with mayors.
Ik zal dit punt daarom agenderen in het volgende gesprek met de VNG en in mijn contacten met burgemeesters.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over opgevraagde documenten bij het algemeen overleg van 3 maart 2015 en het algemeen overleg van 26 maart 2015 over de Voortgang van de uitbetalingsproblematiek van persoonsgebonde

MP Keijzer asked the State Secretary to send the documents requested at the 3 March and 26 March 2015 committee meetings on the PGB payment problems at the SVB, and to provide the updated budget covering all extra costs. The State Secretary sent most listed documents, promised to report total extra costs by mid-May, and offered confidential inspection of CIO opinions and steering committee minutes, while declining to release source code for security and intellectual property reasons.
I see no good way to make the source code available in an accessible and understandable manner.
Ik zie geen goede mogelijkheid om de broncodes op een toegankelijke en begripvolle manier beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over "gedwongen zzp-erschap bij Sensire"

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked the ministers about reports that care provider Sensire wanted to dismiss 600 home-care workers and rehire them as self-employed, questioning whether this amounts to disguised self-employment and whether unions should be involved. Minister Asscher answered that pressuring employees into self-employment is undesirable, that UWV and courts assess individual cases, that UWV refuses dismissal permits where the aim is to avoid employee status, and pointed to the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and the 2013 action plan.
In general terms, it is for the courts to assess the facts and circumstances of the individual case and rule on them.
In algemene zin is het aan de rechter om de feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval te beoordelen en daar een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘CBP: doorbreking geheimhoudingsplicht Jeugdwet niet goed geregeld’ (CBP: College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens)

An MP asked whether the Youth Act lacks a clear basis for youth care providers to share client data with municipalities for financing and control, following a Dutch privacy regulator warning. The state secretary replied that the Act already provides a basis for such data sharing for access to youth care, that the rules will be further specified in a pending bill, and that privacy is adequately safeguarded with no actual risk.
The care for and privacy of individual clients is not endangered as a result of the legislation and the actions described above.
De zorg voor en de privacy van individuele cliënten loopt geen gevaar als gevolg van de wetgeving en de hiervoor beschreven acties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het waarborgen van privacy binnen de Jeugdwet

D66 MPs asked whether the Youth Act adequately protects children's privacy, given reports of unnecessary labelling and parents being forced to disclose information to get care reimbursed. The Secretary of State answered that privacy is protected within the Wbp and Youth Act, pointed to completed privacy impact assessments and training for municipal staff, and argued there is no legal gap, while adding clarifying provisions in a separate bill.
It is the responsibility of the municipal executive to handle personal data carefully within these frameworks.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het college van B&W om binnen deze kaders op een zorgvuldige manier om te gaan met de persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘De jeugdwet, het CBS en… privacy’

MP Kooiman asks the State Secretaries about reports that CBS will receive individual, potentially identifiable youth care data under the Jeugdwet, raising privacy, professional secrecy and administrative burden concerns. The government replies that CBS pseudonymises the BSN immediately, publishes only non-identifiable aggregates, that the data flow is legally mandated and reviewed in a PIA, and that professional secrecy is not breached, while declining to ask the CBP for a new opinion.
The system for policy information is organised so that no data traceable to individuals is published.
De systematiek van de beleidsinformatie is zodanig ingericht dat geen tot personen herleidbare gegevens worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er steeds meer geweld is in de opvang

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of rising violence in shelters, whether the 'Veilig werken in de zorg' scheme should cover the shelter sector, and about waiting lists for supported and protected housing. The state secretary said no national violence figures exist, explained the inspectorate's risk-based approach and that the sector can join the scheme this year, and said waiting-list data are not recorded nationally since municipalities are responsible.
The number of people waiting for shelter, supervised and protected housing was not and is not recorded at national level.
Het aantal wachtende personen voor opvang, begeleiding en beschermd wonen werd en wordt niet op landelijk niveau geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Pgb-scanner heeft probleem met blauwe pen’

An MP asked whether the SVB cannot process personal budget (pgb) care contracts written in blue ink, how many cases were affected, and why parliament learned of it through the media. The state secretary replied that the SVB reports no processing problems from blue ink, that scans are occasionally hard to read, and that unreadable documents are checked against originals or returned to the budget holder.
The SVB informs me that there are no problems in processing documents from budget holders.
De SVB meldt mij dat er geen problemen zijn bij het verwerken van documenten van budgethouders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht “Tarieven Wmo over de kop”

An MP (PVV) asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether large differences in Wmo care tariffs between municipalities affect care quality, and whether he would investigate their consequences for residents. The state secretary replied that municipalities and providers are responsible for quality under the Wmo 2015, that tariff differences follow from local negotiation and policy choices, and that he sees no reason for additional measures or specific research.
I therefore see no reason at this time to take additional measures.
Ik zie dan ook op dit moment geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat mensen te maken krijgen met stijgende zorgkosten door de bezuinigingen op de langdurige zorg

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary about reports that care costs for people receiving long-term care rose sharply after cuts, including a 630 euro monthly co-payment and survey findings of large increases. The secretary disputes the survey interpretation, says the income figures do not match the claimed increases, and points to municipalities' responsibility for financial case-by-case support, while committing to information and no new compensation.
On the basis of the information available to me, it is not possible to give the requested explanation.
Op grond van de mij ter beschikking staande informatie is het niet goed mogelijk om de gevraagde verklaring te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Rebel en Van der Staaij over de rokende gokker

MPs asked why Holland Casino expanded and made attractive smoking rooms with gambling machines, whether this is lawful and consistent with anti-smoking policy, and whether the government will change it. The government answered that such rooms are lawful under the Tabakswet provided the NVWA's criteria are met, that the offer should not be more attractive than outside the room, and agreed to talk with Holland Casino about a prevention pledge.
Smoking rooms, however, are exempt from the smoking ban, and the way Holland Casino has set up its smoking rooms does not conflict with the rules on this.
Rookruimten zijn echter uitgezonderd van het rookverbod en de manier waarop Holland Casino haar rookruimten heeft ingericht is niet strijdig met de regels daaromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over de uitvoering van het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) in de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw) voor intensieve kindzorg

MP Otwin van Dijk asked the State Secretary about problems with the Zvw personal budget (pgb) for intensive child care, including minute-based declarations, the non-professional tariff, budget cuts and late SVB payments. The State Secretary acknowledged the signals, described steps taken with insurers (adjusted declaration methods, review of the tariff in evaluation, a practical solution pending new funding rules) and outlined the changes in administration for beneficiaries.
I have no insight into whether this means that in no single situation has a reduction been applied to intensive child care anymore.
Ik heb geen inzicht in of dit betekent dat er in geen enkele situatie meer een korting is toegepast bij intensieve kindzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat basiszorg voor daklozen een urgent probleem is

Ms Leijten (SP) asked the minister how to respond to a study of street doctors showing poor healthcare access for homeless people, including questions on registration, identification barriers, and coordination. Minister Schippers replied that existing rights and municipal responsibilities suffice, gave no new counts or uniform registration, and promised only a talk with the Dutch street doctors group.
In the short term, talks will be held with the Dutch street doctors group to further exchange views on the bottlenecks they encounter in practice.
Op korte termijn zal met de Nederlandse straatdoktersgroep in gesprek worden gegaan om nader van gedachten te wisselen over de knelpunten die zij in de praktijk tegen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over het bericht dat ex-daklozen hun huis verliezen door te hoge huren

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked about reports that ex-homeless people lose their homes due to high rents, including numbers, waiting times and rent subsidy gaps. Minister Blok answered that data on these cases is largely unavailable, pointed to reinstated fit-for-purpose rent rules and corporation and municipal measures against evictions, and did not commit to new concrete steps beyond existing motions.
No data is known about this.
Hier zijn geen gegevens over bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat het aantal meldingen over mishandeling van ouderen met bijna de helft is toegenomen

An MP asked the state secretary about a reported 43% rise in elder abuse reports in big cities and whether cuts to care and closures of care homes explain it. The secretary says the figures are partly inaccurate, attributes the rise to greater awareness and the meldcode rather than more abuse, and rejects the link to cuts while arguing care reforms can help.
I therefore regard this increase – which, incidentally, began a few years ago – as an intended effect of policy.
Ik beschouw deze toename – die overigens dus al een paar jaar geleden is ingezet – daarom als een beoogd effect van beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het vervreemden van zorgvastgoed als een gemeenschap een ouderenzorgvoorziening wil voortzetten

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a Vinkeveen residents' group wishing to keep the Vinkenoord care home running as an elderly care facility, the legal obstacles to community takeover, the owner Careyn's preference for leasing to a mental health provider, claimed absence of demand and of needs research, and whether the College sanering zorginstellingen oversight can protect local interests. The secretary replied that there are in principle no legal barriers, that any party including residents may bid under College sanering supervision for a market price, that the College has not yet been approached, and that the ministry lacks data on property values and procurement volumes.
The College sanering publishes the decisions it has taken on its website.
Het College sanering publiceert de besluiten die het heeft genomen op haar website.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht “Jos de Blok: deze transitie in de zorg moet je niet willen”

Member Gerbrands (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Health whether the 2015 care reforms, criticised by Buurtzorg's Jos de Blok as too complex and bureaucratic, will add overhead, and what will be done about the split between wijkgerichte and individual wijkverpleging funding. The State Secretary rejects the claim that the reforms are too complex, acknowledges administrative burden signals, and commits to a letter on reducing it and to revisiting the S1/S2 funding split.
I will inform your House more on this in the progress report on long-term care.
Ik zal uw Kamer hier nader over informeren in de voortgangsrapportage Langdurige Zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Otwin van Dijk over onduidelijkheid scheiding onderwijs- en zorgbudget voor ernstig gehandicapte kinderen

MPs Ypma and Otwin van Dijk asked how care and education budgets for severely disabled children during school hours are divided, and what happens when schools, municipalities and insurers cannot agree on funding. The state secretary answered that the boundary is individual, care can be agreed in the child's Wlz care plan, a consultation guide and support are offered, and a regulation will redirect about EUR 6-8 million of previously compensated funds to special schools from 2015-2016.
I am aware that there are signals of unclarity about the provision of care and support during school hours for children with severe multiple disabilities.
Het is mij bekend dat er signalen zijn over onduidelijkheden rondom de invulling van zorg en ondersteuning tijdens schooltijd voor kinderen met een ernstige meervoudige beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de verhoging van de eigen bijdrage Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) en Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that co-payments under the Wmo and Wlz rise by up to 50% in 2015 because the 33% discount is abolished, and about affected numbers, municipal use of general facilities, CAK billing errors and whether people retain pocket money. The State Secretary answered that the discount abolition was a known coalition measure, that effects vary by person, that he sees no evidence people cannot pay for general facilities, and that he will monitor implementation and report via the budget cycle.
There is no insight into the current actual situation, as regarding Wmo clients this depends on how municipalities currently organise support.
Er is geen inzicht in de huidige feitelijke situatie gezien dit wat betreft Wmo-cliënten afhangt van de wijze waarop gemeenten nu de ondersteuning inrichten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over de ICT-problemen bij de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) met betrekking tot het niet uitbetalen van pgb’s (persoonsgebonden budgetten)

An MP asked the state secretary many detailed questions about the SVB's ICT problems with paying personal budgets (pgb), including fraud controls, data flows from municipalities, fallback scenarios, costs, and oversight of the SVB by the ministry's CIO. The state secretary answered in detail, acknowledging teething problems but defending the trekkingsrecht system, rejecting a fallback to the old system and an independent feasibility study, and committing to a repair plan and improved oversight.

In the general debate with your House on the pgb trekkingsrecht of 3 March, I committed to drawing up an improvement plan with the parties involved before this summer and informing the House about it.

In het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer over het trekkingsrecht pgb van 3 maart jl. heb ik toegezegd om voor deze zomer in overleg met betrokken partijen een verbeterplan op te stellen en de Kamer daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het menselijk leed door de bezuinigingen op de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo)

Parliamentary member Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about cases of neglect and delayed home care after municipal cuts under the Wmo 2015, and whether the government would monitor and intervene. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have procedures for urgent cases, that some cases were resolved or taken to court, that no national data on waiting times is collected, and that he sees no reason to doubt municipalities are performing their duties.
I do not have the information requested by the House on the number of people who would wait for home care or receive no home care in an acute situation, because it is not collected at national level.

Ik beschik niet over de door de Kamer gevraagde gevraagde informatie met betrekking tot het aantal mensen dat op thuiszorg zou wachten of geen thuiszorg zou krijgen in een acute situatie, omdat deze niet op landelijk niveau wordt verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat hulpverleners te weinig oog hebben voor het kind bij huiselijk geweld

An MP asked the state secretary whether youth-protection bodies track children who are repeatedly reported as victims of abuse, and why professionals share too little information in domestic violence cases. The state secretary answered that Veilig Thuis must now record repeat reports and actively follow up on children, that a new handling protocol and a child check in the meldcode are in place, and that information-sharing will be addressed through practical support and step-by-step guidance rather than new legal obligations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van het Wout over het bericht “Megaheffing voor cliënten van Ascensio”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether clients of care provider Ascensio, found to have committed abuses, face clawbacks of personal budget (pgb) funds, and whether the directors rather than clients should be held liable. The State Secretary confirmed Achmea zorgkantoor is recovering unverified pgb amounts but suspended recovery pending investigation, will explore support for good-faith budget holders, and noted directors can be held liable under civil law.
I have agreed with Achmea that, while that investigation is ongoing, the claim against budget holders to repay the pgb is suspended.
Ik heb met Achmea afgesproken dat lopende dat onderzoek de vordering op de budgethouders om het pgb terug te betalen, wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de vermelding van zorgzwaartepakket 4 Verpleging en Verzorging

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Health about differing descriptions of care package ZZP 4 Verpleging en Verzorging across websites, the criteria for eligibility (including whether early dementia or alarm-button capability matters), indication numbers, and CIZ assessment practice. The State Secretary answered that providers are responsible for their own descriptions, that the Wlz care profiles are set in regulation and unchanged in substance, gave indication figures and a 2015 contracting estimate, and explained that the CIZ indicates under the Wlz criteria without an 'able to press an alarm' criterion.
However, I will point this out to the sector organisation.
Ik zal de branche-organisatie er evenwel op wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Rebel over het bericht dat actiegroep "Zij Is Hier" een pand kraakt voor de opvang van kwetsbare en verborgen vrouwen

MPs Yücel and Rebel asked about a women's shelter set up by activist group Zij Is Hier in a squatted building in Amsterdam Nieuw West, whether abandoned women with insecure residence status can access municipal shelters, and what measures and human rights ambassadors could provide. The state secretary answered that the municipality could not verify the number of occupants, that eight people were later housed in Nieuw West, that Amsterdam shelter options remain available regardless of residence status, and that trained volunteers could be deployed on rights and referral.
At our request, the municipality of Amsterdam sent us a factual account of the report that an activist group had squatted a building in Amsterdam.
De gemeente Amsterdam heeft ons op ons verzoek een feitenrelaas doen toekomen over het bericht dat een actiegroep een pand heeft gekraakt in Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over VGP bericht: 'Chemopatiënten kweken stiekem cannabis'

An MP asks the state secretary about a report that cancer patients grow cannabis secretly because pharmacy cannabis is ineffective or unreimbursed, including a patient whose home-grown plants were seized. The secretary answers that home cultivation is banned under the Opium Act, that five pharmacy cannabis varieties largely meet need, that most insurers reimburse it, and that current policy will not be changed.

I do not rule out that there are patients who help each other by exchanging information about the beneficial effects they experience from a particular cannabis variety that is not available in pharmacies on prescription.

Ik sluit niet uit dat er patiënten zijn die elkaar helpen door informatie uit te wisselen over de heilzame werking die zij zelf ervaren door het gebruik van een bepaalde cannabisvariant die niet op doktersrecept in de apotheek verkrijgbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorginstelling Thebe een eigen televisiekanaal opricht

Parliamentary questions from MP Leijten (SP) asked whether the care provider Thebe's plan for its own television channel was a sensible use of care funds amid job losses and cuts, and whether its board and supervisors set the right priorities. The State Secretary replied that no television channel is being set up, only a trial video bulletin to inform residents, families and staff about care and the transition, with residents asked for feedback on it.
There is no question of setting up a television channel.
Er is geen sprake van het oprichten van een televisiekanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het succes van Buurtzorg

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about Buurtzorg's quality and cost success, whether self-managing teams should become the norm, monitoring of nurses, management cuts, and why some insurers bypass Buurtzorg. The State Secretary largely defers to dialogue with the sector, declines to keep or publish provider-level data beyond what is already public, and points to existing programmes rather than new binding measures.
The Ministry of Health does not have the names of the care providers or their scores in the comparison.
VWS beschikt niet over de namen van de zorgaanbieders of hun scores in de vergelijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat een bejaarde Rotterdamse gevangen zit in een zwaar versoberd verzorgingshuis; Zorgen om Nelly van 101

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether a 101-year-old Rotterdam resident, reportedly confined to a heavily austere care home after a change to living and care arrangements, reflects the intended closer-to-home care, and whether she really wants this. The state secretary acknowledged the report, said some residents may dread more independent living, and stated that existing residents' situations should be preserved as far as possible while a suitable solution is sought with the care office, provider and client.
That is why, in consultation between the care office, the care provider and the client, a suitable solution must be sought if an institution moves to separate housing and care.
Daarom moet in overleg tussen zorgkantoor, zorgaanbieder en cliënt gezocht worden naar een passende oplossing indien een instelling overgaat tot het scheiden van wonen en zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat thuiszorgmedewerkers moeten bloeden voor falend ICT-beleid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health how he judges thuiszorg organisation Laurens failing to determine staff wages because its 'Planapp' system malfunctioned, and about its ICT investments and minute-registration systems. The State Secretary said the problem stems from ICT integration within the organisation, that the board has taken responsibility and advanced wages, has no insight into the investments (referring to the annual report), and that providers choose whether to use minute registration.
I have no insight into that.
Daar heb ik geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Rebel over de dood van de Rotterdamse Yasmeen Dad

MPs Yücel and Rebel asked the ministers about the death of Yasmeen Dad, who lived in isolation, and whether police had signals of her oppression and what help exists for such women. The minister says criminal investigation limits disclosure, refers to police methods for honour-related violence and to the Rotterdam pilot with community key figures, and does not commit to a new investigation.
Beyond that, no statements can be made because of the interests of investigation and prosecution connected to the criminal investigation into this case.
Voor het overige geldt dat geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging die verbonden zijn aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over VGP het bericht 'Meer kinderen in het ziekenhuis door drank'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of rising hospital admissions of young teenagers for alcohol, asking about causes, parental responsibility and prevention campaigns. The state secretary answered that overall youth drinking is falling, attributed the rise partly to more parents seeking care, and pointed to the NIX18 campaign, school and sports-club initiatives, and long-term monitoring.
At the end of this year I will receive the results of research into the social costs of alcohol use in the Netherlands, and I will send them to you.
Aan het einde van dit jaar zal ik overigens de resultaten van onderzoek naar maatschappelijke kosten van alcoholgebruik in Nederland ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI) de noodklok luidt omdat het oplossen van misdaden in gevaar komt

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether the NFI's warning that solving crimes is at risk means the planned THC testing for the cannabis measure lacks capacity, and whether the measure should be withdrawn. The minister answered that enforcement will be funded within existing budgets, the NFI is drafting a contour plan still under discussion, and the core production and capacity for investigations will be safeguarded; the measure will not be withdrawn.
Enforcement of the measure will take place within the existing budgetary frameworks.
De handhaving van de maatregel zal binnen de bestaande budgettaire kaders plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over de stelselverantwoordelijkheid in de jeugdzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Health who is responsible for investigating a child death in Rotterdam, and where national versus municipal responsibility lies in youth care. The State Secretary answered that the joint national inspectorates supervise the Youth Act, that Rotterdam asked the Inspectie Jeugdzorg to investigate, and that the Rijk bears system responsibility which may lead to adjusting rules if the system malfunctions.
Rotterdam's request to the Inspectie Jeugdzorg to carry out this investigation is in line with these agreements.
Het verzoek dat de gemeente Rotterdam heeft gedaan aan de Inspectie Jeugdzorg om dit onderzoek uit te voeren is in lijn met deze afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over snoepautomaten in ziekenhuizen

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about a survey showing most hospitals offer candy and snack vending machines, with few healthy options, and whether hospitals should adopt specific healthy-food policies and broad agreements. The Minister acknowledged the survey, said healthy choice is a goal but hospital management is responsible for its own layout, and pointed to existing guidelines and the Alles is Gezondheid programme without committing to new binding action.
Responsibility for the layout of a hospital lies with the relevant hospital board.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de inrichting van een ziekenhuis ligt bij het betreffende bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de opkomst van drunkorexia

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the rise of 'drunkorexia' (heavy drinking combined with restricted eating), its health effects, prevalence, prevention activities and available help. The State Secretary answered that there is no specific data or prevention activity on the phenomenon, that no further research or campaigns are planned for now, and that GP and GGZ practice support exist.
For the time being, I see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over minutenregistratie voor persoonsgebonden budgetten

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked whether insurers' requirement to declare personal budget care in five-minute blocks, and their earlier promise to act against minute registration, would be addressed. The Secretary of State says insurers will change their declaration method in consultation with ZN and Per Saldo so pgb holders can declare in a way comparable to the AWBZ, with some insurers needing time to adjust their forms.
In consultation with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) and Per Saldo it was discussed that this creates an undesirable situation for pgb holders.
In overleg met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) en Per Saldo is besproken dat dit voor pgb-houders een onwenselijke situatie oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de inkoop van wijkverpleegkundigen voor het sociale wijkteam

MP Wolbert asked whether CZ's refusal to fund a community nurse for social neighbourhood teams in six Parkstad municipalities endangers care access, and about adequacy of the 40 million euro budget and future funding to 200 million. The State Secretary answered that individual community nursing care is contracted in those municipalities, that not every social team needs a nurse, and that the government will talk with stakeholders to ensure integrated care is delivered.
In the coming period I will again talk with the parties involved to ensure that the intended integrated care continues to be delivered.
De komende tijd ga ik wederom met betrokken partijen in gesprek om er voor te zorgen dat er de beoogde integrale zorg geleverd blijft worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat Utrecht al 600 klachten heeft ontvangen over de thuiszorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that Utrecht received 600 complaints over home-care cuts, the 'Schoon huis' collective provision, reduced hours after file reviews, and whether this fits the Wmo 2015. The state secretary said the complaints are objections under the Awb, that the VNG and he are promoting careful procedures, that the courts will rule on the disputed cases, that huishoudelijke hulp is judged by outcome, and that he lacks the requested overview of objections per municipality.
I do not have the requested overview and for that reason cannot comply with your request.
Ik beschik niet over het gevraagde overzicht en kan om die reden niet aan uw verzoek voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Aanvraag bij Wet Langdurige Zorg stagneert, omdat oudere geen paspoort of ID heeft”

An MP asked why residents of care institutions must submit a copy of their passport or ID for Wlz applications from 1 January 2015, whether this delays applications, and how elderly or demented people can apply for identity documents without visiting the town hall or signing. The state secretary explained the statutory identity check, acknowledged the requirement will be amended since a citizen service number suffices, and said municipalities can use mobile equipment and home visits at their discretion.
Article 9.1.1, sixth paragraph of the Wlz will therefore be amended.
Artikel 9.1.1, zesde lid van de Wlz zal daarom worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het intrekken van een indicatie voor wijkverpleging twee dagen voor ingang nieuwe zorgverdeling tussen gemeenten, Rijk en zorgverzekeraars

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether a family was wrongly told, two days before the new long-term care law took effect, that their son's intensive child care falls under the municipality, and how many others received similar notices. The State Secretary answered that insurers initially used too narrow a benefit scope, corrected it in December, that the family's case was handled in line with agreements, and that data transfers to municipalities and the SVB have been corrected.

Health insurers received an update in December on the scope of entitlement of the affected insured persons and on that basis re-informed them about the care they receive under the Health Insurance Act and the budget amount.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben in december een update ontvangen van de omvang van de aanspraak van de betreffende verzekerden en hebben op basis daarvan hun verzekerden opnieuw geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het faillissement van Pantein/Vivent

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Pantein/Vivent, including the role of budget cuts, the transfer of staff to ZuidZorg, executive pay and the stille bewindvoering period. The State Secretary largely declined to comment on the causes and finances of the bankruptcy, pointing to the court and curator, and said municipalities are responsible for continuity of care while promising ongoing monitoring.
It is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the organisation.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de klachten van 24000 mensen in Gelderland en Overijssel over de veranderingen in de zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a regional survey in which nearly 24,000 people in Gelderland and Overijssel voiced worries about cuts, care quality, affordability and mantelzorg burdens under the Wmo and Wlz reforms. The State Secretary answered that the survey predates the changes, that the government will monitor experiences and report in April, and that municipalities and insurers bear primary responsibility for communication and individual support.
In April I will send you a report giving an overview of the progress and developments of the changes in long-term care and support up to the first quarter of 2015.
In april a.s. zal ik u een rapportage toezenden waarin ik een beeld zal geven over het verloop en de ontwikkelingen van de veranderingen in de langdurige zorg en ondersteuning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over ‘de ellende met de keukentafelgesprekken’

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary for Health about problems with municipal kitchen-table assessment conversations under the new Wmo 2015, including cuts to home care hours, telephone handling, costs and training. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for implementation, that the state lacks national data, that legal safeguards and appeal rights apply, and that intervention is possible only for serious, systemic failures.
If a municipal executive does not carry out the legally required investigation properly, the client has the right to hold the municipality to account, if necessary through objection and appeal.

Indien een college het op basis van de Wmo 2015 verplichte onderzoek in vervolg op een melding niet zorgvuldig uitvoert, heeft de cliënt het recht de gemeente hierop aan te spreken, zo nodig in bezwaar en beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de loondump en dreigende ontslagen bij Verian

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether Verian's pressure on Nijmegen home-care staff to accept a 20% pay cut under threat of dismissal is lawful, and whether the executive pay, municipal duty of care and Verian itself should be intervened on. The State Secretary answered that employers cannot unilaterally cut pay, that a changed job offer can be refused with dismissal then reviewed by UWV under reasonableness criteria, that the WNT pay norm applies to executives, and that municipalities are responsible for continuity of care under the Wmo 2015 and Verian must comply with the rules.
An employer cannot unilaterally reduce the employee's wage.
Een werkgever kan niet eenzijdig het loon van de werknemer verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht 'Gamen tot je niet meer kunt stoppen'

MP Rebel asks the state secretary for health about a report that 4-5% of 13-40 year olds are game-addicted, and about trends, consequences, prevention, developer responsibility, the Game On fund, loneliness and treatment evidence. The state secretary is cautious about the diagnosis, notes rising treatment demand, describes prevention initiatives, declines to fund a cost study, and promises a broader view on addiction treatment later in the year.
I will consider further research and return to it in the vision on addiction care promised during the committee debate, which you can expect around the summer of this year.
Ik zal mij beraden op nader onderzoek en daarop terugkomen in de tijdens het AO-Verslavingszorg toegezegde visie die u rond de zomer van dit jaar kunt verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Leijten over de uitbetaling van zorgverleners van pgb-houders door de Sociale Verzekeringsbank

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked about SVB payments to care workers of personal budget (pgb) holders, including leaked contracts with citizen service numbers, the number of monthly versus declaration-based workers, and the Rapid Response Team. The State Secretary acknowledged the incidents, gave partial figures (68,000 monthly-paid workers, about 130,000 declaration-based), refused a breakdown by pgb type for now, and promised to share the steering group documents in the evaluation.
Within the short timeframe for answering these questions, it is not possible to provide a breakdown into Wlz-pgb, Wmo-pgb and Jeugdwet-pgb.
Binnen de korte termijn voor beantwoording van voorliggende vragen is het niet mogelijk om een uitsplitsing te geven in Wlz-pgb, Wmo-pgb en Jeugdwet-pgb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de Nieuwsuur uitzending “De gemeente moet het doen”

An MP asked the state secretary about a Nieuwsuur broadcast showing municipal Wmo home-care intake conversations, and whether Apeldoorn's practice breached the Wmo 2015 investigation duty and its approach to self-reliance. The secretary said the broadcast excerpt cannot support conclusions about the adequacy of the investigation, reiterated that all municipalities were reminded of their duties, and noted the municipality says it follows the Wmo structure.
I cannot tell from the broadcast that Apeldoorn interprets self-reliance as financial self-reliance.
Ik kan uit de uitzending niet opmaken dat Apeldoorn zelfredzaamheid uitlegt als financiële zelfredzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de huishoudelijke hulp toelage

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport why promised job retention in home care via the huishoudelijke hulp toelage (HHT) has not materialised, and questions tariffs, eligibility for low-income clients, administrative burden and the role of gemeenten. The State Secretary answers that it is too early to quantify jobs saved, that nearly all municipalities will use the HHT, and that tariffs, co-financing and administrative requirements are matters for municipalities and providers, with VWS only monitoring effectiveness.
This means that at present there is no insight into the number of jobs in employment that could be retained up to now.
Dit betekent dat op dit moment geen inzicht bestaat in het aantal banen in loondienst dat tot op dit moment kon worden behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de begeleiding van pleegouders in de Jeugdwet

MP Siderius asked whether the Youth Act's ban on a foster-care supervisor also being a foster parent at the same agency blocks experienced foster parents from mentoring prospective foster parents, and whether foster-parent corporations are desirable. The State Secretary answered that the rule only prevents conflicts of interest for supervisors, that foster parents may mentor each other, and that he will inform Jeugdzorg Nederland to clarify the rule.
To prevent further confusion I will inform Jeugdzorg Nederland about how article 5.1, first paragraph, part b, of the Youth Act works
Om verdere onduidelijkheid te voorkomen zal ik Jeugdzorg Nederland over de werking van artikel 5.1, eerste lid, onderdeel b, van de Jeugdwet informeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over de crowdfundingsite www.geefgezondheid.nu

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that people with health needs must compete for donations on the crowdfunding site geefgezondheid.nu, whether the government will make the site unnecessary by ensuring insurers and municipalities cover needs, and whether it will analyse crowdfunding requests for wrongly denied care. The minister answered that eligibility decisions rest with insurers and municipalities, that crowdfunded items fall outside or only partly within the basic package and that the government has no duty there, and declined to analyse the requests.
These concern forms of care or provisions that are not part of the basic Zvw package or only partly fall under the Wmo
Het gaat hier om zorgvormen of voorzieningen die geen onderdeel zijn van het basispakket van de Zvw of slechts ten dele vallen onder de Wmo
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat oud-cliënten van zorginstelling Pyxis zelf hun persoonsgebonden budget aan Agis Zorgkantoor moeten terugbetalen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether former clients of care provider Pyxis should be forced to repay their personal budgets to Agis Zorgkantoor, and what the government will do about the fraud-related situation and the SVB's readiness to detect pgb fraud. The state secretary said an investigation is ongoing, repayment claims are suspended, talks on support for good-faith budget holders are underway, and the new trekkingsrecht system improves monitoring, while declining to comment on the criminal case.
Because of the ongoing investigation, I cannot respond substantively to the situation.
Vanwege het lopende onderzoek kan ik niet inhoudelijk op de situatie reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over communicatie van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank inzake pgb-overeenkomsten richting gemeenten

An MP asked the state secretary about delays by the Sociale Verzekeringsbank in confirming personal budget holders' care contracts, unreachable phone lines, and the list of unconfirmed contracts sent to municipalities. The secretary acknowledged the delays, said reminder letters crossed with submitted documents, described the phone capacity fix, and announced measures to ensure timely payments in January.
In my letter of 20 January I informed you of measures prepared to make timely payment of care providers possible.
In mijn brief van 20 januari jl. heb ik u geïnformeerd over maatregelen die zijn voorbereid om het tijdig uitbetalen van zorgverleners mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Thieme over de positie van identiteitsgebonden zorgcentra met een landelijke functie

MPs Leijten and Thieme asked whether the vegetarian care home Felixoord, which has a national identity-based function, should be protected from closure caused by decentralisation and the shift to home care. The State Secretary replied that care providers must prepare for fewer light-care residents, that no national status exists for care homes since 2001, that contracting must offer a varied supply, and that he knows of no other identity-based homes threatened.
I have no signals that specifically identity-based care centres are threatened in their continued existence.
Ik heb geen signalen dat specifiek identiteitsgebonden zorgcentra in hun voortbestaan worden bedreigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat het aantal daklozen stijgt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about reported rises in homelessness, particularly among young and elderly people, and whether municipalities are equipped to handle it. The government answered that the figures reflect more people receiving support rather than more homeless people, referred debt-collection questions to the Finance State Secretary, and noted that municipalities are responsible and adequately equipped.
For answering this question I refer to the reply letter of 13 January 2015 from the State Secretary of Finance.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vraag verwijs ik naar de antwoordbrief van 13 januari 2015 van de Staatssecretaris van Financiën
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over thuiszorgorganisatie Vérian die zelfstandige thuishulpen vraagt na een massaontslag

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether thuiszorg organisation Vérian, after dismissing 127 employed home helpers, was rehiring them as self-employed alfa-helpers and whether this undermined policy against such constructions. The State Secretary said dismissals are for UWV or the courts, that Vérian reports no dismissed staff working via its subsidiary, that no broad use of such constructions is known, and that the matter has been referred to an intervention team.
I have now asked the Intervention Team for Reform of Long-Term Care, led by Doekle Terpstra, to look into this further.
Ik heb het Interventieteam Hervorming langdurige zorg onder leiding van Doekle Terpstra inmiddels gevraagd om dit verder na te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de onrust onder budgethouders over uitbetaling van het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

Green Left MP Ellemeet asked the state secretary about unrest among personal budget (pgb) holders over payment delays and SVB administration problems, including unreachability and missing contracts. The state secretary answered that controls were postponed to keep care payments on time, that about 50,000 budget holders are covered, that 43,000 received provisional allocations, and that controls will follow within three months.
I aim to have these controls carried out afterwards, within three months at the latest.
Ik streef er naar om deze controles uiterlijk binnen 3 maanden alsnog uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het onderzoek van de Inspectie van de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) naar de zelfdoding van een bewoner in De Golfstroom

An MP asked the State Secretary why the health inspectorate's investigation into a resident's suicide at De Golfstroom was reported inconsistently, whether whistleblowers at De Vrijwaard were ignored, and how families and contacts were handled. The State Secretary answered that a case mix-up occurred, that the investigation decision dated from 18 November 2014, that the inspectorate asks providers to investigate first, and that families were involved.
The decision dates from 18 November 2014, following receipt and study of the report.
Het besluit dateert van 18 november 2014, volgend op de ontvangst en bestudering van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kerstens over het ontslag van bijna 2000 medewerkers van Thebe

MPs Wolbert and Kerstens asked about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Thebe, which left nearly 2,000 workers jobless, and what municipalities and the Wmo framework do to keep clients and workers in place. The state secretary answered that the curator, municipalities and other providers (TSN, Tzorg) are securing continuity for most clients and offering jobs, that some municipalities have revised their policies, and that the government is following developments closely without committing to new measures.
We closely follow the efforts and progress of the municipalities concerned.
Wij volgen de inspanningen en vorderingen van de betrokken gemeenten nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het door Thebe zelf aangevraagde faillissement van Thebe Thuiszorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy requested by Thebe of its home-care subsidiary Thebe Thuiszorg, affecting about 2,000 staff, including concerns about wage dumping, pay of executives, and continuity of care. The State Secretary regretted the situation, said the bankruptcy is a court matter and that he will not comment on the company's finances, and pointed to takeover arrangements by other providers and municipal responsibility for continuity of care.

Moreover, now that the court has ruled on the basis of all information available to it, it is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the organisation.

Het is, te meer nu de rechtbank tot een uitspraak is gekomen op basis van alle hem ter beschikking staande informatie, niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het faillissement van Thebe

MPs asked whether Brabant municipalities stopping household help for some clients on 1 January 2015 conflicts with a court ruling and the duty of care, and whether the State Secretary would intervene in the bankruptcy of Thebe. The State Secretary answered that municipalities must assess clients individually, that a categorical termination is not allowed, that he has informed all Wmo aldermen, and that the court and curator handle the bankruptcy, so he declined to comment on Thebe's finances.
A categorical termination of an ongoing provision is not permitted under the law.
Een categoriale stopzetting van een lopende voorziening is niet toegestaan op grond van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over verkeerde beddenproblematiek Verpleging en Verzorging (V&V) en Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

An MP asked about patients with GGZ-C psychiatric problems receiving V&V nursing care, the loss of coverage after the transfer of GGZ-C to municipalities, and whether these clients must arrange their own GP and paramedical care. The Secretary of State answered that municipalities are responsible for the care, that GP and pharmacy care stays covered under the Zvw, and that access to the Wlz for GGZ clients will be based on objective criteria pending a Zorginstituut framework.
As promised to your House, there will in future also be access to the Wlz for GGZ clients based on objective, substantive criteria.
Zoals aan uw Kamer toegezegd zal er in de toekomst ook voor ggz-cliënten toegang zijn tot de Wlz op basis van objectieve, inhoudelijke criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Leijten over ID-scanners

MPs Voordewind and Leijten asked the State Secretary for Health about ID-scanners for age checks in alcohol and tobacco sales, including the independence of the Bureau Nuchter mystery-shop research, the Trimbos findings on their effectiveness, and the State Lottery co-funding of scanners. The State Secretary answered that scanners are only a supporting tool within a broader approach, that the ministry will commission the national mystery-shop study from Bureau Nuchter with a scientific committee checking its objectivity, and that the state is not formally a shareholder of the State Lottery.

In response to the questions about conflicts of interest, Bureau Nuchter itself proposed setting up a scientific committee to test the objectivity of this research, and I have responded positively to this.

Naar aanleiding van de gestelde vragen over belangenverstrengeling heeft Bureau Nuchter zelf voorgesteld om een wetenschappelijke commissie in te stellen die de objectiviteit van dit onderzoek zal toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een gehandicapte bewoner bij Cordaan

MP Leijten asked the state secretary about the death of a 19-year-old resident at a Cordaan care home, including the IGZ and police investigations, family involvement, staffing with temporary workers, and parents' concerns. The state secretary answered that the IGZ has asked Cordaan to investigate and report, that no criminal investigation is underway, and that the inspectorate will assess the report and speak with the family, but declined to give details while the assessment is pending.
Pending this assessment by the inspectorate, I cannot go into this further.
Hangende deze beoordeling door de inspectie kan ik hier niet nader op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over het artikel “Ondernemer profiteert van zorgboerderij; Fraudemelding tot op heden nog door niemand serieus genomen”

An MP asked the State Secretary about press reports of PGB (personal budget) fraud at care farms and claims that fraud reports were not taken seriously by oversight bodies. The government answered that it lacks data on PGB spending at care farms, cannot trace the specific reports, describes intensified home visits and an evaluation, and says a public blacklist is not permitted for privacy reasons.
For privacy reasons, however, it is not possible to make public the names of persons convicted under criminal law.
Om redenen van privacy is het echter niet mogelijk om de namen van personen die strafrechtelijk zijn veroordeeld openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht op de site van de Algemene Rekenkamer “Aandachtspunten bij begroting 2015 Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport”

An MP asked the state secretary about Court of Audit warnings on risks to PGB (personal budget) payments in 2015, including whether data transfers and contract approvals would be ready in time and what fallback arrangements exist. The state secretary answered that fallback scenarios have been agreed with VNG, ZN and SVB to keep care continuous, including ex officio approval and payment outside the SVB system, and that municipalities are not obliged to issue new decisions to existing budget holders.
In consultation with the parties involved (VNG, ZN and SVB) I have developed fallback scenarios in case matters are not yet completed by crucial dates.
Ik heb in overleg met de betrokken partijen (VNG, ZN en SVB) terugvalscenario's ontwikkeld mochten er op cruciale data zaken nog niet afgerond zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over het bericht: “Zorgvernieuwing… Op papier”

The MP asks whether the paper-based reimbursement system for dental care in AWBZ institutions is outdated, why it has not been modernised, whether fraud risk warrants faster change, whether digitisation would reduce costs, and whether other long-term care systems are outdated. The Secretary of State agrees the system needs renewal but leaves timing to CAK and Zorgverzekeraars Nederland, sees no evidence of fraud, and says a digital system could be more user-friendly while declining to estimate costs.
I leave it to CAK and ZN to choose a suitable moment to renew this part of the declaration system.
Ik laat het aan CAK en ZN om een geschikt moment te kiezen om dit onderdeel van de declaratiesystematiek te vernieuwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Van ’t Wout over het bericht dat ouderen vaker slachtoffer zijn van geweld

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary for Health about a CBS report showing a rise in violence against elderly people, its causes, and whether additional measures to protect older people are planned. The government said the causes are unclear, pointed to ongoing action plans, prevention campaigns and a care-sector warning register, and said police and prosecutors do not record elder abuse specifically so no sentencing figures can be given.
The police and the public prosecution service do not record specifically on elder abuse.
Politie en het openbaar ministerie registreren niet specifiek op ouderenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over het bericht “Malafide zorgondernemers komen te makkelijk weg”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a care provider closed by the Inspectorate could reappear under another name, and whether the care office (Achmea) fulfilled its fraud-fighting duty in the Ascensio case. The State Secretary answered that the sanction also binds the successor Infinitus, that the care office acted correctly while its fraud investigation continues, and promised a programme plan on fraud in spring 2015.
I am therefore of the view that my order to cease care provision and transfer clients, as it now applies to Ascensio, also applies to Infinitus.
Ik ben dan ook van mening dat mijn aanwijzing tot staken van de zorgverlening en overdracht van de cliënten zoals die zich nu richt op Ascensio zich ook richt op Infinitus.
