Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat minderjarigen nog steeds alcohol kunnen kopen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a CBL-commissioned mystery-shopper study showing minors can still buy alcohol, and whether the CBL and any conflicts of interest were checked. The State Secretary answered that compliance rose from 54% to 62%, that the ministry's own study will be leading, and that he cannot rule out that supermarkets were forewarned.
I cannot rule that out because I am not responsible for the study that the CBL commissioned.
Ik kan dat niet uitsluiten want ik ga niet over het onderzoek dat het CBL heeft laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de dreigende sluiting van de beademingsafdeling in Zuidhorn

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Health Minister and State Secretary whether the threatened closure of the chronic ventilation ward in Zuidhorn, which serves patients with conditions such as muscle diseases, is acceptable given unclear financing, and how structural funding will be secured. The State Secretary denied any closure is threatened, said the NZa and the care office are seeking adequate financing with Zuidhorn, and declined to convene the parties for now.
There is no question of an imminent closure.
Er is geen sprake van een dreigende sluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de eigen bijdrage binnen de Jeugdwet

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the parental contribution for residential youth psychiatric care (up to €900–1,500 per year) deters access to specialist care and what would be done about it. The State Secretary explained the contribution's basis in parental maintenance duties, listed exemptions and hardship arrangements, and said no new measures were planned.
As I indicated in answer 2, the Youth Act takes into account situations in which it is difficult to pay a parental contribution.
Zoals ik in antwoord 2 heb aangegeven houdt de Jeugdwet rekening met situaties waarin het moeilijk is om een ouderbijdrage te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Kooiman over problemen bij Fier Friesland met de budgetten specialistische functies

MPs Siderius and Kooiman asked why specialised national services of Fier Friesland still lack funding agreements for 2015 and whether budgets, shelter for foreign trafficking victims and their children, and the transfer of AWBZ and youth mental health funds to municipalities have been properly arranged. The State Secretary answered that agreements exist through the VNG framework, that municipalities decide on purchasing, that central shelter (COSM) is extended to 2017, and that the government will monitor the transition and revisit the 2015 budget in spring with the VNG, while declining several requests such as a pilot status, a transfer to the Ministry of Security and Justice, or a trust account.
It is up to the municipalities to make agreements on the design and financing of care provision for victims of trafficking in human beings and their children.
Het is aan de gemeenten om afspraken te maken over de vormgeving en financiering van het zorgaanbod voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel en hun kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de inrichting van een adviesteam door de Raad voor de kinderbescherming

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about the Child Protection Board's new advisory team, its overlap with Veilig Thuis, privacy safeguards, medical expertise and the meldcode. The government answered that the advisory role supports municipalities without shifting responsibility, that the Board and Veilig Thuis are complementary, and that privacy and forensic medical procedures are regulated.
When a municipality consults the Board, responsibility for the report and therefore for the child's safety remains with the municipality.
Als een gemeente de Raad consulteert, blijft de verantwoordelijkheid voor de melding en dus voor de veiligheid van het kind bij de gemeente liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de berichten dat kinderen steeds vaker in aanraking komen met e-sigaretten

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of children using e-cigarettes and shisha pens at fairs and toy stores, and whether the government would act. The secretary answered that a minimum sales age for nicotine e-cigarettes and strict advertising rules will be introduced with the EU Tobacco Products Directive, that the gateway effect is still unknown pending RIVM and NVWA research, and that municipalities can address fair sales through permit conditions.
In addition, under the new European Tobacco Products Directive, strict rules will apply to the advertising and promotion of e-cigarettes.
Daarnaast zullen, op grond van de nieuwe Europese Tabaksproductenrichtlijn, strenge regels gaan gelden ten aanzien van de reclame en promotie van e-sigaretten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over kinderen in Friesland die vanwege de stelselwijziging niet tijdig adequate zorg krijgen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether children in Friesland who apply before the 2015 youth care reform will face waiting lists and delayed care, and how transfer to municipalities will be arranged. The State Secretary answered that children with an existing indication keep their entitlement under transitional law and are not automatically waitlisted, that a warm handover agreement is being arranged with VNG, CIZ and insurers, and that Friesland aims to have no children on the waiting list by 31 December 2014.
It is certainly not the case that these children automatically end up on a waiting list.
Het is zeker niet zo dat deze kinderen automatisch op een wachtlijst komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de Mutsaersstichting die wordt bedreigd in haar voortbestaan, waardoor er kwetsbare kinderen op straat dreigen te belanden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the Mutsaersstichting, a youth care provider threatened with collapse over a dispute with municipalities on youth care purchasing, and about the role of the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd. The State Secretary answered that an agreement has been reached, that the TAJ mediated and advised, and that the government will remain involved after 1 January 2015 while leaving first responsibility with municipalities.
Moreover, I will not hesitate to ask municipalities for information where necessary and to inform your House upon request.
Ik zal overigens niet schromen daar waar nodig gemeenten om informatie te vragen en uw Kamer desgevraagd daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het verdeelmodel Wmo 2015 (Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning)

An SP MP asked the state secretary why the regional care-office tariffs for day care and support under the Wmo 2015 are not public, whether gemeenten with more care receive less budget under the new allocation model, and how the model accounts for socio-economic and health differences and financial risks. The state secretary refused to publish the tariffs as market-sensitive and confidential, denied that high-care gemeenten get less, described the objective model's indicators, and committed only to a phased transition and further evaluation.
Het gaat hierbij om «marktgevoelige» en vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het feit dat vele kinderen met lichte verstandelijke beperking en ernstige gedragsproblemen niet in aanmerking komen voor de Wet langdurige zorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary why children with mild intellectual disability and severe behavioural problems, such as the boy Youp, fall outside the Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz) and whether this reflects a selection error and a problem with the transition to the Jeugdwet/Wmo. The state secretary answered that Youp will receive Wlz care next year under the Regeling Wlz-indiceerbaren, that similar cases registered with client organisations may get a one-year decision, and that a decision on the broader group will be considered in 2015.
Given the situation of Youp and his family, it is desirable to treat him nonetheless as belonging to the group of clients covered by the Wlz-indiceerbaren regulation.
Gezien de situatie van Youp en zijn familie is het wenselijk hem alsnog te behandelen als behorende tot de groep cliënten die onder de regeling Wlz-indiceerbaren vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over “de zelfdoding van een bewoner van De Golfstroom naar aanleiding van een gedwongen verhuizing"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that staff warnings of suicide risk were ignored at care institution De Golfstroom after a forced relocation, whether it is desirable that an institution's policy leads to a wish to die and that a director said suicide 'can be a choice', and why the institution lacks a works council. The State Secretary said the Inspectorate will examine whether signals were adequately addressed, declined to interpret the director's remark, and explained the statutory works council rules and the exemption route used at De Golfstroom.
The inspectorate will take into account in its investigation whether this was sufficiently done.
De inspectie zal in haar onderzoek meenemen of dat hier voldoende gebeurd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Modale inkomens veel meer kwijt aan eigen bijdragen”

MP Keijzer asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about press reports that middle-income households pay much more in co-payments, including whether the VNG model regulation on co-payments for general provisions should include an anti-cumulation rule and whether income-based co-payments for general provisions amount to income policy. The State Secretary answered that municipalities, under council control, must set proportionate co-payments and consider cumulative effects case by case, that the model regulation need not include generic anti-cumulation rules, and that no separate study of the effects was planned.
I consider it important that municipalities, supervised by the municipal council, pursue an appropriate co-payment policy for the use of general provisions by people with disabilities.
Ik vind het van belang dat gemeenten, gecontroleerd door de gemeenteraad, een passend eigen bijdragebeleid voeren ten aanzien van het gebruik van algemene voorzieningen door mensen met beperkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over thuiswonende dementerenden die te vaak onvrijwillige zorg ontvangen

MP Kuzu asked the State Secretary about coercive care for home-living people with dementia, including what the government is doing to reduce it and the roles of municipalities, other actors and the Inspectorate. The State Secretary answered that the Zorg en Dwang bill, pending in the Senate, will set conditions for coercion at home, that an action programme is underway, and that the Inspectorate acts on reports from care providers but cannot act against coercion by family carers.
In contrast to coerced restriction of liberty in institutional care, there is no duty to report involuntary care in the home situation to the IGZ.
In tegenstelling tot gedwongen vrijheidsbeperking in de intramurale zorg, bestaat er voor onvrijwillige zorg in de thuissituatie geen meldplicht bij de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten “Mantelzorger niet in beeld”en “Mantelzorgers voelen zich soms zwaar belast”

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that many municipalities do not identify informal carers and that carers, including older ones, face overload. The secretary answers that the Wmo 2015 requires integral assessment of carers' capacity, cites guidance and a new respite care handbook, and states that municipalities will receive extra funds for carer support.
No current figures are available on the extent of informal care provided by people aged 50 and over.
Er zijn geen actuele cijfers beschikbaar omtrent de omvang van informele zorg die door 50-plussers wordt verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over twee Britten die door Amsterdamse drugs zijn overleden

An MP asked the state secretaries about two British tourists who died after taking heroin sold as cocaine in Amsterdam, and about warning signs and prevention. The government answered that the deaths likely stem from misleading cocaine sales, that no incident data on misleading sales exists, that warning signs were posted for about three weeks without recorded incidents, and that prevention policy will be reviewed after a Trimbos study expected at year end.
I do not have figures on the scale of incidents involving misleading sales.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers met betrekking tot de omvang van incidenten door misleidende verkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het artikel op de site van Binnenlands Bestuur "Gemeenten vrezen big bang rondom trekkingsrecht"

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Binnenlands Bestuur article on municipal fears over the PGB trekkingsrecht (payment authorisation) launch, including extra costs shifted to municipalities, unpaid care providers and ICT misalignment with the SVB. The State Secretary answered that the process is being intensified with the VNG, that continuity of care is the priority, that costs and financing are still under discussion, and that fallback scenarios exist for specific parts rather than a single go/no-go moment.
I am currently in consultation with the VNG on the further elaboration of the fallback scenarios.
Ik ben momenteel in overleg met de VNG over de nadere uitwerking van de terugvalscenario's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over pleegkinderen die na hun 18de verjaardag in een zwart gat vallen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how to prevent foster children and other youths from falling through the gap when youth care ends at 18, including a single help desk and legal guarantees for the transition. The State Secretary answered that the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet already require municipalities to plan continuity of care, that care can be extended to age 23, and that ZN and VNG are working on information transfer, but gave no figure on how many municipalities have concrete arrangements.
I will keep urging municipalities and health insurers to give substance to this.
Ik blijf er bij gemeenten en zorgverzekeraars op aandringen hier invulling aan te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Rutte over het wetenschappelijk onderzoek waaruit onder meer blijkt dat het gebruik van cannabis schadelijk is voor de gezondheid, leidt tot een lagere intelligentie en bi

MPs Van der Steur and Rutte asked the government about research linking cannabis use to health harm, lower intelligence and early school leaving, including the Addiction article, cannabis-driving risk, schizophrenia, IQ and school dropout figures. The state secretary answered each question, noting evidence is mixed on causality, that Dutch dropout has fallen, and that cannabis use before 18 should be discouraged.
The original article that Elsevier refers to, published in the journal Addiction, has been added as an annex.
Het oorspronkelijke artikel waaraan Elsevier refereert en dat verschenen is in het blad Addiction is als bijlage toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Segers over draagmoederschap

Two MPs asked the government about surrogacy, including unregulated online matching, risks to children, enforcement under the Criminal Code, and the status of existing policy. The Secretary of State answered that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming investigates only when it learns of a possible surrogacy arrangement, that reporting and a new reporting structure are not needed, that enforcement is limited and largely left to the Public Prosecution Service, and that policy will await the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap, expected in 2016.
It is not inconceivable that single men also make contact with potential surrogate mothers.
Het is niet ondenkbaar dat ook alleenstaande mannen contact leggen met potentiële draagmoeders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van 't Wout en Visser over het bericht “Gehandicapte niet welkom in Utrecht door milieuregels”

MPs Van 't Wout and Visser asked the state secretary about reports that people with mobility-aid vehicles are excluded by Utrecht's environmental zone rules. The secretary said the zone targets vehicles rather than users, that the municipality offers subsidies and possible exemptions, and that the specific case is under municipal review.
I am of the view that measures benefiting the environment should in principle apply to both people with and without a disability.
Ik ben van mening dat maatregelen die ten goede komen aan het milieu in beginsel zowel voor mensen met als zonder een beperking dienen te gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het advies objectief verdeelmodel Wmo 2015 van de Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will adopt the Rfv's advice against introducing the objective Wmo 2015 distribution model for centre municipalities on 1 January 2015, given large redistribution effects and cuts, and about transition arrangements, contracts and GGZ-C criteria. The state secretary agreed the model should not be introduced in 2015, kept historical budgets for next year, committed to a transition path and consultation with the VNG and providers, but referred some matters to municipalities and the Zorginstituut.
I share this conclusion. It was never the intention to introduce an objective distribution model on 1 January 2015.
Ik deel deze conclusie. Het is ook nooit de bedoeling geweest een objectief verdeelmodel per 1 januari 2015 in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over de kwaliteit van zorg in een Haags verpleeghuis

An MP asks the State Secretary about care quality at a Hague nursing home, including a spouse covering shifts due to staff shortages, medication and hygiene concerns, and unheeded client council warnings. The State Secretary says the IGZ inspectorate is responsible for judging care quality, reports voluntary-level findings of staffing, expertise and medication safety improvement points, and points to a forthcoming improvement programme.
The judgement on whether responsible care is being provided is a responsibility of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
Het oordeel op de vraag of er verantwoorde zorg wordt geleverd, is een verantwoordelijkheid van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over twee urgente patiënten in een huisartsenpraktijk die de afgelopen week niet opgenomen konden worden in een verzorgings/verpleeghuis terwijl kamers leeg staan

Two SP MPs asked why two urgent patients could not be admitted to a care or nursing home while beds were reportedly empty, and whether doorzettingsmacht for GPs was possible. The State Secretary replied that providers hold crisis capacity and a 24-hour solution is required, that one patient chose to wait and the other died, and that a check on the number of wait-listed urgent cases would be reported in November.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de toezegging uit het debat over de Wet langdurige zorg, waarin hij aangeeft dat het aantal dagdelen KDC geen norm kan zijn voor een Wlz indicatie

The MP asks whether CIZ bodies know that the number of KDC day-part treatment hours cannot be the norm for a Wlz indication, and how children below eight hours are treated. The State Secretary confirms the position, says children with lower hours but Wlz-level care needs are covered by additional transitional rules, and confirms that permanent supervision or 24-hour nearby care suffices for new clients.
Children who currently have fewer than 8 day-parts of group treatment but may be eligible for the Wlz given their care needs will still be included under the additional transitional arrangement.
Kinderen die nu minder dan 8 dagdelen behandeling-groep hebben maar gezien hun zorgzwaarte toegang kunnen hebben tot de Wlz worden alsnog meegenomen onder het extra overgangsrecht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over leeftijdscontrole bij alcoholgebruik

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about ministry contacts with the food and alcohol industry on age checks for alcohol sales, why a pilot report was only finalised in October 2014, when the ministry learned the pilot's outcome, and industry advertising spending. The state secretary listed Directeuren Overleg Alcohol and regular alcohol policy meetings, said the report was ready in May and will be sent to parliament, noted the pilot's disappointing outcome surfaced in February, and said he has no data on industry marketing spend.
By separate letter you will receive this version ahead of the budget debate.
Middels een separate brief ontvangt u deze versie voorafgaand aan de begrotingsbehandeling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen met betrekking tot onderwijs voor ernstig meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen, kinderen met forse gedragsproblematiek en kinderen met een (zware) verstandelijke beperki

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked how education for severely disabled children is funded from 1 January 2015, whether their right to passend onderwijs is guaranteed, and whether there is handling difficulty among providers and municipalities. The Secretary of State gave figures, explained the shift of care funding to the Jeugdwet, Zvw and Wlz, and said the government will monitor developments, without committing to new research.
I do not recognise the handling difficulty regarding referral to (v)so schools, but I will keep following developments.
Ik herken de handelingsverlegenheid ten aanzien van het doorverwijzen naar scholen voor het (v)so dan ook niet, maar ik zal de ontwikkelingen blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat Philadelphia afziet van het bieden van gehandicaptenzorg aan mensen met een verstandelijke beperking vanwege de nieuwe wetgeving

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked whether the withdrawal of care provider Philadelphia from many municipalities, leaving 450 to 600 people with intellectual disabilities without day care and support, and the need for a uniform basic tariff were acceptable. The State Secretary answered that continuity is guaranteed by transitional rules to 1 January 2016, that municipalities are responsible for procuring the care, that a basic tariff is not appropriate, and that he has no overview of other providers stopping.
I do not have an overview of the number of care providers that stop providing care and support.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal zorgaanbieders wat stopt met het verlenen van zorg en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de benoeming van een partijgenoot als ambassadeur lokale aanpak gezondheidsachterstand

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health why PvdA member Den Besten was appointed ambassador for the local approach to health inequalities, whether the post was filled through an open procedure, its profile, time commitment, fees and her side positions, and whether three PvdA-linked appointments in health-related posts look odd. The State Secretary answers that she was chosen on a profile without an open application procedure, cites her local governance and education-sector experience, states the role takes about 12 days a year with a 12,000 euro compensation to the PO-raad, lists three supervisory side positions, and denies any link between the separate appointments.
On the basis of a profile, a number of persons were considered and the choice fell on Ms Den Besten.
Op basis van een profielschets is een aantal personen de revue gepasseerd en is de keuze gevallen op mevrouw Den Besten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over diens reactie op de zelfdoding van een bewoner van woonzorgcentrum De Golfstroom in Den Helder

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether a 10-week IGZ inspection into a resident's suicide at care home De Golfstroom is acceptable, whether forced relocations should be halted, and whether rules are needed to protect frail residents from unilateral eviction by care institutions. The State Secretary defended the 10-week timeframe, said the decision to halt relocations lies with the provider while the inspection runs, and saw no need for separate rules, while the inspection will examine the institution's handling of the case.
Pending the investigation, I cannot make any statements about this.
Hangende het onderzoek kan ik hierover geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over een illegale actiegroep die kinderen verstopt voor jeugdzorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether an illegal action group hiding children from youth care is acceptable, how widespread the practice is, how many children were hidden in 2012-2014, and what measures are being taken. The government answered that the practice is undesirable, that its extent and the number of hidden children are unknown, and that youth care providers report such cases to the police, who handle tracing and investigation.
If a youth care bureau establishes that a young person is being withdrawn from the youth care for which they were assessed, the institution files a report with the police.
Indien een bureau jeugdzorg vaststelt dat een jeugdige onttrokken wordt aan de jeugdzorg waarvoor de jeugdige geïndiceerd is doet de instelling aangifte bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitzending van Radar “ouderen rustig gehouden met medicatie”

An MP asked the state secretary about a broadcast reporting that elderly nursing-home residents are sedated with psychotropic drugs to keep them calm, and about cost, institutional differences and possible sanctions. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to a culture change programme and the pending Zorg en Dwang bill, and said the Inspectorate can act, but committed to no new sanctions or specific study.
The inspectorate supervises this care and can, where necessary, also take measures against institutions.
De inspectie ziet toe op deze zorg en kan zo nodig ook maatregelen nemen tegen instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Salariseis bestuurder verboden in aanbesteding»

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked whether municipalities may impose salary limits in Wmo tenders, and how this relates to a parliamentary amendment and a motion on local top-income norms. The minister replied that salary demands must meet the proportionality principle under the Aanbestedingswet, that the WNT maxima apply in any case, and that talks with VNG and IPO on local top-income norms are ongoing.
Imposing salary requirements as such does not appear to meet this.
Het stellen van salariseisen als zodanig lijkt hier niet aan te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over de steekpartij bij een opvanglocatie voor maatschappelijke opvang in Eindhoven

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a stabbing at a shelter in Eindhoven, how often violence against shelter staff occurs, and whether staff and client safety is adequately guaranteed. The answer says no figures exist on total violent incidents, states that responsibility for safety lies with the shelter institutions, and describes past inspections and the planned Inspectorate SZW checks from November 2014 to February 2015.
No figures are available on the total number of violent incidents against staff in the social shelter sector.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het totaal aantal gewelddadige incidenten tegen personeel in de maatschappelijke opvang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over de informatie aan mensen die nu nog AWBZ-zorg krijgen en die te maken krijgen met wijzigingen per 2015

The SP MPs asked why the health insurance offices (zorgkantoren) dropped planned letters informing about 2015 AWBZ/care changes for about 800,000 clients, and whether the advertising campaign reaches them. The Staatssecretaris answered that the letters were dropped because they were general, could not be personalised, and risked confusing clients; he says the campaign and follow-up communication by municipalities, insurers and offices will inform people, and attached the draft letters.
As attachments to these answers I am sending you the latest versions of the draft letters.
Als bijlagen bij deze antwoorden stuur ik u de laatste versies van de conceptbrieven mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de problemen die het speciaal onderwijs ondervindt bij de bekostiging van medische zorg voor leerlingen

An MP asked whether special schools face insufficient budgets for care (supervision, personal care, nursing) for pupils with severe multiple disabilities after the AWBZ reform and the introduction of passend onderwijs, and about funding, bureaucracy and possible grouping of these pupils. The state secretary answered that care remains secured under the Jeugdwet, Zvw and Wlz, that continuity is provided through transitional rules, that the government is monitoring the situation and working on handreikingen, that a bureaucracy study is underway, and that a separate financing group for these pupils is not desirable.
It is a worrying signal that there are schools for (secondary) special education that indicate at this stage that they have insufficient (visibility of) budgets.
Het is een zorgelijk signaal dat er scholen voor (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs (het (v)so) zijn die in deze fase aangeven onvoldoende (zicht op) budgetten te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert het bericht dat ActiZ en V&VN opnieuw de noodklok luiden over de knip in wijkverpleging

An MP asked the state secretary for Health whether the warnings by ActiZ and V&VN about a cut in district nursing (wijkverpleging) are justified, and how integrated procurement, the link between indication and care, and nurses' referral practices will work. The state secretary denies any cut at provider or individual level, says the rules allow contracting only where providers also deliver individual care, and promises to monitor the procurement talks, though he gives no concrete new step beyond passing the concerns on.
I therefore interpret the letter from Actiz and V&VN as a call from both parties to keep closely monitoring whether parties adhere to what we agreed on in substance.
Ik duid de brief van Actiz en V&VN dan ook als een oproep van beide partijen om scherp te blijven monitoren of partijen zich houden aan hetgeen we in de inhoudelijke lijn zijn overeen gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de beantwoording van vragen over de intensieve kindzorg vanaf 2015

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked how care for intensive child care is divided between the Youth Act and the Health Insurance Act (Zvw), where short-term stays fall, and whether tariffs are adequate. The state secretary answered that all necessary care for intensive child care falls under the Zvw, that short stays are covered by the Zvw, and that insurers are contracting providers with maximum budgets for 2015.
All guidance a young person needs within intensive child care will be provided under the Health Insurance Act.
Alle begeleiding die een jeugdige in het kader van intensieve kindzorg nodig heeft zal vanuit de Zorgverzekeringswet worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over terugkeer naar en re-integratie in landen van herkomst voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the Safe Future method for discussing return to countries of origin with trafficking victims should become a standard task of shelters and be implemented nationally, and about falling reporting rates, identification of victims in asylum centres, and whether a study should be done. The government welcomed the method and said the project organisation is mapping rollout, announced a one-year pilot of interview studios in victim shelters, pointed to existing COA and IND training, and declined a dedicated study of victims in asylum centres.
In the autumn of 2014 a one-year pilot of interview studios in shelters for trafficking victims will therefore be started.
In het najaar van 2014 zal daarom voor de duur van een jaar een pilot verhoorstudio’s in opvanglocaties van slachtoffers mensenhandel worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over het bericht dat het harde drugsbeleid op festivals zowel advocaten als verslavingszorginstellingen te ver gaat

D66 MPs asked whether festival-goers are adequately informed that accepting an on-the-spot fine gives them a criminal record, whether they can consult a lawyer on site, and whether strict drug enforcement at festivals helps health and safety. The Minister of Justice answered that the public prosecutor informs suspects on request, that a suspect can ask for a lawyer and the case is then postponed, and that the effects of enforcement are limited and no harder data exist.
There is no question of a specific strict drug policy at festivals.
Er is geen sprake van een specifiek streng drugsbeleid op festivals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Siderius over de verschraling van de cliëntenondersteuning in de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) en de AWBZ

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked the State Secretary about reported budget cuts, mass dismissals and gaps in client support (cliëntondersteuning) under the Wmo and AWBZ, with 63% of municipalities lacking agreements with MEE. The State Secretary replied that most municipalities had agreed with MEE on paper, that contracts were still being finalised, that monitoring continues, and that no budget guarantee for MEE would be given.
At this moment I have no reason to assume that municipalities will not or insufficiently take their responsibility for client support.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat gemeenten hun verantwoordelijkheid voor cliëntondersteuning niet of onvoldoende zullen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over frictiekosten bij MEE Twente

An SP MP asked the state secretary why friction costs for MEE Twente, a Wmo client support organisation, are not compensated as they were for youth care transition, and whether affected staff can fall back on a wachtgeld scheme. The secretary replied that MEE Twente is primarily responsible for its own obligations using its reserves, that most staff are being taken over by municipalities, that €360 million was made available for transition, and that no national funds for friction costs are warranted.

Because MEE Twente will no longer play a role in providing client support, there is no reason from the national government from the standpoint of continuity of care or preservation of specific functions to provide funds for friction costs.

Omdat MEE Twente in de toekomst geen rol meer speelt bij de levering van cliëntondersteuning is er vanuit oogpunt van continuïteit van zorg c.q. het behoud van specifieke functies geen aanleiding vanuit het rijk middelen voor frictiekosten te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Ypma over de implementatie van het familiegroepsplan door gemeenten

MPs Voordewind and Ypma asked whether the VNG adequately informed municipalities about the legal obligation, from 1 January 2015, to enable use of the family group plan (familiegroepsplan) under the Jeugdwet, and whether municipalities have incorporated it into policy and budgets. The state secretary rejects that the VNG failed seriously, notes municipal policy gives little attention to the plan, and reports a VNG model regulation revision and a factsheet to raise awareness.
As promised in the general debate with your House of 24 September 2014, I have since held consultations with the VNG to examine how awareness of the family group plan can be increased.
Zoals toegezegd in het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer van 24 september 2014 heb ik inmiddels met de VNG overleg gevoerd om te bezien hoe de bekendheid van het familiegroepsplan kan worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het artikel “Absurde bezuiniging zorg ouderen” en “Conflict tussen zorgverzekeraars en aanbieders van langdurige zorg”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that health insurers cut long-term elderly care tariffs and that providers call the cut absurd. The State Secretary answered that the cut matches the expected decline in low care-package volumes, that he agreed with care offices not to impose additional tariff cuts, and that he will monitor volume developments and act if deviations arise.
Furthermore, I have agreed that I will closely monitor the volume developments.
Voorts heb ik afgesproken dat ik de volumeontwikkelingen nauwgezet zal monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat voor driekwart van de jongeren een burn-out dreigt

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports that three quarters of young people risk burn-out, its causes, available treatment, and whether burn-out should be added to the national prevention programme. The secretary answered that burn-out lacks a clear definition and no trend data exist, that psychosocial problems among youth have risen, and that policy focuses on early detection through youth health care and schools rather than burn-out specifically.
Policy is therefore not specifically aimed at preventing and treating burn-outs among young people, but at the early detection of psychosocial problems.
Het beleid is daarom niet specifiek gericht op het voorkomen en behandelen van burn-outs bij jongeren, maar wel op het vroegtijdig signaleren van psychosociale problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Bruins Slot en Van der Staaij over afspraken tussen supermarkten over het weren van effectieve controlesystemen handhaving alcoholleeftijd

MPs asked the state secretary whether supermarkets agreed to exclude effective age-verification systems for alcohol sales, whether this is unacceptable, what the government knew and what it has done about alcohol-age enforcement compliance (around 50%). The state secretary answered that it is up to supermarkets to choose their approach, that the ACM has not closed its investigation into possible prohibited agreements, that the government is monitoring compliance and is reluctant to impose systems, and that a pilot did not improve compliance.
The ministry is not aware of unlawful agreements between supermarkets.
Het ministerie is niet bekend met ongeoorloofde afspraken tussen supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Wolbert over het bericht dat zeker 10% van de grotere zwangerschapscomplicaties kan worden voorkomen als zwangere vrouwen niet meer roken

MPs Rebel and Wolbert asked the minister whether smoking during pregnancy could be cut to prevent complications, and about costs, measures, lifestyle warnings and the role of midwives. The minister agreed that smoking reduction matters, pointed to existing programmes and inspectorate action, and declined to add warnings to medicine leaflets citing EU rules and industry views.
The instrument also takes lifestyle aspects into account.
Het instrument houdt ook rekening met leefstijlaspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat ABN-Amro vreest dat zorginstellingen de hypotheeklasten niet meer kunnen betalen

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether ABN-Amro's fear that care institutions may be unable to pay mortgage costs, and the resulting risk of bankruptcies and loss of care for residents, reflects failed government policy. The state secretary replied that care institutions are generally financially sound, that the total residual debt is estimated at 150 to 350 million euro, that residents keep their rights and care continuity is guaranteed by the care office, and that local government will handle the neighbourhood function.
There is no data available on that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb), Thomashuizen en vastgoed

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about use of personal budgets (pgb) for housing costs in Thomashuizen and Herbergiers, the franchise model, rent levels, and ownership ties to Vestia and MC-groep. The government answers that pgb funds may not be used for housing costs, that accountability by care offices is too general to rule out such use, and that it will consult parties on clearer accountability, while declining to give a figure on how often pgb money covers housing and arguing that ownership changes fall to competition regulators.
How often individual Thomashuizen and Herbergiers spend pgb money on housing costs is not known to me.
Hoe vaak door individuele Thomashuizen en Herbergiers pgb-geld aan woonlasten uit wordt gegeven is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Siderius en Van Gerven over sluikreclame op scholen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether food companies' so-called educational visits to schools (such as Ronald McDonald Shows and Blue Band lesson packs) amount to disguised advertising and should be banned. The Secretary of State answered that the Reclamecode voor Voedingsmiddelen permits such campaigns only with approval from a recognised authority, promised tightened rules by end 2014 and a letter in spring 2015, but rejected a statutory ban.
I expect the intended tightening to be in place by the end of this year. In spring 2015 I will inform you about this and give you my response.
Ik verwacht dat de beoogde aanscherpingen uiterlijk aan het einde van dit jaar tot stand zijn gekomen. In het voorjaar van 2015 zal ik u hierover informeren en u mijn reactie hierop geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de korting van CZ voor verzorgingshuizen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about insurer CZ's 50% cut to nursing-home budgets in Zuid-Limburg, whether it fits the contracting space, and whether residents risk forced relocation. The State Secretary replied that the cut matches the expected national fall in low-care-package volumes for 2015, that existing residents keep their right to an intramural place, and that relocations will be prepared carefully with the care offices bound by a duty of care.
The care offices will respect the rights of existing clients.
De zorgkantoren zullen daarbij de rechten van bestaande cliënten respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Focus op: toegang op orde/crisisopvang"

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked the state secretary how municipal procurement agreements could conflict with the direct referral route by GPs and specialists under the Youth Act, and whether a persoonsgebonden budget could cover providers without a municipal contract. The state secretary replied that municipalities must ensure the youth care is available, that procurement cannot be a reason to refuse necessary care, that interbestuurlijk toezicht is the lever in extreme cases, and that a pgb is one option among others.
Should it appear that a municipality acts in breach of the Youth Act when procuring youth care, the instruments of interadministrative supervision under the Municipalities Act are available to me.

Mocht blijken dat een gemeente bij de inkoop van jeugdhulp in strijd met de Jeugdwet handelt, dan staat mij het instrumentarium van het interbestuurlijk toezicht op grond van de Gemeentewet ter dienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars de wijkverpleging splitsen

Parliamentarian Leijten (SP) asks the State Secretary whether health insurers splitting the district nursing (wijkverpleging) purchasing into two segments undermines the integrated role of the district nurse and creates extra bureaucracy. The State Secretary rejects the premise of splitting the district nurse's work, says the new 'wijkgericht werken' segment is separate from individual care, and agrees with insurers on shared guidelines, while declining to ban the contracting approach and not answering the request to postpone the transfer to the Zvw.
Unfortunately, the answer could not be provided before the Wlz bill was debated.
Helaas is de beantwoording niet voor de behandeling van de Wlz gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het bericht “Rechtbank overstelpt met ouderenberovers”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a report that courts were overwhelmed with robberies of elderly people, and whether this conflicts with the Ouderen in Veilige Handen action plan and policy of longer home living. The State Secretary disputed the trend, citing an 18% drop in robberies of seniors in 2014, described prevention work with Unie KBO and municipalities, and declined to create a separate safety adviser role, pointing to an integrated approach led by municipalities.
I do not recognise the picture.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de chaos in de jeugdzorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the chaos in youth care: budget uncertainty, a possible emergency law, mass dismissals (about 1,450 collective dismissal notices at UWV), possible waiting lists, frictional cost compensation, budget discrepancies with municipalities, dossier transfers and client information. The government answered that it is working with municipalities and the sector through reconciliation talks, a Transitieautoriteit Jeugd, a transitional cost scheme, a sector retraining plan and a public information campaign, while leaving many outcomes uncertain and pointing to municipalities and providers for the details.
You will be informed in a separate letter about the progress of the transition, the agreements we are making with the branches and the VNG, and any regulatory consequences.
U wordt met een afzonderlijke brief over de voortgang van de transitie geïnformeerd, over de afspraken die we met de branches en de VNG maken en over de eventuele regeltechnische consequenties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bergkamp over het bericht dat er geen sprake is van een zachte landing voor de overheveling van zorgtaken en het bericht ‘Brandbrief gemeenten aan Kamer over cijfers’

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked whether the state secretary knew of reports that the client data handed to municipalities for the transfer of care tasks were unreliable, incomplete or unclear, and what would be done about differing figures and late data. The state secretary answered that the data are consistent with earlier policy information, that differences are explained in an information card, and that talks with municipal and care bodies on solutions are ongoing.
Following the reports, I had further analyses carried out on the data.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving heb ik nadere analyses laten uitvoeren op de gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de intensieve kindzorg vanaf 2015

An MP asked how intensive child care (IKZ) from 2015 under the Zorgverzekeringswet will be arranged, covering insurers' purchasing of supervision, pgb rates, eligibility boundaries with the Wlz and Jeugdwet, indication and appeal procedures, and ouders as caregivers. The State Secretary answered each question, asserting insurers' duty of care and confidence in adequate purchasing, and describing the Zvw indication, appeal route via insurer and SKGZ, and pgb rules.
Health insurers have a duty of care and are responsible for purchasing intensive child care, including the supervision described above.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een zorgplicht en zijn verantwoordelijk voor de inkoop van de intensieve kindzorg, inclusief de begeleiding zoals hierboven benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over onveilige sleutelkluisjes bij ouderen

An MP asked the state secretary about unsafe key boxes used by elderly people and whether providers should be required to use police-certified boxes, and about a safety advisor for the elderly. The government finds the situation undesirable and says providers bear responsibility, but declines binding rules and points to the existing Ouderen in veilige handen plan and awareness work with partners instead of a new safety advisor role.

I consider it self-evident that providers of these services, individually and as branches, must take the burglary risk of the client's home into account in their policy and in agreements with the client.

Ik vind het vanzelfsprekend dat de aanbieders van deze diensten afzonderlijk en als branches in hun beleid en bij het maken van afspraken met de cliënt over het leveren van de dienst rekening moeten houden met het inbraakrisico van de woning van de cliënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over de artikelen “Persoonsgebonden bedrog”, “Hoe de geldzucht het won van de idealen” en “Thomashuizen gebruiken geld voor zorg om huur te betalen”

An MP asks the state secretary whether personal-budget (pgb) funds may indirectly cover property costs at Thomashuizen, whether the rules are clear enough, and whether controls ensure pgb money is spent on care. The secretary replies that housing costs cannot be paid from the pgb, sets out the cost breakdown, promises clearer rules on the 4,000-euro supplement and a pre-approval 'trekkingsrecht' from 2015, and says verification will be explored further with care offices.
The personal budget must be spent on care. That is the starting point.
Het pgb moet worden besteed aan zorg. Dat is het uitgangspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het bericht “Tekort aan toezicht op kwetsbare ouderen dreigt”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether there will be a shortage of supervision (mentors) for vulnerable elderly and disabled people, and what measures will be taken. The State Secretary does not recognise the shortage picture, says mentors are important for those without a social network, and points to subsidised recruitment and training projects by Mentorschap Netwerk Nederland.
I do not recognise the picture that longer home-living by elderly people creates a lack of supervision.
Ik herken het beeld niet dat door het langer thuis wonen van ouderen een gebrek aan toezicht ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het uitbreiden van de pilot voor zzp’ers in de zorg

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries about the pilot allowing self-employed care workers (zzp'ers) to obtain VAR-wuo statements, including how many were contacted, how many enrolled, and whether the pilot would continue. The State Secretary answered that about 650 contracts were concluded, that all care offices participated, and that the pilot's future depends on the long-term care reform and a short-term review of alternative business models.
However, no registration is kept of the reasons why self-employed persons decline participation in the pilot.
Er wordt echter geen registratie bijgehouden van de motieven waarom zzp'ers afzien van deelname aan de pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Overheveling zorgtaken naar gemeenten beter een jaar uitstellen’

An MP asked whether Senator Van Boxtel's call to postpone the Wlz (long-term care act) and the Wmo 2015 transfer to municipalities was justified, and what the effects of a postponement would be. The State Secretary answered that Van Boxtel asked for postponing only the Wlz, that municipalities differ in readiness, that a postponement would keep a narrowed AWBZ in 2015 without changing client entitlements, and that no consultation with opposition parties took place.
In the short term I will inform the House by letter about the progress of the Wmo 2015 transition.
Op korte termijn zal ik de Tweede Kamer per brief informeren over de voortgang van de transitie Wmo 2015
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het feit dat de toegezegde pilot met het persoonlijk assistentiebudget nog niet van start is gegaan

An MP asked why the promised pilot with a personal assistance budget (persoonlijk assistentiebudget) for severely disabled clients had not started, and whether it should be secured in the Wlz before it takes effect. The Secretary of State replied that no legal barriers exist, that existing ZZP-meerzorg pgb rules can be used, that a tailored procedure via Vilans is planned for early October, and that no new pilot or legislative change is needed.
There are therefore no obstacles in laws and regulations to start with personal assistance.
Er zijn dus geen belemmeringen in de wet- en regelgeving om een start te maken met persoonlijke assistentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat mensen verstoken blijven van huishoudelijke verzorging en thuiszorgorganisaties collectief thuiszorgmedewerkers ontslaan

An SP MP asked the state secretary about municipalities (Noordoostpolder, Steenwijkerland, Urk, Son en Breugel, Berkelland) shifting home-care provision to intermediary bureaus or ending contracts, and about Thebe's collective dismissals. The secretary answered that municipalities must follow the Wmo 2015 legal framework, that he does not consider promoting alfahulp arrangements desirable and will keep monitoring, and that much of the information is not yet available or is the responsibility of the municipalities.
I will continue to remind municipalities that they must observe these conditions.
Ik zal gemeenten er op blijven wijzen dat zij deze voorwaarden in acht nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht “Hoe Buurtzorg miljoenen misloopt door willekeur zorgverzekeraars”

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health about reports that Buurtzorg loses millions because health insurers arbitrarily cap its productive output, and whether this penalises success and blocks growth. The state secretary said care access is central, that insurers contract on price-quality, that demand growth is partly explained by ageing and chronic illness, and that a doelmatigheid study will report in autumn; he also explained that unagreed overproduction does not automatically lead to budget adjustment.
A study into the cost-effectiveness of care provided by Buurtzorg is currently underway.
Op dit moment vindt een onderzoek plaats naar de doelmatigheid van de zorglevering door Buurtzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat tijdelijke bestuurders de zorg overspoelen

The SP's Leijten asks the health minister about reports that temporary and externally hired executives are increasingly running care organisations, and whether this harms governance, continuity and accountability. The minister answers that such contracts are not inherently problematic, that supervisory boards are responsible for appointments and governance, and declines to compile lists of failed or temporary executives or to pursue a collective agreement or structural change to board models.
It is not my task to examine the business operations of care institutions, nor to supervise the suitability of individual executives of care institutions.
Het is niet mijn taak om de bedrijfsvoering van zorginstellingen door te lichten, noch om toe te zien op de geschiktheid van individuele bestuurders van zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat er geld voor het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) naar snoepreisjes gaat

MP Siderius asked the state secretary how organisations can still sell 'snoepreisjes' (holiday-type trips) paid from personal budgets (pgb) outside Europe despite the 2013 rules, and what had become of promised fraud measures. The secretary answered that fraud is unacceptable, cited home visits, intake interviews, trekkingsrechten from 2015 and the 13-week rule, but gave no overview of trips, cases or which insurers approve them, saying such data is not centrally available or not specific enough.
There is no nationally specified information available on care purchasing and use of the pgb abroad.
Er is geen landelijke gespecificeerde informatie beschikbaar over zorginkoop en besteding van het pgb in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van het Wout over het artikel “In de watten gelegd”

An MP asked the state secretary for health about a newspaper article reporting that sexual care providers were sometimes paid from personal budgets (pgb). The state secretary agreed such services are not insured care, said zorgkantoren would reject such claims, admitted they do not monitor these rejections, and pointed to the pgb reimbursement list that excludes sexual services.
I do not have this data.
Ik beschik niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het schrappen van dagbesteding en het sluiten van een zorgboerderij

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether closing the Enjoy-it care farm due to persoonsgebonden budget cuts is acceptable, and what happens to affected children and staff. The State Secretary regretted the closure but said the board is responsible for business operations, clients keep their care rights via their budget, and he holds no overview of other closures, while pointing to extra funding for day care.
I do not have such information. Continuing care (its survival) is the responsibility of the care provider.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke informatie. Het continueren van zorg (het voortbestaan) is een verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de brandbrief van de gemeente Zaanstad (ingezonden 23 juli 2014)

MP Leijten asked the state secretaries about a fire letter from Zaanstad and other Amsterdam-region municipalities warning that youth care providers' offers exceed the budgets in the May circular, and about possible shortfalls in The Hague and Haaglanden. The government answered that it expects regional investigations to reduce the gap, that municipalities are responsible for tariffs and contracting, and that it monitors the procurement process and will support municipalities where needed.
It is up to municipalities, in consultation with youth care providers, to make procurement agreements.
Het is verder aan gemeenten in overleg met jeugdhulpaanbieders om inkoopafspraken te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de uitzending ‘Opa en oma in de ban’

An MP (Oskam, CDA) asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about grandparents' difficulties keeping contact with grandchildren after divorce, the legal test for contact orders, and whether the law should be changed. The government answered that the scale of the problem cannot be measured, that courts apply a two-step test (close personal bond, then child's best interest), that Germany and France name grandparents in law but the Dutch route via the court is adequate, and that grandparents feature in the anti-conflict-divorce action plan.

I nevertheless consider the previously outlined possibility for grandparents to obtain a contact arrangement through the court adequate, and therefore see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik acht de eerder geschetste mogelijkheid voor grootouders om via de rechter tot een omgangsregeling te komen niettemin afdoende en zie daarom geen aanleiding hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport naar aanleiding van de documentaire van de NCRV genaamd ‘2doc: een goede plek voor Dex’

An MP asked the state secretary for health about a documentary on a severely disabled boy who lacked a suitable care place, asking for numbers, the regulatory and financing obstacles, and whether the new Long-Term Care Act would fix them. The state secretary answered that about 60-70 clients a year wait too long for suitable care, that obstacles lie mainly in financing and permits rather than national rules, and that existing law already allows new provision, with steps set out in a separate letter to parliament.
The Centre for Consultation and Expertise indicates that there is a group of about 60 to 70 clients a year with complex care needs who have to wait (too) long for a suitable place in care.
Het Centrum voor Consultatie en Expertise geeft aan dat er jaarlijks een groep van circa 60 à 70 cliënten met een complexe zorgvraag is die (te) lang moet wachten op een passende plek in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Siderius over "zorgmedewerkers die na ontslag als vakantiekracht bij hun oude werkgever aan de slag moeten gaan"

SP MPs asked whether care workers dismissed by employers are rehired as cheaper holiday staff, questioning UWV's dismissal permits, the lower pay, and the consequences for care quality. The minister replied that UWV grants permits only for structural job loss, that no evidence of wrongful permits exists, that counts are not held, and that employers and UWV bear responsibility, pointing to new transition measures.
I have no indications that UWV wrongly granted dismissal permits.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat UWV ten onrechte ontslagvergunningen heeft verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het artikel “Brabantse gemeenten zitten financieel aan de grond”

An MP asks whether Brabant municipalities in financial distress can meet the promised soft landing for the 2015 social domain decentralisations and what the government will do to prevent escalation. The minister replies that the provincial analysis is less negative than presented, that 9 municipalities nationally are under preventive financial supervision, and that a Transitiecommissie Sociaal Domein will monitor municipalities from September 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het Leijten over problemen met het Valysvervoer

MP Leijten (SP) asked why Transvision, the Valys transport operator, no longer guarantees solo rides and how this affects travel times and comfort for users. The State Secretary answered that combined transport is the agreed basis to keep Valys affordable, that former special indications had no legal basis, and that passengers' personal preferences will still be accommodated where possible.
After consultation with the carrier, it was therefore decided to inform the relevant pass holders in early April that there is no right to this kind of privilege within Valys transport.
Na overleg met de vervoerder is daarom besloten om de betreffende pashouders begin april te informeren dat er binnen het Valysvervoer geen recht op dit soort privileges is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de zorgsector een goede markt is voor interim-managers

An MP asked the health minister for a reaction to a report that hourly rates for interim managers in healthcare rose from €112 to €145, and how this squares with layoffs and the WNT pay norms. The minister declined to answer substantively, arguing the study's small healthcare sample (11% of 484 respondents) and mixed methodology make the findings unreliable.
Therefore it is impossible for me to give a good answer to your questions.
Derhalve is het voor mij onmogelijk op uw vragen een goed antwoord op te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over brandwonden van een 86-jarige man na een douchebeurt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an 86-year-old man who suffered burns after a shower, possibly given by a trainee, and whether the Inspectorate would investigate and whether the frequency of trainee-involved incidents would be examined. The State Secretary said the Inspectorate had started its own investigation with results expected in autumn, and that the Inspectorate had recorded 29 incident reports involving trainees since 2006, so no additional study was needed.
The inspectorate decided to start its own investigation into this incident immediately.
De inspectie heeft besloten direct zelf een onderzoek naar deze calamiteit te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat een corporatie miljoenen claimt bij de overheid vanwege de sluiting van de verzorgingshuizen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a corporation's reported claim against the state over care home closures, the 1999 compensation arrangement, its potential financial exposure and the government's cost-cutting policy in care. The government says it knows of no claim, cannot speculate on hypothetical claims, notes that the compensation arrangement has never been used, and refers to earlier letters on long-term care reform.
I am not aware of any claim, so I cannot respond to it either.
Mij is geen claim bekend, dus ik kan daar ook niet op in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Van der Steur over het bericht dat smartshops levensgevaarlijke drugs verspreiden

MPs Rebel and Van der Steur asked whether illegal narcotics sold as vitamin pills in smartshops were known, how the NVWA and IGZ supervise smartshops, whether national rules should replace local ordinances, and how drug-testing services and the police fit in. The state secretary answered that the four Amsterdam and Utrecht shops are under examination, that supervision is joint (NVWA, IGZ, police) and mostly complaint-based, and that no additional national rules are considered necessary.
Currently it is being examined further how action can be taken against the four smartshops in Amsterdam and Utrecht.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzocht op welke wijze kan worden opgetreden tegen de vier smartshops in Amsterdam en Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over problemen met hulpmiddelen van Welzorg

An SP MP asks the state secretary about problems with Welzorg's mobility-aid services, long waiting times, staff quality, municipal tendering pressure on prices, executive pay and the removal of aids on supplier changes. The secretary responds that municipalities bear responsibility for quality under EU and Wmo procurement rules, that Welzorg has pledged extra staff and opening hours, and that he lacks overview data and sees no need for further study.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to include quality requirements in the tender specifications and then to monitor them during the contract period.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om kwaliteitseisen in het bestek van de aanbesteding op te nemen en deze vervolgens ook gedurende de contractperiode te bewaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin Van Dijk over het leegstaan van een nieuwbouwlocatie voor kinderen met een verstandelijke beperking, en inkoopbeleid van een zorgkantoor

An MP asked the state secretary why a newly built care location in Hengelo for children with intellectual disabilities has stood empty since autumn 2013 because the care office refused in-kind placement, and what the government will do about the care office's purchasing policy. The state secretary called the situation unfortunate, said a practical solution via a personal budget was found with the families, and pointed to multi-year purchasing contracts and planned rules under the Wlz to limit regional purchasing discretion.
The care office's task is to purchase care that matches clients' preferences, both as regards the way care is delivered (in-kind, vpt or pgb) and the location.

Het zorgkantoor heeft tot taak om zorg in te kopen die aansluit bij de voorkeuren van cliënten, zowel ten aanzien van de wijze waarop de zorg wordt geleverd (zorg in natura, vpt of pgb) als de locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Het wordt chaos; zorgpersoneel slaat alarm over werkdruk’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health about mass layoffs at care provider Amstelring, alongside its hiring of temporary staff, and whether this endangers resident safety and care quality. The State Secretary answered that the layoffs follow from the policy of longer independent living, that the care provider is responsible for safe organisation of care under IGZ supervision, and that no sanctions against the board are warranted.
Given this situation, imposing sanctions is not an issue.
Gezien deze situatie is het treffen van sancties niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat de markt voor hulpmiddelen op slot zit

Mr. Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary for Health whether the market for care aids is fair, whether large suppliers win tenders at unrealistic prices, and whether research into the market is needed. The State Secretary answered that municipalities must follow EU and national procurement rules, that prices of some aids have fallen without known research into the cause, that small suppliers still do well in tenders, and that no market study is needed given existing initiatives such as a model tender document and a quality mark.
In response to the report, I therefore see no reason for a market study.
Ik zie naar aanleiding van het bericht dan ook geen aanleiding voor een marktonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Kooiman over de brief van de gemeente Alphen aan den Rijn over de fiscale consequenties van de inkoop van jeugdhulp

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether the municipality of Alphen aan den Rijn's warning about VAT charges on regional youth care purchasing, possibly cutting budgets by 21%, was accurate, and what would be done about the budget uncertainty. The government replied that VAT exemptions for youth care apply, that clarifying standard cooperation forms with umbrella organisations is underway, and that municipalities received budget certainty on 30 May 2014.
We are therefore in consultation with a number of umbrella organisations to produce a description of the tax consequences of the most common forms of cooperation, as expected.
Wij zijn daarom in overleg met een aantal koepelorganisaties om te komen tot een beschrijving van de fiscale consequenties van de – naar verwachting – meest voorkomende samenwerkingsvormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de hoge advieskosten van zorgorganisatie Fundis

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about a proposed tariff cut of about 243,000 euro imposed on care provider Fundis by zorgkantoor Achmea, the high external advisory costs and the failed Langeland hospital takeover, and whether oversight bodies had judged the financial risks adequately. The State Secretary answered that no fine was imposed, the tariff cut is not yet final, other zorgkantoren found no reason for cuts, and that financial risk assessment and governance of private Fundis lie with its board, supervisory board, ACM, NZa and ultimately the courts.
The judgement on possible shortcomings of a care provider lies primarily with the relevant zorgkantoor, the NZa and, for shortcomings in quality of care, the IGZ.
Het oordeel over eventuele tekortkomingen van een zorgaanbieder is primair aan het betreffende zorgkantoor, de NZa en bij tekortkomingen in de kwaliteit van de zorg aan de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over online drugs kopen

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising online drug purchases, risks to users, and enforcement against online drug marketplaces such as Silk Road. The government answered that monitoring and police digital expertise are being expanded, cited recent convictions, and declined to add the topic separately to an EU Justice Council agenda.
In the context of the investigative interest, it is not desirable to make statements about this.
In het kader van het opsporingsbelang is het niet wenselijk hierover mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over extramurale zorginstellingen die buiten het stagefonds van VWS vallen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the internship fund, which covers only intramural care, should also cover extramural care providers that offer internship supervision without a funding basis under the Zvw, AWBZ, Wmo or Youth Act. The State Secretary replied that extramural providers are already eligible on equal terms, that the case in the blog concerns an institution outside these regimes, and that the scope will be reconsidered from subsidy year 2015–2016.
For the period after that (from subsidy year 2015–2016) a new assessment will be made.
Voor de periode daarna (vanaf subsidiejaar 2015–2016) wordt een nieuwe afweging gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat gemeenten in de biblebelt fors minder geld per jongere krijgen dan andere gemeenten

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether Bible Belt municipalities receive much less youth care funding per young person, and whether the allocation model's use of historical spending is fair, citing the low figure for Bunschoten. The state secretaries answered that the 2015 budget follows historical youth care use, that many municipalities outside the Bible Belt also receive less, and that municipalities must bear high-cost risks themselves.
All municipalities now receive budget for what they use, and therefore the amount of money they need in 2015.
Alle gemeenten krijgen nu budget voor wat ze gebruiken, en dus de hoeveelheid geld die ze in 2015 nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de leeftijdscontrole op alcohol in supermarkten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about whether age verification systems in supermarkets should be restricted to proven effective ones, and about the role of the trade association CBL and franchise restrictions on effective systems. The State Secretary answered that research on effectiveness is underway, that compliance remains insufficient, that the ACM is investigating possible unlawful agreements, and that choice of system is up to the sector.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is currently investigating whether there are unlawful agreements within the CBL regarding the use of certain effective control systems.
Op dit moment onderzoekt de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) of al dan niet sprake is van ongeoorloofde afspraken binnen het CBL over de inzet van bepaalde effectieve controlesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de hoge kosten voor gemeenten vanwege het stallen van scootmobielen bij wooncomplexen door het scheiden van wonen en zorg

Siderius (SP) asks the state secretary how municipalities should handle high unforeseen costs of making housing complexes safe for storing mobility scooters after the separation of housing and care, and whether compensation is planned. The secretary answers that the problem stems from municipal Wmo responsibilities, that there is no reason to compensate municipalities, and that residents and their landlords or owners' associations should address the issue, with municipal support where needed.
There is no reason to compensate municipalities for this problem, since it is an issue that arises from the responsibility municipalities already bear under the Wmo.
Er is geen aanleiding gemeenten voor deze problematiek te compenseren, nu het een vraagstuk betreft dat voortvloeit uit de verantwoordelijkheid die gemeenten op grond van de Wmo reeds dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over het dwarsbomen van de kamerverhuur in verzorgingshuizen door de verhuurderheffing

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked whether the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) is pushing poorer elderly people out of care-home rooms, and asked for data on rents, vacancies and exemptions. The minister gave mostly data gaps and defended the Woonakkoord, promising only a future evaluation of the levy.
There is no overview of the amount of care real estate owned by care providers and the portion that is rented.
Er is geen overzicht van de hoeveelheid zorgvastgoed die in bezit is van zorgaanbieders en het deel dat wordt gehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over het bericht dat gemeenten niet weten hoe ze kindermishandeling moeten tegengaan

MPs Ypma and Rebel asked the state secretaries whether municipalities lack the knowledge and data to prevent child abuse, citing an Ombudsman for Children report. The government answered that most municipalities do hold data, that it will support municipalities with tools, a regulatory change and an updated action plan, while noting that prevention policy is primarily their own responsibility.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for shaping child abuse prevention policy and setting objectives.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk om preventiebeleid voor kindermishandeling vorm te geven en doelstellingen te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Noodplan moet leegloop bij jeugdzorg voorkomen’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary how to retain professional youth-care staff ahead of the 2015 transition, whether national intervention is needed rather than leaving it to municipalities, and whether minimum quality criteria and accrued rights of staff can be secured. The government pointed to existing measures (a 3.8 million euro sector plan, the Transition Authority for Youth, quality criteria in the Youth Act, and a staff-takeover consultation duty) and said it monitors municipal procurement, with a possible instruction to municipalities if preparation proves seriously deficient.
We monitor the care procurement carried out by municipalities.
Wij monitoren de zorginkoop die door gemeenten plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht dat het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport 800.000 AWBZ-cliënten aanschrijft over de veranderingen in de langdurige zorg

An MP asked whether the health ministry may write to 800,000 AWBZ care recipients about long-term care reforms and whether the data transfer from CIZ and CAK respects privacy rules. The state secretary answered that information will flow through general channels and municipalities, that data go to municipalities under Wmo 2015 article 8.2, and that the ministry itself holds no individual client data and will send no individual letters.
VWS is legally not competent to hold clients' data.
VWS is juridisch niet bevoegd om over de gegevens van cliënten te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Blinde paniek door zorgbrief”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that a letter to 800,000 AWBZ care recipients would cause panic, asking about its timing, content, individual consequences, data administration, helpdesks and transitional rules. The State Secretary declined to send a personal letter, outlined a staged communication plan via the Rijk, municipalities and insurers, said a central CAK helpdesk will open on 1 September, and maintained that transitional rules are adequate and the reforms are not too fast.
VWS does not have, and is not authorised to have, individual data on AWBZ-indicated persons.
VWS beschikt niet, en is niet bevoegd om te beschikken, over individuele gegevens van AWBZ-geindiceerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Zorg: 81 miljoen aan open rekeningen’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether care offices must still pay institutions 81 million euros for care clients had a legal right to, and whether unspent AWBZ funds end up with health insurers. The state secretary denied any outstanding payment, stating that overproduction is excluded by NZa rules, that no AWBZ funds were left unused in 2013, and that any leftover would return to the AWBZ fund.
No, that is incorrect. The contract between the care office and the institution specifies the reimbursement the institution is entitled to.
Nee dat is onjuist. In het contract tussen het zorgkantoor en de instelling is vastgelegd op welke vergoeding de instelling recht heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Hoogland over negatieve ervaringen en klachten van rolstoelgebruikers met betrekking tot het openbaar busvervoer
