MPs Otwin van Dijk and Hoogland asked about complaints from wheelchair users refused on buses, including broken wheelchair ramps, and whether the government will engage with users and operators. The government agreed accessible public transport matters, said the Human Rights Board ruling shows non-working ramps breach rules, noted operator Veolia is taking measures, and said the IenM state secretary will urge the sector to clarify rights for electric wheelchair users.
A recent ruling (no. 2014-50) of the Human Rights Board makes clear that a non-working wheelchair ramp is inconsistent with the Dutch rules on accessibility for wheelchair users.

Uit een recent oordeel (nr. 2014–50) van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens komt duidelijk naar voren dat een niet-werkende rolstoelplank zich niet verhoudt met de regels die in Nederland gelden voor toegankelijkheid van mensen met een rolstoel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over het onderzoek van KWR Watercycle Research Institute naar drugsresten in rioolwater

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the government about a KWR study measuring drug residues in sewage, including whether it reliably reflects Dutch drug use and whether more monitoring is needed. The State Secretary answered that sewage measurements give only a limited indication, cannot distinguish dumped from consumed drugs for most substances, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Given the very limited added value of this type of research for prevention and enforcement, I see no reason to commission research into drug residues in sewage water.
Gezien de heel beperkte toegevoegde waarde van dit type onderzoek voor voorlichting, preventie en bestrijding zie ik geen reden opdracht te geven tot onderzoek naar drugsresten in rioolwater.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Dik Faber over fraude met het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service's decision not to investigate suspected PGB fraud in Houten (about 1.6 million euros not spent on care), and reportedly about 200 unprocessed fraud complaints at the national office, was acceptable given the stated lack of priority and capacity. The government replied that fraud is a high priority, that the prosecution service selects cases by modus operandi and motivated its decision, that it could not confirm the 200 figure and referred to earlier letters, and that a package of measures to tighten PGB access is being implemented.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it cannot confirm the stated number of 200 PGB fraud complaints.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld het genoemde aantal van 200 aangiften van pgb-fraude niet te kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de handelwijze van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

An SP MP asks the State Secretary how he assesses staff complaints to the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) about De Zorggroep, including inadequate supervision of dementia patients and understaffing, and why the IGZ only talks to the board rather than investigating independently. The State Secretary calls the complaints worrying, says the inspectorate treats confidential reports seriously, will discuss the issues with the board and monitor closely, points to past intensified supervision and the publicly available reports, and notes IGZ capacity has grown and the 2013 annual report shows improved handling of reports.
In the short term there will be a conversation with the board of directors to discuss this report, but also other reports.
Op korte termijn is er een gesprek met de raad van bestuur om over deze melding, maar ook over andere meldingen, verder te praten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat Alzheimer met preventieve maatregelen terug te dringen is

An MP asked the minister whether Alzheimer's can be delayed or prevented through preventive measures, whether the public is aware of this, whether prevention organisations cooperate on it, what obstacles exist, and when research results are expected. The minister answered that research on prevention is ongoing under the Deltaplan Dementie, promoted healthy lifestyles via the Nationaal Preventie Programma, and expects first research results in 2016.
The first results are expected in 2016.
De eerste resultaten worden in 2016 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Siderius over de heffingskortingen die in mindering zijn gebracht op de AWBZ-premie

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary for a year-by-year breakdown from 1999 of AWBZ premium revenue, how much was spent on tax credits and recovered via the BIKK, and how this compares with care expenditure. The state secretary provided a table of these figures, cautioning that the 2001 break in series (deductions no longer reducing premiums) makes direct comparison misleading, and said the answer to the final question on timing could not be met.
Unfortunately, despite our efforts, that has not succeeded.
Dat is ondanks onze inspanningen helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Fritsma over het bericht met spoed gezocht: 100.000 seniorenwoningen

MPs Agema and Fritsma asked about reports of a shortage of 100,000 senior housing units and whether the government will postpone the ZZP 1-3 extramuralisation measure until enough suitable housing exists. The State Secretary replied that extramuralisation will keep 30,000-35,000 people at home longer, that existing stock is largely sufficient, and pointed to a regional transition agenda for living independently longer.
In our view, housing people who face an increase in limitations is therefore well feasible.
Naar onze mening is daarmee het huisvesten van mensen, die met een toename van beperkingen te maken krijgt, goed uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat verzekeraars Buurtzorg Nederland weigeren te betalen

An MP from the PVV asked the ministry whether insurers refusing to pay Buurtzorg Nederland for care already delivered was justified, and why Buurtzorg had not been compensated for overproduction. The State Secretary answered that care should be paid only within agreed contracting frameworks, that a doelmatigheidsonderzoek into Buurtzorg's efficiency would be commissioned, and that the AWBZ was almost fully spent in 2013.
The NZa policy rules establish that the care provider is not reimbursed more than what has been agreed in advance.
Het is in de NZa beleidsregels vastgelegd dat de zorgaanbieder niet meer vergoed krijgt dan op voorhand afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Meer regeldruk dreigt door transitieplannen»

MPs Ypma and Otwin van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health about Actal's warning that transition plans for youth and long-term care risk increasing red tape, and whether concrete agreements to reduce it are made. The State Secretary answered that the decentralisations are expected to cut regulatory burden by about EUR 20 million, that agreements to remove rules and standardise data requests are included, and that a monitoring commitment with municipalities will follow from 2015, while not adopting all of Actal's recommendations as such.
Question 4: Are you willing to follow the four recommendations of Actal, including concrete agreements that should be made to reduce regulatory burden and bureaucracy?
Vraag 4 Bent u bereid de vier aanbevelingen van Actal op te volgen, waaronder concrete afspraken die gemaakt dienen te worden om regeldruk en bureaucratie te verminderen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen en Segers over de waarborgen voor voldoende landelijke specialistische opvang voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Segers asked whether specialist national shelter for trafficking victims, especially minors, will survive decentralisation of youth and women's care, and how regional inequality and funding gaps will be prevented. The State Secretary replied that from 2015 municipalities will jointly procure this shelter nationally, that a VNG transition arrangement reserves funds, and that continuity of care is guaranteed, but gave few concrete figures or time limits.
The VNG will set aside funds for shelter for this category of victims and procure this form of women's shelter centrally.
De VNG gaat middelen voor de opvang van deze categorie slachtoffers apart zetten en deze vorm van vrouwenopvang centraal inkopen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het beleid van de gemeente Wageningen tot uitplaatsing van 32 bewoners van het verzorgingshuis Dennenrust, omdat scheiden van wonen en zorg niet past in het bestemmingsplan

An MP asked the state secretary whether the municipality of Wageningen may force 32 residents of Dennenrust out of a care home under threat of penalties, although the facility fits the policy of separating housing and care, and on what grounds municipalities can refuse Wmo support to people with care packages. The secretary answered that all current residents may stay, that the new Wmo 2015 reform allows such mixed housing initiatives, that talks between municipality and foundation are ongoing, and that the Wmo/AWBZ division means the municipality may refuse care already covered by AWBZ, with informal arrangements asking municipalities to arrange household help.
All current residents can continue to live at the Dennenrust location.
Alle huidige bewoners kunnen blijven wonen op de locatie Dennenrust.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de wijze van klachtafhandeling door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) inzake vermeend seksueel misbruik in Zorgresidentie Villa de Luchte te Lochem

An SP MP asks the State Secretary why the Inspectorate for Healthcare (IGZ) has not resolved a complaint about alleged sexual abuse and other problems at a care residence, and how it protects vulnerable people from staff with a negative record. The State Secretary says the IGZ investigated thoroughly and found no evidence of abuse, promises to finish the last complaint before 15 June 2014, and points to planned legislation and the new complaints office to strengthen oversight.
The IGZ has committed to me that it will have handled Ms V.'s last complaint before 15 June 2014.
De IGZ heeft mij toegezegd de laatste klacht van mevrouw V. vóór 15 juni 2014 afgehandeld te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat het aantal rokers stabiel is, en het gebruik van de e-sigaret stijgt

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the share of smokers is stable while e-cigarette use is rising, and about the health risks, quitting effectiveness and timing of a regulatory measure on e-cigarettes. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to RIVM research and a planned minimum age for e-cigarette sales, and said the AMvB on e-cigarette product rules would be sent to the Raad van State soon.
In addition, I have announced that I will introduce a minimum age for the sale of e-cigarettes, as is already the case for tobacco and alcohol.
Daarnaast heb ik aangekondigd een minimumleeftijd in te zullen stellen voor de verkoop van e-sigaretten; zoals dat bij tabak en alcohol al het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over handhaving van de Drank- en Horecawet op Nederlandse campings

An MP asked the state secretary how the Alcohol Act is enforced on campsites, whether a Terschelling campsite's website misleadingly suggested underage drinking was allowed, and how to intensify enforcement before summer. The state secretary said the website claim is incorrect, campsites are generally public spaces where under-18s may not have alcohol, inspectors may enter any place, and he will meet the Terschelling mayor and the public prosecutor on tightening enforcement.
In the very near future I will meet with mayor Bats of Terschelling.
Op zeer korte termijn ga ik in gesprek met burgemeester Bats van Terschelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over over de brandbrief van gemeenten in de regio Zuidoost-Utrecht over het tekort op het budget Jeugdzorg

An MP asks the state secretary how he views the Zuidoost-Utrecht municipalities' alarm over a 15 million euro youth-care budget shortfall and whether other municipalities face similar gaps. The state secretary says he is consulting the region, will run a difference analysis after the May circular, and sees no problem with the woonplaatsbeginsel allocation.
It is not exactly known to me which other municipalities expect to face financial shortfalls regarding the youth-care budget.
Het is mij niet exact bekend welke andere gemeenten verwachten te maken te krijgen met financiële tekorten met betrekking tot het budget voor de jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de brandbrief van de regio Zuid-Oost Utrecht over de inkoop van jeugdzorg

An MP (Voordewind, ChristenUnie) asked the State Secretary about a municipal warning letter on a shortfall in youth care funding in the Zuid-Oost Utrecht region, and about how the government will address the budget gap caused by the residence-principle and the concentration of institutions. The State Secretary answered that a difference analysis is underway with the municipalities, that the May 2014 circular raised the macro budget and corrected the residence principle, and that the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd can help providers if needed.
I take these signals seriously and am also in consultation with this specific region about them.
Ik neem deze signalen serieus en ben hierover ook in overleg met deze specifieke regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de ontslaggolf in de jeugdzorg

The SP MP Kooiman asked the state secretaries about the reported loss of 140 jobs at Bureau Jeugdzorg Gelderland and an expected 5,100 to 8,700 job losses in youth care, asking how quality and continuity would be protected, whether dismissals and social plans could be reported by region, and what transition support exists. The government answered that job losses are plausible and depend on municipal contracting, that it is monitoring labour market effects, and that it has allocated funds for transition and retraining, but gave no regional dismissal figures because contracting is not yet complete.
Only once the contracting process between municipalities and providers has progressed further can it be stated to what extent, despite the efforts of these parties, forced dismissals occur and where.
Pas als het inkoopproces tussen gemeenten en aanbieders verder is gevorderd kan worden aangegeven in hoeverre er, ondanks de inspanningen van deze partijen, gedwongen ontslagen zijn en waar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klein en Baay-Timmerman over gewijzigde tarieven van personenalarmering

Two MPs asked why the VAT exemption for personal alarm services was removed, pushing the state to justify the sharp price rise and to bring alarm equipment into the basic health insurance package for frail elderly. The State Secretary explained the VAT change as a competition measure, said the price rise can only partly be explained by VAT, refused to extend basic insurance coverage to elderly people not already eligible, and declined to consult insurers.
Based on the attached document, it is unclear to me what the underlying causes are of the rise in the tariff apart from VAT.
Op basis van bijgevoegd stuk is mij onduidelijk wat de onderliggende oorzaken zijn van de stijging van het tarief los van de btw.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uitspraak van de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie dat je bij zaken als opvangcentra voor verkrachte vrouwen kan afvragen of dat een taak is voor de overheid

An MP asked whether the state secretary's remark that funding shelters for raped women may not be a government task, comparable to beekeeping in Malawi, reflected cabinet policy. The government replied that the remark was not meant to question state responsibility, that municipalities are responsible for victim shelter under the Wmo, and that no consultation with the health ministry had taken place.
Under the Social Support Act, municipalities are responsible for arranging shelter for victims of domestic violence who need it.
Op grond van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning hebben de gemeenten de verantwoordelijkheid om opvang te regelen voor slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld, die dat nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over seksueel misbruik in jeugdzorginstellingen

An MP asked the state secretaries about sexual abuse in youth care institutions, including incident reporting figures, whether gender-separated housing exists, the appropriateness of mixed groups for vulnerable youths, the persistence of abuse after the Samson report, and whether inspectorates will be directed to check safety. The government answered with inspectorate figures, admitted lacking data on police reports and gender-separated places, defended individualised care, pointed to ongoing research and a Rouvoet quality framework, and said the Inspectorate is already conducting targeted supervision.
The IJZ supervision is aligned with the actions from the Rouvoet committee's quality framework for preventing sexual abuse.
Het toezicht van de IJZ sluit aan bij de acties uit het Kwaliteitskader voorkomen seksueel misbruik van de commissie Rouvoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over kinderen van allochtone afkomst die nog steeds evenveel overgewicht hebben

An MP asked the state secretary for health about news that overweight among children of non-Western origin is not declining while it falls slightly among native Dutch children, and what effective interventions exist. The state secretary answered that JOGG and other local, culturally tailored interventions are used, that a national programme for health inequalities (GIDS) starts in 2014, and that data for 2013 are still awaited.
I have asked the Netherlands Nutrition Centre to examine whether and how certain basic information can be offered in various languages from 2015.
Ik heb het Voedingscentrum gevraagd te onderzoeken of en hoe bepaalde basisinformatie vanaf 2015 in verschillende talen aangeboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat Zorggroep Oude en Nieuwe Land honderdduizenden euro's verspilt aan zweverige managementcursussen

An MP asks whether a care group spent public money on management courses by a consultancy whose board-member spouse and affiliated firm raise conflict-of-interest concerns, and whether the supervisory board approved this. The state secretary answers that the care group spent about 285,000 euros a year on advice and coaching, that the supervisory board found no conflict of interest, and that such spending and interim pay are primarily matters for the care institution and its supervisory board.
The assessment of whether there is (the appearance of) a conflict of interest lies primarily with the Supervisory Board.
De beoordeling of hier sprake is (schijn) van belangverstrengeling ligt primair bij de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het bericht “Zorg verstandelijk gehandicapte ouderen onder de maat”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Health about the GOUD study showing that older people with intellectual disabilities age in poorer health, including proposals for mandatory medication reviews, screening guidelines, a specialised training course and an action plan. The State Secretary said care is generally good but that the group faces multimorbidity, that existing guidance and inter-institutional initiatives are in progress, that a workforce advice is due in 2015, and that he will report on a national programme around summer.
I am not of the view that care for older people with an intellectual disability falls short.
Ik ben niet van mening dat de zorg voor ouderen met een verstandelijke beperking tekort schiet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de aftrek weekenduitgaven voor gehandicapten

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Health about tax deductibility of weekend care costs for severely disabled institutional residents, including the 'moral obligation' criterion and a specific case where the child's own income may have excluded deduction. The government affirms that the moral-obligation test is marginal in practice, that the Belastingdienst applies it generously, and it will propose extending the deduction to curatele (curatorship) alongside mentorschap in a future law change.
I will submit a legislative amendment to this end when the opportunity arises.
Ik zal hiertoe bij gelegenheid een wetswijziging indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat THC in beperkte mate een rol speelt bij cannabisverslaving

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a dissertation finding that THC content plays only a limited role in cannabis addiction, and whether this undermines the planned THC cap. The State Secretary replies that the study has limitations, keeps the THC measure based on the Garretsen commission's advice, and sees no need for extra prevention measures beyond existing municipal efforts.
I see no reason to initiate additional measures.
Ik zie geen reden om aanvullende maatregelen te initiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport naar aanleiding van de GOUD-studie 2008-2013

Rep. Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary for health about the GOUD study report on health of older people with intellectual disabilities, including whether more tailored care is needed and how the recommendations will be followed up. The state secretary acknowledged the need for tailored care and knowledge among care professionals, and promised to explore training integration, a role for professional bodies, and a possible national programme with a response expected in summer.
Therefore I want to examine what options there are to bring this knowledge into the care training programmes.
Daarom wil ik bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om deze kennis naar de zorgopleidingen te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat weer een zorgaanbieder verdacht wordt van fraude met het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about suspected PGB (personal budget) fraud by a Zwolle care provider, Pivot, and related measures. The government answered that fraud is unacceptable, pointed to its 2012 intensification plan with face-to-face interviews, home visits and a fraud team, and declined to provide a historical list of providers involved in fraud.
No systematic registration is known to me of care providers that have been involved in PGB fraud over the past ten years.
Er is mij geen systematische registratie bekend van zorgaanbieders die te maken hebben gehad met pgb-fraude de afgelopen tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Rebel over jongeren die identiteitskaarten vervalsen om aan alcohol te komen

MPs Oosenbrug and Rebel asked about young people forging or borrowing ID cards to buy alcohol, including whether scanners make forgery easy, whether prosecution occurs, and whether bar owners check authenticity. The minister said the Dutch ID card is hard to forge, that police act on reported cases, and that bars should check security features more carefully, while noting the survey's representativeness is unclear and committing to no new concrete measures.
The NOS report shows that more attention is needed in the hospitality sector here.
Het NOS-bericht laat zien dat hier in de horeca meer aandacht voor moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Overheveling van taken treft vooral zwakste gemeenten’

Two CDA MPs asked the government whether the decentralisation of youth care, elderly care and Wajong to municipalities hits the financially weakest municipalities hardest and whether municipalities can carry these tasks. The minister answered that the claim is not supported by the comparison made, that a historical distribution model applies for 2015, and that municipalities will get budget clarity in the May circular, while largely restating existing policy.
There is no question of a trial calculation.
Van een proefberekening is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over de heffingskortingen die in mindering zijn gebracht op de AWBZ-premie

The SP MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked whether the BIKK compensates for lost AWBZ premium revenue caused by the tax-credit system, and requested detailed 1999-2013 figures on premium income, reserves and the BIKK. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the BIKK fully compensates the switch from deductions to tax credits each year, that premium income was not squeezed by the system, and supplied a table of hypothetical figures while noting these overstate what would have occurred under the old system.
The BIKK compensates the effect of the conversion from deductions to tax credits.
De BIKK compenseert het effect van de omzetting van aftrekposten naar heffingskortingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de wijkverpleegkundige onvoldoende is voorbereid op wijk

An MP asks whether the district nurse (wijkverpleegkundige) should act as the hub for care users, including preventive planning and coaching, and whether she is prepared for the role before the January 2015 transfer. The State Secretary answers that the district nurse is primarily a care provider with added coordinating and signalling tasks, that training measures and funding are in place, and that the role is not a solo one but works with GPs and social teams.
I am of the view that the district nurse is primarily a care provider and additionally performs extra tasks such as coordinating care and support.
Ik ben van mening dat de wijkverpleegkundige in eerste instantie een zorgverlener is en daarnaast extra taken doet zoals de coördinatie van zorg en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de NIX18 campagne

An MP asked the state secretary about the NIX18 alcohol age campaign, including agreements with partners, the timing of the new slogan, the withdrawal of the logo by supermarkets and industry, and confidence in compliance with the 18+ rule. The state secretary listed partners, explained the transition dates set by the alcohol industry's code, said the supermarket sector now uses the logo or slogan depending on context, and pointed to improved compliance and planned monitoring and engagement.
I have been in contact with the CBL about this.
Ik heb hierover contact gehad met het CBL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Recourt over meer vechtscheidingen door het verplichte ouderschapsplan

MPs Ypma and Recourt asked whether the mandatory parenting plan causes more high-conflict divorces and what support children in such divorces receive. The government says no study shows the parenting plan causes more conflict, describes existing child support and planned early-signalling pilots, and points to parents' and their networks' responsibility.
I am not aware of any research on the basis of which it can be concluded that the parenting plan causes more high-conflict divorces.
Mij is geen onderzoek bekend op basis waarvan de conclusie kan worden getrokken dat het ouderschapsplan voor meer vechtscheidingen zorgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Keijzer over het ouderschapsplan

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked the government about reports that children in high-conflict divorces are in a difficult position, the effectiveness of the parenting plan, and whether relationship counselling is covered by basic insurance. The government answered that it has sent an implementation plan to parliament, that a WODC evaluation is preliminary, that basic insurance does not cover relationship problems without a psychiatric diagnosis, and that municipalities may buy such help from 2015.
To this end, we sent an implementation plan to your House by letter of 31 March 2014.
Daartoe hebben wij bij brief van 31 maart 2014 een uitvoeringsplan naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat opleidingen verpleging razend populair zijn

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked the government about the popularity of nursing degrees amid job losses in healthcare, the shortage of internship places, and whether numerus fixus admission limits are acceptable. The minister says intake is still growing, temporary solutions have been found for internships, a meeting with nursing schools is planned, and that restricted intake is acceptable as regional planning.

VWS and OCW are planning a meeting with the representatives of the HBO nursing programmes, in which among other things the situation regarding internship places for the coming academic year will be discussed.
VWS en OCW plannen een afspraak met de vertegenwoordiging van de hbo-verpleegkunde opleidingen, waarin onder meer de situatie rond de stageplaatsen voor het komende studiejaar aan de orde komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de bewoners van aanleunwoningen in Nieuw Heeswijk actie voeren nu hun verzorgingshuis gesloten is

An MP asked the state secretary about residents of independent apartments in Nieuw Heeswijk protesting the closure of their adjacent care home, the reported celebration during demolition, the loss of neighbourhood care functions under national closure policy, and whether the policy would be reversed. The secretary answered that the residents live independently, that the care home provider offers replacement facilities and community alternatives, that the cuts are offset by extra funding for district nurses and social teams, and that closing care homes is an institutional decision.
Closing (a location of) a care home is a decision taken by the institution itself.
Het sluiten van (een locatie van) een verzorgingshuis is een beslissing die door een instelling zelf wordt genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Tony Van Dijck over het bericht dat zzp-ers in de zorg geen VAR-WUO (Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie Winst Uit Onderneming) meer krijgen van de belastingdienst

MPs Agema and Tony Van Dijck asked whether the Tax Authority's refusal to issue VAR-WUO declarations to self-employed care workers, which hurts patients who rely on agency-placed carers, is known and how it will be addressed. The government acknowledged the problem, said the Tax Authority reclassified 257 cases and issued 900 VAR-loon decisions after review while stressing genuine self-employment must still be recognised, and pointed to direct contracting pilots and ongoing labour-market attention.
I see the problem that is connected to this, although it is not a scale suggested in the broadcast.
Ik zie de problematiek die hier mee samenhangt, hoewel het niet om een schaal gaat die in de uitzending werd gesuggereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jongeren nog steeds geen passende zorg krijgen vanaf hun 18e levensjaar

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about reports that young adults with autism and severe behavioural problems, such as Jabko, still lack suitable care after turning 18, and why a year later no good follow-up places exist. The state secretary expressed understanding, said providers bear responsibility for suitable care, is consulting providers and the CCE on tailored care and its financing, and says the number of such cases is about 40 per year, with no concrete new preventive measures beyond the planned municipal role in youth care.
The CCE has indicated that it sees nationally around 40 (very) hard-to-place young people and (young) adults with autism spectrum disorder and severe behavioural problems each year.
Het CCE heeft aangegeven landelijk jaarlijks circa 40 (zeer) moeilijk plaatsbare jongeren en (jong)volwassenen met een autisme spectrum stoornis en ernstig probleemgedrag te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat hoogbejaarden zorginstelling De Riederborgh in Ridderkerk moeten verlaten

An MP asked whether 11 very elderly residents of De Riederborgh in Ridderkerk, with light care-package indications, had to leave the facility because the care office CZ would no longer reimburse them, and where they would go. The State Secretary replied that a misunderstanding between provider and care office had been resolved, residents can stay, and the care office respects residents' rights in line with national policy.
It has now become clear that residents with a light care package can remain in De Riederborgh and that the care office respects their rights.

Inmiddels is duidelijk geworden dat de bewoners met een licht zorgzwaartepakket in De Riederborgh kunnen blijven wonen en dat de rechten van de bewoners met een licht ZZP door het zorgkantoor worden gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Ypma over de uitzending ‘Dit is de dag – onderzoek’ en de berichten in de Telegraaf over daders van kindermishandeling

MPs Bergkamp and Ypma asked why child abuse complaints rarely lead to prosecution, how effective the policy is, and whether pleaders receive follow-up support. Minister Opstelten answered with registration figures, outlined existing protocols, a planned OM directive on forensic expertise, and promised a progress report and midterm review.
I will inform you of the outcomes in the next progress report.
Ik bericht u over de uitkomsten in de eerstvolgende voortgangsrapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over "een groeiend aantal huisuitzettingen van gezinnen met kinderen".

SP MPs asked whether evictions of families with children and demand for emergency shelter are rising, whether this breaches the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether evictions involving children should be banned. The government confirmed 6,980 evictions from housing corporations in 2013 (up 8%) but said the rise is mainly single adults, not families, and that a ban is unnecessary because courts already weigh tenants' housing interests and a noodmoratorium exists.
A forced eviction will therefore only take place after judicial review; this is related to the special character of residential accommodation.
Een gedwongen ontruiming zal dus alleen plaatsvinden na een rechterlijke toets; dit heeft te maken met het bijzondere karakter van woonruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over een bushalte die wordt betaald met Wmo-geld

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether it is desirable that a bus stop in Krabbendijke be paid for with Wmo care funds, what powers exist to rein in municipalities diverting Wmo money, what measures will prevent such cases, and which municipalities misuse Wmo budgets. The State Secretary said the council must judge the spending, no signs of Wmo underperformance exist in Reimerswaal, intervention tools exist but are not applicable, a temporary social-domain fund will bar such spending from 2015, and he lacks the data to list other municipalities.
It is primarily for the municipal council to judge whether the deployment of funds is desirable.
Het is primair aan de Gemeenteraad om te oordelen of de inzet van middelen wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de carnavalscampagne drinken als een prins

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary for Health about Bavaria's carnival campaign showing the outdated age-16 limit and the alcohol industry's refusal to join the NIX18 campaign. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said Bavaria regrets it and has corrected online material and posters, and defended the self-regulatory approach while reporting early positive campaign results.
I regret this conduct by Bavaria because it may have created confusion about the minimum age for selling and serving alcohol to young people.
Ik betreur deze handelswijze van Bavaria omdat hierdoor onduidelijkheid heeft kunnen ontstaan over de minimumleeftijd voor het verkopen en schenken van alcohol aan jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat zorgmedewerkers opnieuw geïntimideerd worden

An SP MP asked the Secretary of State for Health about reports that care workers striking at AxionContinu were intimidated, including threats to withdraw holiday days and wage deductions. The government said it had no evidence of intimidation, explained that strikers lose pay by law (no pay was withheld in the first two strike days, and later strikers acted in their own time), and pointed to existing complaint channels, Inspectie SZW complaint handling (15 reports since 2012), and the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg, rejecting a separate reporting point and an investigation.
We do not know whether AxionContinu has intimidated striking employees.
Wij weten niet of AxionContinu actievoerende werknemers heeft geïntimideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Otwin Van Dijk over moeizame samenwerking tussen 26 Utrechtse gemeenten en Achmea

MPs Dik-Faber and Van Dijk asked whether cooperation between 26 Utrecht municipalities and insurer Achmea is difficult and what the government will do to improve it. The State Secretary acknowledged mixed experiences, described Achmea's cooperation strategy and regional talks, and committed to actively supporting the agreements between municipalities and insurers, including in Utrecht.
I will actively support the establishment of these agreements in the regions, including in the Utrecht region where necessary, and closely monitor progress together with ZN and the VNG.
Ik zal de totstandkoming van deze afspraken in de regio, waaronder in de regio Utrecht, waar dat nodig is actief ondersteunen en de voortgang samen met ZN en de VNG nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat gemeenten thuiszorg per veiling kopen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health whether it is acceptable that about 35 municipalities buy home care through an online auction (Stipter platform), where lowest price drives awarding, undermining quality and cao wages, and asks whether the government will stop it. The State Secretary rejects price-only procurement, points to statutory quality safeguards in the Wmo and Wmo 2015, says 19 municipalities use the application, and states that the government will not stop it, with no commitment to a new investigation or halt.
How many of these 35 municipalities have bought care through this auction site at too-low rates? Are you willing to investigate this and inform the House?
Vraag 8 Hoeveel van deze 35 gemeenten hebben zorg via deze veilingsite met te lage tarieven ingekocht? Bent u bereid dit te onderzoeken en de Kamer hierover te informeren?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht op de site van de VNG waarin een handleiding aan gemeenten wordt aangereikt ten behoeve van de inkoop van (specialistische) jeugdzorg

An MP asked the state secretary about a VNG handbook for municipalities on purchasing specialist youth care, including whether it wrongly limits direct GP referral and makes social teams gatekeepers. The state secretary answered that the handbook was revised so that GPs can refer directly without passing through the social team, and that the social team need not give prior approval before payment, while noting municipal sturing and payment choices remain open.
I have therefore asked the authors to amend the text (section 6.3.2) of the handbook to the following passage.
Ik heb daarom de stellers gevraagd de tekst (par. 6.3.2.) in de handreiking te wijzigen in de volgende passage
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Rebel over het bericht dat steeds meer jongeren zich met een gameverslaving melden bij verslavingsklinieken

MPs Bergkamp and Rebel asked about reports that more and younger young people are seeking treatment for gaming addiction, and about causes, recognition, reimbursement and prevention. Minister Schippers confirmed the rise in treatment demand, said existing research is sufficient, noted gaming addiction is not in DSM-5 but is generally reimbursed, and pointed to parental responsibility, existing tools and school-based programmes.
I find this development worrying and will continue to monitor it.
Ik vind deze ontwikkeling zorgelijk en zal deze blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de zorg voor kinderen in gevaar is

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretaries whether the transfer of youth care to municipalities threatens continuity of care for children, citing gaps in contracts, budgets, frictional costs and regional cooperation ahead of 2015. The government replied only by referring to its letter on preparing the Youth Act (Kamerstuk 31 839, nr. 351), without answering the questions on substance.

The written questions from MP Kooiman (SP), question number 2014Z04148, have been answered by means of the letter on 'preparing the introduction of the Youth Act on 1 January 2015' (Kamerstuk 31 839, no. 351).
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP), vraagnummer 2014Z04148 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief over «voorbereiding invoering Jeugdwet op 1 januari 2015» (Kamerstuk 31 839, nr. 351 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over uitstel van het rapport van de commissie Dienstverlening aan huis

An MP asked why the mandate of the Commission Dienstverlening aan huis was extended and when its final report would reach parliament, and whether the report should be awaited before the Wmo 2015 bill proceeds. The minister gave reasons for the delay, promised the report by 30 April, and rejected the view that the Wmo 2015 bill must wait for the report.
The establishing decree has been extended to 30 April. I expect to be able to share the final report with the House by that date.
Het Instellingsbesluit is verlengd tot 30 april. Ik verwacht voor die datum het eindverslag met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat nazorg ontbreekt na opname in de gesloten jeugdzorg

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that aftercare is lacking for young women leaving closed youth care, and whether Jeugdzorg-Plus and the decentralisation to municipalities will improve this, and whether Ireland's right to an aftercare plan should be adopted. The State Secretary acknowledged the research, argued that Jeugdzorg-Plus and the new Jeugdwet will improve aftercare, noted that international treaties limit help for young people who become adults against their will, and said he is exploring a mentor proposal.

I expect positive effects from the decentralisation of youth care, also in relation to the Participation Act and the adjustment of the WMO, on aftercare for young people who have stayed in Jeugdzorg-Plus.

Ik verwacht positieve effecten van de decentralisatie van de jeugdzorg, mede in relatie met de Participatiewet en de aanpassing van de WMO, op de nazorg aan jongeren die in jeugdzorgplus hebben verbleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het artikel “Patiënten in verkeerde bedden”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that elderly patients stay longer in hospital or are discharged without adequate aftercare due to stricter rules on nursing-home admission, and about care-hotel costs. The State Secretary said the government wants to avoid unnecessary hospital stays, has reinstated temporary AWBZ admissions for post-hospital rehabilitation for 2014, and will review necessary actions for 2015 within the long-term care reform, while stating he has no signals that patients are admitted less quickly.

For the group that really cannot be placed in a home environment and is dependent on intramural rehabilitation care, I have decided to again accommodate the possibility of temporary admission to an AWBZ institution for rehabilitation care after hospital admission in 2014.

420 ) van 6 februari 2014 heb ik aangegeven dat ik voor de groep die daadwerkelijk niet in een thuisomgeving terecht kan en aangewezen is op intramurale herstelzorg heb besloten om in het jaar 2014 de mogelijkheid tot tijdelijke opname in een AWBZ-instelling in verband met herstelzorg na ziekenhuisopname opnieuw te accommoderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over de Digitale Vragenlijst Schoolkracht Voortgezet onderwijs 2012  van de GGD

An MP asks the State Secretary about the GGD's digital youth questionnaire (EMOVO) on school health, questioning its intrusiveness into privacy, parental consent, data storage and the use of postcode data. The State Secretary replies that the survey is anonymous, voluntary and aggregated, that parents are informed in advance, that data are stored with restricted access, and that refusing has no consequences for care.
Filling in the questionnaire is voluntary and the results remain anonymous, or are used in confidential contact with the youth nurse or youth doctor.
Het invullen van de vragenlijst is vrijwillig en de resultaten blijven anoniem, dan wel worden gebruikt in vertrouwelijk contact met de jeugdverpleegkundige of jeugdarts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het banenverlies in de zorg in Groningen, Friesland en Drenthe

An MP asked the state secretary about projected job losses of about 4% in healthcare in Groningen, Friesland and Drenthe, and whether a sector plan with a support team and retraining funds is underway. The secretary confirmed the forecast and the ongoing regional sector plan work, said a support need would be checked, and pointed to a regional labour market programme with EUR 7.5 million per year to 2015.
For that reason I will check whether the Northern Netherlands region still needs specific support.
Om die reden zal ik nagaan of de regio Noord-Nederland nog specifieke ondersteuning nodig heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Komende acht jaar tekort woningen voor ouderen en gehandicapten’

CDA MP Keijzer asked the State Secretary for Health about a report predicting a shortage of suitable homes for elderly and disabled people, and whether municipalities under the Wmo 2015 will bear the cost of home adaptations and be constrained by budget cuts. The State Secretary answered that municipalities will receive additional funds and that people should be supported to remain in their homes, while promising a letter on housing and care to parliament in early April 2014.
I expect to inform your House in early April.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer begin april te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de naleving- en handhavingcijfers van het rookverbod in de horeca

Rebel (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about the latest compliance and enforcement figures for the smoking ban in hospitality, including the slight dip in compliance and whether tougher enforcement and a higher minimum age will help. The State Secretary answered that compliance is generally good but lags in cafés and discotheques, that the trend has risen since 2011, and that enforcement has been intensified, with annual reporting to parliament planned.
As I indicated in my letter, I would like to inform the House once a year from now on about all enforcement and compliance regarding the smoking ban in hospitality and the tobacco age limit.
Zoals ik in mijn brief heb aangegeven wil ik de Kamer voortaan graag eenmaal per jaar informeren over alle handhaving en naleving van het rookverbod in de horeca en de leeftijdgrens tabak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin Van Dijk over het inkoopbeleid van zorgkantoren

An MP asked the state secretary about Actiz's survey showing that one-year budget agreements and budget-control rules by care insurers (zorgkantoren) hinder renewal of long-term care, and whether multi-year purchasing is needed. The state secretary agreed renewal is needed, said multi-year agreements are being pursued in talks with the sector for 2015, and promised to inform parliament by spring.
As I have informed you, I am taking up the improvement proposals in the talks with the sector organisations and care offices on purchasing intramural long-term care for 2015 and subsequent years.

Zoals ik u heb laten weten, neem ik de verbetervoorstellen ter hand in het kader van de besprekingen met de brancheorganisaties en zorgkantoren over de inkoop van intramurale langdurige zorg voor het jaar 2015 en volgende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bejegenen van nabestaanden na overlijden in de instelling Bartimeus

MP Leijten asks whether relatives of a woman who died after a bathing incident at Bartimeus received no apologies, were pressured to sign a document blaming a viral infection, and whether the IGZ report and institutional response were adequate. The State Secretary says he was not involved in aftercare, finds the lack of apologies regrettable if true, notes the IGZ found no pressure reported and that Bartimeus's and the hospital's assessments do not diverge, and points to an integral improvement plan and a planned IGZ follow-up visit.
Reports of investigations into calamities are in principle not made public by the IGZ.
Rapporten van onderzoek naar calamiteiten worden door de IGZ in principe niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de gevolgen van de sluiting van verzorgingshuizen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the closure of nursing homes, the shift of light-care clients to home care, cuts to AWBZ budgets, and whether elderly people will lose access to care. The State Secretary rejects the premise, says home care will absorb those clients, and gives a breakdown of the 2014 AWBZ cuts while stating that beds for heavier groups remain available.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht dat 15.000 ouderen plots te gezond zijn voor het tehuis

An MP asks whether reports that 15,000 elderly people are suddenly too healthy for care homes are accurate, and how the stricter ZZP care-package rules, cuts to home care and phased implementation affect people staying at home. The State Secretary confirms the ~15,000 figure as a projection of residents leaving institutions under the extramuralisation policy, denies that it is sudden, says on-demand care is budgeted, and promises to send the NZa report in spring 2014.
In a thirty-member debate with your House on 16 January 2014, I committed to expecting the NZa report in spring 2014 and to presenting it to your House.
In een dertigledendebat met uw Kamer op 16 januari 2014 heb ik toegezegd dat ik het rapport van de NZa in het voorjaar van 2014 verwacht en aan uw Kamer zal aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bezuinigingen op bewoners en personeel in de zorg

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about Careyn's plans to declare around 1,000 staff redundant, pay cuts on reassignment, closing care homes, and budget cuts to care, asking whether the government accepts the resulting wage dumping and job losses. The state secretary replied that Careyn's redundancies are closer to 200-300 staff, that the employer bears primary responsibility for personnel policy within the law, and that the government will not give exact cost or closure figures, though it commits to informing parliament via a later labour-market report.
Institutions are and remain primarily responsible for their own business operations and personnel policy.
Instellingen zijn en blijven zelf primair verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering en personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat ‘plain packaging’ als effect heeft dat sigaretten minder aantrekkelijk worden gevonden, en rokers meer geneigd zijn te stoppen

MP Van Gerven asked whether reports that plain tobacco packaging makes smokers more inclined to quit, and studies linking attractive packs to children, should lead the government to adopt plain packaging in the Netherlands and to restrict tobacco sales to specialist shops. The State Secretary replied that early Australian evidence is promising but needs longer-term study, that large combined health warnings will be introduced under the EU Tobacco Products Directive, and that plain packaging and sales restrictions will be evaluated, with the Chamber to be informed before the summer recess.
My aim is to inform the House about this before the summer recess.
Mijn streven is de Tweede Kamer hier voor het Zomerreces over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir over het bericht dat Stichting Dienstverlening Serviceflats (SDS) ouderen uit serviceflats jaagt

MPs Leijten and Bashir asked the government to respond to reports that Stichting Dienstverlening Serviceflats (SDS) pressures elderly residents of service flats, including through alleged financial exploitation, intimidation and forced sales, and asked whether an independent investigation would follow. Minister Blok replied that complaints about a service-flat management organisation are a matter for the courts, that private management contracts fall outside government supervision, and pointed to industry certification initiatives, without committing to an investigation.
Ultimately it is for the judiciary to pass judgment and not for me to go into the substance of this.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechterlijke macht om een oordeel te vellen en niet aan mij om hier inhoudelijk op in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Alcohol taboe voor ouders’

An MP asked the state secretary for health how a shop assistant can tell whether alcohol bought by an adult is intended for a minor under the Drank- en Horecawet, after a supermarket reportedly refused to sell alcohol to parents shopping with their children. The secretary replied that the rules have not changed, that sales to parents shopping with children are allowed, that the law only requires refusal when the minor's purchase is obvious, and that no amendment is planned.
In view of the above explanation, I see no reason to amend the Drank- en Horecawet on this point.
Gezien bovenstaande uitleg zie ik dan ook geen aanleiding de Drank- en Horecawet op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het bericht schoonmaakgigant stort zich op zorg

A 50PLUS MP asked the state secretary whether it is desirable for a commercial cleaning company to take over care and support, risking favouritism and reduced client choice, and how quality and public spending would be safeguarded. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible under the Wmo for quality, contracting and monitoring, that clients keep choice through personal budgets, and that providers with and without profit motive can be contracted.
Under the Social Support Act (Wmo), municipalities are responsible for the quality and continuity of support provided to citizens who depend on it.
Gemeenten zijn op grond van de Wet op de maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van de ondersteuning aan de burgers die daarop aangewezen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het vertrek van de topman van zorgaanbieder Aafje

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the departure of Aafje's chair of the Executive Board, the 630,000 euro severance-style payment, and alleged conflicts of interest with a consultancy partnership linked to Aafje. The State Secretary answered that the Wnt rules were applied correctly, that the payment is a maximum liability subject to anti-cumulation rules, and that the ties described are either absent or pertain to Aafje's own organisational decisions.
In this case the applicable rules have been applied.
In deze casus zijn de geldende regels toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Beëindiging subsidierelaties van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport met Jeugdzorg-Plus niet gegrond”

An MP asked the state secretary why the government decided to end subsidy relations with Jeugdzorg-Plus institutions, how it responds to the Commissie Bezwaarschriften ruling that the advance notice was premature, and whether it will talk with providers. The state secretary answered that the notice was sent in anticipation of the Jeugdwet, that the decision on the objection is postponed until 1 June 2014 pending clarity on conditions, and that additional measures are being discussed with providers, with updates to follow.
Therefore I have decided to postpone a decision on this objection until 1 June 2014 at the latest.
Daarom heb ik besloten een beslissing op dit bezwaar aan te houden tot uiterlijk 1 juni 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over zorgaanbieder Vivium Thuiszorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about care provider Vivium Thuiszorg, which sued municipalities over tender conditions and wage scales for home-care staff, and about a reported mass dismissal later reversed. The State Secretary answered that the courts had ruled, that Vivium has since re-graded staff retroactively, that no dismissal application was filed with the UWV, and that cao composition is for the social partners.
It is not for me to judge the court's ruling.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de uitspraak van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het massaontslag bij zorginstelling Philadelphia

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the announced dismissal of 900 staff at care provider Philadelphia, its consequences for clients, participation, and whether volunteers and digital tools replacing professionals is responsible. The government answered that the reorganisation is the organisation's own choice in anticipation of the 2015 decentralisation and reforms, that staff and clients were consulted, that UWV makes its own independent assessment of dismissal permits, and that it cannot comment on individual board bonuses.
UWV weighs all relevant facts in its assessment. It is not for me to enter into this assessment.
UWV weegt in de beoordeling alle relevante feiten mee. Het is niet aan mij om in deze afweging te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars risicoselectie toepassen bij de aanvullende verzekering

The SP MP Leijten asked the Minister of Health about reports that health insurers apply medical risk selection to supplementary insurance, citing Daniël de Rijke's case, and whether this undermines solidarity and the attractiveness of basic insurance. The Minister answered that supplementary insurance falls under the free market and EU non-life directives, so no acceptance duty can be imposed, that the NZa monitors the market, and that she sees no reason to change the situation.
It is up to insurers to determine what is included in the supplementary package, what acceptance policy is followed and what price they charge for it.
Het is aan verzekeraars om te bepalen wat in het aanvullende pakket zit, welk acceptatiebeleid wordt gevoerd en welke prijs ze ervoor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over beleggingen in tabaksaandelen door pensioenfondsen en banken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health and the Finance Minister whether Dutch pension funds (notably ABP) and state-owned banks (SNS, ABN AMRO) investing in tobacco shares conflicts with FCTC article 5.3 and related recommendations, and whether the government would intervene. The government answered that pension funds and banks are responsible for their own investment policy, that the FCTC recommendations are not binding, that tobacco investment is legal and not excluded by law, and that it sees no reason to instruct ABP, while pointing to existing CSR transparency policy for state holdings.
It is not the government's task to monitor and assess the specific investments of individual funds.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet specifieke beleggingen van individuele fondsen te monitoren en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Rooise ondernemers met de Nixpress de landelijke kranten halen

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about a report that Roosendaal entrepreneurs run a bus taking minors to Belgian discotheques, circumventing the new Dutch age limit, and asked what municipalities and the police can do. The State Secretary agreed it is undesirable, said no alcohol sale to minors occurs so the Drink and Hospitality Act is not violated and municipal plans play little role, and noted that public drunkenness on return could be prosecuted under article 453 of the Criminal Code.
As long as no alcohol is sold to minors on the bus, there is no violation of the Drink and Hospitality Act.
Zolang in de bus geen alcohol wordt verkocht aan minderjarigen, is geen sprake van overtreding van de Drank- en Horecawet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over regulering van e-sigaretten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the RIVM e-cigarette factsheet, NVWA supervision of e-cigarettes under the Warenwet, enforcement capacity in light of an Audit Office report, and a minimum age of 18 for sales. The State Secretary defended the RIVM/NVWA safety work, explained that NVWA enforcement was limited until 2012, and said a minimum age must be set in law (not by AMvB), with options being mapped.
To create a legal basis, either the Warenwet or the Tabakswet must be amended.
Om een wettelijke basis te creëren, dient of de Warenwet of de Tabakswet te worden gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het besluit van Transvision om bij een vervoersreservering voor het bovenregionale Valysvervoer voor dezelfde dag 3 euro boete op te leggen

MP Leijten (SP) asks why Transvision will charge a 3 euro booking fee for same-day or late Valys transport bookings from 2014, and whether the Secretary of State was informed and will drop the fee. The Secretary of State replies that the fee was included in the tender requirements after consultation with client organisations to improve planning and reduce detours, and refuses to intervene.
I included this measure in the Programme of Requirements of the Valys transport tender in consultation with client organisations.
Deze maatregel heb ik in afstemming met cliëntenorganisaties opgenomen in het Programma van Eisen van de aanbesteding voor het Valysvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de boete voor mensen die gebruik maken van Valysvervoer

An MP asked whether a €3 late-booking charge, a rising commercial tariff of €1.31 from 2014 and the kilometre budget for Valys transport are fair compared with ordinary public transport. The Secretary of State said the late-booking charge is a planning measure, not a fine, that the commercial tariff is indexed under the programme of requirements and still below taxi fares, and referred the question on scrapping the kilometre limit to a letter of 19 December 2013.
There is no question of a penalty scheme.
Er is geen sprake van een boeteregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht dat kinderen en jongeren vaker antidepressiva slikken

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked about reports that children and young people increasingly take antidepressants, the progress of round-table talks on demedicalisation, monitoring, and related actions. The State Secretary says rising help-seeking reflects better diagnosis and treatment, outlines the round-table process, ongoing research, and planned follow-up without giving hard outcome data.
Before summer 2014 I will organise a third round table to keep the discussion going and to exchange experiences with demedicalisation.
Voor de zomer van 2014 organiseer ik een derde ronde tafel om de discussie gaande te houden en om ervaringen met demedicalisering uit te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over een minimumleeftijd voor de verkoop van e-sigaretten

An MP asked the state secretary about the addictive health risks of e-cigarettes, their appealing advertising aimed at youth, and whether a minimum sales age of 18 would be introduced quickly. The state secretary acknowledged the risk findings and said he intends to introduce an 18-year minimum age, with details to follow as soon as possible.
I will inform you as soon as possible about the details of how this will be implemented.
Ik zal u zo spoedig mogelijk nader informeren over de invulling hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de verbeterplannen van zorginstelling NOVO een papieren werkelijkheid waren

An SP MP asked the state secretary about an ARGO evaluation finding that care provider NOVO's improvement plans were a paper reality, and how oversight, family involvement and reflection failed. The state secretary acknowledged the ARGO findings matched the inspectorate's concerns, pointed to ongoing inspections and governance reforms, and gave no reason for the lack of family involvement.
At this moment an inspection investigation is ongoing into quality and safety at NOVO's other locations.
Op dit moment is er een inspectieonderzoek gaande naar de kwaliteit en veiligheid binnen de andere locaties van NOVO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het toestaan van kindermarketing in supermarkten

An MP asked the state secretary whether child-targeted marketing of unhealthy products in supermarkets, which drives children's pester-purchases, should be restricted, and why it is banned online and on TV but not in stores. The secretary replied that responsibility lies with industry self-regulation and parents, opposed legal measures, said supermarkets set shelf placement in consultation with manufacturers, and pointed to voluntary initiatives.
I am therefore not in favour of legal measures.
Ik ben daarom geen voorstander van wettelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Rebel over de opmars van e-sigaretten

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the rise of e-cigarettes, the EU tobacco directive's classification, marketing and lobbying by Philip Morris, and possible legal restrictions. The State Secretary responds that the EU framework is not decisive, that Dutch measures such as a minimum age are planned, and that RIVM/NVWA research on additives is ongoing.
I am also looking at other legal options to regulate the e-cigarette. I will inform your House of this as soon as possible.
Ik kijk ook naar andere wettelijke mogelijkheden om de e-sigaret te reguleren. Hierover zal ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het financieren van dure hobby’s met zorggeld

The MP asks whether the government condemns care executives spending care funds on private hobbies, whether the affected care provider's disabled children are protected, whether fines should benefit the institution, and whether fraudulent executives should be barred from care governance. The Secretary answers that such spending is very wrong and fraud is a priority, that the care office ensured continuity, that fines go to general revenue while the institution can reclaim money separately, and that a bill will require board members to present a certificate of conduct.
The letter 'Good governance in care' of 19 September 2013 announces that members of a management board must submit a certificate of conduct (VOG).
In de brief «Goed bestuur in de zorg» van 19 september 2013 staat aangekondigd dat leden van een raad van bestuur een verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG) moeten overhandigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het Foetaal Alcohol Syndroom

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Health about fetal alcohol syndrome, including whether professionals and specialised care are adequate and why a pregnancy warning logo on alcohol will only be sector-wide by 2016. The State Secretary replied that professionals are informed but have little FAS experience, that five specialised centres exist, that the alcohol sector has committed to a logo with compliance targets and monitoring, and that full implementation takes until 2016.
VWS receives annual progress reports from the alcohol sector, with an outlook for the coming year.
VWS ontvangt van de alcoholsector jaarlijkse rapportages over de voortgang, met daarbij een vooruitblik op het komende jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over ontoelaatbare kindermarketing via het Nationaal Schoolontbijt

An MP asked whether the Nationaal Schoolontbijt, sponsored by food companies, is allowed to distribute products that are too sweet, salty or fatty and whether industry self-regulation on child-directed advertising under age 12 is working. The state secretary defended the initiative as private responsibility, noted the Voedingscentrum advises on products, and said industry has agreed to stop advertising to children under 12 except for products meeting nutritional criteria from 2014.
I support it when private parties take their social responsibility to promote a healthy lifestyle for young people.
Ik ondersteun het wanneer private partijen hun maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid nemen om in te zetten op een gezonde leefstijl voor de jeugd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Rebel over zwangeren die alcohol blijven drinken

MPs Wolbert and Rebel asked about reports that many pregnant women keep drinking alcohol and how prevention policy reaches lower-educated women, and whether professionals discuss alcohol before conception. The Staatssecretaris answered that no safe amount of alcohol in pregnancy is advised, described existing public information, professional guidelines and training, and said the government will not further evaluate this but points to existing channels.
During pregnancy there is no safe amount of alcohol.
Bij zwangerschap bestaat geen veilige hoeveelheid alcohol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat de grootste online hulpwebsite van Nederland, hulpmix.nl, wordt opgedoekt

An MP asked whether the closure of the online help site hulpmix.nl for migrant youth, and the funding gap for online prevention, was consistent with e-health policy and how the government would address it. The minister acknowledged the closure is unfavourable, explained that preventive online counselling is not covered by insurance and that the subsidy scheme applies only to anonymous care, and said the state is not responsible for such youth chat services, referring initiators to municipalities and insurers.
It is not the task of the central government to provide this form of online help.
Het is geen taak van de rijksoverheid om te voorzien in deze vorm van online hulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het artikel ‘Vitale ouderen te duur voor zorg’

An MP asked the state secretary whether care offices phasing out lighter care packages in institutions forces residents to move, and whether existing clients' rights are protected. The secretary replied that existing clients keep their right to stay and to indicated care, that the measure applies only to new clients, and that he will consult care offices on the 2015 procurement principles.
Care offices respect the rights of existing clients with a light ZZP to stay in an institution.
Zorgkantoren respecteren de rechten van bestaande cliënten met een licht ZZP op verblijf in een instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over de effectiviteit van de Bob-campagne

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the ministers whether independent research shows the Bob campaign works, especially for young drivers, and whether a new, harder campaign concept is needed. The minister answered that annual effect measurements show a decline in drink-driving offenders, particularly among 18–24 year old men, and rejected a new youth concept and harder confrontational messaging as unsupported by evidence.
I do not agree with that finding.
Ik ben het niet eens met die constatering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Een uitdagende reis naar Azië, betaald met zorggeld'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether using personal budget (pgb) funds to pay for holiday trips abroad fits the purpose of the scheme, and whether such use is tracked or fraudulent. The State Secretary said the rules may need tightening, that data on abroad-spending is not available, and that the relevant care offices will be asked to check the specific case.
I therefore want to further examine whether adjusting the current rules is necessary to prevent unintended and undesirable situations.
Ik wil derhalve nader bezien of aanpassing van de huidige regels nodig is om onbedoelde en onwenselijke situaties te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over verpleegkundigen en verzorgenden die zichzelf onvoldoende toegerust vinden voor preventie en bevorderen van zelfmanagement

An MP asked the state secretary about a Nivel study showing many nurses and care workers feel insufficiently equipped for prevention and self-management support, and about training and practical education. The minister answered that the study gives only a signal without deeper analysis, that new professional profiles address these competences, that training institutions do not recognise the picture, and that the wijkverpleegkundige is central.
A further analysis of exactly where the shortcoming lies and what its cause is is lacking.
Een nadere analyse van waar het precies aan schort en wat de oorzaak daarvan is ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten massaal adviesbureaus inhuren voor hulp bij decentralisaties

MPs Kooiman and Leijten (SP) asked whether it is desirable that municipalities spend large sums on consultancy firms to prepare for the decentralisations and whether this should be stopped. The state secretary answered that municipalities bear their own responsibility and may hire commercial advisers, noted a non-commercial national transition bureau, and declined to commission a study of how much has been spent.

Given the municipalities' own responsibility for the decentralisation and my answers to the previous questions, I do not consider a study into the hiring of consultancy firms by municipalities necessary.
Gegeven de gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid bij de decentralisatie en mijn antwoorden op de vorige vragen acht ik een onderzoek naar de inhuur van adviesbureaus door gemeenten niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de helft van de zorgverleners vindt dat de zorg is verslechterd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health about a report that half of care workers feel care has deteriorated, along with questions on workload, flexible contracts, overtime, and working conditions. The government rejects the claim that care has deteriorated, points to sector benchmarks and inspection, announces a quality agenda, and defers collective labour matters to social partners while referring to its labour market letter.
I am of the view that additional measures, beyond existing policy and supervision by the Health Care Inspectorate, are not necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat extra maatregelen – naast reeds lopend beleid en het toezicht door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg – niet nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht verslaving gaat hand in hand met ADHD

An MP asked the health ministers how they respond to reports that addicts have ADHD far more often than non-addicts, why many addicted patients were never diagnosed, and whether clinicians and addiction services should screen better and integrate treatment. The government replied that ADHD is hard to diagnose alongside addiction, pointed to ongoing guideline revision and a forthcoming Gezondheidsraad advice, and said integrated treatment programmes and a new youth guideline already exist.
In the revision of the ADHD guideline, which the professional groups are currently working on, particular attention is being paid to diagnosis and medicalisation.
Bij de herziening van de richtlijn ADHD, waar de beroepsgroepen op dit moment aan werken, wordt in het bijzonder aandacht besteed aan diagnosticering en medicalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen door het nieuwe vergoedingensysteem duizenden euro’s zelf moeten betalen voor een hoortoestel

MP Leijten (SP) asked the minister whether people must pay thousands of euros themselves for hearing aids under the new reimbursement system, whether insurers follow the protocol, and whether she will restore the UWV-provided hearing aid benefit. Minister Schippers replied that she cannot yet assess insurer compliance or harm, that the effects will be monitored with a report in spring 2014, that insurers may set policy conditions under the Zvw with disputes referable to the SKGZ, and that she will not restore the separate UWV scheme.

At present I cannot assess whether health insurers comply with the agreements they have made themselves with the hearing aid industry and other parties, nor the number of people who would allegedly have been harmed.

Ik kan op moment niet beoordelen of zorgverzekeraars zich houden aan afspraken die zij zelf met de hoortoestellenbranche en andere partijen gemaakt hebben, noch van het aantal mensen dat naar uw zeggen gedupeerd zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Leijten over het financieel misbruik van ouderen

MPs De Wit and Leijten asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about financial abuse of elderly people, including whether notaries can report such abuse given their professional secrecy and whether it should be narrowed. The government answered that it had noted the broadcast and referred to earlier answers on notaries' duty of confidentiality and the KNB's step-by-step plan.
I refer to my answer to questions 2 and 3 from members Van Oosten and Van Veen.
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar mijn antwoord op vragen 2 en 3 van de leden Van Oosten en Van Veen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van Veen over een uitzending waarin aandacht wordt besteed aan het beoordelen van de wilsbekwaamheid door een notaris bij dementie

MPs Van Oosten and Van Veen asked about a broadcast on notaries assessing testamentary capacity in dementia cases, and whether notaries should be released from absolute professional secrecy to report suspected abuse. The government answered that notaries already have a duty to investigate such suspicions under professional rules and case law, can use a KNB reporting protocol, and that pilots on preventing financial exploitation of the elderly run until end 2014.
It is the notary's natural task to provide legal protection to his clients regarding the content and legal consequences of an intended legal act.
Het is de natuurlijke taak van de notaris om aan zijn cliënten rechtsbescherming te bieden ten aanzien van de inhoud en de rechtsgevolgen van een voorgenomen rechtshandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zorgcentrum Geerestein

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary for Health about the closure of care centre Geerestein, the selection of centres, the pace of closure, the possibility of separating housing and care, and transition support for care providers. The state secretary answered that the regional provider consulted the municipality and staff, that three alternative centres are within ten kilometres, that a feasibility study on converting the building is ongoing, and that the sector is supported through transition funding, but did not answer the question on timing for the 2014 budget.
