Because of gathering information and consultation with third parties, it was unfortunately not possible for me to answer your questions before the budget debate.
Vanwege het verzamelen van informatie en overleg met derden was het voor mij helaas niet mogelijk om uw vragen voor de begrotingsbehandeling te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat een standaard screening bij vrouwen met een botbreuk in veel gevallen huiselijk geweld kan voorkomen

An MP asked the state secretary whether standard screening of women with fractures could prevent domestic violence, and whether orthopaedic and trauma surgeons are trained to recognise abuse. The secretary acknowledged the Canadian study findings and the mandatory meldcode since July 2013, but left the question of a separate screening protocol to professional bodies and pointed to planned training improvements.
I leave the judgement on whether a separate screening is needed specifically for victims of fractures to the sector and professional organisations.
Ik laat het oordeel of specifiek voor slachtoffers van botbreuken een aparte screening nodig is over aan de branche- en beroepsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de dagbesteding grotendeels wegbezuinigd wordt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether cuts to transport to day care have caused people with disabilities to lose day care, and how many centres closed or clients were affected. The State Secretary answered that few complaints reached his ministry, that day care and transport remain entitlements, that the NZa received extra funding of 25 million euro for wheelchair users and children, and that the sector's problems are considered incidents, while promising only continued monitoring and transition support to municipalities.
I will continue to closely monitor the practice.
Ik blijf de praktijk goed volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeenten Barendrecht, Albrandswaard en Ridderkerk (de BAR-gemeenten) de huishoudelijke verzorging kapot bezuinigingen

Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary about reports that the BAR municipalities are restructuring home help toward result-based provision, questioning legality, indication by desired outcome, intermediaries, transfer of staff and the risk of cuts. The State Secretary answered that municipalities remain bound by the Wmo, that a complaint and appeal route exists, that existing clients keep their hours, and that no current indication of unlawful conduct requires action.

Where it would appear that the BAR municipalities' policy starting points, in intent or in implementation, are not compatible with the legal framework, I will hold the municipalities to account and, if necessary, take further measures.

Daar waar zou blijken dat de beleidsuitgangspunten van de BAR-gemeente, in opzet of in de uitvoering daarvan zich niet verhouden met de wettelijke kaders, zal ik de gemeenten daarop aanspreken en zo nodig verdergaande maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over seks in Schooltv Weekjournaal

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries whether teachers knew in advance about the 'Dr. Corrie' sex-education item in Schooltv Weekjournaal, why this format was chosen, and whether schools retain freedom over methods. The government answered that schools and broadcasters decide content and methods, that the state has no prior control over broadcasts under article 7 of the Constitution, and declined to discuss the presentation with the broadcaster.
The government has no prior supervision of or influence over the content or form of a television broadcast (art. 7 of the Constitution).
De overheid heeft geen voorafgaand toezicht of invloed op de inhoud of vorm van een televisie-uitzending (art. 7 van de Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeenten Gouda en Den Helder jonge kinderen verplicht te helpen in de huishouding

An MP asks the State Secretary whether municipalities such as Gouda and Den Helder may require young children to help with household chores under Wmo rules on usual care, and whether this harms children's wellbeing and schooling. The State Secretary replies that the Wmo places responsibility with municipalities, that children may do light household tasks according to their ability and age but should not take over professional care, that mantelzorg cannot be compelled, and that municipalities must assess each case individually.
This information is not centrally maintained.
Deze informatie wordt niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over investeren in luxueuze verpleeghuizen door zorgverzekeraar CZ

An SP MP asked the ministers whether health insurer CZ's investment arm, which funds luxury nursing homes for Alzheimer patients, is acceptable, whether vertical integration of insurers and providers is desirable, and whether premium money is used to create a two-tier elderly care system. The State Secretary replied that basic care is equal for everyone, that he has no objection to insurer investments unless they lead to vertical integration, and that the Martha Flora stake, paid from basic-premium income, is acceptable if transparent and intended for innovation.
As long as insurers' investments in care providers do not lead to vertical integration, I have no objection to them.
Zolang investeringen van zorgverzekeraars in zorgverleners niet leiden tot verticale integratie, heb ik daar geen bezwaar tegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Gouda verplicht 5-jarigen thuis de afwas te doen”

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that Gouda required 5-year-olds to do the dishes at home as part of household help assessments, and whether central criteria would be set for using the household's own social environment for domestic help. The State Secretary answered that under the Wmo municipalities are responsible, that the MO-zaak guideline is only a handreiking, that individual circumstances must be weighed, and that no national criteria are planned, while objections and appeals remain available to clients.
In that context, it is always possible for the client to lodge an objection (and appeal) against the municipality's decision on an application.
Daarbij geldt dat het voor cliënt altijd mogelijk is om bezwaar (en beroep) aan te tekenen tegen de besluitvorming op een aanvraag door de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het experiment regelarme zorg

MP Otwin van Dijk asks why care provider Careyn is leaving the regulation-light care experiment and whether administrative burden is really being reduced. The State Secretary cites Careyn's reasons (timing with the reform, need for AWBZ data for decentralisation, and costly alignment with regular registration), acknowledges some rules became more complex, and says administrative burden is largely cultural and will be tackled via standardised data exchange.
I am of the view that administrative burdens in long-term care should be limited to the minimum.
Ik ben van mening dat de administratieve lasten in de langdurige zorg tot het minimale beperkt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van de productie van GHB en de verkoop van grondstoffen hiervoor

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers how to tackle GHB production and the sale of its precursor GBL, including scheduling GBL, a ban on high-purity GBL, a licensing system, and denaturation. The government answered that the CAM quick scan is not yet finished, that a ban would likely be ineffective, that voluntary reporting and warnings to online sellers are in place, and that EU-level measures lacked support.
We expect such a ban would not or hardly be effective, because GBL with less than 80% purity can also be used in producing GHB.
Wij verwachten dat een dergelijk verbod niet of nauwelijks effectief zal zijn, omdat ook GBL met minder dan 80% zuiverheid kan worden toegepast bij de productie van GHB.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport de afgelopen vier jaar bijna een ton heeft geschonken aan het Apollo netwerk

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that ministry officials, including the director of medicines, take part in the Apollo network alongside pharmaceutical companies, that the ministry has paid about a million euros to it, and whether all exchanges and the conditional-reimbursement report can be made public. The minister defends officials' participation as necessary for practical policy knowledge, reports the ministry's annual contributions (about 20,000 to 24,200 euros a year since 2010), declines to disclose the cost of the contractor Accenture and withholds the network's internal exchanges under agreed confidentiality, while saying it is not a stated aim to publish more.
The Apollo network agreed not to go public except with any completed reports of the network.
In het Apollo netwerk is afgesproken om niet naar buiten te treden behoudens met eventuele afgeronde rapporten van het netwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht inzake een wetenschappelijk experiment met het telen van wiet in Utrecht

The MP Rebel asked the Ministers of Justice and Health about a Utrecht cannabis club and a proposed scientific cannabis-growing experiment, and whether an Opium Act exemption would shield the club from prosecution. The government answered that an application for an exemption from the Social Cannabis Club Domstad is pending, no experiment application has yet been filed, and that an exemption only removes prosecution for the covered conduct while the holder remains liable for conduct outside it.
An exemption means that the acts and conduct covered by the exemption are not prohibited under the Opium Act.
Een ontheffing strekt ertoe dat de handelingen en gedragingen waarop de ontheffing ziet niet verboden zijn op grond van de Opiumwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over experimenten met cannabisverstrekking

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the ministers about a proposed Utrecht experiment supplying cannabis to psychosis-vulnerable patients, including whether the Bureau Medicinale Cannabis should supply it and whether it is approved and tested against treaties. The State Secretary answered that no exemption request has been filed yet so questions on that experiment cannot be answered, that any request will be assessed against criteria consistent with international treaties, and that the Social Cannabis Club Domstad request is under review.

No application for an Opium Act exemption has yet been submitted for an experiment (of a treatment) supplying cannabis to patients with vulnerability to psychotic disorders and severe cannabis addiction.

Er is nog geen aanvraag voor een Opiumwetontheffing ingediend voor een experiment (van een behandeling) waarbij cannabis wordt verstrekt aan patiënten met een kwetsbaarheid voor psychotische stoornissen en een ernstige cannabisverslaving.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rutte over handhaving alcoholleeftijd

An MP (Rutte, VVD) asked the State Secretary for Health whether municipalities would concentrate enforcement of the alcohol age limit on 16-year-olds from 2014 and whether the rise to 18 should be delayed. The State Secretary (Van Rijn) answered that municipalities enforce unevenly, that enforcement is important but not the only means, announced a communication campaign, and rejected postponing the 18-year limit.
This autumn I will (together with various parties, such as supermarkets, hospitality, sports canteens, GGDs, etc.) launch a communication campaign
Dit najaar zal ik (samen met diverse partijen, zoals supermarkten, horeca, sportkantines, GGD’en, etc.) een communicatiecampagne starten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen blind zijn voor geweld tegen kinderen

MPs Ypma and Rebel asked the state secretary for Health whether hospitals miss many child abuse cases, why hospitals report too little, and about implementing the mandatory child check in emergency departments. The state secretary answered that hospital reports to the AMK have risen sharply, pointed to the new mandatory reporting code and sector norm, and said the inspectorate will enforce compliance and that a baseline measurement and 2015 evaluation of the child check are planned.
In addition, the IGZ supervises the introduction of the child check as a statutory minimum requirement of the reporting code within its regular oversight.
Daarnaast ziet de IGZ toe op invoering van de kindcheck als wettelijke minimumeis van de meldcode bij haar reguliere toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de tabakslobby in Nederland

An SP MP asked three ministers about tobacco industry lobbying, the use of industry-funded research and Philip Morris-commissioned STAR reports, and conflicts of interest. The government answered that industry-commissioned studies are reviewed on usefulness, that the STAR reports were confidential but the latest was published, and that it does not track professors' tobacco-industry ties beyond disclosed side positions.
I am not free to provide these reports to the House without the consent of the commissioning party.
Het staat mij niet vrij deze rapporten zonder toestemming van de opdrachtgever aan de Kamer te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen over het aantal dodelijke slachtoffers als gevolg van vervuilde xtc pillen

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen asked about deaths linked to contaminated ecstasy, the number of drug-related deaths over 20 years, and whether on-site drug testing at festivals should be reinstated. The government answered that cause of death is uncertain, that a full testing system is impossible and on-site testing gives false security, and that it sees no reason to revise drug policy, though it asked Trimbos to address the issue with professionals.
I see no reason to reconsider the current drug policy.
Ik zie geen reden het huidige drugsbeleid te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over handhaving door gemeenten van de leeftijdsgrens voor verkoop van alcohol

An MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities enforcing the new 18-year alcohol sales age would be lax, and how enforcement is being improved. The state secretary agreed enforcement matters, said enforcement varies by municipality with 230-350 inspectors deployed, and pointed to support tools and a communication campaign, though he stressed compliance should not rely on enforcement alone.
My impression is that municipalities approach their task of supervising compliance with the age limits differently.
Mijn beeld is dat de gemeenten hun taak om toe te zien op de naleving van de leeftijdsgrenzen verschillend oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de korting van 89 miljoen euro

Keijzer (CDA) asked the state secretary whether the planned 89 million euro cut to home care (huishoudelijke verzorging) would be withdrawn, what it means for Wmo tasks and municipal funding, and how the policy of keeping people living at home squares with the cuts. The state secretary answered that the 2014 cut will not go ahead, that the CPB and the Algemene Rekenkamer are reviewing municipal financing, and that a monitoring commitment on the Keijzer motion will be pursued.
I have also, in consultation with the VNG, asked the Netherlands Court of Audit to review the method of calculating the funds linked to the decentralisation.
Ook heb ik, in overleg met de VNG, de Algemene Rekenkamer gevraagd een toets te doen op de wijze van berekening van de met de decentralisatie samenhangende middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het verdwijnen van meldingen in het Advies- en Meldpunt Kindermishandeling

An MP asked the state secretary about the Kinderrechtenmonitor finding that it is unknown what happens to a child after a report to the AMK, and about a promised fix to the reporting system. The state secretary says the data on follow-up care is hard to retrieve due to technical problems, disagrees that outcomes are unknown since every AMK records referrals, and commits to a new Kits version from January 2014 that records specific follow-up care.
From January 2014 all AMKs will use this renewed version of Kits.
Vanaf januari 2014 zullen alle AMK's deze vernieuwde versie van Kits gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat bureaus jeugdzorg mogelijk failliet gaan als gevolg van de decentralisatie jeugdzorg

Two SP MPs asked whether Bureaus Jeugdzorg may go bankrupt and lose staff and continuity of youth care as provinces transfer youth care to municipalities, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that regional transition arrangements are due by 31 October 2013, that a support team and an independent commission (TSJ) will assess continuity and possible failures, and that the government may issue binding instructions to municipalities if continuity is not secured.

If this assessment shows that continuity of care is insufficiently secured, or that the required continuity of infrastructure or cooperation agreements between municipalities are inadequate, the national government will issue a binding instruction to the municipality or municipalities concerned under the Youth Act.

Als uit deze toetsing blijkt dat de continuïteit van zorg onvoldoende is geborgd of de daarvoor benodigde continuïteit van de infrastructuur of de samenwerkingsafspraken tussen gemeenten niet toereikend zijn, dan zal het rijk de desbetreffende gemeente(n) binnen de betreffende regio op basis van de Jeugdwet een aanwijzing geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Mishandeling Marokkaanse kinderen onderschat”

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked about a news report claiming child abuse among Moroccan-Dutch families is underestimated, based on a PhD study by Lahlah. The state secretary replied that the study adds knowledge to existing findings, pointed to existing prevention programmes and municipal responsibilities, and said the government will continue its approach to child abuse and juvenile crime.
The research by Ms Lahlah underlines that specific attention to intercultural differences is still needed.
Het onderzoek van mevrouw Lahlah onderstreept dat specifieke aandacht voor interculturele verschillen nog steeds nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat wethouders alarm slaan over de budgetten jeugdzorg

An SP MP asks the state secretary how he will respond to municipal alarms over shrinking youth care budgets, including reports that some South Holland municipalities face cuts above 10% and whether any will not submit their plans. The state secretary says he is in talks with the affected regions, is analysing the gap between indicative and calculated budgets, will send the transition committee's interim report, and promises definitive budgets in the 2014 circular.
At the beginning of October the Transition Committee Youth will come with an interim report on how the regional transition arrangements came about. I will send you this report.
Begin oktober zal de Transitiecommissie Jeugd met een tussenrapport komen over de totstandkoming van de regionale transitiearrangementen. Ik zal u dit rapport toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Den Haag en tabak’

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Health, Economic Affairs and Finance whether the government had consulted the tobacco industry before setting its position on the EU Tobacco Products Directive, and whether this conflicted with the FCTC treaty and earlier statements. The government replied that industry contact is limited to technical implementation matters, that the industry was only consulted on the directive after the BNC fiche was sent to parliament, and that no FCTC violation occurred.
VWS deliberately chose not to consult the tobacco industry and health organisations while the government position was being drafted.
VWS heeft er bewust voor gekozen om, ten tijde van het opstellen van het regeringsstandpunt, niet met de tabaksindustrie en de gezondheidsorganisaties in overleg te treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over reclame voor e-sigaretten

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about Flavor Vapes e-cigarette advertising showing a mother blowing smoke over a pram, whether such marketing should be banned, whether e-cigarettes should fall under the Medicines Act, and whether the answers would come before the plenary debate. The state secretary said the suggestion of risk-free use is worrying, that a general administrative order under the Warenwet with criteria on marketing is being prepared using NVWA and RIVM advice due in October, that the evidence on e-cigarettes as a gateway or cessation aid is still insufficient, and that e-cigarettes are for now treated as consumer goods under the Warenwet, with EU rules pending; he answered yes to timing.
I am preparing an AMVB under the Warenwet setting criteria for certain aspects of the e-cigarette, such as safety and quality, labelling and advertising.
Ik bereid een AMVB onder de Warenwet voor waarin criteria worden gesteld aan bepaalde aspecten van de e-sigaret, zoals veiligheid en kwaliteit, etikettering en reclames.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de wijziging van de Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte

The MP asks whether the Wgbh/cz applies to assistance dogs and whether the government will promote that. The Secretary of State answers that a bill extending the Act to goods and services, including public venues, is in preparation, which would require admitting guide dogs in nearly all cases unless a justified reason exists.

Such a legislative amendment would mean that the obligation to make effective adjustments (as laid down in Article 2 of that Act) will also apply to the field of goods and services and therefore also to public venues.

Een dergelijke wetswijziging heeft tot gevolg dat de verplichting om doeltreffende aanpassingen te treffen (zoals vervat in artikel 2 van die wet) ook op het terrein van goederen en diensten van toepassing zal zijn en dus ook voor de openbare gelegenheden zal gelden.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over het advies van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens aan het kabinet om mensen met een beperking meer kansen te geven in onderwijs, werk en maatschappelijk l

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Kerstens asked whether the government agrees that the draft laws for ratifying the UN disability convention give too few guarantees for an inclusive society, whether other laws should contain such guarantees, and whether a national action plan should be drawn up. The state secretary agreed to consult stakeholders on a plan of action, said the Participation Act and social support bill will be considered against the convention, and deferred final judgement to parliament.
In that context I intend to soon consult these parties to consider how to give shape to the implementation of the convention.
In dat kader wil ik binnenkort met deze partijen in overleg treden om te bezien hoe vorm kan worden gegeven aan de tenuitvoerlegging van het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de uitkomst van de consultaties over de 15% THC-norm voor cannabis

MP Van Tongeren asked the ministers why the consultation results on the 15% THC norm for cannabis were not sent with the impact analysis, and asked what weight was given to the arguments. The minister replied that the consultation advice was internal, now sent to the Chamber as an annex with formal reactions (municipal advice summarized), and that the Garretsen recommendation prompted the impact analysis, while article 3b(2) Opiumwet is not directly linked.
Nevertheless I am happy to comply with your request to send these to your House afterwards, as an annex to these answers.
Ik voldoe evenwel graag aan uw verzoek om deze alsnog aan uw Kamer te verzenden, als bijlage bij deze antwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgorganisatie Vierstroom familieleden verplicht tot mantelzorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether care provider Vierstroom's imposed moral obligation on relatives to provide informal care (4 hours a month) conflicts with government's stance that informal care may not be compulsory, and asked about pay, NZa oversight and concrete measures. The state secretary answered that no obligation exists, that the experiment is voluntary, that the NZa found no violation of the Wmg, and that no measures against Vierstroom are needed.
Vierstroom does not impose informal care and therefore I will not take any measures.
Vierstroom verplicht geen mantelzorg en daarom ga ik geen maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over de uitleg hervorming Langdurige Zorg

An MP asks the state secretary whether his explanatory animation on the long-term care reform, which mentions severely demented elderly and people with serious disabilities as examples of those who keep access to care, is consistent with his April 2013 policy letter, notably the 50% figure for ZZP4 V&V clients staying at home. The secretary answers that the examples are not exhaustive, that the 50% figure is unchanged, that he sees no contradiction and will not amend the text, and promises the Wmo and core-AWBZ bills with clearer eligibility criteria this autumn.
I see no contradiction between the policy letter of 25 April 2013 and the text of the explanimation.
Ik zie geen tegenstelling tussen de hoofdlijnenbrief van 25 april 2013 en tekst van de explanimation.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Zorgverzekeraar kan verplichte mantelzorg contracteren

Krol asks whether insurers can require care institutions to demand family caregiving from residents' relatives, whether institutions may refuse clients without it, and what happens to elderly people without nearby relatives. The State Secretary denies mandatory caregiving is possible, says zorgkantoren may only stimulate network participation (e.g. via tariff premiums), and sees no need for new measures given the encouraging Vierstroom experiment.
I want to emphasise again that there is no question of, and there can be no question of, mandatory informal care.
Ik wil nogmaals benadrukken dat er geen sprake is en kan zijn van verplichte mantelzorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat er toch werklozen ingezet worden als thuishulp

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that unemployed people would be deployed as home-care helpers, and whether this would replace dismissed care workers at lower pay. The state secretary said that personal care requiring qualifications must stay with qualified professionals, that municipalities may use volunteers and job-seekers for non-qualified support within their Wmo discretion, and that the national government does not collect data on this.
No. Municipalities account to their municipal council for the implementation of the Wmo. The national government does not collect information on this.
Nee. Gemeenten leggen aan hun gemeenteraad verantwoording af over de uitvoering van de Wmo. Het Rijk verzamelt hierover geen informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over over het bericht dat ambtenaren een 6-daagse cursus krijgen tot jeugdpsychiater

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked whether a six-day course giving civil servants a basic understanding of youth psychiatry is consistent with the transfer of youth care to municipalities, and whether officials deciding on care access could be influenced by municipal budgets. The state secretary replied that the course gives policy staff insight only, that diagnosis remains with qualified professionals, and that municipalities decide their own training and are bound by legal duties to provide adequate care.
It is up to municipalities to determine which training they consider necessary to be properly equipped by January 2015.
Antwoord 2 Het is aan de gemeenten om te bepalen welke opleidingen zij noodzakelijk achten om per januari 2015 goed toegerust te zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Leijten over braille leesregels voor blinden en slechtzienden

MPs Ulenbelt and Leijten asked why blind and partially sighted people with a job must often buy two braille displays, one funded by the health insurer and one by UWV, when one could serve both settings. The government answered that the insurer-funded display may be used at work and at home, and that UWV only funds a second device when the first is unsuitable for the job, so no change or consultation is planned.
A braille display provided by the health insurer may be used both privately and in the work situation.
Een braille leesregel die is verstrekt door de zorgverzekeraar mag zowel in de privé als de werksituatie worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat ambtenaren de toegang tot jeugdpsychiatrie gaan bepalen

An MP asked whether municipal officials completing a six-day youth psychiatry course could decide on access to youth mental health care, how children would be protected from gaps in care, and whether decentralisation should be postponed. The state secretary rejected the premise that the course qualifies officials to diagnose, stated that diagnosis and referral remain with doctors or specialists, and declined to postpone decentralisation.
That does not mean they will be authorised to diagnose in future.
Dat wil nog niet zeggen dat zij daarmee bevoegd zijn om straks te kunnen gaan diagnosticeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat het UWV een ontslagvergunning heeft verleend aan thuiszorgorganisatie Sensire om 1.100 thuiszorgmedewerkers te ontslaan

PvdA MPs asked the government about UWV granting a dismissal permit to home-care organisation Sensire to lay off 1,100 workers, including whether more care providers would seek preventive dismissals and whether a convenant with the sector was planned. The state secretary replied that talks with municipalities and stakeholders took place, that UWV does not grant preventive dismissal permits while tendering is uncertain, and that a convenant has little added value; instead municipalities will be informed about timely tendering.
In that case the policy line, under current regulations, is that UWV does not grant a dismissal permit because there is no certainty about the structural loss of jobs.
In dat geval is de beleidslijn, op basis van de huidige regelgeving, dat UWV geen ontslagvergunning verleent omdat er geen zekerheid bestaat over het structureel vervallen van arbeidsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het opgezegde vertrouwen van de familieraad in de Raad van bestuur van gehandicaptenzorginstelling NOVO

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about the family council's withdrawal of confidence in the NOVO care institution's Board, including a death in isolation, delayed informing of families, the regime method, and police detention of a resident. The state secretary largely declined to judge the board's conduct, pointed to the Inspectorate's findings, noted one board member had resigned, and said several matters were not known to him or fell to other bodies.

On the content of the central family council's considerations and statements I do not wish to make a judgment, because this is primarily a matter between the family council and the Board of Directors.
Over de inhoud van de afwegingen en uitspraken van de centrale familieraad wil ik geen uitspraak doen omdat dit primair een zaak is tussen de familieraad en de Raad van Bestuur.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de massaontslagen in de zorg

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary of health about mass layoffs across care providers ahead of planned cuts, questioning their consistency with government policy and how quality and workers would be protected. The state secretary replied that employers must respond to changing care demand and that layoff decisions are for employers subject to the preventive dismissal review, while stating the government's aim is sustainable care and that quality oversight remains unchanged.
It is the responsibility of employers to take account of numerous environmental factors and to act on them as well as possible.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van werkgevers om met talloze omgevingsfactoren rekening te houden en daar zo goed mogelijk naar te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat steeds meer gezinnen op straat belanden door de crisis

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that more families are ending up on the street due to the crisis, including refused shelter admissions in Groningen, Drenthe and Friesland. The state secretary replied that centre municipalities monitor rising applications, report no signs of families sleeping rough involuntarily, lack reliable national counts of homeless families, and point to prevention measures and the Trimbos-commissioned monitoring.
The Monitor Stedelijk Kompas 2012 shows there is no good picture of how many families in the Netherlands are currently homeless.
Uit de Monitor Stedelijk Kompas 2012 blijkt dat er geen goed beeld is van hoeveel gezinnen in Nederland op dit moment dakloos zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over nulurencontracten in de zorg

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Health whether zero-hours contracts in care are being disguised as variants, how many such contracts exist, and what measures will be taken. The state secretary mostly refers to earlier answers, says he has no data, and states that working conditions are for social partners to settle.
I do not know that. I also consider that a matter that primarily concerns the social partners in the sector concerned.
Dat weet ik niet. Dat vind ik ook een zaak die primair de sociale partners in de desbetreffende sector regardeert.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat een  in afwachting van hoger beroep zijnde veroordeelde zedendelinquent een baan in de gehandicaptenzorg kon krijgen

MPs asked why a convicted sex offender awaiting appeal could take a job in disability care, and how the government will prevent similar cases, including VOG requirements, IGZ reporting of sexual misconduct complaints, and supervision of offenders pending appeal. The state secretary said the pending Wkkgz bill would require providers to vet staff and allow a VOG requirement by decree, IGZ transparency is limited by confidentiality, and immediate enforceability of probation conditions now exists though no figures are kept, with evaluation planned after three years.

With every request for information, a judgement is made about which information can be disclosed without harming those involved, breaching medical confidentiality, or disrupting the treatment process.

Bij elk verzoek om informatie wordt de afweging gemaakt welke informatie naar buiten kan worden gebracht zonder de betrokkenen te beschadigen, het medisch beroepsgeheim te schenden, of het behandelproces te verstoren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over de toegenomen exitpremies van zorgbestuurders

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked about rising severance payments to healthcare executives and whether pay rose before the WNT pay-cap law took effect, and whether the government would act faster or retroactively. The minister answered that 2012 pay data will come in the December 2013 report, that the WNT transition period is kept as adopted, and that retroactive changes are undesirable given property rights and legal certainty.
For the public and semi-public sectors it will not be possible to answer this question and similar questions on actual developments in top incomes for the year 2012.
Voor de publieke en semipublieke sectoren zal het niet mogelijk zijn over het jaar 2012 deze vraag en vergelijkbare vragen over feitelijke ontwikkelingen in verband met topinkomens te beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het meldpunt ‘De overgang naar een nieuwe thuiszorg’

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Health about a complaints report on the transition to new home care in Rotterdam, including lost care hours, job losses and cuts to domestic help. The state secretary answered that the municipality and providers are responsible, that the Wmo gives municipalities that responsibility, and that he sees no reason to intervene at this stage.
It is up to the municipality of Rotterdam to assess the reports and take action where necessary.
Het is aan de gemeente Rotterdam om de meldingen te beoordelen en zo nodig tot actie over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Mantelzorgers mishandelen uit stress’

An MP asked the state secretary whether rising elder abuse by overburdened informal carers, combined with cuts to home help and day care, shows the government's policy is at fault, and whether municipalities can provide respite care despite budget cuts. The secretary denied a causal link, pointed to better support for carers and a respite-care guide being drafted with the VNG, and announced a study into improving the handling of 'derailed' informal care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen gebitten laten wegrotten

An SP MP asked the state secretary of health about reports that nursing homes let residents' teeth rot, asking about signals, staffing, the IGZ's role and whether an investigation would follow. The state secretary answered that care providers are primarily responsible, that the IGZ has started a dental-care inspection programme in nursing homes with extension to disability care planned, and that further investigation is not considered useful.
The IGZ supervises whether the quality and therefore the safety of care is not endangered, and thus forms the final safeguard.
De IGZ houdt toezicht of de kwaliteit en daarmee de veiligheid van zorg niet in gevaar komt, en vormt daarmee het sluitstuk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Leijten en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat zorginstelling Aafje uit voorzorg ontslag heeft aangevraagd voor honderden thuiszorgmedewerkers

MPs Kooiman, Leijten and Ulenbelt asked whether care provider Aafje's precautionary dismissal request for hundreds of home-care workers was premature and whether the UWV should grant it, and about municipal tendering practices. The state secretary replied that the dismissal request is not expected to proceed, explained the UWV's approach to dismissal permits tied to tenders, the rules on taking over staff, and that municipalities are responsible for tendering and must follow the law.
I have since understood that the dismissal request will not go ahead, at least for the time being.
Inmiddels heb ik begrepen dat de ontslagaanvraag er – in ieder geval voorlopig – niet gaat komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het hebben van een ‘zomerstop’ in de thuiszorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities may impose a summer stop on home-care replacement for budget reasons, and how continuity of care is guaranteed. The state secretary replied that the matter concerns Wmo support, which is the municipalities' responsibility, that continuity is expected where signals show need, and that the Wmo offers legal remedies, but declined to compile an overview or ban summer stops.
There is no overview available of how municipalities provide household help to clients who depend on it.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van hoe gemeenten voorzien in de huishoudelijke hulp van cliënten die daarop zijn aangewezen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel ‘De macht van de tabakslobby, hoe de industrie de winkelier voor haar karretje spant’

An SP MP asked the government for its reaction to a press article on tobacco industry lobbying, including the moral judgement on covertly funded anti-tobacco-prevention campaigns and the FSIT fund linked to the NSO retailers' association, and whether other similar fundraising organisations exist and what will be done to prevent them. The state secretary answered that retailer organisations may freely represent their sector's interests, that other similar bodies may exist, and that they must comply with existing rules such as the tobacco advertising ban, without committing to new action.
It is not for the cabinet to prevent such organisations, which seek to represent the interests of a sector, from being established.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te voorkomen dat dergelijke organisaties, die de belangen van een sector willen vertegenwoordigen, worden opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over een falende zorgbestuurder die nu weer bestuursvoorzitter is van een woonzorg centrum waar een 91-jarige mevrouw op dubieuze wijze overleden is

An MP asked the state secretary about a care executive who again chairs a care home where a 91-year-old woman died under dubious circumstances, and asked how to stop such executives moving between care providers and whether people convicted of elder abuse can be barred from care work. The state secretary said responsibility for governance lies with providers, pointed to planned measures and an autumn letter on good governance, said the IGZ and police investigations prevent further comment on this case, and said convicted elder abusers should not work in care, referring to the pending Wkkgz bill and its VOG requirement.
In the interest of these investigations I cannot make any further statements.
In het belang van deze onderzoeken kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat zorginstellingen hun eigen vermogens hebben vergroot naar 9 miljard euro

An SP MP asked why care providers grew their own equity to 9 billion euros in 2012 while staff are being dismissed, and whether the government will intervene. The minister answered that the underlying report is not yet available, that equity serves to absorb setbacks and fund investment, and that the government will not intervene or publish a full sector overview.
The report on which the Intrakoop press release is based is not yet available.
Het rapport waarop het persbericht van Intrakoop is gebaseerd, is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat patiënten gedwongen worden te verhuizen

MP Leijten asks whether patients at GGZ Centraal are being forcibly moved out of long-standing homes, whether families, staff and works and client councils approved, what alternatives were examined, and how care and staffing are safeguarded. Minister Schippers answers that no patients are forced to move, that a few patients moved with consent to FACT-supported living or sheltered housing, that councils gave positive advice, and that the Inspectorate found care in order and will re-inspect within two months.
The inspectorate recently carried out unannounced inspection visits to several GGZ Centraal locations.
De inspectie heeft recent onaangekondigde inspectiebezoeken gebracht aan verschillende locaties van GGZ Centraal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het onderzoek naar de inzet van mystery guests

An MP asked the state secretary about the IGZ pilot using mystery guests in elderly care, which produced few results and was criticised for limited scale and use of non-inspectors. The state secretary answered that the pilot's limited design explains the thin results, that the evaluation found added value but needed a better approach, and that a decision on future use will follow the 2014 evaluation.
However, the research also shows that the approach chosen in the pilot led to too few concrete results for the inspectorate.
Uit het onderzoek blijkt echter ook dat de in de pilot gekozen invulling tot te weinig concrete resultaten heeft geleid voor de inspectie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Keijzer over het extramuraliseren van ZZP 1 en 2 en het inkoopbeleid van zorgkantoren

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked the state secretary about the extramuralisation of care packages ZZP 1 and 2 at a care home, the withdrawal of funding for residents with heavy care needs, and care purchasing policy of care offices. The state secretary answered that existing clients' rights to residence will be respected, that the transition plan and contracting framework will be sent to parliament, but declined to give a count of closing care homes and referred to workforce effects being mapped.
As I indicated in my answer to question 3, the care office has, from a quality perspective, started the discussion about purchasing care without the treatment component.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 heb aangegeven, is het zorgkantoor vanuit kwaliteitsoogpunt de discussie gestart over het inkopen van zorg zonder de behandelcomponent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het bericht ‘dat er nog altijd veel mis is in de gehandicaptenzorg’

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about a Nieuwsuur report on continued problems in disability care, including untrained staff in risky situations, low staffing scores, and high rates of unjustified coercive measures. The state secretary answered that inspection signals do not show more untrained staff, disputed the comparability of the inspection figures, and pointed to the Zorg en dwang bill and the Actieprogramma onvrijwillige zorg as the response.
With the Action Programme on involuntary care I am stimulating that.
Met het Actieprogramma Onvrijwillige zorg stimuleer ik dat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘dat er nog altijd veel mis is in de gehandicaptenzorg’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about a broadcast claiming many disability care institutions still fail minimum norms on restraint measures, plus related questions on training, registration, and liability. The state secretary rejected the broadcast's picture as unrepresentative (based on 44 risk-selected inspections), pointed to the Zorg en Dwang bill and an action programme, and promised a uniform registration of restraints and further research.
I want research to be carried out, in line with the Denktank's recommendations, into how clients experience involuntary care and into tools for care workers to better assess this experience.

Ik wil dat er, in lijn met de aanbevelingen van de Denktank, onderzoek worden gedaan naar de beleving van onvrijwillige zorg door cliënten en naar hulpmiddelen voor hulpverleners om deze beleving van cliënten beter te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Inpakken en wegwezen na overlijden in verpleeghuis’

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the state secretary about a Consumentenbond survey finding that nursing homes often clear a deceased resident's room before the seven-day period in the general conditions, and that about 40% give incorrect or no information on this. The state secretary said such practice is hurtful, that the seven-day rule was agreed with consumer and patient organisations, and that he will raise non-compliance with the sector organisation Actiz in regular meetings.
In the regular consultation my ministry has with the branch organisations, I will raise why such clear agreements are still not always complied with.
In het overleg dat mijn ministerie regulier met de branche-organisaties heeft, zal ik aan de orde stellen waarom dergelijke heldere afspraken toch niet altijd worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Spullen overledenen gedumpt in vuilniszak; Verzorgingshuizen ontruimen kamers veel te snel’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that care homes clear deceased residents' rooms too quickly and bag belongings, and why the NZa did not act. The state secretary said the 7-day clearance rule in the Algemene Voorwaarden is not always followed, will raise it with the sector, asked the NZa to investigate mutation days, and said Actiz will warn members and sanctions run through the complaints scheme.
I have asked the NZa to examine the matter of mutation days more closely, take action where necessary, and inform me about it.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd de materie van mutatiedagen nader te onderzoeken, zo nodig actie te ondernemen en mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Onmacht en angst zag ik in de time-outkamer’

Bergkamp (D66) asked about care-institution managers discussing a deceased client's case in a national newspaper, and whether this breaches medical confidentiality and privacy. The state secretary answered that privacy law does not protect the deceased, that confidentiality is only breached under narrow exceptions, leaves judging any breach to the courts, and commits to asking the CIZ to examine the indication procedure and inform relatives.
I consider the scope for protecting privacy in general to be sufficient.
Ik acht de ruimte voor het beschermen van de privacy in algemene zin voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toepassing van een zelfbedachte behandelmethode

Parliamentary questions from MP Bergkamp (D66) ask whether an institution (NOVO in Onnen) experimented with a self-devised treatment method, whether that is permitted and supervised, and how the rules on taking over a location with a Bopz indication apply. The state secretary answers that the Kwaliteitswet applies to experimental treatments with the institution board responsible and the IGZ supervising, that no separate legal regime exists for new methods, and that NOVO never applied for a Bopz designation and had no Bopz clients, so the location was not authorised for such admissions.
Yes. The Quality Act also applies to experimental treatments.
Ja. De Kwaliteitswet is ook op experimentele behandelingen van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat NOVO onder verscherpt toezicht staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the death of a resident of care institution NOVO after fixation, the IGZ's critical findings, and why the case was dropped and the institution's location closed. The State Secretary answered that structural shortcomings were found at the Onnen location, which has since closed, that the IGZ is monitoring the other locations, and that the public prosecutor's dismissal was upheld by the court.
The public prosecution service did take this decision carefully, however, and it was reviewed by the court.
Het OM heeft dit besluit echter zorgvuldig genomen en het is door de rechter getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het signaal dat steeds meer Zorgkantoren een pgb-ontmoedigingsbeleid voeren

An MP asked the state secretary whether health insurers (Zorgkantoren) discourage personal budgets (pgb) by refusing them when clients have not explored contracted care and by holding conversations meant to deter pgb use, and whether this undermines the pgb as an equal alternative to care in kind. The state secretary answered that the approach follows the 2013 budget agreement, is aimed at conscious pgb choice rather than deterrence, and that he sees no signals that clients choosing pgb-funded small-scale housing were refused, while committing to keep discussing the matter with the insurers.
I do not characterise this approach as a deterrence policy, but as a policy aimed at conscious use of the pgb.
Ik kwalificeer deze aanpak niet als een ontmoedigingsbeleid, maar een beleid om te komen tot een bewust gebruik van het pgb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over regeldruk bij de nieuwe Jeugdwet

Keijzer (CDA) asked the state secretary about regulatory burden under the new Youth Act, including Actal's advice on centring young people and families, national certification, quality registers, inspections and accountability information. The government answered that the Act aims to reduce burden and strengthen families, that gemeenten bear responsibility for their own information gathering, that certification and inspections are coherent, and that a minimal uniform dataset will replace the current reporting format.

Together with the VNG, the creation of a uniform set of accountability information is being investigated, which municipalities can request in a standardised way from institutions through a shared facility.
Met de VNG wordt de totstandkoming van een uniforme set verantwoordingsinformatie onderzocht, die gemeenten gestandaardiseerd via een gemeenschappelijke voorziening bij instellingen kunnen uitvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er twijfels zijn over de dood van een bewoner in een zorginstelling

An SP MP asked the state secretary about media reports doubting the death of a resident in a care institution, including whether the Inspectorate had imposed enhanced supervision, how long the Inspectorate took to visit, prior complaints, and whether staff were heard. The state secretary answered that the institution remains responsible for safety, no enhanced supervision has been imposed yet, an independent external investigation is underway with the family's agreement, and the institution is in contact with the family.
At present the external investigation by independent investigators into the report is ongoing. Based on the outcomes of this investigation, the IGZ will determine further steps.
Op dit moment loopt het externe onderzoek door onafhankelijke onderzoekers naar de melding. Op grond van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal de IGZ verdere stappen bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bergkamp over het formuleren van kritische succesfactoren ten aanzien van de Transitie Jeugdzorg

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked whether critical success factors with SMART indicators should be formulated to monitor the youth care transition and what conditions must be met by 1 January 2014 for a responsible transition on 1 January 2015. The state secretary answered that the Transitieplan Jeugd, the spoorboekje and the independent Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd, which will assess regional arrangements on three criteria, serve as the steering instruments, without publishing SMART success factors.

The Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd (TSJ) will assess the regional transition arrangements on the basis of three criteria: realisation of continuity of care, realisation of the required infrastructure and limiting the friction costs resulting from the transition.

De Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd (TSJ) zal de regionale transitiearrangementen beoordelen op basis van drie criteria: realisatie continuïteit van zorg, realisatie benodigde infrastructuur en het beperken van de frictiekosten als gevolg van de transitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een verstandelijk beperkte vrouw

An SP MP asked the state secretary and the justice minister about the death of a woman with an intellectual disability, including the NOVO care institution's kort geding to block broadcast of security camera footage, whether the IGZ had seen the footage, whether the footage was part of the criminal investigation, and the delay in answering. The government answered that the court, not the minister, decides on such privacy objections and did not ban broadcast, that the IGZ had viewed the footage at the police station, that the footage was included in the criminal investigation, and that more time was needed to answer.
It is not for me, but for the judge, to assess whether such an objection – in this case based on privacy considerations – is well-founded or not.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de rechter om te beoordelen of een dergelijk verzet – in deze kwestie ingegeven uit overwegingen van privacy – gegrond is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het gegeven dat er nog steeds geleidehonden van blinden en slechtzienden worden geweigerd in openbare gelegenheden.

An MP asks the state secretary for Health about guide dogs for blind and partially sighted people being refused in public places, as shown in a TV item. The secretary acknowledges the problem, points to awareness work, Amsterdam's taxi rule and a planned amendment of the equal treatment act that would extend reasonable-adjustment duties to goods and services, which would generally oblige public places to admit guide dogs.
This bill, together with the bill approving the treaty, is expected to be sent to the Council of State for advice after the summer.
Dit wetsontwerp zal te samen met het wetsvoorstel tot goedkeuring van het verdrag na verwachting na de zomer voor advies aan de Raad van State worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport “Opgeven is geen optie” van GGMD

An MP asked the state secretary about the GGMD report on multiple problems among deaf people and whether specific groups will be addressed in the planned letter on reforming long-term care. The secretary answered that the report concerns contracting between care offices and a provider, that he will address care for sensory-impaired people in a forthcoming letter, and that he will take into account a CVZ advisory report.
In the promised letter on specific groups I will also address the positioning of care and services for sensory-impaired people.
Ik zal in de toegezegde brief over specifieke groepen ook ingaan op de positionering van de zorg en dienstverlening aan zintuiglijk gehandicapten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Twijfels over cijfers geweld tegen ouderen”

The MP Bergkamp (D66) asks the state secretary whether the estimate of 200,000 abused elderly people per year rests on a 1996 study, whether it is still realistic, and whether new research will be commissioned. The state secretary confirms the estimate stems from 1996, says the true figure is likely much higher due to a taboo, and announces an exploratory study on feasibility of quantitative research to be reported in the autumn 2013 progress letter.
I therefore first want an exploration carried out into the possibilities for such research.
Ik wil daarom eerst een verkenning laten uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheden van een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Laar over de participatie van doven en slechthorenden binnen de samenleving

MPs Bergkamp and Van Laar asked about participation of deaf and hard-of-hearing people in education, the labour market and sheltered workshops over ten years. The state secretary provided enrolment figures, noted missing data on start qualifications, sheltered workshop disability types and CI status, and gave older OSA labour-market estimates.
I cannot answer the question of how the ratio is among deaf pupils with and without a cochlear implant.
Ik kan geen antwoord geven op de vraag hoe de verhouding is onder dove leerlingen met en zonder cochleair implantaat.
Antwoord vragen Hamer en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat het UWV een ontslagvergunning heeft verleend aan thuiszorgorganisatie Sensire om 1.100 thuiszorgmedewerkers te ontslaan

Two PvdA MPs asked why UWV granted Sensire permission to dismiss 1,100 home-care workers despite the care accord and whether the works council and unions were overruled. The minister said UWV applied the dismissal rules on business-economic grounds, that the decision is for UWV and the municipalities, and that the state secretary will contact the parties shortly.
UWV acted in application of the dismissal and policy rules.
UWV heeft gehandeld met toepassing van de ontslag- en beleidsregels.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Ulenbelt ver over het bericht dat thuiszorgmedewerkers massaal ontslagen worden

MPs Kooiman and Ulenbelt asked why UWV granted dismissal permits for about 1,100 home-care workers at Thuishulp Sensire and whether the state will intervene. The state secretary answered that the dismissals are the employer's own business decision on economic grounds, that UWV acted within its rules, that most work should remain in 2014 and that he will contact the parties and report on transition plans.
UWV acted in accordance with the dismissal and policy rules.
UWV heeft gehandeld in overeenstemming met de ontslag- en beleidsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de ouderenzorg slecht voorbereid is op een hittegolf

SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether elderly care is poorly prepared for heatwaves, why many care institutions lack cooling and heat protocols, and whether inspection and the GGD monitor this. The state secretary rejected the generalisation, said heat protocols are not mandatory but care providers must deliver good care including heat measures supervised by the IGZ, and declined to commission a survey of protocol compliance.
I have asked the inspectorate to inform me directly if it appears that institutions do not have this policy in order.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd mij direct te informeren indien blijkt dat instellingen dit beleid niet op orde hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Drinken tijdens zwangerschap kan gewoon’

MPs Bruins Slot, Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether a UK study suggesting moderate drinking in pregnancy is harmless changes government advice, and how professional guidance and a warning logo will be addressed. The State Secretary answered that the advice to avoid alcohol in pregnancy stands, will be raised with professional groups, and that talks with the drinks sector on a voluntary pregnancy logo continue, with a report to follow after summer.
The government's position remains that it is best to avoid drinking alcohol when you want to become pregnant, are pregnant or are breastfeeding.
Het standpunt van de overheid is nog altijd dat het het beste is het drinken van alcohol te vermijden wanneer je zwanger wilt worden, zwanger bent of borstvoeding geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over de vergoeding van hoortoestellen aan mensen met een structurele functionele hoorbeperking

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked why people with a structural functional hearing impairment can no longer claim hearing aids from UWV for keeping their job, whether referral to health insurers is adequate, and whether the 25% co-payment and deductible burden is acceptable. The minister answered that since 2013 all necessary hearing aids fall under the Zvw, that the 25% co-payment applies to hearing devices, and that he is not willing to reverse the change, while providing UWV and insurer expenditure figures.
No, I am not willing to reverse the removal of hearing aid reimbursements from the UWV or to expand reimbursement of hearing aids in the basic package.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om het schrappen van de vergoedingen voor hoorhulpmiddelen vanuit het UWV ongedaan te maken of om de vergoeding van hoorhulpmiddelen in het basispakket te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over ‘vechtscheidingen’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the health ministry about rising 'high-conflict divorces', the sources behind claims about their outcomes, research on relationship support and parenting plans, registration of such cases, and whether divorce costs should be studied. The state secretary replies that no rising trend is established, points to ZonMw-funded research and WODC studies on parenting plans, declines to create a statistical definition or register, and says the cost study would not establish causation.
The Ministry of VWS has instructed ZonMw to include 'divorce' as a priority theme within the programme.
Het ministerie van VWS heeft ZonMw opdracht gegeven om «echtscheiding» als prioritair thema binnen het programma op te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat online alcoholhoudende drank kopen kinderspel is

MPs Van der Staaij and Bruins Slot asked whether municipalities lack effective enforcement powers over online alcohol sales to minors, and whether the Drank- en Horecawet should change. The state secretary acknowledged weak enforcement of online sales, outlined interministerial work on eID-based age verification with no firm timeline, and argued that parents bear primary responsibility.
In practice it has proved difficult to exercise adequate supervision here, because delivery takes place at the front door at unpredictable moments.
In de praktijk is het lastig gebleken hier adequaat toezicht op te houden, omdat het gaat om levering aan de voordeur op niet te voorspellen momenten.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber en Schouten over mantelzorgers die weinig steun hebben aan hun baas

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked whether the government recognises that informal carers receive little support from their employers, whether it will convene social partners to improve workplace arrangements, and what further measures it will take. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to a planned labour-and-care summit with social partners in autumn and to extended leave rules, and said the carers letter would address the work-care link only briefly.
In the coming period we will work together with the minister and state secretary of OCW to prepare a 'labour-and-care summit' which is expected to take place in the autumn.
De komende tijd werken wij samen met de minister en staatssecretaris van OCW een «arbeid-en-zorgtop» uit die naar verwachting in het najaar zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen Agema over het bericht ‘200 medewerkers weg bij Pleyade’

MP Agema asked the state secretary about reported layoffs of 200 staff at care provider Pleyade, linking them to AWBZ funding for extra staff and to risks for elderly care and inspection. The state secretary attributes the reorganisation to falling client demand, says care access is guaranteed through AWBZ indications and the care office, and sees no reason to intensify inspection.
I see no reason to intensify the inspection task at Pleyade.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de controletaak bij Pleyade te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over de onbekendheid van verlofregelingen bij mantelzorgers

An MP asked the state secretaries about caregivers' unawareness of leave schemes, employer information duties, and how the AOW cohabitation rule affects elderly carers. The government acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing leave schemes and planned an information project and a labour-and-care summit, and referred the AOW question to a later response.
That is why we intend to carry out a project aimed at informing working caregivers and employers.
Daarom zijn wij voornemens om een project gericht op voorlichting van werkende mantelzorgers en werkgevers uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Verdriet en angst in verzorgingstehuizen’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of elderly residents being forced to leave care homes and how existing clients' rights are protected. The state secretary says existing clients keep their right to stay, that relocation can occur only through closure or renovation, and that the NZa and insurer Achmea have confirmed existing clients' rights will be respected.
existing clients retain the right to residence in a care institution
bestaande cliënten recht behouden op verblijf in een zorginstelling
Antwoord vragen Agema over het bericht dat er meer gevallen van ouderenmishandeling gemeld worden

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about rising reports of elder abuse, the likely hidden scale of the problem, the plan to keep care-dependent elderly at home, and tougher penalties. The state secretary answered that the Action Plan 'Ouderen in veilige handen' and the reporting code are being implemented, that the estimated prevalence is about one in twenty elderly, and that the Justice Minister sees no need to raise sentences since vulnerability is already weighed.
Yes, I certainly do not rule out that this concerns the tip of the iceberg.
Ja, Ik sluit zeker niet uit dat het hier gaat om het topje van de ijsberg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over slechts een waarschuwing bij het veroorzaken van ernstige brandwonden door een verpleegkundige

An MP asked the state secretary whether a nurse receiving only a tuchtrechtelijke waarschuwing for causing severe burns to a disabled girl was too lenient, and whether the warning and reprimand should be abolished. The state secretary declined to comment on the specific case, stated that disciplinary measures aim at correcting professional conduct rather than punishment, and said he would not abolish warnings or reprimands.
it is not appropriate for me as State Secretary to make statements about the imposed measure
ligt het niet in de rede dat ik als Staatssecretaris uitspraken doe over de opgelegde maatregel
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat verpleegkundigen vrezen voor hun baan

An MP asked the health ministers whether nurses are worried about their jobs, why unemployment among nurses rose, what the vacancy situation is, and whether matching problems exist. The government acknowledged the reports, described a small rise in job seekers as a normal fluctuation, cited falling vacancy rates, and said it had seen no signals of matching problems, promising to review a sector survey after the summer.
We have no data available on the number of open vacancies for nurses.
We hebben geen data voorhanden over het aantal openstaande vacatures voor verpleegkundigen.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over het bericht dat zorgorganisaties veel mensen die het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) verliezen geen zorg kunnen bieden

An MP asks whether care providers can serve people losing their personal budget (pgb) under the 10-hour rule and whether the government will change course. The Secretary of State says talks with Per Saldo, care offices and sector bodies are ongoing on how the rule can work, with an update expected in early July.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this in early July.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hierover begin juli te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord vragen Otwin van Dijk over passende zorg voor mensen met gespecialiseerde begeleiding met minder dan 10 uur zorg per week

MP Otwin van Dijk asked whether people needing specialised support of under 10 hours a week, who will lose their PGB from 1 January 2014, can find appropriate care, after a Per Saldo survey found most could not. The State Secretary called the survey non-representative but took the signal seriously, committed to consulting Per Saldo and care offices on alternatives, and promised to inform the House in early July.

I am consulting, as I indicated during the recent debate on the Reform of Long-Term Care, with Per Saldo, care offices and sector organisations for small providers on how the 10-hour measure can be elaborated and whether there are alternatives within the available budget.

Ik overleg, zoals ik heb aangegeven tijdens het nota-overleg van afgelopen week over de Hervorming van de Langdurige Zorg, momenteel met Per Saldo, zorgkantoren en brancheorganisaties voor kleine aanbieders hoe de 10 uursmaatregel uitgewerkt kan worden en of er alternatieven zijn die passen binnen het beschikbare budgettaire kader.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch, Heijnen en Monasch over de toekomst van het Oranjehotel Scheveningen nu het kabinet van plan is de Scheveningse gevangenis te sluiten

MPs Marcouch, Heijnen and Monasch asked whether the government still supports keeping the Oranjehotel monument (Dodencel, Poortje, Gedenkplaat) after the planned closure of the Scheveningen prison, and how its future will be secured. The state secretary confirmed the monument should be preserved, said a future design is being developed with the Stichting Oranjehotel and that the detailed plan will follow once the DJI masterplan decision is taken.

Once the decision-making on the DJI Masterplan is completed, and it is therefore clear whether the PI Scheveningen will continue to exist, the Foundation, in consultation with the state, will further develop the preliminary design of a Oranjehotel Monument.

Zodra de besluitvorming over het Masterplan DJI is afgerond en daarmee ook duidelijk is of de PI Scheveningen blijft bestaan, zal de Stichting in samenspraak met het rijk het voorlopige ontwerp van een Monument Oranjehotel verder uitwerken.
Antwoord vragen Agema over het bericht ‘Vertrek bestuurder kost ZuidZorg 170.000 euro’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health whether a hospital/care board member's 170,000 euro departure payment for seven weeks of work at ZuidZorg is acceptable, whether the money can be recovered, and what will be done about excessive severance payments. The state secretary acknowledged a poor appointment procedure and regretted the costs, said recovery is not possible legally, and pointed to the Wnt pay-cap law and the supervisory board as the responsible party.
I deeply regret that this Supervisory Board did not act carefully enough in this matter.
Ik betreur het zeer dat deze Raad van Toezicht hier niet zorgvuldig genoeg heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het nieuws dat het gehoor van de Nederlandse jeugd nog verder is verslechterd

MPs Wolbert and Van Laar asked the state secretary about reported further hearing deterioration among Dutch youth and what measures would be taken. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, promised a RIVM study, a prevention programme item and a convenant with the music sector, but deferred a statutory noise limit and declined to answer some questions in time.
I have asked the RIVM to conduct research into this, so that we can have recent figures.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om hier onderzoek naar te doen, zodat we over recente cijfers kunnen beschikken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Hilkens over het verband tussen het verstrekken van vergunningen voor online kansspelen en gokverslaving

MPs Mei Li Vos and Hilkens asked whether licensing online gambling would increase gambling addiction and what safeguards and measurement exist. The government answered that it does not expect an explosive rise, citing strict licence conditions (warnings, limits, a national exclusion register, a duty of care), monitoring every five years, and enforcement powers of the Kansspelautoriteit.
I do not have data on the private addiction care sector.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens van de «particuliere» verslavingszorgsector.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat 135 thuiszorgmedewerkers ontslagen worden

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about Zorggroep VDA's request to dismiss 135 home-care staff, whether other providers will stop home help, job security and wages for transferred staff, and claims of bureaucratic overload. The state secretary said the provider made its own business decision, that the 2015 home-help budget cut was softened, that continuity for clients is being arranged with other providers under the CAO, and that he will look at simplifying administrative burdens.
I contacted the director of Zorggroep VDA and asked for an explanation of the statements attributed to him in the article.
Ik heb contact opgenomen met de directeur van Zorggroep VDA en gevraagd om een toelichting op de aan hem toegeschreven uitspraken in het artikel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Ontslagen en faillissementen dreigen in de zorg’

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary of Health whether his policy, including budget cuts, job losses and bankruptcies in care, will weaken care, and questions the transition of youth care and cuts to home-care tariffs. The state secretary rejects the claim that care is being dismantled, argues that bankruptcies make room for better providers, says continuity of youth care will be safeguarded through regional arrangements and Rijk instructions, and disputes the 50,000 job-loss figure.
By 31 October 2013 regional transition arrangements will be in place in all regions, setting out how cooperating municipalities will ensure continuity of care.
Op 31 oktober 2013 zullen er regionale transitiearrangementen liggen in alle regio's waarin uitgewerkt is hoe de samenwerkende gemeenten de zorgcontinuïteit realiseren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het initiatief Second love

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether the government finds it undesirable that the Second love initiative, which advertises in media, undermines relationships, including via public broadcasting, and what it will do to promote relationship support. The State Secretary answered that relationships are a private matter that cannot be imposed by government, that municipalities and Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin are responsible for relationship support (with a handreiking), and that government does not judge advertisements, which are assessed by the Reclame Code Commissie.
The government has no substantive involvement in, nor any judgement on, advertising.
De overheid heeft geen inhoudelijke bemoeienis met en ook geen oordeel over reclame-uitingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het versterken van operationele vaardigheden op de werkvloer na de transitie jeugdzorg

Ypma (PvdA) asked how knowledge from specialist centres can be translated into practical tools and reach frontline professionals such as teachers and municipal staff after the youth care transition. The state secretary replied that existing knowledge institutes, ZonMw programmes and municipal networks already share and disseminate knowledge, and promised an inventory of gaps with ZonMw whose results would be shared with the House later.
I would gladly inform you of the outcomes of this ZonMw programme in due course.
Over de uitkomsten van dit programma van ZonMw wil ik u t.z.t. graag informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de regeling aanwijzing groep chronisch zieken en gehandicapten

MP Voortman asked the government whether the narrow hardship clause for chronically ill and disabled tenants under the income-dependent rent increase should be widened, covering those who cannot reasonably move, including people with mantelzorg-reduced care indications and those who paid for adaptations. Minister Blok defended the existing criteria as needed for enforceability, offered only limited coulance for adapted dwellings and deferred on the mantelzorg compliment, promising to revisit that scheme.
No, I do not have this data available.
Nee, over deze gegevens beschik ik niet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over verlenging van de VUT-uitkering

Two PvdA MPs asked whether extending VUT early-retirement benefits to bridge the rise in the AOW pension age would trigger immediate taxation, and whether the Tax Authority's pension knowledge group's view was government policy. The state secretary answered that extension past age 65 would lose the transitional regime and trigger the VUT levy, that the knowledge group's advice is not policy, and that spreading existing entitlements over a longer period will be tolerated under conditions via a policy decision.
Policy in the formal sense is determined exclusively by me.
Beleid in formele zin wordt uitsluitend door mij vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het meldpunt ontruimingen van kamers in verzorg- en verpleeghuizen
