An MP asked the state secretary about a Consumentenbond complaints point on rapid room clearances in care homes, and whether the NZa supervises compliance with clearance rules. The state secretary said the Consumentenbond may set up such a point, that the NZa has not investigated the double-billing risk since 2006, and that he will ask the NZa to investigate and report back.
However, I will ask the NZa to investigate the matter, take action if necessary, and report back to me on it.
Ik zal de NZa echter vragen een en ander te onderzoeken, zonodig actie te ondernemen en mij hierover terug te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Als pleegouder moet je veel in je mars hebben’

An MP asks the state secretary about media reports that foster parents quit quickly, tensions with child protection guardians, screening of foster parents, and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg ignores foster parents. The government answers that it lacks data on early quitting, describes a qualitative rather than quantitative shortage, refers to a themed day and a forthcoming letter on guardian-foster parent relations, and notes new legal rights for foster parents from 1 July 2013.
I do not have figures on the number of foster parents who stop prematurely with foster care.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal pleegouders dat voortijdig stopt met pleegzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het omzetten van dagbesteding binnen de PGB naar ZIN en vice versa

An MP asked the state secretary whether clients converting full day-care from PGB to in-kind care (ZIN) or back are cut in day-part entitlement, and whether this is an improper conversion. The secretary denies any cut, explains that from 2013 PGB day-care budgets for clients with a residential indication are tied to available VPT day-care funds, and declines to change course.
I do not share your view that unequal situations have arisen.
Ik deel niet uw mening dat er ongelijke situaties zijn ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat ouderen wekenlang verstoken zijn van thuiszorg

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that elderly people went weeks without home care after Rotterdam's new domestic care contract started, and whether this was linked to hour cuts. The state secretary answered that about 2% of clients got no help in the first week, that the municipality arranged help within days, and that no link to budget cuts was found.
I asked the municipality of Rotterdam how it ensures that the people who need it receive support again.
Ik heb nagevraagd bij de gemeente Rotterdam op welke wijze zij ervoor zorgen dat de mensen die dit nodig hebben weer ondersteuning ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat 800 huishoudelijk verzorgenden ontslagen worden

An MP asks the state secretary whether the dismissal of 800 home-help workers at Sensire results from government policy, how many clients will lose their carers, and how municipalities can cope if a large provider withdraws. The state secretary replies that the provider's decision is its own business, municipalities are responsible for continuity, and existing transition measures and guidance are in place.
It is a consideration of the organisation itself which choices it makes and how it anticipates possible changes and adjusts its staffing.
Het is een afweging van de organisatie zelf, welke keuzes zij maakt en op welke wijze ze daarbij anticipeert op mogelijke veranderingen en haar personeelsomvang aanpast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Leijten en van het Leijten over het bericht dat zorgjongeren aan hun lot worden overgelaten

MPs Keijzer and Leijten asked the state secretary how care for youths was left unprovided after the bankruptcy of care provider Sterk!Zorg, and what role the Inspectorate, the care office and youth bureau had. The state secretary answered that replacement care was arranged via a takeover by De Driestroom, that the Inspectorate acted after an anonymous report, and that responsibility for PGB-funded care lies with the client, while the care provider failed.
The inspectorate will monitor the quality of care by re-checking within three to four weeks.
De inspectie zal de kwaliteit van zorg volgen door binnen drie à vier weken opnieuw te toetsen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over onnodige sterfte door Hepatitis B en C

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about rising mortality from hepatitis B and C, the trend after 2010, risk groups among first-generation migrants, and the China-in-the-Low-Countries pilot and Bibhep project. The minister answered that cases are similar to 2009-2010, that a screening/vaccination policy for migrant risk groups is being explored with the RIVM and may go to the Gezondheidsraad, and that the pilots are being evaluated and partly supported.
If necessary, the Health Council will be asked for advice.
Zonodig zal de Gezondheidsraad om een advies gevraagd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgjongeren aan hun lot worden overgelaten

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that youth care clients were left without care after the provider Sterk!Zorg went bankrupt, including whether the IGZ should intervene, whether Bureau Jeugdzorg or the zorgkantoor neglected their duty of care, and whether staff wages went unpaid. The document refers to written answers sent on 29 May 2013 in a separate letter, so the substance of the government's replies is not reproduced here.

Further answer: the questions from MP Leijten (SP) to the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about the report that youth care clients are left to their fate, submitted 18 April 2013, were also answered in the letter of 29 May 2013.

Nader antwoord De vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat zorgjongeren aan hun lot worden overgelaten, ingezonden 18 april 2013 (vraagnummer 2013Z07943 ) zijn ook beantwoord in de brief van 29 mei 2013
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat 220 duizend Nederlanders zich zwaar belast voelen door mantelzorg

MP Voortman asked the state secretary about a report that 220,000 Dutch people feel heavily burdened by informal care, and about the causes, support rights, and effects of AWBZ/PGB cuts on carers' respite and the mantelzorgcompliment. The state secretary acknowledged the burden, said it stems mainly from many hours of care, and pointed to municipal responsibility and planned measures without committing to new concrete steps.
So I am proceeding from what people can informally organise.
Ik ga dus uit van wat mensen informeel kunnen organiseren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rutte over de e-sigaret

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about children buying nicotine e-cigarettes, the absence of age limits, and the addictiveness and gateway effects of e-cigarettes. The State Secretary confirmed no age limits apply since e-cigarettes fall outside the Tobacco Act, said research on addictiveness is inconclusive and no research yet shows a gateway effect or a quitting benefit, and declined new research on usage.
No age limits apply to the e-cigarette because it does not fall under the Tobacco Act.
Voor de e-sigaret gelden geen leeftijdsgrenzen, omdat deze niet onder de Tabakswet vallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het bericht dat controle op de verkoop van tabak aan jongeren onder de 16 jaar niks voorstelt

An MP asked why NVWA inspections of tobacco sales to under-16s fell to about 900 in 2012, and what will be done about enforcement, inspection capacity, mystery shoppers, technology and store numbers. The state secretary attributed the drop to priorities on smoking bans in hospitality and aggression against inspectors, announced a 17 fte youth tobacco team from 2014, and argued the age-limit increase to 18 supports the norm.
I consider compliance and supervision of the age limit to be of great importance.
Ik vind naleving en het toezicht op de leeftijdsgrens van groot belang.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de berichtgeving dat bezuinigingen op de AWBZ averechts werken

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether AWBZ cuts were backfiring, including a shift toward heavier care indications, removal of ZZP 1-2 people from care homes, the effects of dropping light support, and income effects. The state secretary denied that the policy was wrong, said the shift reflects natural care needs and ageing, promised a CIZ-based analysis and stricter indication controls, and declined to quantify income effects because they vary by person.
I would like to be able to substantiate this quantitatively and have therefore asked the Nza for an analysis.
Ik wil dat graag goed nader kwantitatief kunnen onderbouwen en heb daartoe de Nza om een analyse gevraagd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er een explosieve toename is van aanvragen voor zware zorg

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary for Health about reports of a sharp rise in applications for heavy care, and whether patients are being wrongly given higher care-package indications. The state secretary acknowledged the rise, attributed it mainly to longer home-living policy and ageing, said an NZa analysis is still being studied, and promised an investigation into possible abuse and a later letter on the future access rules for long-term care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het contracteerbeleid van zorgverzekeraars bij logopedisten

The MP asks the minister about insurer contracting policy for speech therapists, including the value of speech therapy, whether a NZa-backed tariff increase has reached providers, shifts from school speech therapy to primary care, and market power. The minister answers that the tariff increase was substantial, that insurers may contract below NZa maximum tariffs, sees no abuse of market power, and declines an independent market study.
As I indicated in previous answers, I see no abuses in the speech therapy market that could harm the interests of the patient/consumer.
Zoals ik in voorgaande antwoorden heb aangegeven zie ik geen misstanden in de markt voor logopedie die nadelig kunnen uitwerken op het belang van de patiënt/consument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat zorgkantoren zorginstellingen dwingen om dure keurmerken te kopen

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether care offices force care providers to buy costly quality certificates, questioning whether this conflicts with earlier policy against mandatory certification. The state secretary answered that providers must have a quality system under the Kwaliteitswet, that certification can serve as evidence of this but must stay proportionate, and that care offices ask for a working quality system without mandating specific certificates.
Inquiries with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland show that all care offices, in line with the AWBZ care purchasing guide, ask all care institutions to be contracted to have a working quality system.

Navraag bij Zorgverzekeraars Nederland wijst uit dat alle zorgkantoren in lijn met de Zorginkoopgids AWBZ van alle te contracteren zorginstellingen vragen dat zij een werkend kwaliteitssysteem hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de aanpak van pgb-fraude (persoonsgebonden budget)

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Health about the enforcement against PGB (personal budget) fraud, including recovered amounts, evaluation, cooperation with professionals bound by medical confidentiality, the 2013 PGB rules, CIZ face-to-face assessments, Inspectorate SZW investigations, and the NZa's role. The state secretary answered that about EUR 6 million has been recovered so far, many measures are underway, and several items are still being developed, with some answers deferred or referred to other responsibilities.
Currently, VWS together with the parties involved is elaborating the introduction of the trekkingsrecht.
Momenteel wordt door VWS samen met betrokken partijen de invoering van het trekkingsrecht uitgewerkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Roemer en Leijten over de contracteerruimte in de AWBZ, wachtlijsten en leegstand

SP MPs Roemer and Leijten asked why care-home rooms stand empty while people wait for institutional care, and asked for waiting-list and care-package figures plus an explanation of contracting room for 2013. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the zorgkantoren have a duty of care, that the waiting-list data was still being cleaned and would be sent around 1 June, and that the 2013 contracting room was reduced only by transfers to the Zorgverzekeringswet, not by a shortfall.
In early June, your House can expect information on the size and composition of the waiting list for long-term care.
Begin juni kan uw Kamer informatie tegemoet zien over de omvang en samenstelling van de wachtlijst in de langdurige zorg.
Antwoord vragen Agema over de brandbrief tegen de overhevelingen van zorgtaken naar de gemeenten

An MP asks the state secretary for Health about a letter from the Wmo councils' umbrella body warning that transferring long-term care tasks to municipalities will harm patients and municipalities, and whether the timetable is justified. The state secretary rejects the criticism, says the transfer is a reform with savings, cites the regiegroep and VNG consultation, and promises further talks with parliament without committing to a changed timetable.
I am continuously in discussion with all parties to examine in what way and at what pace the reforms in long-term care can be realised.
Ik ben voordurend met alle partijen in gesprek, om te bezien op welke manier en in welk tempo de hervormingen in de langdurige zorg gerealiseerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen Bergkamp over het bericht Zorgjongeren aan hun lot overgelaten in Alverna

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that youths needing 24-hour care were left without support at Alverna after the provider's bankruptcy and staff sick leave, and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg knew but did not intervene. The state secretary confirmed the Inspectorate visited the locations and found the reports accurate, said Bureau Jeugdzorg intervened promptly once aware, and referred to planned personal-budget (pgb) reforms in a separate letter.
The situation at Sterk!zorg shows that Bureau Jeugdzorg, from the moment it became aware of the worrying situation, intervened promptly.
De situatie bij Sterk!zorg laat zien dat bureau Jeugdzorg, vanaf het moment dat men bekend werd met de zorgelijke situatie, voortvarend in heeft ingegrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de toenemende tweedeling in de ouderenzorg

MP Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary whether the growth of private, premium elderly care residences creates a two-tier system in which wealthy elderly buy luxury care while others have no choice, and whether private providers offer better quality or an escape from strained regular care. The state secretary answered that residents may pay housing costs themselves, that about 2% of care staff and places are private, and that basic care must be guaranteed everywhere, while rejecting the two-tier concern as part of normal societal choice.
I am of the view that basic care must be in order in every place.
Ik ben van mening dat de basiszorg op elke plek op orde moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de extra toelage wooninitiatief

An MP asked the state secretary whether clients of small-scale housing initiatives were unclear about how the EUR 4,000 supplement is offset against the budget guarantee, and whether calculation and communication differ across care offices. The state secretary answered that clients were not always aware of the offsetting, that all care offices apply it the same way, that clients were informed late in some cases, and that the College voor Zorgverzekeringen will be asked to address the point in its next information bulletin.
Do you consider this desirable? Answer 2: The offsetting is laid down in the Regulation on AWBZ subsidies.
Vindt u dit wenselijk? Antwoord 2 De verrekening is vastgelegd in de Regeling subsidies AWBZ.
Antwoord vragen Rutte en Taverne over de doorkruising van Nederlands gezondheidsbeleid door internationaal recht

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Health whether the WHO tobacco convention, in particular Article 8(2), can be directly applicable and override national law following a Hague Court of Appeal ruling in the CAN case. The State Secretary answered that the convention is not directly applicable in that sense, that Article 8(2) leaves states wide discretion, and that the State will appeal to cassation.

The Dutch government is of the view that Article 8, paragraph 2, of the convention is not a provision binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution, by which existing national legislation can be set aside.

De Nederlandse regering is van mening dat artikel 8, tweede lid, van het verdrag geen eenieder verbindende bepaling is in de zin van artikel 93 en 94 van de Grondwet waarmee bestaande nationale wetgeving terzijde kan worden geschoven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de publicatie “Medezeggenschap bij PPI is juridische gatenkaas”

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary whether works council consent rights extend to the implementation agreement when a pension scheme is placed with a premium pension institution (PPI), following a critical article in Pensioen en Praktijk. The State Secretary answered that consent rights cover the pension agreement, not the implementation agreement, acknowledged this departs from earlier parliamentary statements, and declined to legislate for clarity, saying the answers suffice.
I do not believe that the way participation rights at the PPI have been regulated and explained gives rise to unclarity.
Ik ben niet van mening dat de wijze waarop de medezeggenschap bij de PPI is geregeld en toegelicht, aanleiding geeft tot onduidelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het niet kunnen vinden van een goede behandelplek voor kinderen/jongeren met een zorgindicatie

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary about children and young people with a care indication who cannot find a suitable treatment place, which may lead to out-of-home placement or closed youth care. The state secretary said he is not aware of concrete cases, that data collection by Jeugdzorg Nederland is underway, and that out-of-home placement requires a judge's authorisation, in which parents' arguments are weighed.
A forced out-of-home placement is carried out carefully and can only be effected through judicial intervention in order to safeguard the rights of those involved.
Een gedwongen uithuisplaatsing gebeurt zorgvuldig en kan alleen via rechterlijke tussenkomst worden bewerkstelligd om zo de rechten van betrokkenen te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat supermarktketens weigeren effectieve naleving van leeftijdgrenzen bij alcoholverkoop toe te passen

Two MPs asked the government about reports that supermarket chains resist effective age checks for alcohol sales, including remote age-verification systems. The state secretary answered that compliance is the supermarkets' own responsibility, that the burgomaster supervises compliance and can impose sanctions, and that the government has contacted the VNG and will evaluate the law after three years.
However, it is up to the supermarkets themselves to determine how the age limits for the sale of alcoholic beverages are complied with and which systems they use for this.
Het is echter aan de supermarkten zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze de leeftijdsgrenzen bij de verkoop van alcoholhoudende dranken worden nageleefd en welke systemen zij daarvoor hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Dik-Faber over het meetellen van het persoonsgebonden budget in box 3

MPs Schouten and Dik-Faber asked whether unspent personal budget (PGB) advances count as box 3 wealth, lowering the fairness of the AWBZ own-contribution rules, and whether the government will investigate alternatives. The government confirmed PGB advances count as liquid assets, noted that payment timing by two care offices can create a small effect, and promised a letter after the Spring Memorandum on possible remedies.

During the debate of 4 April 2013 on the unintended effects of the wealth income add-on, I committed to indicate in a letter following the Spring Memorandum whether there are options to remedy the identified effects of the PGB on the wealth income add-on for the AWBZ own contribution.

Tijdens het debat van 4 april 2013 over de ongewenste effecten van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling heb ik toegezegd dat ik in een brief naar aanleiding van de Voorjaarsnota zal aangeven of er mogelijkheden zijn om de geconstateerde gevolgen van het PGB voor de vermogensinkomensbijtelling voor de eigen bijdrage AWBZ te verhelpen.
Antwoord vragen Otwin Van Dijk over het bericht dat er nog steeds weinig gegevens zijn over dwang en drang in de verstandelijk gehandicaptenzorg

An MP asked the state secretary about the lack of data on coercion in intellectual disability care, late calls for external expertise, staff continuity and knowledge sharing. The secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Zorg en dwang bill, an action programme based on the Denktank complexe zorg, and further research, while stating that few incident reports reach the Inspectorate and that the number of affected institutions is unknown.
The Inspectorate has also received no signals about institutions no longer daring to accept clients.
Ook de Inspectie heeft geen signalen ontvangen over het niet meer aan durven nemen van cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het niet verlenen van het mantelzorgcompliment en de vrijstelling erfrechtbelasting

An MP asks why carers of people with an intramural care indication who live at home do not receive the mantelzorgcompliment or the higher inheritance tax exemption, and what will be done about it. The state secretary acknowledges the unfairness, says a fix is not simple technically or budgetarily, and promises to inform parliament before summer; information for carers has also been improved.
Before the summer I will inform the House further about the mantelzorgcompliment.
Voor de zomer zal ik de Kamer nader informeren over het mantelzorgcompliment.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over de invloed van nepsigaretten op jonge kinderen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether 'Shisha pens', tobacco-like products sold to primary school children, encourage smoking and trivialise its harms, and whether they should be banned or age-restricted like tobacco. The State Secretary answered that no proven harm exists, sees no reason yet for a ban or age limit, and will ask RIVM to assess the health risks before deciding on further measures.
However, I will ask RIVM to assess the health risks of this product.
Wel zal ik het RIVM vragen een inschatting te maken van de gezondheidsrisico's van dit product.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek ‘Do time restrictions on alcohol advertising reduce youth exposure’

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Kooiman asked whether a study showing the 6:00–21:00 time slot for alcohol advertising has counterproductive effects for high-risk youth should lead to extending the slot or other measures, and about compliance with the advertising code. The state secretary replied that the time slot is effective for young children, that he will discuss further protection of 12–18 year olds with the education ministry and report back, that code compliance is good, and that no further evaluation is needed beyond the existing one.

As indicated earlier during the debate on the private member's bill raising the alcohol age, I will soon discuss with the education ministry how young people aged 12–18 can be further protected from the influence of alcohol advertising.

Ik zal, zoals eerder aangegeven tijdens het debat over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel verhoging leeftijd alcohol, binnenkort met het ministerie van OCW bespreken op welke manier jongeren tussen de 12–18 jaar verder kunnen worden beschermd tegen de invloed van alcoholreclame.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over het bericht dat een meisje misbruikt is door haar groepsleider in de instelling van de Hoenderloo Groep waar zij verbleef voor behandeling als gevolg van misbruik door l

MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether a youth care group leader's abuse of a girl at the Hoenderloo Groep was reported to the Inspectie Jeugdzorg, what the institution did, whether other victims were investigated, the status of the criminal case, and whether the suspect could still work with minors. The government answered that the inspectorate required improved reporting and protocols, no other victims were found, the investigation is in its final phase, and mandatory VOG screening for youth care staff is being introduced.
The inspectorate pointed out to the Hoenderloo Groep that in future it must itself report such an incident promptly.
De inspectie heeft de Hoenderloo Groep (DHG) erop gewezen dat zij in het vervolg een dergelijke calamiteit zelf en tijdig dient te melden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het onderzoek naar de hulp aan kinderen die betrokken zijn bij huiselijk geweld

MP Bergkamp (D66) asks the state secretary whether the study on help for children exposed to domestic violence shows that help often does not start, children drop out at each step, and whether central registration or other measures are planned. The state secretary acknowledges children do not always get needed help, points to a forthcoming child maltreatment guideline and ZonMw research, and says the study does not show Bureau Jeugdzorg lacks oversight or that coordination is absent, while citing decentralisation of youth care to municipalities as the response.
On the question of whether the help provided is effective, no unambiguous answer can be given.
Op de vraag of de geboden hulp wel effectief is, is geen eenduidig antwoord te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over onderzoek door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) bij overlijden in zorginstelling

An MP asked the state secretary about the IGZ's handling of a patient's death in a care institution (SEIN), where the family had to supply key facts and an IGZ employee made an inappropriate remark. The state secretary acknowledged the situation was unacceptable, announced a duty to notify families of incidents, said the IGZ tightened its review method, and declined a separate independent inquiry, pointing to an ongoing IGZ improvement trajectory.
I believe care institutions should inform parents and/or other directly involved persons promptly and correctly about the circumstances of an incident and involve them in the investigation.
Ik vind dat zorginstellingen ouders en/of andere direct betrokkenen tijdig en juist dienen te informeren over de toedracht van een calamiteit en hen dienen te betrekken bij onderzoek hiernaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat palliatieve zorg vaak te laat wordt ingezet bij chronische aandoeningen

An SGP MP asked the state secretary whether palliative care is started too late for chronic conditions, and how the government is broadening palliative care beyond cancer as the motion requested. The government answered that broadening is built into policy through a generic palliative care module, ZonMw programmes and training, without giving concrete results yet.
In the interim I will inform you about the results of this programme, which also leaves room to test the palliative care module.
Tussentijds zal ik u informeren over de resultaten van dit programma, waarin ook ruimte is voor het toetsen van de module voor palliatieve zorg.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht dat ontslagrondes in de zorg in aantocht zijn

Leijten (SP) asked the health minister and state secretary about reports of dismissal rounds in healthcare, requesting regional and national data on expected surpluses, dismissals, staff shortages and the effects of extramuralisation. The minister answered that no forced dismissals are expected per current research, that national dismissal data are not kept, and that an labour market effect report is pending, with the government pointing to employers' primary responsibility and a three-track policy.
The figures on the number of (forced) dismissals cannot be provided.
De cijfers over het aantal (gedwongen) ontslagen kunnen niet worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Agema over het rapport ‘Verloren tijd’

PVV MPs Fritsma and Agema asked whether the government agrees that asylum seekers should not receive day-care, education or recreation while cuts hit care for the elderly and disabled, and asked for the ACVZ report 'Verloren tijd' to be destroyed. State Secretary Teeven confirmed receipt of the advice and said a full government response will follow within three months, without taking a position on the substance yet.
As is customary, a government response to the report of the Advisory Committee on Migration Affairs (ACVZ) will be sent to the House of Representatives within three months of publication.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk wordt binnen drie maanden na verschijning van een rapport van de Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken (ACVZ) een kabinetsreactie aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind  en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘IJsland wil porno blokkeren’

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked about Iceland's plan to block internet pornography and about what is known of its effects on Dutch children, including exposure, help-seeking and research. The government answered that Iceland's plans are only under study, that the evidence on harm is mostly correlational, and that no further research is considered necessary beyond the ongoing NHL study.
The state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport and I do not consider initiating additional research necessary.
Het entameren van aanvullend onderzoek achten de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de acties van de vakbond leiden tot de sluiting van het Sarphatihuis

MP Leijten asks the state secretary for Health about union actions and the threatened closure of the Sarphatihuis care home, including whether intensification funds were spent properly and whether funds were shifted from other Amsta locations. The state secretary answers that this is a dispute between an employer and its union, that no closure is currently planned, that the care office (zorgkantoor) rather than the ministry checks how funds are spent, and that Amsta is drawing up a plan with the works council and client council.
This is primarily a matter between a care employer and its employees, represented by a union. I am not a party to that.
Het gaat hier primair om een zaak tussen een zorgwerkgever en haar werknemers, vertegenwoordigd door een vakbond. Daarin ben ik geen partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat tienduizenden mensen hun zorg verliezen als gevolg van de 10-uursgrens voor het persoonsgebonden budget

MP Voortman asked the state secretary about reports that tens of thousands of people will lose care under the 10-hour limit on personal budgets (pgb) for care, and whether this is affordable and adequate. The state secretary said the Per Saldo survey is not a formal study, that the 10-hour limit's effects will be reported to parliament, that care offices are responsible for providing suitable care, and that he sees no reason yet to revise the policy.
I do not find it appropriate or effective to respond to an ongoing reporting campaign that is not representative and on which care offices have not been asked for their view.
Ik vind het niet passend en effectief te reageren op een nog lopende meldactie die niet representatief is en waar bovendien zorgkantoren niet naar hun oordeel is gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat ouderen steeds vaker een fatale val maken en de kans hierop door dit kabinetsbeleid toeneemt

An MP asked whether the rise in fatal falls among elderly people, and the removal of the rollator from the basic insurance package and cuts to home care, would increase falls, and what measures the government will take. The state secretary answered that the rollator is a personal responsibility, that the removal was decided in the Budget Agreement 2013, and pointed to local and national fall-prevention initiatives and a vitamin D supplement recommendation without committing to new national measures.
For that reason, the Budget Agreement 2013 decided that simple mobility aids, including the rollator, would no longer be reimbursed under the Zvw package from 1 January 2013.

Om die reden is in het Begrotingsakkoord 2013 besloten de eenvoudige mobiliteitshulpmiddelen, waaronder de rollator, met ingang van 1 januari 2013 niet langer te vergoeden uit hoofde van het Zvw-pakket.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat jeugdzorg steeds meer zelfstandige ondernemers krijgt

MP Bergkamp asked whether the Inspectie Jeugdzorg supervises private youth care providers only indirectly through the main contractor, and how quality and child safety are guaranteed, including for persoonsgebonden budget arrangements. The State Secretary answered that the main contractor remains responsible and must give the Inspectorate access to subcontracted private providers, that the Inspectorate has regular supervision of main contractors, and that for PGB situations the IGZ supervises under the Kwaliteitswet, with the Wcz amendment extending complaint and handling rules to sole practitioners.
The main contractor ensures that the IJZ has access to the private subcontractor where the client resides.
De hoofdaannemer draagt er zorg voor dat de IJZ toegang heeft tot de particuliere onderaannemer waar de cliënt verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Albert De Vries Albert en Otwin Van Dijk over mantelzorgwoningen en groepswonen

MPs asked about the savings potential of care annexes (mantelzorgwoningen) and group housing for elderly care, the status of housing experiments, deregulation under the BOR, the risk that temporary housing becomes permanent, and a barrier inventory for care providers. The government answered that savings cannot be quantified, experiments have ended and a new programme is being discussed, deregulation is planned via the BOR, enforcement remains with municipalities, and a municipal guidance note is expected after the summer.
On the subject of care annexes, a guidance note for municipalities is being prepared.
Op het terrein van mantelzorgwoningen is een handreiking voor gemeenten in de maak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat de uitvoering van de huishoudelijke zorg in de gemeente Emmen niet aan de wet voldoet

MP Leijten asks the state secretary how he responds to a court ruling that Emmen's home-care arrangement (schoonmaakondersteuning) violates the Wmo, whether he still stands by his earlier view that gemeenten must follow the law, and how he will ensure compliance and inform other municipalities. The state secretary responds that the ruling concerned the specific implementation, not the policy itself, that Emmen will not appeal and will issue new decisions, that enforcement is primarily the municipality's responsibility though he retains systemic responsibility, and that he will ask the VNG to inform municipalities of the ruling.
I have asked the municipality to send me its analysis and to inform me of the follow-up actions.
Ik heb de gemeente verzocht mij haar analyse te doen toekomen en mij te informeren over de vervolgacties.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Ypma over het geadopteerde Chinese meisje dat na drie weken bij een pleeggezin is ondergebracht

MPs Recourt and Ypma asked the state secretaries about a Chinese adopted girl placed with a foster family after three weeks, the Inspectorate's findings, whether the Central Authority was informed, adoption-matching failures and aftercare. The government answered that the adoptive parents did not inform the intermediary or Central Authority, that the Central Authority of China was informed afterwards, that the Inspectorate's recommendations will feed into an evaluation of the quality framework, and that VWS will report on aftercare in the first half of 2013.
The quality framework for intercountry adoption intermediaries is currently being evaluated.
Momenteel wordt het kwaliteitskader voor de vergunninghouders interlandelijke adoptie geëvalueerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat er meer huurders uit huis worden gezet

Parliamentary member Schouten asked about reports that more tenants are being evicted, including whether debt counselling and debt rescheduling are offered often enough to prevent evictions and whether early warning of debts can be improved. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that evictions rose about 10% in 2012 per housing association survey, that corporations prevent evictions where they can and cooperate with municipalities, and that the government will raise the issue with Aedes and municipalities and explore expanding early-warning and credit-registration systems with concrete proposals before summer.
I have taken note of the report.
Ik heb kennis genomen van het bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht CNV Publieke zaak “Herregistratie BIG-register”

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that care institutions in disability care have lower-qualified staff carry out reserved medical acts, and about training, liability and inspection. The minister answered that only certain BIG-registered professionals may perform reserved acts independently, that others may do so on instruction if competent, that training is the profession's own responsibility, and that the Inspectorate checks whether institutions have competent staff.
It is not permitted for staff to perform reserved acts for which they are not competent.
Het is niet toegestaan dat medewerkers voorbehouden handelingen verrichten waar ze niet bekwaam voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de gevolgen van extramuralisering voor zorgaanbieders

An SP MP asks the state secretary how extramuralisation of low-care-intensity (ZZP 1-4) long-term care affects care providers, including whether care offices can guarantee capacity, continuity of care, and who is responsible when homes face vacancies. The secretary replies that providers must adapt, that care offices remain responsible for continuity of care but not for individual institutions, and that the NZa supervises, while giving few figures and promising further information later.
I am not aware whether all care offices have taken a position on the consequences of this measure.
Het is mij niet bekend of alle zorgkantoren een standpunt hebben ingenomen over de gevolgen van de maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht  ‘Ouderen sluizen massaal geld weg’

Member Keijzer (CDA) asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that elderly people were giving away assets to avoid the new asset-income surcharge on long-term care contributions, and whether the government had anticipated this behaviour. The secretary replied that people may legally reduce their assets through gifts, that the effect on the surcharge's revenue is hard to estimate and will be monitored with first figures around Prinsjesdag, and that the surcharge does not affect the planned raise of the in-facility contribution, so no reconsideration is needed.
The revenue of the assets-income surcharge will be monitored.
De opbrengst van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling zal gemonitord worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de alternatieve opvang voor slachtoffers van loverboys

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a private foundation housing loverboy victims in homes without professional training or government oversight, and whether the Inspectorates can intervene. The state secretary said the foundation falls outside the health and youth care framework so the Inspectorates lack powers, that existing tools can address abuse but not ban the initiative, and that a study on supervising privately funded boarding schools is underway.

The Youth Care Inspectorate and the Health Care Inspectorate have no statutory power to supervise the foundation because its activities cannot be classified as care or support falling under the health ministry's legislation.

De Inspectie Jeugdzorg en de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg hebben geen wettelijke bevoegdheid om toezicht te houden omdat de activiteiten van de stichting niet kunnen worden aangemerkt als zorg of ondersteuning die tot het domein van de VWS-wetgeving behoort.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over de decentralisatie van de jeugd-ggz

MP Ypma asks the state secretary whether the sector wrongly believes youth mental health care (jeugd-ggz) will not be decentralised to municipalities, what will be done about the Chamber majority's wish to include it, and what measures will be taken against providers and insurers not anticipating decentralisation and how experiments before 2015 will be encouraged. The state secretary confirms decentralisation of jeugd-ggz is in the coalition agreement, promises a bill before summer 2013, and describes a digital library of good practices and a transition plan.
The coalition agreement states that youth care will be decentralised to municipalities in 2015 and that youth mental health care is part of this.
In het regeerakkoord staat dat in 2015 de jeugdzorg wordt gedecentraliseerd naar gemeenten en dat de jeugd-ggz hiervan een onderdeel is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht verstandelijk beperkt echtpaar in de vrieskou

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops asked about a couple with intellectual disabilities evicted from a Dordrecht senior flat over rent arrears, and about cooperation to prevent evictions. The minister answered that the eviction followed a court ruling, that prevention is mainly the landlord's responsibility, that a new prevention covenant with Dordrecht was signed, and that the government will underline the importance of prevention in consultations.
Preventing evictions is a responsibility of landlords.
Het voorkomen van huisuitzettingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van verhuurders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Hilkens over de uitzending van 1Vandaag over de drug GHB

Two MPs from CDA and PvdA asked the state secretaries about a 1Vandaag broadcast on GHB, covering prevention, addiction treatment waiting lists, hospital care, enforcement, and the GBL precursor. The government answered that prevention and local tailored approaches are underway, that treatment capacity is limited and some regions have waiting lists, and that it will commission a quick scan on GBL and consider policy adjustments.
I will instruct the Coordination Committee for Assessment and Monitoring of New Drugs to carry out a quick scan on the use of GBL.
Ik zal de Coördinatiecommissie Assessment en Monitoring nieuwe drugs opdragen een quick scan uit te voeren met betrekking tot het gebruik van GBL
Antwoord vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht dat loverboyslachtoffers hun veiligste haven verliezen

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether no closed youth care facility for girls remains in the Netherlands after the merger of two institutions, and how safe care for loverboy victims is ensured. The State Secretary answered that capacity exists in open and closed youth care across regions, that some girls-only categorical groups exist, that professionals choose between mixed and girls-only groups case by case, and that a categorical pilot is only in an exploratory phase.
With the merger of the institutions De Lindenhorst and Almata, there are no youth care plus institutions where only girls reside.
Met het samengaan van de instellingen De Lindenhorst en Almata zijn er in de jeugdzorg plus geen instellingen waar uitsluitend meisjes verblijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over Turkse pleegkinderen in Europa

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked about a Turkish parliamentary committee chair's claim that Turkey might reclaim Turkish children placed with Christian or gay foster families in Europe, the Hague Convention, and foster-care numbers. The government rejected any idea of Turkish reclaiming of children under the 1961 Convention, said it does not hold the data on Turkish-passport children in care, and offered only to explain Dutch foster-care decision-making if Turkey asks.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over de berichtgeving over de NMa-boetes van € 9 miljoen aan een aantal taxibedrijven vanwege kennelijk schending van mededingingsregels

An MP asked whether NMa fines of €9 million on taxi companies for competition violations affect the award of the Valys patient transport contract to the same companies, and why the award was not reconsidered. The state secretary answered that the violations did not concern the Valys tender itself, that he has been fully informed and is satisfied on continuity, and that he will await the summary proceedings before signing.
A careful weighing starts with having the necessary, complete information.
Een zorgvuldige afweging begint met het beschikken over de daarvoor noodzakelijke, volledige informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de opening van een babyhuis met vondelingenkamer te Dordrecht

An MP asked whether a baby house with an anonymous foundling hatch in Dordrecht conflicts with children's right to know their parents and with better care for pregnant women in need. The government answered that such a hatch breaches children's rights, pointed to a confidential-birth protocol and planned reforms of women's shelter care, and said babyhouse carers are not screened as foster parents under youth-care law.
The babyhouse therefore does not fall under the regular supervision of the inspectorate.
Het babyhuis valt daardoor niet onder het reguliere toezicht van de inspectie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over de opvang van slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP from the Labour party asks whether a merger of youth care institutions will remove closed-care places where girls who are victims of loverboys can be treated, and whether separate care for girls will remain available. The state secretary replies that places are not closed, that a mixed-gender pilot has started, that girl-only specialist groups still exist in youth care plus, and that Fier Fryslân will cooperate with Horizon on specialist trajectories.
No, there is a merger, not the closing of places.
Nee, er is sprake van een fusie, niet van het sluiten van plekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat jongeren geen jeugdzorg meer krijgen vanaf hun 18e levensjaar

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked about reports that young people lose youth care at age 18, with the case of Jabko, an autistic young man with no follow-up placement. The state secretary acknowledged such gaps occur, said he would investigate how often, rejected raising the age limit to 21 for now, and described efforts to develop follow-up care and a working group.
I am willing to investigate how often this happens and to inform the House about it.
Ik ben bereid uit te zoeken hoe vaak dit gebeurt en daarover de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over voortgang jeugdzorg’

An MP asked the state secretaries about a critical report on the progress of the youth care decentralisation, and whether the government shares its concerns. The government says the findings match its agenda, commits to reporting deadlines and a transition plan to parliament, and describes the consultation arrangements with field organisations.
Yes, we commit to that. These points will be included in the transition plan.
Ja, dat zeggen we toe. In het transitieplan zullen deze punten terugkomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over voortgang jeugdzorg’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries for Health and for Justice about concrete activities and results in preparing the youth care transition, before and after November 2012. The government listed the parliamentary letters, debates and the 28 February 2013 letter, and said a transition plan will be sent to parliament after April consultations with VNG and IPO.
The Transition Plan will address the process planning, programme structure, method of steering and allocation of responsibilities.
In het Transitieplan zal worden ingegaan op de procesplanning, de programmastructuur, de wijze van sturing en de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het aantal ondertoezichtstellingen en voogdijmaatregelen

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about the rise in child protection supervision orders (ondertoezichtstellingen) and guardianship placements, the causes of the rise, how municipalities will prevent such measures after decentralisation of youth care, and related budget and caseload questions. The government answered that the rise is likely due to greater attention to child abuse, that numbers have fallen since 2009, that municipalities will be responsible for integrated youth policy and quality requirements under the new law, and that some data (spending by municipalities, caseload averages) cannot be provided or are not planned for research.
Deze vraag is niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat zeker honderd buurthuizen gesloten zijn en vele tientallen met sluiting worden bedreigd

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that about a hundred neighbourhood centres have closed and many more are threatened, asking whether he would count closures, act against them, and agree measures with municipalities. The state secretary replied that closures are a local responsibility under the Wmo, declined to count closures or investigate, and pointed to existing programmes and transition support while refusing to intervene.
Whether or not to close neighbourhood centres is a local responsibility.
Het al dan niet sluiten van buurthuizen is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over kinderen en jongeren in de maatschappelijke en vrouwenopvang

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the rising number of children and young people in shelters, the causes, the link to youth care waiting lists and budget cuts, and prevention measures. The state secretary answers that the figures do not show an absolute rise, explains the varied reasons and support available, notes Veerkracht and prevention efforts, and says gemeenten carry primary responsibility while no additional funding is available.
The budget cut in youth care will not be reversed.
De budgettaire korting in de jeugdzorg wordt niet ongedaan gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht dat steeds meer kinderen in de noodopvang wonen

MPs Tanamal and Ypma asked the state secretary about reports that more children live in emergency shelters, whether this is acceptable, how many children stay long-term, and what will be done. The state secretary agreed children should not be in shelter, said 2012 figures are not yet available, acknowledged some stays exceed a month, and committed to further monitoring and discussions with municipalities and the VNG.
There are not yet any figures known on the number of children who were received in the social shelter in 2012.
Er zijn nog geen cijfers bekend over het aantal kinderen dat in 2012 in de maatschappelijke opvang is opgevangen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over het weigeren van blindengeleidehonden door taxichauffeurs

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked whether taxi drivers refusing guide dogs, shown on PowNews, is acceptable and what measures exist to guarantee taxi accessibility. The state secretary condemned refusals, said municipalities can impose accessibility and carriage duties under the Taxiwet, promised to urge municipalities to act, and said national legislation is not needed.
I will urge the municipalities to include this point in their local taxi regulations.
Ik zal bij de gemeenten aandringen dit punt in hun locale taxiregelgeving op te nemen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Kooiman over het onderzoeken en het tijdig voorkomen van pedofilie

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Kooiman asked about the lack of research on female paedophilia, the availability of help for people with paedophilic feelings, the Stop It Now! helpline and its funding. The minister answered that no separate figures on female offenders or the hidden group exist, that existing bodies do not distinguish offenders by sex, and that funding for Stop It Now! will be reviewed with VWS and reported in April 2013.
Figures on the size of the hidden group of (female) paedophiles do not exist as far as I am aware.
Cijfers over de omvang van de verborgen groep (vrouwelijke) pedofielen bestaan voor zover ik weet niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het onderzoek van Foodwatch

MP Wolbert asked the state secretary about a Foodwatch study finding over 80% of food marketed to children is unhealthy, the reliability of industry self-regulation, public disclosure of violations, and whether a traffic-light labelling system should replace the Vinkje. The secretary acknowledged the findings, said industry self-regulation has improved and is under review, pointed to the Advertising Code Commission as a transparent accountability route, and defended the Vinkje over traffic lights.
I am currently in consultation with the FNLI on this and I expect them to take their responsibility.
Momenteel ben ik hierover in overleg met de FNLI en ik verwacht dat zij haar verantwoordelijkheid pakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over kinderen die de dupe worden van (v)echtscheidingen

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether Youth Care Bureaus see a rising trend of children harmed by high-conflict divorces and what measures will protect them. The government answered that bureaus do not register this problem, that parents bear responsibility for their children's welfare, and pointed to decentralisation of youth care, prevention, and the mandatory parenting plan with the court and Child Protection Board as the safeguard.
The youth care bureaus do not register cases by specific problem type.
De bureaus jeugdzorg registreren niet aan de hand van specifieke problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de oprichting van het meldpunt Klokkenluiders verstandelijk gehandicapten

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Health why a whistleblower reporting point for people with intellectual disabilities was needed, and about complaint handling, the Inspectorate's capacity, and the power of care providers. The State Secretary acknowledged weaknesses in complaints procedures, pointed to planned reforms (Wet cliëntenrechten zorg, a Zorgloket, binding dispute procedures and a cliëntenvertrouwenspersoon) and largely declined to comment on individual cases or specific providers.
I will not comment on the views of individual care institutions such as Stichting Philadelphia Zorg.
Ik laat mij niet uit over de opvatting van individuele zorginstellingen zoals Stichting Philadelphia Zorg.
Antwoord vragen Bergkamp over het bericht dat de jeugdzorg steeds meer zelfstandige ondernemers krijgt

Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that youth care increasingly uses self-employed foster-home operators, including quality, supervision, and the roughly 36,000 euro per child payment. The state secretary said particular providers must meet the same quality standards under a protocol with provinces and the Inspectie Jeugdzorg, but did not have data on the number of children in such homes and said the payment is income plus costs, with motives for becoming a foster parent left to subsidised providers to assess.
I do not have data on the number of children who stay in private foster homes.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over het aantal kinderen dat in particuliere gezinshuizen verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over zijn uitspraken over overheveling van zorgtaken naar gemeenten

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked State Secretary Van Rijn about his remarks that municipalities need not account separately for each decentralised care task, how this relates to the minister's stance, how outcomes will be monitored, and how the VNG's risk warnings, job impacts and continuity of care will be handled. The answers defend integrated budgeting with monitoring at the level of the whole social domain, promise a letter on long-term care, and decline to guarantee that all current AWBZ care will remain equally available.
Requiring financial accountability per component would unnecessarily frustrate this desired integrated approach.
Financiële verantwoording vragen per onderdeel zou deze gewenste integrale benadering onnodig frustreren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over ondertoezichtstellingen die vele jaren worden verlengd

An MP asked whether repeated extensions of child supervision orders (OTS) lasting many years should be capped by law, and whether financial incentives for youth-protection organisations discourage foster guardianship. The government declined a statutory maximum, pointing to case-by-case judicial review, the pending bill with a prospect-based test and Raad voor de Kinderbescherming advice, and said it knows of no such financial practice.
Ultimately, it is the children's judge who, after carefully weighing all interests, judges whether the measure should continue.
Uiteindelijk is het de kinderrechter die na zorgvuldige afweging van alle belangen een oordeel geeft over de noodzaak om de maatregel al dan niet te laten voortduren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over misstanden bij Pleyade

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Social Affairs about understaffing, neglect and union access at care provider Pleyade, including a staff diary sent to the Inspectorate. The government answered that the Inspectorate monitors the institution, that the care provider is primarily responsible for staffing and quality, and that the Inspectorate will revisit and gather information, without committing to new extra inspections.
Following the diary, the IGZ requested information from Altenova. Once the IGZ has received the information it will visit Altenova again.
De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van het dagboek informatie opgevraagd bij Altenova. Als de IGZ de informatie heeft ontvangen zal zij Altenova nogmaals bezoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat mensen geen tegemoetkoming vanuit de Wtcg hebben ontvangen

An SP MP asks the state secretary why people entitled to a Wtcg allowance for chronically ill and disabled people have not been paid, how many are affected, and what will prevent recurrence. The state secretary attributes non-payment mainly to incomplete or incorrect client data (bank details), notes that about 85,000 payments were outstanding in early 2013 with 53,000 paid in January-February, and declines further measures.
Incomplete or incorrect client data are the main cause of the allowance not being paid (on time).
Onvolledige of incorrecte klantgegevens zijn de belangrijkste oorzaak van het niet (tijdig) uitbetalen van de tegemoetkoming Wtcg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over het bericht dat de afstemming tussen ketenpartners bij de aanpak van huiselijk geweld beter moet

MP Hilkens asked the ministers about reports that coordination among partners in tackling domestic violence must improve, including a fatal Maastricht case, data sharing, and decentralisation. The minister answered that an external commission found inadequate integrated handling and weak steering in Maastricht, that recommendations are being implemented, and that privacy law is not seen as a blocking factor.

However, the commission also concluded that the agencies involved, deviating from the Directive on Domestic and Honour-Related Violence, did not handle this domestic violence case sufficiently in an integrated way.

De commissie heeft echter ook geconcludeerd dat de betrokken instanties, in afwijking van de Aanwijzing Huiselijk Geweld en Eergerelateerd Geweld 2 , deze huiselijk geweldzaak onvoldoende integraal hebben benaderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Agema over de absurde Turkse inmenging in aangelegenheden van pleegzorg in Nederland

PVV MPs De Roon and Agema asked whether Turkey may interfere in placement of Turkish foster children in the Netherlands and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg should stop contact with a Turkish inquiry commission. The state secretary answered that Dutch law already sets careful placement rules, that Turkey has no authority over Turkish-national foster children here, and that the Netherlands will explain its procedures if Turkish authorities ask.
The Turkish government has no authority over foster children in the Netherlands who have Turkish nationality.
De Turkse regering heeft geen zeggenschap over pleegkinderen in Nederland met de Turkse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over Turkse pleegkinderen

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked about Turkish criticism of Dutch foster care for Turkish children, whether Turkey has authority over them, and whether foster parents can be excluded on religion or sexual orientation. The state secretary answered that placement follows careful rules considering the child's religious and cultural background, that Turkey has no authority over these children, and that exclusion on religion or sexual orientation is not allowed.
I am willing to report to the House on this.
Ik ben bereid hierover verslag te doen aan de Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Na de commissie blijft het akelig stil rond seksueel misbruik’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about criticism of the ministry over sexual abuse in youth care after the Samson commission report, and about the number of recommendations adopted. The state secretary answered that 26 of 28 recommendations are adopted, that a quality framework by Jeugdzorg Nederland is being prepared, and that Parliament will be informed in May 2013.
26 of the 28 recommendations are adopted by the government.
26 van de 28 aanbevelingen neemt de regering over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het rapport ‘sociaal economische gevolgen van echtscheiding’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretaries and minister about a report on the socio-economic costs of divorce, including its effects on health, well-being, public finances, poverty risk and family policy. The government answered that the report does not directly establish effects on public finances and that a further cost study would not isolate causal links, pointed to work participation and social safety nets against poverty, and described the handreiking and planned evaluations on relationship support and family policy.
In view of the above, further research into the total societal costs of divorce will be insufficient to demonstrate causal relationships.
Gezien het voorgaande zal nader onderzoek naar de omvang van de totale maatschappelijke kosten van echtscheiding onvoldoende oorzakelijke verbanden kunnen aantonen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars verpleegkundig specialisten niet als hoofdbehandelaar erkennen

MP Wolbert asked the minister whether insurers refuse to recognise nurse specialists as main treating professionals, why the issue persists, and how the government will improve use of their skills. The minister confirmed insurers restrict main-treater status, including for nurse specialists, and pointed to a pending IGZ advice and a field norm on main-treater status as the route to clarity.
I therefore expect that the IGZ advice will give more insight into the considerations of health insurers regarding main-treater status.
Ik verwacht daarom dat het advies van de IGZ meer inzicht zal geven in de overwegingen van de zorgverzekeraars op het gebied van het hoofdbehandelaarschap.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over ouderen die letterlijk in de kou zitten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about elderly residents at a care home being kept cold, the home's large reserves despite not funding repairs, and whether the inspectorate checks temperature. The state secretary answered that a technical pump fault caused the cold, a replacement was installed, maintenance is ongoing, temperature is not a separate inspection criterion, and the inspectorate will raise it during a planned visit.
Temperature is not a separate criterion that the inspectorate checks.
Temperatuur is geen apart criterium waar de inspectie op toeziet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat de activiteiten van de stichting Ombudsman op 1 juni a.s. worden beëindigd

MP Bergkamp asked whether the closure of the Stichting De Ombudsman's activities, after subsidies for patient and broadcast-related organisations ended, means social-legal assistance disappears, and who takes it over and how it fits the Wmo and AWBZ reforms. The state secretary answered that CG-Raad, Platform VG, NPCF and Landelijk Platform GGZ will provide legal support to their own members from April 2013 via a new joint service, that municipalities are not responsible for funding the national foundation, and that the care reform letter will address citizens' safeguards.
In my policy letter on the reform of long-term care I will go into detail on the safeguards for and position of the citizen.
In mijn beleidsbrief over de hervorming van de langdurige zorg zal ik uitgebreid ingaan op de waarborgen voor en de positie van de burger.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Falende aanpak jongeren” (onderzoek van instituut Movisie)

An MP asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to a Movisie study finding that youth policy and youth-work/police cooperation fall short, including on prevention, unemployment and reporting crime. The secretary answers that local municipalities are primarily responsible, describes good cooperation and prevention efforts, and says the study's recommendations will be shared with municipalities via the VNG.
The municipality is responsible for (steering) the approach to youth nuisance.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor de (regie op de) aanpak van jongerenoverlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het gebruik van persoonsgebonden budget in het buitenland

An MP from GroenLinks asked why PGB holders may purchase AWBZ care abroad, even within the EU, for only 13 calendar weeks per year, while care in kind has no such time limit. The state secretary answered that the 13-week limit aligns with restitution rules and that EU law requires no export of cash payments like the PGB, so the difference is justified, and he sees no reason to extend the period.
I see no reason to extend the 13-week period during which the granted PGB can be used abroad.
Ik zie geen reden om de periode van 13 weken waarin het toegekende pgb in het buitenland kan doorlopen te verruimen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat GGD Nederland, het Trimbos-instituut en het Nederlands Instituut voor Alcoholbeleid (STAP) adviseren zo snel mogelijk over te stappen op effectieve leeftijds

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether they support calls by GGD Nederland, Trimbos and STAP for supermarkets to adopt effective age verification for alcohol sales, and what they will do to ensure this. The government supports the call, notes that enforcement has passed to municipalities with new sanction powers, and agrees that effective age checks would reduce municipal supervision burden.
We support the call of these parties.
Wij ondersteunen de oproep van deze partijen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over mensen met een complexe meervoudige zorgvraag

An MP asks the state secretary about the timeline for implementing the Denktank Complexe zorg report, sufficiency of places and CCE request volumes, extreme care budgets, CCE access to institutions, and Inspectorate complaints about people with complex multiple care needs. The secretary points to the Actieplan Onvrijwillige Zorg and the Zorg en dwang bill, acknowledges long waiting times, gives figures on requests and budget, and reports few complaints, with no full answer on how many dependents live at home.
I do not know how many situations there are of children/young people living at home who could not or would not be admitted to an institution.
Ik weet niet hoeveel situaties er zijn van thuiswonende kinderen/jongeren die niet in een instelling zouden kunnen of willen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Megasalaris van 180.000 euro voor adviseur thuiszorgorganisatie ZuidZorg’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a former ZuidZorg board member received a 180,000 euro salary as an adviser, and why the full board could not do the work. The state secretary answered that the arrangement stemmed from existing contract terms, that the organisation claims the adviser's expertise was needed for property files and financial risks, and that overhead is about 15%, while he cannot independently verify the organisation's claims.
I can of course not assess whether what Zuidzorg states is correct.
Ik kan uiteraard niet beoordelen of hetgeen Zuidzorg aangeeft juist is.
Antwoord vragen Keijzer en Omtzigt over casussen van verontruste burgers

CDA MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Health about anonymised citizen cases showing sharply higher care contributions from the asset-income surcharge (VIB) and about treatment of homes, letselschade, landgoederen and the pocket-money threshold. The secretary answered most questions in substance, admitted some cases did not reconcile with available data, pointed to CAK follow-up, and said the revenue estimate was still too early to confirm.
I am consulting with the CAK to determine how this limited group of clients should be handled.
Ik ben in overleg met het CAK om te bezien hoe met deze beperkte groep cliënten om kan worden gegaan.
Antwoord vragen Kuzu over een tekort aan opvangplekken voor dakloze gezinnen

MPs Kuzu and Ypma asked about a shortage of shelter places for homeless families, families being turned away, mixing with psychiatric or addicted people, daytime access, and whether a plan of action is needed. Secretary of State Van Rijn said the situation is undesirable in places, that data is lacking and monitoring is commissioned, that preventive measures are preferred over a separate plan of action, and that he will inform parliament before summer.
Neither the VNG nor the Federatie Opvang, the umbrella organisation of shelter institutions, knows how many families have become homeless over the past five years or how many are on a waiting list.

Bij de VNG en bij de Federatie Opvang, de koepelorganisatie van de instellingen voor maatschappelijke opvang, is niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen de afgelopen vijf jaar dakloos zijn geraakt en hoeveel er op een wachtlijst staan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat meer kinderen seksueel worden uitgebuit

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked about reports that more children are sexually exploited, including whether agencies under-report victims and whether the government underestimates the problem. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers, saying CoMensha records age at the time of reporting, describing pilots and training to spot trafficking signals, and denying a structural shortage of shelter places.
It is being examined whether additional information on victims can be supplied to CoMensha and recorded in a new registration system.
Er wordt bekeken of het mogelijk is aanvullende informatie over slachtoffers aan CoMensha te leveren en te registreren in een nieuw registratiesysteem.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het stopzetten van de vervoersregeling voor gehandicapte teamsporters

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether she is aware that the Fonds Gehandicaptensport has ended its transport scheme for disabled team athletes due to insufficient funds, and whether she will seek a structural solution. The minister confirmed the facts and stated that she is consulting with stakeholders on options for a structural solution, promising to inform parliament by 15 March 2013.
Together with the parties involved, I am in consultation to explore the possibilities of reaching a structural solution for the transport scheme.
Samen met betrokken partijen ben ik in overleg om de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om tot een structurele oplossing te komen voor de vervoersregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over het gebrek aan dranktoezicht van de gemeenten

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about municipalities being unprepared for taking over alcohol enforcement from the NVWA on 1 January 2013, including the shortage of trained enforcement officers and the risk of more youth alcohol access. The government acknowledged the reports, said a transitional arrangement lets untrained officers work within a year of appointment, expects municipalities to train staff, and says the NVWA's team remains available in 2013 to support them.
In the coming months I will closely monitor developments regarding the decentralisation of supervision.
De komende maanden zal ik de ontwikkelingen omtrent de decentralisatie van het toezicht op de voet volgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het makkelijker aan drank komen door jongeren

An MP asked the state secretary whether the 1 January 2013 decentralisation of alcohol law enforcement to municipalities would make it easier for youths to obtain alcohol, and how enforcement was progressing. The state secretary rejected that conclusion, said some municipalities were not yet ready but a transition arrangement applies, and pointed to NVWA support and guidance for municipalities.
In the coming months I will closely monitor developments regarding the decentralisation of supervision.
De komende maanden zal ik de ontwikkelingen omtrent de decentralisatie van het toezicht op de voet volgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rutte over de handhaving van het rookverbod in de horeca

An MP from the VVD asks the state secretary about low enforcement of the smoking ban in hospitality, citing about 3,000 checks against some 60,000 establishments, and questions the adequacy of inspection and the absence of checks in some regions. The state secretary replies that 3,154 targeted checks were carried out in cafés and discotheques (about 10,000 establishments), that 14,074 food safety inspections also flagged smoking, that rural areas are checked less, and that enforcement is as optimal as current NVWA capacity allows.
In my view there is no question of a low level of control effort.
Mijns inziens is er geen sprake van een geringe controle-inspanning.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over de onzekerheid ten aanzien van wijkverpleegkundigen in de Zichtbare Schakel

An MP asked the health minister whether municipalities were spending only half of the Zichtbare Schakel budget on district nurse projects and how spending would be monitored. The minister said the projects are not being stopped, municipalities may not redirect the funds, and ZonMw will set up a monitor, though details remain undecided.
On your questions about municipalities not spending the funds on Zichtbare schakel projects, we cannot give an answer given the answers to the previous questions.
Op uw vragen over het niet besteden van de middelen door gemeenten aan Zichtbare schakel projecten kunnen wij – gegeven de antwoorden op voorgaande vragen – geen antwoord geven.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de effecten van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling voor het bepalen van de eigen bijdrage voor de Algemene Wet Bijzondere Ziektekosten (AWBZ) en de Wet maatschappelijke onderst

An SGP MP asked the state secretary for Health about the actual revenue, average increase, and distribution of the box III wealth income add-on (vermogensinkomensbijtelling) on care contributions under the AWBZ and Wmo, including impacts on people with illiquid assets. The state secretary said early intramural revenue is in the expected range, extramural and Wmo figures are not yet known, provided tables of box III wealth bands and age groups, and will examine the measure's effects before discussing consequences with the Chamber.
It is now too early to state with certainty what the revenue will be.
Het is nu te vroeg om met zekerheid aan te geven wat de opbrengst zal worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de eigen bijdragen WMO/ AWBZ door de Vermogensinkomensbijstelling

An MP asked the state secretary how people facing higher AWBZ/Wmo co-payments due to the capital-income add-back were informed, whether the measure was included in the CPB and Nibud purchasing-power calculations, and how chronically ill people and people with disabilities are affected. The government answered that about 238,000 clients were notified by letter, the measure was not included in those calculations, and the CAK does not record chronic illness or disability, so the number affected is unknown.
The CAK does not record whether insured persons who owe an AWBZ or Wmo co-payment have a chronic illness or a disability.
Het CAK registreert niet of de verzekerden die een eigen bijdrage AWBZ of WMO verschuldigd zijn, chronisch ziek zijn of een beperking hebben.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Smits inzake pesten bij kinderen van 4 tot 18 jaar

Two MPs asked the state secretary about bullying programmes, budgets, effectiveness, inter-policy coordination, the government's role, school sanctions and school safety monitoring. The government answered at length, describing programmes and budgets, noting evaluations are not yet complete, promising a plan of action in March, and reporting that no clear trend in bullying has been found.
The studies from the Onderwijs Bewijs action programme have not yet been completed.
De onderzoeken uit het actieprogramma Onderwijs Bewijs zijn nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord vragen Keijzer over de berichten ‘Dreigend ontslag 287 thuiszorgmedewerkers’ en ‘Honderden medewerkers thuiszorg Rotterdam op straat’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary about reports of dismissal threats for home-care workers in Rotterdam and the uncertainty this causes for staff and clients, and whether municipalities comply with article 10a of the Wmo on staff transfer between providers.
