The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for overseeing transfer talks, that the statutory duty is sufficient, that no overview exists of how municipalities apply it, and that he is willing to discuss it with the VNG.
I am willing to discuss with the VNG whether it could be useful to additionally point municipalities to the different ways they can give effect to article 10a.
Ik ben bereid met de VNG in gesprek te gaan om te bezien of het zinvol kan zijn om gemeenten aanvullend te wijzen op de verschillende manieren waarop zij invulling kunnen geven aan artikel 10a.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het gebruik van alcohol tijden de zwangerschap

An MP asked the health minister about inconsistent no-alcohol advice in pregnancy among gynaecologists, midwives and GPs, and what government should do to publicise it and target low-SES women. The minister acknowledged the findings, said professional bodies and the Partnership Vroegsignalering Alcohol will raise awareness, pointed to existing preconception campaigns and municipal duties, and gave no new binding commitment.
The PVA will bring the gynaecologists' shortcoming to the attention of the KNMG, with which it cooperates on early signalling.

Het PVA zal het knelpunt voor wat betreft gynaecologen onder de aandacht brengen via de Koninklijke Nederlandsche Maatschappij tot bevordering der Geneeskunst (KNMG), waarmee samenwerking op het gebied van vroegsignalering plaatsvindt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht minder kinderen in jeugdinstellingen in Zeeland

MPs Ypma and De Vries asked about a report that fewer children in Zeeland are placed in youth institutions thanks to the wraparound care model, and whether this model should guide the transition of youth care to municipalities. The state secretary answered that the Zeeland method is a good example for the transition, though it has not yet reduced placements, and pointed to existing models, shared learning platforms and funding for pilots.
I will further examine how we can make these good examples more visible.
Ik ga nader bezien hoe wij deze goede voorbeelden meer zichtbaar kunnen maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over de te hoge werkdruk bij verpleegkundigen

MP Wolbert asked the minister about nursing staff reporting workloads too high to keep working until retirement, and asked how the government would retain care staff and reduce workload. The minister answered that the employer and employees bear primary responsibility, cited existing arbo tools and inspectorate checks, and listed government programmes on sustainable employability and professional pride.
It is primarily their responsibility, together with employees, to manage the workload and improve job satisfaction.
Het is primair hun verantwoordelijkheid om, in samenwerking met werknemers, de werkdruk te beheersen en de werktevredenheid te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over het bericht van slechte zorg en intimidatie in de locatie voor gehandicaptenzorg “Kleine Johannes” van de zorginstelling Amsta

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports of poor care, intimidation, unhygienic rooms, staff shortages and a visiting restriction imposed on a parent at the Kleine Johannes disability care location run by Amsta. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate placed the location under intensified supervision for six months on 3 December 2012, that it found high risks in restrictive measures and support plans, and that the Inspectorate handles individual complaints and cases while visiting restrictions are a matter for the institution and family to resolve.

That is why the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate placed the 'De Kleine Johannes' location under intensified supervision for six months from 3 December 2012 and is meanwhile conducting further investigation.

Daarom heeft de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (hierna: Inspectie) de locatie «De Kleine Johannes» op 3 december 2012 – voor een periode van 6 maanden – onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld en doet zij ondertussen nader onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Keijzer over de bezuiniging op dagbesteding in 2013

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked how the planned 2013-2014 savings on day care (dagbesteding) and personal care under the AWBZ-to-Wmo transfer were built up, and about client numbers, new applications, admissions to institutions and costs per ZZP. The state secretary gave partial figures, explained the savings assumptions, said the final implementation may differ, and promised a letter to the House in early 2013 on the policy.
No data are available on clients assessed by the Bureaus Jeugdzorg.
Van de cliënten geïndiceerd door de Bureaus Jeugdzorg zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Agema over het bericht dat de gemeente Smallingerland opvang voor uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers wil betalen met geld dat bedoeld is voor mensen met een beperking

MPs Fritsma and Agema asked whether the government will stop the municipality of Smallingerland from providing shelter to rejected asylum seekers using funds meant for people with disabilities, and how it will ensure return policy is not undermined. The state secretary said the municipality's plans were not yet clear, that municipalities have discretion over their own funds, and that the government will keep pursuing active return policy, without committing to any new concrete step against the municipality.
It is not yet clear whether and how the municipality will actually provide (emergency) shelter to these people and how this will be financed.
Het is nog niet duidelijk of en hoe de gemeente daadwerkelijk (nood)opvang gaat bieden aan deze mensen en op welke wijze een en ander gefinancierd gaat worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over de acties in de verpleeghuiszorg van 3 november jl

MPs Kuzu, Leijten and Voortman asked whether care provider Amsta received intensification funds for extra staff yet did not hire them, and questioned executive pay and strike-related measures. The state secretary answered that Amsta received about 4.1 million euros, reported on its use via a progress report, and that the government does not intend to request an overview from each institution; he also stated the right to strike is not in question.
Beyond the oversight of the care office, I monitor the progress of the realisation of the extra funds at macro level.
Naast het toezicht van het zorgkantoor monitor ik op macroniveau de voortgang van de realisatie van de extra middelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over een innovatieplatform ten behoeve van de transitie jeugdzorg

An MP asks the state secretaries whether differences in municipal readiness for the youth care transition, the value of innovative pilot projects, and the need for an innovation platform should be addressed. The government answers that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that existing support and knowledge-sharing are in place, and that it will consult the field on whether a platform is needed.
In consultation with the field I want to discuss and test whether there is a need for a platform and how the exchange of innovative projects can be improved.
In overleg met het veld wil ik bespreken en toetsen of er behoefte is aan een platform en hoe de uitwisseling van innovatieve projecten kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de situatie bij Altenova

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the dispute at care centre Altenova, including whether union AbvaKabo was refused access, how many staff the intensification funds (EUR 1.6 million) created, and how care offices supervise spending. The state secretary answered that access is only by appointment, that about 20 FTE were funded, and that care offices supervise spending as part of regular contracting.
Agreements have been made with the care offices on supervising the efficient use of the extra funds.
Met de zorgkantoren zijn afspraken gemaakt over het toezicht op de doelmatige aanwending van de extra middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat in korte tijd twee gehandicapte bewoners zijn overleden bij zorginstelling Bartimeus

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about reports of two deaths of disabled residents at care institution Bartimeus, linked to a reorganisation, staff fears, intimidation, oversight and executive pay. The state secretary answered that investigations by the Inspectorate (IGZ) and an external bureau are ongoing, that the reorganisation was approved by the supervisory board and works councils, that the IGZ has received few staff reports, and that enforcement depends on the IGZ findings.
The IGZ wants to receive the outcomes of this investigation by 2 December at the latest and will use them in its own investigation.
De IGZ wil de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek uiterlijk vóór 2 december ontvangen en zal dit gebruiken bij haar eigen onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het schrappen van de functie huishoudelijke verzorging

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Health about Thebe's plan to drop the home-help (thuishulp) function and offer staff a pay cut or dismissal, and whether municipalities should stop this. The state secretary says the business decision is Thebe's, the social plan is a matter between employer and employees, municipalities remain responsible for providing help, and the government plans to restrict household help under long-term care reform.
It is up to municipalities to enable citizens, where necessary, to run a household and to deliver the tailored provision offered.
Het is aan gemeenten om burgers waar nodig in staat te stellen een huishouden te voeren en de op basis van maatwerk aangeboden voorziening uit te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanhoudende misstanden bij HWW Zorg

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about persistent abuses at care provider HWW Zorg, including underfunding from wrong care-intensity classifications, understaffing, intimidation of staff, neglect of residents, and whether directors can be held liable. The State Secretary answers that the provider is primarily responsible, the Inspectorate received no report of the incident, and the government will present a vision on governance including director liability.
I cannot assess whether and to what extent staff are being intimidated. In its next visits the IGZ will speak with staff and the client council.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of en zo ja in hoeverre personeel wordt geïntimideerd. In haar volgende bezoeken zal IGZ gaan praten met medewerkers en cliëntenraad.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over de AWBZ tariefskorting in de vier grote steden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health whether AWBZ tariff reductions are imposed on care providers in the four largest cities, why parliament was not informed, and how this fits with needed quality improvements. The government replied that there is no city-specific tariff reduction, that contracts between care providers and care offices may set lower rates than NZa maximums, and that contracting space is not reduced.
There is no tariff reduction specifically aimed at the major cities.
Er is geen sprake van een tariefskorting, specifiek gericht op de grote steden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Keijzer en Heerma over de impact van voorgenomen bezuinigingen in het regeerakkoord voor de langdurige ouderenzorg in Nederland

CDA MPs Keijzer and Heerma asked whether the government accepts Gupta's finding that proposed long-term care cuts could cut purchasing power by up to 63% for heavy care users, and whether older people and middle/higher-income groups would be disproportionately hit. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that outcomes depend on how cuts are implemented, that no income guarantees are given, and that the proposals will be worked out with municipalities and target groups.
The cabinet never gives purchasing-power guarantees, so it cannot do so in this case either.
Het kabinet geeft nooit koopkrachtgaranties, dus kan dit in dit geval ook niet doen.
